papers.title: CPI-Bench: A Comprehensive,Practical and Intelligent Benchmark for Real-World Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of image editing models and their widespread application across various domains, there is an increasingly urgent need to deploy these model capabilities directly into real-world scenarios. However, existing benchmarks remain confined to simple single-image tasks, suffering from limited coverage dimensions and an inability to effectively differentiate performance among diverse models. Consequently, they fail to reliably evaluate model performance in complex multi-image editing, highly demanding reasoning instructions, and practical deployment settings. To address these limitations, we propose CPI-Bench, a Comprehensive, Practical andIntelligent benchmark for real-world image editing. CPI-Bench comprises three core subsets: CPI-General-Bench, which comprehensively covers diverse editing tasks and pioneers the inclusion of multi-image editing evaluation; CPI-Practical-Bench, which focuses on high-frequency real-user application scenarios; and CPI-Intelligent-Bench, which is dedicated to evaluating capabilities in highly demanding reasoning-based editing. Evaluation results of mainstream image editing models based on CPI-Bench demonstrate that CPI-Bench enhances performance differentiation among models. It provides a comprehensive and reliable quantification of gaps in general editing capabilities, practical deployment efficacy, and advanced reasoning-based editing, offering invaluable guidance for the future optimization of image editing models. Crucially, our ranking analysis reveals that CPI-Bench achieves the highest alignment with the Arena Image Edit Leaderboard, indicating it faithfully captures the preferences and perceptual judgments of human evaluators, serving as a robust proxy for real-world user experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CPI-Bench，一个面向真实世界图像编辑的综合、实用且智能的基准，包含三个核心子集：CPI-General-Bench（覆盖多样编辑任务并首创多图像编辑评测）、CPI-Practical-Bench（聚焦高频真实用户应用场景）和 CPI-Intelligent-Bench（评测高要求推理型编辑）。基于主流图像编辑模型的评测显示，该基准增强了模型间的性能区分度，且其排名与 Arena Image Edit Leaderboard 对齐度最高，可作为人类评估者偏好与感知判断的可靠代理。
Motivation: 现有图像编辑基准局限于简单单图像任务，覆盖维度有限，难以区分不同模型的性能，无法可靠评估复杂多图像编辑、高要求推理指令以及实际部署场景下的模型表现。
Method: 提出 CPI-Bench，包含三个子集：通用子集全面覆盖多样编辑任务并首次纳入多图像编辑评测，实用子集聚焦真实用户高频应用场景，智能子集专门评估需要高推理能力的编辑任务。
Result: 基于主流图像编辑模型的评估显示，CPI-Bench 增强了模型间的性能区分度；排名分析表明其与 Arena Image Edit Leaderboard 对齐度最高，能忠实反映人类评估者的偏好与感知判断。
Conclusion: 该基准提供了对通用编辑能力、实际部署效能和高级推理编辑差距的全面可靠量化，为图像编辑模型的未来优化提供指导，并可作为真实用户体验的稳健代理。

papers.title: MagnifiQ: Patch-aware Text Guided Progressive Upscaling for High-Resolution Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution image restoration from degraded inputs is challenging because it must preserve global structural consistency while recovering fine-grained local details, especially at 4K resolution where direct diffusion-based restoration is computationally expensive and prone to repeated or inconsistent textures. In this work, we introduce MagnifiQ, an image restoration framework that progressively upscales and restores images across resolutions, e.g., from 1024x1024 to 4096x4096. Our approach leverages a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model such as SDXL and adapts it for more scalable high-resolution inference by replacing its original self-attention layers with convolutional operations whose computational cost grows linearly with image resolution. We further propose a progressive upscaling strategy that iteratively restores images over multiple resolution stages, refining each intermediate output rather than directly hallucinating the final 4K image, thereby improving global coherence and reducing high-resolution artifacts. To enhance local details while controlling content drift, MagnifiQ uses patch-specific text prompts that provide spatially localized semantic guidance during restoration. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world degraded images show that MagnifiQ outperforms prior diffusion-based restoration methods in perceptual quality and human preference, producing sharper textures and more coherent 4K results while offering practical speed--quality trade-offs through its scalable backbone and progressive design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MagnifiQ，一个用于高分辨率图像恢复的框架，通过渐进式跨分辨率上采样（如从 1024x1024 到 4096x4096）来恢复图像。方法基于预训练文本到图像扩散模型（如 SDXL），将原始自注意力层替换为计算成本随分辨率线性增长的卷积操作，并引入多分辨率阶段的渐进式上采样策略以及 patch-specific 文本提示以提供空间局部语义引导。实验表明，该框架在合成与真实退化图像上优于先前的扩散式恢复方法，在感知质量和人类偏好上表现更好，同时提供实际的速度-质量权衡。
Motivation: 高分辨率（尤其是 4K）图像恢复需要在保持全局结构一致性的同时恢复细粒度局部细节，而直接基于扩散的恢复计算昂贵且容易产生重复或不一致的纹理。
Method: 采用预训练文本到图像扩散模型（如 SDXL）作为基础，用卷积操作替换其自注意力层以实现可扩展的高分辨率推理；提出渐进式上采样策略，在多个分辨率阶段迭代恢复并细化中间输出，而非直接生成最终 4K 图像；同时使用 patch-specific 文本提示提供空间局部化的语义指导，以增强细节并控制内容漂移。
Result: 在合成和真实退化图像上的大量实验显示，MagnifiQ 在感知质量和人类偏好上优于先前的扩散式恢复方法，产生更锐利的纹理和更连贯的 4K 结果，并通过可扩展骨干与渐进式设计提供实用的速度-质量权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调其可扩展骨干与渐进式设计能够在不直接幻觉最终高清图像的情况下改善全局连贯性并减少高分辨率伪影，从而为高分辨率恢复提供更实用的速度-质量折中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generation-Powered Inference for Distribution-Valued Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Modern generative models increasingly produce distribution-valued outputs, such as predicted cellular responses to genetic perturbations in single-cell genomics. While these models provide valuable auxiliary information, they are inherently imperfect, creating a need for statistical methods that leverage their predictions without relying on their correctness. We propose generation-powered inference (GPI), a general framework for improving inference on distribution-valued parameters using auxiliary generative models. Focusing on Wasserstein barycenters and related distributional functionals, we introduce a function-valued bridge representation that transforms inference in the nonlinear Wasserstein space into estimation of a mean function in a Hilbert space, enabling an augmented estimation framework analogous to prediction-powered inference. We develop a family of GPI estimators with optimal information borrowing, establish consistency, asymptotic normality, and simultaneous confidence bands, and derive valid inference for linear functionals and Wasserstein distances. Simulation studies demonstrate efficiency gains over labeled-data-only methods and robust performance under generative model misspecification. We illustrate the proposed framework using a Perturb-seq study of K562 cells, where synthetic perturbation responses generated by the State foundation model are used to improve inference for pathway-level consensus gene expression distributions associated with perturbations of the 40S ribosome module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 generation-powered inference (GPI)，一个利用辅助生成模型改进分布值参数推断的通用框架，重点针对 Wasserstein 重心及相关的分布泛函。作者引入函数值桥表示 (function-valued bridge representation)，将非线性 Wasserstein 空间中的推断转化为 Hilbert 空间中均值函数的估计，从而构建类似 prediction-powered inference 的增强估计框架。摘要报告了估计量的一致性、渐近正态性和同步置信带，并通过模拟和单细胞 Perturb-seq 数据验证。
Motivation: 现代生成模型越来越常输出分布值结果（如单细胞基因组学中预测的细胞对遗传扰动的响应），但这些模型本质上不完美，需要在不依赖其正确性的前提下利用其预测来改进推断。现有统计方法对非线性 Wasserstein 空间中分布值参数的推断处理不足。
Method: 提出 GPI 框架，用函数值桥表示将 Wasserstein 重心的推断转化为 Hilbert 空间中均值函数的估计，从而得到一种类似 prediction-powered inference 的增强估计框架；发展一族具有最优信息借用 (optimal information borrowing) 的 GPI 估计量，并建立一致性、渐近正态性和同步置信带，同时为线性泛函和 Wasserstein 距离导出有效推断。
Result: 模拟研究表明 GPI 相比仅使用带标签数据的方法有效率提升，并在生成模型误设定 (misspecification) 下表现稳健。在 K562 细胞的 Perturb-seq 研究中，使用 State foundation model 生成的合成扰动响应，改善了对与 40S 核糖体模块扰动相关的通路级共识基因表达分布的推断。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架可以在不要求辅助生成模型正确的前提下改进分布值参数的统计推断，并在单细胞扰动响应分析中得到应用验证；方法目前聚焦于 Wasserstein 重心及相关的分布泛函。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Decoding the Past: An Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning Framework for Sex Attribution in Prehistoric Hand Stencils
papers.abstract_en: Determining the biological sex of the individuals who created Upper Paleolithic hand stencils remains a challenging problem due to the absence of ground truth, population differences between contemporary and prehistoric groups, and the uncertainty introduced by image degradation. Traditional morphometric methods suffer from high structural overlap across sexes, poor cross-population generalizability, and subjective feature engineering. This study presents an uncertainty-aware deep learning framework for sex attribution in prehistoric hand stencils that explicitly models, propagates, and aggregates uncertainty throughout the analytical pipeline. The methodology combines dual image processing, dual contour extraction, structured silhouette augmentation, model architectural diversity, and ensemble-based decision aggregation. The pipeline generates twelve plausible silhouette realizations per stencil to capture boundary uncertainties, which are processed by two ensembles of ten deep neural networks each (EfficientNet-B3 and MobileViT-S) trained on 14,036 contemporary hand samples. Furthermore, a triangulated validation scheme integrates ensemble predictions with unsupervised 2D latent-space manifold mapping (UMAP + k-NN) and explainable AI spatial attributions (LayerCAM) to ensure anatomical consistency. On contemporary data, ensemble models achieve strong classification performance, with accuracies exceeding 88% in older age groups. When applied to prehistoric stencils, the framework produces both sex predictions and confidence measures of internal agreement, enabling the distinction between morphologically stable and ambiguous cases. Convergence across ensemble predictions, latent-space structure, and interpretability analyses shows that uncertainty can become a measurable component of archaeological inference, enabling robust and reproducible decoding of ancient rock art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种不确定性感知 (uncertainty-aware) 的深度学习框架，用于推断旧石器时代晚期手印模板 (hand stencils) 创作者的生物性别。该框架显式地对不确定性进行建模、传播与聚合，结合双图像处理、双轮廓提取、结构化剪影增强、模型架构多样性与集成决策，并为每个模板生成十二种轮廓实现以捕捉边界不确定性。在当代手部样本上集成模型在较年长年龄组中准确率超过 88%，应用于史前手印时同时给出性别预测与内部一致性置信度。
Motivation: 由于缺乏真实标签、当代与史前人群差异以及图像退化带来的不确定性，推断旧石器时代手印模板创作者的生物性别一直很困难；传统形态学方法存在性别间结构重叠高、跨人群泛化性差和特征工程主观等问题。
Method: 框架由两个各含十个深度神经网络的集成组成（EfficientNet-B3 和 MobileViT-S），在 14,036 个当代手部样本上训练；每个模板生成十二个合理的剪影实现以捕获边界不确定性。此外，采用三角化验证方案，将集成预测与无监督二维潜空间流形映射（UMAP + k-NN）以及可解释人工智能空间归因（LayerCAM）相结合，以保证解剖一致性。
Result: 在当代数据上，集成模型在较年长年龄组中分类准确率超过 88%；应用于史前手印时，框架同时输出性别预测和内部一致性置信度，能够区分形态稳定与模糊的案例。
Conclusion: 集成预测、潜空间结构与可解释性分析之间的收敛表明，不确定性可以成为考古推断中可测量的组成部分，从而支持对古代岩画进行稳健且可复现的解码。

papers.title: Marionette: Predicting World States, Rendering Geometry, Painting Appearance
papers.abstract_en: Interactive game world models typically autoregress visual observations directly in pixel or latent space, forcing structured properties such as pose, geometry, and occlusion to be implicitly maintained by the same generative sequence. Over long horizons, errors in these latent world properties accumulate, making consistency and controllability fragile. We explicitly model the evolving world state, delegate exact geometric computation to a fixed, zero-parameter renderer, and leave the neural model to synthesize appearance. We instantiate this idea as Marionette, a world model for interactive games with articulated characters. First, a two-stage autoregressive dynamics model predicts an explicit and interpretable 276-dimensional 3D world state comprising multi-entity articulated skeletons, metric root trajectories, and rotations. Second, a zero-parameter graphics bridge converts the predicted state into pose-control videos, computing world-space geometry and occlusion in closed form. Third, a control-conditioned video-diffusion observation model synthesizes photorealistic RGB observations from the resulting structured controls. Our experiments establish two properties of Marionette. First, the predicted world state is directly controllable. Forcing a mismatched action stream changes root-aligned joint error by 31% across 48 held-out segments. Second, long-horizon behaviour is determined in the state, and can be repaired there. Left free, the two generated characters drift to 21.2 m apart (recorded sessions stay near 5 m) and a third of frames show ground penetration. Two rules imposed on the explicit state, a terrain collider and a separation cap, cut penetration by 66% and keep the pair engaged, with no change to the observation model. Routing appearance through the predicted state costs no fidelity we can detect, at an FVD of 831 against 799 for recorded pose.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Marionette，一个面向带有骨骼动画角色 (articulated characters) 的交互式游戏世界模型。其核心思想是显式建模演化的世界状态：由两阶段自回归动力学模型预测 276 维的 3D 世界状态（多实体骨骼、度量根轨迹与旋转），再用零参数图形渲染器把状态转成姿态控制视频，最后用控制条件视频扩散模型合成逼真 RGB 观测。实验表明该显式状态可直接控制、可在状态层面修复长期行为，且通过状态路由外观未检测到保真度损失。
Motivation: 交互式游戏世界模型通常直接在像素或潜空间自回归生成视觉观测，导致姿态、几何、遮挡等结构化属性由同一个生成序列隐式维持；在长时程上这些隐式世界属性的误差会累积，使一致性和可控性变得脆弱。
Method: Marionette 由三部分组成：一是两阶段自回归动力学模型，预测显式且可解释的 276 维 3D 世界状态，包括多实体骨骼、度量根轨迹和旋转；二是零参数图形桥接 (zero-parameter graphics bridge)，以闭式方式计算世界空间几何与遮挡，将状态转换为姿态控制视频；三是控制条件视频扩散观测模型，从结构化控制中合成照片级 RGB 观测。
Result: 强制注入不匹配的动作流会使根对齐关节误差 (root-aligned joint error) 在 48 个保留片段上变化 31%。若不加约束，两个生成角色会漂移到相距 21.2 m（录制会话保持在约 5 m），且三分之一的帧出现地面穿透；在显式状态上施加地形碰撞器和分离上限后，穿透减少 66%，且无需修改观测模型。外观经由预测状态路由未检测到保真度损失，FVD 为 831，而录制姿态为 799。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，显式建模世界状态使预测结果可直接控制，并允许在状态层面修复长期行为；将外观生成路由经过预测状态没有带来可检测的保真度代价。其适用范围是带有骨骼动画角色的交互式游戏。

papers.title: Handover of In-Context Learning State Across Session Boundaries
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates the methodological and theoretical properties of session handover in applications that use large language models. A task may continue in a new session when the context reaches the model's input limit, when the application restarts, or when another agent is asked to finish the task. The application must then decide which information from the earlier session to pass on. We formulate handover as the transfer of a task-relative in-context learning (ICL) state and distinguish exact recovery of earlier material from preservation of the target distribution. Under an exogeneity condition, predictive equivalence characterizes the coarsest deterministic sufficient handover and gives a fixed-length bit requirement. The analysis isolates the effects of the memory constraint, the writer, and the continuation procedure, and quantifies the cost of writing before the realized downstream query is known. We propose a three-part record that stores decisions and constraints exactly, uses task-justified statistics for repeated evidence, and retains original observations whose effect is not preserved by those statistics. Gaussian linear regression gives an exact finite-dimensional handover and finite-bit perturbation bounds, while nonparametric regression gives upper and lower bounds that relate memory to squared prediction error. These results provide a theory and method for deciding what a handover must retain and how its memory requirement depends on the continuation task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型应用中跨会话交接（session handover）的方法论与理论性质，将交接形式化为任务相关上下文学习（in-context learning, ICL）状态的迁移，并区分早期材料的精确恢复与目标分布保持。在外部性（exogeneity）条件下，预测等价性刻画了最粗的确定性充分交接并给出定长比特需求；高斯线性回归给出精确有限维交接与有限比特扰动界，非参数回归给出联系记忆与平方预测误差的上下界。
Motivation: 会话可能因上下文达到输入上限、应用重启或交由另一智能体继续而中断，应用需要决定从先前会话传递哪些信息；现有方法缺乏对交接必须保留什么以及记忆需求如何依赖后续任务的理论刻画。
Method: 将交接建模为任务相关 ICL 状态的迁移，提出一个三部分记录：精确存储决策与约束、用任务合理统计量（task-justified statistics）表示重复证据、保留未被这些统计量保持效果的原观测；并在高斯线性回归与非参数回归下分析记忆约束、书写者与续接过程的作用。
Result: 摘要报告：预测等价性给出最粗确定性充分交接及定长比特要求；高斯线性回归得到精确有限维交接和有限比特扰动界；非参数回归得到将记忆与平方预测误差相联系的上下界；分析还量化了在真实下游查询未知前书写的代价。
Conclusion: 这些结果提供了判定交接必须保留什么信息以及记忆需求如何依赖续接任务的理论与方法；摘要未涉及具体实验验证或实际部署评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Participatory Moral AI Is Not Neutral: The Invisible Hand of Developers
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems make more morally loaded decisions across society, one response has been moral preference elicitation. In this approach, researchers poll participants on hypothetical dilemmas and use the aggregated votes to train a policy that an AI model then applies at scale. Before any vote is cast, developers make three key choices in the moral AI elicitation pipeline: feature scoping, voter sampling, and question framing. In other words, they decide which features go to a vote, which voters to include, and how to present the question. These choices are often opaque, undocumented, and treated as technical details rather than normative ones. We examine each of these choices within a common empirical study and show that each can shape the preferences produced by moral AI elicitation. Across two phases (N = 809) in three deployment contexts (i.e., AI kidney allocation, AI agents simulating absent workers, and generative AI depictions of the deceased), we examine the three main stages of the moral AI elicitation pipeline. First, morally relevant features shift across contexts. This suggests that feature schemas should not be assumed to transfer across deployment domains. Second, preferences differ by political ideology for roughly one-third of features, with some differences reversing direction. The ideological composition of the voter pool can therefore affect the resulting aggregated preference profile. Third, the wording of the elicitation question can narrow or widen ideological gaps by up to a full scale point. The framing conditions also change how moral foundations are associated with participants' judgments. Taken together, these findings suggest that voting-based alignment cannot deliver fair or transparent AI by aggregation alone; at minimum, each stage of the moral AI elicitation pipeline should be audited and disclosed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究道德AI偏好 elicitation 管线中开发者所做的三类关键选择（特征范围界定、选民抽样、问题措辞）如何影响聚合偏好结果。基于两个阶段共 N=809 名参与者、三个部署场景（AI肾脏分配、AI代理模拟缺勤工人、生成式AI描绘逝者）的实验，作者发现每个环节都会实质性改变偏好输出，因此主张仅靠投票聚合无法带来公平透明的对齐，每个阶段都应被审计和披露。
Motivation: 道德偏好 elicitation 常被用作让AI系统做出道德决策的手段，但开发者事先设定的特征选择、样本构成和问题框架被视为技术细节而非规范性选择，导致其影响不透明。论文希望揭示这些被忽视的选择如何塑造最终偏好。
Method: 论文在共同的实证研究框架下拆解道德AI elicitation 管线的三个阶段：特征范围界定、选民抽样和问题措辞。跨两个阶段（N=809）和三个部署场景开展实验，比较不同特征模式、不同政治意识形态的选民群体以及不同问题措辞条件下的偏好差异。
Result: 研究发现：道德相关特征在不同场景间转移性差；约三分之一的特征上偏好随政治意识形态不同而改变，部分差异方向反转；问题措辞可将意识形态差距缩小或扩大至一个完整量表点，并改变道德基础与判断的关联方式。
Conclusion: 作者认为投票式对齐不能单靠聚合实现公平透明，至少需要审计并披露道德AI elicitation 管线的每个阶段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning-to-Transition for Large-scale and High-Order MIMO Detection
papers.abstract_en: High-order multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) detection requires efficient search over a large discrete symbol space while producing reliable soft information for channel decoding. This paper develops a learning-to-transition (L2T) framework that formulates MIMO detection as a stochastic sequence of complete-vector transitions. At each transition, a channel-coupled Transformer updates both the instance embedding and the sampling policy, while a blockwise autoregressive factorization captures inter-stream dependence with moderate sequential complexity. For hard-output detection, a transition network is applied recursively and trained through a residual-to-BER curriculum, which first learns the MIMO search geometry from the exact residual metric and then aligns the policy with transmitted-bit accuracy. For soft-output reception, the well-trained hard policy is cloned at the parameter level into every layer of an untied soft-input soft-output iterative detection and decoding (IDD) receiver. This tied-to-untied transfer preserves the learned zero-prior search dynamics while enabling layer- and round-specific specialization under decoder feedback. Within each IDD round, decoder priors tilt candidate generation according to Bayes' rule, and likelihood-weighted terminal hypotheses produce posterior and extrinsic log-likelihood ratios for LDPC decoding. A multi-stage training strategy further stabilizes the hard-to-soft transfer by progressively exposing the receiver to synthetic and in-loop decoder-generated priors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向大规模高维 MIMO 检测的 learning-to-transition (L2T) 框架，将检测建模为完整向量转移的随机序列。框架使用通道耦合的 Transformer 更新实例嵌入与采样策略，并采用块状自回归分解以中等顺序复杂度建模跨流依赖。硬输出检测通过残差到误码率课程训练递归转移网络，软输出检测则将训练好的硬策略参数级克隆到未绑定的迭代检测与解码 (IDD) 接收器中，并配合多阶段训练逐步引入合成及解码器生成的先验。
Motivation: 高维 MIMO 检测需要在巨大的离散符号空间中高效搜索，同时为信道解码生成可靠的软信息，现有检测方法难以同时兼顾搜索效率与软信息质量。
Method: 提出的 L2T 框架将检测视为随机完整向量转移序列，每个转移由通道耦合 Transformer 更新实例嵌入和采样策略；硬检测阶段采用递归转移网络并通过残差到 BER 的课程学习先学习搜索几何再对齐比特准确率；软检测阶段通过参数级克隆将硬策略迁移到每层独立的软输入软输出 IDD 接收器，每个 IDD 轮中按贝叶斯规则利用解码器先验倾斜候选生成，并用似然加权的终端假设产生后验和外信息对数似然比。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的数值实验结果，主要贡献在于提出 L2T 框架、硬到软迁移机制以及多阶段训练策略。
Conclusion: 作者强调绑定到未绑定的迁移可在解码器反馈下保留所学零先验搜索动态，同时实现层和轮次特化；多阶段训练策略用于稳定硬到软的迁移过程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Split the Labor: Separating Evidence Interpretation from Decision Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Systems that ask a language model to reach a conclusion from many sources usually concatenate them into one prompt. This conflates two operations with different requirements. Interpreting a source rewards capacity and context. Combining interpretations rewards fixed arithmetic, comparability across instances, and the option to return nothing. Once separated, the design problem becomes the interface between them. We propose a four-field evidence tuple (hypothesis, reliability bucket, rationale, provenance) and show that fixing it determines both halves. The separation also reveals a failure mode in how such systems combine, which we call count-scale drift. Thresholding a sum of unnormalized weights is exactly posterior thresholding, but at an operating point that slides with the number of sources consulted. The slide grows with reader reliability. When source reliabilities differ, the vote rule and the posterior order instances differently, and no threshold reconciles them. Pooling calibrated log-likelihood ratios addresses both problems. The fix is arithmetic rather than architectural, and applies to a class of rules beyond language models: score-summing triage engines, diagnostic panels scored by counting positives, and additive multi-signal detectors. We then instantiate the principle twice on one longitudinal corpus, once after outcomes resolve and once before. The same partition helps in both, at different granularities: over reading in the first, over learning capacity in the second. There, a small sequence encoder on an easy auxiliary objective plus a tree ensemble carrying the censored survival loss reaches 0.921 AUPRC against 0.805 for a hand-crafted baseline. We separate what transfers from what must be re-estimated per domain, and state five predictions that would falsify the framework, three negative results, and which comparisons remain confounded.

TL;DR: 本文主张将语言模型从多源证据中得出结论的任务拆分为两个操作：解释证据（interpreting a source）与聚合决策（combining interpretations），并指出两者需求不同。作者提出四字段证据元组（hypothesis, reliability bucket, rationale, provenance），并揭示一种称为 count-scale drift 的失败模式——对未归一化权重求和做阈值等价于后验阈值，但工作点随来源数量滑动。修复方法是对校准后的对数似然比（log-likelihood ratios）做池化，属于算术层而非架构层的改动。作者在一个纵向语料上两次实例化该原则，分别在结局已定和结局未定时获得收益，后者达到 0.921 AUPRC，对比手写基线 0.805。
Motivation: 现有系统通常将多个来源的资料拼接进单个 prompt 让模型下结论，这混淆了两种需求：解释来源需要容量和上下文，而聚合解释则需要固定算术、跨实例可比性以及返回空值的选项。作者认为这种混淆会导致设计问题变得模糊，并隐藏了聚合阶段的系统性缺陷。
Method: 提出四字段证据元组（hypothesis, reliability bucket, rationale, provenance），固定该元组即可同时确定解释与聚合两半的设计。针对聚合阶段的 count-scale drift，采用池化校准的对数似然比代替直接对未归一化权重求和并阈值化，并指出该修复适用于更广的规则类，包括分数求和分诊引擎、按阳性计数评分的诊断面板和加性多信号检测器。
Result: 在一个纵向语料上，结局发生后的场景中分离解释与聚合带来阅读粒度的收益；结局发生前的场景中，采用小型序列编码器（辅助目标）加上携带删失生存损失（censored survival loss）的树集成，达到 0.921 AUPRC，手写基线为 0.805。

papers.title: RecipeNet: A Hierarchical Transformer for Recipe Data
papers.abstract_en: Recipe data arises in domains such as materials synthesis, pharmaceutical formulation, and industrial manufacturing, where procedures are represented as ordered sequences of steps containing heterogeneous structured fields. Existing tabular learning methods typically flatten this structure into fixed-schema representations, limiting their ability to capture hierarchical field interactions and procedural dependencies. We propose RecipeNet, a hierarchical Transformer architecture that encodes field-level interactions within each step and sequential dependencies across steps through stacked Transformer encoders. Experiments on multiple recipe datasets and tasks demonstrate that RecipeNet consistently outperforms existing tabular models, highlighting the value of hierarchical and sequential modeling for recipe representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RecipeNet，一种面向食谱数据的分层 Transformer 架构。食谱数据出现在材料合成、制药配方和工业制造等领域，其过程表示为包含异构结构化字段的有序步骤序列。RecipeNet 通过堆叠的 Transformer 编码器分别建模步骤内的字段交互和步骤间的顺序依赖，在多个食谱数据集和任务上优于现有表格学习模型。
Motivation: 现有表格学习方法通常将食谱结构展平为固定 schema 的表示，难以捕获层级化的字段交互（field-level interactions）和过程依赖（procedural dependencies），限制了此类数据的表示学习能力。
Method: 提出分层 Transformer 架构 RecipeNet，使用堆叠的 Transformer 编码器：底层编码步骤内的字段交互，上层编码跨步骤的顺序依赖，从而显式建模食谱数据的层级与序列结构。
Result: 在多个食谱数据集和多种任务上的实验表明，RecipeNet 一致性地优于现有表格模型（tabular models），验证了层级与顺序建模对食谱表示学习的价值。
Conclusion: 作者强调层级和顺序建模对食谱数据表示学习的重要性，表明保留过程结构与字段交互优于展平式表格表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Universal Thermodynamic Interatomic Potentials for Crystalline Materials
papers.abstract_en: Free energies govern solid-state phase stability, yet computational materials discovery still relies largely on ground-state energies because free energy calculations require ensemble averages. We introduce the thermodynamic interatomic potential (TIP), which extends an interatomic potential from its static energy to a thermodynamically consistent Gibbs free energy model, with thermodynamic responses following from temperature and pressure by automatic differentiation. We implement TIP[UMA] using the universal potential UMA, train it on free energies from quasi-harmonic to molecular dynamics fidelity, and calibrate it to higher-resolution calculations or experiment. From a single evaluation, it returns the equation of state of a crystal and locates phase transitions among competing branches, including dynamically stabilized phases. Fine-tuning extends the model to alloy solubility limits and miscibility gaps. TIP makes the free energy as accessible as the potential energy, opening finite-temperature phase stability to high-throughput discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出热力学原子间势 (thermodynamic interatomic potential, TIP)，将原子间势从静态能量扩展到热力学一致的 Gibbs 自由能模型，并借助自动微分获得温度与压力下的热力学响应。作者基于通用势 UMA 实现 TIP[UMA]，在从准谐近似到分子动力学精度的自由能上训练并校准到更高分辨率计算或实验；单次评估即可返回晶体状态方程并定位竞争分支间的相变，包括动态稳定相。
Motivation: 固相相稳定性由自由能决定，但自由能计算需要系综平均，导致计算材料发现仍主要依赖基态能量。该工作旨在填补自由能难以高通量获取的空白，使有限温度相稳定性可用于高通量发现。
Method: 提出 TIP 框架，将原子间势扩展为热力学一致的 Gibbs 自由能模型，热力学响应由温度与压力的自动微分得到；使用通用势 UMA 实现 TIP[UMA]，在准谐到分子动力学精度的自由能数据上训练，并对更高分辨率计算或实验进行校准。
Result: 单次评估即可得到晶体的状态方程，并在竞争的能量分支中定位相变，包括动态稳定相；微调可将模型扩展到合金溶解度极限和混溶间隙 (miscibility gaps)。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TIP 使自由能与势能一样易于获得，从而将有限温度相稳定性纳入高通量材料发现流程。

papers.title: Rollplex: Cross-Phase GPU Spatial Sharing for Vision Language Model Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable embodied agents to reason and act from visual observations and language instructions. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training enhances these capabilities using task feedback, but current on-policy RL runtimes execute rollout, reference scoring, and actor training in strict serial phases. While effective for text-only RL, this phase-granular execution is wasteful for VLMs, where processing dense video inputs and prompt prefixes occupies a large fraction of each phase. Because prefix processing is independent of the generated response, it can be run alongside rollout decoding, which leaves GPU compute capacity underutilized, without breaking synchronous on-policy semantics. We present Rollplex, a runtime that decomposes the reference and training phase and moves the prefix computation into the rollout decode window. Realizing this schedule requires more than concurrent kernel launches: naive colocation of Qwen2.5-VL-32\,B requires roughly 165\,GiB per GPU, while rollout and training prefer different tensor-parallel (TP) degrees and weight layouts. Rollplex addresses these constraints with two mechanisms. Phase-aware memory management controls HBM residency according to producer--consumer lifetimes. Parallelism-aware weight sharing uses the same physical storage for layout-compatible tensors across distinct TP degrees and reconstructs only incompatible tensors, avoiding a complete second actor copy. On 32 H800 GPUs, Rollplex achieves $1.23\times$--$1.30\times$ speedup over serial colocation and $1.57\times$--$2.24\times$ over disaggregation under the same GPU budget, while preserving the synchronous RL update.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Rollplex，一个面向视觉语言模型 (VLM) 强化学习后训练的 GPU 运行时，通过跨阶段空间共享来消除严格串行阶段中的计算浪费。其核心思路是识别出 rollout、reference 评分与 actor 训练各阶段中，prefix 处理独立于生成响应，因此可将 prefix 计算移入 rollout 解码窗口并行执行。在 32 块 H800 GPU 上，Rollplex 相对于串行共置取得 1.23x–1.30x 加速，相对于分离部署取得 1.57x–2.24x 加速，同时保持同步 on-policy 更新语义。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 的 on-policy RL 后处理运行时将 rollout、reference scoring 和 actor training 按严格串行阶段执行，这种阶段粒度调度在处理密集视频输入和长 prompt prefix 时浪费 GPU 算力，因为 prefix 处理不依赖生成结果，本可并行进行。
Method: Rollplex 将 reference 和 training 阶段分解，把 prefix 计算调度到 rollout 解码窗口内。为应对朴素共置 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 需约 165 GiB/GPU 以及 rollout 与 training 偏好不同张量并行 (TP) 度和权重布局的问题，提出两机制：基于生产者-消费者生命周期的相位感知内存管理，以及并行度感知权重共享——对不同 TP 度下布局兼容的张量共用同一物理存储，仅重建不兼容张量，避免完整第二份 actor 副本。
Result: 在 32 块 H800 GPU 上，Rollplex 相比串行共置获得 1.23x–1.30x 加速，相比同 GPU 预算下的分离部署 (disaggregation) 获得 1.57x–2.24x 加速，并保持同步 RL 更新。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过将 prefix 计算移入 rollout 解码窗口并配合相位感知内存管理与跨 TP 度权重共享，可以在不破坏同步 on-policy 语义的前提下显著提升 VLM 后训练的 GPU 利用率。

papers.title: Generating Benchmark Health Data Using a Tabular Diffusion Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Cross-Tabular Data Generation (CTDG) seeks to learn a generative model from multiple heterogeneous tables and produce new synthetic tabular datasets. However, existing synthetic tabular data generation methods are largely restricted to single-input-table scenarios and struggle to effectively handle multiple heterogeneous tables with diverse feature sets. To address this limitation, we propose a two-stage framework for cross-tabular data generation. In the first stage, each heterogeneous raw table is transformed into a standardized statistical table with the same set of columns across all tables. Each statistical table captures the marginal distributions of the original columns and the pairwise correlations among them. In the second stage, a diffusion transformer model is trained to capture structural patterns across these homogeneous statistical tables and to generate synthetic statistical tables. Synthetic raw tables are subsequently reconstructed from the generated statistical tables via multivariate Gaussian sampling followed by an inverse probability integral transform. This two-stage CTDG framework enables the learning of a unified generative model from multiple heterogeneous tables and supports the generation of an unlimited number of realistic synthetic heterogeneous tables. Experimental results demonstrate high fidelity in the learned statistical representations and a favorable fidelity-diversity trade-off in the generated synthetic data, validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨表格数据生成（Cross-Tabular Data Generation，CTDG）提出一个两阶段框架：第一阶段把各异构原始表转换为具有相同列结构的标准化统计表，保存各列边际分布与两两相关性；第二阶段训练扩散Transformer（diffusion transformer）学习这些统计表的结构模式并生成合成统计表，再通过多元高斯采样和逆概率积分变换重建原始表。实验结果显示所学统计表示的保真度高，生成数据的保真度-多样性权衡良好。
Motivation: 现有合成表格数据生成方法大多局限于单输入表场景，难以有效处理特征集各异的多个异构表格。
Method: 提出两阶段CTDG框架：先将每个异构原始表转化为统一列结构的统计表，捕获边际分布与成对相关；再用扩散Transformer建模这些同构统计表的结构模式并生成新统计表，最后经多元高斯采样和逆概率积分变换重建合成原始表。
Result: 实验证明生成的统计表示具有高保真度，合成数据在保真度-多样性权衡上表现良好，验证了该方法的效果。
Conclusion: 该框架能从多个异构表学习统一生成模型，并支持生成任意数量逼真的合成异构表。

papers.title: Approximate Muon with low-rank adapters
papers.abstract_en: The Muon optimizer shows clear benefits versus alternatives when pretraining neural networks. However, it is used less frequently for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). One potential reason is that the most common PEFT method, LoRA, does not naturally combine with Muon since it is not mathematically possible to orthogonalize the weight update given by a low-rank parameterization. In this paper, we address this issue by approximating the solution to a relaxed Muon objective in the low-rank setting via linearization and then least-squares. We provide an efficient implementation that uses matmul operations only, as opposed to more complex linear algebra decomposition routines. Our method, sMuon (small Muon), performs favourably across SFT and a ReLoRA pretraining experiment. While results are model- and eval-dependent, we find overall that using Muon for low-rank fine-tuning provides moderate performance improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Muon 优化器在预训练神经网络时相比其他优化器有明显优势，但很少用于参数高效微调（PEFT），原因是 LoRA 这类低秩参数化下无法对权重更新做正交化。本文通过在低秩设置中对松弛的 Muon 目标做线性化并求解最小二乘近似，提出仅使用矩阵乘法运算的高效实现 sMuon（small Muon）。该算法在 SFT 和 ReLoRA 预训练实验中表现良好，但结论依赖模型和评测设置。
Motivation: 最常用的 PEFT 方法 LoRA 无法与 Muon 自然结合，因为低秩参数化下的权重更新在数学上不可能进行正交化，这限制了 Muon 在 PEFT 场景中的使用。
Method: 在低秩设置中，将松弛的 Muon 目标通过线性化转为最小二乘问题，并给出只依赖 matmul 运算的高效实现，避免了复杂的线性代数分解例程。
Result: 所提出的 sMuon 在 SFT 和 ReLoRA 预训练实验上表现相对更好；整体上低秩微调使用 Muon 提供了适度的性能提升，但结果因模型和评测而异。
Conclusion: sMuon 为低秩微调使用 Muon 提供了一种可行的近似路径，其性能增益中等且不稳定，需结合实际任务进一步验证。

papers.title: Optimal Scheduling of Road Maintenance Jobs Considering Impact on Traffic Flows
papers.abstract_en: Network-level maintenance planning requires repeated evaluations of equilibrium traffic flows under road capacity reductions. While equilibrium traffic assignment models are well established, their repeated solution quickly becomes computationally prohibitive and challenging to embed within maintenance scheduling problems. This paper investigates data-driven surrogate models that approximate equilibrium arc flows directly from origin-destination demand, using optimization-based equilibrium solutions as ground truth. A real-world case study based on traffic data from the Newark, New Jersey area demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed approach as a scalable building block for future maintenance scheduling frameworks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究道路维护作业的调度优化问题，提出用数据驱动的代理模型直接近似均衡交通流，以替代计算代价高昂的均衡交通分配迭代求解。基于美国新泽西州纽瓦克地区的真实交通数据进行了案例研究，验证该方法作为可扩展构建模块的有效性。
Motivation: 网络级维护规划需要在道路容量降低的情况下反复评估均衡交通流，而传统均衡交通分配模型重复求解计算开销过大，难以嵌入维护调度问题。
Method: 采用数据驱动的代理模型，从起讫点需求直接近似均衡路段流量，以基于优化的均衡解作为监督真值进行训练。
Result: 基于纽瓦克地区真实交通数据的案例研究显示，该方法能够有效逼近均衡流量，且具备可扩展性，可作为未来维护调度框架的基础组件。
Conclusion: 作者认为该代理建模思路为将交通流影响纳入维护调度提供了一种可扩展的可行途径，但摘要未讨论迁移性、泛化边界或与调度优化联合求解的效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Twin: Playing an Unknown Game with a Test-Time Digital Twin
papers.abstract_en: We present a Test-time World-model Inference (Twin) system, in which a frontier coding agent writes an executable world model for completing continual learning tasks, such as ARC-AGI-3 games. Traditional approaches hand-engineer such models, one custom design per task. Each game hides its rules and goal, and our system constructs them from simulation and interaction alone. Its inductive prior over grid games is strong enough to recover the true transitions of the game and the goal on nearly all levels. Replay validation happens in a twin world model. The harness enforces that an action is not made until the program reproduces every previous observed game transition. Each mismatch between a world model prediction and the actual action result becomes a counterexample that is used to repair the world model. Twin clears 179 out of 183 levels (97.8%), and does so more efficiently than humans in 158 out of 179 levels (88.3%). The system infers the goal before any reward on 156 of the levels it clears (87.2%), and in the remaining levels automatically discovers the goal by search. The benchmark scores completion and action efficiency, between 0 and 100, against humans playing each game for the first time. Played directly, the base model scores only 7.8%; an off-the-shelf harness increases it to 61.1%, whereas our twin world model increases the same base model to 93.3%, clearing 23 out of 25 games. Building a usable world model is simpler than anticipated, whereas the harder problem is inferring the right goal.
papers.comment: Project website with action-by-action replays of all 25 runs: https://arc-agi-3-twin.vercel.app/ Code: https://github.com/Alexyskoutnev/TWIN-ARC-AGI-3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出测试时世界模型推断（Twin）系统，让前沿编码智能体为ARC-AGI-3等连续学习任务编写可执行世界模型，仅通过仿真和交互推断隐藏的游戏规则与目标。系统在183个关卡中清除179个（97.8%），并在此前无奖励的情况下在156个关卡推断出目标。摘要强调构建可用的世界模型比预期简单，而难点在于推断正确目标。
Motivation: 传统方法为每个任务手工设计一个世界模型，而每个游戏都隐藏规则和目标，需要一种能从仿真和交互中自动构建模型的方法。
Method: 系统利用编码智能体写出可执行世界模型；重放验证在孪生世界模型中进行，且只有当程序复现所有先前观察到的游戏转换时才允许动作；世界模型预测与实际动作结果之间的每个失配都成为修复模型的反例。
Result: Twin清除183个关卡中的179个（97.8%），其中158个比人类首次游玩更高效（88.3%）；基础模型直接得分仅7.8%，现成框架将其提升至61.1%，而孪生世界模型将同一基础模型提升至93.3%，清除25个游戏中的23个。
Conclusion: 作者指出构建可用的世界模型比预期更简单，真正困难的问题是在游戏过程中推断出正确目标。

papers.title: No Reduction of Tropical Convection with Warming Expected from Theory or Models
papers.abstract_en: Theoretical arguments have for decades anticipated substantial weakening of tropical convection as the surface warms, yet convection-resolving models show no robust change in column-integrated convective mass transport and an increase in transported volume. Here we reconcile this apparent discrepancy by demonstrating that the two main theoretical arguments identify a redistribution, rather than a straightforward reduction, of convective motions. A commonly invoked hydrological argument accordingly captures a weakening at a single altitude that is offset by strengthening aloft as the troposphere expands upward. Further, reduced convective mass flux following atmospheric structures that rise with warming simply reflects decreasing air density aloft. Convective motions and transported water are shown to be highly invariant to surface warming along isotherms, and the ability to predict convective responses at individual altitudes is a manifestation of this invariance. Together, these findings recast and simplify long-standing expectations of how the tropical atmosphere will respond to warming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数十年来理论预期热带对流随地表增温显著减弱、而对流解析模式（convection-resolving models）显示柱积分对流质量输送无稳健变化且输送体积增加这一矛盾，提出两种主要理论论证实际描述的是对流运动的再分布而非直接减弱。作者指出，常用水文论证所捕捉的单高度减弱被对流层向上扩展带来的高空增强所抵消，而沿随增温抬升的大气结构的对流质量通量减少仅反映高空空气密度下降。沿等温线（isotherms）的对流运动与输运水汽对地表增温高度不变，且各高度对流响应的可预测性正是这一不变性的体现。
Motivation: 理论界长期预期热带对流随增温显著减弱，但高分辨率模式并未显示柱积分对流质量输送出现稳健变化，二者之间存在明显矛盾，需要澄清理论论证的实际含义。
Method: 作者分析解释了两个主要理论论证，证明它们识别的是对流运动的再分布：水文论证所预测的减弱只出现在单一高度，并因对流层向上扩展而被高空增强抵消；而沿随增温上升的大气结构的质量通量减小，仅反映高空空气密度降低。
Result: 摘要报告对流解析模式显示柱积分对流质量输送无稳健变化且输送体积增加，并对流运动与输运水汽沿等温线对地表增温高度不变；各高度对流响应可由该不变性预测。
Conclusion: 这些发现重新诠释并简化了关于热带大气对增温响应的长期预期，即理论上的减弱实为再分布而非整体减少。

papers.title: Ensuring Safe Physical AI in Urban Mobility via Hazard-Informed Synthesized Envelopes
papers.abstract_en: As heterogeneous robotic systems deploy across diverse urban zones, maintaining safety amid complex human-robot interactions remains a critical challenge. We present a unified framework that bridges systematic hazard analysis and runtime enforcement using hazard-informed safety envelopes. Rather than treating safety as a static constraint isolated within individual software modules, we introduce a cross-layer safety transformation process spanning symbolic, spatial, and dynamic world models. We show how this representation naturally interfaces with physical AI runtime harnesses to guarantee safe urban mobility.
papers.comment: The 2026 International Conference on Control, Robotics Engineering and Technology (CRET 2026), https://www.cret.net/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，将系统化危害分析（hazard analysis）与运行时强制（runtime enforcement）通过“危害知情的安全包络”（hazard-informed safety envelopes）连接起来，用于异构机器人在城市环境中的安全部署。作者引入跨层安全变换过程，覆盖符号、空间和动态世界模型，并与物理 AI 运行时框架对接以保证城市移动安全。
Motivation: 异构机器人系统在多样城市区域部署时，人机交互复杂，安全维护面临关键挑战；现有方法常将安全视为单个软件模块内的静态约束，缺乏系统性保障。
Method: 提出统一的跨层安全变换（cross-layer safety transformation）框架，将危害分析结果编码为安全包络，并贯通符号、空间与动态世界模型，使其与物理 AI 运行时框架（runtime harnesses）自然接口。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，主要主张是该方法能通过安全包络表示与运行时框架结合，保证安全城市移动。
Conclusion: 作者强调把安全从孤立静态约束转变为跨层、危害驱动的运行时机制，是保障城市物理 AI 系统安全的关键。

papers.title: LP-NAS: Linear Programming-based Neural Architecture Search
papers.abstract_en: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) aims to automate neural network architecture design, reducing reliance on human expertise. Among the various NAS methods, differentiable NAS has gained prominence due to its efficiency and accuracy compared to conventional NAS approaches. Since differentiable NAS relaxes the architecture search space into a continuous domain, it is possible to apply principles from continuous optimization to NAS. In this paper, we propose Linear Programming-based NAS (LP-NAS), a mathematical programming-based framework for differentiable NAS that is applicable to a wide range of continuous search spaces. LP-NAS formulates a linear program (LP) using the validation-loss gradient and the training-loss Hessian to compute an architecture update direction that improves generalization while preserving the optimality of the model parameters. By following this LP-derived descent direction, LP-NAS efficiently navigates the architecture search space, leading to faster and more effective architecture optimization. We introduce two computationally efficient variants of LP-NAS, namely S-LP-NAS and R-LP-NAS. Applying LP-NAS to the Differentiable Architecture Search (DARTS) search space results in two algorithmic variants, S-LP-DARTS and R-LP-DARTS. Both variants achieve faster convergence and significantly higher validation performance during the early search iterations than the standard DARTS algorithm. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 show that LP-DARTS outperforms standard DARTS in both the architecture search and evaluation phases. Additionally, we compare our approach with several DARTS variants (P-DARTS, PC-DARTS, and STO-DARTS) on the CIFAR-10 dataset and demonstrate its effectiveness. Furthermore, we validate the transferability of the discovered architectures through experiments on the ImageNet dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LP-NAS，一个基于线性规划 (linear programming) 的可微分神经架构搜索框架，适用于广泛的连续搜索空间。LP-NAS 利用验证损失梯度与训练损失 Hessian 构造线性规划，计算既能改进泛化又保持模型参数最优性的架构更新方向。在 DARTS 搜索空间上实例化为 S-LP-DARTS 与 R-LP-DARTS，两者比标准 DARTS 收敛更快，且在 CIFAR-10/100 的搜索与评估阶段均表现更好，并验证了在 ImageNet 上的架构可迁移性。
Motivation: 可微分 NAS 将架构搜索空间松弛为连续域，从而可以借用连续优化原理，但现有方法在架构更新中可能无法同时兼顾泛化改进与参数最优性。
Method: 将架构搜索建模为一个数学规划问题，使用验证损失梯度和训练损失 Hessian 构建线性规划，得到指导架构更新的下降方向；提出 S-LP-NAS 和 R-LP-NAS 两种计算高效的变体，并在 DARTS 搜索空间上具体化为 S-LP-DARTS 和 R-LP-DARTS。

papers.title: Expected Free Energy-based Informative Path Planning for Robotic Mars Exploration
papers.abstract_en: An autonomous robot efficiently exploring an unknown environment, such as looking for water sources on Mars, faces two simultaneous demands: building an accurate information map while quickly finding the regions of greatest value, and paying for every meter of travel and the cost of every measurement it takes. Classical information-seeking and reward-seeking criteria address only one of these objectives at a time. Here, we propose Expected Free Energy (EFE), the principled action-selection objective from active inference, as a unifying criterion for budgeted robotic informative path planning. Maintaining a Gaussian-process belief over the information field, our agent plans continuous trajectories that minimize expected free energy under hard path-length constraints. The results from multiple realizations show that EFE-based planning yields accurate posterior maps and locates the highest-value regions simultaneously, outperforming information-theoretic baselines under the same settings. In robotic exploration, these unified, easy-to-tune principled information-gathering strategies facilitate autonomous deployment while enforcing efficiency and resource constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将主动推理中的期望自由能 (Expected Free Energy, EFE) 作为统一准则，用于有预算约束的机器人信息路径规划 (informative path planning)，并以火星水资源探索为应用场景。智能体对信息场维持高斯过程信念，在硬路径长度约束下规划连续轨迹以最小化期望自由能。多个随机实现的实验显示，该方法能同时构建准确的后验地图并定位高价值区域，优于相同设置下的信息论基线。
Motivation: 自主机器人探索未知环境时需要同时满足两个需求：构建准确的信息地图并快速找到高价值区域，同时还要为每米移动和每次测量付出代价。经典的信息搜索准则和奖励搜索准则各自只处理其中一个目标，缺乏统一的预算约束下的规划框架。
Method: 将主动推理中的期望自由能作为统一的动作选择目标，用于预算受限的机器人信息路径规划。智能体维护关于信息场的高斯过程信念，并在硬路径长度约束下规划连续轨迹以最小化期望自由能。
Result: 多个随机实现的结果表明，基于 EFE 的规划能够同时产生准确的后验地图并定位最高价值区域，在相同设置下优于信息论基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，这类统一且易于调参的基于信息理论原则的信息采集策略，能够在施加效率和资源约束的同时促进机器人的自主部署。

papers.title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model
papers.abstract_en: A frozen language model on reasoning tasks has two coupled weaknesses: it under-uses evidence its own residual stream already encodes, and it fails to detect when the input is insufficient to answer, so it confabulates. This paper consolidates two research lines that address these on the same residual stream: a conditional steering probe writes the stream at mid-stack layers and recovers reasoning accuracy from a frozen backbone, and a zero-shot sufficiency direction reads the stream and abstains when information is insufficient. Deployed in one forward pass they interfere: the steering write shifts the state the direction reads, costing up to 8 AUROC points of cross-domain transfer on small models; a separate clean pass doubles inference cost. We keep the direction fixed and train a small network to reconstruct the pre-steering residual from the steered one -- mean-squared error on (steered, clean) pairs, no sufficiency labels -- and read the direction on the reconstruction. The resulting system, YOPO (You Only Pass Once), answers, steers, and abstains in one forward pass of a frozen Qwen2.5 backbone (1.5B/3B/7B). End to end, three-way accuracy more than doubles the frozen baseline (0.375->0.798 on 1.5B alphaNLI) and one pass beats the two-pass reference at every scale (0.798/0.830/0.893 vs 0.753/0.790/0.863) and on ten backbones across six model families. We chart the capacity-transfer frontier quantifying the principle that abstention should not be trained in; a source-side audit catches our own alphaNLI construction leaking a surface artifact, so architectural claims are anchored on native-label replications (SQuAD2, RepLiQA, MuSiQue); and on the standard four-domain suite we contribute, to our knowledge, the first answer-or-abstain benchmark, where our gate tops every in-domain dataset and the label-free direction is the only gate family to survive domain transfer.
papers.comment: 24 pages. Ziyang Luo and Zhongyao Chu contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对冻结语言模型的两个耦合弱点——未充分利用残差流中已编码的证据，以及无法识别输入信息不足而编造答案（confabulate）——提出 YOPO (You Only Pass Once) 系统。该系统在冻结的 Qwen2.5 骨干（1.5B/3B/7B）上结合条件转向探针与零样本充分性方向（zero-shot sufficiency direction），通过一个小网络重建转向前的残差，实现一次前向传播中同时回答、转向和弃权。摘要报告其端到端三路准确率超过冻结基线两倍多，并在多种规模与骨干上优于两遍参考方法。
Motivation: 已有两条研究线分别解决残差流证据利用不足和无法弃权的问题，但在同一次前向传播中部署它们会互相干扰：转向写入会改变充分性方向读取的状态，在小模型上造成最多 8 AUROC 点的跨域迁移损失；而单独做一次干净前向传播则会使推理成本翻倍。
Method: 方法 YOPO 保持充分性方向固定，训练一个小网络在均方误差损失下从转向后的残差重建转向前的残差（使用 (steered, clean) 配对数据，无需充分性标签），然后在重建的残差上读取充分性方向。这使得回答、转向和弃权能够在冻结骨干的单一前向传播中完成。
Result: 在 1.5B alphaNLI 上，三路准确率从 0.375 提升到 0.798，超过冻结基线两倍多；单次前向传播在三种规模（0.798/0.830/0.893 vs 0.753/0.790/0.863）及六个模型家族的十个骨干上均优于两遍参考。作者还绘制了容量-迁移前沿（capacity-transfer frontier），并通过源端审计发现自身 alphaNLI 构造泄漏了表面伪迹，因此架构主张以原生标签复制（SQuAD2、RepLiQA、MuSiQue）为锚，并在标准四域套件上贡献了据称是首个 answer-or-abstain 基准。
Conclusion: 作者强调弃权不应被训练进模型（abstention should not be trained in）这一原则，并指出标签无关的充分性方向是唯一能在域迁移下存活的门控族。摘要未明确列出其他局限，但提及对自身 alphaNLI 构造的泄漏进行了审计并以原生标签复制支撑结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shift Aware Transfer Learning with Adaptive Dual-Encoder Fusion for PM Forecasting in Data-Limited Environments
papers.abstract_en: Short-horizon forecasting of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) remains difficult when observations from the target domain are limited and the statistical properties of the source and target domains differ. In these settings, models trained only on local data may not capture complex temporal dynamics, while direct transfer learning can result in negative transfer. This study develops a shift-aware dual-encoder transfer framework that combines source-domain knowledge with target-specific representation learning. The source encoder was pretrained using hourly observations from 10 U.S. monitoring locations. The framework was then adapted and evaluated using two years of hourly observations from 77 stations in Taiwan under a chronological train-validation-test protocol. Among the four principal baselines, the frozen-source dual-encoder model achieved the best performance, with MSE = 21.8960, MAE = 3.1597, and R^2 = 0.8725. This corresponds to an MSE reduction of approximately 7.1% relative to TL-v1 and 4.1% relative to TL-v2. The ablation analysis showed that removing the Taiwan-specific branch caused the largest decline in performance. Allowing the source encoder to adapt produced the best overall result, with MSE = 21.6575, MAE = 3.1383, and R^2 = 0.8739. SHAP analysis indicated that predictions were driven mainly by recent PM2.5 observations and meteorological variables related to pollutant transport and dispersion. These results suggest that source-domain knowledge is most effective when target-specific information is preserved and the transferred representation is allowed to adapt under target supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究目标域观测有限且源/目标域统计特性不同的场景下的 PM2.5 短期预报问题，提出一种 shift-aware 双编码器 (dual-encoder) 迁移框架，将源域知识与目标专属表示学习结合。源编码器使用美国 10 个站点的小时观测预训练，并在台湾 77 个站点两年小时观测上按时间顺序的训练-验证-测试协议评估。摘要报告冻结源的 dual-encoder 模型在四个主基线中最佳，MSE=21.8960、MAE=3.1597、R²=0.8725，而允许源编码器适配的版本取得最佳整体结果，MSE=21.6575、MAE=3.1383、R²=0.8739。
Motivation: 当目标域观测数据有限且源域与目标域统计特性不同时，仅用本地数据训练难以捕捉复杂时间动态，而直接迁移学习可能导致负迁移 (negative transfer)，需要显式处理分布偏移的迁移策略。
Method: 提出 shift-aware 双编码器迁移框架，包含预训练的源编码器与目标域专属表示分支；源编码器在美国 10 个地点的逐小时观测上预训练，随后在台湾数据上按时间顺序切分训练、验证与测试，并进行消融实验和 SHAP 可解释性分析。
Result: 冻结源编码器的 dual-encoder 模型在四个主基线中表现最好，MSE 较 TL-v1 降低约 7.1%、较 TL-v2 降低约 4.1%；允许源编码器在目标监督下适配后取得最佳总体性能。消融显示移除台湾专属分支导致最大性能下降，SHAP 显示预测主要由近期 PM2.5 观测及与污染物输送和扩散相关的气象变量驱动。
Conclusion: 源域知识最有效的前提是保留目标域特定信息，并允许迁移表示在目标监督下进行适配。

papers.title: Quantifying internal variability in large-ensemble climate data with the Wasserstein distance
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying forced and internal variability in climate data is fundamental to detecting the climate change signal and assessing uncertainty in climate projections. We propose a metric that quantifies the relative magnitude of internal variability in single-model initial-condition large ensembles (SMILEs). We measure forced and internal variability by two 1-Wasserstein distances, a form of optimal transport cost. The proposed metric is the distance for internal variability divided by the sum of the two. Computing this ratio requires only sorting the samples and differencing the resulting quantiles, with no additional parameters. The metric reflects the entire distribution shape and applies to non-Gaussian variables, because the 1-Wasserstein distance quantifies the difference between any two probability distributions. We validate the metric with synthetic climate data from Gaussian, uniform, and lognormal distributions. Unlike the two existing metrics, the proposed metric gives stable estimates irrespective of the distribution shape and the presence of outliers, provided that the ensemble has about 40 members or more. We then apply the proposed and existing metrics to the 2 m air temperature and total precipitation of the Community Earth System Model Large Ensemble (CESM-LE) under two different forcing scenarios. All the metrics indicate that the relative contribution of internal variability decreases as the forcing increases, but the proposed metric shows this response most clearly. The 1-Wasserstein distance thus provides a simple and useful tool for analyzing large-ensemble datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用两个 1-Wasserstein 距离之比来量化单模型初始条件大集合（SMILEs）中内部变率相对于总变率的贡献，并将该指标应用于 CESM-LE 的 2 米气温和总降水数据。合成数据验证表明，在约 40 个成员以上时该指标对分布形状和离群值稳健，优于两种现有指标。应用结果显示，随着强迫增强，内部变率的相对贡献下降，且该指标对此响应刻画得最清晰。
Motivation: 区分强迫变率与内部变率是检测气候变化信号和评估气候预测不确定性的基础，现有指标受分布形状和离群值影响而不够稳定。
Method: 用两个 1-Wasserstein 距离分别度量强迫变率和内部变率，并取内部变率距离与两者之和的比值作为指标；计算只需排序样本并差分相应分位数，无需额外参数，适用于非高斯分布。
Result: 在 Gaussian、uniform、lognormal 合成数据上验证了稳定性；对 CESM-LE 两个强迫情景的分析显示所有指标都表明内部变率相对贡献随强迫增大而下降，但新指标表现最清晰。
Conclusion: 1-Wasserstein 距离为分析大集合气候数据提供了简单有效的工具，且在集合成员数约 40 以上时估计稳定。

papers.title: SheetCompass: Hierarchical Relation Graphs for Agentic Spreadsheet Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Spreadsheets are widely used to organize, analyze, and manipulate semi-structured data, yet automated spreadsheet reasoning remains challenging for large language models (LLMs). Real-world workbooks often contain implicit cross-table associations, fine-grained column dependencies, and complex spatial layouts. Existing methods typically flatten these multidimensional structures into sequential strings, losing important intra-sheet boundaries and inter-sheet semantics. Consequently, LLMs cannot exploit the global spatial context that human experts naturally use when inspecting spreadsheets. We propose SheetCompass, a graph-guided and memory-driven agentic framework for spreadsheet reasoning and automation. SheetCompass explicitly models structural relationships within and across worksheets while maintaining task-relevant information in memory, enabling agents to reason more effectively over complex workbooks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SheetCompass，一个面向电子表格推理与自动化的图引导、记忆驱动智能体框架。针对现有方法将多维表格结构压平成序列而丢失工作表内部边界与跨表语义的问题，SheetCompass 显式建模工作表内与工作表间的结构关系，并在记忆中维护任务相关信息。摘要未报告定量实验数据，仅表示该方法能使智能体在复杂工作簿上更有效地推理。
Motivation: 真实世界的电子表格工作簿常包含隐式跨表关联、细粒度列依赖和复杂空间布局，而现有方法通常将多维结构压平成顺序字符串，丢失工作表内边界与跨表语义，导致 LLM 无法利用人类专家查看表格时所依赖的全局空间上下文。
Method: 提出 SheetCompass，一种图引导且记忆驱动的智能体框架，显式建模工作表内部及工作表之间的结构关系，同时把任务相关信息保存在记忆中，使智能体能在复杂工作簿上进行更有效的推理。
Result: 摘要未给出具体的量化结果、数据集或基线对比，仅声称该方法使智能体能够更有效地对复杂工作簿进行推理。
Conclusion: 作者强调保留电子表格的多维结构化信息（而非简单展平）并配合任务记忆，是提升 LLM 电子表格推理能力的关键方向。

papers.title: Wyvern: An Agentic Framework for Generating Grounded Multimodal Reports
papers.abstract_en: In the current artificial intelligence-driven innovation era, the pace of knowledge growth is accelerating, and is hard to keep up with. While generative models are increasingly used to synthesize content, they often lack in information grounding. To address these peculiarities of our time, we propose Wyvern, a multi-agent framework for the automated generation of grounded, multimodal technical reports. Wyvern allows for the generation of multimodal outputs, integrating images, tables, and text with supporting references in a unified report. Additionally, a particular focus is placed on the grounding of the content, with the implementation of a claims auto-revision stage. We conduct a human evaluation study to assess the quality of our proposed framework. The results show that the figures' informativeness is perceived as superior to that of a recent baseline in 87% of cases. Furthermore, Wyvern's reports are rated as more useful than those produced by three alternative methods in 63% to 100% of instances. We also carry out automatic evaluations showing that Wyvern gains up to 2.3$\times$ in citation recall and 1.6$\times$ in citation precision with respect to the baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Wyvern，一个多智能体框架，用于自动生成有引文支撑的多模态技术报告，能够整合图像、表格、文本并附上参考文献。框架特别加入了内容 grounding 的声明自动修订阶段，并通过人工评估与自动评估验证报告质量。
Motivation: 生成模型虽常用于合成内容，但往往缺乏信息 grounding；同时知识增长加速，个人难以跟上。论文针对这一现状，希望自动化生成既多模态又有可靠引文支撑的技术报告。
Method: Wyvern 是一个多智能体 (multi-agent) 框架，支持在统一报告中整合图像、表格与文本，并为内容提供支持性引用；其核心设计包括一个声明自动修订阶段 (claims auto-revision stage) 以强化内容 grounding。
Result: 人工评估显示，Wyvern 生成的图片信息量在 87% 的案例中被认为优于近期基线；报告有用性在 63% 到 100% 的实例中高于三种替代方法。自动评估中，相较基线，Wyvern 的引文召回率提升最高 2.3 倍，引文精确率提升最高 1.6 倍。
Conclusion: 作者通过人工与自动评估表明，Wyvern 能生成引文更准确、信息量更高的多模态技术报告。摘要未明确讨论该框架在不同领域或非技术报告上的泛化范围。

papers.title: Designing Compact Neural Architectures via Neuron Gating and Mixed Activation
papers.abstract_en: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) is naturally formulated as a bilevel optimization problem, where the upper-level optimizes the architecture using validation performance and the lower-level trains network parameters using training loss. However, NAS is computationally expensive due to discrete architectural decisions, exponentially growing search spaces, and the high cost of training candidate architectures. This work develops a general bilevel optimization framework for NAS across diverse architectures, including MLPs, CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers, to identify compact architectures with strong predictive performance. We propose three scalable formulations that replace discrete neuron- and activation-level decisions with continuous relaxations, enabling differentiable optimization over otherwise combinatorial architecture spaces. These formulations give rise to three NAS methods: NAS based on Neuron Gating (NAS-NG), NAS based on Mixed Activation (NAS-MA), and NAS based on Neuron Gating and Mixed Activation (NAS-NGMA). Experiments on MLPs and CNNs using MNIST and CIFAR-10 show that the proposed methods consistently identify compact architectures with competitive or improved predictive performance. On MNIST, NAS-NGMA achieves 98.68% test accuracy with 7.69M MLP parameters, while NAS-NG achieves 99.63% accuracy with only 0.26M CNN parameters. On CIFAR-10, the proposed methods consistently outperform vanilla DARTS. Further experiments demonstrate that NAS-NG can optimize substantially over-parameterized and literature-optimal architectures, improving accuracy while reducing parameters. These results establish relaxed bilevel optimization as a scalable alternative to discrete NAS and provide a general framework for efficient neuron- and activation-level architecture optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对神经架构搜索（NAS）的通用双层优化框架，将离散的神经元级和激活级决策放松为连续形式，从而支持可微优化。作者给出三种可扩展的公式化方法：基于神经元门控的 NAS-NG、基于混合激活的 NAS-MA，以及两者结合的 NAS-NGMA。在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上的 MLP 与 CNN 实验中，这些方法能持续找到紧凑且预测性能有竞争力或更优的架构，并在 CIFAR-10 上一致优于 vanilla DARTS。
Motivation: NAS 天然是双层优化问题，但离散架构决策、指数级搜索空间和候选架构的训练成本使其计算代价高昂。现有离散 NAS 方法难以高效扩展到神经元级和激活级粒度，因此需要一种可扩展、可微的替代方案。
Method: 将上层的架构优化（基于验证性能）与下层的参数训练（基于训练损失）整合为双层优化问题，并引入三种连续松弛：神经元门控（neuron gating）、混合激活（mixed activation）以及两者组合，由此得到 NAS-NG、NAS-MA 和 NAS-NGMA 三种方法，覆盖 MLP、CNN、RNN 和 Transformer 等架构。
Result: 在 MNIST 上，NAS-NGMA 以 7.69M MLP 参数达到 98.68% 测试准确率，NAS-NG 以仅 0.26M CNN 参数达到 99.63% 准确率；在 CIFAR-10 上，所提方法一致优于 vanilla DARTS。NAS-NG 还能优化过度参数化和文献中已优化的架构，在降低参数量的同时提高准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为松弛化的双层优化可以作为离散 NAS 的可扩展替代方案，并提供了适用于神经元级和激活级架构优化的通用框架。摘要未提及该方法在 RNN/Transformer 上的实验证据，也未讨论这些通用框架在其他任务或更大规模数据集上的局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PACE-Bench: Benchmarking Physics Adaptation via Code Evolution in Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents improve future behavior from interaction experience, yet existing evaluations typically optimize under fixed execution conditions and do not test recovery after those conditions change. To address this gap, we introduce PACE-Bench (Physics Adaptation via Code Evolution), a simulator-grounded benchmark of 144 source-to-target adaptation pairs across six physics domains. Each pair links a source environment to a mutated target environment with the same goal and interface. A code-driven design that succeeds in the source fails in the target, where agents must iteratively adapt it into a working target design using diagnostic sandbox feedback within a limited attempt budget. We compare ten self-evolving methods from four paradigms. The benchmark remains far from saturated: Reflexion + Qwen3-14B succeeds on only 35.9\% of full-benchmark pairs, while GPT-5.5 solves 66.7\% of the Statics subset under the full budget. Together, these results show that simulator-grounded reflection is more reliable than unverified self-revision, while memory anchors agents to early designs and broad tree search explores without converging. Even revealing exact physical changes does not raise the performance ceiling, pointing to mechanism redesign rather than parameter inference as the central bottleneck. Data and code are available at https://github.com/thunlp/PACE-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACE-Bench 是一个基于仿真器的物理适应基准，包含 144 个跨六个物理领域的源到目标环境适配对。每个适配对将一个源环境与一个具有相同目标和接口的变异目标环境相连，使在源环境中成功的代码驱动设计在目标环境中失效，代理需在有限的尝试预算内利用诊断沙盒反馈迭代修改设计。基准比较了来自四种范式的十种自进化方法，结果显示模拟器接地反思比未经验证的自我修订更可靠，且整体性能远未饱和。
Motivation: 现有自进化代理评估通常在固定执行条件下优化，未测试环境条件改变后的恢复能力，缺乏对物理环境动态变化下适应能力的系统性评测。
Method: 构建 PACE-Bench 基准，包含 144 个源到目标适配对，覆盖六个物理领域；每个适配对要求代理使用诊断沙盒反馈在有限尝试预算内将源环境中的成功设计迭代改写为目标环境中的可行设计。
Result: Reflexion + Qwen3-14B 在全基准上仅成功 35.9% 的适配对，GPT-5.5 在完整预算下解决 Statics 子集的 66.7%；揭示精确物理变化并不会提高性能上限，表明核心瓶颈是机制重设计而非参数推断。
Conclusion: 模拟器接地反思比未经验证的自我修订更可靠，而记忆锚定早期设计和广泛树搜索探索而不收敛；基准仍远未饱和，为后续物理适应研究提供公开数据和代码。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Style or Signature? Artist-Disjoint Evaluation of Style Classification in Frozen Vision Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Frozen image embeddings from models such as CLIP are increasingly used to classify paintings by art-historical style, with high reported accuracy. We ask whether this accuracy reflects an understanding of style or the recognition of individual artists. Standard evaluation uses random splits in which works by the same artist appear on both sides, so a classifier can succeed by recognising the painter rather than the movement. We re-evaluate style classification under an artist-disjoint protocol, holding out every artist in turn so that no work is ever classified using other works by its own painter. On a balanced dataset of 320 paintings across four twentieth-century movements, 5-NN style accuracy falls from 0.87 to 0.77 under this protocol, and the drop is sharply uneven. Impressionism and Cubism barely move, while Surrealism falls twenty points. The pattern holds across four image encoders, including a vision-only self-supervised model, which places the effect in visual structure rather than language. Where an encoder captures genuine shared form, individual artists are barely recognisable yet style is robust, while Surrealism shows the opposite. We argue that artist-disjoint evaluation is necessary to measure stylistic understanding in frozen embeddings.

TL;DR: 本文质疑冻结视觉嵌入（如 CLIP）在艺术史风格分类上的高准确率是否真正反映了对风格的语义理解，还是仅识别了画家身份。作者提出艺术家不重叠（artist-disjoint）评估协议，逐个留出所有艺术家，避免同一画家作品同时出现在训练和测试侧；在 320 幅、四个二十世纪艺术流派的平衡数据集上，5-NN 风格准确率从 0.87 降至 0.77，且下降极不均匀：印象派和立体主义几乎不变，超现实主义下降 20 个百分点。该模式在四个图像编码器上一致，包括纯视觉自监督模型，说明效应源于视觉结构而非语言。
Motivation: 标准风格分类评估使用随机划分，同一艺术家的作品会同时出现在训练和测试两侧，分类器可通过识别画家而非画派来获得高分，从而高估嵌入对风格的理解。
Method: 采用艺术家不重叠的评估协议，轮流留出每一位艺术家，确保任何作品都不会借助其同画家的其他作品被分类；在冻结嵌入上做 5-NN 风格分类，并比较多个图像编码器（含纯视觉自监督模型）。
Result: 在 320 幅画的四流派平衡数据集上，5-NN 风格准确率从 0.87 降至 0.77；印象派和立体主义几乎无下降，超现实主义下降 20 个百分点，且该不均衡模式在四个编码器上稳定复现。
Conclusion: 作者主张评估冻结嵌入的风格理解必须采用艺术家不重叠协议；结果表明准确率下降源于视觉结构层面的画家身份线索，而非语言监督的副作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Designing Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models: A Unified Path-Space View
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training provides a direct way to align diffusion models with human preferences and task-specific rewards. However, current RL algorithms for diffusion models remain fragmented: reverse-trajectory methods rely on discretized likelihood ratios, whereas forward-matching methods train on reward-labeled noising versions of the rollout samples. This paper shows that these seemingly different losses arise from a single path-space principle. Starting from the regularized diffusion-RL objective, we use importance sampling between sampling SDEs to obtain an explicit policy-gradient estimator on trajectory space. The estimator contains the stochastic Itô integral underlying Flow-GRPO-type updates; we derive an equivalent variance-reduced value-gradient form that recovers the forward-matching structure of AWM and DiffusionNFT. This identifies the empirical gap between these method families as a variance-reduction effect rather than a difference in RL principle. The derivation yields a unified design space organized by value-gradient estimation, weight functions, and sampling choices. Within this space, we propose a multi-sample KDE value-gradient estimator that reuses rollout groups, together with scale-bounded weight families that retain stable existing recipes while excluding singular ones. Experiments on SD3.5-M and Qwen-Image models validate the variance-reduction explanation and show that the resulting recipe improves over prior diffusion-RL baselines.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从路径空间 (path space) 统一视角重新推导扩散模型的强化学习后训练目标。作者指出反向轨迹方法与正向匹配方法 (如 AWM、DiffusionNFT) 本质上是同一正则化扩散-RL 目标的不同估计，差异源于方差缩减 (variance reduction) 而非 RL 原理不同，并据此提出多样本 KDE 值梯度估计器与尺度有界权重族，在 SD3.5-M 和 Qwen-Image 模型上提升扩散-RL 基线。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型 RL 后训练算法较为碎片化，反向轨迹方法与正向匹配方法看似截然不同，缺乏统一理论视角来解释它们的关系，也限制了算法的系统设计。
Method: 从正则化扩散-RL 目标出发，利用采样 SDE 之间的重要性采样得到轨迹空间上的显式策略梯度估计；进一步推导出等价的方差缩减值梯度形式，恢复 AWM 和 DiffusionNFT 的正向匹配结构，并构建由值梯度估计、权重函数和采样选择组成的统一设计空间。在该空间中提出多样本 KDE 值梯度估计器及尺度有界权重族。
Result: 摘要在 SD3.5-M 和 Qwen-Image 模型上的实验验证了方差缩减解释，并显示所提出的配方优于现有扩散-RL 基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调两类方法族之间的经验差距本质上是方差缩减效应，而非 RL 原则差异，实验支持这一解释。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GhostPoint: Self-Supervised Representation Learning by Hallucinating Occluded LiDAR Structure
papers.abstract_en: 3D object detection from LiDAR point clouds is a core problem in autonomous driving. Recent advances in self-supervised learning (SSL) enable scalable pretraining and transfers well to per-point tasks such as semantic and panoptic segmentation, but transfer to 3D detection remains weaker. We analyze recent SSL methods and find that most objectives are defined only on measured LiDAR returns from visible surfaces, leaving occluded and unobserved regions unconstrained. This visible-surface bias can be sufficient for point-wise prediction, but 3D detection requires robustness to missing structure. To address this gap, we propose GhostPoint, an SSL framework that hallucinates latent features in local neighborhoods around discovered instances, generated via a novel instance voxel dilation. In GhostPoint, an encoder processes observed returns, and an additional predictor infers neighborhood representations from observed context. In addition to standard encoder-level supervision, we introduce a predictor-level supervision scheme on sampled voxels from generated neighborhoods. Specifically, observed (visible/masked) voxels match teacher-encoder targets, while unobserved voxels match teacher-predictor hallucinations. This design encourages the learned representation to explicitly model structure beyond observed returns. Extensive evaluations on nuScenes and Waymo demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently improving downstream 3D detection, especially under sparse scans and limited labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GhostPoint，一个针对 LiDAR 点云 3D 物体检测的自监督学习（SSL）框架。作者指出现有 SSL 目标大多只在可见表面的测量返回上定义，遮挡和未观测区域不受约束；GhostPoint 通过实例体素膨胀（instance voxel dilation）在发现的实例周围生成局部邻域幻觉特征，由编码器处理观测返回、预测器从观测上下文推断邻域表示。摘要报告该方法在 nuScenes 和 Waymo 上达到 state-of-the-art，尤其在稀疏扫描和有限标注下稳定提升下游 3D 检测。
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR 上的 SSL 预训练能较好迁移到逐点任务（如语义和全景分割），但迁移到 3D 检测仍然较弱。作者分析发现大多数 SSL 目标只在可见表面测量上定义，未对遮挡和未观测区域施加约束；这种可见表面偏差对逐点预测足够，但 3D 检测需要对缺失结构具有鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 GhostPoint：通过新颖的实例体素膨胀，在检测到的实例周围局部邻域中生成幻觉特征；编码器处理观测返回，额外的预测器从观测上下文推断邻域表示。除标准编码器级监督外，还引入预测器级监督，使观测（可见/掩码）体素匹配 teacher-encoder 目标，未观测体素匹配 teacher-predictor 的幻觉表示，从而显式建模超出观测返回的结构。
Result: 在 nuScenes 和 Waymo 上的广泛评估表明，GhostPoint 取得 state-of-the-art 性能，并持续提升下游 3D 检测，尤其是在稀疏扫描和有限标签的条件下改进明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在 SSL 预训练中显式约束未观测邻域结构可以弥补 SSL 从逐点任务迁移到 3D 检测的差距，GhostPoint 在多个自动驾驶数据集上验证了该设计。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Dynamics of Intelligence Explosions
papers.abstract_en: AI is increasingly being used to help with AI R&D. Under certain conditions this feedback loop might be able to produce an intelligence explosion, with rapidly escalating AI capabilities. I explore the mathematics of the most explosive possibilities, with an eye to understanding what drives the dynamics. I show that singular growth (towards a vertical asymptote) is harder to achieve than would be expected from recent economics-inspired modelling, and that there is an important but neglected class of growth rates that are faster than exponential but don't lead to a vertical asymptote. I draw out the generation time (the time to go around the feedback loop) as a neglected parameter that plays a pivotal role in determining the behaviour of any intelligence explosion --- one cannot have singular growth unless the generation time rapidly approaches zero.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI反馈回路可能导致的智能爆炸（intelligence explosion）的数学动态，重点关注增长率与生成时间（generation time）的作用。作者证明奇异增长（朝垂直渐近线）比近期经济学启发模型所预期的更难实现，并指出存在一类比指数更快但不产生垂直渐近线的重要增长率。摘要强调生成时间是决定智能爆炸行为的关键参数，除非生成时间迅速趋近于零，否则不可能出现奇异增长。
Motivation: AI正越来越多地被用于辅助AI研发，这种反馈回路在特定条件下可能产生能力快速升级的智能爆炸。作者希望从数学上理解驱动这种爆炸动态的因素，并纠正现有建模中对爆炸可能性的过于乐观预期。
Method: 作者对最极端的爆炸可能性进行数学分析，考察增长率函数与生成时间参数如何共同决定系统行为，并区分奇异增长、超指数增长与指数增长等不同动态类别。
Result: 摘要报告两个核心结果：奇异增长比近期经济学启发模型预期的更难实现；存在一类比指数快但不导致垂直渐近线的被忽视的增长率。生成时间被识别为起关键作用的参数，奇异增长要求生成时间迅速趋近于零。
Conclusion: 摘要强调生成时间是决定智能爆炸行为的关键因素，并指出分析智能爆炸动态时需要区分不同类型的超指数增长。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Knowing When to Stop: Bayesian Optimal Stopping for LLM Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: LLM evaluations often use fixed sampling budgets, testing every item the same number of times even after estimates are precise. We introduce optstop, a precision-based adaptive stopping framework that treats evaluation as a sequential measurement problem: keep sampling where uncertainty remains high, and stop where estimates are precise or stable enough. The framework builds on hierarchical Bayesian inference, supports binary, ordinal, and continuous outcomes, and keeps every benchmark item eligible for sampling, without requiring a calibrated item bank. It runs live or retrospectively, and includes a safeguard that samples more cautiously as measured performance approaches zero, where rare successes matter most. In an illustrative 200-item, 10-epoch evaluation, it removes 57%-97% of planned trials across nine validation settings, with overall conclusions equivalent to the full run. These results show that LLM evaluation compute can be allocated by uncertainty rather than by fixed repetition counts, with the magnitude of savings depending on evaluation design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 optstop，一个基于精度的自适应停止框架，用于 LLM 评估，将评估视为顺序测量问题，在不确定性高时继续采样，在估计精确或稳定时停止。框架基于层次贝叶斯推断，支持二值、有序和连续结果，无需校准题库。在 200 项、10 epoch 的示例评估中，九种验证设置下移除了 57%-97% 的计划试验，且总体结论与完整运行等价。
Motivation: LLM 评估通常使用固定采样预算，即使估计已经精确，仍对每个项目测试相同的次数，造成计算浪费。
Method: 引入 optstop 框架，基于层次贝叶斯推断，把评估当作顺序测量问题；支持二值、有序、连续结果，并允许所有基准项目保持可采样；可实时或回顾性运行，且在性能接近零时会更谨慎地采样，因为此时罕见成功最为关键。
Result: 在 200 项、10 epoch 的示例评估中，九种验证设置下移除了 57%-97% 的计划试验，总体结论与完整运行等价。
Conclusion: LLM 评估的计算量可以按不确定性而非固定重复次数来分配，节省幅度取决于评估设计。

papers.title: UMPIRE-Net: Unrolled Magnitude-Phase Regularization Network for Accelerated MRI
papers.abstract_en: MRI reconstruction from undersampled k-space measurements is an ill-posed inverse problem. Physics-driven deep learning (PD-DL) methods have shown strong performance for this task by combining the MRI forward model with learned image regularization within algorithm-unrolling frameworks. However, most existing PD-DL methods reconstruct complex-valued images directly, thereby implicitly coupling magnitude and phase within a single learned representation. This coupled regularization may be suboptimal in reconstruction settings where accurate phase modeling plays an important role, such as partial Fourier (PF) imaging, where recovery of the omitted asymmetric k-space measurements depends on the underlying image phase. In such scenarios, explicit modeling of magnitude and phase as separate components may reduce the reliance on externally estimated or predefined phase information. To this end, we propose UMPIRE-Net (Unrolled Magnitude-Phase In REgularization Network), a PD-DL method that introduces separate learned regularizers for magnitude and phase components, together with a novel data-fidelity formulation that enforces measurements consistency. We evaluate UMPIRE-Net for accelerated MRI with PF across different datasets and acceleration factors. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method improves reconstruction quality compared with a conventional complex-valued PD-DL baseline, yielding sharper images and reduced artifacts. Code available at: https://github.com/MahdiSaberii/UMPIRE-Net
papers.comment: IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UMPIRE-Net，一种用于加速 MRI 重建的物理驱动深度学习 (PD-DL) 方法，在算法展开 (algorithm unrolling) 框架中对幅度和相位分量分别施加学习到的正则化，并设计新的数据保真 (data fidelity) 公式以加强 k-space 测量一致性。摘要报告该方法在部分傅里叶 (partial Fourier, PF) 加速 MRI 重建中比传统复数域 PD-DL 基线产生更清晰的图像和更少的伪影。
Motivation: 现有 PD-DL 方法通常直接重建复数图像，隐式地将幅度和相位耦合在单一表示中，这在相位建模重要的场景（如 PF 成像）下可能次优，且依赖外部估计或预定义的相位信息。
Method: 提出显式分离幅度与相位分量的学习正则化器，并结合新颖的数据保真度公式来强制测量一致性，整体在算法展开框架中实现。
Result: 在不同数据集和加速因子下评估加速 MRI 与 PF 场景，显示相比传统复数域 PD-DL 基线，重建质量提升，图像更锐利、伪影更少。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式建模幅度和相位作为独立分量可以减少对外部估计相位信息的依赖，并提升 PF 加速 MRI 的重建质量；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: More Correct Mass, Worse Answers: Why Power Sampling Can Fail and How to Fix It
papers.abstract_en: Power Sampling sharpens a language model's distribution over complete generation trajectories, offering a verifier-free way to improve reasoning at inference time. It also has the potential to serve as a general-purpose front end for a broad range of downstream sampling methods. However, we uncover a striking paradox: Power Sampling can drive more probability mass toward correct trajectories while degrading the downstream inference it is intended to enhance. Using self-consistency as a representative case, we observe accuracy drops of up to 18.5 percentage points across models and reasoning benchmarks. We trace this paradox to two mismatches. Dose mismatch arises because a fixed exponent induces drastically different amounts of distributional change across problems. Coverage mismatch arises because global sharpening concentrates mass on a narrow set of dominant paths: high pass@k, often interpreted as evidence of preserved diversity, can therefore coexist with the loss of broad reasoning-path support required for downstream aggregation, search, and selection. Guided by this diagnosis, we replace uniform trajectory exponentiation with a deformation-controlled, support-preserving Power target that calibrates sharpening across problems while limiting the suppression of moderate-probability paths. In a same-budget instantiation with weighted self-consistency, the repaired sampler reverses the losses caused by global Power and outperforms standard multi-sample inference across reasoning benchmarks.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Haohui Yang and Jiaxing Sun contributed equally. Xiujun Ma is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Power Sampling 对语言模型推理采样的影响，发现一个悖论：它能将更多概率质量导向正确轨迹，却会损害其本应增强的下游推理。以自洽性 (self-consistency) 为代表案例，作者观察到多个模型和推理基准上准确率最多下降 18.5 个百分点，并将原因归结为剂量不匹配与覆盖不匹配，提出变形控制且保支持的 Power 目标来修复。
Motivation: Power Sampling 有望作为免验证器的推理增强手段，也可作为通用前端服务于多种下游采样方法，但作者发现它可能降低下游推理效果；理解并解决这一矛盾对推理时采样方法的设计很重要。
Method: 通过自洽性案例诊断出两类不匹配：固定指数在不同问题上导致分布变化量差异巨大的剂量不匹配，以及全局锐化将概率质量集中到少数主导路径、丢失广泛推理路径支持的覆盖不匹配。据此提出用变形控制、保支持的 Power 目标替代统一的轨迹指数化，跨问题校准锐化强度并限制对中等概率路径的过度抑制。
Result: 在多个模型和推理基准上，Power Sampling 使自洽性准确率最多下降 18.5 个百分点；在同等预算下用加权自洽性 (weighted self-consistency) 实例化修复后的采样器，可逆转全局 Power 造成的损失，并优于标准多采样推理。
Conclusion: 摘要强调高 pass@k 并不代表推理路径多样性被保留，全局锐化可能破坏下游聚合、搜索与选择所需的支撑集；修复后的 Power 采样器能够在保持采样预算的同时更稳健地改善推理。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CytoBERT: A Foundation Model for Cytometry Data
papers.abstract_en: Cytometry measures the complex characteristics of single cells (e.g., counts and protein expression of immune cells) and is widely used across immunological research and clinical settings. However, cytometry data is highly heterogeneous and unstandardized due to experimental protocols and the choice of measured features. While machine learning methods hold the potential to gain deeper insights into cell biology, these challenges make them difficult to apply and transfer across studies. Recent advances in foundation models can alleviate these issues, but corresponding approaches are still scarce in this field. To address this, we provide CytoBERT, a publicly available, open-source, open-weight foundation model for single-cell cytometry data with variable marker panels. CytoBERT is pretrained in a self-supervised manner on a large-scale cytometry corpus (15 human datasets with heterogeneous marker panels and more than 50 million cells) curated through marker standardization, enabling it to learn transferable inter-marker relationships within cells. Fine-tuning CytoBERT for sample-level classification demonstrates that transfer learning across heterogeneous cytometry datasets is feasible, providing a starting point for scalable, generalizable cytometry analysis. Code is available at GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CytoBERT，一个面向单细胞流式/质谱细胞术（cytometry）数据、支持可变标记面板（marker panel）的开源开放权重基础模型。模型在包含 15 个人类数据集、超过 5000 万个细胞的语料上以自监督方式预训练，并通过标记标准化（marker standardization）学习细胞内部可迁移的标记间关系。在下游样本级分类任务上微调后，作者展示了跨异质细胞术数据集的迁移学习是可行的。
Motivation: 细胞术数据因实验方案和测量特征选择而高度异质且缺乏标准化，导致机器学习方法难以应用和跨研究迁移；基础模型虽有缓解此类问题的潜力，但在该领域仍很稀缺。
Method: CytoBERT 采用自监督预训练，训练语料为经过标记标准化整理的 15 个人类细胞术数据集（超过 5000 万个细胞），旨在学习细胞内可迁移的标记间关系（inter-marker relationships），并支持可变标记面板。
Result: 将 CytoBERT 微调用于样本级分类，结果表明跨异质细胞术数据集的迁移学习是可行的。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为可扩展、可泛化的细胞术分析提供了起点，并将模型与代码公开（open-source、open-weight，代码见 GitHub）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Inference in Distributional Temporal-Difference Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study online statistical inference for functionals of the return distribution under a fixed policy. The return distribution is estimated by nonparametric distributional temporal-difference learning from a single Markov trajectory. For the Polyak--Ruppert averaged estimator, we prove that its root-$T$ error converges weakly to a centered Gaussian random element in Cramér space. We also prove that, conditionally on the observed trajectory, the root-$T$ difference between the bootstrap and original averages converges weakly to the same Gaussian limit. These results justify bootstrap inference for smooth statistical functionals, including variance, CVaR, expected shortfall, and expectiles. For nonsmooth statistical functionals, we develop a local asymptotic theory for the estimated return CDF over $T^{-1/2}$-neighborhoods of finitely many thresholds, together with its bootstrap analogue. This theory allows us to conduct inference for nonsmooth statistical functionals characterized by CDF equations, including return quantiles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在固定策略下，基于单条马尔可夫轨迹使用非参数分布时域差分学习（distributional temporal-difference learning）估计回报分布，并对该分布的泛函进行在线统计推断。作者证明 Polyak–Ruppert 平均估计量的 root-T 误差在 Cramér 空间中弱收敛到中心高斯随机元，并证明基于观测轨迹的 bootstrap 与原始平均的 root-T 差也收敛到同一高斯极限。对于非光滑泛函，文章建立回报 CDF 在有限阈值 T^{-1/2} 邻域内的局部渐近理论及其 bootstrap 版本，从而支持对由 CDF 方程刻画的分位数等非光滑泛函进行推断。
Motivation: 分布时域差分学习在强化学习中广泛用于估计回报分布，但对其估计量的在线统计推断（如置信区间和假设检验）缺乏理论保证。现有工作大多关注估计的收敛性，而非推断性质，本文旨在为光滑和非光滑回报分布泛函提供严格的渐近推断基础。
Method: 采用非参数分布时域差分学习从单条马尔可夫轨迹估计回报分布，并研究 Polyak–Ruppert 平均估计量的渐近分布。通过证明估计误差在 Cramér 空间中的弱收敛性，以及条件 bootstrap 的渐近等价性，建立光滑泛函（方差、CVaR、期望短缺、expectiles）的推断方法；对非光滑泛函，发展回报 CDF 在阈值附近的局部渐近理论及其 bootstrap 版本。
Result: 摘要报告两个主要理论结果：Polyak–Ruppert 平均估计量的 root-T 误差弱收敛到中心高斯随机元；条件 bootstrap 与原始平均的 root-T 差收敛到同一高斯极限。这些结果支持方差、CVaR、期望短缺、expectiles 等光滑泛函的 bootstrap 推断，并进一步允许对回报分位数等非光滑泛函进行推断。
Conclusion: 本文为分布时域差分学习提供了在线统计推断的渐近理论，覆盖光滑与非光滑回报分布泛函，并给出 bootstrap 推断的合理性证明。文章为 61 页的理论性工作，未在摘要中报告实验评估。
Relevance: 0
