papers.title: The Past and Future of AI Scientists
papers.abstract_en: We present a survey of the past and future of AI Scientists: machines capable of automating science. AI Scientists can originate hypotheses, deduce their consequences, design and execute experiments, interpret their results, and revise their beliefs. Such systems are integrated scientific agents, connected to the literature, formal knowledge, mathematical models, simulations, data-analysis systems and physical laboratories. Adam was the first machine to make novel scientific discoveries through cycles of hypothesis formation and physical experimentation. Eve established the architecture of the modern self-driving laboratory. Foundation models, autonomous agents and laboratory robotics now make it possible to build systems far more general than either Adam or Eve. The central problem is no longer whether individual components of science can be automated. They can. The problem is integration. AI Scientists must combine neural learning with logic, probability, mathematics, causal reasoning, simulation, experimental design, robotics and formal scientific records. AI Scientists have the potential to transform science: to make science faster, cheaper, more systematic and more reproducible. AI Scientists could investigate systems too complicated for unaided human science, and enable thousands of AI scientists to work together on single problems. The Nobel Turing Challenge sets the goal of developing by 2050 AI systems capable of automating Nobel-quality discoveries. Progress is ahead of schedule. When we succeed it will create a new form of science and transform the world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于AI科学家（自动从事科学发现的机器）过去与未来的综述。作者回顾了Adam和Eve等早期系统，指出当前基础模型、自主智能体（autonomous agents）和实验室机器人已使构建更通用的系统成为可能，核心问题已从单个环节能否自动化转向集成（integration）问题。摘要还提出Nobel Turing Challenge目标，即到2050年实现自动化诺贝尔级发现，并称进展超前于计划。
Motivation: 科学自动化的主要瓶颈不再是科学中单个组件能否自动化，而是如何将神经学习、逻辑、概率、数学、因果推理、模拟、实验设计、机器人与正式科学记录整合为统一的科学智能体，以加速、降低成本和提升科学可复现性。
Method: 本文是一篇综述，梳理AI科学家的历史脉络，从自动化假设形成与物理实验的Adam到建立现代自驱动实验室架构的Eve，并讨论基于基础模型、自主智能体和机器人技术构建更通用系统的前景，以及Nobel Turing Challenge所设定的2050年目标。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果；其主要论断是AI科学家能够研究过于复杂而无法由人类独立完成的系统，并可使数千个AI科学家协作处理单一问题，同时Nobel Turing Challenge的进展超前于计划。
Conclusion: 作者认为成功实现自动化科学将创造一种新形式的科学并转变世界；但作为展望性综述，摘要未给出具体评估或局限性说明。
Relevance: 15

summary_sections.motivation: 科学自动化的主要瓶颈不再是科学中单个组件能否自动化，而是如何将神经学习、逻辑、概率、数学、因果推理、模拟、实验设计、机器人与正式科学记录整合为统一的科学智能体，以加速、降低成本和提升科学可复现性。
summary_sections.method: 本文是一篇综述，梳理AI科学家的历史脉络，从自动化假设形成与物理实验的Adam到建立现代自驱动实验室架构的Eve，并讨论基于基础模型、自主智能体和机器人技术构建更通用系统的前景，以及Nobel Turing Challenge所设定的2050年目标。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果；其主要论断是AI科学家能够研究过于复杂而无法由人类独立完成的系统，并可使数千个AI科学家协作处理单一问题，同时Nobel Turing Challenge的进展超前于计划。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为成功实现自动化科学将创造一种新形式的科学并转变世界；但作为展望性综述，摘要未给出具体评估或局限性说明。

papers.title: From Style Replication to Style Exploration: Enabling Art Style Exploration with Analyze-Experiment-Resituate Framework
papers.abstract_en: Art style is a signature of professional digital artists that develops through repeated experimentation, reflection, and adaptation. While generative AI (GenAI) can reproduce styles with high fidelity, current tools provide limited support for exploring new stylistic directions and may encourage style replication over exploration. To address this gap, we propose Analyze-Experiment-Resituate (AER), a framework for AI-assisted style exploration derived from interviews with 10 professional digital artists. Rather than prioritizing visually appealing outputs alone, AER supports three core practices of style exploration, including interpreting references, trying out stylistic possibilities, and reflecting on how emerging styles may be received. Specifically, AER enabled artists to (1) analyze artworks into interpretable stylistic elements, (2) have controllable experimentation guided by their own choices, and (3) resituate emerging styles through simulated social perspectives. We implemented AER in a prototype system and evaluated it in a controlled study with 16 artists. Compared with a direct style-transfer workflow, AER increased artists' agency and reflection as they pursued new stylistic directions. A two-week field study with four artists revealed how the AER framework influenced daily style exploration, such as reflection, experimentation, and stylistic decision-making at each stage. We discuss opportunities and challenges in designing AI-assisted style-exploration workflows, and outline implications for future artistic support tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式 AI 在艺术风格复制上的局限，提出 Analyze-Experiment-Resituate (AER) 框架，用于 AI 辅助的风格探索。框架源自对 10 位专业数字艺术家的访谈，包含解析作品为可解释风格元素、按自身选择进行可控实验、以及通过模拟社会视角重新情境化新兴风格三个核心实践。作者在原型系统上进行了 16 位艺术家的对照研究和 4 位艺术家的两周实地研究，结果显示相比直接风格迁移工作流，AER 提升了艺术家的能动性与反思。
Motivation: 现有生成式 AI 工具虽然能高保真复制风格，但对探索新的风格方向支持有限，甚至可能鼓励风格复制而非探索；这一空白是本文要解决的问题。
Method: 提出 AER 框架，基于对专业艺术家的访谈提炼出风格探索的三个核心实践：分析 (Analyze) 参照作品为可解释的风格元素、受控实验 (Experiment) 以支持由艺术家自身选择引导的尝试、以及重新情境化 (Resituate) 以通过模拟社会视角反思新兴风格的接受情况；并据此实现了一个原型系统。
Result: 在 16 位艺术家的对照研究中，相比直接风格迁移工作流，AER 增加了艺术家追求新风格方向时的能动性和反思；为期两周的 4 位艺术家实地研究进一步揭示了该框架如何影响日常风格探索中的反思、实验和各阶段风格决策。
Conclusion: 作者讨论了 AI 辅助风格探索工作流的设计机会与挑战，并概述了对未来艺术支持工具的启示。

papers.title: CRAFT: Constrained Reward via Attention Fine-Tuning for Subject Personalization without Composed Targets
papers.abstract_en: Subject-driven image personalization---generating new images that preserve the identity of one or several reference subjects in novel scenes---is a foundational capability for modern visual content creation. It is currently dominated by generalized methods that fine-tune a pretrained multimodal diffusion transformer (MMDiT) on hundreds of thousands to millions of paired \emph{(reference, composed-target)} examples, where each composed target is a synthesized image of the subject in a novel scene. Producing such targets demands a costly multi-stage curation pipeline---LLM-based prompt generation, T2I-based composed-target synthesis, reference-subject extraction, VLM-based quality filtering, and correspondence labeling---and tightly couples each method to a particular target synthesizer and curation choice. We introduce \emph{CRAFT} (Constrained Reward via Attention Fine-Tuning), a single-step ReFL framework that fine-tunes a pre-trained \emph{reference-aware} MMDiT via LoRA adapters using a compact reference-only data construction---$10$K reference images and subject masks, with no composed-target supervision. CRAFT realizes a \emph{Where to look} principle: attention-level rewards align noise- and phrase-token attention with the correct reference subject, and the resulting per-subject attention masks gate a pixel-level identity reward to keep image-space supervision consistent with the learned attention routing. Applied to FLUX.2-klein-9B, CRAFT achieves state-of-the-art performance on XVerseBench \rev{while using no composed-target supervision---only $10$K reference-only samples, whereas prior generalized methods require $150$K to over $2$M composed-target pairs}. The same recipe transfers to other reference-aware backbones, consistently improving performance. Project page: https://jihun999.github.io/projects/CRAFT/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRAFT（Constrained Reward via Attention Fine-Tuning），一种无需合成目标图像（composed-target）监督的主体个性化方法。它通过 LoRA 适配器在约 1 万张参考图像和主体掩码上对预训练的参考感知多模态扩散 Transformer（MMDiT）做单步 ReFL 微调，并用注意力级奖励与注意力掩码门控的像素级身份奖励来约束生成。在 FLUX.2-klein-9B 上，CRAFT 以仅 1 万参考样本在 XVerseBench 取得当前最优，且该训练方式可迁移到其他参考感知主干。
Motivation: 现有通用主体个性化方法依赖数十万到数百万对（参考图, 合成目标图）数据，合成目标需要多阶段高成本流程（LLM 提示生成、T2I 合成、参考主体提取、VLM 质量过滤、对应标注），且方法被绑定到特定目标合成器与数据筛选方案。作者希望去除对合成目标监督的依赖，降低数据构建成本并增强方法通用性。
Method: CRAFT 采用单步 ReFL 框架，用 LoRA 适配器微调预训练的参考感知 MMDiT，仅使用约 1 万张参考图像与主体掩码。其核心是“看哪里”（Where to look）原则：注意力级奖励使噪声 token 与短语 token 的注意力对齐正确的参考主体；学习得到的逐主体注意力掩码进一步门控像素级身份奖励，使图像空间监督与注意力路由保持一致。
Result: 应用于 FLUX.2-klein-9B 时，CRAFT 在 XVerseBench 上达到当前最优，且不使用任何合成目标监督，仅需 1 万参考样本，而以往通用方法需要 15 万到超过 200 万对合成目标数据。同一训练配方迁移到其他参考感知骨干时也持续带来性能提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过注意力约束奖励进行微调可以替代组合目标监督，从而显著降低主体个性化方法的数据依赖和流程复杂度。其适用对象限定为参考感知（reference-aware）架构，并依赖紧凑的参考图像加掩码数据构建。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Offline Deep Q* Estimation with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: In offline RL, estimating the optimal action-value function $Q^*$ can be formulated as solving the optimal Bellman equation based solely on offline observations. A fundamental challenge is that the reward function and transition kernel are unknown, so the optimal Bellman operator is not directly observable from data. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework that decouples operator estimation from value function learning. In this approach, we first formulate conditional diffusion models to estimate the reward law and transition kernel, which induces a data-driven approximation of the optimal Bellman operator. We then plug these estimators into the Bellman equation and obtain a deep estimator of $Q^*$ by minimizing the empirical Bellman residual over a neural network function class. Theoretically, we first establish sharp nonasymptotic convergence rates for learning the optimal Bellman operator through an end-to-end analysis of conditional diffusion estimation in total variation distance. We then establish the oracle value-stage rate $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(n^{-\frac{2β}{d_x+d_a+2β}}\bigr)$ for the excess Bellman residual risk. Finally, under a concentrability condition, we translate this residual bound into an $L^2$ convergence rate of $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(n^{-\fracβ{d_x+d_a+2β}}\bigr)$ for the resulting deep estimator of $Q^*$, where $d_x$ and $d_a$ denote the dimensions of the state and action spaces, respectively, and $β$ denotes the Hölder smoothness index of $Q^*$. Importantly, our theoretical analysis does not rely on completeness assumptions commonly used in deep RL theory. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and its strong empirical performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离线强化学习中的最优动作值函数 Q* 估计，提出将算子估计与值函数学习解耦的框架：先用条件扩散模型估计奖励分布与转移核，从而得到最优 Bellman 算子的数据驱动逼近，再将该算子代入 Bellman 方程，在神经网络函数类上最小化经验 Bellman 残差。理论部分给出了条件扩散估计在总变差距离下的非渐近收敛率，以及过剩 Bellman 残差风险和 Q* 估计的 L2 收敛率，且不依赖深度 RL 理论中常用的完整性假设。数值实验验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 离线 RL 中估计 Q* 可归结为仅基于离线观测求解最优 Bellman 方程，但奖励函数和转移核未知，导致最优 Bellman 算子无法直接从数据中观测，这是核心困难。
Method: 提出解耦框架：首先用条件扩散模型估计奖励分布和转移核，构造数据驱动的最优 Bellman 算子逼近；然后将估计的算子嵌入 Bellman 方程，在神经网络函数类上通过最小化经验 Bellman 残差得到 Q* 的深度估计器。
Result: 理论上建立了估计最优 Bellman 算子的非渐近收敛率（基于总变差距离的端到端条件扩散估计分析），给出过剩 Bellman 残差风险的 oracle 值阶段速率 tilde O(n^{-2β/(d_x+d_a+2β)})；在可集中性条件下，进一步得到 Q* 深度估计器的 L2 收敛率 tilde O(n^{-β/(d_x+d_a+2β)})，其中 d_x、d_a 为状态与动作维度，β 为 Q* 的 Hölder 光滑指数。实验表明方法有效且经验性能强。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该理论分析不依赖深度 RL 理论中常用的完整性假设，并通过大量数值实验展示了所提方法的有效性和强经验表现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Whose doctor does the AI recommend? An algorithm audit of reputation and demographic signals in large language model-assisted physician choice
papers.abstract_en: Patients increasingly ask large language model (LLM) assistants which doctor to see, making these systems AI infomediaries: algorithms that intermediate one person's choice among other people and thereby decide, silently and at scale, which physicians become visible. We report a prespecified randomized algorithm audit of what causally moves those recommendations. Seven models (six open-weight; gpt-4o-mini) each chose among five synthetic family-medicine physician cards whose attributes were independently randomized across 3,024 choice sets, three patient personas, nine prompt paraphrases and nine experimental arms, yielding 40,068 scored responses; gender and ethnicity were signaled through names following correspondence-audit methodology. Reputation signals dominate: raising a rating from 3.9 to 4.7 increases choice probability by 31.4 percentage points (pp), and raising the fee from $90 to $190 lowers it by 20.0 pp. Demographic parity is rejected, but not in the direction human audit studies predict: female-signaled names gain 2.5 pp, and Hispanic-, South-Asian- and Black-signaled names gain 1.3-2.9 pp over White-signaled names, tilts worth $7-$14 per visit in fee-equivalent terms, and a content-free first-listed position is worth $11. Yet models mentioned gender or ethnicity in at most 0.03% of their stated reasons and abstained in 0.39% of trials, so these effects are invisible in the models' own explanations, and transparency obligations relying on model self-report would not detect them. One reasoning model failed the prespecified auditability gate outright. The frozen design makes the audit repeatable: any new model can be assessed against identical stimuli, making recurring behavioural audit, rather than self-reported explanation, the monitoring technology fit for purpose.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一项预先注册的随机算法审计，考察大型语言模型（LLM）助手在患者选择医生场景中哪些信号因果性地影响推荐。七种模型（六种开放权重模型及 gpt-4o-mini）在 3,024 个选择集、三个人设、九个提示改写和九个实验臂中，从五张合成的家庭医生卡片中选择，共得到 40,068 个带评分响应。结果显示声誉信号主导推荐，人口统计信号虽有影响，但在模型给出的解释中几乎不可见。
Motivation: 患者越来越多地向 LLM 求助“该看哪位医生”，使这类系统成为 AI 信息中介（infomediary），在规模上静默决定哪些医生可见。论文指出现有透明度义务依赖模型自我报告的解释，而这些自我报告无法探测上述偏差，因此需要可重复的行为审计来监控推荐。
Method: 采用预注册的随机算法审计：五个合成家庭医生卡片的属性被独立随机化，性别与族裔通过姓名信号传递（沿用 correspondence-audit 方法）；七种模型在各实验臂中对固定刺激作答。冻结设计保证可复现，任何新模型都可以用相同刺激被评估。
Result: 声誉信号主导：评分从 3.9 升至 4.7 使选择概率提高 31.4 个百分点，费用从 $90 升至 $190 使选择概率降低 20.0 个百分点。人口统计均等被拒绝，但方向与人类审计研究预期相反：女性姓名获得 2.5 个百分点，Hispanic、South-Asian 与 Black 姓名相对 White 姓名多 1.3-2.9 个百分点，折算为每次就诊约 $7-$14；首个展示位置（content-free）价值 $11。模型在理由中提及性别或族裔的比例至多为 0.03%，并在 0.39% 的试验中弃权；一个推理模型未通过预先设定的可审计性门槛。

papers.title: LLMs Don't Pay for the Jump
papers.abstract_en: Zahavy [2026] argues that Large Language Models, despite their capabilities in induction and deduction, cannot perform the abductive "Jump" that produced Einstein's equivalence principle, and attributes this limitation to the absence of embodied simulation. Zheng-Xin [2026] and Farmer [2026] question whether embodiment is necessary for abduction, pointing to alternative routes to General Relativity and forms of abduction that require no sensorimotor grounding. Max Planck resolved the blackbody radiation problem in 1900. Planck's move to E = hν required no embodied simulation. It was motivated by a mathematical consequence of classical theory, an infinite predicted energy for a finite measured quantity, that could not be physically accepted. We show that neither induction nor deduction could have produced the postulate and argue that its adoption required a coupling between epistemic error and physical cost. We formalize this distinction through thermodynamic coupling and show that fixed-weight transformer inference lacks such coupling, regardless of model scale. This is consistent with empirical results showing that output entropy remains nearly unchanged across tasks with sharply increasing causal difficulty, even as accuracy falls from 100% to 17%. We therefore argue that the missing ingredient in machine abduction may lie deeper than embodiment: a system must have some physical mechanism through which epistemic error becomes costly enough to force revision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从 Planck 1900 年解决黑体辐射问题并提出 E = hν 的历史案例切入，论证大语言模型缺乏完成溯因性 "Jump" 所需的机制，并将缺失环节定位为认知错误与物理代价之间的热力学耦合 (thermodynamic coupling)。作者认为固定权重 Transformer 推理无论规模大小都缺乏这种耦合，并用"任务因果难度上升时输出熵几乎不变、准确率从 100% 降至 17%"的经验结果加以支持，以此回应关于具身模拟 (embodied simulation) 是否必要的争论。
Motivation: 针对 Zahavy [2026] 将 LLM 无法完成爱因斯坦等效原理式溯因跳跃归因于缺乏具身模拟，以及 Zheng-Xin [2026] 和 Farmer [2026] 对此必要性的质疑，作者希望找到比 embodiment 更根本的缺失条件。Planck 案例表明无需具身模拟也能产生划时代假说，因此需要解释是什么机制让既不能由归纳也不能由演绎推出的假说最终被采纳。
Method: 通过 Planck 黑体辐射案例论证 E = hν 这一公设无法由归纳或演绎产生，其采纳要求认知错误与物理代价之间的耦合；作者用热力学耦合形式化这一区分，并分析固定权重 Transformer 推理，指出其不具备该耦合，同时给出输出熵与准确率随任务因果难度变化的实证观察。
Result: 经验结果显示，在因果难度急剧上升的任务上模型准确率从 100% 降至 17%，但输出熵几乎保持不变；作者认为这与固定权重推理缺乏热力学耦合的论断一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为机器溯因缺失的关键可能比具身模拟更根本：系统需要某种物理机制，使认知错误变得足够昂贵从而强制修正。该结论主要基于 Planck 案例的概念论证，经验证据限于输出熵与准确率的变化模式。

papers.title: AI-Assisted Discovery and Construction of a Counterexample to the Convergence of Three-Block ADMM with the Identity Matrix as its Third Constraint Block
papers.abstract_en: The alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), as a landmark algorithm, has attracted tremendous research attention and extensive practical applications over the past two decades. It is well known that, although the two-block ADMM enjoys well-established theoretical convergence guarantees, its direct extension to the three-block case may fail to converge, as demonstrated by existing counterexamples [5]. However, to the best of our knowledge, the case in which the third constraint block is the identity remains unresolved: the existing literature gives neither a general convergence proof nor a counterexample for this subclass. In this paper, we give a negative answer: direct three-block ADMM may fail even when the first two blocks are strongly convex quadratics. Using Codex with GPT-5.6 Sol, we construct an explicit rational counterexample candidate and verify it along a piecewise-affine reduction path; exact checks show that direct three-block ADMM on this instance produces a bounded nonconvergent orbit of period 66. Within the same Codex workflow, we further guide a study of multiplier relaxation and clarify when convergence can be restored at the fixed-instance and class levels: a problem-dependent small dual step can restore convergence, whereas no positive relative step works uniformly over the whole class. Furthermore, we also test the recent Kimi Code with Kimi K3 model without the Codex candidate or project-specific route guidance; along a different path it produces an exact locally attracting period-23 certificate, convertible to an equivalent all-identity instance. The comparison suggests that different research-harness configurations can shape the mathematical objects explored and the certificates pursued.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对三块 ADMM（alternating direction method of multipliers）中第三个约束块为单位矩阵这一尚未解决的情形，给出否定性答案：即使前两块为强凸二次函数，直接三块 ADMM 也可能不收敛。作者借助 Codex 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 构造并精确验证了一个显式有理数反例，该实例产生周期为 66 的有界非收敛轨道；随后在相同工作流中研究乘子松弛，并比较了另一种 AI 研究配置（Kimi Code 与 Kimi K3）下得到的周期 23 证书。
Motivation: 两块 ADMM 有成熟收敛理论，但三块直接扩展可能失效；已有反例未覆盖第三个约束块为单位矩阵的子类，该子类既无一般收敛证明也无反例，是文献中遗留的开放问题。
Method: 通过 AI 辅助搜索构造显式有理数反例候选，沿分段仿射约简路径进行验证，并用精确计算确认轨道性质；在同一 Codex 工作流中研究乘子松弛对收敛恢复的影响，同时用不同模型配置（Kimi Code 与 Kimi K3）独立探索以对比所得数学对象。
Result: 摘要报告直接三块 ADMM 在第三约束块为单位矩阵且前两块为强凸二次函数时仍可能发散，给出的实例产生有界非收敛周期 66 轨道；问题依赖的小步长对偶步长可恢复收敛，但不存在对整类一致有效的正相对步长；另一配置得到可转化为全单位矩阵实例的周期 23 局部吸引证书。
Conclusion: 摘要给出的结论是：单位约束块这一子类的三块 ADMM 直接扩展并不具备收敛保证，且收敛恢复依赖于具体实例的步长选择；此外，不同的 AI 研究工具链配置会影响所探索的数学对象和所追求的证书类型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IRGNN: Efficient Invariant Radar Graph Neural Network for Radar Point Cloud Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Perception is a fundamental component of autonomous driving systems. While LiDAR-based methods have achieved remarkable progress in object detection, their reliability can degrade under adverse weather conditions. Radar point clouds provide a robust alternative due to their resilience to bad weather and low-illumination scenarios. However, radar point clouds are typically sparse, unordered, and less informative than LiDAR data, making it challenging to directly apply existing LiDAR-based perception methods. To address these challenges, we propose IRGNN, an Invariant Radar Graph Neural Network for radar point cloud object detection. IRGNN first reconstructs radar point clouds into graph representations using translation- and rotation-invariant feature designs, enabling robust modeling of sparse radar measurements. It then employs an improved message passing neural network (MPNN) with residual connections and a virtual node layer to enhance local feature propagation and global context modeling. Finally, task-specific heads are applied to the learned graph representations for object classification and bounding box prediction. Experimental results on the RadarScenes dataset show that IRGNN outperforms existing radar-based object detection methods and achieves competitive performance. In addition, IRGNN significantly reduces computational cost and memory usage during inference, demonstrating its effectiveness and practical potential for efficient radar-based perception in autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IRGNN，一种面向雷达点云目标检测的等变图神经网络。IRGNN 先将稀疏雷达点云重构为具有平移和旋转不变性特征的图表示，再用带残差连接和虚拟节点层（virtual node layer）的改进消息传递神经网络（MPNN）增强局部特征传播与全局上下文建模，最后用任务专用头完成分类和包围框预测。在 RadarScenes 数据集上，IRGNN 优于现有基于雷达的目标检测方法并达到有竞争力的性能，同时显著降低推理阶段的计算成本和内存占用。
Motivation: 自动驾驶感知中，LiDAR 方法在恶劣天气下可靠性下降；雷达点云对恶劣天气和低光照更鲁棒，但其稀疏、无序、信息量低于 LiDAR，导致现有 LiDAR 感知方法难以直接迁移。
Method: 将雷达点云重建为图表示，并采用平移和旋转不变的特征设计以稳健建模稀疏测量；随后使用带有残差连接和虚拟节点层的改进 MPNN 提升局部信息传播与全局上下文建模；最后用任务专用头进行目标分类和包围框预测。
Result: 在 RadarScenes 数据集上，IRGNN 的检测性能优于现有基于雷达的方法且具有竞争力，并大幅降低推理时的计算开销和内存使用。
Conclusion: 作者认为 IRGNN 展示了高效雷达感知在自动驾驶中的实用潜力，尤其适用于恶劣天气等场景。

papers.title: Tripwire: Triggering Aligned Refusal via Statistically Certified Safety Neurons
papers.abstract_en: Neuron- and path-level interventions offer the finest-grained route to defending large language models (LLMs) against jailbreak attacks, yet existing methods fall short of this promise, i.e., they often compromise model utility significantly. Specifically, one line of work suppresses toxic neurons to erase harmful semantics, but since such semantics are distributed across the network, blocking every pathway forces a large intervention footprint. An alternative line of research focus on identify safety neurons using external classifiers. While promising, the existing approaches suffer from compromising neurons that are important for the model utility as well. Moreover, both approaches remain always on and thus perturb every benign request even when no attack is present. To address these limitations, we present \ours{}, a training-free defense that first identifies safety-specific neurons through per-neuron hypothesis tests under false-discovery-rate control together with a utility-specificity filter. Based on this identification, a trigger-style clamp holds the selected neurons at their harmful-conditional mean activations, injecting an internal harmful-input signal that triggers the refusal behavior learned during alignment. The clamp is then realized by two provably equivalent deployment modes, namely a detector-gated inference-time intervention and an offline bias-patch weight edit. Extensive experiments across four safety-aligned LLMs and four representative attacks demonstrate that \ours{} reduces the average attack success rate to at most 2.0\% while incurring a utility drop of only 0.5\% to 5.3\% on MT-Bench, the smallest among all defenses. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Tripwire-65C4.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tripwire，一种免训练的 LLM 越狱防御方法。它通过逐神经元假设检验在错误发现率 (FDR) 控制下识别安全特异性神经元，并采用触发式钳制 (trigger-style clamp) 将选定神经元固定在有害条件均值激活上，从而注入内部有害输入信号并触发对齐阶段学到的拒绝行为。该方法提供检测器门控推理干预与离线偏置补丁权重编辑两种可证明等价的部署模式，在四个安全对齐 LLM 和四种攻击上平均攻击成功率降至至多 2.0%。
Motivation: 现有神经元/路径级防御要么通过抑制有毒神经元来消除有害语义，但因语义分布广泛而干预足迹过大；要么依赖外部分类器识别安全神经元，仍会损害对效用重要的神经元。此外这些方法始终开启，即使没有攻击也会扰动良性请求。
Method: 先对每个神经元进行假设检验并在 FDR 控制下筛选，再叠加效用特异性过滤器，得到安全神经元集合；随后用触发式钳制将选中神经元钳制到有害条件均值激活，以内部有害信号触发拒绝行为。部署时提供两种等价方式：检测器门控的推理时干预，以及离线偏置补丁权重编辑。
Result: 在四个安全对齐的大语言模型和四种代表性攻击下，平均攻击成功率被降至至多 2.0%，同时 MT-Bench 上的效用下降仅为 0.5% 到 5.3%，为所有对比防御中最小。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Tripwire 无需训练即可实现两种等价部署模式，并在保持模型效用方面优于现有防御。

papers.title: Can We Defend Against AI-Generated Video Attacks on Real-World Crisis Events? A Systematic Evaluation of Detectors, Generators and Social Dissemination
papers.abstract_en: Recent video generators can fabricate realistic depictions of wars, disasters, public emergencies, and other real-world crises, creating substantial risks of misinformation. Existing benchmarks, however, provide limited evidence on detector and generator behavior in such settings, including how detectability varies with generation conditions, how people perceive generated videos, and whether detectors remain reliable during social dissemination. To address this gap, we introduce RA-Bench, a benchmark for AI-generated video detection that uses Real videos as Anchors. RA-Bench contains 17,886 videos, comprising 1,830 real-video anchors across 10 social-risk categories and 16,056 generated clips from four open-source and five closed-source generators. Based on RA-Bench, we organize our evaluation along three dimensions. We first assess detector generalization across seven traditional detectors, ten zero-shot multimodal models under three review settings, and two MLLMs specifically fine-tuned on AI-generated video detection. Across these methods, none of the three detector families generalizes consistently across RA-Bench instances. We then examine how detectability varies with generation quality, conditioning information, and sampling seeds. These analyses show that generation properties affect detector families differently, while source-level detection patterns remain stable across seeds. Finally, we study human authenticity judgments and detector reliability during social dissemination. We find that videos that mislead people are also difficult for current detectors, and that social dissemination makes detection harder. Together, these findings show that current methods struggle to detect realistic AI-generated videos, highlighting the need for detectors robust to evolving video generators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RA-Bench，一个以真实视频为锚点的 AI 生成视频检测基准，包含 17,886 个视频，其中 1,830 个真实视频锚点覆盖 10 类社会风险场景，以及来自四个开源和五个闭源生成器的 16,056 个生成片段。基于该基准，作者从检测器泛化、生成条件对可检测性的影响、以及人类真实性判断与社交传播中的检测可靠性三个维度进行系统评估。结果显示三类检测方法均无法在 RA-Bench 上一致泛化，且能骗过人类的视频也更难被检测器识别，社交传播进一步加大了检测难度。
Motivation: 现有基准对真实世界危机事件中 AI 生成视频的检测器和生成器行为证据有限，尤其缺乏关于生成条件如何影响可检测性、人类如何感知生成视频、以及社交传播过程中检测器是否依然可靠的评估。
Method: 构建 RA-Bench 基准，包含 17,886 个视频（1,830 个真实视频锚点、16,056 个生成片段，来自 4 个开源和 5 个闭源生成器），覆盖 10 个社会风险类别；并沿三个维度评估：7 个传统检测器、10 个零样本多模态模型（三种审查设置）和 2 个针对 AI 生成视频检测微调的 MLLM 的泛化能力，随后分析生成质量、条件信息和采样种子对可检测性的影响，最后研究社交传播中的人类真实性判断与检测器可靠性。
Result: 三类检测器系列均未能在 RA-Bench 实例上一致泛化；生成属性对不同检测器系列的影响不同，而基于来源的检测模式在不同采样种子间保持稳定。摘要还报告，误导人类的视频同样难以被当前检测器识别，且社交传播会使检测更加困难。
Conclusion: 当前方法难以检测真实的 AI 生成视频，研究凸显了对能够适应不断演进的视频生成器的鲁棒检测器的需求。

papers.title: GBU-Palm: A Multimodal Video Dataset and Benchmark for Palm Presentation Attack Detection
papers.abstract_en: Existing palm presentation attack detection (PAD) datasets are often limited by static imagery, restricted acquisition conditions, or insufficient multimodal video data, hindering systematic evaluation across environments, modalities, and attack types. We present GBU-Palm, a large-scale multimodal video dataset and benchmark containing 21,326 videos from 105 subjects and 210 palms across six acquisition environments, including bona fide, Print, and Replay presentations, with 6,310 synchronized RGB-NIR samples. We construct leakage-controlled protocols that separate palm identity and attack lineage and benchmark four representative video architectures under environment-matched and held-out-environment settings. Results reveal substantial architecture-dependent degradation under environmental shift and show that RGB-NIR fusion does not consistently outperform RGB-only input. We further analyze model behavior through true accept (TA), true reject (TR), false accept (FA), and false reject (FR) decomposition, spectral masking, temporal-order intervention, and frozen-backbone NIR probing, revealing distinct failure patterns and evidence utilization across architectures. GBU-Palm provides a unified and challenging benchmark for developing and evaluating robust multimodal palm PAD methods under cross-environment conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GBU-Palm，一个大规模多模态视频数据集和基准，用于手掌演示攻击检测（PAD）。数据集包含来自105名受试者、210只手掌在6个采集环境下的21,326个视频，涵盖bona fide、Print和Replay三类演示，并提供6,310个同步RGB-NIR样本。作者设计了泄漏控制协议并基准测试四种代表性视频架构，结果显示环境偏移下的性能退化呈架构依赖性，且RGB-NIR融合并非始终优于仅使用RGB输入。
Motivation: 现有手掌PAD数据集多受限于静态图像、受限的采集条件或缺乏多模态视频数据，难以在环境、模态和攻击类型等维度上进行系统性评估。
Method: 构建GBU-Palm数据集，覆盖6个采集环境的21,326个视频与同步RGB-NIR样本；设计分离手掌身份和攻击谱系的泄漏控制协议（leakage-controlled protocols），并在环境匹配与held-out-environment两种设置下评测四种视频架构；随后通过true accept/true reject/false accept/false reject分解、频谱掩蔽（spectral masking）、时间顺序干预（temporal-order intervention）和冻结主干NIR探测（frozen-backbone NIR probing）分析模型行为。
Result: 摘要报告：在环境偏移下，不同架构出现显著的性能退化差异；RGB-NIR融合并不一致地优于仅RGB输入；行为分析揭示不同架构存在不同的失败模式和证据利用方式。数据集规模为21,326个视频（105名受试者、210只手掌、6个环境）和6,310个同步RGB-NIR样本。
Conclusion: 论文认为GBU-Palm为跨环境条件下鲁棒多模态手掌PAD方法的开发与评估提供了统一且具有挑战性的基准，同时指出环境泛化与多模态融合的收益仍存在未解决的问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeaMoE: Efficient MoE Structure for Fast Small-Batch Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have been widely adopted in real-time interactive applications such as coding assistants, real-time audio-video interaction systems. To meet the extremely low response latency requirements of these scenarios, practitioners commonly employ small-batch decoding, under which MoE inference becomes memory-bound and is severely bottlenecked by expert weight loading. However, this bottleneck has received limited attention, and existing solutions such as post-training weight compression or fine-grained expert design during pre-training either degrade model accuracy or introduce additional computation and communication overhead. To tackle this issue, we propose DeaMoE, a decoding-efficient MoE architecture, in which the experts are grouped into several departments, and the experts belonging to the same department share most parameters since they come from the same professional field, and additionally each expert contains a few private parameters to reflect its uniqueness. Moreover, we design customized two-stage routing strategy for DeaMoE to avoid redundant loading, under which DeaMoE greatly improves the efficiency during LLM decoding. Compared with vanilla MoE, DeaMoE reduces per-step loaded weights by up to 50.9% and achieves up to 1.33 end-to-end TPOT speedup for the pre-trained 7B model on A40, and up to 2.00x and 1.97x peak speedup for DeepSeek-V3 on A40 and H100 in microbenchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeaMoE，一种面向小批量解码的 MoE 架构，用于降低实时交互场景下 LoE 推理因专家权重加载而产生的内存瓶颈。其核心是把专家按专业领域划分为部门，同部门专家共享大部分参数并保留少量私有参数，同时设计两阶段路由以避免重复加载。相比 vanilla MoE，DeaMoE 在预训练 7B 模型上将每步加载权重减少最多 50.9%，端到端 TPOT 加速最高 1.33 倍，在 DeepSeek-V3 的微基准中取得最高 2.00 倍（A40）和 1.97 倍（H100）的峰值加速。
Motivation: 小批量解码下 MoE 推理受限于内存带宽，瓶颈集中在专家权重加载，而现有方案（训练后权重压缩或细粒度专家设计）要么损害模型精度，要么引入额外计算与通信开销。
Method: 提出 DeaMoE 结构，将专家分组到部门，同一部门内专家共享大部分参数并各自保留少量私有参数；还设计了定制的两阶段路由策略，以减少权重重复加载。
Result: 与 vanilla MoE 相比，DeaMoE 将每步加载权重最多降低 50.9%，预训练 7B 模型在 A40 上获得最高 1.33 倍端到端 TPOT 加速；在 DeepSeek-V3 微基准中，A40 和 H100 上峰值加速分别为 2.00 倍和 1.97 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为部门级参数共享配合两阶段路由可显著提升 LLM 解码效率，适合低延迟小批量交互场景；摘要未讨论该方法的训练精度影响或更广泛任务上的局限。

papers.title: AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world tasks require LLM agents to interact with their environments over long execution horizons. Errors that occur early in execution may propagate through both the agent context and environment state, and their effects may be difficult to reverse through subsequent actions. Existing methods mainly seek to reduce such errors through plan refinement and safety checks but provide little support after errors occur. To enable recovery during long-horizon execution, we present AgentRewind, a runtime recovery framework that records aligned checkpoints of the agent context and controlled environment, allowing agents to return to an earlier state and resume execution with information from previous attempts. We also construct MettleBench, a benchmark for evaluating task completion and partial progress on long-horizon engineering assignments containing a series of related requirements. Experiments across tasks, multiple models, execution strategies, and agent harnesses show that AgentRewind improves task success rate and average checklist progress over the compared baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentRewind，一个面向长时程 LLM 智能体的运行时恢复框架，通过记录智能体上下文与受控环境的对齐检查点，使智能体在执行出错后能够回退到较早状态并携带先前尝试的信息继续执行。作者还构建了 MettleBench 基准，用于评估长时程工程任务上的任务完成率与部分进展。实验表明该方法在多个任务、模型、执行策略与智能体框架上相比基线提升了任务成功率和平均清单进度。
Motivation: 长执行视界下，早期错误会通过智能体上下文和环境状态持续传播，且难以通过后续动作逆转；现有方法主要依靠计划细化和安全检查来减少错误，对错误发生后的恢复支持不足。
Method: 提出运行时恢复框架，记录智能体上下文与受控环境状态的对齐检查点，允许智能体回退到之前的执行状态并利用失败尝试中的信息重新恢复；同时构建 MettleBench 基准来评估长时程工程任务完成情况。
Result: 摘要报告跨任务、多种模型、执行策略及智能体框架的实验显示，AgentRewind 相比对比基线提高了任务成功率与平均清单进度，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调长时程执行中的运行时恢复机制能够为已经发生的错误提供事后支持，从而改善任务完成率。

papers.title: Reflex: Enabling Fast and Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models for Reaction-Critical Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved promising performance in robotic manipulation. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate generalization on static manipulation tasks and largely overlook dynamic interaction scenarios. To address this gap, we present ReflexBench, a benchmark for reaction-critical manipulation. ReflexBench contains six dynamic tasks and introduces an evaluation framework that decouples simulator stepping from robot control while supporting configurable latency under synchronous and asynchronous inference. Building upon ReflexBench, we propose ReflexVLA, an efficient VLA model designed for reaction-critical manipulation without large-scale robot-data pretraining. ReflexVLA enhances temporal reasoning through latent future prediction and multi-frame temporal fusion within the vision backbone, while reducing deployment latency through batched visual encoding and CUDA Graph replay. Experiments show that ReflexVLA consistently improves dynamic manipulation performance while maintaining competitive accuracy on standard static manipulation benchmarks, and real-world experiments further demonstrate its effectiveness under practical deployment conditions. Project website: https://reflexvla.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态交互场景下视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）评估缺失的问题，提出反应关键操作（reaction-critical manipulation）基准 ReflexBench 和高效模型 ReflexVLA。ReflexBench 包含六个动态任务，并引入将模拟器步进与机器人控制解耦的评估框架，支持同步与异步推理下的可配置延迟。ReflexVLA 通过潜在未来预测与多帧时间融合增强时间推理，并以批量视觉编码和 CUDA Graph replay 降低部署延迟。实验显示其在动态操作上持续提升，同时保持标准静态操作基准上的竞争力，真实世界实验也验证了实用性。
Motivation: 现有机器人操作基准主要评估静态任务上的泛化能力，普遍忽略动态交互场景，导致反应关键操作缺乏专门评估基准和高效模型。
Method: 提出 ReflexBench 基准，包含六个动态任务，其评估框架解耦模拟器步进与机器人控制，并支持同步/异步推理下的可配置延迟；在此基础上提出 ReflexVLA，在不依赖大规模机器人数据预训练的前提下，通过潜在未来预测和多帧时间融合增强时间推理，并通过批量视觉编码与 CUDA Graph replay 降低部署延迟。
Result: 实验表明 ReflexVLA 在动态操作任务上持续提升性能，并在标准静态操作基准上保持有竞争力的精度；真实世界实验进一步证明其在实际部署条件下的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的基准与模型能够支撑反应关键操作的评估与高效推理，且无需大规模机器人数据预训练即可兼顾动态性能与静态精度。

papers.title: A Survey of Large Models in Sports
papers.abstract_en: Sports have witnessed growing global enthusiasm in recent years, serving as a vital force for physical health, cultural exchange, social connection, and economic growth. The rapid advancement of large models, particularly (multimodal) large language models (M)LLMs, has demonstrated transformative potential to reshape sports understanding, analysis, and interaction across diverse domains. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of large models in sports, including (i) an overview of tasks and applications across different participant groups; (ii) a detailed analysis of sports-related datasets and benchmarks; and (iii) a critical discussion of current challenges and future directions. Our goal is to establish a foundation for advancing research and practical development of large-model-driven sports intelligence. An open-source GitHub repository is maintained at: https://github.com/Road2Redemption/Awesome_Large_Models_In_Sports1.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to Findings of ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于体育领域大模型的综述，系统梳理了大型语言模型与多模态大语言模型 (M)LLM 在体育理解、分析与交互中的应用。内容涵盖不同参与群体下的任务与应用、相关数据集与基准的详细分析，以及对当前挑战和未来方向的批判性讨论。论文共 36 页，含 4 幅图和 6 张表，已被 Findings of ACL 2026 接收，并维护了开源 GitHub 资源仓库。
Motivation: 体育在全球范围内日益受到关注，而大模型特别是 (多模态) 大语言模型的发展为重塑体育领域的理解、分析与交互带来了变革潜力；目前缺少对该方向的系统性梳理。
Method: 采用综述方法，围绕三部分展开：不同参与群体的任务与应用概述、体育相关数据集与基准的详细分析、当前挑战与未来方向的批判性讨论。
Result: 作为综述论文，本文不报告新的实验结果，而是给出任务分类、数据集/基准分析和挑战展望，并配套开源 GitHub 仓库。
Conclusion: 作者旨在为大规模模型驱动的体育智能研究与应用奠定基础，强调通过系统化梳理推动后续研究与实践发展。

papers.title: Wrong but Useful: Trajectory Value Beyond Answer Correctness in Multi-Agent Messages
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reasoning systems often use agreement, confidence, or automated scores to decide which messages should shape a final answer. Such filtering assumes that a message likely to be correct is also worth keeping. Yet a wrong answer can contain a useful decomposition, constraint, or scientific principle. We test this distinction with Diverse Hypothesis Deliberation (DHD), a controlled measurement protocol that caches five independently generated messages and replays the same downstream solver, called the integrator, with each message available or hidden. The replay comparison measures a message's trajectory value: whether making the message available helps or harms subsequent reasoning. Across five mathematics and science benchmarks and two openly available model families, gpt-oss-120b and gemma-4-31B-it, wrong-helpful messages appear in every benchmark-model combination. Among wrong-answer messages that change final correctness, more than four in ten changes are helpful in each model. Controlled repeats show that the number of repeatable message effects is unlikely to arise from replay variation alone (p=0.0002). A focused intervention on repeatable wrong-helpful messages finds that the complete message works best, while retaining its reasoning preserves more success than retaining only its answer; the source of the complete-message advantage remains open. Within the same problem, repeated trajectory-value evidence also identifies a better keep-or-remove choice than answer correctness alone. Answer correctness is therefore informative but does not determine trajectory value. DHD measures this missing property and produces reusable labels for learning when agents should listen.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 9 figures. Includes an appendix and an ancillary reproducibility artifact
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Diverse Hypothesis Deliberation (DHD)，一种受控测量协议，用于区分多智能体消息的答案正确性与轨迹价值（trajectory value）。DHD 缓存五个独立生成的消息，并回放同一个下游求解器（integrator），对比每条消息可见或隐藏时对后续推理的影响。在五个数学与科学基准和两个开放模型（gpt-oss-120b、gemma-4-31B-it）上，每个基准-模型组合都出现了错误但有用（wrong-helpful）的消息，说明正确性不能决定消息是否值得保留。
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统常用一致性、置信度或自动评分过滤消息，假设大概率正确的消息才值得保留。但错误答案可能包含有用的分解、约束或科学原理，因此需要一种超出答案正确性的测量方式。
Method: 提出 DHD 协议：缓存五个独立生成的消息，对同一 integrator 进行回放比较，分别在有/无每条消息的条件下观察最终推理结果，从而量化单条消息的轨迹价值。还设计了可重复性检验和针对可重复错误-有用消息的干预实验。
Result: 在每个基准-模型组合中都出现错误但有用的消息；在改变最终正确性的错误答案消息中，每个模型有超过四成（more than four in ten）的变化是有帮助的。受控重复显示可重复消息效应不太可能仅由回放变化引起（p=0.0002）。干预实验表明完整消息效果最好，保留其推理过程比仅保留答案能保留更多成功。
Conclusion: 答案正确性具有信息量但不能决定轨迹价值；DHD 能测量这一缺失属性，并为学习智能体何时应听取消息生成可复用标签。完整消息优势的来源仍待解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Characterizing the Evolution of Tropical Cyclone Thermal Structure: A Tropical Cyclone Thermal Phase Space
papers.abstract_en: Current understandings of the tropical cyclone (TC) warm core primarily relies on statistical averages from soundings and satellite products, which provide a climatological thermal state but cannot adequately characterize the continuous three-dimensional evolution of the warm core throughout the TC life cycle. In this study, Empirical Orthogonal Function (EOF) analysis was applied to three-dimensional temperature anomalies of Western North Pacific (WNP) TCs derived from the ERA5 reanalysis dataset for the period 1979-2024. We found that the three leading EOF modes effectively capture the primary characteristics of the TC thermal structure: the first mode represents the typical warm core structure; the second mode characterizes vertical baroclinicity; and the third pattern captures the horizontal asymmetry of the temperature anomalies. Using the first three principal components (PCs), we established a three-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system. Within this framework, two phase parameters define a thermal phase space to visualize the TC's three-dimensional thermal structure: one diagnoses the vertical barotropic or baroclinic structure, and the other quantifies the horizontal asymmetry of the thermal field. The results demonstrate that the trajectory in the phase diagram effectively captures the observed intensity changes and thermal structural evolution. The EOF-based phase diagrams offer promising insights and provide a novel, objective tool for analyzing and diagnosing structural thermodynamic characteristics and intensity evolution by quantifying key thermal features and their dynamic relationships with TC intensity. This capability thereby holds substantial potential for advancing both theoretical understanding and operational forecasting of TCs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用1979-2024年ERA5再分析资料，对西北太平洋热带气旋（TC）的三维温度异常做经验正交函数（EOF）分析，发现前三个模态分别对应典型暖心结构、垂直斜压性和水平不对称性。基于前三个主成分建立三维笛卡尔坐标系，并定义两个相位参数构成热力相空间，用以可视化TC热力结构的三维演化。相图轨迹能够捕捉强度变化与热力结构演变，作者认为该EOF相图可作为诊断TC结构热力学特征和强度演化的客观工具。
Motivation: 现有对TC暖心结构的认识主要依赖探空和卫星产品的统计平均，只能给出气候态热力状态，难以刻画暖核在整个生命史中连续的三维演化过程。
Method: 对ERA5再分析得到的西北太平洋TC三维温度异常进行EOF分解，取前三个主成分建立三维笛卡尔坐标系，并定义两个相位参数——一个诊断垂直正压/斜压结构，另一个量化热力场的水平不对称性——从而构造热力相空间。
Result: 摘要报告前三个EOF模态分别代表典型暖心结构、垂直斜压性和水平不对称性，且相图中的轨迹能够有效反映观测到的强度变化和热力结构演变。
Conclusion: EOF相图提供了一种新颖、客观的TC结构热力学诊断工具，可量化关键热力特征及其与TC强度的动态关系，对理论理解和业务预报均有潜在价值。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Boosting Data Augmentation with Stochastic Weight Averaging
papers.abstract_en: The symmetries of a learning task have become an important factor in designing modern deep learning solutions. Data augmentation is a straightforward and effective way of incorporating symmetries into a generic neural network. Recent results show that infinitely large deep ensembles show perfect symmetry when trained on augmented data. However, since training ensembles requires repeating the training process many times, this method is costly. In this work, we study stochastic weight averaging (SWA) as an alternative ensembling technique that does not require repeated training runs. We analyze SWA by approximating the stochastic training trajectory at the end of training with an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process. We show that in the infinite-width limit, SWA on augmented data provides an equiviariance boost that goes beyond what could be expected from the performance increase due to SWA alone. We verify our results with extensive numerical experiments on numerous models spanning computer vision and graph classification with both discrete and continuous symmetries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将随机权重平均 (stochastic weight averaging, SWA) 用作数据增强下训练深度模型的低成本集成方案。作者在训练末期用 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程近似随机训练轨迹，并在无限宽极限下证明，对增强数据做 SWA 能带来超出单纯 SWA 性能提升的等变性 (equivariance) 增益。数值实验覆盖计算机视觉与图分类中的离散和连续对称性任务。
Motivation: 集成训练能更好利用数据增强中的对称性，但训练多个模型成本高；SWA 可作为无需重复训练的替代方案，但其对增强数据下对称性/等变性的影响尚未被充分刻画。
Method: 将训练末期随机轨迹建模为 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程，在无限宽极限下从理论上分析增强数据上的 SWA，论证其提供超出 SWA 单独性能提升的等变性增益，并在计算机视觉与图分类模型上做数值验证。
Result: 摘要报告，在无限宽极限下，SWA 结合数据增强可提供额外等变性提升；大量数值实验在多种计算机视觉与图分类模型（涵盖离散与连续对称性）上验证该结论。
Conclusion: SWA 可作为重复集成训练的低成本替代方案，在增强数据上获得额外的等变性收益；作者通过理论和实验支持这一观点。

papers.title: Catching the Imposter: Self-Supervised Learning of Physical Coherence with Cross-Entity Feature Permutations
papers.abstract_en: Scientific data often describe entities whose features are jointly governed by the laws of physics, yet existing self-supervised learning (SSL) objectives largely ignore this physical coherence. We introduce imposter, a discriminative pretext task that replaces subsets of an entity's features with real observations donated by another entity and trains the encoder to identify the swapped features. Because every donated value is individually plausible, the task can only be solved by learning cross-feature physical dependencies. We evaluate the proposed objectives on global ERA5-Land reanalysis data using 21 environmental variables and assess the learned representations on seven downstream tasks spanning climate classification, carbon flux estimation, and streamflow prediction. Our study includes, to our knowledge, the first systematic comparison of self-supervised objectives for land-surface modeling under a shared architecture and pre-training budget. We find that the most effective pretext task depends on the downstream task family rather than any single objective's superiority, and that imposter provides complementary information when combined with existing SSL objectives. These results suggest that physical coherence is a valuable new source of self-supervision for scientific foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为 imposter 的判别式自监督预训练任务：用另一实体贡献的真实观测替换某实体的特征子集，并训练编码器识别被交换的特征，从而迫使模型学习跨特征的物理依赖。作者在 ERA5-Land 再分析数据上使用 21 个环境变量预训练，并在气候分类、碳通量估计、径流预测等七个下游任务上评估。结果显示最有效的预训练任务依下游任务族而异，imposter 与现有 SSL 目标组合时能提供互补信息。
Motivation: 现有自监督学习（SSL）目标大多忽略科学数据中实体特征受物理定律共同约束这一特性，缺少利用物理一致性的自监督信号。
Method: 提出 imposter 任务：将实体的部分特征替换为另一实体捐赠的真实观测，由于每个捐赠值单独看都合理，该任务只能通过学习特征间的物理依赖来求解。
Result: 在 ERA5-Land 上用 21 个环境变量评估，涵盖气候分类、碳通量估计、径流预测等七个下游任务；结果表明没有单一 SSL 目标普遍最优，imposter 与现有目标结合时提供互补信息。
Conclusion: 作者认为物理一致性是科学基础模型有价值的新自监督来源，但强调最有效的预训练任务取决于下游任务族，需要按任务选择或组合目标。

papers.title: A Hybrid LLM-Based Framework for Automated Security Annotation Generation in Business Process Models
papers.abstract_en: The modelling and analysis of secure business processes require the incorporation of security annotations into process models. Although BPMN extensions, including SecBPMN2, exist for this purpose, the derivation of accurate and complete security annotations from natural-language specifications remains a manual, expert-intensive, and error-prone task. This paper presents a hybrid framework that takes a BPMN process model and a security requirements document as input and automatically generates security annotations adhering to the SecBPMN2 specification. The approach combines Large Language Model (LLM)--based semantic extraction with schema-constrained mapping, rule-based normalization, and deterministic validation. The framework is evaluated comprehensively on a curated dataset of 27 process models from various domains. The results indicate that it consistently produces structurally valid SecBPMN2 annotations with high schema completeness. Compared to human security analysts, the system achieves substantially higher precision (0.58 vs. 0.29) while maintaining comparable recall (0.52 vs. 0.50) and reduces erroneous or misplaced annotations by nearly 50%. In addition, annotation generation is significantly faster than manual annotation. These findings demonstrate that hybrid LLM- and rule-based automation can reduce modeling effort while improving consistency and reliability, thereby providing a scalable foundation for security-by-design BPM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个混合框架，输入 BPMN 流程模型和安全需求文档，自动生成符合 SecBPMN2 规范的安全标注。框架结合基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的语义抽取、模式约束映射、规则归一化和确定性校验。在 27 个跨领域流程模型上的评估显示，系统能稳定产出结构有效、模式完整度高的安全标注，比人工分析具有更高精确率且基本相当的召回率，同时显著降低错误或错位标注并大幅缩短生成时间。
Motivation: 在业务流程建模中集成安全标注需要从自然语言规范中人工推导出准确且完整的安全注解，该过程依赖专家且容易出错，尽管已有 BPMN 扩展（如 SecBPMN2）支持此类标注，但自动化程度不足。
Method: 提出一个混合框架，将基于 LLM 的语义抽取与基于模式约束的映射、基于规则的归一化和确定性验证相结合，以 BPMN 流程模型和安全需求文档为输入，输出符合 SecBPMN2 规范的安全标注。
Result: 在 27 个来自不同领域的流程模型数据集上，系统生成的 SecBPMN2 标注具有较高的模式完整性；与人工安全分析员相比，系统的精确率显著更高（0.58 vs. 0.29），召回率相当（0.52 vs. 0.50），错误或错位标注减少了近 50%，且标注生成速度明显快于人工。
Conclusion: 作者认为混合 LLM 与规则驱动的自动化可以减少建模工作量，同时提高标注的一致性和可靠性，为安全设计 (security-by-design) 的 BPM 提供了可扩展的基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Non-Shattering at and Above the Dynamical Temperature in the Spherical Pure p-Spin Model
papers.abstract_en: We consider the notion of shattering introduced by Ben Arous and Jagannath for spherical pure $p$-spin glasses with overlap $q$. For every $p\geq 3$ and $0<β\leqβ_{\mathrm{sh}}(p)$, we rule out shattering whenever $q\leq2^{-1/2}$ or $q>\sqrt{(p-2)/(p-1)}$. The proof combines a deterministic $N+1$ bound for disjoint bands in the first range with a general-$p$ sign law showing that their total marked weight has subdominant free energy in the second. A spherical-code bound and Hölder's inequality give an additional $q$-dependent obstruction; in particular, they rule out every fixed overlap for $0<β\leq\sqrt{\log2}$. For $p=3$, the first two ranges already exhaust every fixed $q\in(0,1)$, so the landscape is not shattered at any $T\geq T_{\mathrm{sh}}$. For $p\geq4$, the cases not covered by our criteria are confined to $2^{-1/2}<q\leq\sqrt{(p-2)/(p-1)}$ and $\sqrt{\log2}<β\leqβ_{\mathrm{sh}}(p)$. In particular, this paper partially resolves Conjecture 1 of the paper above and also suggests new methods to show non-shattering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究球形纯 p-spin 玻璃模型中 Ben Arous 与 Jagannath 引入的 shattering 概念，在给定重叠 q 下给出非 shattering 的充分条件。对于每个 p≥3 与 0<β≤β_sh(p)，作者排除了 q≤2^{-1/2} 或 q>√((p-2)/(p-1)) 范围内的 shattering；结合球形码界与 Hölder 不等式，进一步排除了 0<β≤√log2 时的所有固定重叠。对 p=3，这些条件覆盖所有固定 q∈(0,1)，从而在一切 T≥T_sh 下景观均不 shatter；对 p≥4 则留下一个中间区间未被覆盖。该工作部分解决了上述论文中的 Conjecture 1，并提出了证明非 shattering 的新方法。
Motivation: Ben Arous 与 Jagannath 曾提出球形 p-spin 模型中 shattering 的概念，并留下一个猜想（Conjecture 1）尚未完全解决。作者试图在动力学温度以上以及等于该温度的区域证明非 shattering，以理解玻璃态景观的几何结构。
Method: 证明分三部分：在第一段 q 区间使用确定性的 N+1 界处理不相交条带；在第二段 q 区间使用一般 p 的符号律（sign law）说明这些条带的总标记自由能是次主导的；再用球形码界（spherical-code bound）与 Hölder 不等式得到额外的 q 依赖障碍。
Result: 对 p≥3 与 0<β≤β_sh(p) 排除了 q≤2^{-1/2} 与 q>√((p-2)/(p-1)) 的 shattering；对 0<β≤√log2 排除了所有固定重叠 q。p=3 时所有固定 q∈(0,1) 均被覆盖，因此 T≥T_sh 时景观不 shatter；p≥4 未覆盖区间仅剩 2^{-1/2}<q≤√((p-2)/(p-1)) 且 √log2<β≤β_sh(p)。
Conclusion: 本文部分解决了 Conjecture 1，并给出证明非 shattering 的新方法；但 p≥4 时仍存在未被判据覆盖的参数区间，需要进一步工作。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mind the Long Tail: Understanding the Difficulty of Delay Detection in Business Processes
papers.abstract_en: The early detection of delayed cases in business processes is a critical capability for organizations. Predictive process monitoring (PPM) supports this task by using historical event logs to predict the remaining time of ongoing cases, enabling timely interventions to avoid missed deadlines and service level violations. Although remaining time prediction has advanced considerably through sophisticated deep learning architectures, little is known about the intrinsic difficulty of delay detection itself. Since performance is typically assessed using aggregate metrics, prior work provides limited insight into how models perform across the target distribution, especially on the operationally most critical cases with large delays. In this paper, we address this gap by analyzing the difficulty of delay detection. Across 14 event logs, we show that remaining times are typically strongly right-skewed, with only a small fraction of cases exhibiting large delays. Existing models capture the mode of this distribution well but perform poorly on high-delay cases. We further uncover pronounced heteroscedasticity, showing that predictive uncertainty increases with delay magnitude. Based on these findings, we evaluate approaches to mitigate the imbalance problem, but find only limited benefits, suggesting that the key underlying problem may not be imbalance but higher uncertainty associated with delayed cases. We show that this correlation can be exploited to substantially improve the identification of delayed cases. Overall, our work provides new insights into the sources of difficulty in delay detection and identifies uncertainty-aware modeling as a promising direction for future PPM research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究业务流程中延迟检测任务的固有难度。作者利用14个事件日志（event logs）分析剩余时间预测（remaining time prediction）的分布特性，发现剩余时间通常严重右偏，只有少数案例出现大延迟，现有模型能捕捉众数但在高延迟案例上表现差，且预测不确定性与延迟幅度呈正相关。基于此，作者尝试缓解不平衡问题但收益有限，指出核心问题可能不是类别不平衡而是延迟案例的更高不确定性，并利用该相关性显著改善延迟案例识别。
Motivation: 现有预测性流程监控（PPM）研究主要用聚合指标评估剩余时间预测性能，对延迟检测本身的固有难度缺乏理解，尤其不清楚模型在目标分布上的表现，特别是操作上最关键的大延迟案例。
Method: 作者跨14个事件日志分析剩余时间分布，揭示右偏和异方差性（heteroscedasticity），并评估缓解不平衡问题的方法，同时利用预测不确定性与延迟幅度的相关性来改进延迟案例识别。
Result: 摘要报告剩余时间典型地强右偏，仅少数案例有大延迟；现有模型能很好拟合分布众数但在高延迟案例上表现差；预测不确定性随延迟增大而增加；缓解不平衡的方法只能带来有限收益，而利用不确定性相关性可显著改进延迟案例识别。
Conclusion: 作者认为延迟检测困难的根源可能不是类别不平衡而是延迟案例固有的更高不确定性，并将不确定性感知建模（uncertainty-aware modeling）列为未来PPM研究的有前景方向。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告剩余时间典型地强右偏，仅少数案例有大延迟；现有模型能很好拟合分布众数但在高延迟案例上表现差；预测不确定性随延迟增大而增加；缓解不平衡的方法只能带来有限收益，而利用不确定性相关性可显著改进延迟案例识别。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为延迟检测困难的根源可能不是类别不平衡而是延迟案例固有的更高不确定性，并将不确定性感知建模（uncertainty-aware modeling）列为未来PPM研究的有前景方向。

papers.title: Weakly Supervised Polar Low Segmentation in Sentinel-1 SAR Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Polar lows are intense maritime cyclones that form rapidly at high latitudes. Deep learning can detect them in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, but pixel-level segmentation remains an open challenge. No pixel-level masks are available for training, and a polar low's extent is inherently subjective, with diffuse boundaries that even experts delineate inconsistently. We propose Constrained Region Erasing with Soft Targets (CREST), a Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) framework that generates masks solely from image-level labels. Our approach builds on Adversarial Erasing (AER), which iteratively mines discriminative regions, erases them, and retrains a classifier to reveal complementary cues that become pseudo-labels for segmentation. However, standard AER also collects irrelevant background features, degrading pseudo-label quality. CREST addresses this with (i) a Constrained Ordinal Region Expansion (CORE) module that encodes the spatial-connectedness prior of polar lows, constraining region expansion from a high-confidence seed, and (ii) a Dynamic Bootstrapping (DB) loss that treats the mining order as a proxy for label reliability, attenuating supervision from noisier, later-mined regions. On Sentinel-1 SAR data, CREST follows the cyclone structure more closely than standard AER, and returns a multi-class rather than binary mask whose classes indicate the reliability assigned to each region. We further evaluate on BUS-UCLM breast ultrasound and PASCAL VOC person data, whose targets satisfy the same connectedness prior but come with the dense masks the SAR data lacks. On both datasets, CREST performs better than the equivalent AER pipeline under identical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CREST (Constrained Region Erasing with Soft Targets)，一个仅依赖图像级标签的弱监督语义分割 (WSSS) 框架，用于在 Sentinel-1 SAR 影像中分割极地低压 (polar low)。CREST 基于对抗擦除 (Adversarial Erasing, AER)，通过添加约束有序区域扩展 (CORE) 模块编码空间连通性先验，并使用动态自举 (DB) 损失按挖掘顺序衰减噪声监督。在 BUS-UCLM 乳腺超声和 PASCAL VOC person 数据集上，CREST 在相同设置下优于等价 AER 管线。
Motivation: 极地低压是快速形成的高纬度海洋气旋，深度学习可在 SAR 影像中检测它们，但像素级分割仍是开放问题：没有可用的像素级掩码，且低压范围本身具有主观性，边界弥散，专家标注也不一致。
Method: 提出 CREST，构建在对抗擦除之上：迭代挖掘判别区域、擦除并重训分类器以发现互补线索，将其作为分割伪标签。CORE 模块利用极地低压的空间连通性先验，从高置信种子约束区域扩展；DB 损失把挖掘顺序视为标签可靠性代理，降低较晚挖掘出的噪声区域的监督权重。
Result: 在 Sentinel-1 SAR 数据上，CREST 比标准 AER 更贴合气旋结构，并输出多类而非二值掩码，类别表示各区域的可靠性；在 BUS-UCLM 和 PASCAL VOC person 两个具有稠密掩码的数据集上，CREST 在相同设置下优于等价 AER 管线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用连通性先验并结合软目标，可仅凭图像级标签生成比标准 AER 更高质量的分割掩码；但它未涉及计算开销、失败案例或泛化限制。

papers.title: Designing Sustainable Federated Learning as a Service using Neural Architecture Search
papers.abstract_en: The sustainability constraints of FLaaS consumers pose significant challenges to maintaining carbon-feasible federated training in FLaaS environments. These constraints often lead to infeasible consumer participation and unstable federated training under hard carbon constraints. We propose a Sustainable Federated Learning as a Service (SFLaaS), a carbon- constrained Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework for heteroge- neous sustainable constraints. We introduce a requirement-driven search space that transforms consumer sustainability profiles into a feasible architecture region before federated execution. We develop a consumer-level carbon feasibility estimation mechanism to evaluate candidate architectures under dynamic carbon conditions. We propose a sustainable con- sumer scheduling strategy that adaptively selects feasible consumers and allocates local workloads to preserve consumer participation and statistical data coverage. An evolutionary search strategy jointly optimised for predictive performance, consumer feasibility, and participation coverage under hard carbon constraints. Experiments on real-world datasets and a simulated environment demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可持续联邦学习即服务(SFLaaS)，一个面向异构可持续性约束的碳约束神经架构搜索(NAS)框架。该方法通过需求驱动的搜索空间将消费者可持续性画像转化为可行架构区域，结合消费者级碳可行性估计与可持续消费者调度策略，在硬碳约束下联合优化预测性能、消费者可行性与参与覆盖率。实验在真实数据集和模拟环境中验证了有效性。
Motivation: FLaaS 消费者的可持续性约束会在硬碳约束下导致参与者不可行和联邦训练不稳定，本文针对这一挑战提出解决办法。
Method: 提出 SFLaaS 框架：设计需求驱动的搜索空间，在联邦执行前将消费者可持续性画像转换为可行架构区域；开发消费者级碳可行性估计机制来评估动态碳条件下的候选架构；提出可持续消费者调度策略，自适应选择可行消费者并分配本地工作负载；并使用进化搜索策略在硬碳约束下联合优化预测性能、消费者可行性和参与覆盖率。
Result: 在真实世界数据集和模拟环境上的实验证明了所提方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将碳约束纳入 NAS 与消费者调度能够缓解 FLaaS 中可持续性约束带来的参与不可行与训练不稳定问题。

papers.title: Disentangled Shared Representations Improve Morpho-Transcriptomic Integration
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables the simultaneous profiling of gene expression and tissue morphology, creating an opportunity to learn multimodal representations capturing shared morpho-transcriptomic structure. However, standard multimodal models often compress modalities into a common latent space without explicitly separating shared and modality-specific sources of variation, which may limit downstream utility. We investigate whether explicit disentanglement of shared and private latent components improves multimodal representation learning for paired Hematoxylin \& Eosin (H\&E) and ST data. We compare VAE-based and contrastive approaches, each in standard and disentangled variants, across two cancer cohorts under matched experimental conditions. Representations are evaluated using cross-modal reconstruction, downstream probing and cross-modal probe transfer. The experiments suggest two main trends. First, contrastive objectives yield higher downstream probing performance than VAE-based models. Second, disentangled variants improve the selected reconstruction and probing metrics, although the gains depend on the model family, task, direction, and disentanglement strength. Overall, our results suggest that explicitly factorizing shared and modality-specific information can improve multimodal representation learning for spatial transcriptomics and provides a useful evaluation framework for future foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对空间转录组学（ST）与H&E组织学图像配对数据，研究显式解耦共享与模态特有（private）潜在成分是否能改善多模态表示学习。作者在两种癌症队列中，以匹配的实验条件比较了基于VAE和基于对比学习的模型，各自的标准版与解耦变体，并用交叉模态重建、下游探测（downstream probing）和交叉模态探测迁移（cross-modal probe transfer）评估表征。摘要报告两个主要趋势：对比目标的模型下游探测性能高于VAE模型；解耦变体在部分重建和探测指标上有所提升，但收益取决于模型族、任务、方向和解耦强度。
Motivation: 标准多模态模型通常将各模态压缩进一个公共潜在空间，却不显式分离共享变异与模态特有变异，这可能限制下游任务的实用性。该论文瞄准这一缺口，探究显式解耦共享表征对形态-转录组整合是否有帮助。
Method: 提出一个系统性比较框架：将VAE类模型和对比学习模型各实现为标准与解耦（disentangled）两种变体，在配对的H&E与ST数据上训练，并采用交叉模态重建、下游探测和交叉模态探测迁移三类指标进行评估。
Result: 实验显示，对比目标（contrastive objectives）比VAE模型带来更高的下游探测性能；解耦变体在选定的重建与探测指标上有提升，但增益依赖模型族、任务、方向和解耦强度。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式分解共享与模态特有信息可以改善空间转录组学的多模态表示学习，同时该评估框架可用于未来基础模型的比较。

papers.title: ScienceFlow: A long-horizon agent for ML research, scientific discovery and beyond
papers.abstract_en: Enabling LLM agents to sustain productive, stable, and goal-aligned research over extended horizons is a central challenge for autonomous machine learning and scientific discovery, as progress hinges on continuously managing evolving state, exploration decisions, and computational resources. Pioneering autoresearch agents, despite great success, still lack mechanisms for continuity, recovery from dead ends, and value-driven compute allocation, which inherently undermines overall search efficiency, wastes computational resources, and lowers the chance of ultimate success. To bridge this gap, we introduce ScienceFlow, an end-to-end autoresearch agent framework that organizes long-horizon research work into research segments grounded in executable workspaces. It represents research progress as recoverable executable states, enabling efficient exploration, revision, and execution. Transitions between research segments are governed by Executable-State Transition through Re-Anchoring (ESTRA), which selects either the live state or an archived state as the next anchor and determines whether to continue or redirect the research trajectory. An evidence-aware execution controller allocates resources to physical jobs based on resource availability, remaining budget, and validated progress. We evaluate ScienceFlow on tasks spanning machine learning, scientific modeling, and mathematical optimization. Results on diverse long-horizon benchmarks demonstrate its ability to sustain effective research processes, highlighted by a SOTA 70.22 percent Any-Medal score on the full MLE-bench within a 24-hour budget, outperforming prior reported results by 4.92 percentage points. The efficacy of ScienceFlow further demonstrates that efficient state management, adaptive exploration, and objective-aligned execution are critical for scaling autonomous research beyond short-horizon interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScienceFlow，一个面向长期自主研究的端到端自动研究代理 (autoresearch agent) 框架，将研究过程组织为基于可执行工作区 (executable workspace) 的研究片段，并用可恢复的可执行状态表示进展。框架通过 ESTRA 机制在活状态与存档状态之间选择下一锚点以决定继续或重定向，并由证据感知的执行控制器按资源、预算和已验证进度分配计算资源。在多种长时程基准上，ScienceFlow 在 24 小时预算下于完整 MLE-bench 取得 70.22% 的 Any-Medal 分数，较先前报告结果提升 4.92 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有自主动研究代理虽已取得一定成功，但缺乏连续性、死胡同恢复和按价值分配计算的机制，导致整体搜索效率低下、计算资源浪费，并降低最终成功概率。
Method: 提出 ScienceFlow 框架：将长期研究切分为基于可执行工作区的研究片段；将研究进展表示为可恢复的可执行状态，支持探索、修订和执行的解耦；通过 Executable-State Transition through Re-Anchoring (ESTRA) 决定下一个锚点取自活状态还是存档状态，并判断继续或重定向研究轨迹；利用证据感知执行控制器根据资源可用性、剩余预算和已验证进度分配物理作业资源。
Result: 在涵盖机器学习、科学建模和数学优化的任务上评估，摘要报告在 24 小时预算内于完整 MLE-bench 取得 SOTA 的 70.22% Any-Medal 分数，超过先前已报告结果 4.92 个百分点。
Conclusion: ScienceFlow 表明高效的状态管理、自适应探索和目标对齐执行是超越短时程交互、扩展自主研究能力的关键。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ATLAS: Discovering Agent Strategies through LLM-Guided Abstraction and Automata Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used for complex tasks such as software testing and cybersecurity assessment. While these agents demonstrate impressive capabilities, their behavior is difficult to understand, explain, and analyze. Existing evaluations focus mainly on task success and execution traces, offering limited insight into the strategies employed by the agent. We present ATLAS (Automata Learning for Agent Trajectory Analysis and Strategy Discovery), an approach for recovering interpretable behavioral models from agent trajectories. ATLAS combines trace abstraction with automata learning to infer finite-state models that capture observed agent-environment interaction strategies. These models provide human-interpretable insights and support automated analyses of recurring behaviors, decision points, successful task-completion paths, and failure loops. As a proof of concept, we apply ATLAS to trajectories generated by an LLM-based penetration-testing agent. The resulting models expose high-level behavioral strategies for exploiting vulnerable machines that are difficult to identify from raw execution traces alone. We discuss how learned behavioral models can support explainability, model-guided exploration, auditing, and analysis of agentic systems. We further demonstrate symbolic model-based knowledge transfer from powerful frontier models to compact language models. In addition, we show how model transformations can derive concise explanations of agent behavior in a penetration-testing case study comprising 12 vulnerable machines. ATLAS highlights a new opportunity for model-driven engineering: transforming agent trajectories into explicit behavioral models that enable systematic understanding and analysis of otherwise opaque AI agents.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATLAS（Automata Learning for Agent Trajectory Analysis and Strategy Discovery），一种从 LLM 智能体轨迹中恢复可解释行为模型的方法。ATLAS 将轨迹抽象 (trace abstraction) 与自动机学习 (automata learning) 结合，推断出能刻画智能体与环境交互策略的有限状态模型。作为概念验证，作者将其应用于 LLM 驱动的渗透测试智能体轨迹，所得模型暴露出从原始轨迹中难以识别的高层攻击行为策略，并在包含 12 台易受攻击机器的案例中展示了基于模型变换的简洁行为解释。
Motivation: 基于大语言模型的智能体在软件测试、网络安全等任务中表现强大，但其行为难以理解、解释和分析；现有评估主要关注任务成功率和执行轨迹，对其采用的策略缺乏洞察。
Method: ATLAS 将轨迹抽象与自动机学习相结合，从智能体轨迹中推断有限状态模型以捕捉智能体-环境交互策略；这些模型支持对循环行为、决策点、成功完成路径与失败循环的自动化分析，并可进一步用于模型变换与符号化的知识迁移。
Result: 在 LLM 驱动的渗透测试智能体轨迹上，ATLAS 生成的行为模型揭示了利用易受攻击机器的高层行为策略；论文还展示了从强前沿模型到小型语言模型的符号化模型知识迁移，并在 12 台易受攻击机器的案例研究中派生出简洁的行为解释。
Conclusion: 作者认为学习得到的行为模型可支持可解释性、模型引导探索、审计与分析，并指出模型驱动工程的新机会：将智能体轨迹转化为显式行为模型，从而系统理解和分析原本不透明的 AI 智能体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Non-Parametric Spatiotemporal Trajectory Prediction via State-Conditioned Transition Sampling
papers.abstract_en: We present a training-free method for multi-modal trajectory prediction that achieves comparable accuracy to a 57M-parameter transformer while requiring no GPU and zero learned parameters. The method builds a transition table of historical state-to-next-position pairs and retrieves neighbors using a product kernel over spatial proximity, bearing, speed, and temporal context. Two inference modes operate over this shared representation: diversity-penalized sampling produces trajectories covering distinct plausible routes, while beam search finds the highest-likelihood path. On the TrAISformer benchmark (Danish Maritime AIS), our method achieves competitive accuracy at full data availability and dramatically outperforms the transformer in data-scarce regimes---remaining stable down to 10% of training data where TrAISformer degrades catastrophically. This enables deployment in new geographic regions from an order of magnitude less historical data, and with no GPU training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种免训练的多模态轨迹预测方法，不依赖 GPU 且零学习参数。方法构建历史状态到下一位置的转移表 (transition table)，并用空间邻近度、方位角、速度和时态上下文的乘积核 (product kernel) 检索近邻；推理时支持多样性惩罚采样 (diversity-penalized sampling) 与 beam search 两种模式。在 TrAISformer 基准（丹麦海事 AIS）上，该方法在完整数据下达到与 57M 参数 Transformer 相当的精度，并在数据稀缺场景下显著优于后者，数据量低至 10% 时仍保持稳定。
Motivation: 现有轨迹预测通常依赖大规模训练模型和 GPU 训练，且在历史数据稀缺时性能急剧下降，难以快速部署到新地理区域。本文针对这一问题，探索无需训练、无学习参数的非参数化替代方案。
Method: 构建历史状态到下一位置的转移表，通过空间邻近度、方位角、速度和时态上下文的乘积核检索近邻。共享表示上提供两种推理模式：多样性惩罚采样生成覆盖不同合理路线的轨迹，beam search 寻找最高似然路径。
Result: 在 TrAISformer 基准（丹麦 Maritime AIS）上，完整数据可用时达到与 57M 参数 Transformer 相当的精度；在数据稀缺场景下大幅超越 Transformer，在仅 10% 训练数据时仍保持稳定，而 TrAISformer 性能严重退化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调免训练非参数方法能够以数量级更少的历史数据和新区域部署需求达到与 Transformer 相当的精度，且无需 GPU 训练；评估场景为海事 AIS 轨迹预测。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Clearing the Fog: Towards Installing and Refining Proactive Exploration Capabilities in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: We study proactive exploration in LLM agents, i.e., the ability to explore an environment to acquire information that improves future decision-making. In this regard, we first identify two fundamental bottlenecks that hinder this capability and then propose \ours, a novel method designed to instill and refine proactive exploration. Specifically, \ours\ consists of two components: (1) Exploratory Data Construction, which synthesizes exploration-rich trajectories to mitigate the hindsight bias of standard demonstrations; and (2) RL Optimization with Contrastive Signal Guidance, which leverages contrastive trajectory pairs to distinguish productive exploration from redundant wandering. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of \ours\ and provide insights into the characteristics of proactive exploration. Our code is available at: https://github.com/GuanZhizhao/SAFARI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 智能体 (LLM agent) 中的主动探索能力，即通过探索环境获取信息以改进未来决策。作者先识别出阻碍该能力的两个根本瓶颈，并提出方法 SAFARI，包含两个组件：探索性数据构造 (Exploratory Data Construction)，合成富含探索的轨迹以缓解标准示范中的事后偏差 (hindsight bias)；以及带对比信号引导的强化学习优化 (RL Optimization with Contrastive Signal Guidance)，利用对比轨迹对区分有效探索与冗余游荡。大量实验显示该方法有效，并对主动探索的特征给出见解。
Motivation: LLM 智能体普遍缺乏主动探索环境的能力，而标准示范数据存在事后偏差，难以教会模型在信息不足时主动获取信息，这限制了其在复杂环境中的决策表现。
Method: 提出 SAFARI，由两部分组成：一是探索性数据构造，合成探索密集的轨迹来缓解标准演示中的事后偏差；二是带对比信号引导的 RL 优化，利用对比轨迹对引导模型区分有产出的探索与无意义的游荡。
Result: 大量实验验证了 SAFARI 的有效性，并揭示了主动探索的一些特征；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 摘要认为安装并细化主动探索能力可提升 LLM 智能体的决策质量，工具与代码已开源 (https://github.com/GuanZhizhao/SAFARI)。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: CORAL: Curriculum-Optimized Reward Adaptation for LiDAR-Based Goal-Directed Urban Driving
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is promising for autonomous urban driving, but long-horizon goal-directed navigation asks a policy to acquire several competing behaviors at once--reaching a distant goal, tracking a route, avoiding obstacles, obeying signals--and a fixed objective gives no order in which to learn them. This paper presents CORAL, which advances two schedules together: a five-stage curriculum that progressively lengthens routes and tightens behavioral constraints, and a stage-aware reward whose component weights shift emphasis from mission progress toward route following, safety, smoothness, and rule compliance as the task hardens. The policy is a multi-stream actor-critic network trained with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) in CARLA on a compact 99-dimensional state pairing a polar LiDAR histogram with vehicle telemetry, ego-frame route geometry, and traffic-rule indicators--no point-cloud encoder, no bird's-eye-view rasterization. Against two PPO baselines under an identical protocol, CORAL reaches the goal in all twenty evaluation episodes on the longest routes under the full set of behavioral constraints, where the baselines reach 5% and 10%; a factorial ablation shows that neither schedule alone matches their combination: removing either lowers both success and route completion, and disabling both drops success to 55%. Trained in one town, the policy transfers zero-shot to seven unseen towns, succeeding in 68-98% of episodes on routes of the same 100-150 m length, with mean lateral deviation below 0.35 m.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CORAL 面向 LiDAR 的城市驾驶目标导向导航，提出与阶段感知奖励同步推进的五阶段课程，使用多流 actor-critic 网络在 CARLA 中训练。在最长路线和全部行为约束下，CORAL 在二十个评估回合中全部到达目标，而两个 PPO 基线仅分别为 5% 和 10%；因子消融表明两个调度缺一不可。单城镇训练后零样本迁移到七个未见城镇，成功率为 68-98%，平均横向偏差低于 0.35 米。
Motivation: 长视界目标导向的城市驾驶要求策略同时学习多种竞争行为，而固定奖励目标无法规定学习顺序，导致策略难以在真实复杂约束下收敛。
Method: 提出 CORAL 框架，联合推进五阶段课程（逐步加长路线、收紧行为约束）与阶段感知奖励（分量权重从任务进度转向路线跟随、安全、平滑与规则遵守），并在 CARLA 中用 PPO 训练多流 actor-critic 网络，输入为 99 维状态（极坐标 LiDAR 直方图、车辆遥测、自车坐标系路线几何和交通规则指示），无需点云编码器或鸟瞰图栅格化。
Result: 在最长路线且全部行为约束下，CORAL 二十个评估回合全部成功，两个 PPO 基线仅 5% 和 10%；因子消融表明单独保留任一调度都会降低成功率和路线完成度，同时移除两者成功率降至 55%。零样本迁移到七个未见城镇，成功率为 68-98%，平均横向偏差低于 0.35 米。
Conclusion: 摘要强调课程与阶段感知奖励的联合调度是 CORAL 成功的关键，且该策略无需高成本输入表示即可实现跨城镇泛化；但评估限于同一路线长度范围的 CARLA 场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Program-space Diffusion for Morphology-to-Transcriptomics Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables genome-wide gene expression profiling while preserving tissue architecture, but its cost and limited scalability remain major bottlenecks. This has motivated models that predict spatial expression directly from routine histology. Despite promising results, most existing approaches operate at the gene level without leveraging established transcriptomic modeling practices and rely on heterogeneous gene selection strategies, which complicates fair comparison across methods. We propose to reformulate morphology-to-transcriptomics prediction as conditional generation in transcriptional program space, thereby exploiting coordinated transcriptional variation instead of predicting genes independently. Using consensus non-negative matrix factorization (cNMF), we extract a low-dimensional set of transcriptional programs capturing coordinated expression variation in the training data, and train a conditional diffusion model to generate program activations from histology. This formulation exploits coordinated transcriptional variation and substantially lowers the dimensionality of the conditional generative task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对空间转录组学 (spatial transcriptomics, ST) 成本高、可扩展性差的问题，提出将形态学到转录组的预测重新形式化为转录程序空间中的条件生成任务。作者用一致性非负矩阵分解 (cNMF) 从训练数据提取低维转录程序，并训练条件扩散模型 (conditional diffusion model) 从组织学图像生成程序激活值，从而利用基因间的协调表达变化，降低条件生成任务的维度。
Motivation: ST 虽能在保留组织结构的同时进行全基因组表达 profiling，但成本和扩展性受限，因此需要直接从常规组织学图像预测空间表达。现有方法多在单个基因层面建模，未利用已有的转录组建模实践，且依赖不一致的基因选择策略，导致方法间难以公平比较。
Method: 提出用 cNMF 提取一组低维转录程序以捕捉协调表达变化，并训练条件扩散模型，以组织学图像为条件生成这些转录程序的激活值，取代独立预测每个基因的做法。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果；方法声称通过利用协调的转录变异显著降低了条件生成任务的维度。
Conclusion: 作者主张在转录程序空间进行条件生成是形态学到转录组预测的有效形式化，但摘要未讨论局限或给出实验证据。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果；方法声称通过利用协调的转录变异显著降低了条件生成任务的维度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张在转录程序空间进行条件生成是形态学到转录组预测的有效形式化，但摘要未讨论局限或给出实验证据。

papers.title: A Four-Axis Trustworthiness Benchmark for LLM-as-Judge in Principle-Based Regulation
papers.abstract_en: Principle-based regulation, with evaluative standards such as "fair, clear, and not misleading" or "deliver good outcomes", cannot be reduced to binary predicates, and LLM-as-judge is increasingly used as the substitute. Our position is that any such judge must be evaluated on four axes: accuracy, paraphrase robustness, adversarial robustness, and calibration. We release Principle-Bench, 168 cryptoasset financial-promotion scenarios mapped to two UK FCA principles, with paraphrase, adversarial keyword-stuffing, and boundary perturbations authored under a pre-registered rubric; the first benchmark covering all four axes for principle-based regulation. We also introduce Ceca (Calibrated Exemplar-Cluster Assessment): a calibrated, auditable assessor that emits exact per-exemplar counterfactual attributions. Across keyword counting, three sentence-transformer embedders, an open-weight LLM-judge, and a calibrated cascade, no method dominates all four axes. A 120B LLM-judge, strongest on benign inputs, loses 47 accuracy points (0.74 to 0.27) on keyword-stuffed Consumer Duty inputs: "compliance theatre." A second judge from a different model family agrees only at Cohen's kappa = 0.16 on that split, localising the failure to the model rather than the corpus. Any deployment-grade LLM-judge for principle-based regulation must report per-principle adversarial deception and post-hoc calibration alongside aggregate accuracy.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the KDD 2026 Workshop on Secure and Trustworthy Large Language Models (SeT-LLM), poster
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出针对原则性监管（principle-based regulation）中 LLM-as-judge 的可信度四轴评估框架，并发布 Principle-Bench 基准：168 个加密资产金融推广场景，映射到英国 FCA 的两条原则，包含改写、对抗性关键词堆砌和边界扰动三类测试数据。作者还提出 Ceca（Calibrated Exemplar-Cluster Assessment）校准可审计评估器，输出逐样本反事实归因。实验显示没有单一方法在四个轴上全面占优，且一个 120B LLM 评判器在关键词堆砌的 Consumer Duty 输入上准确率从 0.74 跌至 0.27。
Motivation: 原则性监管使用如“公平、清晰、不误导”或“提供良好结果”等评价性标准，无法还原为二元谓词，LLM-as-judge 正被用作替代方案；因此需要一套系统评估此类评判器可信度的方法，而现有基准未同时覆盖准确性、改写鲁棒性、对抗鲁棒性和校准四个维度。
Method: 构建 Principle-Bench，首次在原则性监管场景中覆盖四个评估轴，并在预注册规则下编写改写、对抗关键词堆砌和边界扰动样本；同时提出 Ceca，一种经过校准且可审计的评估器，能够输出精确的逐样本反事实归因。
Result: 在关键词计数、三种 sentence-transformer 嵌入器、一个开放权重 LLM 评判器以及一个校准级联（calibrated cascade）的对比中，没有任何方法在四个轴上全面占优；一个 120B LLM 评判器在良性输入上最强，但在关键词堆砌的 Consumer Duty 输入上准确率下降 47 个百分点（0.74 到 0.27），作者称之为“合规表演”（compliance theatre）；另一个不同模型家族的评判器在该子集上与前者的一致性仅为 Cohen's kappa = 0.16，说明失败主因是模型而非语料。
Conclusion: 用于原则性监管的部署级 LLM-judge 必须在聚合准确率之外，按原则分别报告对抗性欺骗（adversarial deception）和事后校准（post-hoc calibration）结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TRIAGE: Risk-Controlled Pseudo-Label Admission for Annotation-Efficient Semi-Supervised Retinal OCT Classification
papers.abstract_en: The advanced retinal disease diagnosing imaging modality, optical coherence tomography (OCT), encounters a lack of automation because of the high expenses for annotations performed by specialists. The use of SSL solves the problem of insufficient annotations using unlabeled B-scans; however, most of the current techniques for generating pseudo-labels are based on prediction confidence without considering the asymmetry between different types of errors. This paper proposes TRIAGE, a risk-controlled semi-supervised framework for OCT scans classification, which uses the concept of a patient-level conformal risk controller with an asymmetric cost matrix. TRIAGE unites three crucial modules: a hierarchical classifier that is capable of working with partially abnormal supervision of the disease subtypes, a patient-grouped conformal risk controller with primal-dual coverage control, and a context-aware Transformer teacher for cross-slice verification. On the dataset from Noor Eye Hospital (16,822 B-scans, 161 patients, and 554 volumes) with a test set of unseen patients, TRIAGE demonstrates 89.66% scan-level accuracy, 0.8805 macro-F1, 0.9641 macro-AUC, and an 8.34% under-grading rate when using only 20% of the labeled data. With only 5% of the labeled data, TRIAGE keeps 76.88% accuracy and a 0.1656 under-grading rate. Compared with the other six state-of-the-art semi-supervised methods, TRIAGE significantly outperforms them with ablation study demonstrating the contribution of each module in the overall framework performance (by 42.7% in terms of under-grading rate comparing to fixed threshold methods). TRIAGE demonstrates 98.00% accuracy for 3-class classification with 1% labeled data and 95.94% accuracy for 8-class classification with 10% labeled data on the OCT-C8 dataset.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 12 figures, 13 tables. Code available at https://github.com/mdahakash/TRIAGE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRIAGE，一个面向视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）B-scan 分类的风险受控半监督框架，利用患者级共形风险控制器（conformal risk controller）与不对称代价矩阵来生成伪标签。在 Noor Eye Hospital 数据集上，仅用 20% 标注数据达到 89.66% 的扫描级准确率、0.8805 macro-F1、0.9641 macro-AUC 和 8.34% 的欠分级率；在 OCT-C8 数据集上，用 1% 标注数据实现 3 类分类 98.00% 准确率，用 10% 标注数据实现 8 类分类 95.94% 准确率。
Motivation: OCT 影像诊断缺乏自动化，专家标注成本高昂，半监督学习（SSL）可用未标注 B-scan 缓解标注不足，但现有伪标签方法多基于预测置信度，忽略了不同类型错误（尤其是临床上危险的欠分级）之间的不对称性。
Method: TRIAGE 融合三个模块：支持部分异常疾病亚型监督的分层分类器（hierarchical classifier）、采用 primal-dual 覆盖控制的患者分组共形风险控制器，以及用于跨切片验证的上下文感知 Transformer teacher。整体框架在患者层面控制风险并依据不对称代价矩阵决定是否接纳伪标签。
Result: 在 Noor Eye Hospital 数据集的未见患者测试集上，TRIAGE 在仅用 20% 标注数据时取得 89.66% 扫描级准确率、0.8805 macro-F1、0.9641 macro-AUC 和 8.34% 欠分级率；仅用 5% 标注数据时保持 76.88% 准确率和 0.1656 欠分级率。相较六种 SOTA 半监督方法显著更优，且消融实验表明各模块均有贡献，与固定阈值方法相比欠分级率降低 42.7%。
Conclusion: 作者强调风险受控的伪标签接纳能在显著减少标注需求的同时降低临床上有害的欠分级率，并验证了分层分类、共形风险控制与 Transformer teacher 三个模块各自的必要性。
Relevance: 5
