papers.title: AnchorBench: A Multi-Pathway Benchmark for the Anchoring Effect in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The anchoring effect is a cognitive bias in which an initial reference value shifts a later judgment toward itself. This effect is well established in human judgment and decision-making, and recent work suggests that large language models (LLMs) exhibit similar behavior. However, existing work on anchoring in LLMs typically evaluates only a narrow set of anchor pathways and rarely distinguishes irrelevant from plausible anchors. We introduce AnchorBench, a benchmark for the anchoring effect in LLMs that evaluates multiple anchor pathways under an explicit anchor relevance axis. Across fourteen models, including ten open-weight models and four frontier API models, and a large set of controlled prompts, we find that (1) anchoring is strongly pathway-dependent, (2) plausible anchors usually induce larger shifts than irrelevant ones when introduced through stronger pathways, (3) anchor influence generally weakens as the anchor moves farther from the evidence-supported answer, most clearly on External and RAG, and (4) high task accuracy on the anchor-free control condition (Acc$_{10}$: answers within 10 points of gold) does not guarantee robustness: even frontier API models above 95% control accuracy remain susceptible to plausible anchors.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnchorBench，一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）中锚定效应（anchoring effect）的多路径基准，并引入显式的锚点相关性（anchor relevance）维度。作者在 14 个模型（10 个开放权重模型和 4 个前沿 API 模型）以及大量受控提示上评测，发现锚定效应强烈依赖于引入路径；通过较强路径引入时，合理锚点通常比无关锚点造成更大偏移；锚点离证据支持的答案越远，其影响越弱，在 External 和 RAG 路径上最明显；且无锚条件下的高准确率并不能保证稳健性。
Motivation: 现有关于 LLM 中锚定效应的研究通常只评测少数锚点路径，且很少区分无关锚点与合理锚点。
Method: 设计了 AnchorBench 基准，在显式锚点相关性轴上系统评估多种锚点引入路径，并用大量受控提示在多种开源与 API 模型上测试。
Result: 摘要报告四点发现：锚定效应强烈依赖路径；通过较强路径引入时合理锚点通常产生更大偏移；锚点离证据支持的答案越远影响越弱，尤其体现在 External 和 RAG 上；在无锚对照条件下准确率超过 95% 的前沿 API 模型仍易受合理锚点影响，即高控制准确率（Acc10）不保证对锚定的稳健性。
Conclusion: 结论是 LLM 中的锚定效应具有路径依赖性，且高性能模型仍可能受合理锚点影响，AnchorBench 可用于更全面地评测这一认知偏差。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quantum Multi-Armed Bandits and Linear Bandits: Lower Bounds and Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: We study quantum multi-armed bandits (QMAB) and quantum linear bandits (QLB) in the model of Wan et al. [2023], where the learner queries each arm or action through a quantum reward oracle or its inverse. Prior work gives algorithms over horizon $T$ with regret $O(K\log T)$ for QMAB with $K$ arms and $O(d^2\operatorname{polylog} T)$ for $d$-dimensional QLB. This leaves open whether the $K\log T$ scale is unavoidable and whether the $d^2$ dependence can be improved. We prove the first minimax lower bounds of $Ω(K\log(T/K))$ for QMAB and $Ω(d\log(T/d))$ for finite-action QLB, resolving the question raised by Wan et al. [2023] of whether regret independent of $T$ is achievable. At the heart of our argument is a high-confidence single-arm quantum testing lower bound for distinguishing a fixed reward mean from an interval of alternatives, proved by the polynomial method and a Remez-type inequality for trigonometric polynomials. A bandit-to-testing reduction then lifts it to the QMAB lower bound, while a linear embedding gives the finite-action QLB lower bound. Complementing the lower bounds, we give a design-based elimination algorithm for finite-action QLB. When the action set has size $\operatorname{poly}(d)$, its regret is linear in $d$, improving the prior $d^2$ dependence and matching our lower bound up to polylogarithmic factors. The algorithm couples a low-bias low-variance quantum mean estimator with a small-support $G$-optimal design through a query allocation matched to the design weights. The design-based elimination reduces the dimension dependence from $d^2$ to $d^{3/2}$ when using Quantum Monte Carlo estimates. The low-variance estimator then makes reconstruction error aggregate through variance rather than worst-case absolute error, removing the remaining $\sqrt d$ factor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究量子多臂老虎机 (QMAB) 与量子线性老虎机 (QLB)，采用 Wan et al. [2023] 的量子奖励 oracle 或逆 oracle 查询模型。作者证明了首个极小极大下界：QMAB 为 Ω(K log(T/K))，有限动作 QLB 为 Ω(d log(T/d))，并给出一个基于设计的消除算法，将有限动作 QLB 的 regret 维度依赖从 d² 降至 d（在动作集大小为 poly(d) 时）。
Motivation: 先前工作给出了 QMAB 的 O(K log T) 和 d 维 QLB 的 O(d² polylog T)  regret 算法，但遗留两个问题：K log T 的规模是否不可回避，以及 d² 依赖能否改进。Wan et al. [2023] 也提出是否存在与 T 无关的 regret，本文旨在回答这些开放问题。
Method: 核心是高置信单臂量子测试下界，用多项式方法和三角多项式的 Remez 型不等式证明，用于区分固定奖励均值与一个备选区间。通过 bandit-to-testing 归约得到 QMAB 下界，通过线性嵌入得到有限动作 QLB 下界。算法方面，提出设计消除算法，将低偏差低方差量子均值估计器与小支撑 G-最优设计结合，并按设计权重分配查询；使用 Quantum Monte Carlo 估计时维度依赖从 d² 降至 d^{3/2}，低方差估计器使重构误差通过方差而非最坏绝对误差累积，从而去掉剩余的 √d 因子。
Result: 证明 QMAB 的极小极大 regret 下界为 Ω(K log(T/K))，有限动作 QLB 为 Ω(d log(T/d))，回答了 Wan et al. 关于 T 无关 regret 是否可达到的问题。消除算法在动作集大小为 poly(d) 时获得线性于 d 的 regret，将先前的 d² 依赖改进并匹配下界至 polylog 因子。
Conclusion: 摘要强调下界与算法相互匹配，设计消除方法显著改善了维度依赖，并解决了原模型中的一个开放问题。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究量子多臂老虎机 (QMAB) 与量子线性老虎机 (QLB)，采用 Wan et al. [2023] 的量子奖励 oracle 或逆 oracle 查询模型。作者证明了首个极小极大下界：QMAB 为 Ω(K log(T/K))，有限动作 QLB 为 Ω(d log(T/d))，并给出一个基于设计的消除算法，将有限动作 QLB 的 regret 维度依赖从 d² 降至 d（在动作集大小为 poly(d) 时）。

summary_sections.method: 核心是高置信单臂量子测试下界，用多项式方法和三角多项式的 Remez 型不等式证明，用于区分固定奖励均值与一个备选区间。通过 bandit-to-testing 归约得到 QMAB 下界，通过线性嵌入得到有限动作 QLB 下界。算法方面，提出设计消除算法，将低偏差低方差量子均值估计器与小支撑 G-最优设计结合，并按设计权重分配查询；使用 Quantum Monte Carlo 估计时维度依赖从 d² 降至 d^{3/2}，低方差估计器使重构误差通过方差而非最坏绝对误差累积，从而去掉剩余的 √d 因子。
summary_sections.result: 证明 QMAB 的极小极大 regret 下界为 Ω(K log(T/K))，有限动作 QLB 为 Ω(d log(T/d))，回答了 Wan et al. 关于 T 无关 regret 是否可达到的问题。消除算法在动作集大小为 poly(d) 时获得线性于 d 的 regret，将先前的 d² 依赖改进并匹配下界至 polylog 因子。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调下界与算法相互匹配，设计消除方法显著改善了维度依赖，并解决了原模型中的一个开放问题。

papers.title: Intelligent Detection of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) Metrics Based on 2D Floor Plans
papers.abstract_en: This research developed a neural network-based model to extract various information from 2D floor plans. We detect lighting symbols, identify the appropriate type of light, and extract the associated texts with lights. The study aims to enable efficient floor designing and determining the number and type of lights needed per floor, i.e., allow efficient design and estimate the power requirement of the floor plan. The model was developed using Mask RCNN as the base. The images were annotated and converted into a Coco data format for training the model. The model achieved bbox\_mAP and segm\_mAP values of 0.7596 and 0.7111, respectively. It also performed well at different IoU thresholds, i.e., with bbox\_mAP 50 and segm\_mAP 75 values of 0.9850 and 0.9219, respectively. The developed model will help various industries, such as architecture and construction, to improve design time and create efficient workflows by automatically detecting Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) objects from floor plans, and it is the first step towards building tools that will help energy-efficient building design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Mask R-CNN 的神经网络模型，从 2D 平面图中自动检测照明符号、识别灯具类型并提取与灯具关联的文本。模型使用 COCO 数据格式的标注图像训练，取得 bbox_mAP 0.7596 与 segm_mAP 0.7111，并在不同 IoU 阈值下保持良好性能，目标是为建筑与施工行业提供高效的 MEP 对象自动检测。
Motivation: 平面图设计过程中需要人工识别机械、电气、给排水（MEP）对象，耗时且易出错；自动检测有助于缩短设计时间、优化工作流，并为后续节能建筑设计工具的构建奠定基础。
Method: 以 Mask R-CNN 作为基础模型；对 2D 平面图图像进行标注并转换为 COCO 数据格式用于训练，实现对照明符号的检测、灯具类型的分类以及相关文本信息的提取。
Result: 摘要报告模型取得 bbox_mAP 0.7596 和 segm_mAP 0.7111；在不同 IoU 阈值下，bbox_mAP 50 达 0.9850，segm_mAP 75 达 0.9219。
Conclusion: 该模型是迈向节能建筑设计的辅助工具的第一步，可帮助建筑与施工行业自动检测 MEP 对象、提高设计流程效率；摘要未讨论在更广泛建筑类型或真实项目数据上的泛化表现与局限性。

papers.title: Spatial Message Passing in Language Space for Pathology Image Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can generate pathological descriptions from histological images, but gigapixel Whole Slide Images (WSIs) exceed their visual context limits. The standard tiling workaround makes WSIs tractable yet severs the tissue neighborhoods that define tumor-stroma interfaces and morphology. We introduce Spatial Language Message Passing (SLMP), a framework that performs spatial reasoning entirely in language space, human-readable by construction. SLMP represents a WSI region as a spatial text graph: tiles are nodes initialized with MLLM descriptions, and edges encode spatial adjacency. For each tile, an LLM refines its description by integrating language messages from adjacent tiles under a shared aggregation policy that, on the tile grid, acts as an adaptive local kernel operating on text rather than learned embeddings. This policy is an inspectable prompt that can be refined from model-observed tissue phenotypes via textual gradients, enabling automatic semantic optimization from local cellular context to broader tissue morphology without fine-tuning MLLM weights. On representative HER2 and CAMELYON16 regions, SLMP improves tile-level tumor description accuracy in settings spanning general-purpose and pathology-specialized backbones, with gains of +3.3 to +19.6 percentage points. Random-neighbor ablations confirm that these gains stem from spatial context rather than additional text alone, and inspecting the optimized policies reveals interpretable, tissue-specific decision rules. Besides, without any weight updates or fine-tuning the backbone MLLM, SLMP substantially improves general-purpose MLLMs and narrows its gap to pathology-specialized counterparts, offering a transparent and flexible mechanism for incorporating spatial reasoning into MLLM-based pathology analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spatial Language Message Passing (SLMP)，一种完全在语言空间中进行空间推理的病理图像分析框架。SLMP 将 WSI 区域表示为空间文本图：tile 用 MLLM 描述初始化节点，边编码空间邻接关系；LLM 在共享聚合策略下整合相邻节点的语言消息来细化描述。在 HER2 和 CAMELYON16 区域上，该方法将 tile 级肿瘤描述准确率提升 +3.3 到 +19.6 个百分点，且无需微调 backbone MLLM 权重。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 可以从组织学图像生成病理描述，但 gigapixel 级别的全切片图像 (WSI) 超出其视觉上下文限制；常见的切块 (tiling) 处理虽然可行，却切断了定义肿瘤-间质界面和形态学的组织邻域关系。
Method: SLMP 将 WSI 区域建模为空间文本图，tile 为节点并由 MLLM 描述初始化，边编码空间邻接；每个 tile 的 LLM 通过共享聚合策略整合相邻 tile 的语言消息，该策略在 tile 网格上等效于作用在文本上的自适应局部核 (adaptive local kernel)。该策略是可检查的 prompt，可通过文本梯度 (textual gradients) 从模型观察到的组织表型中自动优化语义，不需要微调 MLLM 权重。
Result: 在 HER2 和 CAMELYON16 区域，SLMP 在通用和病理专用 backbone 上均提升 tile 级肿瘤描述准确率，增益为 +3.3 到 +19.6 个百分点；随机邻居消融证实增益来自空间上下文而非额外文本。优化后的策略呈现可解释的组织特异性决策规则；在不更新权重或微调的情况下，显著提升通用 MLLM 并缩小其与病理专用模型的差距。
Conclusion: SLMP 提供了一种透明且灵活的方式，将空间推理融入基于 MLLM 的病理分析，且无需权重更新或微调 backbone。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Sensor-Driven Mission Synthesis for UAV/UGV Swarms: A TB-CSPN Coordination Architecture with Hardware-Enforced Safety
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a coordination architecture for heterogeneous UAV/UGV swarms that synthesises mission actions from uncertain, multi-modal sensor evidence while preserving hardware-enforced safety at the actuation boundary. The approach combines radar, RF, acoustic, and visual observations with Topic-Based Communication Space Petri Net (TB-CSPN) orchestration to support incremental mission formation under partial and evolving information. Consultant agents transform sensor outputs into temporally bounded semantic tokens, while supervisor agents provide authorisation and policy-governed release of mission transitions. This separation between interpretation, coordination, and execution yields auditable decision paths, constrains non-determinism within the coordination layer through guards and synchronisation, and enables bounded-time integration of heterogeneous evidence. To improve resilience in contested environments, including cyber compromise, spoofing, jamming, and communication loss, the digital coordination layer is complemented by independent analogue safety envelopes that clamp or veto unsafe actuator commands issued to individual vehicles. A coastal-surveillance case study illustrates how the proposed architecture enables dependable, governed, and physically safe swarm coordination under operational uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向异构 UAV/UGV 集群的协调架构，从不确定的多模态传感器证据中合成任务动作，同时在执行边界保持硬件强制安全性。方法结合雷达、射频、声学和视觉观测与基于主题的通信空间 Petri 网 (Topic-Based Communication Space Petri Net, TB-CSPN) 编排，支持在部分且不断演化的信息下增量形成任务。
Motivation: 在争议环境中，无人机/无人车集群需要在不完整、不确定的传感器信息下可靠协调，同时应对网络攻击、欺骗、干扰和通信丢失等威胁；现有方案难以兼顾可审计的决策路径与物理层安全强制。
Method: 咨询代理 (consultant agents) 将传感器输出转化为时间有界的语义令牌，监督代理 (supervisor agents) 提供授权和策略管控的任务转换释放；解释、协调与执行相分离，通过守护条件和同步约束协调层内的非确定性。数字协调层之外，独立模拟安全包络 (analogue safety envelopes) 可对单个车辆的致动指令进行钳制或否决，以增强抗毁性。
Result: 通过一个沿海监视案例研究说明该架构能在运行不确定性下实现可靠、受治理且物理上安全的 swarm 协调；摘要未报告量化实验数据。
Conclusion: 作者认为该架构通过隔离解释、协调与执行来产生可审计决策路径，并在协调层内约束非确定性，同时以独立模拟安全包络提供硬件级安全强制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Detecting Contaminated Code-Generation Prompt Batches via Influence Functions
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet they remain vulnerable to prompts that elicit insecure implementations. Existing defenses typically rely on predefined threat models or known vulnerability patterns, limiting their effectiveness against novel attacks. We propose CodeSIFT, a threat-model-agnostic detection method that leverages influence functions to identify batches of prompts that induce anomalous model behavior. Rather than detecting specific vulnerabilities, CodeSIFT measures the parameter-space influence of generated code and uses a statistical test to determine whether a candidate prompt set deviates from a benign reference distribution. To evaluate our approach, we introduce two benchmark datasets covering a variety of vulnerabilities. We evaluate CodeSIFT on three open-weight code LLMs ranging from 3B to 7B parameters, achieving AUROC scores of up to 0.98 at moderate-to-high injection rates, while maintaining well-calibrated false positive rates and substantially outperforming static analysis baselines. These results suggest that influence-function-based detection is a promising direction for identifying malicious code-generation prompts without requiring prior knowledge of the underlying attack class.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CodeSIFT，一种与威胁模型无关的检测方法，利用影响函数 (influence functions) 识别会诱发大语言模型生成不安全代码的提示批次。方法不是检测特定漏洞，而是度量生成代码在参数空间中的影响，并用统计检验判断候选提示集是否偏离良性参考分布。在 3B 到 7B 参数的三个开源代码模型上，AUROC 最高达 0.98，并显著优于静态分析基线。
Motivation: 现有针对代码生成模型的防御通常依赖预定义威胁模型或已知漏洞模式，难以应对新型攻击。需要一种无需先验攻击类别知识、能识别异常提示批次的通用检测方法。
Method: CodeSIFT 通过影响函数衡量生成代码对模型参数的影响（parameter-space influence），构造统计检验来判断候选提示批次是否偏离良性参考分布；同时引入两个覆盖多种漏洞的基准数据集用于评估。
Result: 在三个 3B 至 7B 参数的开源代码 LLM 上，该方法在中高注入率下取得最高 0.98 的 AUROC，保持校准良好的假阳性率，并大幅超过静态分析基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于影响函数的检测是识别恶意代码生成提示的有前途方向，且无需预先了解攻击类别。摘要未提及具体局限。

papers.title: Conditional Neural Optimal Transport for Predicting Cellular Phenotypes from Molecular Structure
papers.abstract_en: High-content microscopy enables systematic profiling of cellular responses to chemical perturbations, but the scale of the chemical space makes exhaustive phenotypic characterization experimentally infeasible. This motivates computational models that can predict image-derived phenotypes without acquiring the corresponding treated cells. We formulate molecule-induced phenotype prediction as an inductive conditional transport problem in image representation space. Given a negative-control phenotype and the structure of a molecule, we aim to predict the phenotype induced by the corresponding molecule. We first evaluate classical optimal transport baselines and show that static couplings do not yield useful predictions on large-scale phenotypic image datasets. We then introduce a molecule-conditioned Neural Optimal Transport (NOT) model with a Monge-Gap regularization training objective that learns to transport negative-control unperturbed phenotypes toward perturbed phenotypes using molecular structure as conditioning information. NOT recovers molecule-specific phenotypic effects while reducing microscopy-associated technical variation, thereby facilitating comparisons across experimental batches. On unseen active molecules, the model outperforms baseline approaches, demonstrating that chemically conditioned transport can generalize beyond the molecules observed during training. We identified the molecular encoder as the main limitation to this generalization, while transport in a compressed representation space improves performance and scalability. These results establish NOT as a promising framework for predicting cellular phenotypes from molecular structure and negative-control phenotypes, while highlighting the development of more informative molecular representations as a key direction for improving out-of-distribution performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at the BioImage Computing (BIC) Workshop, ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将分子诱导的细胞表型预测建模为图像表征空间中的归纳条件最优传输问题。作者评估了经典最优传输基线，发现静态耦合在大规模表型图像数据集上无法产生有效预测，进而提出以分子结构为条件的 Neural Optimal Transport (NOT) 模型，采用 Monge-Gap 正则化训练目标，将阴性对照表型传输到扰动表型。在未见过的活性分子上，NOT 优于基线方法，并证明化学条件传输可以泛化到训练中未见的分子。
Motivation: 高内涵显微镜可系统记录化学扰动下的细胞反应，但化学空间规模巨大，穷尽式表型表征在实验上不可行，因此需要仅从分子结构预测图像表型的计算方法。
Method: 将问题形式化为图像表征空间中的归纳条件最优传输；在验证静态耦合不适用后，提出分子条件化的 Neural Optimal Transport (NOT) 模型，以分子结构为条件，用 Monge-Gap 正则化训练目标学习从阴性对照表型到扰动表型的传输。
Result: 在未见的活性分子上，NOT 优于基线方法；模型能恢复分子特异表型效应并降低显微技术相关变异。作者指出分子编码器是泛化主要瓶颈，压缩表征空间的传输可提升性能与可扩展性。
Conclusion: 结论认为 NOT 是从分子结构与阴性对照表型预测细胞表型的有前景框架，并强调发展更具信息量的分子表征是提升分布外性能的关键方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Mobius-v0, an architecture that comprises a globally shared Memory (FFN) that stores knowledge vectors and multiple Reasoners (Self-Attn) that iteratively achieve compositional reasoning. Using hidden states as cache and carrier, reasoners repeatedly query memory for required knowledge-vectors, while the knowledge is transmitted back to reasoning operators. Through this knowledge-reasoning-separation architecture, Mobius achieves better knowledge compression and reasoning efficiency. Built upon Mobius-v0 architecture: 1) Our 7B model trained-from-scratch achieves similar downstream score as a 7B Transformer baseline with 62.6% of baseline's training data. 2) Our Intern-S2-Mobius, continually-pretrained from Qwen3.5-35B, achieves similar downstream score while delivering nearly 4x end-to-end inference speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mobius-v0 架构，将知识存储与推理解耦：全局共享的 Memory (FFN) 存储知识向量，多个 Reasoner (Self-Attn) 通过迭代查询完成组合推理，以隐藏状态作为缓存与载体。基于该架构，7B 从零训练模型在相似下游分数下仅用基线 62.6% 的训练数据；持续预训练的 Intern-S2-Mobius（基于 Qwen3.5-35B）在相似下游分数下实现近 4 倍端到端推理加速。
Motivation: 传统 Transformer 将知识存储与推理耦合在同一前向过程中，导致知识压缩效率与推理效率受限；论文旨在通过解耦知识（Memory）与推理（Reasoner）来提升两者的效率。
Method: 提出 Mobius-v0：全局共享的 Memory 模块以 FFN 形式存储知识向量，多个 Reasoner 模块以 Self-Attn 形式迭代执行组合推理；推理器以隐藏状态为缓存和载体反复查询 Memory 获取所需知识向量，知识再回传至推理算子。
Result: 7B 从零训练模型达到与 7B Transformer 基线相近的下游分数，但仅使用基线 62.6% 的训练数据；Intern-S2-Mobius 在 Qwen3.5-35B 上持续预训练，达到相近下游分数且端到端推理速度提升近 4 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调知识-推理分离架构能同时改善知识压缩与推理效率；未提及具体下游基准或计算细节。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Convex losses and their applications to SVM, SVR, and Shallow Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We propose multiple new convex losses for SVM and Neural Networks, applied to binary classification tasks. While there are practical limitations in exploiting them with the dual SVM models, we are able to use them with SVM primal formulation and Neural Networks. In detail, the primal SVM problem with the modified losses has been solved with the Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm. We prove that the proposed losses are a generalization of the standard loss, and we experiment them with several small data-sets. This preliminary study shows that using pattern correlations inside the loss function could in theory enhance the generalization performances on some data-sets. To evaluate the performance of each loss, we adopt a Nested Cross-Validation procedure. Results show that generalization measures are the same with or without the new losses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为 SVM 与浅层神经网络提出若干新的凸损失函数，用于二分类任务，并证明这些损失是标准损失的推广。由于对偶 SVM 模型的实用限制，作者将修改后的损失用于 SVM 原始形式（primal formulation）并以粒子群优化（Particle Swarm Optimization）求解；在若干小数据集上的嵌套交叉验证（Nested Cross-Validation）实验显示，加入新损失后泛化指标与不使用新损失时相同。
Motivation: 作者试图通过在损失函数中引入模式相关性（pattern correlations）来改善分类器的泛化性能，并给出新的凸损失族作为标准损失的推广。
Method: 提出多个新的凸损失函数用于 SVM 和神经网络；利用 SVM 原始形式而非对偶形式，并采用粒子群优化算法求解带修改损失的原始 SVM 问题，同时用嵌套交叉验证评估各损失的性能。
Result: 在若干小数据集上的初步实验表明，使用或不使用新损失的泛化测度相同；摘要也指出在理论上利用模式相关性可能增强某些数据集的泛化表现。
Conclusion: 这是一项初步研究，强调新的凸损失是标准损失的推广，但当前实验证据显示其并未带来泛化提升；其对天气、降水临近预报等领域没有直接关联。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Acoustic UAV Detection in Battlefield Scenarios: Handling Noise, Domain Shift, and Weak Labels
papers.abstract_en: Passive acoustic sensing offers a critical, cost-efficient, and, crucially, passive alternative for detecting small unmanned aerial vehicles. However, the practical deployment of acoustic systems is discouraged by extreme environmental noise and sensor-induced domain shift caused by heterogeneous hardware. This paper addresses these challenges by introducing a robust framework optimized for real-world battlefield conditions. We propose the integration of Per-Channel Energy Normalization (PCEN) and attention-based pooling to enhance feature extraction under low signal-to-noise ratio scenarios. We further propose a domain-aware training strategy that leverages auxiliary classes and multi-microphone data to mitigate cross-domain performance degradation. Evaluated on a unique dataset of combat-zone recordings from the Ukrainian frontlines, our approach significantly outperforms existing baselines, increasing the F1 score from 55.4% to 78.6%. This paper was originally presented at the International Conference on Military Communication and Information Systems (ICMCIS), organized by the Information Systems Technology (IST) Scientific and Technical Committee, IST-224-RSY - the ICMCIS, held in Bath, United Kingdom, 12-13 May 2026.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对战场环境下无源声学无人机检测在极端环境噪声与异构硬件导致的域偏移下性能退化的问题，提出一个鲁棒检测框架。方法包括在低信噪比下使用按通道能量归一化 (PCEN) 和注意力池化增强特征提取，并利用辅助类别与多麦克风数据的域感知训练策略缓解跨域退化。在乌克兰前线战斗区录音数据集上，该方法将 F1 分数从 55.4% 提升到 78.6%，显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 无源声学传感是检测小型无人机的低成本被动替代方案，但实际部署受制于极端环境噪声和异构硬件带来的域偏移，导致检测性能严重下降。
Method: 提出集成 Per-Channel Energy Normalization (PCEN) 与基于注意力的池化 (attention-based pooling) 来增强低信噪比场景下的特征提取；进一步提出域感知训练策略，利用辅助类别和多麦克风数据缓解跨域性能退化。
Result: 在来自乌克兰前线的战斗区录音专用数据集上，该方法将 F1 分数从基线 55.4% 提升至 78.6%，显著优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架能够提升真实战场条件下声学无人机检测的鲁棒性，为实战部署提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Seeing Red, Thinking Bad: Color Bias in Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in industrial decision-making systems, such as recruitment support and recommendation. This motivates careful analysis of how VLMs process visual and textual information. In this work, we study how VLMs interpret text rendered as an image, and investigate the influence of visual styling biases. To this end, we introduce Stealth Visual Prompts, which subtly change visual styling of text, such as color and contrast, while preserving semantic content. Using these prompts, we systematically control the visual styling of words in text and measure their impact on the analysis performed by VLMs. We further analyze how such visual perturbations affect the latent representations of the vision encoder. From our experiments, we observed that coloring positive words in green consistently shifts sentiment predictions toward a positive direction. As a result, VLMs often fail to properly account for negative words present in the text. Our analysis suggests that this behavior is correlated with changes in the latent representations of the vision encoder induced by color variations. In addition, we show that reducing text--background contrast increases reliance on visually salient cues and leads to more incorrect Visual Question Answering (VQA) outputs. These results suggest that the visual styling of rendered text can guide VLMs' interpretation in ways that diverge from human semantic understanding. Project page: https://github.com/KohsukeIde/color-bias-vlm
papers.journal_ref: In: Pattern Recognition. ICPR 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science. Springer, Cham, pp. 261-275
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）如何解读以图像形式呈现的文字，关注视觉样式偏差的影响。作者提出 Stealth Visual Prompts，在不改变语义内容的前提下微妙调整文字颜色和对比度，系统测量这些扰动对 VLM 分析结果的影响，并结合视觉编码器潜在表征进行分析。实验显示，将正面词汇染成绿色会一致地把情绪预测推向正面方向，降低文字与背景对比度会增加对视觉显著线索的依赖并导致更多 VQA 错误。作者认为渲染文字的视觉样式能使 VLM 的解释偏离人类语义理解。
Motivation: VLM 正被用于招聘支持、推荐等工业决策系统，因此需要仔细分析其处理视觉与文本信息的方式；已有研究缺少对图像化文字的视觉样式偏误的系统度量。
Method: 引入 Stealth Visual Prompts，通过保持语义内容不变、仅改变文字视觉样式（如颜色和对比度）来系统控制图像化文字中单词的视觉样式；同时分析视觉扰动对视觉编码器潜在表征的影响，并与其对 VLM 行为的影响相关联。
Result: 实验中，将正面词汇着色为绿色会一致地将情绪预测移向正面方向，使 VLM 经常无法正确处理文本中的否定词；降低文字与背景的对比度会增加对视觉显著线索的依赖，并带来更多错误的 VQA 输出。这些行为变化与颜色引起的视觉编码器潜在表征变化相关。
Conclusion: 结果表明，渲染文字的视觉样式可以引导 VLM 的解释，使其偏离人类的语义理解；作者在摘要中强调视觉样式偏误需要被纳入 VLM 可靠性的考量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5: A Toolkit for Robot Process Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained robotic evaluation matters for understanding embodied models, going beyond binary success rates and rule-based process scores. We present PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5, a toolkit for robot process assessment that turns rollout videos into dense progress curves and derives multiple fine metrics. PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5 introduces three metrics, building on version 1.0, that characterize failure-side progress, post-drawdown recovery, and success-side execution quality, helping users understand embodied model capability. Based on the rollout videos from benchmarks, we perform a comprehensive assessment of the embodied models, providing some fine-grained metric results and key findings. We further introduce RoboPulse++ to evaluate the reliability of process reward models (PRM), providing evaluators with a more accurate testing platform. Moreover, we release a user-friendly assessment suite, including the benchmark, metric implementation, and visualization tools, to support reproducible manipulation process evaluation. We call on the community to rethink how robots are evaluated and establish transparent, procedural, and reproducible assessment as a foundation for the next generation of embodied intelligence.

papers.title: MAGneT-3D: Monocular and Domain-Generalizable Temporal 3D Detection
papers.abstract_en: Monocular temporal 3D detection aims to detect objects in 3D, given a monocular video. Query-based 3D detectors unify detection and cross-view association, but their learnable queries fit the spatial distribution of the training data (e.g., field-of-view). We show that this issue is especially severe when these models are applied to monocular video, hindering generalization to unseen datasets and environments. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGneT-3D, the first method for domain-generalized monocular temporal 3D object detection. Instead of relying on static learnable queries, we propose a Domain-Robust Anchor Generator (DRAG) approach that adaptively derives 3D proposals during inference. To further enable domain generalization, we propose a Temporal Refinement and Identity Merging (TRIM) strategy, reducing dependence on specific 3D proposals. To enable comprehensive domain-generalization evaluation, we establish a cross-dataset benchmark spanning nuScenes, Waymo, Lyft, and ONCE. Under zero-shot domain shifts, MAGneT-3D outperforms all baselines, improving NDS from 12.1% to 18.6% while also increasing in-domain accuracy.
papers.comment: To appear at ECCVW 2026 (DriveX workshop; Oral paper). Johannes Meier and Mohamed Kotb - both authors contributed equally. Project page: https://mo-sameh.github.io/MAGneT-3D-Project-Page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAGneT-3D，首个面向域泛化的单目时序 3D 目标检测方法。针对 query-based 3D 检测器中可学习 query 易过拟合训练数据空间分布（如视场角）的问题，提出 Domain-Robust Anchor Generator (DRAG) 在推理时自适应生成 3D proposals，并用 Temporal Refinement and Identity Merging (TRIM) 降低对特定 proposals 的依赖。在 nuScenes、Waymo、Lyft、ONCE 的跨数据集基准上，零样本域迁移下 NDS 从 12.1% 提升到 18.6%，同时提升域内精度。
Motivation: 现有 query-based 单目 3D 检测器统一了检测与跨视角关联，但其可学习 query 会拟合训练数据的空间分布（如视场角），在单目视频场景下这一问题尤其严重，阻碍模型泛化到未见数据集和环境。
Method: 提出 MAGneT-3D，包含 Domain-Robust Anchor Generator (DRAG) 以在推理时自适应推导 3D proposals，替代静态可学习 query；并提出 Temporal Refinement and Identity Merging (TRIM) 策略，减少对特定 3D proposals 的依赖，从而提升域泛化能力。
Result: 建立覆盖 nuScenes、Waymo、Lyft 和 ONCE 的跨数据集基准；在零样本域迁移下，MAGneT-3D 优于所有基线，NDS 从 12.1% 提升至 18.6%，同时域内精度也有提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过推理时自适应生成 proposals 并结合时序细化与身份合并，可以显著改善单目时序 3D 检测的域泛化性能。

papers.title: Learning to Forecast Crop Growth from Earth Observation Data
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting crop growth across agricultural landscapes is important for improving the productivity, resilience, and operational management of farming systems. In this work, we investigate whether Earth observation time series and meteorological drivers can be used to predict future canopy development at country scale. We focus on winter wheat and formulate crop growth prediction as forecasting future leaf area index (LAI) trajectories beyond the last available Sentinel-2 observation. We evaluate this task on a multi-year dataset which spans the entire country of Switzerland, containing over 20 million pixel-level Sentinel-2-derived LAI time series paired with meteorological variables. Because cloud cover and revisit gaps leave LAI supervision sparse, models fit the few valid (cloud-free) LAI observations yet oscillate implausibly between them, producing trajectories no real canopy could follow. We introduce a lightweight unimodal shape regulariser which improves trajectory plausibility with negligible loss in accuracy. We compare deep learning sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) models with classic machine learning baselines and show that Seq2Seq models generalise well across years, achieving $\mathrm{R}^2$ above 0.8 and consistently outperforming conventional approaches. Together, these results demonstrate that remote sensing and weather-driven sequence modelling can learn crop growth dynamics at landscape scale. S
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用 Sentinel-2 叶面积指数（LAI）时间序列与气象变量，在国家尺度上预测冬小麦未来冠层发育轨迹。作者在覆盖瑞士全国、含超过 2000 万像素级 LAI 序列的数据集上，将任务建模为对未来 LAI 的序列到序列（Seq2Seq）预测。由于云层覆盖导致监督稀疏，模型在有效观测之间产生不合理的震荡轨迹，作者因此引入轻量级单峰形状正则化器加以约束。
Motivation: 作物生长预测对农业生产力与运营管理很重要，但现有方法在稀疏的云无关观测下难以生成物理上合理的冠层轨迹。作者希望检验遥感时间序列和气象驱动能否在国家尺度上预测未来冠层发育。
Method: 将作物生长预测形式化为预测最后一个可用 Sentinel-2 观测之后的未来 LAI 轨迹，并引入轻量级单峰形状正则化器（unimodal shape regulariser）来抑制轨迹震荡；同时比较深度学习 Seq2Seq 模型与经典机器学习基线。
Result: 摘要报告 Seq2Seq 模型在跨年份泛化上表现良好，R² 高于 0.8，并持续优于传统方法；形状正则化器在几乎不损失精度的前提下提升了轨迹合理性。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合遥感和天气驱动的序列建模可以在景观尺度上学习作物生长动态，但摘要未说明对不同区域或作物的泛化边界。

papers.title: Pairton: Iterative Reconstruction of Short-Lived Particles
papers.abstract_en: We present Pairton, an iterative framework for reconstructing short-lived particles in high-energy collision events. By formulating particle reconstruction as a masked prediction process over graph structures, Pairton learns conditional distributions consistent with a factorised decomposition of decay products and iteratively predicts edges in the adjacency matrix representing particle decay relationships. Leveraging a pairformer-based architecture with dynamically updated pairwise representations, our method incorporates global event consistency. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on fully hadronic $t\bar{t}$ decays. Pairton provides a general, flexible paradigm for particle reconstruction and can be readily extended to other topologies, bridging ideas from modern generative modelling and high-energy physics.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, to be submitted to Phys. Rev. D
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pairton，一个用于高能碰撞事件中短寿命粒子重建的迭代框架。作者将粒子重建形式化为图结构上的掩码预测过程，学习与衰变产物因子分解一致的条件分布，并迭代预测表示粒子衰变关系的邻接矩阵中的边。基于 pairformer 架构与动态更新的成对表示，方法融合了全局事件一致性，并在全强子 t$\bar{t}$ 衰变上展示了最先进性能。
Motivation: 短寿命粒子无法被直接观测，需要从衰变产物中重建。现有方法在复杂衰变拓扑上难以同时满足衰变结构的因子分解与全局事件一致性，该工作尝试用生成式图建模统一这一重建过程。
Method: 将粒子重建定义为图结构上的掩码预测：学习与衰变产物因子分解一致的条件分布，并迭代预测邻接矩阵中的边。架构采用 pairformer，动态更新成对表示，以纳入全局事件一致性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在全强子 $t\bar{t}$ 衰变上取得最先进的性能，并指出该框架可推广到其他粒子衰变拓扑。
Conclusion: Pairton 提供了一种通用、灵活的重建范式，连接现代生成建模与高能物理；作者强调其可扩展到其他拓扑，但摘要未给出具体数值或消融细节。

papers.title: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a promising way to transfer reasoning capabilities from stronger teacher models, but applying it to long-context reasoning teachers and short-context students introduces practical challenges, including tokenizer mismatch, teacher-student distribution mismatch, response length explosion, and training instability. In this work, we study this setting by transferring proof-reasoning capabilities from the long-context reasoning model SU-01 to short-context student models. To handle tokenizer differences, we perform OPD in a shared text space and align only tokens that occupy identical text spans under the student and teacher tokenizers. To mitigate the problem of excessive generation length and frequent truncation, we introduce a student reference KL loss and mask the advantages of special termination tokens such as </think> and <|im_end|>. This strategy constrains the student from drifting excessively from its initial policy, thereby mitigating the teacher-student distribution mismatch problem and fostering steady length growth. Experiments on both same-family and different-family student models, including Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Intern-S2, GLM-4.7, Gemma-4, show consistent gains in mathematical reasoning, especially natural-language math proving. Notably, Intern-S2-Preview improves by 21.2 points on ProofBench, reaching 55.2 and surpassing Gemini-2.5-Pro. It also improves on science benchmarks such as HLE and HiPhO, suggesting that OPD transfers reasoning capabilities that generalize beyond the mathematical training domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将长上下文推理教师模型的能力通过 on-policy distillation (OPD) 迁移到短上下文学生模型时遇到的实践问题，包括 tokenizer 不匹配、师生分布不匹配、响应长度爆炸和训练不稳定。作者将 SU-01 的证明推理能力蒸馏到 Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Intern-S2、GLM-4.7、Gemma-4 等学生模型，在数学推理尤其是自然语言数学证明上取得一致提升。Intern-S2-Preview 在 ProofBench 上提升 21.2 分达到 55.2，超过 Gemini-2.5-Pro，并在 HLE、HiPhO 等科学基准上也有改进。
Motivation: OPD 被用于从强教师模型迁移推理能力，但当教师是长上下文推理模型、学生是短上下文模型时，存在 tokenizer 差异、分布偏移、生成长度爆炸和训练不稳定等实际障碍，此前缺乏针对该设置的系统研究。
Method: 在共享文本空间中进行 OPD，只对齐学生和教师 tokenizer 下占据相同文本跨度的 token，以处理 tokenizer 差异；引入 student reference KL loss，并掩蔽 </think>、<|im_end|> 等特殊终止 token 的优势，约束学生不要过度偏离初始策略，从而缓解分布不匹配并让生成长度稳定增长。
Result: 在多个同族与异族学生模型上均获得数学推理提升；其中 Intern-S2-Preview 在 ProofBench 上达到 55.2，较其基础提升 21.2 分并超过 Gemini-2.5-Pro，同时 HLE 和 HiPhO 等科学基准也有改进，表明迁移能力可泛化到数学训练领域之外。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，在共享文本空间中对齐 token 并结合学生参考 KL 损失与终止 token 优势掩蔽，能够稳定地进行长上下文教师到短上下文学生的 OPD，并实现超越数学领域的推理能力迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TimeSage-EV: A Live Benchmark for Agentic Time Series Analysis in Evolving Environments
papers.abstract_en: Time series analysis in high-stakes domains relies on recurring data releases, where new observations can alter the evidence base and the validity of later conclusions. Existing time series QA benchmarks mostly rely on fixed snapshots, leaving temporal validity and cutoff-aware evidence use unevaluated. We introduce TimeSage-EV, a live benchmark for agentic time series analysis in evolving environments. It tracks 60 real institutional scenarios across 6 domains, comprising 1,485 scenario-period QA pairs from Feb 2023 to May 2026 and spanning monthly, weekly, daily, and irregular release cadences. At each period, large language model (LLM) agents receive time series data and source reports, while the withheld target release provides ground truth. TimeSage-EV evaluates state identification, data summarization, and outlook reasoning. Experiments with frontier LLM agents and TimeSage-1.0, a novel self-evolving agent with a reusable analytical skill library, reveal significant performance gaps across model tiers and recurring failures in temporal validity, exogenous context use, and adaptation. We release TimeSage-EV as a research resource with monthly updates, code, a leaderboard, and failure-mode analyses.

papers.title: Accelerating Large-scale Bundle Adjustment for LiDAR Mapping via Parallel Computing
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR bundle adjustment is widely utilized in mapping to construct globally consistent point cloud maps. In this paper, we propose the first fully parallel computing framework to accelerate LiDAR bundle adjustment for large-scale mapping, incorporating three key techniques. First, we design an adaptive, asynchronous data loading strategy to efficiently process large-scale point cloud datasets on memory-constrained GPUs. Secondly, we present a novel bottom-up voxelization method for extracting planar features, enabling fully parallelized pre-processing. Thirdly, we build upon a majorization-minimization formulation to accelerate compute-intensive tasks in the optimization via parallel computation, including the computation of residuals, Jacobian and Hessian matrices, and a parallel increment solver. To support our design, we provide both theoretical and experimental analysis of the time complexity of our approach. Extensive benchmarking on large-scale public datasets across various computational platforms validates the robustness and adaptability of our approach, achieving up to a tenfold improvement in computational efficiency while preserving mapping accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art methods. To benefit future research, the implementation code is available on GitHub.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个完全并行的LiDAR bundle adjustment（BA）框架，用于加速大规模点云地图构建。框架包含三项关键技术：面向有限GPU内存的适应性异步数据加载、用于平面特征提取的自底向上体素化方法，以及基于majorization-minimization（MM）公式对残差、Jacobian、Hessian矩阵和增量求解器进行并行计算。在大型公开数据集和多类计算平台上，该方法在保持与先进方法相当的建图精度的同时，最高可提升约十倍计算效率。
Motivation: 大规模LiDAR建图中的bundle adjustment计算量巨大，现有方法在GPU等并行平台上难以高效处理大规模点云数据，需要一种完整的并行计算方案来加速优化过程。
Method: 提出三种核心机制：一是适应性异步数据加载策略，以在内存受限的GPU上处理大规模点云；二是新的自底向上体素化方法提取平面特征，使预处理完全并行化；三是基于MM公式并行计算优化中的计算密集型任务，包括残差、Jacobian与Hessian矩阵以及并行增量求解器，并提供时间复杂度的理论和实验分析。
Result: 在多个大型公开数据集和不同计算平台上的广泛基准测试表明，该方法在保持与现有先进方法相当的建图精度的同时，可实现最高约十倍的效率提升。
Conclusion: 作者提供了所提方法的时间复杂度分析，认为该框架在大规模LiDAR建图中具有良好的鲁棒性和适应性，并已在GitHub开放实现代码以供后续研究使用。

papers.title: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Model merging combines trained models directly in weight space, offering a compute-efficient alternative to additional fine-tuning. Selecting merge parameters is nevertheless difficult because downstream evaluations are expensive, gradients are unavailable, and source capabilities can conflict. We formulate merge-parameter selection as a black-box multi-objective optimization problem and introduce MOBO-Merge, a merge-operator agnostic framework that uses multi-objective Bayesian optimization to approximate the Pareto front under a limited evaluation budget. We evaluate Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B in two-model instruction-math and three-model instruction-math-code settings using Linear, SLERP, TIES, and block-wise merge operators. On held-out benchmark partitions, MOBO-Merge obtains higher mean hypervolume than random search in 11 of 12 reported comparisons. The gain is small for one-dimensional Linear interpolation but substantially larger for several TIES, block-wise, and three-objective searches. No merge operator is uniformly best: TIES leads in three of four family-setting combinations, whereas Block-Linear 4x is strongest for the Llama three-model merge. These results show that multi-objective Bayesian optimization is valuable as a search layer for expressive merge parameterizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOBO-Merge，一种与合并算子无关（merge-operator agnostic）的框架，将模型合并中的参数选择形式化为黑盒多目标优化问题，并用多目标贝叶斯优化（multi-objective Bayesian optimization）在有限评估预算下近似 Pareto 前沿。在 Qwen3-4B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 上结合 Linear、SLERP、TIES 与 block-wise 合并算子评估，12 组对比中有 11 组平均 hypervolume 高于随机搜索。作者认为多目标贝叶斯优化可充当表达性合并参数化的搜索层。
Motivation: 模型合并直接在权重空间组合已训练模型，是替代额外微调的计算高效方案，但合并参数选择困难：下游评估昂贵、梯度不可用，且源模型能力可能相互冲突。
Method: 提出 MOBO-Merge，使用多目标贝叶斯优化来搜索合并参数并近似 Pareto 前沿；在二模型指令-数学和三模型指令-数学-代码设置下，对 Linear、SLERP、TIES 以及 block-wise 等合并算子进行评估。
Result: 在留出基准分区上，MOBO-Merge 在 12 个报告比较中有 11 个取得比随机搜索更高的平均 hypervolume；一维 Linear 插值的增益较小，而 TIES、block-wise 和三目标搜索的增益显著更大。没有合并算子普遍最优：TIES 在四种 family-setting 组合中三种领先，Block-Linear 4x 对 Llama 三模型合并最强。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多目标贝叶斯优化作为表达性合并参数化的搜索层是有价值的，但它并未声称某种合并算子在所有设定下统一最优。

papers.title: On the Robustness of Temporal Vision-Language Models for Surgical Endoscopy Videos
papers.abstract_en: Temporal vision-language models (TVLMs) offer a reusable, prompt-based interface for surgical video understanding, yet, their robustness under clinically realistic acquisition artifacts in endoscopy remains insufficiently characterized. In practice, degradations such as defocus, haze, motion blur, noise, cautery smoke, and packet loss introduce structured distribution shifts which may compromise video-text alignment. We study the robustness of temporal VLMs under such shifts caused by corruptions in clip frames. We introduce Endo-C6, a compact corruption benchmark of six endoscopy-realistic perturbations evaluated at a fixed high severity, and apply it to public Gastrointestinal (GI) endoscopy and laparoscopic cholecystectomy videos. Under a standardized prompt protocol, we benchmark 3 recent surgical TVLM baselines and analyze robustness in both mean and worst-case settings, spanning 294 dataset-level evaluations. Finally, we present RobustEndoCLIP, obtained by few-shot parameter-efficient tuning with VeRA, outperforming existing TVLM baselines. Our findings show that off-the-shelf TVLMs can exhibit severe worst-case collapse under endoscopy-specific corruptions, whereas lightweight few-shot adaptation can substantially improve corrupted performance and robustness without changing the prompt-based interface. We expect Endo-C6 to support standardized robustness reporting and promote more reliable clinical vision-language systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间视觉语言模型 (temporal vision-language models, TVLMs) 在手术内窥镜视频中面对临床现实采集伪影的鲁棒性。作者提出 Endo-C6，一个包含六种内窥镜现实扰动、固定高严重度的压缩基准，并在 GI 内窥镜和腹腔镜胆囊切除术视频上、294 次数据集级评估中基准测试了 3 个手术 TVLM 基线。最后提出基于 VeRA 的少样本参数高效微调模型 RobustEndoCLIP，优于现有 TVLM 基线并改善受污染性能与鲁棒性。
Motivation: TVLM 被用作可复用的提示接口进行手术视频理解，但在临床现实中的 defocus、haze、motion blur、噪声、cautery smoke 和 packet loss 等采集伪影下，其鲁棒性尚未被充分刻画，这些结构化分布偏移可能破坏视频-文本对齐。
Method: 引入 Endo-C6 压缩基准，在固定高严重度下评估六种内窥镜现实扰动；采用标准化提示协议，在平均和最坏情况设置下、跨越 294 次数据集级评估来基准测试 3 个近期手术 TVLM 基线；并提出 RobustEndoCLIP，通过 VeRA 进行少样本参数高效微调。
Result: 现成的 TVLM 在内窥镜特定扰动下会出现严重的最坏情况崩溃，而轻量级少样本自适应能大幅提升受污染性能与鲁棒性，且不改变基于提示的接口；RobustEndoCLIP 在摘要报告的性能上超过现有 TVLM 基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Endo-C6 可用于支持标准化鲁棒性报告，并促进更可靠的临床视觉语言系统；摘要未明确讨论方法在其他视频领域的泛化或额外局限。

papers.title: Meteorology-driven Causal Nowcasting of Fugitive Landfill Emissions Enables Proactive Public Health Response
papers.abstract_en: Fugitive emissions from waste sites increasingly expose communities to toxic and odorous gases, yet public-health responses remain largely retrospective, with episodes investigated only after residents have been exposed. Here we show that the meteorological drivers of elevated hydrogen sulphide (HS) at a long-monitored European landfill, and the timescales over which they act, can be identified directly from routine monitoring data. We introduce CAIRN (Causal-Anchored Inference for Receptor Nowcasting), a machine-learning framework whose internal memory is matched to these measured timescales: a fast component tracking hour-scale wind-borne transport and a slow component tracking multi-hour weather changes. Trained to predict gas measurements, CAIRN operates using only routine weather variables and the calendar, without hand-engineered features. Its behaviour is consistent with the identified transport mechanisms, and the framework transfers unchanged to a second monitoring station and to co-emitted methane. Combining four such nowcasters produces a site-level, tiered alert aligned with WHO odour guidance that closely reproduces the alert generated by a direct sensor network and tracks an independent record of community odour complaints. Weather-driven nowcasting can therefore estimate community impact as an emission episode unfolds, providing public-health authorities with a validated, graded trigger for intervention and enabling exposure to be reduced during events rather than after them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用常规监测数据识别欧洲某长期监测填埋场硫化氢(H2S)升高的气象驱动因素及其作用时间尺度，提出机器学习框架CAIRN（Causal-Anchored Inference for Receptor Nowcasting）。CAIRN包含快慢两个内部记忆组件，分别追踪小时级风载传输和多小时天气变化，仅使用常规气象变量和日历即可训练，无需手工特征。框架可迁移到第二个监测站和共同排放的甲烷，组合四个临近预报器可生成与WHO异味指南一致的分级警报，并能重现直接传感器网络的警报和独立社区异味投诉记录。
Motivation: 垃圾场逸散排放使社区暴露于有毒和有气味气体，但公共卫生响应大多是事后性的，通常只在居民暴露后才调查事件。作者希望证明可以从常规监测数据中直接识别气象驱动因素和时间尺度，从而实现事件发生过程中的主动响应。
Method: 引入CAIRN框架，其内部记忆与测量到的气象作用时间尺度匹配：快组件跟踪小时级风载传输，慢组件跟踪多小时天气变化。模型仅用常规天气变量和日历作为输入，训练目标为预测气体测量值，不依赖人工工程特征，并以识别出的传输机制作为一致性约束。
Result: CAIRN的行为与识别出的传输机制一致，可无修改地迁移到第二个监测站和共同排放的甲烷。组合四个此类临近预报器得到的站点级分级警报与直接传感器网络生成的警报高度吻合，并能追踪独立的社区异味投诉记录。
Conclusion: 天气驱动的临近预报可以在排放事件展开时估算社区影响，为公共卫生部门提供经验证的分级干预触发机制，使暴露能在事件期间而非事件后得到减少。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文利用常规监测数据识别欧洲某长期监测填埋场硫化氢(H2S)升高的气象驱动因素及其作用时间尺度，提出机器学习框架CAIRN（Causal-Anchored Inference for Receptor Nowcasting）。CAIRN包含快慢两个内部记忆组件，分别追踪小时级风载传输和多小时天气变化，仅使用常规气象变量和日历即可训练，无需手工特征。框架可迁移到第二个监测站和共同排放的甲烷，组合四个临近预报器可生成与WHO异味指南一致的分级警报，并能重现直接传感器网络的警报和独立社区异味投诉记录。
summary_sections.motivation: 垃圾场逸散排放使社区暴露于有毒和有气味气体，但公共卫生响应大多是事后性的，通常只在居民暴露后才调查事件。作者希望证明可以从常规监测数据中直接识别气象驱动因素和时间尺度，从而实现事件发生过程中的主动响应。
summary_sections.method: 引入CAIRN框架，其内部记忆与测量到的气象作用时间尺度匹配：快组件跟踪小时级风载传输，慢组件跟踪多小时天气变化。模型仅用常规天气变量和日历作为输入，训练目标为预测气体测量值，不依赖人工工程特征，并以识别出的传输机制作为一致性约束。
summary_sections.result: CAIRN的行为与识别出的传输机制一致，可无修改地迁移到第二个监测站和共同排放的甲烷。组合四个此类临近预报器得到的站点级分级警报与直接传感器网络生成的警报高度吻合，并能追踪独立的社区异味投诉记录。
summary_sections.conclusion: 天气驱动的临近预报可以在排放事件展开时估算社区影响，为公共卫生部门提供经验证的分级干预触发机制，使暴露能在事件期间而非事件后得到减少。

papers.title: Grounding Without Corrective Control: Truth-Tracking Profiles for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent work suggests that some large language model representations have content or reference. Grounding can secure either without supplying live routes for correction. This paper asks what follows from that gap. An output is answerable when discrepancies can affect what a target- and task-specific arrangement produces, accepts, or withdraws. The arrangement has corrective control only when live, sufficiently independent routes can detect and repair fresh discrepancies. A route profile records which routes constrain the arrangement and how they are related. Those profiles support analysis of truth-tracking: patterned support for representational success. Language models are the pressure case; text-only arrangements provide a task-relative limiting case. Text-trained models inherit patterns of testimony, coherence, and prior correction. Where target-sensitive correction survives training, these can supply derivative answerability (inherited constraint); live answerability is the relation supplied by a current route for fresh discrepancies. Fluent failures should follow when a task requires independently informative access to the facts. Self-consistency, retrieval, tools, code execution, multimodal input, and feedback should help selectively. Route-by-task interactions test the distinctions. The decomposition's empirical burden is to predict held-out route--task combinations or improve intervention choice without conceptual refitting. Surface improvement and truth-tracking improvement can come apart.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. A six-page methodological supplement, reproducible R script, and constructed data are included as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）表征是否具有内容或指称的近期研究，提出接地（grounding）并不保证实时纠正路径，并由此探讨真值追踪（truth-tracking）的条件。作者区分了可回答性（answerability）与纠正控制（corrective control），引入路线档案（route profile）分析框架，以文本训练的模型为主要案例，并讨论文本-only安排的极限情形。该工作是概念性/理论性论文，强调表面改进与真值追踪改进可能分离。
Motivation: 已有研究表明LLM表征可以有内容或指称，但接地本身不提供实时纠正路线；论文追问这一差距的后果，试图澄清输出在何种意义上对事实负责。
Method: 定义可回答性为差异能否影响目标-任务特定安排的产出、接受或撤回；定义纠正控制为实时且足够独立的路线能否检测和修复新差异。提出路线档案记录哪些路线约束安排及其关系，并以此分析真值追踪；以语言模型为压力案例，文本-only安排为极限案例，考察继承的证言、一致性与先前纠正模式。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数字，而是提出分解的经验负担：预测留出的路线-任务组合或在不进行概念重配的情况下改进干预选择；并论证流畅失败应出现在任务需要独立信息获取事实时，自一致性、检索、工具、代码执行、多模态输入和反馈应能有选择地帮助。
Conclusion: 作者认为该分解可用于分析不同任务下真值追踪的支持模式，并强调表面改进与真值追踪改进可能不一致，干预选择需要依据路线-任务交互。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Polaris : Multi Agentic System for Conversational Enterprise Analytics
papers.abstract_en: In today's fast-paced environment, the ability to swiftly access, understand, and act on data is no longer optional; it is essential. Yet most organizations remain data-rich but insight-poor, constrained by the complexity of querying, interpreting, and explaining enterprise-scale information. We present Polaris, a supervisor-led multi-agent framework for conversational enterprise analytics that bridges this gap. Polaris introduces Dynamic Task Coordination (DTC), a decision-theoretic orchestration layer that models agent-task assignment as adaptive bipartite matching, enabling real-time coordination, recovery, and optimization across specialized agents for querying, visualization, and reasoning. By coupling DTC with reason-first, ReAct-style agents, Polaris transforms natural-language queries into coherent analytical workflows that not only retrieve and visualize data but also explain the underlying "why." Evaluation on structured enterprise datasets demonstrates high semantic fidelity and answer relevancy, underscoring the potential of multi-agent orchestration to deliver trustworthy, end-to-end business intelligence at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Polaris，一个由 supervisor 主导的多智能体框架，用于企业会话式数据分析，将自然语言查询转化为包含检索、可视化和解释的端到端分析流程。核心是 Dynamic Task Coordination (DTC) 编排层，把智能体-任务分配建模为自适应二分图匹配。摘要报告在结构化企业数据集上的评估显示出较高的语义保真度和答案相关性。
Motivation: 多数组织数据丰富但洞察贫乏，企业级数据的查询、解释和沟通复杂性阻碍了快速决策，现有工具难以让用户便捷地理解数据背后的原因。
Method: Polaris 采用 supervisor 主导的多智能体架构，引入决策理论驱动的 Dynamic Task Coordination (DTC) 编排层，将智能体-任务分配建模为自适应二分图匹配，实现实时协调、恢复与优化；同时配合 reason-first 的 ReAct 风格智能体，分别处理查询、可视化和推理任务。
Result: 在结构化企业数据集上的评估表明，该方法取得了较高的语义保真度 (semantic fidelity) 和答案相关性 (answer relevancy)，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为多智能体编排有望实现可信、可扩展的端到端商业智能，并强调该框架在解释数据‘为什么’方面的价值。

papers.title: Body size predicts how long ant workers live - but not how they age or how they die from heat
papers.abstract_en: In social insects, mortality risk comprises distinct components that may not share the same predictors: lifespan duration, senescence trajectory, and thermal vulnerability. We tested these three axes in 18 Australian ant species using paired field-laboratory survival assays (2,363 cohort-day observations; 1,148 workers). Body size predicted duration (Cox HR = 0.67, p = 0.002), while colony size (p = 0.60) and the size x temperature interaction (p = 0.72) showed no detectable moderating effect. A weak but significant size x foraging-rate interaction was detected (LRT p = 0.014), suggesting that intrinsic physiology remains the most parsimonious explanation for the main size-longevity pattern, although ecological context may contribute. Senescence trajectory was associated with circadian niche rather than size: it was steepest in matinal species (Kruskal-Wallis p = 0.009; matinal vs. crepuscular p = 0.002) and was uncorrelated with body mass (Spearman p = 0.32). Thermal hazard plateaued above 20 degrees C (Delta AIC = -38; p < 0.001), with elevated thermal sensitivity in Rhytidoponera (Ectatomminae) above the plateau (5% per degree C, p = 0.015). Circadian regime and lineage identity, not body size, therefore emerge as the most climate-relevant axes, although they are strongly collinear (Cramer's V = 0.85). These results show that body size captures only one dimension of mortality risk and that size-based vulnerability indices may misrank taxa when senescence and thermal sensitivity are decoupled from body size.
papers.comment: 6 figures, 10 main-text tables, and 5 supplementary tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用18种澳大利亚蚂蚁的配对野外-实验室存活测定（2,363 个 cohort-day 观测，1,148 只工蚁）检验死亡风险的三个轴：寿命时长、衰老轨迹与热脆弱性。结果显示体型只显著预测寿命时长（Cox HR = 0.67, p = 0.002），衰老轨迹与昼夜节律生态位相关而非体型，热风险在 20°C 以上进入平台期并与谱系相关。作者据此认为体型只捕捉死亡风险的一个维度，基于体型的脆弱性指数可能在衰老和热敏感性脱钩时错排分类群。
Motivation: 社会昆虫的死亡风险由寿命长短、衰老轨迹和热脆弱性等不同成分组成，这些成分可能不具有相同的预测因子；而现有研究往往以体型作为脆弱性指标，缺乏对这三条轴的综合检验。
Method: 对18种澳大利亚蚂蚁开展配对的野外-实验室存活实验，使用 Cox 比例风险模型分析寿命，用衰老轨迹分析检验昼夜节律与体重的作用，并建立温度-死亡率模型刻画热风险平台及谱系差异。
Result: 体型显著预测寿命（Cox HR = 0.67, p = 0.002），群体大小（p = 0.60）和体型×温度交互（p = 0.72）无调节作用，但体型×取食率交互较弱（LRT p = 0.014）。衰老轨迹在晨行性（matinal）物种中最陡（Kruskal-Wallis p = 0.009），与体重不相关（Spearman p = 0.32）。热风险在 20°C 以上进入平台（Delta AIC = -38, p < 0.001），Rhytidoponera（Ectatomminae）在平台以上每摄氏度热敏感性增加 5%（p = 0.015）；昼夜节律与谱系高度共线（Cramer's V = 0.85）。
Conclusion: 体型只解释死亡风险的一个维度；当衰老轨迹和热敏感性与体型脱钩时，基于体型的脆弱性指数可能对分类群风险排序产生误导。与气候最相关的轴是昼夜节律生态位和谱系身份，而非体型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Zero-Shot Skeleton-Based Action Anticipation
papers.abstract_en: Action anticipation (AA) aims to recognize ongoing human or humanoids actions from partial observations, enabling robots to predict intentions before the actions are completed. Although skeleton-based AA offers efficiency advantages, existing approaches assume that all action classes are seen during training, which limits their deployment in real-world scenarios where novel actions inevitably arise. To address this gap, we study the new task of Zero-Shot Skeleton-Based Action Anticipation (ZS-SkAA). This task requires recognizing unseen action classes using only limited early-stage skeleton sequences, combining the challenges of partial observations, temporal dynamics, and zero-shot generalization. To establish foundational research for ZS-SkAA, we introduce:(1) A baseline model comprising a spatio-temporal feature extractor and a mutual information estimation and maximization module. This baseline model explicitly aligns partial visual features with semantic class embeddings across modalities by estimating and maximizing their mutual information, enhancing generalization to unseen classes.(2) A benchmark protocol using the NTU RGB+D dataset, which is adapted for rigorous ZS-SkAA evaluation. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our model as a strong baseline for ZS-SkAA, achieving high zero-shot accuracy on NTU RGB+D. This work establishes ZS-SkAA as a vital research direction for real-world systems requiring generalization to novel actions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出新任务 Zero-Shot Skeleton-Based Action Anticipation (ZS-SkAA)，要求模型仅凭早期骨架序列识别训练中未见过的动作类别，同时应对部分观测、时间动态与零样本泛化。作者引入一个基线模型，包含时空特征提取器和互信息估计与最大化模块，将部分视觉特征与语义类别嵌入对齐，并在 NTU RGB+D 上设计了适配的基准评测协议。摘要报告该模型在 NTU RGB+D 上取得高零样本准确率，可作为 ZS-SkAA 的强基线。
Motivation: 现有基于骨架的动作预测 (action anticipation) 方法都假设所有动作类别在训练时可见，限制了在真实世界中遭遇新动作类别时的部署。本文填补这一空白，研究仅用有限早期骨架序列识别未见动作类别的 ZS-SkAA 任务。
Method: 提出一个基线模型：由时空特征提取器与互信息估计和最大化模块组成，后者通过估计并最大化部分视觉特征与语义类别嵌入之间的互信息，显式对齐跨模态特征以提升对未见类别的泛化。同时给出基于 NTU RGB+D 数据集的基准协议，用于严格的 ZS-SkAA 评测。
Result: 摘要报告该基线模型在 NTU RGB+D 上取得了较高的零样本准确率，验证了其在 ZS-SkAA 任务上的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者将 ZS-SkAA 确立为面向需要泛化到新动作的真实世界系统的重要研究方向，并提供了基线模型与评测协议作为后续研究基础。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将 ZS-SkAA 确立为面向需要泛化到新动作的真实世界系统的重要研究方向，并提供了基线模型与评测协议作为后续研究基础。

papers.title: AppleScab-LT: A Longitudinal Real-Field Apple Scab Dataset for Temporal Disease Progression Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The development of reliable plant disease monitoring systems is constrained by limited longitudinal datasets capturing disease progression under natural field conditions. Although existing plant disease datasets have advanced image-based recognition, most consist of static images acquired at a single time point, limiting analysis of temporal disease evolution and severity progression. To address this gap, this study presents AppleScab-LT, a longitudinal real-field dataset developed to monitor apple scab progression through repeated observations of individually tracked infected leaves. Guided by a research-question-driven framework, the dataset was systematically developed, validated, and characterized for reliable longitudinal disease analysis. AppleScab-LT was constructed through systematic orchard monitoring under natural environmental conditions, incorporating longitudinal leaf tracking, expert-guided disease verification, polygon-based annotation, leaf isolation, disease severity quantification, and temporal sequence construction. A comprehensive quality assurance framework, including standardized annotation protocols, expert validation, automated integrity checks, sequence-level verification, and temporal consistency analysis, was applied throughout curation. The dataset contains 21 longitudinal leaf sequences, 2,101 high-resolution images, and 264 progressive temporal samples from repeated monitoring of same infected leaves. It captures variability in severity accumulation, progression rates, monitoring duration, and inter-leaf progression. Quantitative disease descriptors based on pixel severity, color-intensity severity, and normalized relative severity provide standardized measurements for temporal disease analysis. AppleScab-LT provides a reliable resource for temporal disease intelligence, disease progression modelling, precision agriculture, and future crop health monitoring
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AppleScab-LT，一个纵向真实田间苹果黑星病数据集，用于时间维度上的病害进展分析。数据集通过重复观测同一被感染叶片构建，包含 21 条纵向叶片序列、2,101 幅高分辨率图像和 264 个渐进时间样本，并提供基于像素严重度、颜色强度严重度和归一化相对严重度的定量描述符。摘要将其定位为时序病害智能、病害进展建模和精准农业的资源。
Motivation: 现有植物病害数据集大多是单时间点采集的静态图像，难以支持时序病害演化与严重度进展分析，缺乏自然田间条件下的纵向数据。
Method: 遵循研究问题驱动的框架，通过系统化果园监测、叶片纵向追踪、专家验证、多边形标注、叶片分离、病害严重度量化与时间序列构建来建立数据集，并应用标准化标注协议、专家验证、自动完整性检查、序列级验证和时间一致性分析等质量保证流程。
Result: 数据集包含 21 条纵向叶片序列、2,101 幅高分辨率图像和 264 个渐进时间样本，覆盖严重度累积、进展速率、监测时长和叶片间进展的变异性，并提供三类定量严重度描述符作为标准化测量。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 AppleScab-LT 为时序病害智能、病害进展建模、精准农业和未来作物健康监测提供可靠资源；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: AutoSchema: Live Schema Grounding for Agentic Text-to-Sparql over Heterogeneous Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Life science knowledge graphs make large collections of structured data available through SPARQL, but each resource uses its own schema, identifiers, and links. TogoMCP helps language model agents query these resources by providing curated Metadata Interoperability Exchange files. Creating and maintaining these files still requires language model assisted drafting, validation, and manual review. We study \emph{live schema grounding}, where an agent obtains the schema evidence needed for a question directly from the current endpoints. We present \textsc{autoschema}, a general framework for live schema grounding that requires no training. It inspects live schemas, maps entity names in a question to graph identifiers, explores relation paths, and finds possible connections between resources during iterative query construction. We use TogoMCP as our main comparison framework. We evaluate \textsc{autoschema} on Resource Focused Biomedical KGQA, Multi Resource Biomedical KGQA, Longitudinal Biomedical Semantic QA over BioASQ Task B, and Chemistry Knowledge Graph Transfer to a previously undocumented RDF graph. \textsc{autoschema} improves mean factoid accuracy over TogoMCP in the biomedical KGQA tasks and gives consistent gains in the longitudinal BioASQ evaluation. It also reduces iteration budget exhaustion and uses fewer tool calls on average in the core evaluation. The transfer study gives preliminary evidence that live schema grounding can support irregular and previously unseen graphs without first creating a curated schema file.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoSchema，一个无需训练的通用框架，用于智能体在异构知识图谱上进行 Text-to-SPARQL 时的实时 schema grounding（live schema grounding）。它通过检查端点实时 schema、将问题中的实体名映射到图标识符、探索关系路径并在迭代查询构造中寻找资源间连接，来获取问题所需的 schema 证据。在以 TogoMCP 为主要对比框架的生物医学 KGQA、纵向 BioASQ 及化学知识图谱迁移任务上，AutoSchema 提升了平均事实性准确率，并减少了迭代预算耗尽和工具调用次数。
Motivation: 生命科学知识图谱通过 SPARQL 提供大规模结构化数据，但各资源使用不同的 schema、标识符和链接。TogoMCP 依赖语言模型辅助起草、校验和人工审查来创建并维护 curated 的 Metadata Interoperability Exchange 文件，成本较高。作者研究 live schema grounding，即让智能体直接从当前端点获取回答问题所需的 schema 证据。
Method: 提出 AutoSchema 框架，无需训练即可工作：它检查实时 schema，将问题中的实体名映射到图标识符，探索关系路径，并在迭代查询构造过程中寻找资源之间可能的连接。
Result: 在 Resource Focused Biomedical KGQA、Multi Resource Biomedical KGQA、Longitudinal Biomedical Semantic QA（BioASQ Task B）和化学知识图谱迁移到先前未记录 RDF 图谱的任务中，AutoSchema 相比 TogoMCP 提升了平均 factoid 准确率，在纵向 BioASQ 评估中获得一致增益，同时平均工具调用次数更少、迭代预算耗尽情况减少。迁移研究初步表明，无需预先创建 curated schema 文件即可支持不规则和未见过的图谱。
Conclusion: 作者认为 live schema grounding 可以支持不规则和先前未见过的图谱，而无需事先构建策划好的 schema 文件；AutoSchema 是一个无需训练的通用框架，但摘要中未讨论其局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Attributing Preprocessing Invariance in Spectral Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Preprocessing invariance is an appealing goal for spectral foundation models: a frozen model should remain useful when laboratories preprocess spectra differently. It is usually measured by training a classifier under one preprocessing pipeline and testing it under another, with preserved accuracy read as evidence of learning. We revisit that reading, using a Raman foundation model as a case study. Such models normalize their inputs before any learned parameter is applied. If that normalization maps two differently preprocessed spectra to the same vector, the encoder receives identical inputs, so the invariance cannot be attributed to learning. For a normalization that uses each spectrum's own statistics, this happens exactly when one spectrum is a positive multiple of the other plus a constant. Several standard preprocessing operations take that form. The encoder should therefore be measured against the normalization alone, which has no learned parameters. On six Raman evaluation datasets, the model does not measurably outperform its own normalization. It improves on raw spectra, but so does the normalization alone. Training does improve the encoder over random initialization, and a controlled experiment shows that it learns to ignore a transformation only when that transformation reaches it. A numerical test settles which transformations a given normalization removes. Across released systems in five modalities, most normalizations already remove transformations of that form, and several of those systems claim that invariance as learned. Replicating the comparison on two of them shows no gain either.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视谱域基础模型（spectral foundation models）中的预处理不变性（preprocessing invariance），以拉曼光谱基础模型为案例。作者指出，若模型在可学习参数之前先做归一化，且该归一化能把不同预处理后的谱映射到同一向量，则所谓的“不变性”不能归因于学习。在六个拉曼评估数据集上，该模型并未显著优于其自身的归一化方法；它能改进原始谱，但单独使用归一化同样能做到。训练确实让编码器优于随机初始化，受控实验表明模型只有当变换到达编码器时才会学会忽略它。对五个模态的已发布系统进行统计后发现，多数归一化已经移除了该类变换，而其中若干系统却声称这种不变性是学来的；在其中一个系统上复现比较也未看到增益。
Motivation: 现有做法通常用“一种预处理下训练、另一种预处理下测试”的分类准确率来衡量预处理不变性，并将保住的准确率视为学习到的证据。作者认为这种归因可能有误，因为归一化发生在任何可学习参数之前，可能已经把不同预处理的差异消除。
Method: 论文提出用仅含归一化（无学习参数）的对照来衡量编码器，并给出一个数值测试来判断给定归一化会移除哪些变换。作者理论刻画了基于谱自身统计量的归一化：当且仅当一个谱是另一个谱的正倍数加常数时，两个不同预处理谱会被映射到同一向量。
Result: 在六个拉曼评估数据集上，模型没有可测量的优于归一化本身的表现；对原始谱的改进可由归一化单独实现。对五个模态的已发布系统统计显示，大多数归一化已经移除该类变换，且在两个系统上的复现比较没有增益。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在谱域基础模型中评估预处理不变性时，应把归一化本身作为基线；部分声称由学习获得的不变性实际上可能归因于固定、无参数的归一化步骤。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: RankT2I: A Submodular Framework for Discovering Interpretable and Diverse Semantics in Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) models have revolutionized the field of image generation and editing. However, identifying semantics that a T2I model can successfully edit in an image continues to be a challenging task. Most existing approaches require users to manually specify semantics to modify a particular image, a time-consuming process that often involves extensive trial and error. In this paper, we present RankT2I, a novel, training-free, and model-agnostic framework that automates the discovery of editable semantics in diffusion and FLUX-based models. Given a visual domain, we first utilize a multimodal vision-language model to gather a broad set of candidate semantics. We then frame semantic discovery as a set selection problem and use a submodular objective to identify semantics that are relevant, editable, and diverse. Our method helps users efficiently identify a wide range of semantics for text-to-image editing models across several domains while outperforming existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RankT2I 是一个无需训练、模型无关的框架，用于自动发现文本到图像 (T2I) 模型可编辑的语义。给定视觉域，它先用多模态视觉语言模型收集候选语义，再将其建模为集合选择问题，通过子模目标 (submodular objective) 选出相关、可编辑且多样的语义。摘要称该方法在多个域上优于现有方法，适用于扩散和 FLUX 类模型。
Motivation: 现有 T2I 编辑方法需要用户手动指定要修改的语义，耗时且常需大量试错；自动发现模型可编辑语义的问题尚未得到很好解决。
Method: 采用两阶段流程：先使用多模态视觉语言模型为给定视觉域生成广泛的候选语义集合，再将语义发现转化为集合选择问题，利用子模目标函数同时优化相关性、可编辑性和多样性。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在多个领域上优于现有方法，能够帮助用户高效识别广泛的 T2I 编辑语义。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种训练免费、模型无关的自动语义发现途径，但摘要未明确讨论局限性或计算开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Extending Occam's inversion with lasso fusion, overcomplete dictionaries, and isotropic total variation regularisation
papers.abstract_en: Occam's inversion is a robust algorithm to perform nonlinear geophysical inversion. It provides the smoothest model within observation noise, thereby discouraging geological overinterpretation. While Occam originally penalised l2 model roughness, l1 can be used to provide models that are visually sharp. However, l1 regularised geophysical inversion has diverged from the larger body of statistics and imaging literature. For example, l1 regularisation with a difference operator (i.e., total variation) in multiple dimensions has two distinct forms, only one of which is invariant to edge orientation -- a distinction often overlooked in geophysics. In one dimension this reduces to the fused lasso problem in statistics. Within the Occam framework, for l2 data norm and l1 model regularisation, we show that lasso fusion through either synthesis or analysis leads to the same 1D problem. We extend the framework to multiple dimensions and to operators such as wavelet transforms in a dictionary, unravelling the mathematics behind three commonly used solvers for l1 regularised problems. These are coordinate descent, iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS), and split Bregman. We use them to solve a sequence of problems that are linear (1D regression, 2D deblurring) and nonlinear (1D airborne transient electromagnetics) including a field data example. We recommend coordinate descent for 1D problems, and IRLS over split Bregman for 2D problems, with IRLS requiring up to an order of magnitude fewer least squares solves. We hope this work will further encourage geophysicists to adopt l1 regularised inversion, by presenting its various forms as a familiar Occam's inversion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Occam反演框架下讨论l1范数正则化，证明在l2数据范数和l1模型正则化下，通过合成(synthesis)或分析(analysis)途径的lasso融合在1D中归结为同一问题，并将框架扩展到多维和过完备字典（如小波变换）算子。作者梳理了坐标下降、迭代重加权最小二乘(IRLS)和分裂Bregman三种求解器的数学联系，并在线性和非线性地球物理反演问题（含野外数据）上比较其表现。
Motivation: 地球物理中的l1正则化反演与统计学和成像文献脱节，例如多维全变差存在两种形式，其中只有一种对边缘方向不变，这一区别常被忽略。作者希望将l1正则化的各种形式统一呈现为熟悉的Occam反演，推动地球物理学家采用该类方法。
Method: 在Occam框架内，针对l2数据范数和l1模型正则化，证明lasso融合的合成途径与分析途径在1D等价；扩展到多维和过完备字典算子，并解析坐标下降、IRLS和分裂Bregman三种常用求解器的数学结构，用于求解线性问题（1D回归、2D去模糊）和非线性问题（1D航空瞬变电磁）。
Result: 摘要推荐1D问题使用坐标下降，2D问题使用IRLS而非分裂Bregman，且IRLS所需的最小二乘求解次数可少一个数量级；方法在含野外数据的非线性反演任务上得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者希望通过把l1正则化反演表述为Occam反演的推广，鼓励地球物理界更广泛采用该类方法；主要贡献是统一多种l1形式与求解器，并给出分维度的求解器选择建议。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge Retrieval and Verification-Guided Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Autoformalization is commonly framed as translating natural-language mathematical statements into machine-verifiable formal languages such as Lean 4. However, faithful formalization requires more than translation. Models must map mathematical concepts to the complex hierarchy of types and definitions in formal libraries such as Mathlib, while ensuring that generated statements preserve the meaning of the source propositions. Existing approaches struggle because they rely heavily on the model's parametric memory for library-specific knowledge, while common data construction pipelines often resort to filtering single-pass outputs and lack mechanisms for feedback-driven revision. To address these challenges, we introduce MathForm, an autoformalization framework for constructing verified training data through Mathlib knowledge retrieval and verification-guided iterative refinement. Before generation, a retrieval planner gathers relevant definitions and existing formalizations from Mathlib to guide the formalization generator. Generated statements are then revised using compiler diagnostics and semantic-consistency feedback. Using this framework, we construct FormalVerse, a Lean 4 dataset containing approximately 367K verified examples across diverse mathematical domains and sources. We then train MathForm-8B through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. Across six benchmarks, MathForm-8B achieves average Pass@8 rates of 88.06% under Syntax Check (SC) and 72.37% under Consistency Check (CC), outperforming multiple specialized 32B autoformalizers. On the challenging FATE-H and FATE-X subsets, it attains CC pass rates of 63% and 37%, exceeding the strongest specialized baselines in both cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MathForm，一个通过 Mathlib 知识检索与验证引导的迭代精化来构造可验证训练数据的自动形式化 (autoformalization) 框架。该框架生成了包含约 367K 个 Lean 4 已验证样本的 FormalVerse 数据集，并训练出 MathForm-8B 模型（监督微调加强化学习）。在六个基准上，MathForm-8B 在 Syntax Check (SC) 下的平均 Pass@8 为 88.06%，在 Consistency Check (CC) 下为 72.37%，超过了多个专门的 32B 自动形式化器。在更具挑战性的 FATE-H 和 FATE-X 子集上，其 CC 通过率分别达到 63% 和 37%，均优于最强的专门基线。
Motivation: 现有自动形式化方法主要依赖模型参数记忆库中的领域知识，而常见的数据构造管道往往只是过滤单次生成结果，缺乏基于反馈的迭代修订机制，导致形式化结果难以保持原命题的语义并正确映射到 Mathlib 的类型和定义层级。
Method: 提出 MathForm 框架：在生成前由一个检索规划器 (retrieval planner) 从 Mathlib 中收集相关定义和已有形式化来引导形式化生成器；生成后的语句使用编译器诊断信息和语义一致性反馈进行修订；最后用监督微调 (supervised fine-tuning) 加强化学习 (reinforcement learning) 训练得到 MathForm-8B。
Result: 在六个基准上，MathForm-8B 的平均 Pass@8 在 Syntax Check (SC) 下为 88.06%，在 Consistency Check (CC) 下为 72.37%，优于多个专门的 32B 自动形式化器；在 FATE-H 和 FATE-X 子集上 CC 通过率分别为 63% 和 37%，均超过最强专门基线。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过 Mathlib 知识检索和验证引导的迭代精化，可以大规模构造高质量已验证的自动形式化训练数据，并显著提升模型在多样数学领域上的形式化准确性与语义一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Generalized Parallelogram Rule for Proportional Analogies on Riemannian Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Analogies are quaternary relations of the form "a is to b as c is to d", usually denoted a : b :: c : d. This notion is formalized in particular with the notion of proportional analogy, which imposes some constraints on the valid analogies. Whereas proportional analogies have been studied mostly in symbolic domains and in vector spaces, their use is limited in non-Euclidean spaces. In this paper, we introduce a proportional analogy relation in Riemannian domains, extending the parallelogram rule used for arithmetic analogies in Euclidean spaces. We illustrate the introduced analogy on various manifolds, such as the sphere, shape spaces and manifolds of probability distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究黎曼流形上的比例类比 (proportional analogy)，将欧氏空间中算术类比所用的平行四边形法则 (parallelogram rule) 推广到黎曼域。作者在球面、形状空间 (shape spaces) 以及概率分布流形等流形上展示了所提出的类比关系。该工作把类比的建模从符号域和向量空间扩展到非欧氏几何空间。
Motivation: 比例类比此前主要在符号域和向量空间中研究，在非欧氏空间中的应用受限；作者希望将这类四元关系扩展到黎曼流形，以支持更广泛的几何表示。
Method: 在黎曼域中引入一种比例类比关系，通过推广欧氏空间中用于算术类比的平行四边形法则来定义有效的 a : b :: c : d 结构，并适配流形上的几何约束。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，仅在球面、形状空间和概率分布流形等多种流形上对所引入的类比关系进行了展示和说明。
Conclusion: 作者提出并展示了黎曼流形上比例类比的形式化方法，表明平行四边形法则可被推广到非欧氏空间；摘要未讨论明显局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Connected Subspace Clustering: Hardness, a Scalable Heuristic, and an Application to Sea Level Geodesy
papers.abstract_en: Constrained optimization extends classical optimization by integrating side information, making it widely applicable across scientific and engineering domains. Consider a setting where we measure variables at different physical locations. When grouping these measurements, we often want clusters that are both internally similar and physically coherent. Thus, we have a constrained clustering problem where the constraint models coherence. Motivated by an application in geodesy, where contiguous regions of the sea surface must be identified for principal component analysis, we introduce the Connected Subspace Clustering problem: given high-dimensional points and a connectivity graph, partition them into $k$ connected clusters, minimizing their total squared distance to the clusters' best-fit $m'$-dimensional affine subspaces. We prove that, even for $m' = 0$ and a grid graph with holes, the problem is NP-hard to approximate within $Ω(n^{1/2-\varepsilon})$ for every $\varepsilon>0$, where $n$ is the number of measurements. We then introduce an efficient Lloyd-style heuristic that alternates subspace fitting with an iterative merging procedure to enforce connectivity. Our method returns exactly $k$ connected regions by construction, whereas unconstrained methods leave up to $1{,}966$ disconnected fragments at higher cost. In a study of 160 configurations on global sea level time series, our merging-based repair is the strongest of four strategies in $73.75\%$ of cases, and consistently outperforms competitors such as (connected) Ward's method across all tested cluster counts. The resulting regions isolate signals aligning with climate indices such as the El Nino-Southern Oscillation and Indian Ocean Dipole. Although developed for geodesy, the approach applies to other spatially embedded multivariate time series, such as climate fields, remote sensing, neuroimaging, and sensor networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出连通子空间聚类问题 (Connected Subspace Clustering)：给定高维测量点和连通图，将测量划分为恰好 k 个连通簇，使各簇到其最佳拟合 m' 维仿射子空间的总平方距离最小。作者证明该问题即使在 m'=0、网格图含洞的情形下也难以近似，并给出一个 Lloyd 风格启发式算法；在全球海平面时间序列上，该方法按构造返回恰好 k 个连通区域，而无约束方法会留下大量碎片。
Motivation: 在地球物理学应用中，海平面测量需要按物理连续的区域分组以进行主成分分析；普通无约束聚类会产生过多不连通的碎片，因此需要把空间连通性作为硬约束纳入聚类。
Method: 先证明问题的 NP-hard 近似下界（对网格图含洞情形，近似比下界为 Ω(n^{1/2−ε})），再提出一个 Lloyd 式启发式：交替进行子空间拟合 (subspace fitting) 并通过迭代合并过程强制连通性，从而按构造返回恰好 k 个连通区域。
Result: 在 160 个全球海平面时间序列配置中，该基于合并的修复策略在 73.75% 的情况下优于四种策略中的其他方案，并在所有测试簇数上一致超过 (connected) Ward 方法；相比无约束方法可留下多达 1,966 个碎片，本方法返回恰好 k 个连通区域且成本更低。所得区域隔离出的信号与厄尔尼诺-南方涛动 (ENSO) 和印度洋偶极子 (IOD) 等气候指数对齐。
Conclusion: 作者指出，尽管该方法是针对大地测量学 (geodesy) 开发的，它同样适用于其他空间嵌入的多变量时间序列，例如气候场、遥感、神经影像和传感器网络。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: APTER: Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics
papers.abstract_en: As large language models enter professional domains, they must satisfy domain constraints, include critical evidence, and provide complete reasoning rather than merely produce fluent responses. Existing post-training methods often rely on holistic preferences or outcome-level verification, while recent rubric-based methods usually generate rubrics independently for each query. In specialized domains, such unconstrained rubrics may omit critical requirements and vary across samples, hindering the diagnosis and targeted repair of persistent capability deficiencies. We propose APTER (Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics), a framework that integrates structured domain knowledge into fine-grained evaluation, optimization, and diagnosis for specialized complex reasoning. First, expert-grounded rubric construction starts from an expert criteria framework built by domain experts, where each criterion represents a stable professional capability. For each query, APTER selects relevant criteria and instantiates them into query-level rubrics linked to their source criteria, turning reusable expert criteria into executable query-level supervision without reference answers. Second, adaptive post-training uses rubric verdicts as both optimization and criterion-level diagnostic signals. Aggregating low-scoring verdicts by criterion ID reveals persistent deficiencies and triggers targeted supervised fine-tuning updates during reinforcement learning. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and medical question answering show consistent gains across both domains. Across three model generations, APTER improves the mathematics and medical averages over the corresponding base models by up to 15.86 and 8.04 points, respectively. Code and rubric datasets are available at https://github.com/AntDT-APTER/APTER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 APTER（Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics），一个把结构化领域知识整合进大语言模型后训练（post-training）的框架，面向数学推理和医学问答等专门领域的复杂推理。它由领域专家构建稳定的能力标准框架，为每条查询选取相关标准并实例化为与源标准关联的查询级 rubric，再把 rubric 判定同时用作优化信号和按标准 ID 聚合的诊断信号，在强化学习期间触发针对性的监督微调。摘要报告跨三个模型代际在数学和医学平均分上相对对应基座模型最高提升 15.86 和 8.04 分。
Motivation: 现有后训练方法常依赖整体偏好或结果级验证，而近期的 rubric 方法通常为每个查询独立生成 rubric；在专业领域中这种无约束 rubric 可能遗漏关键要求且跨样本不一致，难以对持续存在的能力缺陷进行诊断和针对性修复。
Method: APTER 首先进行专家接地 rubric 构建：基于领域专家给出的标准框架，每个标准代表一种稳定的专业能力；对每条查询选择相关标准并实例化为查询级 rubric 并链接回源标准，从而在无参考答案情况下把可复用专家标准转化为可执行的查询级监督。随后进行自适应后训练，用 rubric 判定作为优化信号和标准级诊断信号，按标准 ID 聚合低分判定以揭示持续缺陷，并在强化学习过程中触发针对性的监督微调更新。
Result: 在数学推理和医学问答两个领域的实验均获得一致提升；跨三个模型代际，APTER 相对对应基座模型将数学和医学平均分分别最高提升 15.86 和 8.04 分。代码和 rubric 数据集已公开。
Conclusion: 摘要强调专家接地 rubric 与标准级诊断能把可复用的专家标准转化为无需参考答案的查询级监督，并支持对模型能力缺陷的定位和定向修复；实验范围限于数学与医学领域。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 APTER（Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics），一个把结构化领域知识整合进大语言模型后训练（post-training）的框架，面向数学推理和医学问答等专门领域的复杂推理。它由领域专家构建稳定的能力标准框架，为每条查询选取相关标准并实例化为与源标准关联的查询级 rubric，再把 rubric 判定同时用作优化信号和按标准 ID 聚合的诊断信号，在强化学习期间触发针对性的监督微调。摘要报告跨三个模型代际在数学和医学平均分上相对对应基座模型最高提升 15.86 和 8.04 分。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有后训练方法常依赖整体偏好或结果级验证，而近期的 rubric 方法通常为每个查询独立生成 rubric；在专业领域中这种无约束 rubric 可能遗漏关键要求且跨样本不一致，难以对持续存在的能力缺陷进行诊断和针对性修复。
summary_sections.method: APTER 首先进行专家接地 rubric 构建：基于领域专家给出的标准框架，每个标准代表一种稳定的专业能力；对每条查询选择相关标准并实例化为查询级 rubric 并链接回源标准，从而在无参考答案情况下把可复用专家标准转化为可执行的查询级监督。随后进行自适应后训练，用 rubric 判定作为优化信号和标准级诊断信号，按标准 ID 聚合低分判定以揭示持续缺陷，并在强化学习过程中触发针对性的监督微调更新。
summary_sections.result: 在数学推理和医学问答两个领域的实验均获得一致提升；跨三个模型代际，APTER 相对对应基座模型将数学和医学平均分分别最高提升 15.86 和 8.04 分。代码和 rubric 数据集已公开。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调专家接地 rubric 与标准级诊断能把可复用的专家标准转化为无需参考答案的查询级监督，并支持对模型能力缺陷的定位和定向修复；实验范围限于数学与医学领域。

papers.title: Training Fair Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) have emerged as leading methods for tabular predictive tasks, leveraging in-context learning to predict on new data without task-specific training. Despite the increased use of TFMs in high-stakes decision-making, their fairness properties remain largely unexplored. In this work, we incorporate fairness constraints directly into TFM training, enabling fair predictions in a single forward pass. Our approach addresses two key challenges: limited access to sensitive attributes in training data, and the incompatibility of existing fairness techniques with the in-context learning paradigm. We propose FairTFM, a scalable training strategy based on synthetic fairness tasks and a fairness-aware architecture using a gradient reversal layer, which encourages the model to learn representations invariant to sensitive attributes. Experiments on 132 fairness tasks show consistent improvements in fairness while maintaining competitive accuracy.
papers.comment: Spotlight paper at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FairTFM，把公平性约束直接引入表格基础模型 (Tabular Foundation Models, TFMs) 的训练，使模型在一次前向传播 (forward pass) 中即可给出公平预测。方法针对两个难点：训练数据中敏感属性访问受限，以及现有公平性技术与上下文学习 (in-context learning) 范式不兼容。实验在 132 个公平性任务上显示公平性一致提升，同时保持有竞争力的准确率。
Motivation: TFM 在高风险决策中的使用增多，但其公平性属性尚未被充分研究；现有公平性技术难以直接应用于上下文学习范式，且训练时敏感属性的可用性可能受限。
Method: 提出 FairTFM，一种基于合成公平性任务 (synthetic fairness tasks) 的可扩展训练策略，并采用带梯度反转层 (gradient reversal layer) 的公平性感知架构，鼓励模型学习对敏感属性不变的表征。
Result: 在 132 个公平性任务上的实验显示公平性得到一致提升，同时准确率保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要表明将公平性约束嵌入 TFM 训练可以在一次前向传播中实现公平预测，为该类模型在高风险场景中的使用提供可行路径；但摘要未给出具体数值或数据集名称细节。
