papers.title: How Much Do Legal RAG Systems Still Hallucinate?
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination is a major challenge for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems in the legal domain, where ungrounded answers can lead to serious consequences. To better understand this problem, we conduct a fine-grained analysis of hallucination behavior in eight legal RAG systems across two legal corpora, the GDPR (in English) and a national civil law (in French). Using claim-level and answer-level evaluation, we report on hallucination density and severity, analyze performance across question categories and user personas, and validate our findings on an independent set of 142 legal-expert-authored questions. Our results show that hallucinations remain pervasive, ranging from less than 10% of responses for the best-performing systems to nearly half in the worst case. We further find that false-premise questions, containing incorrect assumptions that must be rejected, produce high hallucination rates on the manually-drafted questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对法律领域的检索增强生成 (RAG) 系统进行了细粒度的幻觉行为分析，覆盖八个系统、两个法律语料库（英文 GDPR 和法文国内民法）以及 142 个法律专家撰写的问题。作者采用 claim 级和 answer 级评估，报告了幻觉密度与严重程度，并考察了问题类别和用户角色对性能的影响。结果表明幻觉仍然普遍存在，最优系统的幻觉响应占比低于 10%，最差系统则接近一半。
Motivation: 幻觉是法律领域 RAG 系统面临的主要挑战，因为无依据的答案可能带来严重后果；现有研究缺少对该问题的细粒度理解。
Method: 对八个法律 RAG 系统在两个法律语料库上进行幻觉行为分析，采用 claim 级与 answer 级评估，度量幻觉密度和严重程度，并分析不同问题类别与用户角色下的表现，同时在独立的 142 个法律专家撰写问题上验证发现。
Result: 幻觉在所有系统中仍然普遍，最优系统不足 10% 的响应存在幻觉，最差系统接近一半；在人工撰写的问题中，包含需被拒绝的错误假设的 false-premise 问题产生了较高的幻觉率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调法律 RAG 系统的幻觉问题依然严重，尤其对于含有错误前提的问题；该发现提示需要更鲁棒的幻觉缓解与前提校验机制。

papers.title: Adaptive Protection for Evolutionary Feature Construction in Symbolic Regression with Application to Credit Classification
papers.abstract_en: Evolutionary feature construction has shown strong promise in symbolic regression by automatically discovering informative transformations of input features that enhance a simple base learner. However, existing approaches often lack explicit mechanisms to preserve important constructed features discovered during evolution, and valuable genetic material can be lost when genetic operators disrupt effective features. This paper introduces an adaptive protection mechanism that leverages feature importance metrics to selectively preserve constructed features during evolution. The mechanism provides stronger protection for more important constructed features while still allowing less important features to be modified and to incorporate useful building blocks from more important features. We evaluate the approach using multiple feature importance calculation methods and demonstrate its robustness across different base learners. Experimental results on 98 regression benchmark datasets show that the proposed mechanism consistently improves solution quality over baseline approaches, and experiments on two credit classification datasets demonstrate that the method also extends effectively to improve search effectiveness beyond symbolic regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对符号回归中的进化特征构造提出一种自适应保护机制，利用特征重要性指标在进化中优先保留更重要的构造特征，同时允许次要特征继续演化并吸收重要特征的构件。在98个回归基准数据集上的实验表明该方法持续提升解质量，在两个信用分类数据集上也验证了其扩展有效性。
Motivation: 现有进化特征构造方法缺少显式机制来保留进化过程中发现的重要构造特征，遗传算子可能破坏有效特征，导致有价值的遗传物质丢失。
Method: 提出基于特征重要性度量的自适应保护机制：对更重要的构造特征施加更强保护，较不重要的特征仍可被修改并整合来自重要特征的构建块；实验中使用多种特征重要性计算方法并在不同基学习器下评估鲁棒性。
Result: 在98个回归基准数据集上，该方法相对基线一致地提升解质量；在两个信用分类数据集上的实验表明其效果可扩展至符号回归之外的搜索任务。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该保护机制在不同特征重要性方法和基学习器下表现稳健，并能推广到信用分类等任务，但未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: MMUSV-Sim: A Perception-Oriented Simulation and Data-Generation Platform for Multi-USV Cooperative Perception
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative perception among multiple unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) combines complementary observations to extend maritime target sensing beyond the view range and field of a single platform. Developing such systems at scale calls for a unified workflow for configurable multi-USV scenarios, multimodal acquisition, and shared annotations. We present MMUSV-Sim, a perception-oriented maritime simulation and data-generation platform built on Unreal Engine 5 and Project AirSim. It provides island, open-sea, and port environments; configurable weather, time of day, and wave conditions; a diverse vessel asset library; and spline-based multi-vessel motion. MMUSV-Sim acquires RGB, depth, semantic, LiDAR, and radar observations across multiple USVs and captures a common world state for per-agent annotation export. Experiments verify that the configured wave settings produce the intended changes in vessel heave, roll, and pitch, and evaluate the geometric consistency between projected annotations and semantic renderings. In LiDAR-based cooperative BEV vessel detection experiments on the generated multi-USV dataset, Early Fusion achieves an AP@0.5 of 72.74, compared with 45.54 using a single USV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMUSV-Sim，一个基于 Unreal Engine 5 和 Project AirSim 的多无人水面艇 (multi-USV) 协同感知仿真与数据生成平台。平台提供岛屿、开放海域和港口环境，支持天气、时段与波浪条件配置，以及样条驱动的多船运动，可采集多 USV 的 RGB、深度、语义、LiDAR 和雷达观测，并基于共享世界状态导出逐智能体标注。实验验证波浪设置能产生预期的船舶升沉、横摇和纵摇变化，并在 LiDAR 协同 BEV 检测中显示 Early Fusion 的 AP@0.5 为 72.74，优于单 USV 的 45.54。
Motivation: 多 USV 协同感知通过融合互补观测可扩展海上目标感知范围，但大规模开发缺少统一的可配置多 USV 场景、多模态采集和共享标注工作流。
Method: 构建基于 Unreal Engine 5 与 Project AirSim 的感知导向仿真平台，包含岛屿/开放海域/港口环境、可配置天气/时段/波浪、多样船只资产库和样条多船运动；支持多 USV 多模态传感器采集，并记录统一世界状态用于逐智能体标注导出。
Result: 实验表明配置的波浪设置能产生预期的船体升沉、横摇和纵摇变化，投影标注与语义渲染之间具有几何一致性；在生成的 multi-USV 数据集上，基于 LiDAR 的协同 BEV 船只检测中 Early Fusion 达到 AP@0.5 72.74，而单 USV 为 45.54。
Conclusion: 摘要将该平台定位为面向多 USV 协同感知的仿真与数据生成工具，能够生成带共享标注的多模态数据以支撑协同感知研究；摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: FreeBalance: Pre-Routing Online Moe Load Balancing via Residual Workload Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Load imbalance poses a major bottleneck to the efficiency of expert parallelism in distributed inference of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The most heavily loaded rank stalls global execution due to skewed routing distributions, directly increasing latency. While offline expert placement can alleviate persistent imbalance, practical multi-task serving workloads exhibit layer- and batch-dependent routing dynamics, making online load balancing indispensable. Existing approaches rely on routing statistics collected after each MoE router, requiring expert weight load or migration to begin only after routing decisions are available, consequently placing migration overhead on the inference critical path. In this work, we observe that online balancing can instead be largely overlapped with computation before target routing (e.g., attention), if routing distributions can be predicted accurately in advance. Therefore, we propose FreeBalance, a lossless online load-balancing framework that overlaps expert migration with preceding computation stages via residual workload prediction. FreeBalance leverages cross-layer similarities in hidden representations within the residual network to build a lightweight workload predictor. This enables proactive expert migration planning before routing decisions are available, creating substantial overlap between weight transfer and computation-heavy pre-routing stages. Furthermore, a cost model constrains the number of swaps to fully hide the synchronization overhead within the available window. Experiments across models and datasets show that FreeBalance reduces the max-to-mean rank load ratio by 32.8% and end-to-end prefill latency by 13.1%. Specifically, our method hides balancing overhead of an average of 5.1 experts per layer, which would otherwise account for about 8.5% of the critical-path latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FreeBalance，一个针对 MoE 模型分布式推理中专家并行负载不均衡的无损在线负载均衡框架。核心想法是在路由决策可用之前，利用残差网络中隐藏表示的跨层相似性预测路由分布，从而将专家迁移与前面的计算阶段（如注意力）重叠，避免迁移开销落在推理关键路径上。实验显示在多个模型和数据集上，max-to-mean rank 负载比降低 32.8%，端到端 prefill 延迟降低 13.1%，并隐藏了平均每层 5.1 个专家的均衡开销。
Motivation: 现有在线负载均衡依赖每个 MoE 路由之后收集的统计信息，导致专家权重加载或迁移只能在路由决策之后开始，将迁移开销置于推理关键路径；而离线专家放置无法处理多任务服务中与层和 batch 相关的路由动态。因此需要能够在路由前准确预测路由分布并提前规划的在线均衡方法。
Method: 提出 FreeBalance，利用残差网络内隐藏表示的跨层相似性构建轻量级 workload predictor，在路由决策可用之前预测路由分布并进行前瞻性专家迁移规划；同时引入成本模型约束交换次数，以在可用时间窗口内完全隐藏同步开销。
Result: 摘要报告 FreeBalance 将 max-to-mean rank 负载比降低 32.8%，端到端 prefill 延迟降低 13.1%；平均每层隐藏 5.1 个专家的均衡开销，这些开销原本约占关键路径延迟的 8.5%。

papers.title: MINT: A Universal Zero-Shot Predictor for Transaction Data
papers.abstract_en: Banks analyse sequential financial transaction data to perform many tasks, including fraud prevention, credit risk assessment and offer personalization. To improve the predictive accuracy of these tasks, Payments Foundation Models encode transaction sequence data as rich contextual embeddings, which can then be provided to task-specific models as features. However, these Foundation Models are not designed for flexible zero-shot reasoning across novel downstream prediction tasks, limiting their adaptability and utility. Existing LLM-based approaches to zero-shot prediction often fail to fully exploit the predictive signal within transaction data, while relying on costly text serialization or task-specific architectures that scale poorly. To address these limitations, we present the Multimodal Instruction Network for Transactions (MINT), a framework that connects a pretrained transaction sequence encoder to a decoder-only LLM through lightweight embedding injection, transaction-language alignment, and instruction tuning. We find that MINT achieves state-of-the-art predictive question-answering performance in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution questions, while substantially reducing input tokens, latency, and memory consumption compared to text-serialization baselines. Through comprehensive analyses of representations, alignment strategies, training data, and history length, we establish that compact transaction embeddings are a superior approach to transaction representation than text serialization for multimodal reasoning and zero-shot prediction tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MINT (Multimodal Instruction Network for Transactions)，一种将预训练交易序列编码器与 decoder-only LLM 连接的框架，通过轻量嵌入注入、交易-语言对齐和指令调优来实现交易数据的零样本预测。摘要报告 MINT 在分布内和分布外预测问答上达到最先进性能，同时相比文本序列化基线显著减少输入 token、延迟和内存消耗。作者通过表征、对齐策略、训练数据和历史长度分析，认为紧凑交易嵌入优于文本序列化的交易表示。
Motivation: 银行的交易预测任务（如欺诈预防、信用风险评估）依赖序列化交易数据，但现有 Payments Foundation Models 缺乏跨新下游任务的灵活零样本推理；基于 LLM 的方法要么未充分利用交易数据中的预测信号，要么依赖昂贵文本序列化或扩展性差的任务特定架构。
Method: MINT 将预训练交易序列编码器连接到 decoder-only LLM，采用轻量嵌入注入 (embedding injection)、交易-语言对齐 (transaction-language alignment) 和指令调优 (instruction tuning) 三部分，使模型能基于紧凑交易嵌入进行多模态推理和零样本问答。
Result: 摘要称 MINT 在分布内和分布外预测问题上取得最先进的问答性能，并相较文本序列化基线大幅降低输入 token、延迟和内存消耗；综合实验表明紧凑交易嵌入优于文本序列化表示。
Conclusion: 作者认为紧凑的交易嵌入是多模态推理和零样本交易预测任务中优于文本序列化的表示方式，并强调 MINT 框架在效率和适应性上的优势。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: KV Cache Compression Through the Lens of Transform Coding
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache stores information from past tokens and is a major memory bottleneck in long-context inference. Existing quantization methods address this bottleneck by representing the KV cache uniformly with lower-precision data types and designing quantization schemes to minimize reconstruction error in the cache itself, without accounting for how that error propagates through attention mechanisms. We prove that, under a white-noise quantization model, the expected attention-aware distortion decomposes into additive key and value contributions that factor across tokens and channels. Building on transform coding and reverse water-filling, which are classical tools from signal processing and rate-distortion theory, we introduce Attention-Aware Transform Coding (AATC), which allocates bits over a calibration set to minimize attention-aware distortion. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, evaluated across LongBench, RULER, GSM8K, MMLU-Pro, and MATH-500, our method achieves near-lossless accuracy at approximately $5.8\times$ compression, whereas each baseline degrades in at least some settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文推理中 KV cache 的内存瓶颈，提出注意力感知的变换编码方法 AATC。作者证明了在白噪声量化模型下，期望的注意力感知失真可分解为键和值的加性贡献，并借助信号处理中的变换编码与逆水填充（reverse water-filling）在标定集上分配比特。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 上的 LongBench、RULER、GSM8K、MMLU-Pro、MATH-500 评测中，该方法在约 5.8 倍压缩下保持近无损精度，而每个基线都至少在某些设置下退化。
Motivation: KV cache 存储历史 token 的信息，是长上下文推理的主要内存瓶颈。现有量化方法只优化缓存自身的重建误差，没有考虑误差在注意力机制中的传播。
Method: 证明白噪声量化下注意力感知失真可分解为跨 token 与通道的加性键、值贡献；基于变换编码与逆水填充提出 AATC，在标定集上分配比特以最小化注意力感知失真。
Result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 上，跨 LongBench、RULER、GSM8K、MMLU-Pro、MATH-500 五个基准，方法在约 5.8 倍压缩下达到近无损精度，而每个基线至少在某些设置下出现退化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将注意力感知失真纳入比特分配可使 KV cache 在高压缩率下实现近无损推理精度。

papers.title: Revisiting Energy-based Tabular Anomaly Detection: Energy and Reconstruction are Complementary
papers.abstract_en: Tabular anomaly detection is dominated by classical density-proxy methods (Isolation Forest, OCSVM, LOF), reconstruction-based detectors (Autoencoders, VAEs), and modern non-parametric scorers (COPOD, ECOD, Deep SVDD), all of which approximate the inlier distribution only indirectly; explicit energy-based models are largely absent. Motivated by the recent revival of EBMs in deep learning (e.g., Energy-Based Transformers, JEPA), we revisit the classical Deep Boltzmann Machine (DBM) for this task and hypothesize that its mean-field energy combines more effectively with a reconstruction-based score than same-lineage pairs do. We evaluate a two-hidden-layer DBM on two tabular benchmarks spanning distinct domains (UCI Bank Marketing and NSL-KDD) against eight classical and modern baselines across twenty random seeds. The DBM mean-field energy matches the strongest baseline (the Autoencoder) on Bank Marketing and statistically beats it on NSL-KDD, while significantly outperforming the remaining seven on both datasets. When fused with the Autoencoder via rank fusion, the DBM energy yields a statistically significant improvement on both datasets (AUROC=+0.014, p<0.01 on Bank Marketing; +0.002, p<0.001 on NSL-KDD); every non-DBM-derived base model instead fails to improve or significantly degrades the AE-paired ensemble. Our position is that classical EBMs, exemplified by the DBM, deserve a place in the tabular anomaly detection toolbox as a non-redundant complementary view to the reconstruction-based scores that dominate current practice.
papers.comment: This is the author's version of a paper accepted at the 33rd International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视基于能量的表格异常检测，提出经典 Deep Boltzmann Machine (DBM) 的平均场能量可作为重建类评分的互补视图。作者在 UCI Bank Marketing 和 NSL-KDD 两个表格基准上、跨二十个随机种子，与八个经典和现代基线对比，发现 DBM 能量与 Autoencoder 经秩融合 (rank fusion) 后能带来统计显著的 AUROC 提升，而其他非 DBM 派生的基线与 Autoencoder 配对时无法改善甚至显著降低集成性能。
Motivation: 表格异常检测被密度代理方法、重建类检测器和现代非参数评分器主导，这些方法都只能间接近似正常分布，显式基于能量的模型基本缺席；作者希望借助深度学习中 EBM 的复兴，检验经典 DBM 能否提供非冗余的互补视角。
Method: 使用一个两隐层的 DBM，将其平均场能量作为异常评分，并与 Autoencoder 的重建误差通过秩融合 (rank fusion) 结合；在 UCI Bank Marketing 和 NSL-KDD 上对比八个基线的 AUROC。
Result: DBM 平均场能量在 Bank Marketing 上与最强基线 Autoencoder 持平，在 NSL-KDD 上统计显著优于它，并在两个数据集上显著优于其余七个基线；与 Autoencoder 秩融合后在 Bank Marketing 上 AUROC +0.014 (p<0.01)，在 NSL-KDD 上 +0.002 (p<0.001)，而所有非 DBM 派生的基线均无法改善或会显著降低该配对集成。
Conclusion: 作者主张经典 EBM（以 DBM 为代表）应被纳入表格异常检测工具箱，作为对当前主导的重建类评分的一种非冗余互补视图；实验规模限于两个表格基准。

papers.title: Can Language Models Understand mmWave Data? Benchmarking Large Language Models for mmWave Radar-Based Human Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable reasoning and generative capabilities, motivating their use as universal reasoning engines for perception. While modern approaches such as vision-language models (VLMs) have attempted to incorporate reasoning capabilities into visual sensing, the integration of LLMs with the millimeter-wave (mmWave) modality-despite its unique advantages under low light and occlusion-remains largely unexplored. The principal bottlenecks stem from the scarcity of radar language pairs, severe cross-dataset heterogeneity, and the absence of a foundational mmWave encoder. We address this gap through a minimal textualization interface that serializes each mmWave point cloud into concise natural language, allowing off-the-shelf LLMs to operate in a question answering (QA) setting. Building on this, we present mmWave-QA, the first benchmark for language-conditioned mmWave human perception. mmWave-QA aggregates heterogeneous public mmWave datasets and harmonizes them via calibration-aware preprocessing and global taxonomy alignment, while providing natural language QA. Spanning six scenarios and five QA tasks, the benchmark enables standardized evaluation across diverse mmWave hardware and experimental conditions, establishing a foundation for scalable research on mmWave-LLM integration. We further evaluate and analyze LLMs on our mmWave-QA, highlighting their zero-shot reasoning potential for radar perception, as well as their robustness under visual degradation.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) Findings, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 mmWave-QA，首个面向语言条件毫米波雷达人体感知的基准，通过 minimal textualization interface 将 mmWave 点云序列化为简洁自然语言，使 off-the-shelf LLM 能在问答 (QA) 设置下工作。基准聚合异构公共 mmWave 数据集，经校准感知预处理和全局分类对齐，覆盖六个场景和五个 QA 任务。作者对 LLM 在该基准上的评估显示其具备针对雷达感知的零样本推理潜力，并在视觉退化下保持鲁棒性。
Motivation: LLM 已被广泛用作通用推理引擎，但将其与毫米波 (mmWave) 模态集成仍未被探索，尽管该模态在低光照和遮挡条件下有独特优势；主要瓶颈是雷达-语言配对稀缺、跨数据集异质性强以及缺少基础 mmWave 编码器。
Method: 提出一个 minimal textualization interface，将每个 mmWave 点云序列化为简洁自然语言，使现成 LLM 可直接在 QA 设置中运行；并构建 mmWave-QA 基准，聚合异构公共 mmWave 数据集，通过校准感知预处理和全局分类对齐进行统一，同时提供自然语言 QA 标注。
Result: 摘要报告对 LLM 在 mmWave-QA 上的评估，突出其用于雷达感知的零样本推理潜力以及在视觉退化条件下的鲁棒性；基准覆盖六种场景和五个 QA 任务，支持跨不同 mmWave 硬件和实验条件的标准化评测。
Conclusion: 作者认为 mmWave-QA 为可扩展的 mmWave-LLM 集成研究奠定了基础，能够实现跨异构硬件与实验条件的标准化评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LightTeaNet: A Weakly Supervised Lightweight CNN for Multi-Label Tea Leaf Disease Detection and Localization
papers.abstract_en: Tea is known as an important crop in many parts of South and Southeast Asia, yet the production of tea is still hampered by the multiple diseases that decrease the quantity and quality. Traditional methods of inspection, which are manual, are not consistent, labor-intensive, and depend on extensive monitoring. This paper introduces a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) designed for weakly supervised multi-label classification and disease localization in tea leaves called LightTeaNet. LightTeaNet learns directly from image-level labels and employs Class Activation Mapping (CAM) to localize disease-affected regions automatically, unlike conventional object detection models such as YOLO, which require extensive bounding box annotations. For Parameter efficiency, the network integrates Depthwise Separable Convolutions, and for enhanced feature discrimination, it integrates Channel Attention. LightTeaNet has achieved a Precision of 0.9615, a Recall of 0.8772, and an F1-score of 0.9179, while it shows mAP@0.50=0.1810 without any manual annotations, which delivers a competitive localization performance in the experimental results. These results validate the model as an interpretable as well as a resource-efficient framework for intelligent disease monitoring in agriculture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LightTeaNet，一种用于茶叶叶片多标签病害检测与定位的轻量级 CNN。它采用弱监督学习，仅使用图像级标签并通过 Class Activation Mapping (CAM) 自动定位病害区域，从而避免 YOLO 等传统目标检测模型所需的边界框标注。网络集成了深度可分离卷积 (depthwise separable convolutions) 与通道注意力 (channel attention) 以提升参数效率和特征判别力。摘要报告 Precision 0.9615、Recall 0.8772、F1-score 0.9179，并在无人工标注下取得 mAP@0.50=0.1810，验证了其可解释性和资源效率。
Motivation: 茶叶生产受多种病害影响，传统人工检查存在不一致、劳动密集且依赖持续监测的问题，而现有目标检测模型如 YOLO 需要大量边界框标注。因此需要一种不依赖密集标注、资源消耗低的病害检测与定位方案。
Method: 提出一个轻量级 CNN LightTeaNet，直接从图像级标签进行弱监督多标签分类，利用 CAM 自动定位感染区域；通过深度可分离卷积降低参数数量，通过通道注意力增强特征判别能力。
Result: 摘要报告模型达到 Precision 0.9615、Recall 0.8772、F1-score 0.9179，且在无需任何人工标注的情况下 mAP@0.50=0.1810，表现出有竞争力的定位性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为实验结果表明 LightTeaNet 是农业智能病害监测中可解释且资源高效的框架，弱监督定位避免了边界框标注成本。

papers.title: Structure-Guided Spatiotemporal Attention Graph Neural Network for Traffic Flow Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Deep spatiotemporal models integrating graph convolutions and attention mechanisms have demonstrated excellent performance in network-level traffic flow prediction, owing to their exceptional ability to capture complex spatiotemporal dependencies. Despite their predictive success, deployment of such models in safety-critical urban systems remains constrained by their inherent lack of transparency. Existing post-hoc diagnostic methods often struggle with spurious correlations and fail to unveil the intrinsic decision-making mechanisms governing traffic dynamics, resulting in suboptimal interpretability and limited operational trustworthiness. To address these challenges, this paper proposes the Structure-Guided Spatiotemporal Attention Graph Neural Network (SGSAN). Departing from traditional architectures that rely on unconstrained adaptive graphs, SGSAN explicitly learns a static Directed Dependency Graph (DDG) to identify the invariant macroscopic propagation paths of traffic states. We further introduce an InfoNCE-based soft-coupling mechanism that anchors the model's dynamic spatiotemporal attention to this structural prior, offering a mechanistic account of the model's decision-making process while ensuring robust forecasting by aligning attention-based reasoning with identified macroscopic dependencies and preventing over-reliance on ephemeral local noise. Furthermore, a decoupled two-stage optimization framework is developed to resolve the fundamental conflict between structural discovery and predictive error minimization. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that SGSAN achieves state-of-the-art predictive accuracy while providing built-in interpretability that organically aligns with the physical logic of traffic networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构引导的时空注意力图神经网络 SGSAN，用于网络级交通流预测。与依赖无约束自适应图的传统架构不同，SGSAN 显式学习一个静态有向依赖图（Directed Dependency Graph, DDG）以刻画交通状态的不变宏观传播路径，并通过 InfoNCE 软耦合机制将动态时空注意力锚定到该结构先验上。作者还设计了去耦的两阶段优化框架来平衡结构发现与预测误差最小化，并在多个真实数据集上报告了最先进的预测精度和内置可解释性。
Motivation: 深度时空模型在交通流预测上精度高，但缺乏透明度，限制了在安全关键城市系统中的部署；现有事后诊断方法易受虚假相关影响，无法揭示交通动力学的内在决策机制。
Method: 提出 SGSAN，显式学习静态有向依赖图作为结构先验；引入基于 InfoNCE 的软耦合机制，将模型的动态时空注意力与结构先验对齐，避免过度依赖瞬时局部噪声；并采用去耦的两阶段优化框架缓解结构发现与预测误差最小化之间的冲突。
Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，SGSAN 取得了最先进的预测精度，同时提供与交通网络物理逻辑一致的内置可解释性（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将注意力推理与可识别的宏观依赖对齐，可以在保证鲁棒预测的同时获得有机契合交通网络物理逻辑的内置可解释性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Concept Guidance: Precise, Training-Free Latent Control for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models have two major drawbacks that severely limit their practical utility: (1) standard models lack an intrinsic mechanism for continuous, concept-specific guidance (e.g., for precisely controlling how aesthetically pleasing an image looks), and (2) they lack reliability for tasks requiring high local coherence (e.g., generating text or human hands). To tackle these issues, we introduce a novel notion of concept-wise mutual information and find large, concept-dependent differences between individual layers, demonstrating that the generation of specific structures is localized in distinct parts of the network. We exploit this insight by reinforcing the impact of concept-relevant layers in Concept Guidance (CoG), a precise, target-specific guidance method that works for models out-of-the-box without additional training, external models, gradients, or prompt engineering. CoG first quantifies each layer's concept-specific impact and then guides denoising using a weighted combination of predictions generated with concept-relevant layers skipped. We demonstrate performance increases across various targets and popular models like PixArt-alpha, SD3, SD3.5, and FLUX.1-dev. Code is available at https://github.com/CompVis/concept_guidance
papers.comment: Accepted at GCPR 2026 (Oral). 28 pages, includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Concept Guidance (CoG)，一种无需训练、无需外部模型、无需梯度或提示工程（prompt engineering）的文本到图像扩散模型目标引导方法。作者引入概念级互信息（concept-wise mutual information）来量化各层对特定概念（如美学质量）的贡献，发现不同层对具体结构的生成具有强局部性，进而通过跳过概念相关层并用加权组合引导去噪过程。实验在 PixArt-alpha、SD3、SD3.5、FLUX.1-dev 等模型上报告了性能提升。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型缺乏对连续、概念级引导（例如精确控制图像美观程度）的内在机制，且在需要高局部一致性（如生成文字或人手）的任务上可靠性不足。
Method: CoG 先量化每个层对目标概念的特定影响，然后在去噪时使用跳过概念相关层产生的预测的加权组合来引导生成；该方法即插即用，无需额外训练或外部模型。
Result: 摘要报告在多种目标与流行模型（PixArt-alpha、SD3、SD3.5、FLUX.1-dev）上均获得性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调概念相关生成在不同网络层中具有局部性，利用这种局部性可实现对特定属性的精确、训练无关的引导控制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Classical Limits of Spectral Filtering in Quantum Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Spectral filtering has been proposed as a route to regularization in quantum generative models: the quantum Fourier transform exposes the amplitude spectrum of a quantum circuit Born machine, and a diagonal filter suppresses the high frequencies associated with finite-sample noise, an operation whose classical counterpart seemingly requires manipulating an exponentially long amplitude vector. We examine whether this coherent operation produces anything that classical post-processing of samples from the unfiltered model cannot match. Measuring the filter against convolution with a symmetric probability kernel at matched sampling cost, which accounts for the post-selection overhead of attenuation, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the gap between the two to vanish. Magnitude (attenuating) filters obey a dichotomy: at a fixed affordability threshold, the filtered output is either a constant-size Fourier object with an efficient classical sampler, or the passband must widen until no fixed frequency is attenuated and the filter no longer smooths. In neither case does the filter create a quantum-classical separation. Whatever separation survives is inherited from the spectral phase of the input state. Numerical experiments on trained circuit Born machines confirm the classification and show that the deciding phases are invisible to the Born-rule training loss and set by the initialization. Within the diagonal family, pure phase filters remain the only spectral operations exempt from these constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究量子生成模型（如量子电路 Born 机器）中谱滤波（spectral filtering）正则化的经典极限。作者将滤波操作与经典后处理（以对称概率核对样本做卷积）在匹配采样成本下比较，并考虑衰减造成的后选择开销，推导出两者差距消失的充要条件。结果显示幅度（衰减）滤波器要么退化为常数大小的傅里叶对象并存在高效经典采样器，要么通带必须加宽直到不再平滑，因此不产生量子-经典分离。数值实验在训练过的电路 Born 机器上证实了这一分类，并表明决定性的相位对 Born 规则训练损失不可见，而由初始化设置。
Motivation: 谱滤波被提出为量子生成模型的正则化手段：量子傅里叶变换暴露幅度谱，对角滤波器抑制高频有限样本噪声，其经典对应似乎需要操纵指数长的幅度向量，可能暗示量子优势。作者希望检验这种相干操作是否真的产生经典后处理无法匹敌的效果。
Method: 将滤波器与在匹配采样成本下的对称概率核卷积进行对比，计入衰减带来的后选择开销，推导量子滤波与经典后处理之间差距消失的充要条件；并对幅度（衰减）滤波器建立二分法分析，辅以训练过的电路 Born 机器上的数值实验验证。
Result: 幅度滤波器满足二分法：在固定可负担阈值下，滤波输出要么是常数大小的傅里叶对象且有高效经典采样器，要么通带必须加宽到没有固定频率被衰减、滤波器不再平滑；两种情况下都不产生量子-经典分离，残存的分离继承自输入态的谱相位。实验确认该分类，并表明决定性相位对 Born 规则训练损失不可见，由初始化设定。
Conclusion: 在对角滤波族内，纯相位滤波器是唯一不受这些约束的谱操作；任何存留的量子-经典分离都来自输入态的谱相位，而非滤波本身。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BiasTrace: Linking Reasoning Behaviours to Biased Outputs in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: LLMs exhibit social biases that can produce inaccurate and discriminatory inferences, posing risks in high-stakes applications. While prior work has made progress in measuring and mitigating bias, it largely focuses on final outputs of models, with limited understanding of the mechanisms that produce biased outcomes. Recent advances in LLM reasoning offers a new lens for investigating bias, yet the link between reasoning and bias remains poorly understood. Existing approaches focus primarily on final answer correctness or explicitly biased language, overlooking different behaviours in reasoning that can drive biased outcomes. We introduce BiasTrace, an annotation scheme for labelling reasoning behaviours in model-generated traces and linking them to biased outcomes. BiasTrace captures bias-specific behaviours (e.g., unsupported demographic assumptions) as well as general reasoning patterns that may implicitly contribute to bias (e.g. overthinking). We apply BiasTrace to reasoning traces in bias-sensitive contexts, scaled using validated LLM-as-a-judge methods, producing a large annotated dataset. Our analysis shows that biased outputs often stem from subtle reasoning behaviours rather than explicitly biased language, and that reasoning-level annotations improve bias detection. We further show that BiasTrace behaviours can be exploited for inference-time mitigation. These findings underscore the importance of examining a broader range of reasoning patterns to better understand bias in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BiasTrace，一种用于标注 LLM 推理轨迹中推理行为并将其与偏见输出关联的注释方案。作者用 LLM-as-a-judge 方法在偏见敏感场景中规模化标注，生成大型数据集，并发现偏见输出往往来自微妙的推理行为而非显式偏见语言，且推理级标注可改进偏见检测并支持推理时缓解。
Motivation: 现有偏见研究主要关注模型最终输出的正确性或显式偏见语言，对产生偏见结果的推理机制理解有限；推理与偏见之间的联系尚未被系统研究。
Method: 提出 BiasTrace 注释方案，用于标注模型生成轨迹中的推理行为并关联偏见输出，既捕获偏见特定行为（如无依据的人口统计假设），也捕获可能隐含贡献偏见的一般推理模式（如过度思考）；通过经过验证的 LLM-as-a-judge 方法将标注扩展到偏见敏感场景，构建大规模标注数据集。
Result: 分析表明偏见输出往往源于微妙的推理行为而非显式偏见语言；推理级注释能够改进偏见检测；BiasTrace 行为还可用于推理时的偏见缓解。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要检查更广泛的推理模式来理解 LLM 中的偏见，而非仅关注最终答案或显式偏见语言。

papers.title: Removing Temporal Note Redundancy Improves Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Medicine
papers.abstract_en: Mechanical ventilation is a critical life-support intervention, requiring dynamic adjustments to ventilator settings as a patient's condition evolves. While reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising framework for optimizing these sequential decisions, standard approaches rely primarily on structured electronic health record (EHR) data, missing crucial clinical context recorded in free-text notes. Integrating longitudinal clinical notes into RL state spaces is challenging because notes are heavily inflated by temporal redundancy, such as copy-forward text, templating, and repetitive documentation, which dilutes time-local updates and degrades state representation quality. To address this, we propose a redundancy-aware multimodal state representation framework that explicitly removes duplicated note text over time before policy learning. We evaluate two computationally efficient temporal decomposition strategies for removing duplicated note text: (1) an embedding-space decomposition using singular value decomposition on local history subspaces, and (2) an interpretable sentence-level diff operation that filters out previously documented sentences before text encoding. Using real-world ICU data, we demonstrate that state representations constructed by stripping temporal note redundancy significantly outperform both structured-only and raw-note baselines across multiple off-policy evaluation methods (Model-Based Rollouts, Fitted Q-Evaluation, Weighted Importance Sampling, and Weighted Doubly Robust Evaluation). Our findings show that explicitly isolating new clinical information from repeated note text yields higher-quality state representations and directly improves RL performance for clinical decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机械通气中强化学习（RL）状态表示忽略自由文本临床笔记、且笔记因复制转发等造成时间冗余的问题，提出冗余感知的多模态状态表示框架，在策略学习前显式去除随时间重复的笔记文本。作者在真实ICU数据上比较了两种时间分解策略，并报告去除冗余后的状态表示在多种离线评估方法上显著优于仅结构化数据和原始笔记基线。
Motivation: 标准RL方法主要依赖结构化EHR数据，丢失了自由文本笔记中的关键临床背景；而直接将纵向笔记纳入状态空间会被时间冗余（copy-forward、模板化、重复记录）稀释时间局部更新并降低状态表示质量。
Method: 提出冗余感知的多模态状态表示框架，在策略学习前显式去除重复笔记文本，包括两种计算高效的时间分解策略：基于局部历史子空间奇异值分解（SVD）的嵌入空间分解，以及可解释的句子级diff操作，在文本编码前过滤先前已记录的句子。
Result: 在真实ICU数据上，由去除时间笔记冗余构建的状态表示在多种离线策略评估方法（Model-Based Rollouts、Fitted Q-Evaluation、Weighted Importance Sampling、Weighted Doubly Robust Evaluation）上显著优于仅结构化和原始笔记基线。
Conclusion: 明确从重复笔记文本中分离新的临床信息能获得更高质量的状态表示，并直接提升临床决策支持的RL性能。摘要未提及明显局限，但评估场景聚焦于机械通气决策支持。

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning solution for pickup and delivery routing problems with time window and capacity constraints
papers.abstract_en: The task of constructing vehicles optimal routes for pickup and delivery of goods is one of most promising tasks in the context of global urban population growth. Although this kind of problems with small size can be solved by various classical approaches, a fast (or realtime) route optimizer under the constraints of the real world (such as capacity and time windows constraints) for medium-large size problems still remains a highly challenging task. In this work we, for the first time, successfully applied a deep Reinforcing Learning approach (modified JAMPR model) to solve Pickup and Delivery problem with Capacity and Time Window constraints (CPDPTW). We obtained a robust model that gives a fast optimal solution for problems of small and medium size, and gives fast suboptimal solution for problems of larger (> 200) size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带容量和时间窗约束的取送货问题（CPDPTW），首次将深度强化学习方法应用于此类组合优化任务，采用修改后的 JAMPR 模型（即基于注意力机制的构造式求解器）进行求解。摘要报告该模型对中小规模问题可快速给出最优解，对规模大于 200 的问题可快速给出次优解，并称模型具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 随着城市人口增长，取送货车辆路线优化成为重要问题；经典方法只能处理小规模实例，而在真实世界的容量和时间窗约束下，中大规模问题的快速（或实时）路线优化仍很困难。
Method: 采用修改后的 JAMPR 模型，将深度强化学习 (deep reinforcement learning) 用于求解同时包含容量约束 (capacity constraints) 和时间窗约束 (time windows) 的取送货问题 (CPDPTW)。
Result: 摘要称该方法对中小规模问题能得到快速最优解，对规模大于 200 的问题能得到快速次优解，且模型表现稳健。
Conclusion: 作者认为深度强化学习方案可以在真实约束下为不同规模的取送货问题提供快速解，是经典方法之外的有效补充。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Efficient Multimodal and Multilingual Opinion Extraction for STI: A QLoRA-Based Fine-Tuning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have reshaped semantic analysis. Opinion Extraction (OE) for Science and Technology Intelligence (STI) requires concise core opinions from large information streams. Off-the-shelf models struggle to filter noise from these streams and show limited structured-output reliability in zero-shot multilingual and multi-modal settings. To address information overload and extraction defocus, this study proposes a multimodal core-opinion extraction framework in which visual evidence serves as a contextual anchor for textual judgment. Using VideoLLaMA2 (VL2) and VideoLLaMA2.1 (VL2.1) as the base models, we apply Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) fine-tuning on a curated dataset of 2,194 multilingual and multimodal samples. Under the selected Image-Augmented setting, fine-tuned VL2.1 generates structured JSON core-opinion outputs, achieving 64.98% Precision, 42.15% Recall, 51.14% F1-score, and 74.00% sample-level accuracy. Relative to the zero-shot VL2.1 setting, it raises the F1-scores of Spanish and Russian from 4.83% and 0.45% to 46.05% and 51.93%, respectively. The framework further incorporates a Fuzzy Cumulative Prospect Theory-based post-extraction triage module for case-level value assessment, providing a case-level value signal for downstream STI screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向科技情报（STI）的多模态核心观点抽取框架，以视觉证据作为文本判断的上下文锚点，基于 VideoLLaMA2（VL2）与 VideoLLaMA2.1（VL2.1）采用 QLoRA 微调，在 2,194 条多语言多模态样本上训练。在选定的 Image-Augmented 设置下，微调后的 VL2.1 生成结构化 JSON 核心观点输出，达到 64.98% Precision、42.15% Recall、51.14% F1 与 74.00% 样本级准确率，并将西班牙语和俄语的 F1 从零样本的 4.83% 和 0.45% 提升到 46.05% 和 51.93%。框架还包含一个基于模糊累积前景理论（Fuzzy Cumulative Prospect Theory）的抽取后分诊模块，用于案例级价值评估。
Motivation: 现成模型难以从大规模信息流中过滤噪声，在零样本多语言和多模态场景下结构化输出可靠性有限，导致信息过载与抽取失焦；该研究针对科技情报中核心观点抽取的这一缺口提出解决方案。
Method: 以 VideoLLaMA2（VL2）和 VideoLLaMA2.1（VL2.1）为基座模型，在整理的 2,194 条多语言多模态样本上应用量化的低秩适配（QLoRA）微调；框架让视觉证据作为上下文锚点辅助文本判断，并在抽取后引入基于模糊累积前景理论的分诊模块进行案例级价值评估。
Result: 在 Image-Augmented 设置下，微调后的 VL2.1 取得 64.98% Precision、42.15% Recall、51.14% F1 和 74.00% 样本级准确率；相比零样本 VL2.1，西班牙语 F1 从 4.83% 提升到 46.05%，俄语从 0.45% 提升到 51.93%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调视觉证据锚定与 QLoRA 微调结合能显著改善多语言多模态场景下的核心观点抽取，尤其是低资源语言上的表现，并指出模糊累积前景理论分诊模块可为下游 STI 筛选提供案例级价值信号。

papers.title: QuaSAR: Quantization Compensation via Stable Activation-Aware Rank Truncation
papers.abstract_en: Recent training-free post-training quantization methods restore model accuracy through closed-form residual compensation. To constrain additional model storage overhead, several existing methods gate layer selection by goodness-of-fit, retaining only those layers whose compensation yields a positive residual fit score and discarding the rest. In this paper, we show that, under the low-bit W4A4 setting, this gating mechanism fails to distinguish poorly predictable quantization error from numerical solver failure. Rank-deficient input activations yield severely ill-conditioned or numerically singular Gram matrices, causing the closed-form solver to become unstable and produce spuriously negative fit scores. Consequently, existing goodness-of-fit gates misclassify affected layers as uncompensable and discard them. Many of these discarded layers can nevertheless provide substantial error recovery when their compensation is computed using a numerically stable solver. To address this problem, we propose a parameter-free truncated pseudoinverse solver which removes collapsed directions prior to inversion. On ViT-B with the W4A4 setting, our training-free method achieves 81.42\% top-1 accuracy, outperforming prior post-training methods and fine-tuning-based baselines. Combined with joint low-rank and quantization compression, the proposed method reaches a deployable operating point of 80.26\% accuracy at 54.7 MB, providing a well-balanced trade-off between model size and accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究训练后量化（post-training quantization）中基于拟合优度（goodness-of-fit）门控的层选择机制在低比特 W4A4 设置下的失效问题。作者指出，秩亏的输入激活会导致 Gram 矩阵病态或数值奇异，使闭式补偿求解器不稳定并产生虚假的负拟合分数，从而让现有门控错误地丢弃本可补偿的层。为此提出无需参数的低秩截断伪逆求解器（truncated pseudoinverse solver），在求逆前去除塌缩方向。
Motivation: 现有训练后量化方法通过闭式残差补偿恢复精度，并用拟合优度门控控制存储开销，但低比特 W4A4 下该门控无法区分量化误差预测差与数值求解失败，导致秩亏激活引起的病态问题使可补偿层被误弃。
Method: 提出参数自由的 truncated pseudoinverse solver，移除秩亏激活产生的塌缩方向后再进行求逆，从而为原本不适定的层提供数值稳定的补偿计算。
Result: 在 ViT-B 的 W4A4 设置下，该训练无关方法达到 81.42% 的 top-1 精度，优于先前训练后量化方法和微调基线；结合联合低秩与量化压缩后，达到 80.26% 精度、54.7 MB 模型大小的可部署工作点。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过数值稳定的求解器可以重新利用被现有门控误弃的层来恢复精度，并在模型大小与精度之间取得良好平衡。

papers.title: SCVIB: Editable State-Conditioned Visual Instance Binding forMulti-Turn Personalized Localization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce editable state-conditioned visual instance binding, a multi-turn localization setting in which several support-defined instances are introduced across turns and protocol-defined state events determine the final target. We instantiate this setting as SCVIB, comprising 1,050 manually verified support--query base pairs and 1,500 episodes spanning five visual domains, three difficulty levels, and four target-state dependency groups. Direct Seq-free inference reaches only 60.13\% Joint@0.5, indicating that resolving the final reference does not ensure effective use of the corresponding visual evidence for query-side localization. We address this gap with TT-VG (Transition-Tree Visual Grounding), which combines a Target-State Transition Tree (TSTT) with Visual Evidence Grounding Adaptation (VEGA). TSTT compiles the visible interaction into protocol-defined events, executes them over versioned target states, and resolves the final-query reference to the corresponding support evidence. Adapted on trajectory-derived same-instance pairs, VEGA performs support-conditioned grounding of the resolved instance using a Visual Evidence Package. TT-VG reaches 70.27\% Joint@0.5; under matched target resolution, VEGA exceeds the strongest comparison method by 16.20 points. Gains over direct inference are largest on Counter-Recency and Rollback, which require routing to non-latest or restored support evidence. Together, these results establish SCVIB as a controlled testbed and highlight the effective use of resolved support evidence for query-side same-instance localization as a central challenge in multi-turn personalized localization.

papers.title: CSG-Mamba: A Convolutional Scoring Gating Vision State Space Network for Endoscopic Polyp Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate polyp segmentation is critical for computer-aided colonoscopy, yet endoscopic images often contain low-contrast boundaries, mucosal texture interference, specular highlights, and device-dependent appearance shifts. Vision State Space Models (SSMs) provide efficient long-range modeling with linear complexity, but existing Vision Mamba segmentation models typically convert 2D features into 1D scanning sequences, which may weaken local geometric continuity and over-smooth irregular contours. We propose CSG-Mamba, a convolutional scoring gating Vision State Space network for endoscopic polyp segmentation. Built on a VM-UNet-style asymmetric U-shaped encoder-decoder, CSG-Mamba inserts a Convolutional Scoring Gating (CSG) module at the semantically rich bottleneck. CSG generates a local spatial score map through pointwise and large-kernel depthwise convolutions and recalibrates state-space features by multiplicative gating. Experiments with three random seeds show that CSG-Mamba achieves 0.9220 Dice and 15.87 HD95 on Kvasir-SEG, and 0.7418 Dice and 0.6570 mIoU on CVC-ColonDB, outperforming the baselines on most overlap and recall metrics while maintaining competitive boundary accuracy.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, and 5 tables. Accepted by ICONIP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CSG-Mamba，一种面向内窥镜息肉分割的卷积评分门控视觉状态空间网络。方法基于 VM-UNet 风格的非对称 U 形编码器-解码器，在瓶颈处插入 Convolutional Scoring Gating (CSG) 模块，通过点卷积和大核深度卷积生成局部空间评分图，并以乘法门控重校准状态空间特征。三个随机种子实验显示，CSG-Mamba 在 Kvasir-SEG 上达到 Dice 0.9220、HD95 15.87，在 CVC-ColonDB 上达到 Dice 0.7418、mIoU 0.6570，在多数重叠率和召回率指标上优于基线，同时保持有竞争力的边界精度。
Motivation: 准确的息肉分割对计算机辅助结肠镜检查至关重要，但内镜图像存在低对比边界、黏膜纹理干扰、镜面高光和设备相关外观差异。现有 Vision Mamba 等状态空间模型通常将 2D 特征转换为 1D 扫描序列，可能削弱局部几何连续性并过度平滑不规则轮廓。
Method: 构建 VM-UNet 风格的非对称 U 形编码器-解码器，并在语义信息丰富的瓶颈处插入 CSG 模块。CSG 通过逐点卷积 (pointwise convolution) 和大核深度卷积 (large-kernel depthwise convolution) 生成局部空间评分图，再以乘法门控方式重校准状态空间特征。
Result: 基于三个随机种子的实验表明，CSG-Mamba 在 Kvasir-SEG 上获得 Dice 0.9220 和 HD95 15.87，在 CVC-ColonDB 上获得 Dice 0.7418 和 mIoU 0.6570；在大多数重叠率 (overlap) 和召回率 (recall) 指标上优于基线，并维持有竞争力的边界精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在瓶颈处引入卷积评分门控机制可以有效缓解 1D 扫描序列造成的过度平滑，提升不规则息肉轮廓的分割质量，并在两个内镜数据集上取得优于基线的结果。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Visual on-policy distillation relies heavily on an informative teacher-student asymmetry, through either a larger, stronger teacher or privileged supervision, such as reference answers or ground-truth regions of interest. This raises a fundamental question: where can informative asymmetry come from when nothing privileged is available? We answer this by inverting where the asymmetry comes from. Rather than adding privileged information to the teacher, we subtract information from the student. This asymmetry creates the same effective learning signal for free as a teacher with access to information unavailable to the student, without ground-truth annotations, rewards, or a separate stronger teacher model. Building on this principle, we introduce Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation (S$^2$VOPD), a simple yet effective method that constructs on-policy learning signals from asymmetric augmented views. S$^2$VOPD distills the teacher's distribution conditioned on the original image on-policy into the student distribution conditioned on a strongly augmented view of the same image. We systematically explore a broad design space of visual augmentations and uncover that (1) asymmetry matters: all four augmentation families improve performance, while symmetric self-distillation degrades it; (2) strength matters: performance peaks at a moderate strength; and (3) the gap must remain task-consistent: augmentations that completely remove the question-relevant evidence can induce large but uninformative discrepancies. Across six fine-grained perception benchmarks, S$^2$VOPD improves Qwen3.5-4B from 70.7% to 77.4%, above all open-source models compared, up to Qwen3-VL at 235B, and surpasses GPT-5.4. While holding training data the same, it recovers 96% of the improvement achieved by methods with privileged information. Website is at https://williamium3000.github.io/s2vopd
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation (S^2VOPD)，一种无需任何特权信息（如 ground-truth 标注、奖励或更强的教师模型）的视觉 on-policy 蒸馏方法。其核心思路是反转不对称性的来源：不给教师添加信息，而是对学生的输入做强数据增强，从而把教师基于原图的分布蒸馏到基于增强视图的学生分布上。在六个细粒度感知基准上，该方法将 Qwen3.5-4B 从 70.7% 提升到 77.4%，超过所对比的全部开源模型（直至 235B 的 Qwen3-VL），并超越 GPT-5.4。
Motivation: 现有视觉 on-policy 蒸馏依赖教师-学生之间的信息不对称，通常来自更强的教师或特权监督（如参考答案、ground-truth 区域），但在没有特权信息可用时，这种不对称从何而来是一个根本问题。作者提出反转不对称来源，通过从学生侧减去信息（强增强）而非向教师侧添加信息来产生学习信号。
Method: S^2VOPD 从同一图像构造不对称增强视图，将教师基于原始图像的条件分布 on-policy 地蒸馏到学生基于强增强视图的条件分布中。作者系统探索了视觉增强的设计空间，并总结出三条规律：不对称性至关重要（四类增强族都能提升性能，而对称自蒸馏反而降低性能）、增强强度需适中（中等强度达到峰值）、增强造成的差距必须与任务一致（完全移除问题相关证据的增强会产生大但无信息量的差异）。
Result: 在六个细粒度感知基准上，S^2VOPD 将 Qwen3.5-4B 的准确率从 70.7% 提升到 77.4%，超过所有对比的开源模型（包括 235B 的 Qwen3-VL），并超越 GPT-5.4。在训练数据相同的情况下，该方法恢复了使用特权信息方法所获提升的 96%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过从学生侧减去信息而非向教师侧添加特权信息，可以免费获得与特权教师等效的学习信号。增强的不对称性、强度和任务一致性是该方法有效性的关键；该工作为没有特权监督的视觉 on-policy 蒸馏提供了新途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PISA: A Pseudo-Individual Source-Domain Feature Adaptation Framework for Test-Time Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection test-time adaptation (OVOD-TTA) aims to address the performance degradation that pre-trained base models suffer when encountering image-domain shifts. Existing source-free OVOD-TTA methods rely either on refined test-time information for re-scoring or on pseudo-labels for self-training, leading to significant accuracy degradation when initial predictions are poor. Meanwhile, most conventional source-domain estimation methods recover abstract, sparse representations suitable for the classification task, but fail to capture the dense, concrete features required for detection. To address these issues, we propose PISA, a novel source-free OVOD-TTA method that can be seamlessly integrated into open-vocabulary visual backbones. The core components of our method are the Corruption-Invariant Feature Extractor (CIFE), the Feature Alignment Module (FAM), and a multi-scale alignment framework (BAA). To capture detection-suitable features, we develop CIFE to exploit the invariance of CLIP's visual features across corrupted images, ensuring robustness against various corruptions. We further develop FAM and BAA for the pre-training and adaptation to transform the corruption-invariant features into pseudo-individual source-domain features that are close to the original source-domain features. In this way, dense and concrete pseudo-individual source-domain features are used for supervision instead of unreliable pseudo-label signals. Experiments on the corrupted VOC-C, COCO-C, and LVIS-C benchmarks across three base models demonstrate that PISA substantially improves both the localization precision and the category recognition accuracy of the original models. Notably, PISA achieves state-of-the-art performance without requiring access to source-domain data, surpassing existing methods by 3.92% in AP@50% on COCO-C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PISA，一种无源域（source-free）的开放词汇目标检测测试时适应（OVOD-TTA）方法，可无缝集成到开放词汇视觉骨干网络中。其核心组件包括损坏不变特征提取器（CIFE）、特征对齐模块（FAM）和多尺度对齐框架（BAA），利用CLIP视觉特征对损坏图像的不变性，将损坏不变特征转换为接近原始源域特征的伪个体源域特征，并用这些密集特征而非伪标签进行监督。在VOC-C、COCO-C和LVIS-C基准上的实验表明，PISA显著提升原始模型的定位精度与类别识别准确率，且在COCO-C上AP@50%超出现有方法3.92%。
Motivation: 现有无源域OVOD-TTA方法依赖测试时信息重打分或伪标签自训练，当初始预测较差时精度下降严重；而常规源域估计方法恢复的是分类任务所需的抽象稀疏表示，无法捕获检测所需的密集具体特征。
Method: 提出PISA框架，包含损坏不变特征提取器（Corruption-Invariant Feature Extractor, CIFE）、特征对齐模块（Feature Alignment Module, FAM）和多尺度对齐框架（BAA）。CIFE利用CLIP视觉特征在损坏图像上的不变性来获得鲁棒特征；FAM和BAA用于预训练与适应阶段，将这些特征转换为与原始源域特征接近的伪个体源域特征，从而用密集具体的特征进行监督。
Result: 在损坏的VOC-C、COCO-C和LVIS-C基准上，跨三个基础模型的实验显示PISA显著提升定位精度和类别识别准确率；无需访问源域数据即可达到最优性能，在COCO-C上AP@50%比现有方法高3.92%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，用密集具体的伪个体源域特征替代不可靠的伪标签信号，能有效解决开放词汇目标检测在图像域偏移下的性能退化问题，且不依赖源域数据。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，用密集具体的伪个体源域特征替代不可靠的伪标签信号，能有效解决开放词汇目标检测在图像域偏移下的性能退化问题，且不依赖源域数据。

papers.title: Smart routes: a system for development and comparison of algorithms for solving vehicle routing problems with realistic constraints
papers.abstract_en: The problem of route optimization with realistic constraints is becoming extremely relevant in the face of global urban population growth. While we are aware of approaches that theoretically provide an exact optimal solution, their application becomes challenging as the problem size increases because of exponential complexity. We investigate the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (CVRPTW) and compare solutions obtaining by exact solver SCIP with heuristic algorithms such as LKH, 2-OPT, 3-OPT, the ORTools framework, and the deep learning model JAMPR. We demonstrate that for problem of size 50 deep learning and classical heuristic solutions became close to SCIP exact solution but requires less time. Additionally for problems with size 100, SCIP exact methods around 13 times slower that neural and classical heuristics with the same route cost and on around 50% worse for the first feasible solution on the same time. To conduct experiments, we developed the Smart Routes platform for solving route optimization problems, which includes exact, heuristic, and deep learning models, and facilitates convenient integration of custom algorithms and datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Smart Routes 平台，用于在现实约束下求解并比较车辆路径问题算法，研究对象为带时间窗的容量受限车辆路径问题 (CVRPTW)。作者比较了精确求解器 SCIP、启发式算法 LKH、2-OPT、3-OPT、ORTools 以及深度学习模型 JAMPR，发现规模 50 时深度学习和经典启发式结果接近 SCIP 精确解但耗时更少；规模 100 时 SCIP 比神经与经典启发式慢约 13 倍，且在相同时间下首次可行解质量差约 50%。平台支持便捷集成自定义算法和数据集。
Motivation: 全球城市人口增长使带现实约束的路线优化问题愈发重要，精确方法虽然理论上能给出最优解，但随着问题规模增大面临指数级复杂度，实际应用困难，因此需要系统化的算法比较与集成工具。
Method: 开发 Smart Routes 平台，整合精确求解器、经典启发式算法和深度学习模型，并支持自定义算法与数据集的集成；在该平台上对 CVRPTW 进行多算法实验比较。
Result: 实验显示，在问题规模 50 时，深度学习和经典启发式算法已接近 SCIP 精确解且所需时间更少；在规模 100 时，SCIP 精确方法比神经网络和经典启发式慢约 13 倍，且相同时间限制下首次可行解质量约差 50%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明在较大规模问题上，神经与经典启发式方法在耗时与解质量之间提供了更好的权衡，Smart Routes 平台为此类算法比较和集成提供了可扩展的实验基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPARGen: Unifying Spatial Perception and Reasoning through Native Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Spatial perception and reasoning from visual observations require recovering geometric structure, establishing correspondences, and understanding spatial relations. Existing approaches typically address these capabilities separately using task-specific architectures or external geometric modules, limiting knowledge transfer among complementary representations of the same physical scene. We introduce SPARGen, a unified multimodal framework that casts 3D reconstruction, dense correspondence, and spatial reasoning as instruction-conditioned generation tasks. SPARGen serializes compact structured and linguistic outputs as token sequences while generating dense geometric fields in image-aligned forms, enabling spatial supervision to jointly shape shared representations within a native multimodal generative model. Experiments across benchmarks for 3D reconstruction, correspondence, and spatial reasoning show that SPARGen achieves competitive performance across heterogeneous spatial tasks within a single native multimodal generative framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARGen 提出一个统一的多模态生成框架，将 3D 重建、稠密对应和空间推理统一建模为指令条件化的生成任务。方法把紧凑的结构化与语言输出序列化为 token 序列，同时以图像对齐形式生成稠密几何场，使空间监督能够联合塑造共享表示。实验表明，在多个异构空间任务基准上，该单一原生多模态生成模型取得了有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有方法通常用任务专用架构或外部几何模块分别处理空间感知与推理能力，限制了同一物理场景互补表示之间的知识迁移。
Method: SPARGen 将 3D 重建、稠密对应和空间推理转化为指令条件化生成任务，用 token 序列表示结构化与语言输出，并以图像对齐形式生成稠密几何场，从而在原生多模态生成模型中联合施加空间监督。
Result: 摘要报告在 3D 重建、对应和空间推理的多个基准上，SPARGen 在单一框架内取得了与异构任务竞争的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一的多模态生成式建模可以有效支持多种空间任务，但摘要未明确讨论局限性或失败场景。

papers.title: HiCo-GS: Hierarchical Context Aggregation and Geometric Consistency for Octree Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Octree-based anchor Gaussian Splatting has emerged as a scalable representation for city-scale novel view synthesis, where multi-level anchors adaptively capture scene content from coarse building structures to fine architectural details. However, we identify a fundamental limitation in existing methods: cross-level feature isolation, where each level's anchor features are optimized independently with no inter-level communication, causing color drift on building facades and over-smoothing in textured regions. We present HiCo-GS, a high-fidelity reconstruction framework with two complementary modules. Cross-Level Context Aggregation (CLCA) enables bidirectional hierarchical prior injection by leveraging the octree's spatial containment structure to aggregate per-level context vectors into parent-self-child triplets, fused via a lightweight MLP with residual connection. Coarse-level structural priors flow down to inform fine-level anchors, while fine-level detail statistics feed back to prevent over-smoothing, at negligible computational overhead. Depth-Normal Geometric Consistency (DNGC) regularization enforces agreement between rendered normals and depth-derived normals through an alpha-weighted consistency loss, complemented by edge-aware smoothness losses with progressive warmup that exploit the strong planar priors ubiquitous in urban geometry to suppress floating artifacts. We further introduce the China-Pagoda dataset comprising 8 ancient Chinese pagodas with over 1,200 images each, featuring dense ornamental carvings, curved multi-layer eaves, and repetitive fine-grained textures. Extensive experiments on Mill19, UrbanScene3D, MatrixCity, and China-Pagoda demonstrate that HiCo-GS achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality and substantially cleaner geometry across real-world and synthetic urban benchmarks.Code: https://github.com/WZ-CS/HiCo-GS.
papers.comment: 21 pages, including supplementary material. To appear in the Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiCo-GS，一种面向八叉树锚点高斯溅射 (octree-based anchor Gaussian Splatting) 的高保真重建框架。作者指出现有方法存在跨层级特征隔离问题，并引入跨层级上下文聚合 (CLCA) 与深度-法向几何一致性 (DNGC) 两个互补模块，同时构建了包含 8 座中国古代宝塔的 China-Pagoda 数据集。在 Mill19、UrbanScene3D、MatrixCity 和 China-Pagoda 上的实验表明，该方法取得了领先的渲染质量并生成更干净的几何。
Motivation: 现有基于八叉树的锚点高斯溅射在城市级新视图合成中虽然能自适应地从粗粒度建筑结构到细粒度建筑细节建模，但各层级锚点特征独立优化、缺少层级间通信，导致建筑立面出现颜色漂移、纹理区域过平滑。
Method: CLCA 利用八叉树的空间包含结构，将每层的上下文向量聚合为父-自-子三元组，并通过带残差连接的轻量 MLP 融合，实现粗到细与细到粗的双向层级先验注入；DNGC 通过 alpha 加权的渲染法向与深度推导法向一致性损失，配合渐进式热启动的边缘感知平滑损失，利用城市几何中普遍的平面先验抑制漂浮伪影。
Result: 在 Mill19、UrbanScene3D、MatrixCity 与 China-Pagoda 上的大量实验表明，HiCo-GS 在真实与合成城市场景基准上均达到最先进的渲染质量，并获得明显更干净的几何结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过跨层级上下文聚合与几何一致性约束，可以在可忽略的计算开销下同时改善城市级重建的渲染质量与几何干净度，并公开了代码与 China-Pagoda 数据集。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AgilePE: Autonomous UAV Pursuit-Evasion via Self-Play Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous pursuit-evasion is a fundamental challenge for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), requiring rapid decision-making under tightly coupled dynamics and continuously changing opponent behaviors. Traditional rule-based or differential-game approaches often struggle with high-dimensional aerial interactions and agile maneuvering. We present AgilePE, a complete system for autonomous UAV pursuit-evasion via self-play reinforcement learning. AgilePE integrates agile low-level control, competitive policy optimization, and sim-to-real deployment in a unified framework. The policy directly maps onboard state observations to Collective Thrust and Body Rates (CTBR) commands, enabling end-to-end agile maneuvering without intermediate trajectory planners or waypoint controllers. For training, we use competitive self-play with Prioritized Fictitious Self-Play (PFSP) and a diversified opponent pool, enabling agents to improve against historical policies while stabilizing optimization and reducing policy oscillation. This process leads to the emergence of sophisticated pursuit and evasion strategies. For real-world deployment, we develop a hardware-aligned simulation pipeline that models actuator-response dynamics, communication latency, and domain randomization. The learned policies transfer zero-shot to real quadrotors without task-specific tuning. Real-world experiments reproduce pursuit-evasion tactics observed in simulation, including rapid dodging and flanking, and demonstrate interactive two-agent zero-shot deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgilePE，一个面向无人机自主追逃 (pursuit-evasion) 的完整系统，采用自博弈强化学习 (self-play reinforcement learning) 将敏捷低层控制、竞争性策略优化与 sim-to-real 部署统一起来。策略直接由机载状态观测输出 Collective Thrust and Body Rates (CTBR) 指令，实现端到端敏捷机动。系统使用 Prioritized Fictitious Self-Play (PFSP) 和多样化对手池训练，并通过硬件对齐的仿真管线实现真实四旋翼上的零样本部署。
Motivation: 自主追逃需要在高维空中交互和快速变化的对手行为下做快速决策，而传统基于规则或微分博弈的方法难以应对敏捷机动。
Method: AgilePE 将敏捷低层控制、竞争性策略优化与 sim-to-real 部署统一；训练阶段采用竞争性自博弈，结合 PFSP 和多样化对手池以减少策略振荡；部署阶段构建建模执行器响应、通信延迟和域随机化的硬件对齐仿真管线。
Result: 学习到的策略可零样本迁移到真实四旋翼，无需任务级微调；真实实验复现了仿真中出现的追逃战术，如快速躲避 (rapid dodging) 和侧翼包抄 (flanking)，并展示了双智能体交互式零样本部署。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一的自博弈强化学习框架结合硬件对齐仿真，能够使无人机追逃策略从仿真直接迁移到真实平台并涌现出复杂的追逃行为。

papers.title: Act2Intention: A Benchmark For Developing Active Mobile Agents Through Inferring User Intention from GUI Actions
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI Agents powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promise in human-computer intelligence. However, current research primarily focuses on reactive task execution while lacking a comprehensive understanding-prediction-execution process for user intentions, which are the core requirements of active agents. In this paper, we propose the Act2Intention framework that builds an active mobile agent by integrating understanding, predicting user intentions, and executing decisions. First, we construct the Act2Intention Bench through data collection and validated generation, comprising 72,511 intentions and over 700,000 actions across 52 apps, thereby establishing the first benchmark for evaluating proactive agents via continuous intention-action trajectories. We further develop the Act2Intention Agent, achieving proactive services through Proactive-oriented Intention Understanding, Personalized Proactive Intention Prediction, and Experience-guided Intention Execution. Experimental results show that supervised fine-tuning on Act2Intention Bench yields absolute improvements of +32.0 Acc-S, +10.25 Acc-S, and +6.9 SSR points over non-fine-tuned counterparts under the same agent framework for intention understanding, prediction, and execution, respectively. This success underscores the necessity and value of the Act2Intention Bench, which establishes a standardized platform for developing and evaluating proactive agents and consequently paves the way for research on intention-driven human-computer interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Act2Intention 框架，旨在通过理解、预测用户意图并执行决策来构建主动式移动智能体，而非仅执行被动任务。作者构建了包含 72,511 条意图和超过 700,000 个动作、覆盖 52 个应用的 Act2Intention Bench 基准，并在该基准上开发了 Act2Intention Agent。实验表明，在该基准上做有监督微调后，意图理解、预测和执行分别比未微调基线绝对提升 +32.0 Acc-S、+10.25 Acc-S 和 +6.9 SSR 点。
Motivation: 当前移动 GUI 智能体研究主要聚焦于反应式任务执行，缺乏对用户意图的完整理解-预测-执行过程，而这正是主动式智能体的核心需求。需要一个标准化的基准来支撑意图驱动的主动智能体研究。
Method: 提出 Act2Intention 框架，包含三部分：通过数据收集与验证生成构建 Act2Intention Bench；开发 Act2Intention Agent，具体包括面向主动性的意图理解 (Proactive-oriented Intention Understanding)、个性化主动意图预测 (Personalized Proactive Intention Prediction) 和经验引导的意图执行 (Experience-guided Intention Execution)。
Result: 在 Act2Intention Bench 上进行有监督微调后，同一智能体框架下意图理解、预测和执行的指标分别绝对提升 +32.0 Acc-S、+10.25 Acc-S 和 +6.9 SSR 点。
Conclusion: 实验结果验证了 Act2Intention Bench 的必要性和价值，它为开发和评估主动式智能体提供了标准化平台，并为意图驱动的人机交互研究铺平道路。

papers.title: AlignFace: Human-Aligned Face Similarity Metric with Interpretable Concept Relations
papers.abstract_en: Computer vision models for generated facial content, such as face editing and privacy protection, increasingly affect people, requiring similarity metrics that serve as faithful proxies for human perception. While perceptual evaluation has progressed from signal-based heuristics to representation-based metrics, current approaches are limited to behavioral modeling without cognitive alignment. They rely on implicit and spurious relations while assuming a universal observer, failing to account for inherent variations across diverse human populations. This leads to inaccurate evaluative models of stakeholders and misleading guidance for generative model debugging. Rather than treating perception as a black box, we leverage scientific findings from cognitive psychology of human face similarity perception: dependence on facial featural and configural attributes, nonlinear psychophysical response scaling, and own-group biases. We introduce the FACETS dataset and propose AlignFace, an interpretable, human-aligned, face similarity metric that encodes these cognitive principles through ante-hoc modeling. It employs visual-language modeling (VLM) to encode paired face images and text-based attributes, gated cross-attention (CA) to extract attribute-specific facial difference representations, concept bottleneck modeling (CBM) to constrain reasoning via interpretable face attributes, and neural generalized additive model (GAM) to model their nonlinear influence. Experiments found AlignFace significantly improves alignment with human subpopulation perceptions compared to baseline metrics, including recent domain-free learned perceptual metrics. By bridging learned representations and human cognitive processes, this work enables more transparent and aligned perceptual evaluation metrics for face images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AlignFace，一个可解释、与人类对齐的人脸相似度度量（face similarity metric），通过 ante-hoc 建模编码认知心理学中关于人脸相似性感知的三个原则：特征性与构形属性（featural and configural attributes）、非线性心理物理响应缩放（psychophysical response scaling）以及本群体偏差（own-group biases）。作者引入 FACETS 数据集，并采用视觉-语言建模（VLM）、门控交叉注意力（gated cross-attention）、概念瓶颈建模（CBM）和神经广义加性模型（GAM）来实现该度量。实验表明 AlignFace 相比包括最近无领域学习感知度量在内的基线，显著提升与人类子群体感知的对齐程度。
Motivation: 现有生成人脸内容越来越影响用户，需要能忠实代理人类感知的相似性度量。当前感知评估从信号启发式发展到表示类度量，但只停留在行为建模、缺乏认知对齐，依赖隐式且虚假的关系，并假定通用观察者，忽视不同人群的固有差异，导致对利益相关者评估不准确，并给生成模型调试带来误导。
Method: 提出 AlignFace，一种利用认知心理学发现进行 ante-hoc 建模的可解释度量。它通过 VLM 编码成对人脸图像与文本属性，用门控交叉注意力提取属性特异的人脸差异表示，用概念瓶颈建模约束推理过程，并用神经广义加性模型建模属性的非线性影响；同时引入 FACETS 数据集。
Result: 摘要报告，在实验中对齐人类子群体感知方面，AlignFace 显著优于多种基线度量，包括近年提出的无领域学习感知度量。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过桥接学习表示与人类认知过程，该工作使人脸图像的感知评估度量更加透明且与人类对齐。

papers.title: BGA: A noise-immune neural distillation framework for malicious signature extraction in high-entropy encrypted flows
papers.abstract_en: To mitigate attention dilution in high-entropy TLS 1.3 flows, we propose BGA, a noise-immune neural distillation framework for encrypted threat intelligence.The methodology first employs Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) to decouple high-discriminatory control-plane features - specifically industrial setpoints - from stochastic cryptographic noise. To resolve the extreme class imbalance within a corpus of 86,878 flow records, a Wasserstein GAN with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) module, enforcing the 1-Lipschitz constraint, is integrated to synthesize high-fidelity minority samples, elevating the detection recall of rare Malicious State Command Injections(MSCI) attacks by 43.2%. At its core, the BGA architecture integrates Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) for temporal dependency extraction and an Adaptive Gated Multi-Head Attention mechanism. This gated unit functions as a neural filter to dynamically suppress encryption artifacts while amplifying malicious signatures. Extensive evaluations on CIC-IDS-2018 and Edge-IIoT benchmarks demonstrate a performance ceiling exceeding 95.2% across all key metrics. Furthermore, noise-injection stress tests confirm BGAs superior structural resilience with a 8.57% performance margin over vanilla Transformers, while its ultra-low inference latency of 0.2820 ms (estimated 1.6920 ms via theoretical scaling for ARM) indicates a high potential for real-time feasibility on heterogeneous industrial edge gateways, providing a promising architectural baseline for future hardware implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BGA，一个面向高熵 TLS 1.3 加密流量的抗噪声神经蒸馏框架，用于提取恶意软件签名。方法先用方差分析（ANOVA）将高判别性的控制面特征与随机密码学噪声解耦，再用带梯度惩罚的 WGAN（WGAN-GP）合成少数类样本以缓解类别不平衡，核心架构由 BiLSTM 与自适应门控多头注意力组成。在 CIC-IDS-2018 和 Edge-IIoT 基准上所有关键指标超过 95.2%，推理延迟仅 0.2820 ms，显示其在工业边缘网关上的实时可行性。
Motivation: 高熵 TLS 1.3 流量中加密噪声导致注意力稀释（attention dilution），同时真实网络流量中存在极端类别不平衡，使得罕见恶意攻击（如 MSCI）难以被检测。
Method: 提出 BGA 框架：先用 ANOVA 将工业设定点等高判别性控制面特征从随机密码学噪声中解耦；然后引入强制 1-Lipschitz 约束的 WGAN-GP 模块合成高保真少数类样本；核心网络结合 BiLSTM 提取时序依赖与自适应门控多头注意力，该门控单元作为神经滤波器动态抑制加密伪影并放大恶意签名。
Result: 在 86,878 条流记录上，WGAN-GP 使罕见的恶意状态命令注入（MSCI）检测召回率提升 43.2%；在 CIC-IDS-2018 和 Edge-IIoT 基准上所有关键指标超过 95.2%；噪声注入压力测试显示 BGA 比 vanilla Transformer 有 8.57% 的性能余量；推理延迟为 0.2820 ms（ARM 上理论扩展估计为 1.6920 ms），适合异构工业边缘网关的实时部署。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 BGA 在加密流量恶意签名提取上具备强结构鲁棒性与极低推理延迟，为未来在工业边缘网关上的硬件实现提供了架构基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Traj-LeWM: Path-Aware World-Model Planning via Latent Trajectory Cost
papers.abstract_en: LeWM is a lightweight visual world model that learns latent dynamics end-to-end from pixels and ranks candidate action sequences by the distance between their predicted endpoints and the goal. However, LeWM has two limitations. First, during training, it learns local next-step transitions without evaluating complete trajectories relative to the task goal. Second, during planning, it ranks candidates solely by predicted endpoint distance. Because model predictions may differ from actual execution outcomes, the candidate whose predicted endpoint is closest to the goal may not perform best when executed in the environment. The evolution of the complete predicted trajectory can therefore provide complementary information beyond endpoint distance. To address these limitations, we propose Traj-LeWM, which retains LeWM's local-dynamics objective and endpoint score while introducing a goal-conditioned latent trajectory cost (LTC) that aggregates trajectory-level information as a complementary signal. During training, LTC-based trajectory-preference supervision complements next-step prediction in shaping the shared representation. During planning, LTC is combined with endpoint distance to incorporate intermediate-path information into candidate ranking. With joint endpoint-plus-LTC scoring, Traj-LeWM outperforms LeWM on Push-T, OGBench-Cube, Reacher, and Two-Room by $3$, $14$, $7$, and $7$ percentage points, respectively. Controlled experiments and ablations further verify the complementary roles of trajectory-level representation shaping and path-aware candidate ranking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LeWM 轻量视觉世界模型的两点局限——训练时只学习局部下一步转移、规划时仅按预测终点距离排序——提出 Traj-LeWM，引入目标条件化的隐轨迹代价 (latent trajectory cost, LTC) 作为补充信号。训练时 LTC 提供轨迹级偏好监督，规划时将 LTC 与端点距离联合用于候选动作排序。在 Push-T、OGBench-Cube、Reacher 和 Two-Room 上，Traj-LeWM 分别比 LeWM 高 3、14、7、7 个百分点。
Motivation: LeWM 的训练和规划都只利用局部转移与终点距离，而模型预测可能与实际执行结果不一致，导致预测终点最接近目标的候选在真实环境中未必表现最佳，完整的预测轨迹演化信息未被利用。
Method: 保留 LeWM 的局部动力学目标和端点分数，新增目标条件化的隐轨迹代价 LTC 来聚合轨迹级信息；训练阶段用 LTC 轨迹偏好监督与 next-step 预测共同塑造共享表征，规划阶段将 LTC 与端点距离结合进行候选排序。
Result: 联合端点加 LTC 的评分方式在 Push-T、OGBench-Cube、Reacher、Two-Room 上较 LeWM 分别提升 3、14、7、7 个百分点；受控实验与消融验证了轨迹级表征塑造与路径感知候选排序的互补作用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轨迹级信息可以作为端点距离之外的互补信号改善世界模型规划，并指出实验证据支持两者的互补性。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Production Scheduling in an Industry-Based Coating Scenario Using the Digital Model Playground
papers.abstract_en: Production scheduling in complex manufacturing environments is challenging when sequence-dependent setup times, stochastic disturbances, and due-date constraints must be addressed simultaneously. While reinforcement learning (RL) methods have shown promising results in research, most studies rely on simplified benchmark processes, limiting their industrial relevance. This paper demonstrates the applicability of RL-based scheduling in an industry-inspired coating process that reflects practical complexities such as sequence-dependent setup times, machine breakdowns, and variable utilization. The open-source Digital Model Playground (DMPG), a discrete event simulation framework, is used to model the scenario and to train RL agents. Two standard algorithms, Deep Q-Networks and Proximal Policy Optimization, are benchmarked against conventional dispatching rules to illustrate feasibility and to provide a transparent testbed for further research. Results indicate that RL-based scheduling achieves balanced improvements across key performance indicators, with PPO delivering the most robust performance. The main contribution of this work is to bridge the gap between academic research and industrial practice by validating RL-based scheduling in a realistic, shareable scenario and by providing a reusable open-source framework for future studies.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习（RL）在生产调度中的应用，针对一个贴近工业实际的涂层场景，使用开源离散事件仿真框架 Digital Model Playground (DMPG) 建模并训练智能体。作者将 Deep Q-Networks 和 Proximal Policy Optimization 两种标准算法与常规调度规则（dispatching rules）对比，结果显示 RL 调度在多个关键绩效指标上取得均衡改善，其中 PPO 表现最稳健。主要贡献是提供一个可复现、可共享的工业级测试环境，缩小学术研究与工业实践之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有 RL 调度研究大多依赖简化的基准流程，难以反映顺序相关换模时间（sequence-dependent setup times）、随机扰动和交期约束等实际工业复杂性，导致工业相关性不足。本文目标是通过一个体现此类复杂性的涂层工艺场景，验证 RL 调度的可行性。
Method: 利用开源的 DMPG 离散事件仿真框架构建涂层场景，纳入顺序相关换模时间、机器故障和可变利用率等实际因素；训练 DQN 与 PPO 两种 RL 智能体，并与传统调度规则进行基准对比，提供一个透明的测试平台。
Result: 结果表明，RL 调度在关键绩效指标上实现均衡改进，其中 PPO 展现出最稳健的性能。
Conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是通过在现实且可共享的场景中验证 RL 调度，并提供可复用的开源框架，以弥合学术研究与工业实践之间的差距。

papers.title: Overcoming Shortcut Learning in Graph Neural Networks through Active Explanation Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) can solve prediction tasks by unintentionally exploiting shortcuts---that is, edges, nodes, and features that correlate with but are not causal for the prediction---which compromise their reliability in out-of-distribution tasks. We introduce XIGL, an architecture-agnostic human-in-the-loop strategy for removing such shortcuts from GNNs. Our key insight is twofold. On the one hand, reliance on shortcuts can be detected by inspecting GNN explanations. On the other hand, once made aware of such shortcuts, sufficiently expert users can provide tailored corrective feedback, which helps deconfound the model. XIGL supports any query strategy; however, since corrective feedback can be expensive to acquire, we develop an active learning strategy for prioritizing explanations that are more likely to display shortcut behavior, lowering annotation and cognitive costs. We showcase the effectiveness of XIGL, including both existing and proposed explanation-based strategies, on several GNN architectures. Our implementation is available online.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XIGL，一种与架构无关的 human-in-the-loop 策略，用于消除图神经网络 (GNN) 中的捷径学习 (shortcut learning)。核心洞见是：捷径依赖可以通过检查 GNN 解释来检测，而知情用户一旦识别出捷径，就能提供针对性的纠正反馈以帮助模型去混淆 (deconfound)。XIGL 支持任意查询策略，并提出主动学习策略来优先选择更可能表现出捷径行为的解释，从而降低标注和认知成本。作者在多种 GNN 架构上展示了 XIGL（包括已有和提出的基于解释的策略）的有效性，并开源了实现。
Motivation: GNN 会无意中利用捷径（与预测相关但不具有因果性的边、节点和特征）来完成任务，这会损害模型在分布外 (out-of-distribution) 任务上的可靠性，因此需要一种方法来消除这类捷径。
Method: XIGL 采用 human-in-the-loop 框架：先通过 GNN 解释检测模型对捷径的依赖，再由具备足够专业知识的用户提供定制的纠正反馈；同时设计了一个主动学习策略，用于优先挑选更可能展示捷径行为的解释，以减少昂贵的反馈获取成本。
Result: 摘要未给出量化结果，只报告在多种 GNN 架构上展示了 XIGL 的有效性，说明其兼容已有及新提出的基于解释的查询策略，并提供了在线实现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 XIGL 是一种架构无关的捷径消除策略，借助专家纠正反馈和主动解释选择来提升 GNN 的可靠性；其有效性依赖于用户具备足够的领域专业知识来提供纠正反馈。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Fixed Grids to Moving Particles:A Transferable Latent Operator for Fluid Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Lagrangian modeling is vital to fluid dynamics, as it characterizes particle transport and complements the Eulerian description.However, Lagrangian trajectories are less commonly available than Eulerian fields, while most neural operators are trained and evaluated primarily in the Eulerian representation. This mismatch motivates a new learning problem: can a model trained solely on Eulerian observations generalize zero-shot from Eulerian field prediction to Lagrangian particle rollout, without Lagrangian supervision or task-specific adaptation? To address this problem, we propose the Transferable Latent Operator (TLO), which learns a unified flow representation shared by Eulerian field prediction and Lagrangian particle rollout. TLO decouples latent flow evolution from coordinate-dependent decoding: querying the evolving latent representation at fixed spatial coordinates yields Eulerian fields, whereas querying velocities at particle positions and recursively updating these positions enables Lagrangian rollout. Across five fluid-dynamics benchmarks, TLO consistently outperforms existing neural operators in both Eulerian field prediction and zero-shot Lagrangian rollout, with further gains from limited Lagrangian fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可迁移潜算子 (Transferable Latent Operator, TLO)，解决仅用欧拉 (Eulerian) 观测训练的神经算子能否零样本推广到拉格朗日 (Lagrangian) 粒子推演的问题。TLO 学习一个欧拉场预测与拉格朗日粒子 rollout 共享的潜流表示，将潜流演化与坐标相关的解码解耦：在固定空间坐标查询得到欧拉场，在粒子位置查询速度并递归更新位置则得到拉格朗日 rollout。作者在五个流体动力学基准上验证，称 TLO 在欧拉场预测和零样本拉格朗日 rollout 上均优于现有神经算子，有限拉格朗日微调可进一步提升性能。
Motivation: 拉格朗日建模对流体动力学很重要，但拉格朗日轨迹数据通常不如欧拉场容易获得，而现有神经算子主要在欧拉表示上训练和评估，造成两种表示之间的不匹配。作者希望回答一个学习问题：仅用欧拉观测训练的模型能否在无拉格朗日监督或任务特定适配的情况下，从欧拉场预测零样本推广到拉格朗日粒子 rollout。
Method: 提出 Transferable Latent Operator (TLO)，学习一个统一的流形表示，同时支持欧拉场预测和拉格朗日粒子 rollout。TLO 将潜流演化与坐标相关的解码解耦：在固定空间坐标查询演化中的潜表示得到欧拉场，在粒子位置查询速度并递归更新粒子位置实现拉格朗日 rollout。
Result: 在五个流体动力学基准上，TLO 在欧拉场预测和零样本拉格朗日 rollout 上均一致优于现有神经算子；有限量的拉格朗日微调还能带来进一步增益。
Conclusion: 摘要认为欧拉观测训练的潜表示可以零样本迁移到拉格朗日粒子 rollout，且少量拉格朗日微调可进一步改善性能，展示了跨表示迁移的可行性。
Relevance: 42

papers.title: Learning to Run Power Networks: Effective AlphaZero-inspired Topological Control
papers.abstract_en: As the integration of volatile renewable energy sources increases the strain on modern power grids, the use of Reinforcement Learning (RL) for autonomous topological reconfiguration has emerged as a promising research field to keep strained grids stable and operational. Compared to traditional redispatching measures, topological actions offer a cheaper and more cost-effective way to manage grid congestion. However, their implementation is hindered by a vast combinatorial action space and strict operational constraints. This paper investigates the effectiveness of model-based AlphaZero-inspired approaches that utilize Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for proactive grid management. We systematically evaluate how reward functions, observation density, and search guidance influence an agent's survivability. Our results demonstrate that the optimized AlphaZero approach achieves a peak survivability of 98.43%, significantly outperforming the proximal policy optimization (PPO) variant. We find that conducting the MCTS without guidance from a prior learned policy or value function can enhance training efficiency, and that a straightforward binary survival reward provides more effective search guidance than complex, multi-objective functions. Our findings demonstrate that while AlphaZero is a powerful framework for topological control, pure reinforcement learning is not sufficient; rather, an effective and reliable system requires a 'minimalist' integration of domain-specific heuristics, binary rewards, and a restricted observation space of line loads.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 9 figures. Accepted for publication in ACM SIGENERGY Energy Informatics Review, Volume 6, Issue 3, September 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究受 AlphaZero 启发的模型驱动方法，利用蒙特卡洛树搜索 (MCTS) 对电力网络进行主动拓扑重构以缓解电网拥堵。结果显示优化后的 AlphaZero 方案达到 98.43% 的峰值网络存活率，显著优于近端策略优化 (PPO) 变体；无先验策略或价值函数引导的 MCTS 可提升训练效率，简单二元存活奖励比多目标奖励更能有效引导搜索。
Motivation: 高波动性可再生能源并网加大了对现代电网的压力，拓扑重构相比传统再调度 (redispatching) 更经济，但其巨大的组合动作空间和严格运行约束使其难以落地，需要更有效的强化学习方法。
Method: 提出基于 AlphaZero 思想的模型驱动方法，使用 MCTS 进行主动电网管理，并系统评估奖励函数、观测密度和搜索引导方式对智能体存活能力的影响，同时与 PPO 变体进行对比。
Result: 优化后的 AlphaZero 方案达到 98.43% 的峰值存活率，显著优于 PPO；不带先验策略或价值函数引导的 MCTS 能增强训练效率；简单的二元存活奖励比复杂多目标奖励提供更有效的搜索引导。
Conclusion: 研究指出 AlphaZero 是拓扑控制的有力框架，但纯强化学习并不足够；有效可靠的系统需要结合领域特定启发式、二元奖励以及受限的线路负载观测空间。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fixed-Budget Gaussian Volume Encoding with Structure-Aware Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Scientific simulations often produce scalar volumes faster than they can be stored, transferred, and loaded, while in situ reduction must use only a limited share of simulation resources. This work encodes scalar fields as anisotropic Gaussian primitives under a fixed budget. The complete primitive set is allocated analytically from local field structure, including position, orientation, and shape, then refined directly against the scalar field without densification, pruning, or count changes. The selected budget determines encoded storage before refinement and, together with the iteration schedule, provides a controllable refinement-time budget. In a controlled benchmark, truncation-aware field evaluation reduces encoding time by up to 51x; 1.4 million Gaussians encode a billion-voxel volume in at most four minutes on one desktop GPU, with reduced-iteration refinement completing in under one minute. Across five datasets spanning 2.1 million to 1.1 billion evaluated voxels, compression-useful configurations achieve 15.0-38.7 dB PSNR at compression ratios from 2.2x to over 40,000x. Pre-encoding structure statistics characterize fields for which one-shot allocation yields limited gains from additional capacity. Because primitives retain scalar attributes rather than baked appearance, a single compact model serves every subsequent visualization state - supporting post-hoc transfer-function, colormap, lighting, and viewpoint changes without re-encoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种固定预算下的各向异性高斯原语（anisotropic Gaussian primitives）编码方法，用于压缩科学模拟产生的标量体数据。原语集合从局部场结构中解析分配位置、朝向与形状，并在不加密、不剪枝、不改数量前提下直接对标量场精炼。截断感知的场评估可将编码时间最多降低51倍，1.4M个高斯原语可在单张桌面GPU上约4分钟内编码十亿体素；五个数据集上在2.2倍到超过40000倍压缩比下达到15.0-38.7 dB PSNR，且保留标量属性以支持后续任意可视化状态调整。
Motivation: 科学模拟生成标量体数据的速度常超过存储、传输与加载能力，而in situ缩减只能占用有限模拟资源，因此需要一种在固定预算下可控编码开销、又能保持重建质量的体数据压缩方案。
Method: 将标量场编码为各向异性高斯原语，在固定预算下解析分配完整原语集（位置、朝向、形状），再直接对标量场进行精炼而不改变原语数量。通过截断感知的字段评估（truncation-aware field evaluation）降低编码时间，并让所选预算决定编码存储量、与迭代调度共同控制精炼时间。
Result: 截断感知场评估使编码时间最多降低51倍；1.4M个高斯原语在单张桌面GPU上至多4分钟编码十亿体素，缩减迭代的精炼可在1分钟内完成。跨五个数据集（评估体素从2.1M到1.1B），压缩比2.2倍至超过40000倍，PSNR为15.0-38.7 dB。预编码结构统计还可识别一次性分配场景下额外容量收益有限的字段。
Conclusion: 由于原语保留标量属性而非烘培外观，单一紧凑模型即可服务所有后续可视化状态，支持事后传输函数、颜色映射、光照和视点改变而无需重新编码。
