papers.title: A Graph-Based Reinforcement Learning Framework for Structured Drift Diagnosis and Recovery in Autonomous LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous LLM agents are increasingly deployed in complex real-world workflows, yet they remain vulnerable to runtime behavioral drift, a silent deviation from the original task that can lead to irreversible side effects on external systems. Existing approaches address drift at the prompt level but lack structured mechanisms for step-level detection, risk assessment, and recovery decision. Because the main task-executing agent is often a large and expensive model that cannot be re-trained on every deployment, this work targets a plug-and-play recovery module instead. It introduces a graph-based framework in which a single small language model is trained via reinforcement learning to specialize at each node of a recovery graph, external to the main agent. Each node has a precise role\,: drift classification, operation detection, risk evaluation, or final decision and the model learns to produce structured XML-formatted reasoning adapted to that role. Training combines rule-based structural rewards with an LLM-as-judge semantic-quality signal, so that the model is graded both on how it answers (schema and length) and on what it says. Experiments on the public AppWorld benchmark show that the method generally exploits information about the suspected drift onset to issue correct recovery decisions using a small language model. In addition, the trained small language model reliably respects the prescribed output schema and produces semantically appropriate content in each field according to its assigned node role.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于图结构的强化学习框架，用于自主LLM智能体的运行时行为漂移诊断与恢复。框架在外部维护一个恢复图（recovery graph），用单个小语言模型通过强化学习在每个节点上专门化，节点角色包括漂移分类、操作检测、风险评估和最终决策，模型输出结构化XML格式的推理。训练结合基于规则的structural rewards与LLM-as-judge语义质量信号，同时考核输出schema合规性和语义内容。在AppWorld基准上的实验显示，该方法能利用疑似漂移起始的信息做出正确恢复决策，且小模型可靠遵守输出schema并生成语义恰当的内容。
Motivation: 现有方法在提示层面处理LLM智能体的运行时行为漂移，缺乏逐步检测、风险评估和恢复决策的结构化机制；而主任务执行模型通常过大且昂贵，无法在每次部署时重新训练，因此需要即插即用的恢复模块。
Method: 提出图式框架：单个小语言模型通过强化学习在恢复图的每个节点上专门化，每个节点承担漂移分类、操作检测、风险评估或最终决策等明确角色，并学习产生适配该角色的结构化XML推理。训练奖励由基于规则的structural rewards与LLM-as-judge语义质量信号组成。
Result: 在公开AppWorld基准上，该方法通常能利用疑似漂移起始信息，用小语言模型给出正确的恢复决策；训练后的小模型稳定遵守规定的输出schema，并在各字段产生语义恰当的内容。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架作为主智能体外部即插即用模块的可行性，表明小语言模型可以承担结构化、分步骤的运行时漂移诊断与恢复任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning for Dense Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-intensive retrieval requires text representations to capture not only semantic similarity, but also the reasoning needed to determine relevance under a given retrieval instruction. Existing reasoning-enhanced embedding models improve retrieval by incorporating reasoning information into dense representations, yet their supervision is typically dominated by the final retrieval objective. As a result, latent reasoning trajectories may learn shortcut reasoning patterns that preserve retrieval performance without producing meaningful incremental retrieval gains. We propose Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning (RGLT), a latent reasoning framework for dense retrieval that explicitly connects intermediate latent transitions with retrieval improvements. RGLT performs non-autoregressive reasoning in hidden space through an instruction-conditioned latent reasoning trajectory constructed from silent tokens. It combines process-supervised explicit-to-implicit distillation with retrieval-grounded supervision, using stage-wise CoT reconstruction to shape intermediate latent states and retrieval-effect credit to optimize incremental retrieval gains across the latent reasoning trajectories. Experiments on reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmarks show that RGLT consistently outperforms strong baselines while preserving efficient embedding inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning (RGLT)，一种面向稠密检索 (dense retrieval) 的潜在推理框架，旨在把中间潜在状态转移与检索增益显式关联起来。RGLT 通过隐藏空间中的非自回归推理轨迹，结合过程监督蒸馏与检索效应监督来训练嵌入模型。实验显示该方法在推理密集型检索基准上一致优于强基线，同时保持高效的嵌入推理。
Motivation: 现有增强推理的嵌入模型虽然把推理信息引入稠密表示，但其监督主要由最终检索目标主导，导致潜在推理轨迹可能学习捷径推理模式，在保持检索性能的同时无法产生有意义的增量检索收益。
Method: RGLT 利用静默标记 (silent tokens) 构造指令条件化的潜在推理轨迹，在隐藏空间进行非自回归推理；监督上结合过程监督的显式到隐式蒸馏 (explicit-to-implicit distillation) 与检索效应监督 (retrieval-grounded supervision)，通过逐阶段 CoT 重建塑造中间潜在状态，并用检索效应信用 (retrieval-effect credit) 优化各轨迹段上的增量检索增益。
Result: 在推理密集型检索基准上，RGLT 一致超越强基线，且不需要牺牲嵌入推理效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将潜在推理轨迹与检索改进显式绑定可以避免捷径推理模式，从而带来更有效的推理增强检索；但未给出具体数据集、性能数字或局限性分析。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Forecast Collapse in Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: When forecasting hourly returns for 1,000 US equities, we observe an unexpected phenomenon: predictions become nearly flat and show poor stock ranking, as measured by cross-sectional correlation. We call this forecast collapse. Surprisingly, the phenomenon largely disappears when forecasting trading volume under the same setting. We investigate forecast collapse across time-series foundation models (TSFMs), twelve deep-learning forecasting models, and 97 public benchmark configurations, and find that it is closely tied to target predictability. We identify two distinct reasons behind it: low predictability limits the amplitude of calibrated point forecasts, while per-series objectives leave cross-series structure unidentified. These findings reveal a calibration-ranking tradeoff: optimizing squared error leads to flat predictions, whereas directly optimizing cross-sectional correlation improves ranking but can inflate forecast amplitude by more than an order of magnitude. To address this tradeoff, we introduce CalibRank, a simple objective that balances calibration and ranking. On Finance1K, CalibRank nearly triples cross-sectional correlation while keeping amplitude close to the target, and improves correlation on all tested models. Our results reveal a blind spot in conventional time-series evaluation: per-series metrics can hide failures in cross-series structure needed by downstream decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在预测 1,000 只美股的小时收益率时发现一种意外现象：预测结果几乎平坦，横截面相关性 (cross-sectional correlation) 很低，作者称之为 forecast collapse；而在同一设定下预测交易量时该现象基本消失。作者在时间序列基础模型 (TSFMs)、12 个深度学习预测模型和 97 个公开基准配置上考察了这一现象，发现其与目标可预测性密切相关，并提出两种成因：低可预测性限制了点预测的幅度，而逐序列 (per-series) 目标未能识别跨序列结构。为缓解校准与排序之间的权衡，论文提出 CalibRank 目标，在 Finance1K 上将近乎三倍的横截面相关性，同时保持预测幅度接近目标值。
Motivation: 传统时间序列评估使用逐序列指标，可能掩盖下游决策所需的跨序列结构失效；论文揭示了金融收益率预测中预测平坦化、股票排序能力差的盲点，并指出校准与排序之间存在根本权衡。
Method: 论文先系统分析 forecast collapse 在多种模型与基准中的表现，将其归因于目标可预测性和逐序列训练目标；随后提出 CalibRank，一个在校准 (calibration) 与排序 (ranking) 之间取得平衡的简单目标函数，并直接优化横截面相关性。
Result: 在 Finance1K 上，CalibRank 使横截面相关性几乎提高三倍，同时保持预测幅度接近真实目标，并在所有测试模型上提升了相关性；优化平方误差会导致平坦预测，而直接优化横截面相关性可将预测幅度放大一个数量级以上。
Conclusion: 论文指出常规时间序列评估的盲区：逐序列指标会掩盖跨序列结构上的失败；校准与排序之间的权衡需要通过兼顾两者的目标来缓解，这对需要跨序列排名的下游决策具有直接意义。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Rewrite Once, Validate Anywhere: Producing OWL-Aware SHACL Constraints (Extended Version)
papers.abstract_en: The Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL) is a W3C recommendation to express syntactic constraints, called shapes, on RDF graphs. SHACL validators are used to test whether a given graph adheres to such a shape. However, RDF graphs often come with OWL ontologies, whose implicit knowledge needs to be taken into account. This is classically handled by first applying reasoning and then performing the constraint checking on the results, often using different technologies which makes the process inefficient and vulnerable for mistakes. To overcome this, we propose to internalise the OWL axioms in the SHACL constraints; we construct a rewriting which takes as input both shapes and an OWL EL$^-$ ontology -- a fragment of OWL EL restricting the usage of existential restrictions -- and produces SHACL constraints. This output can then be evaluated by any validator supporting SHACL core regardless of its reasoning support, while yielding the same results as the traditional approach. The implementation of our translation is evaluated both against applying state-of-the-art reasoners and validators consecutively, as against validators with built-in reasoning support. For our benchmark, we show that our approach is in general more efficient in finding violations compared to the sequential approach, thus providing a powerful tool which simplifies combining reasoning with validation.
papers.comment: Technical report of our ISWC'26 paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 RDF 图同时带有 OWL 本体时隐式知识难以被 SHACL 验证的问题，提出重写方案：输入形状（shapes）和 OWL EL^- 本体，输出不依赖推理支持的 SHACL 约束，使任何实现 SHACL core 的验证器都能得到与传统“先推理后验证”相同的结果。作者实现并评测了该转换，基准表明其在发现违规方面总体上比顺序式推理加验证更高效。
Motivation: RDF 图常伴随 OWL 本体，传统的做法是先应用推理再对推理结果做约束检查，往往需要串联不同技术栈，过程低效且容易出现错误；论文希望把本体公理内化进 SHACL 约束，从而简化推理与验证的结合。
Method: 构造一个重写（rewriting）过程，将给定形状与 OWL EL^- 本体（OWL EL 中限制存在量词使用的片段）作为输入，输出满足 SHACL core 语法的约束；该输出可由任意不支持推理的验证器直接评估。
Result: 在与顺序使用先进推理器和验证器的基准对比中，该方法在发现违规（finding violations）上总体更高效；论文也对比了带内置推理支持的验证器。
Conclusion: 作者认为该技术简化了推理与验证结合流程，使无推理能力的 SHACL core 验证器也能复现传统方法的验证结果，但适用范围限定于 OWL EL^- 本体。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Sequence prediction under a lying oracle
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of sequential prediction of an $m$-ary sequence, where at each epoch, (i) the environment selects an outcome from an $m$-ary alphabet, (ii) the learner selects a probability distribution over the same alphabet (unaware of the outcome generated by the environment), and finally, (iii) the learner incurs a cost that depends on the probability assigned to the outcome. The cost function we consider captures the complexity of predicting the outcome generated by the environment, in a scenario where the aforementioned prediction is performed via comparative queries to a lying oracle. We consider both stochastic and adversarial environments, propose algorithms for both settings, and establish logarithmic upper bounds on their regret.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 m 元序列的在线序贯预测问题：每轮环境从 m 元字母表选择结果，学习者在不知情的情况下选择概率分布，并依据结果被赋予的概率承担代价。该代价函数刻画通过向会说谎的 oracle（lying oracle）发起比较查询来预测环境结果的复杂度；作者针对随机和对抗两类环境分别提出算法，并建立了遗憾（regret）的对数上界。
Motivation: 在线预测通常假设学习者能直接获得结果或可靠反馈，而本文考虑反馈来自可能说谎的 oracle、只能通过比较查询间接预测的场景，该设置下的遗憾界尚缺乏分析。
Method: 针对随机环境和对抗环境分别设计序贯预测算法；算法通过向 lying oracle 发起比较查询来获取信息，并利用反映预测复杂度的代价函数进行在线学习，进而证明遗憾具有对数上界。
Result: 在随机和对抗两类环境下，作者均提出了相应算法，并建立了遗憾的对数上界（logarithmic upper bounds）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将在线序列预测推广到带说谎 oracle 的比较查询设置是可处理的，并给出了理论遗憾保证；但未涉及具体字母表大小下的实验结果或数值验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Resource-Adaptive Primal-Dual Learning for One-Warehouse Multi-Store Systems with Censored Demand
papers.abstract_en: The one-warehouse multi-store (OWMS) system is a fundamental inventory network in which a nonreplenishable warehouse allocates shared stock across multiple stores over time. Existing OWMS learning policies are built around a fixed target calibrated to the initial average resource rate, but such a fixed-target architecture cannot re-center after realized sales change the remaining resource available per future period. We develop Resource-Adaptive Primal-Dual Learning, a new learning framework that tracks the primal-dual resolving path with censored demand as the remaining-resource state evolves. In each period, the current resource rate indexes the target store allocations and dual variable, while censored sales provide gradient estimates for updating both. The analysis combines expected-sales geometry with a moving-target argument to yield logarithmic expected regret, improving on the state-of-the-art square-root-order guarantees of existing OWMS learning policies. The underlying design and analytical ideas may inform other online learning problems with depleting shared resources. Numerical experiments further demonstrate good finite-horizon performance of a practical variant across different horizon lengths and inventory regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单仓库多门店 (one-warehouse multi-store, OWMS) 库存系统中的在线分配问题，提出 Resource-Adaptive Primal-Dual Learning 框架。该方法在剩余资源随实现销量变化时重新调整目标分配与对偶变量，利用删失需求 (censored demand) 提供梯度估计，并证明对数阶期望遗憾，优于现有 OWMS 学习策略的平方根阶保证。数值实验展示了实际变体在不同库存参数下的有限时域表现。
Motivation: 现有 OWMS 学习策略以初始平均资源率校准的固定目标为中心，无法在已实现销量改变未来每期可用资源后重新居中，导致策略在库存动态变化下失去最优性。
Method: 提出 Resource-Adaptive Primal-Dual Learning，沿剩余资源状态演化跟踪原始-对偶求解路径；每期用当前资源率索引目标门店分配与对偶变量，并以删失销量作为梯度估计同时更新两者，结合期望销量几何与移动目标论证进行分析。
Result: 摘要报告该方法实现对数阶期望遗憾 (logarithmic expected regret)，改进了现有 OWMS 学习策略平方根阶的最优性保证；数值实验显示实际变体在多种时域长度和库存机制下具有良好有限时域表现。
Conclusion: 该框架的设计与分析思路可能启发其他共享资源不断耗尽的在线学习问题，但结论范围主要限定于 OWMS 系统及删失需求设定。

papers.title: P2Skill: Privacy Preserving Skill Distillation for Cloud-Local LLM Inference Systems
papers.abstract_en: Cloud-local LLM inference systems have the potential to use the reasoning capability of large cloud models while protecting sensitive user data on personal devices. Cloud-bound requests must exclude personally identifiable information (PII) to prevent external data leakage. Existing privacy-preserving methods rely on prompt perturbation, entity masking, or model fine-tuning, but these approaches may distort contextual semantics or require additional training. This paper proposes P2Skill, a prompt-based skill distillation method in which a local small language model (SLM) autonomously performs decomposition, PII-aware routing, paraphrasing, and reconstruction by following the skill prompts. Skills are iteratively refined from execution failures by a cloud LLM, enabling the local SLM to generalize beyond memorized PII patterns, and therefore P2Skill requires no privacy-specific fine-tuning or learned auxiliary detectors. Evaluation on a four-domain benchmark shows that P2Skill achieves $1.69\times$ and $3.66\times$ higher privacy-preserved inference quality than previous baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 P2Skill，一种面向云-本地 LLM 推理系统的基于提示的技能蒸馏方法。本地小语言模型（SLM）通过跟随技能提示自主完成分解、PII 感知路由、改写和重建，并由云端 LLM 根据执行失败迭代精炼技能，因此无需针对隐私的微调或学习的辅助检测器。摘要报告在四领域基准上，该方法相比此前基线将隐私保持推理质量提升 1.69 倍和 3.66 倍。
Motivation: 现有隐私保护方法依赖提示扰动、实体掩码或模型微调，可能扭曲上下文语义或需要额外训练；在云-本地推理中需要在排除个人身份信息（PII）的同时保持推理质量。
Method: 提出提示式技能蒸馏：本地 SLM 依据技能提示执行分解、PII 感知路由、改写和重建；云端 LLM 从执行失败中迭代精炼技能，使本地模型能泛化到未记忆的 PII 模式，且无需隐私专用微调。
Result: 在四领域基准上，P2Skill 的隐私保持推理质量较之前基线分别提升 1.69 倍和 3.66 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 P2Skill 通过技能蒸馏在避免额外训练和辅助检测器的同时实现更好的隐私保护与推理质量，并具备超越记忆化 PII 模式的泛化能力。

papers.title: Regime-Conditional Verification: Correctness Estimation for Adapting and Monitoring Safety Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Safety classifiers deployed with large language models often fail for two reasons: their decisions reflect the policy learned during training rather than the deployer's desired policy, and their performance degrades as deployment traffic evolves. We present Regime-Conditional Verification (RCV), a lightweight wrapper that adapts an off-the-shelf safety classifier without retraining it. RCV estimates, from the classifier's internal representations, the probability that each prediction disagrees with the deployer's policy, and selectively corrects predictions likely to be wrong. The same correctness estimates also provide a label-free signal for detecting distribution shift, enabling a maintenance loop that updates the correctness estimation layer and resorts to classifier fine-tuning only when necessary. Across three off-the-shelf safety classifiers and two benchmark datasets, RCV improves adherence to the deployer's policy in every classifier-dataset combination, catching up to 0.81 of previously missed unsafe content without modifying the underlying classifier. In a deployment study with ten attack campaigns, each a harm category held out of RCV's training, RCV detects every campaign in a dedicated injection panel; in the maintenance census most drift episodes are repaired without updating the classifier, and the fine-tune is reserved for the residual episodes that repair does not restore.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Regime-Conditional Verification (RCV)，一种轻量包装器，在不重训练的情况下让现成安全分类器适配部署者策略。RCV 从分类器内部表征估计每个预测与部署者策略不一致的概率，并选择性纠正可能出错的预测；这些正确性估计同时作为无标签信号检测分布漂移，形成维护循环。在三个现成安全分类器和两个基准数据集上，RCV 在每个分类器-数据集组合都提升策略符合度，最高捕获 0.81 的此前遗漏不安全内容。
Motivation: 与 LLM 一起部署的安全分类器常因两个原因失效：其决策反映训练时学到的策略而非部署者期望的策略，并且随着部署流量演变性能会退化。因此需要一种无需重训练即可适配和监控分类器的机制。
Method: RCV 作为一个包装器，从分类器的内部表征估计每个预测与部署者策略不一致的概率，然后选择性修正高错误概率的预测。同时，这些正确性估计提供无标签的分布漂移检测信号，触发维护循环：先更新正确性估计层，仅在必要时才微调分类器。
Result: 在三个现成安全分类器和两个基准数据集上，RCV 在每一分类器-数据集组合均提升策略符合度，最多捕获 0.81 的此前遗漏不安全内容。部署研究中十个攻击活动（每个都是 RCV 训练中留出的危害类别）在专用注入面板全部被检测到；维护普查中大部分漂移事件无需更新分类器即可修复，微调仅留给修复无法恢复的残余事件。
Conclusion: RCV 提供轻量、无重训练的适配与监控方案，通过正确性估计和选择性修正提升部署者策略符合度，并在维护循环中把分类器微调保留为最后手段。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CoDS: Robust Collaborative Perception via Expert-driven Detection and BEV Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative perception breaks through single-view limitations via multi-agent information exchange. However, multi-source noise such as pose errors and communication delays degrades fusion feature quality, constraining perception performance. Joint training of detection and BEV segmentation provides a natural remedy, where segmented road regions help constrain target distributions and detection bounding boxes help recover ambiguous segmentation boundaries. To this end, we propose a robust Collaborative perception framework with expert-driven Detection and bev Segmentation (CoDS). To address spatial inconsistency in fusion quality, we first introduce the Collaborative Reliability Map (CoRM) to explicitly quantify feature quality distribution. Based on CoRM, we design the Semantic Mixture-of-Experts (S-MoE) module to extract differentiated features for inconsistent feature demands. Finally, to further mitigate feature noise degradation, the Bidirectional Task Complementary Interaction (BTCI) refines task-aware features through bidirectional injection. Extensive experiments on OPV2V and V2V4Real datasets show that our CoDS surpasses existing baselines on both tasks and maintains stable robustness under multi-source noise. Code: https://github.com/JinlongW128/CoDS and https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/OpenAIDriving/CoDS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为 CoDS 的鲁棒协同感知框架，结合专家驱动的目标检测与 BEV 分割，以应对多源噪声（如位姿误差、通信延迟）导致的融合特征退化。框架包含协同可靠性图（CoRM）、语义混合专家（S-MoE）和双向任务互补交互（BTCI）三个模块，并在 OPV2V 和 V2V4Real 数据集上验证了检测与分割任务的性能提升与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 协同感知中多智能体信息交换会引入位姿误差和通信延迟等多源噪声，降低融合特征质量，进而限制感知性能；现有方法缺乏对融合质量空间不一致性的显式建模。
Method: 提出协同可靠性图（CoRM）显式量化特征质量分布，并基于它设计语义混合专家（S-MoE）模块以提取适应不同特征需求的差异化特征；再通过双向任务互补交互（BTCI）在检测与 BEV 分割之间双向注入任务相关特征，缓解特征噪声退化。
Result: 在 OPV2V 和 V2V4Real 数据集上的实验表明，CoDS 在检测和 BEV 分割两个任务上均超过现有基线，并在多源噪声下保持稳定鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为联合训练检测与 BEV 分割并显式建模融合可靠性，可以有效提升协同感知在多源噪声下的鲁棒性；代码已开源。

papers.title: Owner3D: Ownership-Guided Style Writing for Training-Free Localized 3D Stylization
papers.abstract_en: Localized 3D stylization aims to modify the appearance of a specified object part while preserving the remaining surfaces. In large reconstruction models (LRMs), this task is challenging because style is injected into intermediate appearance representations before rendering, while compact triplane features are shared across target and non-target surfaces, causing style leakage and boundary ambiguity. We propose Owner3D, a training-free framework for localized 3D stylization that integrates localized appearance control directly into the LRM reconstruction process. Specifically, Owner3D introduces ownership-guided style writing to restrict reference-style injection to target regions, producing a single localized stylized triplane without additional training while avoiding separate global style and appearance representations. To resolve appearance ambiguity near semantic boundaries, we further introduce boundary dual slots that maintain separate local feature sources for target and non-target regions. Finally, a surface-first texture readout hierarchically combines surface, 3D, and triplane ownership evidence to robustly recover appearance under incomplete visibility. Experiments on a benchmark constructed from Google Scanned Objects and PartNet demonstrate that Owner3D consistently outperforms existing 3D stylization methods in target-region style fidelity and non-target appearance preservation, reducing appearance leakage by 86.4% and 89.9% compared with StyleSplat and LAENeRF, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Owner3D，一种无需额外训练的局部 3D 风格化框架，将局部外观控制直接集成到大型重建模型 (LRM) 的重建过程中。通过 ownership-guided style writing 将参考风格限制在目标区域，并引入 boundary dual slots 解决语义边界处的歧义，最后用 surface-first texture readout 恢复外观。在基于 Google Scanned Objects 和 PartNet 构建的基准上，相比 StyleSplat 和 LAENeRF，外观泄漏分别降低 86.4% 和 89.9%。
Motivation: 局部 3D 风格化需要只修改指定对象部分的外观，但大型重建模型 (LRM) 中压缩的 triplane 特征被目标和背景表面共享，导致风格泄漏和边界模糊。
Method: 提出训练免费的 Owner3D 框架，包含 ownership-guided style writing 限制风格注入到目标区域，产出单一局部风格化 triplane；引入 boundary dual slots 为目标和非目标区域维护独立的局部特征源；以及 surface-first texture readout，分层组合 surface、3D 和 triplane 的 ownership 证据以在不完整可见性下鲁棒恢复外观。
Result: 在 Google Scanned Objects 和 PartNet 构建的基准上，Owner3D 在目标区域风格保真和非目标外观保持上一致优于现有 3D 风格化方法，相比 StyleSplat 和 LAENeRF 分别将外观泄漏降低 86.4% 和 89.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将局部外观控制直接整合进 LRM 重建过程并以所有权证据引导特征读取，可以有效缓解风格泄漏与边界歧义，且无需额外训练。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出训练免费的 Owner3D 框架，包含 ownership-guided style writing 限制风格注入到目标区域，产出单一局部风格化 triplane；引入 boundary dual slots 为目标和非目标区域维护独立的局部特征源；以及 surface-first texture readout，分层组合 surface、3D 和 triplane 的 ownership 证据以在不完整可见性下鲁棒恢复外观。
summary_sections.result: 在 Google Scanned Objects 和 PartNet 构建的基准上，Owner3D 在目标区域风格保真和非目标外观保持上一致优于现有 3D 风格化方法，相比 StyleSplat 和 LAENeRF 分别将外观泄漏降低 86.4% 和 89.9%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，将局部外观控制直接整合进 LRM 重建过程并以所有权证据引导特征读取，可以有效缓解风格泄漏与边界歧义，且无需额外训练。

papers.title: Reaction-Transformation-Aware Flow Matching for Generalizable Transition State Generation
papers.abstract_en: Transition-state (TS) structures define the energetic barriers and mechanistic pathways of elementary chemical reactions, yet their identification remains computationally demanding because conventional saddle-point searches require expensive quantum-mechanical calculations. Recent machine-learning approaches have accelerated TS generation by predicting structures from reaction endpoint information, but they primarily learn geometric correspondence between endpoints and TSs, leaving the structural transformations underlying elementary reactions implicitly represented. To address this limitation, we introduce TransTS, a reaction-transformation-aware framework for generalizable TS generation from atom-mapped reactant-product pairs. TransTS explicitly learns atom-level structural transformations between reaction endpoints and integrates them with a unified atom-aligned geometric representation of reactants, TSs and products, enabling reaction-aware equivariant generation of TS geometries. TransTS is designed to provide reliable TS initial guesses for subsequent quantum-chemical refinement, where generated structures are evaluated not only by geometric similarity but also by their ability to converge to validated saddle points and recover the intended reaction pathways. Across IID and zero-shot OOD benchmarks, TransTS demonstrates improved TS initialization quality, with particularly strong generalization to unseen reaction distributions. On the challenging GDB-10-rxn and GDB-17-rxn OOD benchmarks, TransTS generates TS candidates that more frequently converge to validated saddle points and recover the intended elementary reactions after refinement than existing approaches under the same training regime. Scaling reaction coverage and model capacity further improves both geometric fidelity and refinement outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TransTS，一个面向泛化过渡态 (transition state, TS) 生成的反应变换感知框架，从原子映射的反应物-产物对生成 TS 几何。TransTS 显式学习反应端点之间的原子级结构变换，并将其与反应物、TS、产物的统一原子对齐几何表示结合，实现反应感知的等变 TS 生成。在 IID 和零样本 OOD 基准上，TransTS 生成的 TS 候选在后续量子化学精修中更频繁收敛到验证鞍点并恢复目标基元反应。
Motivation: 传统鞍点搜索依赖昂贵的量子力学计算，而现有机器学习方法主要学习端点与 TS 之间的几何对应，隐式表示结构变换，限制了泛化能力。
Method: 引入反应变换感知框架 TransTS，显式学习端点间的原子级结构变换，并集成统一原子对齐几何表示，实现反应感知的等变 TS 几何生成，为后续量子化学精修提供初始猜测。
Result: 在 IID 与零样本 OOD 基准上，TransTS 提升了 TS 初始化质量；在 GDB-10-rxn 和 GDB-17-rxn OOD 基准上，其生成的 TS 候选在精修后比现有方法更频繁收敛到验证鞍点并恢复目标基元反应。扩大反应覆盖和模型容量进一步提升几何保真度和精修效果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式学习反应结构变换能提升 TS 生成的泛化能力，并指出生成结果需结合量子化学精修评估。

papers.title: A Pathway to General-Purpose Scientific AI: Multimodal Comprehension of Scientific Images
papers.abstract_en: Scientific figures and tables encode essential experimental evidence, yet remain difficult for digital libraries and multimodal AI systems to retrieve and interpret. The ALD/E-ImageMiner benchmark and ICDAR 2026 Competition on Information Extraction from Atomic Layer Deposition/Etching Scientific Figures provide 1,951 figures from 205 publications, expert-annotated for classification, data table extraction, summarization, and visual question answering. In these companion proceedings, we present a forward-looking perspective on how the benchmark can guide future scientific-image challenges. We examine how its tasks probe capabilities from visual and quantitative reading to domain-grounded reasoning and evidential justification, and how Bloom-informed question design can support deeper scientific understanding. We propose "scientific conceptual understanding from images" as a long-term benchmark objective, with future directions including broader domains and figure types, contextual and cross-document synthesis, hypothesis evaluation, provenance, uncertainty, counterfactual grounding, and open-ended multimodal research. This perspective connects the ICDAR 2026 challenge to a broader agenda for machine-actionable scientific visual knowledge and verifiable multimodal scientific AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 ICDAR 2026 科学图表信息提取竞赛的配套观点文章，围绕 ALD/E-ImageMiner 基准展开前瞻性讨论。该基准包含来自 205 篇出版物的 1,951 张图，经专家标注用于分类、数据表提取、摘要和视觉问答等任务。作者提出把“从图像进行科学概念理解”作为长期基准目标，并给出更广阔的通用科学 AI 议程。
Motivation: 科学图表和表格承载关键实验证据，但数字图书馆和多模态 AI 系统对其检索与解释仍存在困难，现有基准不足以引导科学图像理解能力的评测与发展。
Method: 作者以透视性分析的方式梳理基准任务如何从视觉与量化阅读逐步延伸到领域推理和证据论证，并提出结合 Bloom 认知层次的问题设计来支撑更深层的科学理解；同时提出“科学概念图像理解”作为长期基准目标。
Result: 摘要未报告实验结果，仅给出基准规模：包含 1,951 张图、205 篇出版物，任务涵盖分类、数据表提取、摘要和视觉问答。
Conclusion: 作者强调未来方向包括更广的领域与图表类型、跨文档情境综合、假设评估、来源追溯、不确定性、反事实归因和开放多模态研究，旨在推动机器可操作的科学视觉知识与可验证的多模态科学 AI。

papers.title: Mandato: Protocol-Level Enforcement of Digitally Signed Mandates on AI Agent Actions with Cryptographically Chained Audit Trails
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly act on external systems through standardized tool-calling protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), yet no infrastructure layer constrains their actions to what a principal has verifiably authorized: authorization logic lives in application code, is neither signed nor independently auditable, and the resulting logs lack evidentiary value. We present Mandato, a governance proxy that enforces digitally signed mandates on agent actions at the protocol level. A mandate is a machine-readable, cryptographically signed authorization artifact specifying which tools an agent may invoke, under which parameter constraints and contextual conditions, for how long, and on whose behalf; the proxy evaluates every tool call against the applicable mandate chain, blocks non-conforming calls in line, and records every decision -- permit, deny, and the evidence for each -- in an append-only, hash-chained audit log designed for evidentiary use and periodically anchored via qualified timestamps. The mandate is deliberately modeled on the civil-law institution of delegation of authority, making the artifact legible to lawyers and auditors, not only to engineers. We give the mandate model and its decision semantics, the reference architecture as an MCP-transparent proxy with separated decision and enforcement points, and a mapping of the mechanism onto EU AI Act Articles 12 and 14, GDPR accountability, NIS2, and eIDAS 2, including a roadmap to qualified attestation through Qualified Trust Service Providers (QTSPs). We describe the implementation status of the reference system and a quantitative evaluation plan covering enforcement overhead, audit completeness, and tamper-evidence verification cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mandato，一个治理代理（governance proxy），在协议层对 AI 智能体的工具调用强制执行数字签名授权（mandate）。其核心是机器可读、密码学签名的授权工件，代理对每个工具调用依据适用的 mandate 链求值，拒绝不合规调用，并将所有决策记录到仅追加、哈希链式审计日志中，并与欧盟 AI 法案等法规映射。摘要描述了授权模型、参考架构和评估计划，属于系统设计论文。
Motivation: 现有 AI 代理通过 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 等协议调用外部系统，但授权逻辑驻留在应用代码中，既无签名也无可独立审计性，日志缺乏证据价值；缺少一个能将代理动作约束在主体可验证授权范围内的协议层基础设施。
Method: 提出 Mandato 治理代理：定义机器可读、数字签名的 mandate 授权工件，规定代理可调用哪些工具、参数约束、上下文条件、时限以及代表谁执行；代理在调用链中实时评估每个工具调用并阻止不合规调用；采用仅追加、哈希链式审计日志并通过合格时间戳定期锚定；参考架构是 MCP 透明代理，分离决策点与执行点，并将机制映射到欧盟 AI 法案第 12、14 条、GDPR、NIS2 与 eIDAS 2。
Result: 摘要未报告已完成的实证结果；仅描述了参考系统的实现状态和定量评估计划，涵盖执行开销（enforcement overhead）、审计完备性（audit completeness）和防篡改验证成本（tamper-evidence verification cost）。
Conclusion: 作者强调授权工件刻意模仿民法中的授权委托制度，使律师和审计人员也能理解；并给出通过合格信任服务提供商（QTSPs）实现合格认证（qualified attestation）的路线图。论文以体系设计和法规映射为主，实证验证尚待实施。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Domain Data Repetition in LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: As large language models scale, their training-token budgets must also increase to maintain an appropriate tokens-per-parameter ratio (\(\mathrm{TPP}\)). However, high-quality domain data is much harder to scale than general web data. As model size and the training-token budget increase, its fraction in the training mixture tends to decrease. Repeating the available high-quality data provides an effective way to counteract this dilution, but excessive repetition may lead to overfitting. We study this trade-off under practical LLM scaling, where the training-token budget grows proportionally with model size. For a fixed domain, we first find that, surprisingly at a fixed \(\mathrm{TPP}\), the optimal repetition count mildly increases with model size. Across different domains, we find that the optimal repetition count is strongly negatively correlated with the final validation loss of a domain: domains with lower loss can generally benefit from more repetitions. In contrast, the amount of unique domain data is only weakly related to the optimal repetition count. These findings suggest that repetition counts tuned on smaller proxy models with the same \(\mathrm{TPP}\) can provide a practical estimate for larger models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型预训练中，在训练 token 预算随模型规模成比例增长、从而保持 tokens-per-parameter (TPP) 不变的条件下，高质量领域数据的最优重复次数如何变化。摘要发现：固定 TPP 时最优重复次数随模型规模温和增加；跨领域时最优重复次数与领域最终验证损失强负相关、与唯一领域数据量仅弱相关。作者据此提出，在相同 TPP 下用更小的代理模型调得的重复次数可作为更大模型的实用估计。
Motivation: 高质量领域数据远难于通用网页数据扩展，随着模型规模和训练 token 预算增大，其在训练混合中的占比趋于稀释；重复使用现有高质量数据能抵消稀释，但过度重复可能导致过拟合，因此需要在现实的 LLM 扩展场景下量化这一权衡。
Method: 在训练 token 预算与模型规模成比例增长（固定 TPP）的设置下，针对固定领域考察最优重复次数与模型规模的关系，并跨领域分析最优重复次数与领域最终验证损失、唯一领域数据量之间的相关性，同时检验小代理模型重复次数调参向大模型迁移的可行性。
Result: 固定 TPP 下，最优重复次数随模型规模温和增加；跨领域而言，最优重复次数与领域最终验证损失呈强负相关，损失越低的领域通常越能从更多重复中受益，而与唯一领域数据量仅呈弱相关。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，在相同 TPP 下用小代理模型调出的重复次数可以为更大模型提供实用的估计；其主张建立在重复次数与损失、模型规模之间稳定关系的基础之上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: InstructVVT: Instruction-Driven Video Virtual Try-On without Auxiliary Spatial Priors
papers.abstract_en: Video virtual try-on is a highly constrained editing task requiring the precise replacement of a target person's clothing while strictly preserving the original video's spatial structure and temporal dynamics. Existing methods heavily rely on auxiliary handcrafted spatial priors (e.g., masks, poses) for editing control. However, these priors are prone to failure in unconstrained real-world videos and often compress rich visual context into incomplete structural signals. Furthermore, standard reconstruction objectives fail to fully capture try-on-specific human preferences. To address these challenges, we propose InstructVVT, an instruction-driven and reference-guided video virtual try-on framework based on a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) that operates without inference-time spatial priors. Our core insight is to recover fine-grained control directly from the input triplet (source video, reference garment, and instruction) via a dual-level reference conditioning scheme. Specifically, an MLLM infers semantic edit tokens for target disambiguation and structural preservation, while a lightweight conditioning pathway explicitly injects fine-grained visual garment details. Finally, we design a try-on-specific reward and utilize the DiffusionNFT algorithm to align the model with human preferences. Extensive experiments on ViViD-S and TripVVT-Bench demonstrate that InstructVVT outperforms state-of-the-art open-source methods in garment fidelity, structural preservation, and temporal consistency, despite requiring fewer inference-time controls.

TL;DR: InstructVVT 是一个基于 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 的视频虚拟试穿框架，在推理阶段无需辅助空间先验，直接从源视频、参考服装和指令的三元组中恢复细粒度控制。方法通过 MLLM 推断语义编辑 token 实现目标消歧与结构保持，并用轻量级条件路径注入服装细节，最后用 DiffusionNFT 算法对齐试穿特定人类偏好。在 ViViD-S 和 TripVVT-Bench 上，该方法在服装保真度、结构保持和时间一致性上超过现有开源方法，且需要的推理时控制更少。
Motivation: 现有视频虚拟试穿方法严重依赖手工设计空间先验（如 mask、pose）来进行编辑控制，这类先验在无约束真实视频中容易失效，且会把丰富视觉上下文压缩成不完整的结构信号；同时标准重建目标无法充分刻画试穿任务中的人类偏好。
Method: 提出双层级参考条件化方案：一个多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 推断语义编辑 token 以进行目标消歧和结构保持，一个轻量级条件化通路显式注入细粒度视觉服装细节；并设计试穿特定奖励，利用 DiffusionNFT 算法使模型与人类偏好对齐。
Result: 在 ViViD-S 和 TripVTT-Bench 上的大量实验显示，InstructVTT 在服装保真度、结构保持和时间一致性上优于最先进的开源方法，同时需要更少的推理时控制输入。
Conclusion: 作者认为无需推理期空间先验、直接从输入三元组恢复细粒度控制，并结合试穿特定人类偏好对齐，可以提升视频虚拟试穿的性能。摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: MACS: A Hybrid Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable Conversational E-Commerce Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Conversational recommendation for e-commerce is increasingly mediated by large language models (LLMs), yet many real-world deployments operate under a stricter requirement: recommendations must be drawn only from a merchant's fixed catalog, without web search or unsupported product claims. In this setting, the main challenge is reliability under hard constraints: the system must satisfy user requirements, remain grounded in available inventory, and preserve preferences across multiple conversational turns. We present MACS (Multi-Agent Commerce System), a hybrid multi-agent framework for reliable conversational recommendation in fixed-catalog settings. MACS uses LLMs for language-facing tasks such as interpreting user requests, eliciting preferences, and generating responses, while correctness-critical operations, including product retrieval, hard-constraint filtering, brand exclusion, and progressive relaxation, are executed deterministically by the merchant agent. A session-persistent preference layer tracks constraints across turns, enabling consistent handling of budget overwrites and exclusion reversals. On a 140-query single-turn benchmark, MACS achieves the highest pass rate (87.1%) and perfect brand compliance (1.000). On a 10-scenario multi-turn benchmark, MACS achieves the strongest macro Pass@5 (72% vs. 56% GPT+Catalog / 52% Gemini+Catalog) with zero constraint drift. The advantage is sharpest on exclusion reversal (100% vs. 20% / 0%) and constraint accumulation (100% vs. 60% / 40%). Mean judged response quality is similar across systems (0.751 vs. 0.736). These results suggest that hybrid architectures combining deterministic constraint enforcement with session-persistent preference tracking provide stronger reliability-oriented performance than catalog-bound prompt-only baselines in the fixed-catalog merchant setting.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MACS（Multi-Agent Commerce System），一个面向固定目录电商场景的混合多智能体对话推荐框架。系统用 LLM 处理语言类任务，而商品检索、硬约束过滤、品牌排除与渐进放松等正确性关键操作由商家智能体确定性执行，并加入跨轮次的会话持久偏好层以跟踪约束变化。在 140 查询单轮基准上，MACS 取得最高通过率（87.1%）与完美品牌合规（1.000）；在 10 场景多轮基准上，其宏平均 Pass@5 达 72%（对比 GPT+Catalog 的 56% 与 Gemini+Catalog 的 52%），且零约束漂移。
Motivation: 真实电商部署中，对话推荐必须只能从商家固定目录中取商品，不能联网搜索或做无依据的产品声明；在此硬约束下，系统需要同时满足用户需求、保持库存 grounded 并跨多轮维持偏好，这是现有基于提示的目录绑定基线难以可靠保证的。
Method: MACS 采用混合多智能体架构：LLM 负责任务理解、偏好 elicitation 与回复生成，而商品检索、硬约束过滤、品牌排除和渐进放松（progressive relaxation）等正确性关键操作由 merchant agent 用确定性逻辑执行；一个 session-persistent preference layer 跨轮次跟踪预算覆盖（budget overwrite）与排除反转（exclusion reversal）等约束变化。
Result: 在 140 查询单轮基准上，MACS 达到最高 pass rate（87.1%）和完美品牌合规（1.000）。在 10 场景多轮基准上，MACS 的宏平均 Pass@5 为 72%，优于 GPT+Catalog（56%）与 Gemini+Catalog（52%），且零约束漂移；优势在排除反转（100% vs. 20%/0%）和约束累积（100% vs. 60%/40%）上最明显，人工评分的回复质量相近（0.751 vs. 0.736）。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，在固定目录的商家场景中，将确定性约束执行与会话持久偏好跟踪结合的混合架构，比仅依赖目录绑定的 prompt-only 基线提供更强的面向可靠性（reliability-oriented）的表现。

papers.title: When Denoising Hurts: Rethinking the Terminal Step of Diffusion Time Series Forecasters -- Extended Version
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models offer a natural way to model uncertainty in time series forecasting, yet their iterative sampling process is often treated as a uniformly beneficial refinement procedure. Our study challenges this view by examining how forecast quality evolves throughout reverse diffusion. We find that general temporal structure is often recovered at relatively high noise levels, whereas continued low-noise refinement can introduce statistical drift and degrade the final forecast. Our analysis further suggests that this behavior explains why prior methods often favor relatively narrow diffusion architecture and schedule design. Building on this observation, we propose a label-free global stopping criterion that detects the optimal termination point, eventually speeding up inference and improving predictive accuracy. Additionally, since early stopping terminates inference in high-noise regions, we propose a Bernoulli timestep sampler that concentrates training on this region while preserving coverage of the full diffusion process. Extensive experiments conducted across eight real-world datasets demonstrate the superior performance of our method compared to existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视扩散模型用于时间序列预测时反向扩散（reverse diffusion）每一步是否都带来收益。作者发现一般时间结构在高噪声阶段即可恢复，而低噪声阶段的继续细化反而引入统计漂移并降低预测质量；据此提出无标签的全局停止准则（label-free global stopping criterion）来确定最优终止点，并配套一种伯努利时间步采样器（Bernoulli timestep sampler）让训练聚焦于高噪声区域。在八个真实数据集上的实验表明该方法优于现有方法，同时加快推理并提升预测精度。
Motivation: 现有扩散时间序列预测把迭代采样视为均匀有益的细化过程，但作者质疑这一假设，指出低噪声阶段的细化可能损害最终预测质量，从而需要重新思考反向扩散的终止步骤。
Method: 提出无标签的全局停止准则，用于检测反向扩散的最优终止点以提前终止推理；同时提出伯努利时间步采样器，将训练集中于高噪声区域，同时保持对整个扩散过程的覆盖。
Result: 在八个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法相比现有方法性能更优越，并能加速推理、提高预测精度。
Conclusion: 作者认为反向扩散在高噪声阶段已能恢复一般时间结构，低噪声细化会造成统计漂移；该工作为扩散时序预测器提供了更优的终止点选择，并解释了先前方法偏好较窄扩散架构与调度设计的原因。

papers.title: Rethinking Automated Program Repair: The Impact of Bug Complexity, Fault Localization, and LLM Cost-efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Background: Software bugs remain a critical challenge in development, necessitating effective Automated Program Repair (APR) techniques. While Large Language Model (LLM)-based APR systems have shown promise, prior studies primarily focus on overall repair effectiveness. The effects of bug complexity, fault localization, reasoning settings, and repair cost-effectiveness remain insufficiently explored. Aims: This study presents a comprehensive empirical analysis of LLM-based APR, focusing on how repair performance is shaped by bug complexity, fault localization, reasoning settings, and costs. Method: We evaluate two APR techniques (ChatRepair and CodeCorrector) using three LLMs (DeepSeek, GPT, and Llama), and examine their performance across diverse levels of bug complexity and localization strategies through a multi-dimensional empirical framework and statistical analysis. Results: Although structurally complex bugs and imprecise fault localization make repair more challenging, LLM-based APR techniques still achieve competitive repair effectiveness. Imprecise fault localization can substantially enlarge the performance gap between APR techniques. Furthermore, higher-cost LLMs and stronger reasoning settings do not consistently yield better cost-efficiency, revealing a nontrivial trade-off between repair effectiveness and computational cost. Conclusions: Over 50% of moderately complex bugs can be repaired by low-cost LLM-based APR techniques. The repair effectiveness gap between APR techniques becomes larger as fault localization becomes less precise. GPT-5 repairs 7 and 39 more complex bugs than DeepSeek-V4-pro and DeepSeek-V3.2, respectively; whereas the total repair cost of DeepSeek-V3.2 shows the best cost-efficiency performance.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at ESEM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的自动程序修复 (APR) 技术的实证研究。作者评估了 ChatRepair 和 CodeCorrector 两种 APR 技术，搭配 DeepSeek、GPT、Llama 三种 LLM，研究 bug 复杂度、故障定位 (fault localization)、推理设置和修复成本效率如何影响修复表现。结果显示，虽然结构复杂 bug 与不精确的故障定位会增加修复难度，LLM 驱动的 APR 仍能达到有竞争力的修复效果；高成本模型和更强推理设置并不总带来更好的成本效率。
Motivation: 以往 LLM-based APR 研究主要关注总体修复有效性，对 bug 复杂度、故障定位、推理设置与修复成本效益之间的相互作用缺乏系统考察，而这对于实际部署中的技术选择至关重要。
Method: 构建多维实证框架，在三种 LLM 上运行两种 APR 技术，并通过统计分析比较不同 bug 复杂度级别和故障定位策略下的修复性能与成本。
Result: 摘要报告：不精确的故障定位会显著拉大 APR 技术之间的性能差距；GPT-5 比 DeepSeek-V4-pro 多修复 7 个复杂 bug，比 DeepSeek-V3.2 多修复 39 个，但 DeepSeek-V3.2 在总修复成本上表现出最佳成本效率，说明修复有效性与计算成本之间存在非平凡权衡。
Conclusion: 超过 50% 的中等复杂度 bug 可由低成本 LLM-based APR 技术修复；APR 技术之间的修复有效性差距会随故障定位精度下降而扩大。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Benchmarking data-driven material models on the classic Treloar dataset
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning is rapidly reshaping constitutive modeling, offers new ways to learn material behavior directly from experimental data, and challenges long-established modeling paradigms. But with a growing number of machine-learning-based approaches available, how do they compare in practice? In this paper, we use the classic experimental data of Treloar to benchmark popular frameworks for hyperelasticity: (Generalized-Invariant) Constitutive Artificial Neural Networks, Physics-Augmented Neural Networks, (Adaptive) Material Fingerprinting, and Efficient Unsupervised Constitutive Law Identification & Discovery. We compare their fitting performance, computational cost, hyperparameter sensitivity, and ease of implementation. Furthermore, we discuss the trade-offs between predictive accuracy and model complexity. The latter is assessed by quantifying both the number of material parameters in the discovered models and the computational time required to evaluate the constitutive model and its derivatives. The results show that all methods can reproduce the benchmark data remarkably well. Rather than identifying a single winner, we highlight the strengths and limitations of each approach and provide practical guidance for their use. The source code for all six methods, including the training and comparison scripts, as well as all results and data used in this study, is publicly available via https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21915635.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以 Treloar 经典实验数据为基准，系统对比六种机器学习的超弹性本构建模框架：(Generalized-Invariant) Constitutive Artificial Neural Networks、Physics-Augmented Neural Networks、(Adaptive) Material Fingerprinting，以及 Efficient Unsupervised Constitutive Law Identification & Discovery。作者比较了拟合性能、计算成本、超参数敏感性和实现易用性，并用材料参数数量与模型及其导数评估时间衡量模型复杂度。结果显示所有方法都能很好地复现基准数据，没有单一赢家；作者总结了各方法的优缺点并公开了全部代码与数据。
Motivation: 机器学习正在快速改变本构建模，但面对越来越多的方法，实践中如何比较它们的表现尚缺乏系统的基准；本文用经典 Treloar 数据对主流超弹性学习框架进行统一评测。
Method: 选取六种流行的机器学习超弹性本构方法，在相同的 Treloar 实验数据上统一训练与比较，评估维度包括拟合表现、计算成本、超参数敏感度和实现难度；模型复杂度通过学习到的材料参数数量以及评估本构模型及其导数所需的计算时间来量化。
Result: 摘要报告所有被评测方法都能出色地拟合 Treloar 基准数据；不存在全面占优的单一方法，各方法在预测精度与模型复杂度（参数数量和求导计算成本）之间呈现不同取舍。
Conclusion: 作者不主张选出唯一最佳方法，而是强调每种方法的优势与局限，并为实际选用提供指导；六种方法的训练与对比脚本、结果和数据均通过 Zenodo 公开。

papers.title: Voxel-based 3D Facies Segmentation from Seismic Data: A Comparative Study
papers.abstract_en: Seismic facies segmentation has emerged as a significant challenge in geophysics, requiring robust methods and systems to effectively identify geologically analogous facies with limited labeled data. Although existing studies have shown promising results in 2D facies segmentation, they often preprocess the original 3D seismic volumes into sets of 2D slices, typically the inline and crossline directions, and treat this problem as a purely 2D segmentation task. This simplification introduces discontinuities across slices and fails to preserve the spatial and structural continuity in 3D seismic data, thus limiting the model's ability to learn coherent geological patterns. In this work, we present a comparative and reproducible benchmark for voxel-based 3D seismic facies segmentation, built upon publicly available seismic volumes including the Netherlands F3 and the Parihaka datasets, with standardized data splits and evaluation metrics. By evaluating the three representative families of modern 3D segmentation architectures, we establish strong baseline results that highlight the potential and remaining challenges for future research in this domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于体素 (voxel) 的三维地震相分割 (3D seismic facies segmentation) 对比基准，基于公开的 Netherlands F3 和 Parihaka 地震数据，并提供标准化的数据划分与评估指标。作者评估了三类现代 3D 分割架构并建立强基线结果，指出该方向仍有进一步研究的空间。
Motivation: 现有地震相分割研究大多将原始 3D 地震数据预处理为 2D 切片（如 inline 和 crossline 方向）并当作纯 2D 分割任务，导致切片间不连续，无法保持 3D 数据的空间与结构连续性，限制模型学习连贯地质模式的能力。
Method: 构建可复现的体素级 3D 地震相分割基准，采用公开的 F3 与 Parihaka 数据集，制定标准化的数据划分和评估指标，并系统评估三类代表性现代 3D 分割架构。
Result: 摘要报告通过评估三类 3D 分割架构建立了强基线结果，展示了该领域的研究潜力并揭示了剩余挑战。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要直接处理 3D 地震数据而非 2D 切片预处理，并指出该基准可为未来研究提供可复现的对比基础。

papers.title: Model-agnostic Retrieval-Augmented Extended Forecasting for time series
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting with pretrained foundation models has demonstrated strong zero-shot capabilities. However, achieving optimal performance on time series with short or negligible historical data in domain-specific applications typically requires adaptation via either fine-tuning or RAG. While fine-tuning is effective, it incurs substantial computational costs. This work explores RAG within univariate time series (Retrieval Augmented Generation) as a more efficient alternative, in particular RAF (Retrieval Augmented Forecasting), and introduces RAEF (Retrieval-Augmented Extended Forecasting), a model-agnostic method built upon RAF. RAEF incorporates key refinements to the retrieval and aggregation mechanisms: (1) direct retrieval in input-space rather than embedding-space, reducing inference overhead, and (2) concatenation-based aggregation that preserves temporal structure instead of averaging. Empirical evaluation across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrates that RAEF outperforms RAF in both accuracy and inference overhead. Furthermore, comprehensive comparisons with zero-shot and fine-tuned foundation models show that RAEF achieves competitive or superior performance to fine-tuning while avoiding its computational burden, establishing it as a practical and scalable approach for domain adaptation in time series forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAEF (Retrieval-Augmented Extended Forecasting)，一种基于 RAF 的模型无关 (model-agnostic) 单变量时间序列 RAG 方法。RAEF 将检索改为在输入空间直接进行、并用拼接聚合替代平均聚合，以降低推理开销并保留时间结构。摘要称其在多个基准数据集上优于 RAF，且与微调基础模型相比能达到竞争或更优性能而无需微调计算成本。
Motivation: 预训练基础模型具备零样本时间序列预测能力，但在历史数据很少或缺失的领域应用需要微调或 RAG 适配，而微调计算成本高。作者希望探索 RAG 作为更高效的替代方案，并改进现有 RAF 方法在检索与聚合机制上的不足。
Method: RAEF 在 RAF 基础上引入两项关键改进：一是在输入空间而非嵌入空间直接检索，减少推理开销；二是采用基于拼接的聚合 (concatenation-based aggregation) 而非平均，以保留时间序列的时间结构。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，RAEF 在准确率和推理开销两方面都优于 RAF；与零样本及微调基础模型的全面对比显示，RAEF 能达到与微调竞争或更优的性能，同时避免了微调的计算负担。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RAEF 是一种实用且可扩展的时间序列领域适配方法，能够在避免微调计算成本的前提下获得与微调相当的效果。

papers.title: Discovery and Spatial Characterisation of Multiple Shortcut Groups for Auditing Vision Model Bias
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models trained on datasets with spurious correlations can achieve high average accuracy whilst relying on shortcut features that do not generalise out of distribution. Whilst out-of-distribution testing highlights subgroup performance disparities arising from shortcut learning, it does not localise the regions within images that are associated with it. Existing research mostly uses attribution maps from interpretability methods to understand the spatial nature of spurious correlations. For example, conditional alignment methods separate task-relevant evidence from evidence tied to spurious correlations by comparing attribution maps from a task model, a sensitive attribute model, and a bias-reduced reference model. This yields shortcut-aligned and task-aligned contribution maps for each image. However, existing methods aggregate these maps across the dataset, potentially masking recurring spatial shortcut patterns that occur only in subsets of images. We address this limitation by grouping per-image shortcut and task contribution maps into recurring spatial patterns using K-means and non-negative matrix factorisation, and visualising the resulting shortcut groups through contribution maps and representative examples. Across CelebA, CheXpert, Waterbirds, Camelyon17, and ISIC2019, and across ResNet and ViT models, the discovered shortcut groups reveal both shared and distinct spatial patterns of shortcut and task contribution, with varying subgroup composition and error rates, enabling targeted inspection of image subsets with higher error rates. We perform input occlusion and internal test-time interventions to show that masking or suppressing task contribution regions substantially degrades the model classification performance and propose a combined shortcut suppression and task amplification feature intervention approach which generally reduces performance disparities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉模型偏见审计中现有方法将归因图跨数据集聚合、可能掩盖仅在部分图像子集中出现的重复空间捷径模式的问题，提出将每张图像的捷径与任务贡献图用 K-means 和非负矩阵分解 (NMF) 聚类为重复的空间模式，并以贡献图和代表性样例进行可视化。在 CelebA、CheXpert、Waterbirds、Camelyon17 和 ISIC2019 上结合 ResNet 与 ViT 模型，发现捷径组呈现共享与各异的空间模式，并伴随不同的子组组成和错误率。作者还通过输入遮挡和测试时干预验证任务贡献区域的重要性，并提出组合的捷径抑制与任务放大特征干预方法，通常能降低性能差异。
Motivation: 现有基于归因图的条件对齐方法虽能分离任务相关证据与虚假相关性证据，但将跨数据集的图聚合，可能掩盖仅发生在部分图像子集中的重复空间捷径模式，不利于定位与针对性检查。
Method: 对每张图像的捷径贡献图和任务贡献图使用 K-means 和非负矩阵分解 (NMF) 进行聚类，形成重复出现的空间捷径组；再通过贡献图与代表性样例可视化各组。此外提出一种组合的捷径抑制与任务放大特征干预方法，并在测试时进行干预。
Result: 在 CelebA、CheXpert、Waterbirds、Camelyon17 和 ISIC2019 上，ResNet 和 ViT 模型的捷径组均显示出既有共享又有差异的空间捷径与任务贡献模式，子组组成和错误率各不相同。输入遮挡与内部测试时干预表明，遮蔽或抑制任务贡献区域会显著降低模型分类性能，而组合干预通常能减少性能差异。
Conclusion: 该方法通过将每图像的贡献图聚类为重复空间模式，支持对错误率更高的图像子集进行针对性检查，并为缓解模型偏差提供一种有效的特征干预策略。

papers.title: Evolve Vision-Language-Action Model into an Agent with On-the-fly Tool-use
papers.abstract_en: This paper integrates end-to-end Visual-Language-Action (VLA) models with agentic tool-use to propose Agentic Robot with Tool-use (ART). ART is a tool-injection framework that tunes any VLA model to leverage off-the-shelf tool modules for low-level vision, high-level affordance, and embodiment enhancement. Compared to vanilla VLA models with a whole continuous action solution space, ART reduces the complexity of the action solution space through tool-use, which not only improves generalizability across different tasks but also reduces data dependency. To demonstrate the advantages (high generalizability and low data dependency) of this framework, we first built a dataset of 30K tool-use trajectories and action demonstrations, which is much smaller than those used by baseline methods. We then designed a training regimen for long-trajectory tool-use reasoning in challenging environments. Experiments show that ART achieves a 20% higher success rate than mainstream baselines on simulation and real-world tasks, such as pick-and-place in the dark at novel viewpoints. Empirical results highlight the benefits of an agent-based approach: modular tool utilization enables more efficient training, lightweight deployment, and scalable integration of new tools. This design fosters robustness, adaptability, and extensibility, paving the way for the practical deployment of VLA systems in complex real-world scenarios.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic Robot with Tool-use (ART)，一个将端到端 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型与智能体工具调用 (tool-use) 结合的框架，通过向任意 VLA 模型注入现成工具模块来降低动作解空间复杂度。作者构建了 30K 条工具使用轨迹与动作演示数据集，并设计了面向长轨迹工具使用推理的训练方案。实验显示在仿真与真实世界任务（如黑暗环境新视角下的 pick-and-place）上比主流基线成功率提高 20%。
Motivation: 原始 VLA 模型面对完整连续动作解空间，任务泛化性受限且数据依赖高，难以在复杂环境中进行长轨迹决策。
Method: ART 是一个工具注入式框架，可微调任意 VLA 模型以调用现成的低层视觉、高层 affordance 与具身增强 (embodiment enhancement) 工具模块；同时作者构建了 30K 条轨迹数据集，并设计用于长轨迹工具使用推理的训练流程。
Result: 在仿真与真实世界任务上，ART 相比主流基线取得 20% 更高的成功率，例如在黑暗环境和新视角下完成 pick-and-place。
Conclusion: 作者强调基于智能体的模块化工具利用能够带来更高效的训练、轻量部署以及新工具的可扩展集成，从而提升系统的鲁棒性、适应性与可扩展性，为 VLA 系统在复杂真实场景中的实际部署铺路。

papers.title: Source-Agnostic Image Translation Based on Latent Aware Adaptive Masking
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose a source-agnostic framework that dynamically refines a binary mask throughout the reverse diffusion process by computing the discrepancies of a pretrained diffusion model's prediction for each latent time step. Rather than relying on a fixed threshold, our method introduces a time-dependent statistical thresholding scheme derived from the empirical mean and standard deviation of prediction discrepancies across the latent noisy images from the target distribution. This allows the mask to adapt to the model's varying predictive confidence at different noise levels, effectively isolating domain-specific regions while preserving global structural coherence. Experimental results on the AFHQ and Celeba-HQ datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised Image-to-Image methods in both realism (FID, KID) and faithfulness (SSIM, LPIPS). By requiring only a pretrained model of the target domain, our approach enables precise, automated localization and seamless translation across diverse source distributions without any specialized training. The project source code is available at: https://github.com/dtoma95/PM-Edit

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 source-agnostic 的无监督图像翻译框架，在逆向扩散过程中动态细化二值掩码：计算预训练扩散模型在每个隐时间步上的预测差异，并用目标域隐噪声图像上差异的经验均值与标准差构造随时间变化的统计阈值，从而替代固定阈值。掩码随不同噪声水平下模型置信度自适应变化，隔离域特有区域并保持全局结构一致性。在 AFHQ 和 CelebA-HQ 上，该方法在真实感（FID、KID）和忠实度（SSIM、LPIPS）上均超过现有无监督 Image-to-Image 方法，且只需目标域的预训练模型，无需专门训练。
Motivation: 现有的无监督图像翻译或扩散编辑方法往往依赖固定阈值或面向特定源域的设置，难以在任意源分布之间实现自动化的域相关区域定位与无缝翻译。
Method: 提出潜在感知自适应掩码（latent aware adaptive masking）：在逆向扩散过程中计算预训练扩散模型对每个潜在时间步的预测差异，并基于目标分布潜在噪声图像的差异均值和标准差设计随时间变化的统计阈值来动态调整二值掩码。
Result: 在 AFHQ 和 CelebA-HQ 数据集上，该方法在 FID、KID 两项真实感指标以及 SSIM、LPIPS 两项忠实度指标上优于当前最优的无监督 Image-to-Image 方法。
Conclusion: 该方法仅依赖目标域的预训练扩散模型，即可在多种源分布间实现精确、自动化的区域定位与无缝翻译，无需专门训练；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beyond Text Conditioning: A Systematic Study of MLLM-DiT Fusion for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant paradigm for high-fidelity video generation, yet their ability to perform high-level semantic planning remains limited. While hybrid architectures integrating MLLMs with diffusion backbones have shown strong advantages in image synthesis, such designs remain underexplored in video generation, where existing approaches often treat MLLMs primarily as frozen feature encoders rather than semantic generators. To fill this gap, we systematically study how an MLLM should be integrated with a DiT for video generation by answering three questions: what intermediate representation should bridge the MLLM and DiT, how the MLLM should generate it, and how the DiT should incorporate it during diffusion rendering. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) discrete semantic visual tokens produced by an EMA-based tokenizer provide a stable and expressive interface, (2) autoregressive causal modeling is effective for generating these tokens, and (3) explicit visual-token conditioning is more effective than prompt refinement or latent bridging. Based on these findings, we propose BiVidGen, a hybrid framework where an MLLM first generates semantic visual tokens and a DiT renders videos conditioned on both text and these tokens via multi-layer cross-attention. Extensive experiments show that BiVidGen improves semantic alignment and temporal coherence over a fine-tuned DiT baseline, achieving stronger performance on VBench-Long. These results demonstrate that explicit MLLM-based visual planning provides an effective intermediate interface for text-to-video generation beyond text-only conditioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究 MLLM（多模态大语言模型）与 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 在视频生成中的融合方式，提出 BiVidGen 混合框架。MLLM 首先生成语义视觉 token（semantic visual tokens），DiT 在文本和这些 token 的条件下通过多层交叉注意力渲染视频。摘要报告该方法在 VBench-Long 上提升了语义对齐和时间连贯性，优于微调的 DiT 基线。
Motivation: DiT 已成为高保真视频生成的主导范式，但高层语义规划能力有限；混合 MLLM 与扩散骨干的架构在图像合成中显示了优势，但在视频生成中尚缺乏系统研究，现有方法常把 MLLM 当作冻结特征编码器而非语义生成器。
Method: 围绕三个问题展开：MLLM 与 DiT 之间应使用什么中间表示、MLLM 如何生成该表示、DiT 如何在扩散渲染中纳入它。基于分析提出 BiVidGen：MLLM 用自回归因果建模生成由 EMA-based tokenizer 得到的离散语义视觉 token，DiT 通过多层交叉注意力在文本和这些 token 的条件下渲染视频。
Result: 摘要报告三个关键发现：(1) EMA-based tokenizer 产生的离散语义视觉 token 是稳定且表达力强的交互接口；(2) 自回归因果建模能有效生成这些 token；(3) 显式视觉 token 条件优于 prompt 精炼或潜在桥接（latent bridging）。实验表明 BiVidGen 在 VBench-Long 上优于微调的 DiT 基线，提升语义对齐和时间连贯性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，显式的 MLLM 视觉规划为文生视频提供了超越纯文本条件的有效中间接口，但未提及具体局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adversarial Learning of Classifier-Free Guidance Schedules
papers.abstract_en: Modern text-to-image diffusion models rely on classifier-free guidance (CFG) to achieve high image fidelity and text alignment. However, CFG typically applies a static, global scale across all timesteps, samples, and conditions -- a choice that is generally suboptimal and can introduce artifacts, as different states may benefit from different levels of guidance. While time-varying schedules are known to improve quality, designing them by hand is non-trivial and application-dependent. In this paper, we learn the guidance schedule as a function of diffusion time, conditioning and the current noisy sample, in order to better align sampled images with the text prompt. We frame this as a density ratio estimation problem: a discriminator is trained to estimate the time-dependent log-density ratio between the true and guided marginal distributions, while a lightweight generator network predicts the optimal, state-dependent guidance scale. Empirically, our approach outperforms both heuristic CFG schedules and prior methods for learning dynamic guidance on text-to-image generation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型中分类器无关引导（CFG）使用固定全局尺度的问题，提出学习依赖扩散时间、条件和当前噪声样本的引导调度。方法将问题建模为密度比估计：判别器估计真实与引导边际分布之间的时间相关对数密度比，轻量生成器网络预测最优的状态相关引导尺度。实验表明该方法在文本到图像生成基准上优于启发式CFG调度和先前的动态引导学习方法。
Motivation: 现有CFG对所有时间步、样本和条件使用静态全局尺度，次优且可能引入伪影；不同状态可能需要不同强度的引导，而手工设计时间变化调度困难且与应用相关。
Method: 提出对抗式学习框架：判别器被训练用于估计真实分布与引导边际分布之间的时间相关对数密度比，轻量生成器网络则预测最优、状态相关的引导尺度，从而将引导调度建模为依赖diffusion time、conditioning和当前噪声样本的函数。
Result: 在文本到图像生成基准上的实验表明，该方法在质量上优于启发式CFG调度以及先前学习动态引导的方法。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过学习得到的状态相关引导调度可以更好地将采样图像与文本提示对齐，并实证展示了其相对于启发式与先前学习方法的优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Demystifying Agent Skills: Why They Work-Until They Don't
papers.abstract_en: Skills have emerged as a practical and effective approach for enhancing LLM agents at inference time through structured packages of knowledge. However, existing evaluations largely measure whether skills improve aggregated task success, leaving a more fundamental question underexplored: \emph{\textbf{When do skills help, why do they work, and where do they fail?}} Through controlled experiments across various benchmarks, agent harnesses and LLMs, we isolate the effects of representation, outcome annotation, retrieval difficulty, and cross-framework robustness of skills. To further answer this question, we design a contrastive study that combines controlled quantitative experiments with paired trajectory analysis. We normalize 8,135 trial records from controlled experiments and retain 238 valid unique labels from 240 open-coded records. We consolidate these observations into a taxonomy of three high-level categories and twelve skill-use modes: skills work when noisy trajectories become procedural anchors that stabilize execution. Skills improve over Workflow Memory by 6.06 points in matched comparisons. Procedural anchoring accounts for 65.7\% of skill cases, versus 4.5\% for explicit knowledge injection, showing that skills stabilize action rather than inject missing facts. Retrieval is a separate bottleneck: as pools grow from 5 to 100, actual-use precision falls from 29.6\% to 3.3\%. Confusable distractors impair offline identification, yet downstream success remains stable; exact ground-truth invocation is neither sufficient nor necessary. Skills fail under brittle assumptions, incompatible contexts, or insufficient adaptation. These findings move evaluation beyond aggregate success rates and guide reliable self-evolving agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验研究 LLM agent 技能 (skills) 在何时有效、为何有效以及在哪里失效的问题。作者在多种基准、agent harness 和 LLM 上隔离了表示形式、结果标注、检索难度和跨框架鲁棒性的影响，并将 8,135 条受控实验记录归一化、对 240 条开放编码记录保留 238 条有效标签，归纳出三大类十二种技能使用模式。研究发现技能主要通过稳定执行（procedural anchoring）而非注入缺失事实来起作用，检索是独立瓶颈，且技能在脆弱假设、不兼容上下文或适应不足时失效。
Motivation: 现有评估大多只衡量技能是否提升聚合任务成功率，而忽略了更根本的问题：技能何时有帮助、为什么起作用、在哪里失败。作者希望把评估从聚合成功率推进到对技能作用机制的理解。
Method: 采用对照实验（controlled experiments）与配对轨迹分析（paired trajectory analysis）结合的对比研究设计，跨多个基准、agent harness 和 LLM 隔离技能的表征、结果标注、检索难度和跨框架鲁棒性因素，并对大规模实验记录进行归一化和开放编码以形成分类体系。
Result: 在匹配比较中技能比 Workflow Memory 提升 6.06 分；技能案例中 65.7% 归因于程序锚定，仅 4.5% 归因于显式知识注入。检索池从 5 增至 100 时，实际使用精度从 29.6% 降至 3.3%；易混淆干扰项会损害离线识别，但下游成功率保持稳定，且精确调用 ground-truth 既非充分也非必要条件。
Conclusion: 技能在脆弱假设、不兼容上下文或适应不足时失效。作者认为这些发现应将评估从聚合成功率转向更细粒度的机制理解，并为可靠的自进化 agent (self-evolving agents) 提供指导。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Agent-Orchestration in Autonomous Chip Design
papers.abstract_en: Recent developments in large language models (LLMs) and tool-using agents encourage people to explore the potential of using agents in chip design. The core question is what kind of AI we really need in such a sophisticated industry. To this end, we bring the idea of modeling a chip-design superintelligence as an enormous \textit{AI-organization}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于大语言模型 (LLM) 与工具使用智能体的最新进展，提出将芯片设计超级智能 (chip-design superintelligence) 建模为一个大规模 AI 组织 (AI-organization) 的构想，以回答自主芯片设计究竟需要何种 AI 这一核心问题。摘要目前仅给出概念性框架，未报告具体方法细节或实验结果。
Motivation: 摘要指出核心问题是在芯片设计这一复杂工业场景中我们真正需要怎样的 AI，并由此引入将智能体编排 (agent-orchestration) 视为组织化协作的视角。
Method: 提出将芯片设计超级智能建模为巨大的 AI 组织，以 LLM 和工具使用智能体作为基础单元进行编排；摘要未给出技术实现细节。
Result: 摘要未报告任何具体实验结果、数据集或量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要主要提出概念方向，认为组织化的 AI 智能体或可支撑自主芯片设计；具体可行性、验证与局限性均未在摘要中说明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HAM-RAG: Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal RAG for Structure-Faithful Interleaved Generation
papers.abstract_en: Existing multimodal RAG methods often flatten structured documents into isolated text and image units, weakening the source organization and local text-image logic needed for faithful evidence selection and placement. We propose HAM-RAG, a Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal RAG framework for structure-faithful interleaved generation. HAM-RAG uses document hierarchy as a grounding signal across retrieval and generation, contextualizing textual and visual evidence and preserving source position and local text-image relations in the prompt. We further introduce HAM-Bench, covering Wukong, Wiki, arXiv, and Recipe across game walkthroughs, web pages, scientific papers, and step-wise recipe documents. Across multiple backbones, HAM-RAG improves the main multimodal average by 17.3% over the strongest non-hierarchical baseline. On Wukong, HAM-RAG improves Img-CBS by 24.2% over the strongest non-hierarchical baseline, demonstrating substantially better local text-image alignment. papers.title: AdvDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Joint-Aligned Actions and Adversarial Learning
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation is a fundamental capability for embodied intelligence, but scaling it remains difficult because robot demonstrations are expensive to collect and action spaces vary across embodiments. Policies trained on heterogeneous data can also entangle task-relevant visual cues with embodiment-specific appearance, limiting cross-embodiment generalization. We present AdvDex, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework for learning dexterous manipulation from human and robot demonstrations. First, we introduce OmniShare, a large-scale multimodal dataset of human manipulation demonstrations that provides high-quality kinematic supervision and tactile measurements while reducing reliance on robot teleoperation. Second, we propose the Joint-Aligned Action Space (JAAS), a canonical action representation comprising an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ wrist pose and 15 finger joints, thereby functionally aligning human hands, dexterous robot hands, and parallel grippers. Finally, we use domain-adversarial learning to reduce embodiment-specific information in the learned visual representation. Experiments on hand-action prediction and real-world dexterous manipulation show consistent improvements over baselines, effective zero-shot human-to-robot skill transfer, generalization to unseen objects and environments, and data-efficient few-shot adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdvDex，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，用于从人类和机器人演示中学习灵巧操作。作者引入 OmniShare 大规模多模态人类操作演示数据集，提出关节对齐动作空间（JAAS）作为规范动作表示，并使用域对抗学习减少视觉表示中的具身特定信息。实验显示在手部动作预测和真实世界灵巧操作上优于基线，支持零样本人-机器人技能迁移和对未见物体与环境的泛化。
Motivation: 灵巧操作难以规模化，因为机器人演示采集昂贵且不同具身（embodiment）的动作空间差异大；在异构数据上训练的策略还会将任务相关视觉线索与具身特定外观纠缠，限制跨具身泛化。
Method: AdvDex 包含三部分：OmniShare 多模态人类演示数据集，提供高保真运动学监督和触觉测量；JAAS 规范动作表示，由 SE(3) 腕部姿态与 15 个手指关节组成，对齐人手、灵巧机械手和平行夹爪；域对抗学习以减少学习到的视觉表征中的具身特定信息。
Result: 在手部动作预测和真实世界灵巧操作实验中，AdvDex 相对基线取得一致改进，实现零样本人-机器人技能迁移、对未见物体和环境的泛化，以及数据高效的少样本适配。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一动作表示与域对抗学习相结合，可有效利用人类演示实现跨具身灵巧操作学习，并降低对机器人遥操作采集的依赖。

papers.title: E-S2Feat:Semantic-Guided Spiking Local Feature Detection and Description for Event Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Benefiting from high temporal resolution and dynamic range, event-based local feature methods have attracted increasing attention. However, event sparsity, noise, and limited texture still hinder robust local feature learning. Deploying such methods on resource-constrained platforms such as unmanned aerial vehicles also requires balancing accuracy and energy efficiency. To address these challenges, this paper proposes \textbf{E-S2Feat}, a spiking neural network framework for event-based local feature detection and description. The framework jointly optimizes local feature learning from the perspectives of feature representation and selection. First, a module-specific spiking activation mechanism preserves fine-grained structural cues and discriminative information under low-bit, energy-efficient inference, thereby improving overall representation fidelity. Furthermore, a semantic-guided feature modulation mechanism leverages semantic priors to refine keypoint response distributions and enhance local descriptor discriminability, thereby guiding the model to extract local features with greater geometric stability and stronger discriminative capability. Experiments on the ECD and EDS datasets show that the proposed method significantly outperforms baseline methods such as SuperEvent in pose estimation accuracy. It also achieves accuracy comparable to its artificial neural network counterpart while delivering an approximately 4.8-fold improvement in theoretical computational energy efficiency. Visual-inertial odometry experiments on the TUM-VIE dataset further verify the effectiveness and practical application potential of the proposed method in complete SLAM systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 E-S2Feat，一个用于事件相机 (event camera) 局部特征检测与描述 (local feature detection and description) 的脉冲神经网络 (spiking neural network, SNN) 框架。框架从特征表示和特征选择两方面联合优化：模块特定的脉冲激活机制在低比特、能量高效的推理下保留细粒度结构线索，语义引导的特征调制机制利用语义先验优化关键点响应分布并增强描述子判别力。在 ECD 和 EDS 数据集上的位姿估计精度显著优于 SuperEvent 等基线，并在接近 ANN 方法精度的同时实现约 4.8 倍的理论计算能效提升。
Motivation: 基于事件的方法虽受益于高时间分辨率和动态范围，但事件稀疏性、噪声和有限纹理仍阻碍鲁棒局部特征学习；在无人机等资源受限平台上部署还需要在精度与能效之间取得平衡。
Method: 提出 E-S2Feat 框架，包含模块特定脉冲激活机制以支持低比特、节能推断并保持结构信息，以及语义引导特征调制机制，利用语义先验精细化关键点响应分布、增强描述子判别力，从而引导模型提取几何更稳定、判别力更强的局部特征。
Result: 在 ECD 和 EDS 数据集上，该方法在位姿估计精度上显著超过 SuperEvent 等基线；与对应人工神经网络 (ANN) 方法精度相当，同时实现约 4.8 倍的理论计算能效提升。TUM-VIE 数据集上的视觉惯性里程计实验进一步验证其在完整 SLAM 系统中的有效性与实际应用潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从特征表示与特征选择两个角度联合优化，可提升事件相机局部特征的几何稳定性与判别力，并兼顾能耗；其声称的适用范围是事件相机特征学习及资源受限平台上的 SLAM 应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SSP: An Event-Matched Syn2Sim2Phy Cross-Domain Evaluation Framework for Autonomous Driving VLA Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving jointly produce scene interpretation, language-based reasoning, and driving trajectories. Existing evaluations often use independently selected synthetic, simulated, and physical data, so measured performance gaps can be confounded by changes in scenario content rather than genuine domain sensitivity. We propose SSP (Synthetic-Simulation-Physical), an event-matched Syn2Sim2Phy evaluation framework that anchors cross-domain comparison to the same safety-critical interaction. Starting from a synthetic long-tail video, SSP builds a validated event specification that preserves road topology, participant roles, relative motion, conflict evolution, passing order, response constraints, and event phases. Platform-specific realizations are then constructed in CARLA and on a closed proving ground and are evaluated only after transfer audits confirm preservation of mandatory event properties. SSP maps heterogeneous outputs from OpenEMMA, LLaViDA, and Alpamayo-R1 into common semantic slots and a 1 s trajectory window to assess output validity, semantic accuracy, critical-interaction recognition, trajectory quality, and risk response. Across Cut-in and vulnerable-road-user crossing cases, the macro-averaged Integrated VLA Capability Scores are 0.259, 0.291, and 0.325 in the Synthetic, Simulation, and Physical domains, respectively, while the best domain varies by scenario. Alpamayo-R1, OpenEMMA, and LLaViDA obtain scores of 0.405, 0.338, and 0.131. SSP provides a reproducible scene-transfer chain and an evidence-qualified evaluation of VLA behavior without assuming that the Physical domain is universally superior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SSP（Synthetic-Simulation-Physical），一个面向自动驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的跨域评估框架，通过事件匹配将合成、仿真和实车测试锚定到同一安全关键交互上。框架从合成长尾视频构建事件规范，在 CARLA 和封闭试验场生成平台特定实现，并仅在迁移审计确认关键事件属性保留后才进行评估。SSP 将 OpenEMMA、LLaViDA 和 Alpamayo-R1 的异构输出映射到统一语义槽和 1 秒轨迹窗口，评估输出有效性、语义准确性、关键交互识别、轨迹质量和风险响应。在 Cut-in 和弱势道路使用者穿越场景中，综合能力得分的宏平均在合成、仿真和物理域分别为 0.259、0.291 和 0.325，且最佳域因场景而异。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶 VLA 评估常使用独立挑选的合成、仿真和物理数据，导致跨域性能差异可能由场景内容变化而非真实域敏感性引起，缺乏可归因的跨域比较。
Method: 提出事件匹配的 Syn2Sim2Phy 评估框架：从合成长尾视频构建已验证的事件规范，保留道路拓扑、参与者角色、相对运动、冲突演化、通过顺序、响应约束和事件阶段；随后在 CARLA 和封闭试验场构建平台特定实现，并通过迁移审计确认强制事件属性保留；再将多个 VLA 模型的输出映射到公共语义槽和 1 秒轨迹窗口进行多维度评估。
Result: 在 Cut-in 和弱势道路使用者穿越场景中，宏平均 Integrated VLA Capability Scores 在 Synthetic、Simulation、Physical 域分别为 0.259、0.291、0.325，最佳域随场景变化；Alpamayo-R1、OpenEMMA 和 LLaViDA 得分分别为 0.405、0.338 和 0.131。
Conclusion: SSP 提供了可复现的场景迁移链和基于证据的 VLA 行为评估，且不假设 Physical 域普遍更优，强调跨域比较需控制事件内容。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned video world models require low-latency causal generation and reliable responses to game-native controls. Although causal distillation enables one- or few-step video synthesis, extending it to interactive world models remains challenging, as discrete keyboard states and continuous mouse motion must remain aligned with temporally compressed latent chunks during causal training and autoregressive rollout. We introduce ForgeWM, a progressive framework that transforms a bidirectional action-conditioned video generator into efficient few-step world models through domain adaptation, teacher-forced causal training, causal consistency distillation, and on-policy distribution matching with a bidirectional teacher. The resulting budget-specialized students operate at steady-state denoising budgets of 1, 2, and 4 steps. ForgeWM further supports a dual-path deployment protocol combining latency-critical interaction with optional replay-time refinement, where the one-step student re-noises and refines its saved draft. On paired Minecraft trajectories, ForgeWM leads the evaluated systems in Imaging Quality, reference-aligned motion-profile agreement, action-sign accuracy, and mouse-control accuracy, while achieving the lowest reference LPIPS; the same four-stage recipe transfers to gamepad-controlled FPS gameplay. Replay-time refinement matches four-step reference quality while remaining roughly three times closer to the experienced trajectory than regeneration from noise. These results demonstrate ForgeWM's effectiveness for controllable few-step video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ForgeWM，一个渐进式框架，将双向动作条件视频生成器转换为高效的少步世界模型，通过域适应、teacher-forced 因果训练、因果一致性蒸馏以及与双向教师模型的 on-policy 分布匹配四阶段实现。生成的预算专用学生模型在 1、2、4 步稳态去噪预算下运行，并支持双路径部署。在配对 Minecraft 轨迹上，ForgeWM 在图像质量、参考对齐运动轮廓一致性、动作信号准确性和鼠标控制准确性上领先，且参考 LPIPS 最低；同一配方也迁移到手柄控制的 FPS 游戏。
Motivation: 动作条件视频世界模型需要低延迟因果生成并可靠响应游戏原生控制。因果蒸馏虽能实现一两步视频合成，但扩展到交互式世界模型仍面临挑战，因为离散键盘状态和连续鼠标运动必须在因果训练和自回归 rollout 中与时间压缩的潜变量块保持对齐。
Method: 提出 ForgeWM 四阶段渐进式训练流程：域适应、teacher-forced 因果训练、因果一致性蒸馏、以及使用双向教师模型的 on-policy 分布匹配，得到预算专门化的 1/2/4 步学生模型。还支持双路径部署协议，将延迟关键交互与可选的重放时细化结合，即一步学生对其保存的草稿重新加噪并细化。
Result: 在配对 Minecraft 轨迹上，ForgeWM 在图像质量、参考对齐运动轮廓一致性、动作信号准确性和鼠标控制准确性上均领先，并取得最低参考 LPIPS；同一四阶段配方也适用于手柄控制的 FPS 游戏。重放时细化能达到四步参考质量，且比从噪声重新生成更贴近经验轨迹约三倍。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果展示了 ForgeWM 在可控少步视频生成上的有效性，尤其适用于需要低延迟因果生成的交互式世界模型。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Residual Dominance as a Structural Account of Last-Item Reliance in Causal Self-Attention Recommenders
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based sequential recommenders with causal self-attention often rely heavily on the most recent interaction at inference time, but how this behavior is structurally expressed in the representation used for prediction remains unclear. We combine prediction-time diagnostics with norm-based analysis of the full attention block. First, we show that SASRec-style models exhibit highly localized last-item reliance. We then find that, although self-attention aggregates contextual information, residual addition sharply shifts the full-block representation toward same-position contributions, which we term residual dominance. To probe this interpretation, we use inference-time residual scaling as a controlled diagnostic intervention. Changing the residual strength induces a monotonic trade-off between structural mixing and last-item reliance, while reducing residual strength recovers a subset of final-position misses for which representations at non-final positions already rank the ground-truth item correctly. Our results provide a structural account linking extreme last-item reliance to residual dominance at inference time. The code is publicly available.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Transformer 序列推荐器中因果自注意力在推理时过度依赖最近一次交互的现象，提出“残差主导”（residual dominance）作为结构性解释。作者结合预测时诊断与注意力全块范数分析，发现残差连接使全块表示明显偏向同位置贡献，并用推理期残差缩放作为受控干预验证该机制。结果显示减小残差强度会在结构混合与最后项依赖之间产生单调权衡，并恢复部分最终位置漏判。
Motivation: SASRec 等模型在推理时严重依赖最后一次交互，但这种行为在用于预测的表示中如何被结构化地表达，此前尚不清楚。
Method: 将预测时诊断工具与完整注意力块的范数分析相结合，提出残差主导的概念；随后引入推理期残差缩放（inference-time residual scaling）作为受控诊断干预，通过改变残差强度观察结构混合程度与最后项依赖的变化。
Result: 摘要报告 SASRec 风格模型呈现高度局部的最后项依赖；残差加法使全块表示向同位置贡献急剧偏移；降低残差强度可恢复一部分在非最终位置表示已能正确排序真值项的最终位置漏判样本。
Conclusion: 作者给出了将极端最后项依赖归因于推理时残差主导的结构性解释，并公开代码；该工作聚焦推荐系统序列建模，未涉及天气或降水相关任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does More Correct Data Hurt? Insertion-Stability and the Limits of Dimension-Based Theory
papers.abstract_en: Adding data known to be correct ought to be safe. Not always. Larsen, Pabbaraju and Shetty model the failure with a monotone adversary, which reads an i.i.d. training sample and may append as many further examples as it likes, provided the target hypothesis labels them all. Mehrotra has since settled the cost, showing that for classes of VC dimension d >= 2 no learner can guarantee expected error better than Theta((d/n)log(en/d)), a logarithmic factor above the clean PAC rate. Because that rate is a worst case over all classes, it says nothing about which classes actually suffer the penalty, and the answer turns on the learner. We call a learner insertion-stable if feeding it more correctly labeled examples can only shrink the region where it errs. Such learners are immune to the adversary, since on any given sample the risk after insertions never exceeds the risk on the clean part alone, however much is added and however cleverly it is chosen. High- probability guarantees carry over unchanged, and because Closure is insertion-stable every intersection-closed class keeps its clean rate of E[Err] <= (21d+34)/n. Immunity is not something the classical dimensions can predict. Two classes can agree on VCdim = Ldim = 2 and still split, one at Theta(1/n) and the other at Theta(log(en)/n), while intervals have unbounded Littlestone dimension and are immune anyway. On Mehrotra's hard class we prove more than the failure of a single algorithm, showing that no monotone permutation-invariant compression scheme of any finite size attains the clean rate. The question is therefore not whether a class is hard, nor whether a learner is good, but whether the two suit each other. Given an insertion-stable learner that is optimal on clean data, correct additions are free, and without one the cost belongs to the class, so changing the learner will not avoid it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一个反直觉现象：向训练集添加已知正确的样本有时会提高期望误差。作者提出"插入稳定性"(insertion-stability)这一学习器性质，证明具备该性质的学习器对单调对手免疫，并指出经典维度理论（VC维、Littlestone维）无法预测哪些类别会遭受惩罚。论文进一步证明在 Mehrotra 的困难类别上，任何有限大小的单调置换不变压缩方案都无法达到干净数据下的最优率。
Motivation: 现有结果只给出最坏情况下的代价 Theta((d/n)log(en/d))，无法说明具体哪些类别会因加入正确数据而受损，答案取决于学习器本身。需要一种学习器层面的刻画来理解何时添加正确数据是安全的。
Method: 定义插入稳定学习器：向学习器喂入更多正确标注样本只会缩小其出错区域。作者分析 Closure 这一插入稳定学习器，并通过构造 VCdim 与 Ldim 相同但表现不同的类别对，以及研究 Mehrotra 困难类别上的压缩方案，论证维度理论解释力的界限。
Result: 两个 VCdim=Ldim=2 的类别可分别达到 Theta(1/n) 与 Theta(log(en)/n) 的期望误差；区间类拥有无界 Littlestone 维却仍然免疫。对任意交叉闭类，Closure 保持干净率 E[Err] <= (21d+34)/n。在 Mehrotra 的困难类别上，任何有限大小的单调置换不变压缩方案都无法达到干净率。
Conclusion: 添加正确数据是否无代价，取决于类别与学习器是否匹配：若存在对干净数据最优的插入稳定学习器，则正确样本的加入是免费的；否则代价归属于类别本身，更换学习器无法规避。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Emergent Models: Intelligence from Tiny Substrates
papers.abstract_en: Emergent Models (EMs) are a machine learning paradigm based on simple yet open-ended substrates, such as cellular automata, in which modeling is treated not as the learning of a closed-form input-output map but as the emergence, within simple dynamical systems, of computational behaviors that solve external tasks. Such substrates typically iterate a fixed local rule over a latent space for an adaptive number of steps, with an interface linking the latent state to external input/output signals. Training proceeds by evolutionary search. We hypothesize that some instances of this framework are biased toward global generalization: capturing the rule generating the data over its full domain, and therefore extrapolating beyond the training range. Theoretically, we prove that some EMs are latent-universal: with the update rule and interface held fixed, they can realize any partial computable function by varying only the initial condition of the latent state. Empirically, we study a zoo of minimal EM instantiations across discrete and continuous substrates, showing that local-recursive computation at a tiny scale (tens to hundreds of parameters) can extrapolate exactly on simple arithmetic functions, can support control behaviour and online adaptation, while still exposing several limitations. This work is foundational: it does not propose a competitive architecture, but a framework meant to widen the design space of machine learning beyond differentiable feed-forward maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种称为 Emergent Models (EMs) 的机器学习范式：将建模视为在简单开放端点阵（如元胞自动机）中涌现出解决外部任务的计算行为，而非学习封闭的输入输出映射。训练通过进化搜索进行，潜状态按自适应步数迭代固定局部规则。作者从理论上证明部分 EMs 具有潜在通用性 (latent-universal)，并在离散与连续基底上给出小规模实例的实证结果。
Motivation: 现有机器学习主要依赖可微的前馈映射学习封闭形式的输入输出关系，设计空间受限；该工作希望将建模扩展到更广泛的动力学系统涌现计算，以探索全局泛化与域外外推的可能性。
Method: 定义 Emergent Models 框架：基底在潜空间上迭代固定局部规则若干自适应用步数，并通过接口连接潜状态与外部输入/输出信号，训练采用进化搜索；理论上证明在更新规则与接口固定时，仅改变潜状态初值即可实现任意部分可计算函数 (partial computable function)。
Result: 理论上证明某些 EMs 是 latent-universal 的；实证上，仅含数十到数百参数的极小局部递归实例能在简单算术函数上精确外推，并支持控制行为与在线适应，但也暴露若干局限。
Conclusion: 该工作是基础性框架研究，并非提出竞争性架构，目的是拓宽机器学习在可微前馈映射之外的设计空间。
Relevance: 5
