papers.title: Content Based Video Narration of Gameplay with Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Live game commentary is scarce: it exists for professional esports broadcasts and almost nowhere else. We present a content-based video narration system that produces spoken, esports-style commentary for arbitrary gameplay recordings using a general-purpose vision-language model (VLM) and a text-to-speech back end, with no game-specific instrumentation, no engine telemetry, and no task-specific training. Three mechanisms carry the system. Temporal mosaic packing arranges nine uniformly sampled frames into a single 3x3 image, letting an image-native VLM reason about motion while consuming one image payload per segment instead of nine. Context-conditioned prompting replays the K most recent narrations as assistant-role history, suppressing the repetition that dominates per-segment captioning of static scenes. Duration-conditioned generation and elastic alignment constrain narration length in the prompt, then time-scale or symmetrically pad the synthesized audio so each utterance fills its segment slot exactly, giving frame-accurate muxing without a forced aligner. The implementation supports either cloud TTS or a 6-bit quantized 4B-parameter on-device TTS model on Apple silicon, making the speech stage fully local. We report a qualitative case study on real-time strategy footage, a cost model showing the mosaic reduces per-minute image payloads by 9x, and a candid account of observed failure modes - hallucinated game state, resolution loss from mosaicking, and prosody artifacts from time-scaling. We release the system as a reproducible baseline, with an evaluation protocol for the quantitative study a full version will report.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于内容的游戏视频解说系统，用通用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 加文本转语音后端，为任意游戏录制生成电竞风格的口语解说，无需游戏特定仪器、引擎遥测或任务特定训练。系统靠三个机制：时间马赛克打包 (temporal mosaic packing) 将九个均匀采样帧合成 3x3 单图，让图像原生 VLM 在单次图像载荷内感知运动；上下文条件提示复用最近的解说作为 assistant 历史以抑制重复；时长条件生成与弹性对齐约束解说长度并对合成音频做时间缩放或对称填充，实现无强制对齐器的帧精确混音。摘要报告了在实时战略 (RTS) 录像上的定性案例、马赛克使每分钟图像载荷降低约 9 倍的成本模型，以及若干观察到的失败模式。
Motivation: 现场游戏解说很稀缺，基本只存在于职业电竞转播；作者希望为任意游戏录像自动生成解说，且不依赖游戏引擎遥测或特定任务的专门训练。
Method: 系统由三个机制支撑：时间马赛克打包把九个帧排成一张 3x3 图像，使图像原生 VLM 能推理运动同时只消耗单图载荷；上下文条件提示把最近 K 条解说作为 assistant-role 历史回放以抑制静态场景逐段字幕常见的重复；时长条件生成与弹性对齐在提示中约束解说时长，再对合成音频做时间缩放或对称填充，使每段话语恰好填满对应分段。TTS 后端支持云端或 Apple silicon 上 6-bit 量化 4B 参数本地模型。

papers.title: MedClaw: Heuristic Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Surgical Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Understanding tens-of-minutes surgical videos requires long-horizon temporal reasoning, answering what happens before, after, or across stages of a procedure by grounding the question in visual evidence spread across time. Existing approaches handle this poorly: a one-shot vision-language model (VLM) compresses the whole procedure to fit its context window and loses the detail a "before" or "after" question depends on, while video agents that train the model where to look are data-hungry and transfer poorly to out-of-domain surgery. We build an agent harness that separates reasoning from perception and improves by evolving context rather than optimizing weights. A text-only orchestrator plans which evidence to gather and issues an auditable sequence of tool calls, while frozen vision-language sub-agents execute each call over the pixels, viewing, cropping, inspecting frames, and retrieving external knowledge. We further propose a gradient-free, reward-gated Heuristic Skill Distillation loop that mines the agent's own low-scoring traces and keeps a candidate skill only when it raises a validation reward, yielding reusable retrieval skills, notably directed re-look. Growing an external skill library rather than tuning weights, the loop adapts from only about 100 labeled examples, far fewer than supervised or reinforcement fine-tuning requires. To evaluate this agent, we introduce MedClawBench, a de-leaked, doctor-grounded benchmark of 1,123 questions over self-built long neurosurgery recordings and a held-out public lecture-video test split. Across both datasets and all four evaluation dimensions, our agent consistently outperforms one-shot VLMs and general video-agent frameworks, with the largest gains on the long, out-of-domain neurosurgery videos. Project page: https://fyycs.github.io/medclaw/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedClaw，一个面向数十分钟级手术视频长程时间推理的智能体框架，将推理与感知分离：文本编排器规划证据收集并发出可审计的工具调用，冻结的视觉语言子智能体负责执行帧查看、裁剪、检查与外部知识检索。作者还提出无梯度、奖励门控的启发式技能蒸馏循环，从自身低分轨迹中挖掘候选技能并仅保留能提升验证奖励的技能，从而构建可复用的外部技能库；同时引入去泄漏、医生标注的 MedClawBench 基准。摘要报告该方法在长时域、跨域神经外科视频上显著优于一次性 VLM 和通用视频智能体框架。
Motivation: 现有方法难以处理长时段手术视频中的“之前/之后/跨阶段”问题：一次性视觉语言模型 (VLM) 将整个视频压缩进上下文窗口，丢失回答时间关系问题所需的细节；而训练模型关注位置的视频智能体数据需求大且对域外手术迁移差。
Method: 构建一个分离推理与感知的智能体框架：文本专用编排器规划需要收集的证据并生成可审计的工具调用序列，冻结的视觉语言子智能体在像素层面执行每次调用。进一步提出无梯度、奖励门控的启发式技能蒸馏 (Heuristic Skill Distillation) 循环，挖掘并筛选低分轨迹中的候选技能，仅保留能提高验证奖励的技能，形成逐渐增长的外部技能库而非优化权重。
Result: 在 MedClawBench（1,123 道基于自建长时神经外科录像和公开讲座视频测试集的问题）上，MedClaw 在全部四个评估维度上均优于一次性 VLM 和通用视频智能体框架，其中在长时、域外神经外科视频上增益最大；该方法仅需约 100 个标注样本即可完成适应，远少于监督或强化微调所需。
Conclusion: 核心结论是：通过演进外部技能库而非微调权重，可以低成本地让智能体适应长时手术视频推理，并提升跨域泛化能力；该工作的评估场景限定在手术视频的视觉问答与时间推理上。

papers.title: Buy the Rumor, Sell the News: When Is News Priced In?
papers.abstract_en: Two old market sayings hold that news is already priced in by the time it is published, and that the rumor is bought while the news is sold. Both place the price move associated with a piece of news before and at publication rather than after it. Whether the claims hold, for which kinds of news, and by how much are basic questions about how fast markets absorb public information. We test them on 4.57 million financial news articles covering roughly 3,000 US stocks (2023-2026). A large language model teacher, distilled into a compact classifier through active learning, assigns each article one of 17 event tags and five attributes; articles are clustered into stories to separate first reports from follow-up coverage; and beta-adjusted abnormal returns are measured around the resulting 1.68 million stock-day events, with 364,405 neutral-sentiment events as a placebo group. Three results follow. First, the price move associated with news concentrates before and at publication: pooled across all signed events, the cumulative move in the news direction by the close of publication day is 2.8 times its value 20 days later, and for rumor-flagged events the rumor day captures the entire move while the subsequent confirmation contributes nothing. Second, measured against the placebo of comparable stocks, markets underreact to numbers and overreact to stories: quantified fundamental news (earnings, dividends, guidance, analyst actions) keeps drifting in the direction of the news for weeks, while soft story-driven news (launches, macro commentary, leadership) gives back its move. Third, news carries width as well as direction: publicity raises volatility before the publication day, and volatility declines once the news is out, because publication resolves uncertainty. The study also produces a table of measured drift for each event tag, usable as a prior in news-conditioned forecasting models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用457万篇金融新闻和约3000只美股（2023-2026）的事件数据，检验“新闻在发布前已定价”和“买谣言、卖新闻”两个市场说法。作者用LLM教师蒸馏出的紧凑分类器（配合主动学习）给文章打上17种事件标签和五个属性，再把文章聚成故事以区分首报和后续报道，并基于beta调整异常收益测度1.68百万个股票-日事件，另以364,405个中性情绪事件作安慰剂组。结果显示，价格变动集中在发布前和发布日；数字型基本面新闻持续漂移，而故事型软新闻随后回吐涨幅；新闻会提升发布前波动并在发布后降低波动。
Motivation: 核心问题是市场吸收公共信息的速度：新闻是否在发布前就被定价、不同种类新闻的定价时点和幅度差异有多大。作者以此检验两个流传已久的市场谚语。
Method: 方法包含三个环节：用蒸馏自LLM的紧凑分类器（主动学习标注）给每篇文章分配17个事件标签和5个属性；将相关文章聚类为故事，区分首次报道与跟进报道；围绕事件计算beta调整的异常收益，并用中性情绪事件作为安慰剂对照。
Result: 池化所有带符号事件后，发布日收盘前新闻方向的累计涨幅是20天后数值的2.8倍；对谣言标记事件，谣言日已捕获全部涨幅而后续确认无额外贡献。相对安慰剂组，市场对量化基本面新闻（盈利、分红、指引、分析师行为）在数周内持续漂移（反应不足），而对故事型新闻（发布、宏观评论、管理层变动）则回吐涨幅（反应过度）；新闻还使发布前波动率上升、发布后下降。
Conclusion: 摘要认为研究提供了每种事件标签的漂移测量表，可作为新闻条件预测模型的先验；未明确讨论局限，但结论范围限定在所测新闻类别与样本区间。

papers.title: EchoRec: Multi-Item Prediction-Empowered Generative Recommendation via Cycle-Consistent Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation autoregressively generates the semantic IDs of the target item, unifying preference modeling and index retrieval within the shared token space. Recent attempts have introduced Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) into this field, yet they primarily inherit its efficiency merit, leaving its potential as dense supervision unexplored. Unlocking this potential hinges on whether future behaviors qualify as informative supervision. Our analysis reveals that future behaviors carry a semantic echo of the current one far above that of random pairs, which nevertheless decays along horizons under intent transitions, making them informative yet order-dependent signals. Motivated by this, we propose EchoRec, which empowers MTP with cycle-consistent holistic preference alignment across multi-horizon for generative recommendation. It comprises two synergistic modules. Horizon-aware Preference Generation (HPG) sequentially chains lightweight auxiliary branches upon the base recommender, where each branch conditions on its predecessor to respect preference evolution. Verifiable Holistic-Preference Alignment (VHA) further consolidates them into the holistic preference and echoes it back through cycle-consistent projectors to suppress spurious alignment, with theoretical guarantees that exclude the rank-collapse form of spurious alignment under an invertible transport, enabling the holistic preference to be retained in the decoding representation. All auxiliary components serve as disposable scaffolding discarded at inference, introducing negligible online serving overhead. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate the superiority of our EchoRec, together with its naturally acquired multi-item generation ability. Our code and datasets will be available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EchoRec，针对生成式推荐（generative recommendation）中多 token 预测（MTP）的密集监督潜力未被开发的问题，引入跨多时间范围的循环一致偏好对齐。作者分析发现未来行为与当前行为存在远高于随机对的语义回响（semantic echo），但会随意图转移沿时间范围衰减，因此是有信息量且顺序依赖的信号。方法由两个模块组成：Horizon-aware Preference Generation（HPG）顺序串联轻量辅助分支，以及 Verifiable Holistic-Preference Alignment（VHA）通过循环一致投影器抑制伪对齐并给出理论保证；所有辅助组件在推理时丢弃。在三个数据集上的实验显示 EchoRec 优于基线，并自然获得多物品生成能力。
Motivation: 生成式推荐通过自回归生成目标物品的语义 ID，现有工作引入 MTP 主要继承其效率优势，未探索其作为密集监督的潜力。关键问题是未来行为是否构成有信息量的监督信号；作者的分析显示未来行为携带当前行为的语义回响但随水平衰减，因此是有信息量但顺序依赖的信号。
Method: EchoRec 包含两个协同模块：HPG 在基础推荐器上依次串联轻量辅助分支，每个分支以前一分支为条件以尊重偏好演化；VHA 将这些分支整合为整体偏好，并通过循环一致投影器（cycle-consistent projectors）回映该偏好以抑制伪对齐，在可逆传输（invertible transport）下提供排除秩坍缩形式伪对齐的理论保证，使整体偏好保留在解码表示中。所有辅助组件在推理阶段作为一次性脚手架被丢弃。
Result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明 EchoRec 优于现有方法，并自然获得多物品生成能力；摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为未来行为是可利用且顺序依赖的监督信号，循环一致的偏好对齐能够提升生成式推荐，同时推理时几乎不增加在线服务开销。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: EchoRec 包含两个协同模块：HPG 在基础推荐器上依次串联轻量辅助分支，每个分支以前一分支为条件以尊重偏好演化；VHA 将这些分支整合为整体偏好，并通过循环一致投影器（cycle-consistent projectors）回映该偏好以抑制伪对齐，在可逆传输（invertible transport）下提供排除秩坍缩形式伪对齐的理论保证，使整体偏好保留在解码表示中。所有辅助组件在推理阶段作为一次性脚手架被丢弃。
summary_sections.result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明 EchoRec 优于现有方法，并自然获得多物品生成能力；摘要未报告具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为未来行为是可利用且顺序依赖的监督信号，循环一致的偏好对齐能够提升生成式推荐，同时推理时几乎不增加在线服务开销。

papers.title: Identifiability and Order-Dimension Limits of In-Context Learning on Partial Orders
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning is commonly formalized as inference from examples of a function. Partial orders instead combine transitivity, antisymmetry, and incomparability, so a finite prompt may not determine a queried comparison. We develop a theory of in-context learning on partial orders that separates logical identifiability, prompt teaching cost, structural complexity, and the exact capacity of a formal coordinate-decoder class. A version-space semantics makes background knowledge and open- versus closed-world assumptions explicit. For finite open-world prompts with positive and negative comparisons, we prove an exact completion trichotomy: after taking the reflexive transitive closure of the positive demonstrations, a query is forced true, forced false because every true completion creates a cycle or violates a negative demonstration, or remains genuinely ambiguous. For a known $n$-element universe, we characterize the open-world teaching number as the number of covers plus a blocker-set hitting number, prove that its maximum over all $n$-element posets is $n(n-1)$ and is uniquely attained by the antichain, and identify the blocker term as the exact cost of open-world rather than complete-Hasse semantics. We formalize prompt-dependent $s$-coordinate decoders and use the classical coordinate-order equivalence to obtain an exact representation boundary: dimension at most $s$ is necessary and sufficient, while width at most $s$ is a convenient sufficient condition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为偏序集上的上下文学习 (in-context learning) 建立理论框架，把逻辑可辨识性、提示教学代价、结构复杂度与一类形式化坐标解码器的容量分开刻画。基于版本空间语义，作者证明有限开放世界提示下的补全三分律，并给出开放世界教学数、其最大值以及坐标解码器的精确表示边界。
Motivation: 上下文学习通常被形式化为从函数样例中进行推断，而偏序集同时包含传递性、反对称性和不可比性，因此有限提示未必能确定某个查询比较的结果。作者希望建立一套理论，把逻辑可辨识性与教学代价、结构复杂度等不同方面明确区分开。
Method: 采用版本空间 (version-space) 语义显式建模背景知识以及开放世界与封闭世界假设；对有限开放世界提示，先取正例的反射传递闭包，再判定查询被强制为真、强制为假或保持真正歧义。文中还形式化提示相关的 s-坐标解码器，并利用经典坐标-序等价关系刻画表示边界。
Result: 摘要报告了精确的补全三分律；开放世界教学数等于覆盖数 (covers) 加上一个 blocker 集的 hitting number，且在所有 n 元偏序集上最大值为 n(n-1)，唯一由反链 (antichain) 达到。表示边界方面，维数至多 s 是必要且充分条件，宽度至多 s 是方便的充分条件。
Conclusion: 作者强调 blocker 项精确衡量了开放世界语义相对于完备 Hasse 语义的额外教学代价，并给出坐标解码器类的精确容量边界。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Simulation-Driven Vehicular Traffic Data Augmentation: Extending Sensor Coverage Through Virtual Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Urban traffic management relies on sensor networks whose spatial coverage is limited by deployment costs and privacy regulations. Machine learning models trained on such sparse data cannot generalize to unmonitored locations and must be retrained whenever the sensor infrastructure changes. We propose a simulation-based methodology that addresses this problem by generating augmented traffic count datasets in which each physical sensor is replaced by a virtual sensor placed at a surrogate location in the road network. Virtual sensors are selected by a graph-search heuristic that jointly maximises vehicle-flow continuity and traffic-metric similarity between the original and surrogate locations, while enforcing a minimum spatial displacement to ensure diversity of observed traffic conditions. We validate the method on two Belgian cities: Brussels, using a calibrated model, and Namur, using synthetic models. The augmented datasets preserve the bimodal daily demand profile and the dynamics of traffic at the observed locations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于仿真的车辆交通数据增广方法，用路网中替代位置的虚拟传感器 (virtual sensor) 替换每个物理传感器，以扩展传感器覆盖、缓解稀疏数据问题。虚拟传感器由一种图搜索启发式算法选取，兼顾车流连续性 (vehicle-flow continuity) 与交通指标相似性，并施加最小空间位移以保证观测条件的多样性。方法在比利时布鲁塞尔（标定模型）和那慕尔（合成模型）两个城市验证，增广数据保留了观测位置的双峰日需求剖面和交通动态。
Motivation: 城市交通管理依赖传感器网络，但部署成本和隐私法规限制了空间覆盖；基于稀疏传感器数据训练的机器学习模型无法泛化到未监测位置，且传感器基础设施变化时需要重新训练。
Method: 提出仿真驱动的数据增广流程：利用路网仿真将每个物理传感器替换为替代位置上的虚拟传感器；通过图搜索启发式算法选择替代位置，联合最大化车流连续性与交通指标相似性，并强制最小空间位移以保证观测交通条件多样。
Result: 摘要报告在比利时布鲁塞尔（使用标定模型）和那慕尔（使用合成模型）两个城市上的验证，增广数据集能够保留双峰日需求分布和观测位置的交通动态。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过虚拟感知在替代位置生成增广流量数据集，从而在不改变物理基础设施的情况下扩展覆盖；验证范围限于两个比利时城市，其中那慕尔采用合成模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Content Depth Matters in Short-Video Recommendation: Rethinking the Attention Economy
papers.abstract_en: Driven by the attention economy, short-video Recommender Systems (RSs) are primarily optimized to maximize user engagement by promoting videos that capture attention within seconds. These systems inherently favor shallow-content videos that are effective at attracting immediate attention. However, growing evidence suggests that prolonged exposure to such content may negatively affect users' cognitive engagement and mental well-being, raising concerns about the long-term societal impact of the short-video platform. To tackle this challenge, this paper introduces a new metric, the \textbf{Content Depth Score (CDS)}, to quantify the content depth of short videos. CDS measures the extent to which a video is expected to stimulate higher-order cognitive processes, using a seven-level scale grounded in established theories of cognitive psychology and learning. As an initial step toward this vision, we present \textbf{SCOPE-Bench}, the first benchmark for content-depth evaluation in short-video recommendation. Built upon a large-scale open-source short-video dataset, SCOPE-Bench provides CDS annotations for 150K videos, enabling systematic evaluation of RSs from a cognitive-content perspective. Leveraging SCOPE-Bench, we evaluate 13 representative RSs and reveal a consistent preference for shallow-content videos. Moreover, we find that these algorithms recommending cognitively deep content are only marginally better than random selection, highlighting a previously overlooked limitation of existing recommendation objectives. Our code and datasets are available at https://liweidengdavid.github.io/SCOPE-Bench/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对短视频推荐系统受注意力经济驱动、天然偏好能迅速吸引注意力的浅层内容这一问题，提出内容深度评分 (Content Depth Score, CDS)，并基于大规模开源短视频数据集构建首个内容深度评估基准 SCOPE-Bench，为 150K 个视频提供 CDS 标注。利用该基准评估 13 个代表性推荐系统，发现这些算法一致偏向浅层内容，且推荐认知深度内容的算法仅比随机选择略好。
Motivation: 现有短视频推荐系统以最大化用户即时参与为目标，本质上偏爱浅层内容，而长期接触此类内容可能损害用户的认知参与和心理健康；但目前缺乏从认知内容角度系统评估推荐系统的指标与基准。
Method: 提出 CDS 指标，基于认知心理学和学习理论，以七级量表度量视频预期刺激高阶认知过程（higher-order cognitive processes）的程度；并构建 SCOPE-Bench，基于开源短视频数据集提供 150K 视频的 CDS 标注，用于从认知内容视角系统评估推荐系统。
Result: 摘要报告在 SCOPE-Bench 上评估 13 个代表性推荐系统，揭示它们对浅层内容存在一致偏好；推荐认知深度内容的算法只比随机选择略好，暴露出现有推荐目标此前被忽视的局限。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需要重新审视短视频推荐的优化目标，引入内容深度维度以缓解注意力经济带来的潜在负面影响；代码和数据集已公开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A Subjective Study on a New Sharpness Informed Class of Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Perceptual loss functions in Deep Neural Network (DNN) deblurring architectures improve the overall quality of restored images. However, few focus on explicitly targeting sharpness in the restorations. We conduct a subjective study of models trained with and without losses which explicitly target sharpness using a four-protocol approach, exploring preferred sharpness levels and effects on image quality. We introduce a novel dataset of images with uniform sharpness increments along with Difference Mean Opinion Scores (DMOS). Additionally, we propose a novel class of Sharpness Informed (SI) Image Quality Assessment (IQA) metrics which properly penalize over-sharpening. Our new SI-PSNR metric outperforms all other PSNR variants in terms of correlation statistics on IQA benchmarking datasets. We show that, on average, images restored using a sharpness-aware composite loss are preferred in 67% of binarized comparisons, as opposed to losses that do not explicitly target sharpness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 DNN 去模糊架构中的感知损失，研究显式针对锐度 (sharpness) 的损失对复原图像质量的影响，并开展主观研究。作者引入一个具有均匀锐度递增的图像数据集及对应的差异主观意见分 (DMOS)，同时提出一类锐度感知 (Sharpness Informed, SI) 的图像质量评估 (IQA) 指标，其中 SI-PSNR 在 IQA 基准上的相关统计优于其他 PSNR 变体。结果显示，使用锐度感知复合损失的复原图像在 67% 的二元比较中被偏好。
Motivation: 现有 DNN 去模糊中的感知损失虽然改善复原图像整体质量，但很少有损失显式针对复原结果的锐度；同时需要理解用户偏好的锐度水平以及过度锐化对图像质量的影响。
Method: 采用四种协议 (four-protocol approach) 的主观研究框架，对比使用和不使用显式锐度目标损失的训练模型；构建均匀锐度递增的新数据集并标注 DMOS；提出一类新的 SI-IQA 指标以合理惩罚过度锐化。
Result: 提出的 SI-PSNR 在 IQA 基准数据集上相关性统计优于所有其他 PSNR 变体；平均而言，使用锐度感知复合损失的复原图像在 67% 的二元比较中被偏好。
Conclusion: 摘要表明显式针对锐度的损失能提升用户对去模糊结果的偏好，且 SI 类指标能有效惩罚过度锐化；该工作聚焦于主观研究和锐度感知评估，未涉及天气或降水场景。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B on Apple Silicon: Fixing Deployment Bugs and Decreasing Looped Transformer Memory Overhead
papers.abstract_en: Nanbeige4.2-3B is a 3B-parameter agentic model built around a Looped Transformer (LT) that reuses one stack of layers for a second forward pass, adding effective depth without additional parameters. Evaluated on Apple Silicon (MPS), we identify five independent bugs which prevent the released checkpoint from running via Hugging Face transformers out of the box (including a silently-zeroed RoPE buffer and calls to removed transformers cache APIs). Furthermore, we show that fixing these bugs is still not sufficient for agentic tasks, due to the LT's layer-reuse strategy (which effectively doubles peak attention memory) used to achieve parameter efficiency. We thus introduce a chunked-prefill strategy which alleviates the incurred memory-capacity penalty, extending allowable context width by $2.7 \times$ on 32~GiB shared memory. However, even with the reduced memory overhead, we show that patches are required to render Nanbeige4.2-3B usable; resolving both system prompt and MPS-native memory bugs finally allows reliable evaluation on standard MCP and tool-calling benchmarks. On a subset of MCPMark, the debugged model completes up to 30\% of real agentic tasks (up from the original's 0\%), while, on BFCL, it is near-perfect at single tool calls (yet fails the majority of multi-tool tests). We release the patched checkpoint, system prompt optimizer, and evaluation harnesses at https://github.com/johnhalloran321/Nanbeige4.2-3B-mps-fix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Nanbeige4.2-3B 这一基于 Looped Transformer (LT) 的 3B 参数 agentic 模型，在 Apple Silicon (MPS) 上排查并修复了五个阻止官方 checkpoint 通过 Hugging Face transformers 直接运行的缺陷，包括被静默置零的 RoPE buffer 和调用已移除的 transformers 缓存 API。作者进一步指出，仅修复这些缺陷仍不足以用于 agentic 任务，因为 LT 的层复用策略会加倍峰值注意力内存；为此提出 chunked-prefill 策略，在 32 GiB 共享内存上将可用上下文宽度扩展约 2.7 倍。修复后的模型在 MCPMark 子集上可完成最多 30% 的真实 agentic 任务（原始模型为 0%），在 BFCL 上单工具调用近乎完美，但多数多工具测试仍失败。

Result: 在 32 GiB 共享内存上，chunked-prefill 将可用上下文宽度扩展约 2.7 倍；调试后的模型在 MCPMark 子集上可完成最多 30% 的真实 agentic 任务（原始为 0%），在 BFCL 上单工具调用近乎完美，但多数多工具测试失败。
Conclusion: 即使降低内存开销，仍需多处补丁才能让 Nanbeige4.2-3B 可用；作者发布了修补后的 checkpoint、系统提示词优化器和评估框架，强调 LT 参数效率策略与 agentic 部署之间的内存代价需要通过预填充切分等方式缓解。

papers.title: FIRM: Fine-Grained Intra-Token Representation of Masks for Remote Sensing Reasoning Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning segmentation requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to translate implicit instructions into precise pixel-level masks. MLLMs encode an image as visual tokens, each of which merges a group of image patches. In remote sensing images, small targets, thin structures, and adjacent instances can occupy different parts of the same visual token. Assigning a single binary mask label to such a token loses its internal spatial structure, causing nearby targets to merge and object boundaries to become coarse. To bridge this representational gap, we introduce FIRM, a Fine-grained Intra-token Representation of Masks. For each visual token, FIRM predicts a mask code that specifies an $r\times r$ binary sub-cell pattern rather than a single foreground/background label. Given a target identified by the MLLM, the complete grid of mask codes is predicted in one mask pass. Fixed lookup converts the predicted codes into a discrete sub-cell mask, while marginalizing the code distribution yields a soft structural field. To further recover fine-grained boundaries within each sub-cell, we introduce a lightweight continuous renderer that refines this field using pre-merge visual features and image details. Across five reasoning and referring segmentation benchmarks on satellite and UAV images, FIRM achieves leading results, including $70.5/80.5$ gIoU/cIoU on LaSeRS and a $3.0$-point average gain on EarthReason. These results demonstrate the value of explicitly representing intra-token mask patterns for fine-grained MLLM segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感图像推理分割中视觉 token 丢失内部空间结构的问题，提出 FIRM（Fine-grained Intra-token Representation of Masks）。FIRM 为每个视觉 token 预测一个表示 r×r 二值子单元模式的掩码码（mask code），并配合轻量连续渲染器细化子单元内边界。在五个卫星和无人机图像的推理/指代分割基准上取得领先结果，包括 LaSeRS 上 70.5/80.5 的 gIoU/cIoU 和 EarthReason 上平均 3.0 点的增益。
Motivation: 遥感图像中的小目标、细结构和相邻实例可能占据同一视觉 token 的不同部分，而 MLLM 将每个 token 赋予单一二值掩码标签会丢失内部空间结构，导致相邻目标合并、边界粗糙。
Method: 为每个视觉 token 预测一个 r×r 的二进制子单元模式作为掩码码，而不是单个前景/背景标签；在 MLLM 识别目标后一次性预测完整掩码码网格，用固定查找表将码转换为离散子单元掩码，并对码分布做边际化得到软结构场；随后用轻量连续渲染器，结合合并前的视觉特征和图像细节细化子单元内的细粒度边界。
Result: 在卫星和 UAV 图像的五个推理与指代分割基准上取得领先结果，包括 LaSeRS 上 70.5/80.5 的 gIoU/cIoU，以及 EarthReason 上平均 3.0 点的增益。
Conclusion: 摘要认为显式表示 token 内的掩码模式对于细粒度 MLLM 分割具有价值，实验结果支持该方法的有效性。

papers.title: ProFocus: Interpreting Affective Experience in Artistic Images with Progressive Visual Focusing
papers.abstract_en: Interpreting the emotional responses triggered by images is central to achieving emotional intelligence. Compared with natural images, visual art is intentionally created to elicit emotional responses from its viewers through abstract concepts and visual metaphors, making affective interpretation particularly challenging. However, most existing methods rely on general-purpose visual embeddings (e.g., CLIP), failing to capture the nuanced cues underlying artistic emotion. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{ProFocus}, a novel framework that models affective experience in artistic images via progressive visual focusing. The key idea is to model visual representation learning inspired by a hierarchical cognitive theory of human aesthetic appreciation. Technically, ProFocus contains two core components: a Hierarchical Art Critic (HAC) and a Progressive Hint Fusion (PHF) module. HAC leverages multimodal large language models to generate structured linguistic priors at three cognitive levels--atmospheric style, narrative subjects, and concrete details--thereby translating artistic perception into coherent semantic guidance. Building upon these priors, PHF departs from conventional cross-modal fusion by sequentially injecting the hierarchical hints into visual features, enabling a progressive focusing process that mirrors human perception. This design allows the model to capture subtle affective cues and produce more faithful explanations. Extensive experiments on the ArtEmis v1.0 and v2.0 datasets demonstrate that ProFocus consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both emotion recognition and affective explanation. Project page: https://github.com/Zhang-Zhiyan/ProFocus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProFocus 框架，用于解释艺术图像中的情感体验。该框架受人类审美欣赏的层次认知理论启发，通过渐进式视觉聚焦来建模情感，包含层次化艺术评论家 (Hierarchical Art Critic, HAC) 和渐进提示融合 (Progressive Hint Fusion, PHF) 两个核心组件。在 ArtEmis v1.0 和 v2.0 数据集上，ProFocus 在情感识别和情感解释任务上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有情感识别方法多依赖通用视觉嵌入（如 CLIP），难以捕捉艺术图像中通过抽象概念和视觉隐喻传达的细微情感线索；艺术图像的情感解释比自然图像更具挑战性，需要更有针对性的建模。
Method: ProFocus 利用多模态大语言模型 (multimodal LLM) 在三个认知层次（氛围风格、叙事主体、具体细节）生成结构化语言先验，然后通过 PHF 模块将这些层次化提示顺序注入视觉特征，实现模仿人类感知的渐进式视觉聚焦过程。
Result: 在 ArtEmis v1.0 和 v2.0 数据集上的大量实验表明，ProFocus 在情感识别和情感解释任务上均一致优于最先进方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将层次化认知先验与渐进式提示融合相结合，能够帮助模型捕捉细微情感线索并生成更忠实的情感解释；该方法的适用范围和局限在摘要中未进一步说明。

papers.title: Rethinking Auxiliary Modalities in Multimodal Zero-shot Anomaly Detection: From Semantic Fusion to Conditional Modulation
papers.abstract_en: Recent foundation model-based methods have endowed RGB images with strong zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) through vision-language pretraining. However, RGB observations alone remain limited in perceiving anomalies dominated by geometric deformation, depth variation, or subtle surface changes. Auxiliary modalities can provide complementary structural information, but existing multimodal methods typically fuse them directly into a shared semantic space, which may disturb the text-aligned anomaly semantics established by RGB foundation models and often requires modality-specific architectures. To address this issue, we propose a plug-and-play auxiliary-conditioned enhancement framework for zero-shot anomaly detection. Instead of reconstructing a joint multimodal anomaly semantic space, our framework preserves the original RGB image-text anomaly matching pathway and uses auxiliary observations as conditional signals for RGB feature refinement, allowing auxiliary modalities to seamlessly enhance existing RGB-based zero-shot anomaly detectors. Specifically, a lightweight meta-learning module takes global RGB and auxiliary representations as input and generates sample-adaptive low-rank residual updates to determine how RGB features should be refined. We further construct uncertainty-aware spatial modulation from the initial RGB anomaly response and auxiliary reliability, which determines where local residual updates are strengthened or suppressed. This global-to-local conditional modulation enables selective multimodal enhancement while preserving the original RGB anomaly semantics. Extensive experiments on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies demonstrate that our framework consistently improves multiple popular RGB-based zero-shot anomaly detectors, achieving state-of-the-art performance for multimodal zero-shot anomaly detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种即插即用的辅助条件增强框架用于零样本异常检测（zero-shot anomaly detection），不重建联合多模态语义空间，而是保留原始RGB图像-文本异常匹配路径，将辅助模态作为条件信号用于RGB特征细化。框架通过轻量元学习模块生成样本自适应的低秩残差更新，并结合不确定性感知的空间调制实现从全局到局部的条件调制。在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies上的实验表明，该方法能一致提升多种流行的RGB基础零样本异常检测器并取得最先进性能。
Motivation: RGB观测单独难以感知几何形变、深度变化或细微表面变化主导的异常，而现有多模态方法通常把辅助模态直接融合进共享语义空间，可能干扰RGB基础模型已建立的文本对齐异常语义，且常需要模态特定架构。
Method: 提出即插即用的辅助条件增强框架，保留原始RGB图像-文本异常匹配通路，用辅助观测作为条件信号进行RGB特征精化。轻量元学习模块以全局RGB和辅助表示为输入，生成样本自适应的低秩残差更新；进一步从初始RGB异常响应和辅助可靠性构造不确定性感知空间调制，决定局部残差更新的增强或抑制。
Result: 在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies上的大量实验表明，该框架一致提升多个流行的RGB零样本异常检测器，并达到多模态零样本异常检测的最新最优性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这种从全局到局部的条件调制方式能够在保留原始RGB异常语义的同时实现选择性多模态增强，且框架无需针对特定模态架构改动，可作为即插即用模块增强现有RGB检测器。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PPOM: Marginalizing Patch-Grid Phase for CLIP-Based Generalizable Vision-Language Prompt Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Prompt tuning adapts CLIP-based vision-language models with few trainable parameters, yet its predictions remain sensitive to the spatial sampling imposed by a frozen vision transformer. In particular, non-overlapping patch tokenization makes predictions depend on the alignment (phase) between image and the patch lattice. To reduce prediction sensitivity to patch-grid alignment, we introduce Patch-Phase Orbit Marginalization (PPOM), a training-free inference operator that treats phase shift as a nuisance variable. Given a patch stride, PPOM evaluates the identity view and reflection-padded translations, pairs opposite shifts into horizontal, vertical, and diagonal antithetic families, and assigns equal mass to these families and the identity prediction to avoid view-count bias during phase integration. In summary, PPOM provides a deterministic interface between prompt adaptation and patch-grid sensitivity. Across multiple prompt-learning hosts, PPOM improves host performance without re-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 CLIP 视觉语言模型提示调优 (prompt tuning) 对冻结视觉 Transformer 空间采样敏感的问题，提出 Patch-Phase Orbit Marginalization (PPOM)，一种无需训练的推理算子。PPOM 将 patch-grid 相位偏移视为 nuisance variable，在给定 patch stride 下评估 identity view 与反射填充平移，将相反偏移配对成水平、垂直与对角 antithetic families，并赋予这些 family 与 identity 预测相等权重以避免视图数量偏差。摘要称在多个 prompt-learning host 上无需重新训练即可提升宿主性能。
Motivation: 基于 CLIP 的提示调优虽然参数量少，但预测仍受冻结视觉 Transformer 施加的空间采样影响，尤其是非重叠 patch tokenization 使预测依赖于图像与 patch 网格之间的对齐相位 (phase)，这种敏感性尚未被专门处理。
Method: PPOM 是一种训练无关的推理算子，把相位平移作为干扰变量进行边缘化；具体做法是按 patch stride 构造 identity view 与反射填充的平移视图，将相反方向偏移配对为水平、垂直和对角 antithetic families，并对 identity 预测与各 family 赋予等权重以消除视图数量偏差。
Result: 摘要报告 PPOM 在多种 prompt-learning host 上均能提升宿主性能，且不需要重新训练；未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: PPOM 为提示适应与 patch-grid 敏感性之间提供了确定性的接口，是一种即插即用的推理端方法，适合已有提示调优模型的改进。

papers.title: SAFE: Scene-Aware Feature Modulation for Color Constancy with Learned Color Space in Pure-Color Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Color constancy on pure-color scenes is challenging: when most pixels share a narrow band of hues, every chromaticity-based cue collapses to a single point and standard estimators become ambiguous. We propose a compact framework that couples two innovations: (i) SAFE, a Scene-Aware FeaturE modulation network that organizes illumination cues into a structured four-token representation, which is then selectively reweighted based on scene complexity features; (ii) the Learned Color Space (LCS), a scene-dependent chromaticity normalization that directly addresses the chromaticity collapse problem for pure-color scenes. Experiment results show that SAFE consistently improves performance in pure-color scenes. Compared to the best-performing baseline in each metric, it reduces the mean angular error by 10%, the best-25% error by 20%, and the worst-25% error by 5.8%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对纯色场景下颜色恒常性 (color constancy) 的挑战，提出 SAFE（场景感知特征调制网络）与 Learned Color Space (LCS) 两个创新模块。SAFE 将光照线索组织为四 token 结构并根据场景复杂度特征选择性加权，LCS 则实现场景相关的色度归一化以缓解纯色场景中的色度坍缩。实验表明在纯色场景中，该方法相比各指标最佳基线将平均角度误差降低 10%，最佳 25% 误差降低 20%，最差 25% 误差降低 5.8%。
Motivation: 当图像中大部分像素集中在狭窄色带时，所有基于色度的线索坍缩为单点，标准颜色恒常性估计器变得不可靠，现有方法难以处理纯色场景。
Method: 提出 SAFE 网络，将光照线索整合为结构化四 token 表示，并依据场景复杂度特征进行选择性重加权；同时提出 Learned Color Space (LCS)，一种场景相关的色度归一化方法，直接应对纯色场景的色度坍缩问题。
Result: 摘要报告在纯色场景中相比各指标最佳基线，平均角度误差 (mean angular error) 降低 10%，最佳 25% 误差降低 20%，最差 25% 误差降低 5.8%。
Conclusion: 作者强调场景感知的特征调制与场景相关色度空间相结合，能持续提升纯色场景下的颜色恒常性性能。

papers.title: QUASAR: Lowering the Loss Floor of Quantization-Aware Training with Loss-Aware Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: As large language model inference shifts toward lower precision, post-training quantization (PTQ) becomes increasingly brittle, making quantization-aware training (QAT) essential for preserving model quality. However, QAT computes the loss and surrogate gradients using a lossy reconstruction of latent full-precision weights, while applying updates to the latent weights themselves. This mismatch can lead to suboptimal training trajectories and a higher loss floor. Second-order PTQ methods mitigate a similar gap by minimizing loss-aware reconstruction error, but doing it once for a frozen model can take hours; repeating this process throughout QAT as the weights evolve is impractical. We introduce QUASAR, a QAT method that continuously performs lightweight, loss-aware reconstruction in the training loop to lower the loss floor and improve the resulting low-bit model. At each training step, QUASAR uses the exponential moving average of squared gradients as online saliency estimates, searches over a small set of clipping ranges, and fits affine dequantizers via saliency-weighted least squares. Our analysis shows that the loss-aware reconstruction error is the only reconstruction-dependent term in the QAT convergence bound and controls the loss of the final quantized model, establishing QUASAR's objective as a principled optimization target. QUASAR modifies only the training procedure and supports standard deployment formats, including integer quantization and NVFP4, with no inference-time changes or overhead. Across Qwen3 and Llama-3.1, QUASAR achieves the lowest held-out KL divergence among competitive QAT methods at 2, 3, and 4 bits, reducing KL by at least 10% at 3 and 4 bits and by 29% at 2 bits. At 2 bits, it improves average accuracy across eight tasks by 3.5-4.3 percentage points over strong QAT and PTQ baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QUASAR，一种在量化感知训练 (QAT) 训练循环中持续执行轻量级损失感知重建 (loss-aware reconstruction) 的方法。QUASAR 使用平方梯度的指数移动平均作为在线显著性估计、在小范围候选内搜索截断区间，并通过显著性加权最小二乘拟合仿射反量化器。分析表明损失感知重建误差是 QAT 收敛界中唯一与重建相关的项，并控制最终量化模型的损失。在 Qwen3 和 Llama-3.1 上，QUASAR 在 2/3/4 bit 下取得最低的保留集 KL 散度。
Motivation: 低精度推理下后训练量化 (PTQ) 变得脆弱，QAT 变得必要；但 QAT 用有损的全精度权重重建来计算损失和代理梯度，却把更新施加在潜在全精度权重上，这种不匹配导致次优训练轨迹和更高的损失下限。二阶 PTQ 方法通过最小化损失感知重建误差缓解类似问题，但对冻结模型一次性执行需数小时，在训练过程中反复进行不现实。
Method: QUASAR 在每个训练步骤中持续进行轻量损失感知重建：用平方梯度的指数移动平均作为在线显著性估计，在小规模截断范围集合上搜索，并通过显著性加权最小二乘拟合仿射反量化器。该方法只修改训练流程，支持整数量化和 NVFP4 等标准部署格式，推理时无需改动或额外开销。
Result: 摘要报告在 Qwen3 和 Llama-3.1 上，QUASAR 在 2、3、4 bit 下均取得 QAT 方法中最低的保留集 KL 散度：3 和 4 bit 下 KL 至少降低 10%，2 bit 下降低 29%；在 2 bit 下，八项任务的平均准确率比强 QAT 与 PTQ 基线提升 3.5–4.3 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者通过分析确立 QUASAR 的目标是原则性的优化对象，理由是损失感知重建误差控制最终量化模型的损失；该方法通过降低损失下限改善低比特模型质量，且不引入推理期开销。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Polar Code Based Federated Learning: Convergence Analysis and Resource Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed devices without sharing raw data; however, it faces significant communication bottlenecks and channel impairments in practice. Conventional network layer treatments either idealize the channel as error free or apply equal error protection (EEP) to transmitted model updates, failing to account for the inherently unequal importance of quantization bits within a single local model. To address this limitation, we propose a cross layer polar code based FL scheme that leverages the unequal error protection (UEP) property of polar codes under finite block lengths. Specifically, the proposed design selectively protects more significant quantization bits, thereby mitigating the detrimental effects of channel noise. We further provide a rigorous convergence analysis of the proposed scheme, deriving an upper bound on the convergence gap, which we then jointly optimize over the number of quantization bits and the polar code block length across all training iterations. Experimental results demonstrate that both constant and variable block length configurations of our polar code based scheme consistently achieve substantial performance gains over uncoded and LDPC-based EEP benchmarks, with the advantage becoming increasingly pronounced as the channel quality deteriorating. These findings confirm the efficacy of our cross-layer design in enhancing FL robustness and efficiency under realistic channel conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种跨层极化码 (polar code) 联邦学习方案，利用极化码在有限块长下的不等差错保护 (UEP) 特性，对本地模型更新中更重要的量化比特给予更强保护。作者给出该方案的收敛性分析，推导收敛间隙上界，并联合优化量化比特数与极化码块长。实验表明，常数与可变块长配置均持续优于未编码和基于 LDPC 的等差错保护 (EEP) 基准，且信道质量越差优势越明显。
Motivation: 联邦学习中分布式训练面临通信瓶颈与信道损伤，而传统网络层处理要么假设信道无差错，要么对所有模型更新比特采用等差错保护 (EEP)，忽略了单个本地模型中不同量化比特重要性的差异。
Method: 提出跨层设计：利用极化码的UEP特性选择性保护更重要的量化比特，以缓解信道噪声影响；推导训练收敛间隙上界，并在所有训练轮次上联合优化量化比特数与极化码块长，支持常数与可变块长两种配置。
Result: 摘要报告收敛性分析得到收敛间隙的显式上界；实验显示所提极化码方案在常数与可变块长下均比未编码和 LDPC 的 EEP 基准有显著性能提升，且信道质量恶化时增益更明显。
Conclusion: 作者认为该跨层设计能够在实际信道条件下增强联邦学习的鲁棒性与效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Implementing Computational Law in Wolfram Language for the Governance of Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: How do we govern AI systems whose reasoning we cannot fully inspect? Governance does not require understanding a system's reasoning. It requires stating what the system is obliged, permitted, and forbidden to do, and checking whether it complied. I present an implementation of Reified Input/Output Logic, the formalism behind the DAPRECO knowledge base, in Wolfram Language: the core I/O axioms, obligations, permissions, constitutive norms, reified eventualities, and temporal operators. I then test whether GPT-4 can translate English legal statements into the formalism, and report the failures: hallucinated functions, omitted temporal scope, deviation from the formalism, and (in the worst cases) code that runs, reads plausibly, but silently encodes the wrong norm. A case study, an AI guard dog operating under a computational contract, shows how formalized rules can extend from a contract directly into the operational code of an embodied agent, producing symbolic, auditable justifications for its behaviour. I argue that computational law can be used as a governance tool and that a desirable goal would be to formalize the law that can and ought to be programmatically executable.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, 12 code listings. Wolfram Language implementation and verification script (31 assertions) available at https://github.com/Zaffer/research-computational-law
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Wolfram Language 中实现了 DAPRECO 知识库背后的 Reified Input/Output Logic 形式体系，包括核心 I/O 公理、义务、许可、构成性规范 (constitutive norms)、具体化事件 (reified eventualities) 与时间算子，并将其作为 AI 治理工具。摘要报告了 GPT-4 将英文法律陈述翻译为该形式体系时的各类失败模式，并通过一个受计算契约约束的 AI 守护犬案例展示形式化规则如何直接延伸到具身智能体的运行代码，产生可审计的符号化行为理由。
Motivation: 如何治理无法完全审查其推理过程的 AI 系统：治理不必理解系统推理，而需要明确系统被要求、被允许和被禁止做什么，并检查是否符合要求，这需要可执行的形式化法律表述。
Method: 用 Wolfram Language 实现 Reified Input/Output Logic（DAPRECO 知识库背后的形式体系），并用 GPT-4 将英文法律陈述自动翻译为该形式体系，同时通过 AI 守护犬案例展示从计算契约延伸至具身智能体运行代码的实践路径。
Result: 摘要报告 GPT-4 翻译存在多种失败模式：幻觉函数 (hallucinated functions)、遗漏时间范围、偏离形式体系，最严重的情况下代码可运行、读起来合理却静默编码了错误规范；案例研究则表明形式化规则可产生符号化、可审计的行为理由。
Conclusion: 作者认为计算法 (computational law) 可以作为 AI 治理工具，并主张一个理想目标是形式化那些能够且应当以程序化方式执行的法律。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HELIX: Model-Harness Co-evolution for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Scaling agent capability has largely focused on improving the model, yet an interactive agent acts through a runtime harness that mediates context, tools, control flow, and stopping. The harness shapes both what a model can accomplish and the trajectories from which it learns. This coupling motivates model-harness co-evolution for recursive self-improvement: build harnesses for a fixed model, update the model from verified sibling trajectories, and rebuild the harnesses as model capabilities change. Realizing this loop requires a controlled way to evolve harnesses while preserving intervention identity and effect. We present HELIX, a source-traceable substrate for harness evolution. HELIX decomposes agent systems into typed ports, reusable atoms, recipes, product shells, and runtime policies. It makes interventions explicit and auditable while retaining trajectories, test outcomes, and provenance. Harness evolution thus serves two linked roles: improving fixed-model execution and producing matched successes, regressions, near misses, and alternative solutions as data for subsequent model improvement. We evaluate HELIX in one evolution round on code repair. A 65-candidate portfolio discovers a fixed harness that improves task coverage by 4.0% over Pi, while the full portfolio exposes up to 58.0% more verified coverage through complementary sibling behavior. Selected candidates are assessed with repeated runs and the SWE-bench evaluator. A 200-slot sibling slice yields 438 verified SFT, critic, filter, and preference records. These results show how harness, model, and data form a feedback system: harness evolution expands current capability and creates learning signal for the next model; model updates motivate the next round of harness evolution. HELIX provides an auditable interface for studying this recursive process. Code is available at https://github.com/HKUDS/HELIX.

papers.title: Fast Implicit Neural Light Field Representation via Geometric Decomposition and Multi-Resolution Low-Rank Features
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representations provide a compact and continuous way to reconstruct dense light fields from sampled ray coordinates. However, fast light field reconstruction remains challenging because a light field is a high-dimensional signal with strong spatial-angular redundancy and structured disparity variations. Directly fitting 4D ray coordinates with a neural network often requires considerable optimization time to recover both view appearance and cross-view consistency. To address this issue, this paper proposes a fast implicit light field representation based on geometric decomposition and multi-resolution low-rank features. The proposed method decomposes a 4D light field into a horizontal disparity plane, a spatial texture plane, and a vertical disparity plane. Each plane is represented by a low-rank structure that combines a low-resolution 2D grid with the element-wise product of two high-resolution 1D line features at multiple resolution levels. The fused features are decoded by a lightweight multilayer perceptron to predict RGB values. Experiments on public light field datasets show that the proposed method achieves competitive reconstruction quality while providing a better trade-off among model parameters, training time, and inference efficiency.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, submitted to IEEE CYBER 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对隐式神经光场重建速度慢的问题，提出一种基于几何分解和多分辨率低秩特征的快速隐式光场表示方法。该方法将4D光场分解为水平视差平面、空间纹理平面和垂直视差平面，每部分用低秩结构表示，并通过轻量级多层感知机解码RGB。公共光场数据集上的实验表明，该方法能在重建质量有竞争力的同时，在模型参数、训练时间和推理效率之间取得更好的权衡。
Motivation: 光场是带强空间-角度冗余与结构化视差变化的高维信号，直接对4D射线坐标进行隐式神经网络拟合需要大量优化时间，难以同时恢复视图外观和跨视图一致性。
Method: 将4D光场分解为水平视差平面、空间纹理平面和垂直视差平面，每个平面用低秩结构表示，即低分辨率2D网格与两个高分辨率1D线特征的逐元素乘积在多分辨率级别上的组合，融合后的特征由轻量级多层感知机解码预测RGB值。
Result: 在公共光场数据集上，方法取得有竞争力的重建质量，并在模型参数、训练时间和推理效率之间提供更好的权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调几何分解与多分辨率低秩特征可加速隐式光场重建，并改善参数、训练与推理的综合效率。

papers.title: Musical Mirrors: The LLM as Sounding Board in Songwriting
papers.abstract_en: This paper examines a use of AI in creative practice as an interpretive sounding board for human-generated material, rather than the more familiar pattern of AI generation followed by human curation. Through the lens of resonance as theorized by Hartmut Rosa, I present a first-person case study of songwriting from July 2025 to March 2026, drawing on 16 original pieces in English, French, and other languages along with piano solos. I describe a configuration in which resonance is not located between user and model, but in the author's deepening contact with their own material, mediated through the model. This kind of resonance was supported rather than inhibited by AI when sounding-board behavior was cultivated through sustained calibration by the user. Two failure modes appeared when calibration was absent: sycophantic drift and magical overinterpretation. This account suggests both the potential and the risks of AI as an interpretive partner in creative practice.
papers.comment: In Proceedings of The First Reflection in Creative Experience (RiCE) Workshop (RiCE W1) arXiv:2607.24558
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI在创意实践中作为“解释性共鸣板”（interpretive sounding board）来回应人类既有素材的用法，而非常见的“AI生成后人工策展”模式。作者以Hartmut Rosa的共鸣理论为框架，基于2025年7月至2026年3月的第一人称歌曲创作案例研究（16首英语、法语等语言的原创作品及钢琴独奏）展开分析。文中描述了一种配置：共鸣不发生在用户与模型之间，而是通过模型中介，发生在作者与自身素材的深入接触中。当用户通过持续校准培养“共鸣板”行为时，AI支持而非抑制这种共鸣；缺乏校准时出现两种失败模式：谄媚漂移（sycophantic drift）和魔法式过度解读（magical overinterpretation）。
Motivation: 现有AI创意工具多聚焦于AI生成内容再由人类筛选，较少探讨AI作为解释性伙伴来回响人类已有素材的实践模式，以及这种模式在何种条件下成立或失效。
Method: 采用第一人称案例研究方法，结合Hartmut Rosa的共鸣理论，考察作者在歌曲创作过程中与16首多语言作品及钢琴独奏的互动，分析通过用户持续校准塑造模型“共鸣板”行为的配置，以及无校准时的失败模式。
Result: 摘要报告，在用户持续校准下，AI作为共鸣板支持而非抑制作者与自身素材的深层接触；缺乏校准时出现谄媚漂移与魔法式过度解读两类失败模式。
Conclusion: 该研究提示AI作为创意实践中解释性伙伴的潜力与风险，强调持续校准对于维持“共鸣板”行为的重要性；结论基于第一人称单一案例，推广性有限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AI Research Preference Models
papers.abstract_en: AI research agents (AIRA) can now propose, implement, and evaluate their own machine learning experiments, but progress on frontier tasks is throttled by cost: a candidate solution can be written in minutes, whereas evaluating it can take hours to days of GPU time. An agent can therefore propose far more candidates than it can afford to run, and its progress depends on its research preference: how it allocates a fixed execution budget across many candidates. We introduce AI Research Preference Models (RPMs) that predict which of multiple candidate solutions are most worth executing, without paying the cost of executing them all. We build RPMs from frozen pretrained language models (with no task-specific training), in two forms: an inference-only model that reasons over candidate plans, code, and prior executed solutions, and an agentic model that additionally runs small-scale pilot experiments before deciding. We integrate both into the AIRA-dojo search agent and evaluate on AIRS-Bench, a recent benchmark of machine learning research tasks for AI research agents. The two variants raise the average normalized score from 0.684 to 0.711 and 0.729 respectively, and reach the unguided agent's 24-hour performance in roughly 15 hours, using less than two-thirds of its execution budget. Our best RPMs also yield new state-of-the-art results on two AIRS-Bench tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 AI 研究偏好模型 (RPM)，用于在 AI 研究代理 (AIRA) 中预测哪些候选实验方案最值得执行，从而在有限的 GPU 预算下更高效地推进机器学习研究。RPM 基于冻结的预训练语言模型构建，包含仅推理和可运行小型试点实验的智能体两种变体，并集成到 AIRA-dojo 搜索代理中。在 AIRS-Bench 基准上，两种变体将平均归一化分数从 0.684 提升至 0.711 和 0.729，并在约 15 小时内达到无引导代理 24 小时的性能，消耗不到三分之二的执行预算；最佳 RPM 还在两个 AIRS-Bench 任务上取得了新的最优结果。
Motivation: AI 研究代理可以快速提出、实现和评估自己的机器学习实验，但前沿任务的进展受限于评估成本：候选方案很快写完，而评估需要数小时到数天的 GPU 时间。代理能提出的候选远多于能实际运行的，因此其进展取决于如何在固定执行预算下分配资源，需要一种低成本预测候选方案价值的方法。
Method: 引入 AI 研究偏好模型 (RPM)，从冻结的预训练语言模型构建且无需任务特定训练，包含两种形式：仅推理模型，对候选计划、代码和先前已执行方案进行推理；智能体模型，在决策前额外运行小规模试点实验。两种模型均集成进 AIRA-dojo 搜索代理。
Result: 在 AIRS-Bench 基准上，两个变体分别将平均归一化分数从 0.684 提升到 0.711 和 0.729，约 15 小时即可达到无引导代理 24 小时的表现，且执行预算不到三分之二；最佳 RPM 在两个 AIRS-Bench 任务上取得新的最优结果。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过偏好模型优先选择值得执行的候选方案，可以在不牺牲最终性能的前提下显著节省 AI 研究代理的执行预算。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CMCNet: Aligning Ultrasound Image Embeddings with Textual TI-RADS Representations for Fine-Grained Thyroid Classification
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound is the primary imaging modality for assessing thyroid nodules, and the ACR TI-RADS framework standardizes diagnosis through five ultrasound feature categories that are aggregated into five risk levels (TR1-TR5). Although widely adopted in clinical practice, most deep learning approaches focus on binary malignancy classification, while multi-class prediction and explicit utilization of feature-level supervision remain underexplored, largely due to limited annotated data. In this study, we introduce the STN dataset of 600 thyroid nodules with paired transverse and longitudinal ultrasound images, bounding box annotations, and complete labels for all five TI-RADS feature categories. Following the clinical decision process, we investigate how structured feature information can guide representation learning during training while requiring only images at inference. We demonstrate that text embeddings derived from standardized feature descriptions form a stable surrogate representation for TI-RADS risk levels. Based on this observation, we propose CMCNet, which aligns image embeddings to fixed textual embeddings via a Center-Margin Contrastive Loss that simultaneously promotes intra-class compactness and inter-class separation. Experimental results show that this embedding alignment strategy is more data-efficient and robust than direct multitask learning, and consistently outperforms InfoNCE, center loss, a strong multitask baseline, and a VQA-style multimodal model, particularly in imbalanced settings. The dataset is freely available at doi: 10.5281/zenodo.19125693 and the source code is available at: https://www.healthinformaticslab.org/supp/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CMCNet，通过 Center-Margin Contrastive Loss 将超声图像嵌入与基于 TI-RADS 标准化特征描述生成的固定文本嵌入对齐，用于甲状腺结节的细粒度分类。作者构建并公开了 STN 数据集（600 个结节，含横切/纵切配对图像、边界框及五类 TI-RADS 特征标签），并证明该嵌入对齐策略在数据效率和鲁棒性上优于多种基线，尤其在类别不平衡场景下。
Motivation: 大多数深度学习方法只关注甲状腺结节的二分类（良/恶性），多类预测和对 TI-RADS 五类特征级监督的显式利用仍未被充分探索，主要受限于标注数据有限。作者希望遵循临床决策流程，利用结构化特征信息在训练阶段指导表示学习，同时推理时仅依赖图像。
Method: 基于文本嵌入可稳定表征 TI-RADS 风险等级（TR1-TR5）的观察，提出 CMCNet，将图像嵌入与固定文本嵌入对齐，并使用 Center-Margin Contrastive Loss 同时促进类内紧凑性（intra-class compactness）与类间分离（inter-class separation）。
Result: 摘要报告该嵌入对齐策略比直接多任务学习更数据高效且更鲁棒，并一致优于 InfoNCE、center loss、强多任务基线以及 VQA 风格多模态模型，尤其在类别不平衡设置下表现突出。
Conclusion: 摘要强调遵循临床决策流程并利用特征级文本嵌入可提升细粒度甲状腺分类性能，同时指出受限于有限标注数据这一背景，并公开了 STN 数据集与源代码。

papers.title: CoANeRV: Coordinate-Aware Token-Space Neural Video Representation
papers.abstract_en: Neural representations for videos (NeRV) have shown strong reconstruction fidelity by storing video-specific information in network weights. However, existing formulations typically require either costly per-video optimization or video-specific weight generation, making it difficult to scale to efficient amortized video representation. We propose CoANeRV, a coordinate-aware token-space framework that adapts the broader token-conditioned neural-field paradigm to amortized video representation. CoANeRV forms compact video tokens in one feed-forward pass and uses a shared coordinate-conditioned decoder to reconstruct continuous spatio-temporal queries, avoiding per-video decoder optimization or generation while retaining coordinate-level reconstruction flexibility. To make token-space reconstruction effective, CoANeRV introduces a coordinate-aware decoding architecture that aligns spatio-temporal queries with video tokens through axis-adaptive positional encoding and temperature-modulated cross-attention. Block-wise coordinate querying further reduces peak attention memory, making high-resolution reconstruction practical. Experiments on diverse video datasets show that CoANeRV consistently improves reconstruction quality over prior feed-forward NeRV and INR baselines, reduces peak memory compared with attention-based coordinate decoders, and provides efficient amortized encoding without per-video optimization. These results support the proposed video-specific combination of feed-forward token formation, spatio-temporal coordinate retrieval, and memory-bounded dense querying. The code is available at https://github.com/jialong2023/CoANeRV.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 13 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/jialong2023/CoANeRV
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoANeRV，一个坐标感知的 token 空间神经视频表示框架，将 token 条件神经场范式扩展到可摊销的视频表示。CoANeRV 在前向传播中形成紧凑视频 token，并用共享的坐标条件解码器重建连续时空查询，避免逐视频解码器优化或生成。摘要报告在多个视频数据集上优于前馈 NeRV 和 INR 基线，并降低峰值内存。
Motivation: 现有神经视频表示 (NeRV) 要么需要昂贵的逐视频优化，要么需要视频特定的权重生成，难以扩展到高效的摊销式视频表示。
Method: CoANeRV 采用坐标感知的 token 空间框架：单次前向生成紧凑视频 token，共享坐标条件解码器处理连续时空查询；通过轴自适应位置编码 (axis-adaptive positional encoding) 和温度调制交叉注意力 (temperature-modulated cross-attention) 对齐查询与 token，并用分块坐标查询 (block-wise coordinate querying) 降低峰值注意力内存。
Result: 在多种视频数据集上，CoANeRV 一致地提升了重建质量，优于前馈 NeRV 和 INR 基线；相比基于注意力的坐标解码器降低了峰值内存，并实现了无需逐视频优化的高效摊销编码。
Conclusion: 摘要支持前馈 token 形成、时空坐标检索和内存受限密集查询这一视频特定组合的有效性，并公开了代码。

papers.title: Deep Vision in Smart Manufacturing: MODERN Framework for Intelligent Quality Monitoring and Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Smart manufacturing processes are often installed with a large number of sensors, imaging devices and computers, which not only enable instant communication across various modules of a production system but also aid in intelligent manufacturing management. In this paper, we introduce MODERN, a deep learning framework for quality monitoring and fault isolation, which integrates these enhanced capabilities into the practice of industrial quality control. Using the architecture of an inception residual neural network, we develop a control chart that monitors the likelihood of a product containing defects. We also propose a faulty region estimator that identifies the defective area using transfer learning. To extend our framework to cases where there are not sufficient training data, we suggest a transfer monitoring technique that requires only a small sample size and a hypothesis testing approach for quantitatively assessing the applicability of our method. Theoretically, we establish the minimax optimal convergence rate for both our defect likelihood estimation and fault diagnosis. Our results lead to a seemingly counter-intuitive managerial implication - it may not always be in a manufacturer's best interests to keep upgrading its monitoring equipment regardless of the cost. Empirically, we demonstrate the superior performance of our method in comparison with a state-of-the-art approach using both simulated experiments and real data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MODERN，一个面向智能制造的质量监控与故障隔离深度学习框架。它利用 inception residual neural network 架构构建控制图来监测产品含缺陷的似然，并通过迁移学习给出故障区域估计器；针对训练数据不足的情况，还提出只需小样本量的迁移监控技术与用于评估适用性的假设检验。理论部分证明缺陷似然估计和故障诊断均达到 minimax 最优收敛率，实验在模拟与真实数据上相对最先进方法展示了更优性能。
Motivation: 智能制造系统普遍配备大量传感器、成像设备和计算机，能够支持生产模块间的即时通信与智能管理，但如何把这些能力系统地整合进工业质量控制仍需要专门的深度学习框架；实际场景中训练数据不足也是一个关键障碍。
Method: 采用 inception residual neural network 架构开发控制图以监测缺陷概率；提出基于迁移学习的故障区域估计器；为训练数据有限的场景提出小样本迁移监控技术，并设计假设检验定量评估方法的适用性；理论上刻画了估计量的收敛率。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在模拟实验和真实数据上均优于某最先进方法；理论部分建立了缺陷似然估计与故障诊断的 minimax 最优收敛率。
Conclusion: 作者得到一个反直觉的管理启示：制造商不一定总应不计成本地升级监控设备；同时方法在小样本下的适用性可通过假设检验进行定量评估。

papers.title: Probabilistic indirect models for undrained shear strength: addressing significant data missing and variability with advanced imputation and machine learning techniques
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of undrained shear strength (su) is crucial for geotechnical design, but is often hampered by substantial uncertainty in traditional empirical methods. This study uses the CLAY/10/7490 global database to develop probabilistic indirect models to predict su based on Atterberg limits and piezocone cone penetration (CPTU) measurements. Firstly, the dataset has a high missing data rate and variability. We test three imputation methods - multivariate normal (MN), multiple imputation by chained equations (MICE), and miss forest (MF) - to fill the missing values. To validate their effectiveness, a Probabilistic Extreme Gradient Boosting (PXGB) model is developed, and the imputation methods are evaluated by comparing the PXGB's performance when trained on the imputed datasets against that on the original incomplete data. Secondly, the indirect model is built by integrating a multi-head attention (MHA) mechanism into an artificial neural network (ANN) to enhance information extraction from limited data, which leads to the MHA-based probabilistic neural networks (MHA-PNN) model. The models' performance, alongside a conventional MN-based prediction model, was evaluated using root mean square error (RMSE), coefficient of determination (R2), mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), conditional interval width (wCI), and coverage rate (CR). Results demonstrate that the proposed MN-enhanced MHA-PNN model substantially outperforms other models in both prediction accuracy and uncertainty quantification. These findings highlight the potential of this integrated strategy for building robust probabilistic indirect models in geotechnical applications, particularly when confronted with sparse and incomplete datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 CLAY/10/7490 全球数据库，针对不排水抗剪强度 (undrained shear strength, su) 预测中数据缺失率高、变异性大的问题，测试了三种缺失值填补方法（多元正态 MN、链式方程多重填补 MICE、随机森林 missForest），并用概率极限梯度提升 (PXGB) 模型验证填补效果。随后构建将多头注意力机制 (MHA) 集成进人工神经网络 (ANN) 的 MHA-PNN 概率模型，用于基于 Atterberg 界限和 CPTU 测量预测 su。结果显示 MN 增强的 MHA-PNN 模型在预测精度和不确定性量化上显著优于其他模型。
Motivation: 传统经验方法预测不排水抗剪强度存在显著不确定性，而用于建模的数据集缺失率较高且变异性大，这阻碍了可靠间接预测模型的构建。
Method: 使用 CLAY/10/7490 全球数据库，测试三种缺失值填补方法（MN、MICE、missForest），并以 PXGB 模型在填补数据与原不完整数据上的性能对比来评估填补有效性。间接模型通过在 ANN 中集成多头注意力机制构建 MHA-PNN，并与基于 MN 的传统预测模型对比，采用 RMSE、R2、MAPE、条件区间宽度 (wCI) 和覆盖率 (CR) 进行评价。
Result: 摘要报告称，所提出的 MN 增强 MHA-PNN 模型在预测精度与不确定性量化方面均显著优于其他模型，包括传统基于 MN 的预测模型。
Conclusion: 该集成策略在数据稀疏且不完整的场景下，有助于构建稳健的岩土工程概率间接模型。

papers.title: Determining Meteorological Tidal Transport through a Channel on the Coast
papers.abstract_en: Transient weather systems are often associated with alternating warm and cold advections of air masses and changing wind directions, which drive coastal ocean and estuarine waters to oscillate quasi-periodically. Quantifying water transport under these meteorological oscillations between inland waterways and the coastal ocean helps interpret land-ocean interactions and the impact of migrating weather systems. The challenge lies in the difficulty of obtaining continuous, long-term direct measurements of transport due to logistical constraints. Here, we apply a method to determine the meteorological tide-induced volume transport of water through an intensive survey, correlating transport values measured by a boat-mounted ADCP with vertically averaged velocities from a bottom-mounted ADCP, which recorded a much longer time series. The correlation is then used to compute transport over the period of the bottom-mounted ADCP deployment. Observations were conducted at Belle Pass, Port Fourchon. The transport data revealed the impact of weather systems, including four cold fronts. A model of volume transport, accounting for rotary cold front wind variations, was applied, where both along-channel and along-coastline wind components contribute to the remote wind effect, leading to a more complex response to passing weather systems. The local wind effect is much smaller than the remote wind effect, and transport is primarily controlled by water level fluctuations resulting from open boundary input. Finally, the channel orientation relative to the coastline is found to be critical in determining both the magnitude and phase of the transport.
papers.journal_ref: Li, C. (2025). Determining meteorological tidal transport through a channel on the coast. Continental Shelf Research, Vol. 285: 105394
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通过密集观测推算气象潮（meteorological tide）体积输运的方法：用船载ADCP测得的输运值与底置ADCP长时间序列的垂直平均流速建立相关，再由该相关计算整个底置ADCP部署期间的输运。观测在Port Fourchon的Belle Pass进行，数据揭示了包括四次冷锋在内的天气系统影响。作者还应用了考虑旋转冷锋风变化的输运模型，发现远程风效应主导、局地风效应较小，输运主要受开边界输入引起的水位波动控制。
Motivation: 量化天气系统引起的内陆水道与沿海海洋之间的准周期水量输运有助于理解陆海相互作用和移动天气系统的影响，但连续长期直接测量输运受后勤条件限制而难以实现。
Method: 通过一次密集测量，将船载ADCP实测输运值与底置ADCP记录的长时间垂直平均流速进行相关，并利用该相关性外推底置ADCP部署时段的输运；同时应用一个计入旋转冷锋风变化的输运模型，其中沿河道与沿海岸线风分量共同构成远程风效应。
Result: Belle Pass的输运数据显示了天气系统包括四次冷锋的影响；沿河道与沿海岸线风分量均对远程风效应有贡献，局地风效应远小于远程风效应，输运主要由开边界输入引起的水位波动控制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通道相对于海岸线的方向对输运的大小和相位具有决定性作用，说明通道几何取向是理解气象潮输运响应的关键因素。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Post-training Quantization for Hybrid Iterative Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Iterative Generative Models (IGMs) span autoregressive and diffusion paradigms, and hybrid variants that couple them can achieve remarkable image-generation fidelity. However, their iterative inference incurs substantial computational overhead, making Post-training Quantization (PTQ) appealing for acceleration, while directly applying vanilla PTQ to hybrid IGMs can trigger model collapse. By analyzing these failures, we identify two critical challenges: Excessive Outliers (EOs) in the activations create an irreconcilable trade-off between preserving normal precision and covering EOs, resulting in severe degradation in generation quality; Amplified Anomalies (AAs) arising unpredictably from minor quantization errors, create a mismatch between calibration and inference, thus iteratively triggering model collapse. To address these challenges, we introduce HyGenQ, a PTQ framework for hybrid IGMs. HyGenQ comprises Hierarchical Cluster Decoupling (HCD) and Scaling Recalibration (SR). HCD identifies and decouples outlier channels via a multi-stage clustering process, effectively isolating EOs while maintaining normal value precision, thereby alleviating performance degradation. SR scales AAs beyond Gaussian Bound, thereby avoiding model collapse caused by aggressive truncation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HyGenQ successfully quantizes representative hybrid IGMs to 8-bit precision (W8A8), significantly outperforming existing baselines and validating its robustness across different model families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合迭代生成模型（IGM，耦合自回归与扩散范式）的后训练量化（PTQ）问题，提出 HyGenQ 框架。作者指出直接套用 vanilla PTQ 会触发模型崩溃，并将原因归结为激活中的过度离群值（EOs）与量化误差放大产生的异常（AAs）两个挑战。HyGenQ 通过层次簇解耦（HCD）和缩放重新校准（SR）分别处理这两类问题，在代表性混合 IGM 上实现了 8-bit 权重激活量化（W8A8），显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 混合迭代生成模型虽能实现卓越的图像生成保真度，但迭代推理计算开销大，PTQ 是有效的加速手段；然而直接应用 vanilla PTQ 会导致模型崩溃，因此需要专门针对混合 IGM 的量化方案。
Method: 提出 HyGenQ 框架，包含两个组件：层次簇解耦（HCD）通过多阶段聚类过程识别并解耦离群通道，在隔离过度离群值的同时保持正常值精度；缩放重新校准（SR）将放大异常缩放到高斯边界之外，避免激进截断导致的模型崩溃。
Result: 实验表明 HyGenQ 成功将代表性混合 IGM 量化到 8-bit 精度（W8A8），显著优于现有基线，并在不同模型家族上验证了鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过同时处理激活离群值与量化误差放大异常，HyGenQ 可以有效量化混合 IGM 并避免模型崩溃；其主要适用对象是混合迭代生成模型。

papers.title: RGBX-Next: Towards Realistic Generative Rendering from G-Buffers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved impressive results in image, video, and streaming generation. However, compared to traditional 3D rendering, they still lack precise control over the generated output. We believe a viable path forward is to use generative models as learned renderers conditioned on traditionally rendered G-buffers. We introduce RGBX-Next, a unified generative framework for forward and inverse rendering, which allows estimating G-buffers from images, videos, and streams, and rendering realistic images, videos, and streams from G-buffers. Our key contribution is a general recipe for finetuning diffusion transformer (DiT) models into generative forward and inverse renderers. We show that the resulting models achieve high quality in both realistic generative rendering and intrinsic decomposition. We will make all our models publicly available. We believe that the design principles presented in this paper will benefit future research on controllable generative forward and inverse rendering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RGBX-Next，一个基于 G-buffer 条件扩散 Transformer (DiT) 的统一生成式正/逆渲染框架，既能从图像、视频和流中估计 G-buffer，也能从 G-buffer 渲染逼真的图像、视频和流。作者称其核心贡献是一套将 DiT 微调为生成式正/逆渲染器的通用配方，并在真实感生成渲染与内在分解 (intrinsic decomposition) 上取得高质量结果，且计划公开所有模型。
Motivation: 扩散模型在图像、视频和流生成上表现出色，但相比传统 3D 渲染，对生成结果缺乏精确控制。作者认为可行路径是将生成模型用作以传统渲染 G-buffer 为条件的可学习渲染器，从而实现可控的生成式渲染。
Method: 提出 RGBX-Next 统一框架，支持正渲染（从 G-buffer 生成图像/视频/流）与逆渲染（从图像/视频/流估计 G-buffer）。关键技术贡献是给出将扩散 Transformer (DiT) 微调为生成式正/逆渲染器的一般性配方。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在真实感生成渲染和内在分解两个方向上都达到高质量，但没有给出具体量化指标或基准数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为论文中呈现的设计原则将有益于未来可控生成式正/逆渲染研究，并承诺公开所有模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Never the Number: Structural Abstention for AI Systems Whose Answers Are Consumed as Fact
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have made natural language interfaces to databases (NLIDB) newly credible, but LLM text-to-SQL systems fail in a way that matters for deployment: a hallucinated column or a mis-aggregated total yields a fluent wrong answer, indistinguishable at the point of use from a right one. Where the consumer cannot inspect the generated query, as in enterprise AI deployments and operational dashboards, and increasingly where the consumer is a tool-using agent rather than a person, accuracy alone is insufficient: nothing marks which answers to distrust. This is a reliability problem before it is an accuracy problem. We propose an architectural pattern for such systems, a trusted kernel with a generative shell, resting on one invariant: a component that can fabricate may influence which question the system answers, never which value it returns. A generative shell interprets underspecified input and phrases replies; a deterministic kernel matches fully specified questions against a bounded set of answerable question shapes and compiles them to queries by deterministic execution. The two meet at a confirmation the user reads before any value is computed, and requests the kernel cannot express are declined rather than approximated. We call this structural abstention, and distinguish it from the statistical abstention of selective prediction and calibrated confidence: refusal here needs no confidence estimate, because unanswerable requests are unrepresentable. We specify the pattern implementation-independently, give a five-decision recipe and work it across three domains, extend the invariant from returned values to the actions of agentic systems, and report a two-year production case study alongside two generative alternatives, a fine-tuned parser and a tool-retrieval agent. We close against enterprise and reliability benchmarks published since.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Technical report. Describes architecture and design principles only; contains no code, schemas, datasets, or performance metrics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为被当作事实消费的 LLM 文本到 SQL / 自然语言数据库接口 (NLIDB) 系统提出一种架构模式：可信内核 (trusted kernel) 加生成式外壳 (generative shell)，核心不变量是能编造内容的组件只能影响系统回答哪个问题，而不能影响返回哪个数值。作者称其为结构性弃权 (structural abstention)，与选择性预测中的统计弃权区分开，因为无法表达的请求在系统中不可表示，因此拒绝无需置信度估计。论文给出实现无关的规格、五步决策配方、三个领域的实例、对智能体行动 (agentic actions) 的扩展，并报告了两年生产环境案例研究。
Motivation: LLM 文本到 SQL 系统可能产生幻觉列或错误聚合的流畅错误答案，在使用现场与正确答案无法区分；在企业部署和仪表盘场景以及消费者是使用工具的智能体时，用户无法检查生成查询，准确率本身不足以标记哪些答案不可信，因此可靠性先于准确率成为问题。
Method: 提出可信内核加生成式外壳的模式：生成式外壳解释未充分指定的输入并组织回复；确定性内核将完全指定的问题与一组有界、可回答的问题形状匹配，并通过确定性执行编译为查询。两者在计算任何数值之前要求用户确认；内核无法表达的请求被拒绝而非近似处理。论文以实现无关方式给出该模式，提供五步决策配方，并将不变量从返回值扩展到智能体系统采取的行动。
Result: 摘要报告了与两种生成式替代方案（微调解析器和工具检索智能体）并行的两年生产案例研究，并称与之后发表的面向企业和可靠性的基准进行了对照；论文本身未提供具体性能数字、数据集或指标。
Conclusion: 论文强调可靠性问题应先于准确率问题，结构性弃权不依赖置信度估计即可拒绝不可回答请求，并将该模式定位为与统计弃权不同的设计原则。arXiv 注释说明本文仅描述架构与设计原则，不含代码、模式、数据集或性能指标。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CForce: Boosting Parallel Decoding for dLLMs via Consistency Forcing
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) accelerate language generation by predicting multiple masks in a single forward pass. However, existing dLLMs can suffer from unreliable predictions in early denoising stages under aggressive parallelism strategies, leading to errors that can propagate to later stages. To tackle this issue, we present Consistency Forcing (CForce) for dLLMs, a distillation method to force the mask predictions of early stages to align with those of later stages. CForce trains the model on pre-collected self-rollout trajectories, thereby improving training-inference alignment. We introduce Confidence Adaptive KL Divergence as a distillation objective to conjoin the merits of forward and reverse KL. We further provide a theoretical analysis for the consistency objective to explain why CForce can approximately minimize the prediction error of early stages. Critically, the same formulation applies to both mask-to-token decoding and edit-capable decoding; in the edit-capable case, later token-to-token refinements provide additional supervision for earlier masked-state predictions. Experiments on non-edit and edit-capable LLaDA models show improved speed-quality trade-offs, especially under high-parallelism decoding budgets. Code is available at: https://github.com/inclusionAI/dFactory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Consistency Forcing (CForce)，一种面向扩散大语言模型 (dLLMs) 的蒸馏方法，通过强制早期去噪阶段的掩码预测与后期阶段对齐，缓解高并行解码下早期预测不可靠导致的错误传播。方法基于预收集的自滚动轨迹训练，并引入 Confidence Adaptive KL Divergence 作为蒸馏目标，兼顾前向与反向 KL 的优点；同一公式同时适用于 mask-to-token 解码和可编辑解码。实验在非编辑与可编辑 LLaDA 模型上显示改进的速度-质量权衡，尤其在高并行解码预算下。
Motivation: 现有 dLLMs 采用激进并行策略时，早期去噪阶段的预测可能不可靠，错误会传播到后续阶段，影响生成质量。
Method: 提出 Consistency Forcing (CForce)：在预收集的自滚动轨迹上训练模型，使早期阶段的掩码预测与后期阶段对齐；引入 Confidence Adaptive KL Divergence 作为蒸馏目标，并给出一致性目标的理论分析，说明其能近似最小化早期阶段的预测误差。该公式同时适用于 mask-to-token 解码和可编辑解码，后者中后期的 token-to-token 精炼为早期掩码状态提供额外监督。
Result: 在非编辑和可编辑 LLaDA 模型上的实验显示，CForce 改善了速度-质量权衡，尤其在高并行解码预算下。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过一致性强制对齐训练与推理，可以有效提升 dLLMs 在高并行解码下的可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: OpenBelief-Nav: Evidence-Preserving Object Memory for Open-Vocabulary Language-Guided Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs provide compact semantic memory for language-guided navigation, but mapped objects are often exposed through a single fused feature or committed semantic label. Such commitment can remove minority yet task-relevant hypotheses from the task-time interface. We present OpenBelief-Nav, an evidence-preserving object memory that retains observation-level phrases, reliability cues, and frame-mask provenance while maintaining separate aggregate geometric and visual representations. Semantically related phrases are consolidated into a vocabulary-independent object belief from which task-specific readouts perform fixed-vocabulary projection or free-form retrieval. On five ScanNet200 and eight Replica scenes, full-belief projection achieves mIoU scores of 0.2742 and 0.2912, compared with 0.2393 and 0.2701 for a matched early-commit readout. Across 78 HM3D-YCB navigation trials, consensus and early-commit retrieval each achieve 60/78 successes, compared with 58/78 for belief-weighted retrieval and 55/78 for DualMap. Across 20 Unitree G1 runs organized as 10 matched evaluation cases, a correction policy permitting at most two verified candidate attempts improves target-confirmation success from 6/10 to 8/10 relative to top-1-only execution. Code will be released upon acceptance at https://openbelief-nav.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenBelief-Nav，一种保留证据的对象记忆 (evidence-preserving object memory)，用于开放词汇语言引导导航。与现有开放词汇 3D 场景图不同，该方法不把映射对象提交为单一融合特征或固定语义标签，而是保留观测级短语、可靠性线索和帧掩码来源，并维护分离的聚合几何与视觉表示。语义相关短语被整合为词汇无关的对象信念，任务特定读出可执行固定词汇投影或自由形式检索。在 ScanNet200、Replica、HM3D-YCB 和 Unitree G1 上的实验显示其相对早期提交 (early-commit) 读出的改进。
Motivation: 开放词汇 3D 场景图为语言引导导航提供紧凑语义记忆，但映射对象往往只通过单一融合特征或固定语义标签暴露；这种早期承诺会从任务时接口中移除少数但任务相关的假设，限制下游任务表现。
Method: 提出一种保留证据的对象记忆：保留观测级短语、可靠性线索和帧掩码来源，同时维护分离的聚合几何与视觉表示；将语义相关短语整合为词汇无关的对象信念 (object belief)，任务时读出支持固定词汇投影或自由形式检索。此外引入一个允许至多两次已验证候选尝试的纠正策略，用于执行阶段。
Result: 在五个 ScanNet200 和八个 Replica 场景上，full-belief projection 的 mIoU 分别为 0.2742 和 0.2912，优于 matched early-commit readout 的 0.2393 和 0.2701。78 次 HM3D-YCB 导航试验中，consensus 与 early-commit retrieval 均为 60/78 成功，belief-weighted retrieval 为 58/78，DualMap 为 55/78。20 次 Unitree G1 运行（组织为 10 个匹配评估用例）中，允许至多两次已验证候选尝试的纠正策略将目标确认成功率从 6/10 提升到 8/10。

papers.title: High-dimensional nonparametric changepoint detection via low-rank degree-two density projection
papers.abstract_en: Detecting distributional changes in high dimension is difficult when neither the pre-change nor post-change density is parametrically specified. We introduce a representation-based approach that retains all degree-at-most-two density information while replacing density estimation by matrix mean estimation. For observations in $[-1,1]^d$, a symmetric feature matrix $H_2(X)\in\R^{(d+1)\times(d+1)}$ is constructed so that $M(f)=\E_f H_2(X)$ is an isometric encoding of the degree-two orthogonal projection of the density. We scan matrix CUSUMs after rank-$r$ truncation, exploiting the low rank of the projected jump rather than sparsity of individual coordinates. The resulting \LRD{} estimator has a tent-shaped population objective and a nonasymptotic operator-norm analysis whose leading stochastic term scales as $\sqrt{rd\log(nd)}$. For multiple changes, we give a seeded narrowest-over-threshold procedure and prove exact recovery by an induction that preserves an isolating interval for every undetected change. A cross-fitted scalar refinement learns the changing low-rank direction on one fold and localizes on the other, attaining $\widetilde O_{\Pp}(κ^{-2})$ error; a matching Le Cam lower bound shows optimality up to logarithms. A geometrically $β$-mixing extension follows from a dependent matrix Bernstein inequality. Experiments with ambient dimension up to $200$, a three-change $d=100$ sequence, and a $128$-feature human-activity benchmark show that the method remains computationally practical and accurately detects pure dependence changes that are invisible to mean CUSUMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种高维非参数变点检测方法，通过低秩二次密度投影 (degree-two density projection) 将密度估计转化为矩阵均值估计。对 X∈[-1,1]^d 构造对称特征矩阵 H2(X)，使 M(f)=E_f H2(X) 成为密度二次正交投影的等距编码；算法在秩 r 截断后扫描矩阵 CUSUM，利用投影跳变的低秩结构而非坐标稀疏性。论文给出非渐近算子范数分析，主导随机项量级为 sqrt(rd log(nd))；针对多变点设计了 seeded narrowest-over-threshold 过程并证明可精确恢复。
Motivation: 当变点前后的密度都非参数指定时，高维分布变点检测很困难。传统均值 CUSUM 无法捕捉纯依赖结构的改变，而直接估计高维密度又不可行，因此需要一种保留低阶密度信息、同时避免密度估计的表示方式。
Method: 引入表示化方法：用二次投影的特征矩阵 H2(X) 编码密度信息，把任务替换为矩阵均值估计；对矩阵 CUSUM 做秩 r 截断以利用投影跳变的低秩性。多变点情形使用 seeded narrowest-over-threshold 扫描过程，并用交叉拟合 (cross-fitting) 的标量精化步骤在一折学习变化的低秩方向、另一折定位变点。
Result: 非渐近分析给出主随机项 sqrt(rd log(nd)) 的算子范数界；交叉拟合精化达到 Otilde_P(κ^{-2}) 误差，Le Cam 下界表明该误差在忽略对数因子后最优。实验覆盖环境维度至 200、d=100 的三变点序列以及 128 特征的 human-activity 基准，能准确检测均值 CUSUM 不可见的纯依赖变化。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过低秩二次投影加矩阵 CUSUM 可以在高维非参数场景下实用地检测分布变化，且能捕获纯依赖结构改变；方法还推广到几何 β-mixing 相依序列。

papers.title: When Personal Memory Has No Single Answer: Evaluating LLM Agents under Irreducible Conflict
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly maintain personal memory across sessions, but it can conflict. Preferences depend on context, behavior evolves, and sources can conflict. When a query lacks context, time, or source authority to interpret conflict, treating one memory as definitive converts unresolved conflict into an unjustified, overconfident action. Existing benchmarks recover one answer from conflicting evidence, overlooking whether agents recognize underdetermination, preserve alternatives, seek missing information, and choose appropriate actions. We introduce \underline{T}esting \underline{A}gents' \underline{N}avigation of \underline{G}enuine, \underline{L}atent, and \underline{E}ntangled Memory Conflicts (\textsc{TANGLE}), a benchmark for genuinely unresolvable memory conflicts. It comprises 541 instances across 40 personas and three types: Context-Partitioned Conflict (CPC), Behavior-Oscillation Conflict (BOC), and Source-Contradiction Conflict (SCC). We evaluate two tracks---an oracle track with curated memory and a pipeline track that extracts memory from multi-session dialogues---on five dimensions: conflict perception, causal reasoning, confidence calibration, clarification seeking, and memory faithfulness. Experiments reveal pipeline challenges. With curated memory, models recognize conflicts more reliably than they calibrate actions or seek targeted clarification. With end-to-end pipeline memory, extraction fails to preserve conflict-bearing relations needed for downstream reasoning. Policy comparisons show fixed rules are insufficient when actions must reflect conflict. These findings motivate Conflict-Aware Action Policy (CAAP), which adapts actions to each conflict using available evidence. \textsc{TANGLE} frames conflict handling as recognizing underdetermination, retaining conflicting evidence, and acting without forcing a definitive answer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TANGLE，一个用于评估 LLM 智能体在真正不可消解的记忆冲突下表现的基准，包含 541 个实例、40 个人设和三种冲突类型（CPC、BOC、SCC）。评测覆盖 oracle 与端到端 pipeline 两个轨道，从冲突感知、因果推理、置信度校准、澄清寻求和记忆忠实度五个维度衡量智能体；结果显示现有提取管线无法保留冲突相关的记忆关系，作者因此提出 Conflict-Aware Action Policy (CAAP)。
Motivation: 现有基准倾向于从冲突证据中恢复单一答案，忽略智能体能否识别欠定（underdetermination）、保留备选解释、寻求缺失信息并选择恰当动作；当查询缺少上下文、时间或来源权威来消解冲突时，把一条记忆当作确定答案会产生不合理且过度自信的行为。
Method: 构建 TANGLE 基准，含 541 个实例、40 个人设和三类冲突：Context-Partitioned Conflict (CPC)、Behavior-Oscillation Conflict (BOC)、Source-Contradiction Conflict (SCC)。设置 oracle track（策展记忆）与 pipeline track（从多会话对话提取记忆）两个评测轨道，并在五个维度上评估；进一步提出 CAAP，根据每个冲突的可用证据自适应调整动作。
Result: 实验发现：策展记忆下模型识别冲突比校准动作或寻求针对性澄清更可靠；端到端 pipeline 的记忆提取无法保留下游推理所需的冲突承载关系；固定规则策略不足以应对行动需反映冲突的场景，而 CAAP 能依据证据调整动作。摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: TANGLE 将冲突处理界定为识别欠定、保留冲突证据，并在不强行给出确定答案的前提下行动；作者强调行动必须反映冲突时固定规则不足，CAAP 是一种面向该问题的适应策略。
