papers.title: Beyond Control Points: Arcsecond Relative-Motion Estimation of Vision Measurement Platforms With Incomplete or Absent Control Fields
papers.abstract_en: Long-range vision-based deformation monitoring is highly sensitive to motion of the camera platform. Absolute-pose differencing typically relies on dedicated control data and propagates two independent pose errors into the relative-motion estimate. We develop a control-adaptive differential framework that estimates inter-frame platform motion directly from image displacements and known 3D points. With no dedicated control point, the framework recovers platform rotation from measurement-point observations. One surveyed control point enables prior-constrained translation recovery, while two nonparallel control rays recover full 3D translation. The framework requires neither nonlinear optimization nor an initial pose estimate. Excluding control data from the rotation stage makes the rotation estimate exactly immune to contamination confined to the control field. The inherited differential formulation also cancels translational extrinsic errors exactly. We derive the rotation observability condition, a leakage bound for unmodeled translation and nonrigid point motion, and the single-point axial-prior bias law. Under 0.5-pixel image noise, attitude changes of up to 30~arcmin, and 3D point perturbations of up to 2~mm, the multi-camera estimator achieves a rotation RMSE of 2.97~arcsec and an average runtime of 0.46~ms. With one surveyed control point, its prior-constrained translation RMSE is 1.19~mm. In a bridge experiment without a stable control field, the median coordinate-wise displacement RMSE relative to total-station measurements is 0.85~mm. The estimator also maintains zero divergence under the tested 3D coordinate perturbations on public RGB-D and stereo sequences. These results establish state-of-the-art accuracy, calibration robustness, and computational efficiency among the evaluated methods.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 14 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长距离视觉变形监测中相机平台运动严重干扰测量的难题，提出一种控制自适应差分框架（control-adaptive differential framework），直接从图像位移和已知三维点估计帧间平台运动，无需专用控制点、非线性优化或初始位姿估计。该框架在无控制点时从测量点观测恢复平台旋转，用一个已知控制点进行先验约束的平移恢复，用两条非平行控制射线恢复完整三维平移，并将旋转估计与控制区数据隔离以消除控制场污染。实验在 0.5 像素图像噪声下达到旋转 RMSE 2.97 角秒、平均耗时 0.46 ms，并在一座无稳定控制场的桥梁试验中获得 0.85 mm 的中位位移 RMSE。
Motivation: 长距离视觉变形监测对相机平台运动非常敏感，传统的绝对位姿差分依赖于专用控制数据，并会把两次独立位姿估计的误差传播到相对运动结果中。作者希望直接从图像位移和已知三维点估计帧间相对运动，从而摆脱对完整控制场的依赖。
Method: 提出控制自适应差分框架：从测量点观测中恢复平台旋转，排除控制区数据使旋转估计精确免疫控制场污染；一个已知控制点提供轴向先验约束实现平移恢复，两个非平行控制射线恢复完整三维平移。该框架无需非线性优化和初始位姿，差分形式还能精确抵消平移外参误差，并推导了旋转可观测条件、未建模平移与非刚体点运动的泄露界以及单点轴向先验偏差律。
Result: 在 0.5 像素图像噪声、姿态变化达 30 角分、三维点扰动达 2 mm 的条件下，多相机估计器达到旋转 RMSE 2.97 角秒和平均运行时间 0.46 ms；使用一个已知控制点时，先验约束平移 RMSE 为 1.19 mm。在无稳定控制场的桥梁实验中，相对全站仪测量的坐标方向中位位移 RMSE 为 0.85 mm，且在公开 RGB-D 与立体序列的三维坐标扰动测试下保持零发散。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架在被评估方法中取得了先进的精度、标定鲁棒性和计算效率，特别适用于缺乏稳定控制场的实际变形监测场景。

papers.title: Hybrid Quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Privacy-Aware Federated Biosignal Learning
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings are sensitive biomedical data, limiting the ability of hospitals and wearable devices to share raw signals for centralized model training. Federated learning addresses this practical privacy constraint by enabling collaborative model training while keeping raw biosignal data at their respective sources. However, federated ECG classification remains challenging due to limited client-side samples, imbalanced arrhythmia labels, and non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data across clients. These constraints require classifiers that are both communication-efficient and robust to cross-client distribution shifts. In this work, we evaluate a hybrid quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold network (HQKAN) against a multilayer perceptron (MLP) for five-class arrhythmia classification on the MIT-BIH dataset and three-class classification on the INCART dataset under federated averaging (FedAvg). Across multiple client configurations, HQKAN improves most aggregate and minority-class metrics while using 37.35% fewer trainable parameters and reducing communication cost by 24.89% on MIT-BIH; on INCART, it achieves corresponding reductions of 44.81% and 36.41%. These results indicate that HQKAN offers a compact, communication-efficient and robust alternative to the MLP baseline for privacy-aware federated learning on biosignal data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在联邦学习（FedAvg）框架下评估混合量子启发 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（HQKAN）与多层感知机（MLP）在 ECG 心律失常分类上的表现，数据集为 MIT-BIH（五类）和 INCART（三类）。摘要报告 HQKAN 在多数聚合指标和少数类指标上优于 MLP，同时参数量和通信成本显著更低。
Motivation: ECG 是敏感生物医学数据，医院和可穿戴设备不愿共享原始信号进行集中训练；联邦学习可缓解隐私约束，但客户端样本有限、心律失常标签不均衡以及跨客户端非独立同分布（non-IID）数据使分类仍然困难，需要兼具通信效率和跨客户端分布鲁棒性的分类器。
Method: 在 FedAvg 下，将 HQKAN 作为分类器与 MLP 基线进行对比实验，覆盖多种客户端配置，并在 MIT-BIH 上做五类心律失常分类、在 INCART 上做三类分类。
Result: HQKAN 在多数聚合指标和少数类指标上取得提升；在 MIT-BIH 上可训练参数减少 37.35%、通信成本降低 24.89%，在 INCART 上分别减少 44.81% 和 36.41%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 HQKAN 是隐私感知联邦生物信号学习中紧凑、通信高效且鲁棒的 MLP 替代方案。

papers.title: MedMix: Specialization-Consistent Federated Sparse MoEs under Modality Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Federated multimodal medical AI faces modality heterogeneity at both the client and sample levels: clients may systematically lack access to specific modality types, while individual records within the same client may contain different partial modality subsets. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are a promising remedy for modality-adaptive computation, but their use in federated learning is fragile under cross-client modality heterogeneity, where locally learned routing policies can diverge across clients and drive experts toward incompatible specializations. Different clients may assign the same observed modality configuration to different experts, or train similarly indexed experts on different missing-modality configurations, causing standard aggregation to misalign or overwrite the expert specialization that sparse MoEs are intended to learn. To address this challenge, we propose MedMix, a semantic-alignment framework for federated multimodal sparse MoEs that coordinates cross-client routing and expert specialization using modality context. At the client side, MedMix uses modality-context-aware routing to guide expert selection using each token's modality identity, position, and incompleteness context. Across clients, it uses consensus-guided routing alignment to construct server-side consensus anchors for shared modality patterns and align local routing distributions across clients. Complementing these routing mechanisms, client-adaptive expert aggregation leverages client-specific modality-pattern prototypes to match and aggregate functionally similar experts across clients. Experiments on real-world multimodal medical datasets show that MedMix achieves the best average F1 across diverse modality heterogeneity and modality incompleteness settings, with especially clear gains under severe heterogeneity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedMix，一个面向联邦多模态稀疏 MoE 的语义对齐框架，用于解决客户端和样本两个层面的模态异质性（modality heterogeneity）导致的专家特化不一致问题。MedMix 在客户端使用模态上下文感知路由，在服务端使用共识引导的路由对齐，并配合客户端自适应的专家聚合。在真实多模态医学数据集上的实验显示，MedMix 在多种模态异质性和模态不完整设置下取得最佳平均 F1，尤其在严重异质性下增益明显。
Motivation: 联邦多模态医疗 AI 面临客户端和样本级别的模态异质性，而稀疏 MoE 在联邦学习中会因客户端本地路由策略分歧导致专家特化（specialization）不一致，标准聚合会错位或覆盖稀疏 MoE 本应学到的专家特化。
Method: 提出 MedMix：客户端采用模态上下文感知路由，利用每个 token 的模态身份、位置和不完整上下文引导专家选择；跨客户端使用共识引导的路由对齐，在服务端为共享模态模式构建共识锚点并对齐本地路由分布；客户端自适应专家聚合则利用客户端特定的模态模式原型来匹配和聚合功能相似的专家。
Result: 在真实世界多模态医学数据集上，MedMix 在多种模态异质性与模态不完整设置下取得最佳平均 F1，在严重异质性下的提升尤为明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用模态上下文协调跨客户端的路由与专家特化可缓解联邦稀疏 MoE 在模态异质性下的脆弱性；该框架在医学多模态数据上验证，更广泛的适用性未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: CipherSight: Robust Website Fingerprinting via Record-Resource Semantic Supervision under Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: HTTPS website fingerprinting (WF) aims to identify visited websites from metadata observable in encrypted traffic. However, real-world deployments introduce a significant out-of-distribution (OOD) problem caused by temporal and geographic changes, while previously unseen websites are common in open-world scenarios. Existing methods primarily learn from raw TCP packet sequences and struggle to capture stable and generalizable website representations, resulting in performance degradation under practical conditions. We propose CipherSight, a TLS-record-based hierarchical framework for robust HTTPS WF. Unlike existing approaches that rely on TCP packet sequences and are sensitive to transport-layer artifacts, CipherSight learns website representations from TLS records by jointly encoding multiple record-level attributes. It introduces a hierarchical architecture that captures both intra-flow dependencies among TLS records and inter-flow interactions across concurrent flows, enabling the model to exploit structural patterns in HTTPS traffic. Besides, to learn robust representations, CipherSight employs a masked record modeling (MRM) task to capture contextual traffic semantics and leverages fine-grained record-resource annotations as privileged supervision through structure-aware objectives and semantic distillation. Experiments show that CipherSight achieves 95.41% accuracy across more than 2,000 website classes in the closed-world setting and maintains over 90% accuracy under both temporal and geographic drift, consistently outperforming all evaluated baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CipherSight，一个基于 TLS 记录 (TLS record) 的层次化 HTTPS 网站指纹识别 (website fingerprinting, WF) 框架，用于应对真实部署中的分布偏移 (out-of-distribution, OOD) 问题。该方法不依赖 TCP 包序列，而是从 TLS 记录中联合编码多个记录级属性，并通过遮罩记录建模 (masked record modeling, MRM) 和记录-资源细粒度标注的监督信号学习鲁棒表示。实验显示其在超过 2,000 个网站类别的闭集设定下达到 95.41% 准确率，在时间和地理漂移下保持超过 90% 的准确率。
Motivation: 现有 WF 方法主要从原始 TCP 包序列中学习，容易受传输层噪声干扰，且难以在时间变化、地理位置变化和开放世界中出现的新网站场景下保持稳定的表示，导致实际条件下性能下降。
Method: CipherSight 构建 TLS 记录级别的层次化架构，同时编码多个记录级属性，捕捉 TLS 记录间的流内依赖和并发流间的流间交互；采用 MRM 任务学习上下文流量语义，并利用细粒度的记录-资源标注作为特权监督，通过结构感知目标和语义蒸馏增强表示鲁棒性。
Result: 在闭集设定下，CipherSight 对超过 2,000 个网站类别的分类准确率为 95.41%；在时间漂移和地理漂移条件下仍保持高于 90% 的准确率，且持续优于所有评估的基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从 TLS 记录而非 TCP 包中学习稳定表示可以显著提升 HTTPS WF 在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，但该工作完全面向网络流量指纹识别，与天气或降水领域无关。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Agentic Transaction: Towards ACID-Compliant Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into autonomous systems that execute long-horizon tasks through reasoning, tool use, code generation, and workspace manipulation. As agents increasingly operate over persistent environments and multi-step workflows, they face challenges analogous to those addressed by transactional database systems: reliable execution, consistent outcomes, safe concurrency, and durable state management. We introduce the concept of an agentic transaction and propose an ACID-compliant agent system framework that reinterprets the classical ACID properties for agent execution through four semantic guarantees: Semantic Atomicity, Semantic Consistency, Semantic Isolation, and Semantic Durability. Together, these properties provide a principled foundation for building reliable agent systems despite model uncertainty and dynamic execution environments. To instantiate this framework, we develop an ACID-compliant data agent that realizes these guarantees through transactional exploration-execution-validation cycles, transactional skill hubs, confidence divergence-based validation, semantic dependency-aware isolation, and transaction-aware semantic state management. Experimental results on widely used benchmarks show that our system achieves a 10.6% improvement over state-of-the-art agents, including Claude Code. This work opens a broader research agenda on extending transactional principles and system architectures toward building trustworthy, scalable, and self-evolving AI agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“智能体事务”（agentic transaction）概念，将数据库的 ACID 性质重新诠释为面向 LLM 智能体执行的四类语义保证：语义原子性、语义一致性、语义隔离和语义持久性，并基于此构建了 ACID 合规的数据智能体系统。该系统通过事务化的探索-执行-验证循环、事务化技能中心、基于置信度分歧的验证、语义依赖感知隔离以及事务感知的语义状态管理来实现上述保证。在常用基准上，该系统相对包括 Claude Code 在内的最先进智能体取得了 10.6% 的提升。
Motivation: LLM 智能体正从对话助手发展为执行长时程任务的自主系统，需要在持久化环境与多步骤工作流中保证可靠执行、一致结果、安全并发和持久状态管理——这些挑战与事务型数据库系统所解决的问题类似，但当前缺乏形式化与系统层面的支持。
Method: 提出一套 ACID 合规的智能体系统框架，将经典 ACID 性质重释为语义原子性、语义一致性、语义隔离和语义持久性四种保证；并以数据智能体为实例，通过事务化探索-执行-验证周期、事务化技能中心、基于置信度分歧的验证、语义依赖感知隔离和事务感知语义状态管理落实这些保证。
Result: 摘要报告在广泛使用的基准上，该系统较包括 Claude Code 在内的最先进智能体取得了 10.6% 的性能提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为这项工作开启了将事务性原则与系统架构推广至构建可信、可扩展、可自我进化的 AI 智能体系统的更广泛研究议程。

papers.title: Practical Lossless Volumetric Medical Image Compression via Tri-plane Context Tree Learning
papers.abstract_en: Lossless compression of volumetric medical images is of paramount importance for clinical and research applications where data fidelity is essential. Traditional compression methods are often limited in efficiency due to rigid, handcrafted models. Conversely, deep neural network (DNN)-based compression methods, while effective, demand substantial computational resources, hindering deployment in resource-constrained settings. To address these challenges, we propose a novel tri-plane context tree (TCT)-based method for lossless volumetric medical image compression that delivers high performance without relying on DNNs or external training data. To exploit intra-slice and inter-slice redundancies, we introduce a compact tri-plane context representation that decomposes complex 3D context modeling into efficient 2D modeling on three orthogonal planes. By integrating this representation with a context tree framework, we develop an input-specific TCT model employing an adaptive binary tree structure. At each tree node, the model dynamically selects from a suite of tri-plane based predictors and contextual feature extractors, enabling data-adaptive context modeling tailored to local structural characteristics. Instead of offline training, we sample a subset of the input volume to learn the TCT model by optimizing the minimum description length (MDL) through iterative construction and pruning. With the learned TCT model, each pixel retrieves its corresponding context, computes the prediction residual using the predictor dictated by the context, and performs entropy encoding based on the associated histograms. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves compression performance on par with recent DNN-based methods on multiple datasets, while maintaining low computational cost and fast coding speeds, making it highly applicable in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于三平面上下文树 (tri-plane context tree, TCT) 的无损医学容积图像压缩方法，不需要 DNN 或外部训练数据。方法将三维上下文建模分解为三个正交平面上的二维建模，并结合自适应二叉树结构进行输入特定的上下文建模，通过采样子集并用最小描述长度 (MDL) 优化来学习模型。实验表明该方法在多个数据集上达到与近期 DNN 方法相当的压缩性能，同时计算成本低、编码速度快。
Motivation: 传统无损压缩方法受限于刚性且手工设计的模型，效率有限；基于 DNN 的压缩方法虽然有效，但需要大量计算资源，难以在资源受限场景部署。
Method: 提出紧凑的三平面上下文表示，将复杂的 3D 上下文建模拆解为三个正交平面上的高效 2D 建模；将该表示集成到上下文树框架中，形成采用自适应二叉树结构的输入特定 TCT 模型。每个树节点动态选择三平面预测器和上下文特征提取器，通过迭代构建与剪枝并优化 MDL 来学习模型；随后逐像素获取上下文、计算预测残差并基于关联直方图进行熵编码。
Result: 多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在压缩性能上与近期 DNN 方法相当，同时保持低计算成本和快速编码速度。
Conclusion: 该方法不依赖 DNN 或外部训练数据，能以较低资源开销获得接近 DNN 方法的压缩性能，适合实际应用。

summary_sections.method: 提出紧凑的三平面上下文表示，将复杂的 3D 上下文建模拆解为三个正交平面上的高效 2D 建模；将该表示集成到上下文树框架中，形成采用自适应二叉树结构的输入特定 TCT 模型。每个树节点动态选择三平面预测器和上下文特征提取器，通过迭代构建与剪枝并优化 MDL 来学习模型；随后逐像素获取上下文、计算预测残差并基于关联直方图进行熵编码。
summary_sections.result: 多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在压缩性能上与近期 DNN 方法相当，同时保持低计算成本和快速编码速度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法不依赖 DNN 或外部训练数据，能以较低资源开销获得接近 DNN 方法的压缩性能，适合实际应用。

papers.title: Consensus-gated Multi-Agent Neural Architecture Search for Seismic Fault Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks for seismic fault segmentation are often borrowed from computer vision and medical imaging domains where they train under relatively much larger labeled data resources. Optimizing their architecture under tight labeled data budgets as are common in geophysical applications is not a trivial problem. Manually designing data-optimal architectures is time-consuming while classical neural architecture search (NAS) is restricted to hand-crafted search spaces and large compute budgets. We present an agentic NAS system in which a panel of three large language models (Claude, GPT-5.1, and Gemini~2.5~Pro) debates each candidate architecture to unanimous consensus, authors the complete PyTorch implementation, cross-reviews it, and submits it to an automated validate-train-score loop with a hard 450K parameter budget, keep-or-revert lineage, and a memory of failed mechanisms. Operating on source code rather than a predefined operation menu, the search ran on a single consumer GPU and trained only eight candidates. It discovered \ours{}: a 425K-parameter encoder-decoder with a strip-pooling bottleneck, squeeze-and-excitation gating, an asymmetric one-conv decoder, and a feature-pyramid fusion neck. Trained under a protocol identical to all baselines on sections derived from the Thebe fault dataset, it attains the highest F1 (0.578) and IoU of all models tested while being the smallest, outperforming a published-capacity U-Net (31M parameters, F1 0.484), DeepLabV3-ResNet50 (39.6M, 0.516), an Attention U-Net(1.83M, 0.502). The search cost 101 LLM calls ($\sim$1.15M input / 0.39M output tokens) and roughly one GPU-day, making consensus-gated LLM panels a practical, low-cost route to domain-specific architecture discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于共识门控的多智能体神经架构搜索（NAS）系统，用于地震断层分割。系统由三个大语言模型（Claude、GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.5 Pro）组成专家组，对每个候选架构进行辩论至共识一致，并自动编写PyTorch实现、交叉评审后提交到带450K参数硬预算的验证-训练-评分循环中。搜索在单个消费级GPU上仅训练8个候选，发现一个425K参数的编码器-解码器模型，在Thebe断层数据集上取得最高F1（0.578）和IoU，同时模型最小。
Motivation: 地震断层分割网络常直接借用计算机视觉与医学影像架构，但地球物理应用中标注数据稀缺，手动设计数据最优架构耗时，而经典NAS受限于手工搜索空间和大计算预算。
Method: 提出agentic NAS系统：三个LLM以辩论方式对每个候选架构达成一致共识，编写完整PyTorch实现并交叉评审，再提交至自动的validate-train-score循环，采用450K参数硬预算、keep-or-revert谱系以及失败机制记忆；搜索直接在源代码层面操作，而非预定义操作菜单。
Result: 搜索发现425K参数编码器-解码器，含strip-pooling瓶颈、squeeze-and-excitation门控、非对称单卷积解码器和特征金字塔融合颈部。在与所有基线相同的训练协议下，该模型在Thebe断层数据集上达到最高F1 0.578和IoU，优于31M参数的U-Net（F1 0.484）、DeepLabV3-ResNet50（39.6M，0.516）和Attention U-Net（1.83M，0.502）。搜索总成本为101次LLM调用（约1.15M输入/0.39M输出token）和约1个GPU天。
Conclusion: 摘要强调共识门控的LLM专家组为领域特定的架构发现提供了低成本、实用的途径，使NAS在数据与计算资源受限时仍可行。

papers.title: Fashion Outfit Generation via Unified Sequential Composition Models
papers.abstract_en: The task of synthesizing stylistically coherent fashion outfits from massive item libraries, known as fashion outfit generation, remains a non-trivial challenge, primarily due to the non-monotonic and implicit nature of aesthetic compatibility, coupled with the exponentially large combinatorial search space. In this paper, we formalize this task as Constrained Ensemble Generation (CEG) and model it as a finite-horizon deterministic Markov Decision Process. To address CEG in fashion, we propose the Unified Sequential Composition Model (USCM), which jointly models set-level compatibility and latent composition intents. Guided by USCM's learned priors, a Latent Expansion Monte Carlo Tree Search (LE-MCTS) mechanism is proposed to handle item retrieval during composition, balancing local aesthetic synergy with global structural balance. Extensive experiments on the Polyvore Outfits dataset, along with zero-shot evaluations on the iFashion and PolyvoreU datasets, demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance across independent human preference evaluations, automated aesthetic proxies, and structural validity metrics for constrained fashion outfit generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从海量单品库中合成风格一致的服装搭配（fashion outfit generation），将该任务形式化为约束集合生成（Constrained Ensemble Generation, CEG），并建模为有限时域确定性马尔可夫决策过程。作者提出统一序列组合模型（USCM），联合建模集合级兼容性与潜在组合意图，并设计潜在扩展蒙特卡洛树搜索（Latent Expansion Monte Carlo Tree Search, LE-MCTS）来平衡局部美学协同与全局结构平衡。在 Polyvore Outfits 数据集及 iFashion、PolyvoreU 上的零样本评估中，框架在人工偏好评估、自动化美学代理和结构有效性指标上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 服装搭配生成的主要挑战在于审美兼容性具有非单调和隐式的特性，且组合搜索空间呈指数级增长，使得从大规模单品库中生成风格一致的搭配成为非平凡问题。
Method: 将任务形式化为约束集合生成（CEG），建模为有限时域确定性马尔可夫决策过程；提出统一序列组合模型（USCM）联合建模集合级兼容性与潜在组合意图，并基于其学习先验提出潜在扩展蒙特卡洛树搜索（LE-MCTS）来执行组合过程中的单品检索，兼顾局部美学协同与全局结构平衡。
Result: 在 Polyvore Outfits 数据集上的大量实验，以及在 iFashion 和 PolyvoreU 上的零样本评估表明，该框架在独立人工偏好评估、自动化美学代理和结构有效性指标上均达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联合建模集合级兼容性与潜在组合意图，并配合基于先验的树搜索机制，可以有效处理约束服装搭配生成。

papers.title: Engineering Signals of Human-AI Collaboration in the Agentic Coding Era: A Longitudinal Analysis of 33,228 Pull Requests from vLLM and SGLang with Implications for Biomedical AI Agents and Bioinformatics Pipeline Developmen
papers.abstract_en: The rapid adoption of AI coding assistants and autonomous agentic development systems has coincided with major changes in the pace and structure of open-source software engineering. Yet empirical longitudinal evidence of these changes at the team level remains limited. We present a descriptive longitudinal analysis of seven engineering metrics: pull request (PR) throughput, cycle time, contributor diversity, PR comment density, merge rate, new-author participation, and PR size. Metrics were computed from all merged PRs in two high-velocity AI infrastructure repositories, vLLM (February 2023-June 2026; 18,290 PRs) and SGLang (January 2024-June 2026; 14,938 PRs). We segment development into four eras aligned with major changes in AI-assisted software development and examine human- and bot-authored activities. Both projects show substantial increases in development velocity and AI-developer collaboration signals. PR throughput increased 21x in vLLM and 17.9x in SGLang, while bot-authored PRs accounted for less than 0.2% of this growth, indicating that the increase was overwhelmingly human-driven. In the latest era, median cycle time was 1.04 days for vLLM and 0.62 days for SGLang, while P90 cycle times reached 16.8 and 14.3 days, respectively. Monthly unique authors increased steadily in both projects, suggesting broader contributor participation. PR comment density increased 4.2x in vLLM and 3.8x in SGLang, with bot comments contributing an estimated 15-20% of the increase. In contrast, PR size remained relatively stable across eras. Overall, AI-assisted development is associated with higher throughput, broader contributor participation, and increased AI-developer collaboration signals in high-velocity open-source software development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对两个高吞吐 AI 基础设施仓库 vLLM（18,290 个 PR）和 SGLang（14,938 个 PR）进行了描述性纵向分析，考察 AI 辅助开发时代中开源软件工程指标的变化。研究将开发过程划分为四个时代，统计了 PR 吞吐量、周期时间、贡献者多样性、评论密度、合并率、新作者参与度和 PR 大小等七项指标，并区分了人类与机器人（bot）作者的活动。结果显示两个项目的开发速度大幅提升，且增长主要由人类驱动，机器人 PR 占比不足 0.2%。
Motivation: AI 编程助手和自主智能体开发系统的快速普及被认为改变了开源软件工程的节奏与结构，但关于这些变化在团队层面的长期经验证据仍然有限。
Method: 采用描述性纵向分析方法，从 vLLM 和 SGLang 的所有合并 PR 中计算七项工程指标，按 AI 辅助软件开发的重要变化节点划分四个时代，并分别考察人类与机器人作者的活动贡献。
Result: PR 吞吐量在 vLLM 中增长 21 倍、在 SGLang 中增长 17.9 倍，其中机器人作者 PR 占比不足 0.2%，表明增长主要由人类驱动；最新时代的中位周期时间分别为 1.04 天（vLLM）和 0.62 天（SGLang），P90 周期时间分别达 16.8 天和 14.3 天；PR 评论密度分别增长 4.2 倍和 3.8 倍，其中机器人评论估计贡献了 15–20% 的增长；月度独立作者数量稳步增加，而 PR 大小保持相对稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要总结认为，AI 辅助开发与高吞吐开源软件项目中更高的开发速度、更广泛的贡献者参与以及增强的人机协作信号相关。

papers.title: MemoryLake on MemoryArena: A Matched Study of Agent Memory Backends
papers.abstract_en: Most agent-memory benchmarks test post-hoc recall, whereas MemoryArena evaluates whether memory supports interdependent, multi-session task completion. We compare MemoryLake, a structured multi-track memory backend, with Mem0, text-embedding-3-small vector RAG, and a long-context control across all five MemoryArena domains. The systems share the same agent framework, requested gpt-5-mini model alias, task samples, and scoring code; the memory integration is the intentionally changed component. Because each backend bundles write, retrieval, consolidation, budgeting, and prompt-assembly choices, the study is a matched system-level comparison, not a representation-only ablation or a cost-matched experiment. On the shared evaluation sets, MemoryLake has the highest observed success rate (SR) in mathematics (9/40), physics (12/20), and progressive retrieval (4/20). Every system has zero SR in travel planning, and web shopping yields a single bundle-level success (long context, 1/150); MemoryLake ranks third on both the travel soft process score and shopping step match. Following MemoryArena's suite-level convention, a post-hoc equal-weight average over the five SRs is 20.5% for MemoryLake versus 13.6% for the best comparator. These are point estimates: sample sizes are modest, confidence intervals overlap, and we do not report paired significance tests. A separate MemoryLake-only run over all 221 progressive queries yields a failure-counted SR of 26.7% (59/221) and is not a baseline comparison. The results support a workload-dependent view of memory backends and an observed lead among the four evaluated systems on the shared sets; they do not establish benchmark-wide state of the art or a causal advantage of representation structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 MemoryArena 基准上对三种智能体记忆后端做受控系统级对比：MemoryLake（结构化多轨记忆）、Mem0（text-embedding-3-small 向量 RAG）和长上下文控制，四个系统共享同一智能体框架、gpt-5-mini 模型别名、任务样本和评分代码，仅替换记忆集成。在共享评测集上，MemoryLake 在数学（9/40）、物理（12/20）和渐进式检索（4/20）取得最高成功率；旅行规划所有系统 SR 为 0，web shopping 仅长上下文控制获得 1/150。按 MemoryArena 套件级约定对五个 SR 做等权平均，MemoryLake 为 20.5%，最佳对比系统为 13.6%。
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆基准多测试事后检索 (post-hoc recall)，而 MemoryArena 检验记忆是否支持相互依赖的多会话任务完成；本文旨在这种更严格设定下比较结构化记忆后端 MemoryLake 与常见向量 RAG 和长上下文基线。
Method: 采用匹配系统级比较：四个系统共享同一智能体框架、请求的 gpt-5-mini 模型别名、任务样本和评分代码，故意只改变记忆集成；每个后端捆绑了写入、检索、整合、预算和提示组装等选择，因此不是表征消融或成本匹配实验。
Result: MemoryLake 在数学、物理和渐进式检索上观察到最高 SR（分别为 9/40、12/20、4/20）；旅行规划各系统 SR 均为 0，web shopping 仅长上下文控制获得 1/150。套件级等权 SR 平均为 MemoryLake 20.5% 对最佳对比系统 13.6%。作者明确说明这些是点估计，样本量有限、置信区间重叠、未做配对显著性检验；单独的 MemoryLake-only 221 条渐进查询失败计数 SR 为 26.7%（59/221），并非基线比较。
Conclusion: 结果支持记忆后端效果依赖工作负载的观点，也显示 MemoryLake 在四个被评系统共享评测集上的领先；但不构成基准全域最先进水平，也不能断言表征结构带来因果优势。

papers.title: Variation Brownian Kernel Ladders
papers.abstract_en: Claims about the benefit of depth depend on the complexity assigned to a representation. We introduce the \emph{Variation Brownian Kernel Ladder} (VBKL), a path-atomic function-space framework that separates nonlinear recursive dictionary construction from linear variation superposition. Starting from linear projections, each atom recursively composes unit-ball profiles from the Brownian reproducing kernel Hilbert space; the full VBKL space is then the signed-measure variation hull of the completed dictionary. We identify each recursive dictionary as a union of Brownian pullback RKHS balls and establish variation-controlled Hölder regularity, compactness and attainment, and strict growth with depth under a local non-degeneracy condition whose trace lies in the support of the input measure. For associated finite lower-support architectures, we derive Rademacher and generalization bounds through Brownian quadratic chaos, signed threshold traces, and VC entropy. We also construct two-stage approximants by discretizing the outer measure and the selected outer Brownian profiles, obtaining an $M^{-1/2}+m^{-1/2}$ error bound, a sharp interpolation constant $\sqrt{A/2}$, and at most $2M$ active outer-profile basis contributions per evaluation. Controlled experiments illustrate the approximation mechanisms and indicate a favorable limited-data accuracy--complexity trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Variation Brownian Kernel Ladder (VBKL)，一种路径原子式的函数类空间框架，将递归非线性字典构建与线性变差叠加分离。每个原子从线性投影出发，递归地由 Brownian 再生核 Hilbert 空间 (RKHS) 中的单位球剖面复合，整个 VBKL 空间则是完备字典的符号测度变差包络。作者给出变差控制的 Hölder 正则性、紧性、极值可达性与随深度严格增长等理论性质，并为有限低支撑架构导出 Rademacher 与泛化界。还构造了两阶段逼近器，得到 M^{-1/2}+m^{-1/2} 误差界、插值常数 sqrt(A/2) 以及每次求值至多 2M 个活跃外剖面基贡献。
Motivation: 摘要指出关于深度收益的论断依赖于对表示所赋予的复杂度分配，而现有框架难以精细刻画这种复杂性。该工作目标是为深度增长提供可分析的函数空间基础，分离字典构造与线性叠加两种机制。
Method: 引入 VBKL 框架：从线性投影开始，每个原子递归地复合 Brownian RKHS 中的单位球剖面；完整函数空间取已建成字典的符号测度变差包络。对有限低支撑架构，使用 Brownian 二次混沌 (Brownian quadratic chaos)、符号阈值迹 (signed threshold traces) 和 VC 熵推导 Rademacher 与泛化界；通过离散化外测度和外层 Brownian 剖面构造两阶段逼近器。
Result: 理论结果包括变差控制的 Hölder 正则性、紧性、极值可达性，以及在局部非退化条件下深度严格增长；逼近误差界为 M^{-1/2}+m^{-1/2}，插值常数为 sqrt(A/2)，单次求值最多 2M 个活跃外剖面基贡献。受控实验展示了逼近机制，并显示出有利的有限数据精度-复杂度权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调深度收益的归因取决于表示复杂度的分配，VBKL 提供了一套可分析深度性质与泛化行为的函数空间途径。该工作属于通用学习理论框架，摘要未提及任何具体应用或与气象、降水等任务的联系。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Generalization Error Estimation for Primal--Dual Algorithms in Non-Smooth Regression
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies trajectory-wise estimation of generalization error for primal--dual algorithms in non-smooth regression. Motivating examples include \(\ell_1\)-penalized least absolute deviations regression and square-root Lasso regression, where the data-fitting loss is non-differentiable and existing risk estimators for gradient-type optimization paths do not apply directly. We develop a general recursive framework that includes the Chambolle--Pock algorithm and related primal--dual splitting methods. We estimate risk by correcting each in-sample fitted value with a weighted combination of past dual iterates. The ideal weights are Stein derivative contractions and depend on the design covariance. We construct replacement weights from observable derivative contractions of the fitted-signal trajectory, yielding a covariance-free, data-driven correction. For high-dimensional Gaussian designs and fixed finite iteration horizon, we prove finite-sample guarantees for both estimators. For square-root ridge, we further establish a matched-Gaussian universality result beyond Gaussian designs. Numerical experiments show that the proposed estimators accurately track the out-of-sample risk along finite optimization paths.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非光滑回归中原对偶算法（primal-dual algorithms）轨迹上的泛化误差估计，动机示例包括 ℓ1 惩罚的最小绝对偏差回归和平方根 Lasso 回归。作者提出一个包含 Chambolle–Pock 算法及相关分裂方法的通用递归框架，用过去对偶迭代的加权组合校正样本内拟合值，并构造无协方差、数据驱动的替代权重。在高维高斯设计和固定有限迭代步数下，文章证明两个估计器的有限样本保证，并针对平方根岭回归得到超出高斯设计的 matched-Gaussian 普适性结果。数值实验显示所提估计器能准确追踪有限优化路径上的样本外风险。
Motivation: 对于数据拟合损失不可微的非光滑回归，现有的梯度型优化路径风险估计器无法直接应用，而 ℓ1 惩罚最小绝对偏差回归和平方根 Lasso 等模型恰好属于这一类别。
Method: 建立通用递归估计框架，覆盖 Chambolle–Pock 算法及相关的原对偶分裂方法；通过过去对偶迭代的加权组合校正每个样本内拟合值，理想权重是依赖设计协方差的 Stein 导数收缩，作者用可观察的拟合信号轨迹导数收缩构造替代权重，从而得到无协方差、数据驱动的校正项。
Result: 在高维高斯设计与固定有限迭代步数设定下，作者对两个估计器证明了有限样本保证；对于平方根岭回归，还建立了一个超越高斯设计的 matched-Gaussian 普适性结果。数值实验表明估计器能准确追踪有限优化路径上的样本外风险。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架将风险估计沿原对偶优化路径推广到非光滑回归，并提供了不依赖设计协方差的数据驱动校正；其理论保证主要面向高维高斯设计和有限迭代步数。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Engineering Reliable Coding Agents: Evaluating and Operating the System Around the Model
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are commonly evaluated as models but deployed as systems. Their reliability depends not only on model capability, but on the harness, execution state, retrieval, memory and state management, permissions, review interfaces, and resource allocation. This monograph examines those boundaries and develops a framework for evaluating and operating coding agents reliably. It synthesizes 164 scholarly works, 100 practitioner records, 29 benchmark records, and 17 author-system case records through a structured multivocal review, targeted update audits, software-engineering coverage analysis, and distributed-systems evidence synthesis. Across this evidence, many apparent model failures originate elsewhere in the system, while improvements at one layer often fail to propagate to end-to-end outcomes. Evaluation and operation are treated as a dependency chain in which weaknesses in task construction, execution environments, retrieval, state management, verification, or observability can invalidate downstream conclusions. The monograph contributes a versioned catalog of 206 reliability records: 193 gated practices, including 56 developed in depth, plus 13 research leads; an evidence ledger; a framework for dependency and repair asymmetry across the agent lifecycle; measurements and failure cases from operated agent systems; runnable evaluation and reliability protocols; and five reusable agent skills with evidence maps. Together, these provide a system-level methodology for distinguishing model capability from infrastructure effects, designing defensible evaluations, and building systems that recover safely when components fail. The review is structured rather than exhaustive, evidence strength varies by topic, and results depend on workload and configuration. The methods record which search lanes were executed, which remain unexecuted, and limits on evidence-grading claims.
papers.comment: Technical review and engineering monograph, 314 pages, 30 figures. Includes an evidence audit, a companion research artifact with 206 reliability records, and runnable protocols for evaluating and operating AI coding agents. August 2026. Source, companion, and reusable protocols: https://github.com/sjarmak/engineering-reliable-coding-agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一份关于 AI 编码代理（coding agents）可靠性的工程技术专著，主张这些代理通常被当作模型评估却被当作系统部署，可靠性取决于模型之外的支架（harness）、执行状态、检索、内存、权限、审查界面和资源分配。作者通过对 164 篇学术文献、100 条实践记录、29 条基准记录和 17 条作者系统案例的结构化多语言综述与证据合成，提出一套系统级方法论，用于区分模型能力与基础设施效应、设计可辩护的评估，并构建能安全恢复的系统。
Motivation: 现有评估通常把 AI 编码代理当作模型而不是系统，导致很多表面上的模型失败实际源于系统的其他层，且某一层的改进往往无法传导到端到端结果。
Method: 采用结构化多语言综述、定向更新审计、软件工程覆盖率分析和分布式系统证据合成，把评估与运行视为一条依赖链；贡献包括 206 条可靠性记录的版本化目录、证据账本、跨代理生命周期的依赖与修复不对称框架、可运行的评估和可靠性协议，以及五个带证据图的可复用代理技能。
Result: 摘要报告综合了大量来源并产出 193 条门控实践（其中 56 条深入开发）和 13 条研究线索，同时记录了来自实际运行代理系统的测量与失败案例，指出许多模型级失败其实源于系统中的其他部分。
Conclusion: 作者强调该审查是有结构而非穷尽式的，证据强度因主题而异，结果取决于工作负载与配置；方法部分记录了已执行和未执行的搜索路径及证据分级声明的限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric Filtering of LLM-Generated Samples for Few-Shot Text Classification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate synthetic training data for text classification, but the quality of generated samples is heterogeneous: some fall in correct class regions of the embedding space while others land in peripheral or cross-class zones. We propose a geometric filtering framework that evaluates each LLM-generated sample by its Euclidean distance to real class examples in a sentence embedding space, selecting only geometrically consistent candidates. A soft weighting mechanism transforms filter scores into sample weights for classifier training. Evaluated across 13 datasets, 5 classifiers, 10 augmentation methods, and over 6,700 configurations, our method achieves +2.61 percentage points (pp) over SMOTE ($p<0.0001$, Cohen's $d=0.95$, 88.9% win rate). The approach generalizes to named entity recognition (+9.26pp, 100% win rate) without filter modification, and is robust across 5 LLMs from 4 providers. A key finding is that the simplest distance-based filter consistently outperforms complex multi-criteria alternatives.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, to be published in IEEE LACCI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种几何过滤框架，用于筛选大语言模型（LLM）生成的少样本文本分类训练数据。该方法在句子嵌入空间中计算每个生成样本到真实类样本的欧氏距离，仅保留几何一致的候选样本，并用软加权机制将过滤分数转化为训练权重。在13个数据集、5个分类器、10种增强方法和6700余种配置上，该方法相对SMOTE提升+2.61个百分点，并泛化到命名实体识别任务。
Motivation: LLM生成的合成训练数据质量参差不齐，部分样本落入嵌入空间中正确的类区域，而另一些则位于边缘或跨类区域，影响少样本分类的训练效果。
Method: 提出几何过滤框架，依据生成样本与真实类样本在句子嵌入空间中的欧氏距离评估质量，并引入软加权机制将过滤分数转换为分类器训练权重。
Result: 在13个数据集、5个分类器、10种增强方法和超过6700种配置的评估中，该方法比SMOTE平均提升+2.61个百分点（p<0.0001，Cohen's d=0.95，胜率88.9%）；在命名实体识别上提升+9.26个百分点（胜率100%），且对来自4个提供商的5种LLM均表现稳健。
Conclusion: 作者强调最简形式的距离过滤一致优于复杂的多准则替代方案，且该方法无需修改过滤器即可泛化到其他序列标注任务。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种几何过滤框架，用于筛选大语言模型（LLM）生成的少样本文本分类训练数据。该方法在句子嵌入空间中计算每个生成样本到真实类样本的欧氏距离，仅保留几何一致的候选样本，并用软加权机制将过滤分数转化为训练权重。在13个数据集、5个分类器、10种增强方法和6700余种配置上，该方法相对SMOTE提升+2.61个百分点，并泛化到命名实体识别任务。
summary_sections.motivation: LLM生成的合成训练数据质量参差不齐，部分样本落入嵌入空间中正确的类区域，而另一些则位于边缘或跨类区域，影响少样本分类的训练效果。
summary_sections.method: 提出几何过滤框架，依据生成样本与真实类样本在句子嵌入空间中的欧氏距离评估质量，并引入软加权机制将过滤分数转换为分类器训练权重。

papers.title: Attention Capture Is Not Detection: A Two-Stage Account of How Humans Miss Localized AI Image Edits
papers.abstract_en: As AI-generated image edits proliferate, the platforms meant to curb the resulting disinformation treat detectability as a single, undifferentiated property: an edit either gets a warning or it does not. We show this is the wrong model. Across a controlled eye-tracking study ($N=59$, Latin-square design, four conditions crossing edit area and semantic plausibility), a mixed-effects analysis reveals that whether an edit is noticed and whether it is correctly judged as fake are dissociable stages, governed by different factors: edit area drives attention capture ($p<0.001$) while semantic plausibility drives judgment accuracy and look-but-fail-to-see (LBFS) error rates ($p<0.001$). This dissociation survives correction for multiple comparisons; a secondary interaction between the two factors does not. This two-stage account extends a long-standing distinction in visual attention research (between pre-attentive capture and effortful recognition) into the new domain of AI-edit detectability. We then test whether a generative eye-movement model can computationally operationalize the attention-capture stage: a Transformer trained to generate scanpaths tracks per-image attention with strong discriminative power (Pearson $r=0.77$--$0.82$ across held-out stimuli) and, on the harder task of predicting LBFS incidence, modestly outperforms a two-parameter linear baseline even without access to the plausibility label ($r=0.52$ vs. $r=0.48$). We report this comparison, our ablations, and our method's limitations (a single fixed train/validation split, not leave-one-subject-out) without inflation, consistent with responsibly communicating what a machine learning system can and cannot do to help curb AI-driven disinformation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 生成图像编辑的可检测性问题，提出注意捕获（attention capture）与真伪判断是两阶段、可分离的过程。基于 N=59 的被试内眼动实验和混合效应分析，摘要报告编辑面积驱动注意捕获，语义合理性驱动判断准确率与 look-but-fail-to-see (LBFS) 错误率；并检验了生成式眼动模型能否计算化地实现注意捕获阶段。
Motivation: 当前用于遏制 AI 图像编辑虚假信息的平台把可检测性视为单一、无差别的属性，只要编辑被警告就算被检测。作者认为这是错误模型，因为“是否注意到编辑”和“是否正确判断其为假”由不同因素支配，需要区分这两个阶段。
Method: 采用受控眼动追踪研究（N=59，拉丁方设计，编辑面积与语义合理性两个条件交叉），用混合效应分析检验各因素的作用；随后训练一个 Transformer 生成式眼动模型（scanpath 生成），用于预测逐图像注意力和 LBFS 发生率，并与两参数线性基线对比。
Result: 编辑面积显著驱动注意捕获（p<0.001），语义合理性显著驱动判断准确率与 LBFS 错误率（p<0.001），二因素交互在多重比较校正后不显著。生成式眼动模型对逐图像注意力有强判别力（Pearson r=0.77–0.82），在无合理性标签时预测 LBFS 的 r=0.52，略优于两参数线性基线的 r=0.48。
Conclusion: 作者提出两阶段解释，将注意力研究中“前注意捕获与费力识别”的既有区分推广到 AI 编辑可检测性领域，并认为生成式眼动模型可计算化地实现注意捕获阶段。摘要坦陈局限：使用单一固定训练/验证划分而非 leave-one-subject-out，且结果报告保持谨慎。

papers.title: Joint Optimization of Memory and Computing Frequency for Energy-Efficient DNN Inference
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural network (DNN) inference on mobile devices often incurs high latency and energy consumption due to limited computing and memory resources. To enable energy-efficient DNN inference, most existing studies focus on dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) for adjusting the computing frequency, while the impact of memory frequency on the inference performance has been greatly overlooked. In this paper, we consider the impact of memory frequency and computing frequency on DNN inference time, and jointly optimize these two frequencies together with communication resources for energy-efficient DNN inference. Based on a realistic inference time model, we formulate an optimization problem to minimize the energy consumption of all mobile devices under the deadline constraint. For local inference, we derive a near-optimal closed-form solution via convex optimization, while an optimal closed-form solution for transmission power is obtained for edge inference with the given bandwidth. Furthermore, we propose a low-complexity heuristic algorithm to effectively solve the overall problem with polynomial time complexity. Simulation results based on measured data show that the proposed near-optimal solution for local inference can achieve optimal performance under strict deadline constraints, with a performance gap of up to 2.5% compared with the optimal solution. Meanwhile, our proposed algorithm significantly reduces the energy consumption of devices by up to 10.4% compared to other methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对移动设备上 DNN 推理的能耗问题，提出联合优化内存频率、计算频率与通信资源的调度方案。基于实测数据构建的推理时延模型，作者以截止时间约束下最小化所有移动设备能耗为目标建立优化问题，并给出本地推理的近最优闭式解、边缘推理的发射功率闭式解以及低复杂度启发式算法。仿真结果表明，在严格截止时间约束下本地推理方案与最优解的差距不超过 2.5%，且所提算法相比其他方法最多可降低 10.4% 的设备能耗。
Motivation: 现有节能 DNN 推理研究大多只通过 DVFS 调节计算频率，忽视了内存频率对推理性能的影响。论文指出内存与计算资源共同受限是移动端 DNN 推理高时延、高能耗的关键，因此需要联合优化内存频率、计算频率与通信资源。
Method: 基于考虑内存频率与计算频率的推理时延模型，建立以截止时间为约束、最小化所有移动设备能耗的优化问题。对本地推理采用凸优化导出近最优闭式解，对边缘推理在给定带宽下得到发射功率的最优闭式解，并设计多项式时间复杂度的低复杂度启发式算法求解整体问题。
Result: 基于实测数据的仿真显示，本地推理的近最优解在严格截止时间约束下逼近最优性能，性能差距最多 2.5%；所提算法相比其他方法最多可降低设备能耗 10.4%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，联合调节内存频率与计算频率并协调通信资源，可以在满足截止时间约束的前提下显著降低设备能耗；低复杂度启发式算法使整体问题可在多项式时间内求解。

papers.title: XSA-MAD: Cross-modal Semantic Alignment for Morphing Attack Detection
papers.abstract_en: Morphing attacks pose a serious threat to face recognition systems. However, existing image-based morphing attack detection (MAD) methods often generalize poorly to unseen generation techniques because they rely solely on visual cues. We propose XSA-MAD, a CLIP-based multimodal framework that explicitly models semantic inconsistencies between bona-fide and morphed faces. Morphing concepts are decomposed into four interpretable attributes, including identity, facial geometry, texture, and consistency, and are encoded as structured and attribute-aware textual representations. The image encoder is progressively aligned with this discriminative textual space, resulting in a unified semantic representation that captures generation-invariant and concept-level discrepancies between bona-fide and morph images. Experiments on MAD22 and MorDIFF, following training on SMDD, demonstrate strong generalization across diverse morphing principles. In particular, XSA-MAD achieves an equal error rate of 2.92% on GAN-based morphs and consistently outperforms existing methods under high-fidelity generative attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XSA-MAD，一个基于 CLIP 的多模态框架，用于人脸变形攻击检测（MAD）。方法将变形概念分解为身份、面部几何、纹理和一致性四个可解释属性，并编码为结构化的属性感知文本表示，图像编码器逐步与该判别性文本空间对齐，以捕捉生成无关的概念级差异。在 SMDD 上训练、MAD22 和 MorDIFF 上评估，GAN 变形攻击的等错误率（EER）为 2.92%，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有基于图像的变形攻击检测方法仅依赖视觉线索，面对未见过的生成技术时泛化能力较差，这是人脸识别系统安全中的关键缺陷。
Method: 提出 CLIP 驱动的多模态框架，将变形概念显式分解为四个可解释属性（身份、面部几何、纹理、一致性）并构建结构化文本表示，通过渐进对齐图像编码器与文本空间，得到统一的语义表示来刻画真实脸与变形脸之间的概念级差异。
Result: 在 MAD22 和 MorDIFF 上验证，训练于 SMDD 后展现出跨多种变形原理的强泛化能力；在 GAN 类变形攻击上取得 2.92% 的 EER，并在高保真生成攻击下持续优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将视觉与语义信息结合、显式建模概念级不一致性可以提升 MAD 对未知生成技术的泛化能力。

papers.title: Face Re-morphing: Differential Morphing Attack Detection via Feature-Space Similarity Changes
papers.abstract_en: Face morphing attacks pose a serious threat to face recognition systems because a single morphed document image can be matched to multiple contributors. Differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) addresses this threat by comparing a document image with a trusted live image, but existing methods often rely on static feature differences, constituent-face reconstruction, or multi-cue fusion. This paper proposes Face Re-morphing, a D-MAD method that uses the feature-space response to an additional morphing operation as a detection cue. Given a document image and a trusted live image, the proposed method generates a re-morphed image and uses the change between the document--live and live--re-morphed cosine similarities as the detection score. Experiments on FRLL-Morphs and FEI Morph show that the proposed cue is effective across different morphing conditions, re-morphing methods, and face recognition models. Comparisons with existing methods show favorable results on AMSL and indicate that the proposed method performs well under the Criminal condition on FEI Morph Version~1, particularly when using MorDIFF. These results indicate that re-morphing-induced similarity change provides a complementary cue for D-MAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Face Re-morphing，一种差分变形攻击检测（D-MAD）方法，核心思想是把“再次变形”操作引发的特征空间相似度变化作为检测线索。给定证件图像和可信活体图像，方法生成 re-morphed 图像，并以 document–live 与 live–re-morphed 的余弦相似度之差作为检测分数。在 FRLL-Morphs 和 FEI Morph 上的实验表明该线索在不同变形条件、重变形方法和人脸识别模型下均有效，并在 AMSL 及 FEI Morph Version 1 的 Criminal 条件下取得有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 人脸变形攻击可使单张变形证件照匹配到多个贡献者，对识别系统构成严重威胁；现有 D-MAD 方法多依赖静态特征差异、贡献面孔重建或多线索融合，缺乏利用额外变形操作本身作为检测信号的手段。
Method: 提出 Face Re-morphing：对证件图像与可信活体图像执行额外的 morphing 操作生成 re-morphed 图像，利用 document–live 与 live–re-morphed 两条余弦相似度之间的变化量作为检测分数，从而把特征空间对再次变形的响应转化为 D-MAD 的分类依据。
Result: 在 FRLL-Morphs 和 FEI Morph 数据集上的实验显示，该检测线索在不同变形条件、重变形方法及人脸识别模型下都有效；与现有方法相比，在 AMSL 上结果有优势，并在 FEI Morph Version 1 的 Criminal 条件下表现良好，尤其使用 MorDIFF 作为重变形方法时。
Conclusion: 作者认为重变形引发的相似度变化为 D-MAD 提供了互补的检测线索，可用于增强现有差分变形攻击检测能力。

papers.title: From crown candidates to neighborhood screening: integrating optical GeoAI and spatial modeling for urban-canopy assessment in Davis, California
papers.abstract_en: Timely urban-canopy information is essential for linking remote sensing with heat, mobility, and neighborhood planning. We developed an optical GeoAI workflow for Davis, California, using 2022 National Agriculture Imagery Program imagery (0.6 m RGB+NIR). DeepForest generated crown candidates; an NDVI threshold, non-maximum suppression, and box-prompted Segment Anything Model (ViT-B) produced a crown-anchored canopy surface. Analyses used the 25.92 km2 Census TIGER municipal boundary and a 100 m grid. The workflow retained 11,741 candidate crowns and mapped 2.43 km2 of canopy (9.37% of the city). On the identical extent, 87.8% of mapped canopy pixels and 97.4% of candidate centers agreed with the 2022 USDA/CAL FIRE LiDAR-assisted canopy product; the optical surface represented 34.2% of the reference canopy area (IoU 0.288; Dice 0.448). Approximately 49% of candidates occurred within 15 m of a road. Canopy was inversely associated with Landsat land-surface temperature (Spearman rho = -0.293; partial rho = -0.370 controlling for built probability), and spatial-lag modeling confirmed clear neighborhood structure. Two transparent attention surfaces combined canopy need with thermal and contextual indicators. The framework provides a reproducible, updateable screening layer that complements structural canopy products and municipal inventories while retaining assumptions, data provenance, and spatial diagnostics for planning interpretation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对城市冠层信息更新时效不足的问题，为加州 Davis 构建了一套光学 GeoAI 工作流：用 DeepForest 生成冠层候选框，再经 NDVI 阈值、非极大值抑制和 box-prompted Segment Anything Model (ViT-B) 得到冠层锚定的 canopy surface。在 25.92 km2 的市政边界内保留 11,741 个候选冠层并制图 2.43 km2 冠层（占城市 9.37%）；与 2022 年 USDA/CAL FIRE LiDAR 辅助冠层产品对比，像素一致率 87.8%、候选中心一致率 97.4%，光学表面覆盖参考冠层面积的 34.2%（IoU 0.288；Dice 0.448）。作者还将冠层与 Landsat 地表温度、道路距离和空间滞后模型结合，生成两个注意力图层，作为可复现、可更新的筛选层。
Motivation: 及时的城市冠层信息对于把遥感与热、移动性和邻里规划联系起来至关重要，而现有结构性冠层产品更新周期和局部精度有限，需要一种可复现、可更新的筛选层来补充市政清单。
Method: 提出光学 GeoAI 工作流：使用 2022 年 NAIP 0.6 m RGB+NIR 影像，DeepForest 生成 crown candidates，结合 NDVI 阈值、非极大值抑制和 box-prompted SAM (ViT-B) 生成 crown-anchored canopy surface；随后在 100 m 网格上结合 Landsat 地表温度、建筑概率和空间滞后模型（spatial-lag modeling）生成两个可解释的注意力图层。
Result: 工作流保留 11,741 个候选冠层并映射 2.43 km2 冠层（9.37%）；在相同范围内与 LiDAR 辅助冠层产品相比，87.8% 的映射像素和 97.4% 的候选中心一致，光学表面覆盖参考冠层 34.2%（IoU 0.288；Dice 0.448）。约 49% 的候选位于道路 15 m 内；冠层与地表温度呈负相关（Spearman rho = -0.293；控制建筑概率后偏 rho = -0.370），空间滞后模型确认了明显的邻里结构。
Conclusion: 该框架提供可复制、可更新的筛选层，能补充结构性冠层产品和市政清单，同时保留假设、数据来源和空间诊断信息，便于规划解读。

papers.title: Altitude-Dependent Near-Source Spectral Filtering of Meteor Infrasound Above 80 km and Consequences for Period-Based Energy Estimates
papers.abstract_en: Infrasound signal period is widely used as a proxy for source energy in bolide studies, but the reliability of period-yield relations for small, high-altitude regional meteors has not been systematically evaluated. We analyze 90 infrasound detections from well-constrained regional meteoroid events (source altitudes 20-111 km, ranges 47-268 km) and demonstrate a strong, monotonic decrease in receiver dominant frequency with increasing source altitude (Spearman r_{s} = -0.629, p = 3.3 x 10^11). No detections above 80 km retain dominant frequencies exceeding 3 Hz, and 75% of detections above 100 km are dominated by sub-1 Hz content. Partial correlation analysis indicates this is primarily an altitude effect, not a propagation distance artifact. Near-source dissipation modeling using the generalized Burgers equation supports a physical mechanism: the exponential increase in kinematic viscosity with altitude drives the acoustic Reynolds number downward, imposing frequency-dependent molecular absorption that selectively attenuates high-frequency content within the first 5 km below the source. Our results suggest that this atmospheric low-pass filter systematically modulates the observed period and can bias period-based energy estimates upward by one to two orders of magnitude for sources above 80-90 km when uncorrected period-yield relations are applied. These findings are relevant to any high-altitude infrasound source, including space debris and controlled reentries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了以次声信号周期作为火流星能量代理的可靠性，重点针对高空区域流星事件。作者分析了 90 次受约束的流星体次声探测（源高度 20–111 km，距离 47–268 km），发现接收端主频随源高度单调下降（Spearman r_s = -0.629），且 80 km 以上探测无主频超过 3 Hz，100 km 以上 75% 探测以亚 1 Hz 成分为主。通过广义 Burgers 方程近源耗散模拟，作者将这一现象归因于大气对高频成分的分子吸收低通滤波，并指出未校正的周期-能量关系会使 80–90 km 以上源的能量估计偏高一到两个数量级。
Motivation: 火流星研究中广泛使用次声信号周期作为源能量的代理，但针对小型高空区域流星，周期-能量（period-yield）关系的可靠性尚未被系统评估。
Method: 分析 90 次区域流星事件的次声探测数据，结合偏相关分析排除传播距离假象，并使用广义 Burgers 方程（generalized Burgers equation）对近源耗散进行建模，考察运动粘度随高度指数增加导致的声雷诺数下降和频率依赖的分子吸收。
Result: 观测显示接收主频随源高度强单调下降（Spearman r_s = -0.629）；80 km 以上探测无主频超过 3 Hz，100 km 以上 75% 探测以亚 1 Hz 为主。模型支持高频在源下方前 5 km 内被选择性衰减的机制，并估计未校正的周期-能量关系可使 80–90 km 以上源的能量估计偏高 1–2 个数量级。
Conclusion: 大气低通滤波会系统性地改变观测周期，并可能使基于周期的能量估计对高空源产生显著偏差；该发现适用于任何高空次声源，包括空间碎片和受控再入。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Posterior Inference of Hamiltonian Parameters from RIXS Spectroscopy
papers.abstract_en: We present the first application of simulation-based inference to resonant inelastic X-ray scattering spectroscopy. Using truncated marginal neural ratio estimation to efficiently restrict the prior and conditional flow matching as the joint density estimator, we infer full posteriors with a modest simulation budget for two Ni$^{2+}$ compounds---NiPS$_3$ as a representative covalent case and K$_2$NiF$_4$ as a more atomic one. We demonstrate that a vision transformer encoder whose tokenization matches the physical layout of the RIXS map yields better-covered and sharper posteriors than generic image encoders. Applying the validated method to experimental NiPS$_3$ and K$_2$NiF$_4$ data, we recover a joint posterior that reveals parameter correlations invisible to point estimators, and a posterior predictive distribution that closely matches the observed spectrum. The amortized posterior unlocks a class of analyses not previously available to the field such as nuisance-marginalized uncertainty quantification, multi-measurement posterior fusion and active experimental design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将基于模拟的推断 (simulation-based inference) 应用于共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 谱学，用于从光谱中推断哈密顿量参数的后验分布。方法结合截断边际神经比估计 (truncated marginal neural ratio estimation) 与条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching)，并以视觉 Transformer 编码器处理与 RIXS 图物理布局匹配的 tokenization。作者在 NiPS$_3$ 与 K$_2$NiF$_4$ 两个 Ni$^{2+}$ 化合物上验证了方法，并用实验数据恢复了联合后验与后验预测分布。
Motivation: RIXS 光谱的参数反演通常依赖点估计，难以刻画参数间相关性，也缺乏系统的不确定性量化；该领域此前没有基于模拟推断的完整后验推断工具。
Method: 提出截断边际神经比估计来高效收缩先验，使用条件流匹配作为联合密度估计器，并采用 tokenization 匹配 RIXS 图物理布局的视觉 Transformer 编码器来提取谱图特征，从而以较小的模拟预算推断完整后验。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 NiPS$_3$ 与 K$_2$NiF$_4$ 上得到覆盖率更好且更尖锐的后验；对实验数据恢复的联合后验揭示了点估计无法看到的参数相关性，后验预测分布与观测谱吻合。
Conclusion: 该方法的摊销后验支持在 RIXS 分析中实现 nuisance 边缘化的不确定性量化、多测量后验融合以及主动实验设计等此前不可用的分析。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Separating Spatial and Clinical Risk with Node-Splitting SVM Survival Trees
papers.abstract_en: Recovering geographic variation in survival requires separating spatial risk from patients' clinical characteristics, a problem complicated by prognostic covariates that are themselves spatially structured. We develop a nonparametric two-stage method for this separation. A clinical survival tree fit to the covariates alone supplies leaf Nelson-Aalen cumulative hazard residuals, transferring the censored survival structure to a clinically adjusted scale without imposing a functional form on the clinical hazard, and a second tree fit to these residuals on the coordinates recovers the spatial structure. Both stages are kernel dipole-splitting survival trees, so the resulting spatial risk map is piecewise constant, with sharp, possibly curved boundaries. We establish when the residuals recover the spatial signal: under a multiplicative frailty and an exogeneity condition, they are free of the clinical covariates given location and stochastically ordered by the frailty. An expansion of the frailty Laplace exponent quantifies their approximate exponentiality and identifies the leading remainder. These results assume consistency of the first stage rather than a model class, so the construction extends to other survival estimators. On the LeukSurv leukemia data the method agrees with a Bayesian Gaussian random field frailty about where risk is elevated while resolving sharp adjacencies the smooth surface averages away, and an unadjusted spatial analysis misattributes clinical variation to location. Simulations with known zones, including a sweep through graded violations of exogeneity, locate the point at which the two contributions cease to be separately identifiable, with the smooth benchmark degrading in parallel as that point is approached.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生存分析中空间风险与临床特征混杂的问题，提出两阶段非参数方法：先用仅含协变量的核偶极分裂 SVM 生存树得到叶节点 Nelson-Aalen 累积风险残差，再对这些残差按坐标拟合第二棵树，从而恢复空间结构，得到分段常数、边界尖锐且可能弯曲的空间风险图。理论部分在乘法脆弱性和外生性条件下证明残差能恢复空间信号，模拟实验扫描外生性违例程度以定位两类贡献不再可分离的临界点。
Motivation: 生存数据的地理变异常与患者的临床特征相互纠缠，且许多预后协变量本身具有空间结构，使研究者难以把空间风险从临床因素中干净地分离出来。
Method: 提出非参数两阶段构造：第一阶段对临床协变量拟合生存树并取叶节点的 Nelson-Aalen 累积风险残差，把删失生存结构转换到临床调整后的尺度；第二阶段对这些残差按坐标拟合第二棵生存树，以恢复空间风险。两阶段均使用核偶极分裂生存树 (kernel dipole-splitting survival trees)，因此风险图为分段常数并支持尖锐弯曲边界。
Result: 在 LeukSurv 白血病数据上，该方法与贝叶斯高斯随机场脆弱模型在风险升高区域上一致，同时保留了被平滑表面平均掉的尖锐邻接结构；未调整的空间分析则会把临床变异错误归因于位置。模拟实验在已知风险区域下扫描外生性违例程度，定位到两类贡献不再可分离的临界点，且平滑基准在该点附近同步退化。
Conclusion: 理论结果仅假设第一阶段估计的一致性而非特定模型类，因此该框架可扩展到其他生存估计器；但空间信号的可识别性依赖乘法脆弱性和外生性条件，条件被违反时空间与临床贡献不再可分离。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Federated Prompt Learning: A Unified Framework, Empirical Analysis, and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have become core components of cloud-based intelligent services in academia and industry, yet their training and deployment are hindered by high computational costs, data centralization, and privacy concerns. Federated learning (FL) offers a decentralized training paradigm that enables clients to collaboratively train a learning model without sharing raw data, making it a promising solution for privacy-preserving LLM training and reasoning. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of federated prompt learning (FPL) to review recent advances in integrating the federated learning paradigm and large language models, answering the following research questions: RQ1: The fundamental motivations, characteristics, and enabling technologies of FPL, and how it differs from conventional FL and full-model federated fine-tuning; RQ2: The trade-offs FPL approaches exhibit in performance, communication efficiency, computational overhead, scalability, personalization, and heterogeneity handling; RQ3: The remaining security, privacy, robustness, and system challenges, along with key future research directions. To this end, we systematically examine existing FPL methods across the full model lifecycle: pre-training, fine-tuning, and practical applications, while discussing security, privacy, and robustness issues and summarizing existing defense mechanisms. Finally, we highlight open challenges and future directions, aiming to help readers understand how the insights drive research in FPL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于联邦提示学习 (federated prompt learning, FPL) 的综合性综述，系统梳理了将联邦学习 (FL) 与大型语言模型 (LLM) 结合的最新进展。文章围绕三个研究问题展开：FPL 的基本动机、特性与使能技术及其与传统 FL 和全模型联邦微调的区别；FPL 方法在性能、通信效率、计算开销、可扩展性、个性化和异构性处理上的权衡；以及剩余的安全、隐私、鲁棒性与系统挑战。作者按预训练、微调和实际应用的完整模型生命周期考察现有 FPL 方法，并总结了防御机制与未来方向。
Motivation: LLM 的训练与部署面临高计算成本、数据集中化和隐私问题，而联邦学习提供了一种无需共享原始数据的去中心化训练范式，是隐私保护式 LLM 训练与推理的有前景方案；该综述旨在填补对 FPL 这一交叉方向缺乏系统性梳理的空白。
Method: 采用综述式研究框架，通过 RQ1-RQ3 三个研究问题组织内容，系统考察 FPL 方法在预训练、微调和实际应用等模型生命周期阶段的表现，并讨论安全、隐私、鲁棒性问题及相关防御机制。
Result: 文章未报告具体的定量实验结果，主要产出是对现有 FPL 方法的系统梳理、性能与资源等多维度权衡的归纳，以及对安全隐私挑战和防御机制的总结。
Conclusion: 作者强调 FPL 仍面临安全、隐私、鲁棒性和系统层面的开放挑战，并指出未来研究方向，旨在帮助读者理解相关洞见如何推动 FPL 研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ASSERT: A Measurement Pipeline for GenAI Audits
papers.abstract_en: Audits of generative AI (GenAI) systems often summarize behavior as a reported rate: how often the audited system complies with policy. Researchers and stakeholders use that rate to compare systems, track regressions, and gate deployment. A reported rate reflects both the system under audit and the measurement choices behind it, so a change in the rate can leave it unclear whether the system or those choices moved. We introduce ASSERT, a specification-driven measurement pipeline for GenAI audits that ties each reported rate to a written specification of the measurement choices used to produce it. ASSERT helps draft a behavioral rubric and test cases, then runs the audit against a GenAI system and returns a reported rate. In a case study on conversational deception, we observe that the reported rate moves substantially with the dialogue setup, the simulated user, the judge, and the evidence bar for non-compliance. These measurement choices substantially change the reported rate and can reorder GenAI system rankings. Because each reported rate is tied to an explicit specification, differences across audits are easier to attribute and interpret.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ASSERT，一个规范驱动的 GenAI 审计测量流水线，将每个报告率与产生该率的测量选择书面规范绑定。流水线辅助起草行为准则和测试用例，运行审计后返回报告率。在对话欺骗案例研究中，报告率随对话设置、模拟用户、评判者和不合规证据标准的不同而大幅变化，并可重排 GenAI 系统排名。
Motivation: GenAI 审计的报告率同时反映被测系统与测量选择，比率变化时难以判断是系统还是测量方式发生了改变，影响系统比较、回归追踪和部署决策。
Method: ASSERT 是规范驱动的测量流水线：它帮助起草行为准则和测试用例，对 GenAI 系统运行审计并返回报告率，同时将每个报告率与一份明文的测量选择规范相关联。
Result: 在对话欺骗案例研究中，改变对话设置、模拟用户、评判者和不合规证据标准会显著改变报告率，并且这些测量选择可能重新排序 GenAI 系统的排名。
Conclusion: 由于每个报告率都绑定到明确的规范，不同审计之间的差异更容易归因和解释。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Anti-Shortcut Distillation via Temporal Negative Knowledge Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) trains a compact student by attracting it towards a converged teacher. It is silent about which directions the teacher itself learned to suppress: repulsive and bias-aware objectives exist, but none exploits the teacher's own trajectory to identify what the student should avoid. We observe that the missing signal is already encoded in the teacher's optimization trajectory: features that an early-stage teacher emphasizes but that a converged teacher attenuates are precisely the shortcut directions worth pushing the student away from. We instantiate this observation as \textbf{A}nti-\textbf{S}hortcut \textbf{D}istillation (ASD), a push--pull KD framework that treats the converged teacher $\Tfinal$ as a positive semantic anchor and an early-checkpoint teacher $\Tearly$ as a temporal negative reference. ASD couples two losses: a temporal contrastive loss ($\Ltc$) that places the early-teacher feature as a same-sample negative against in-batch and memory-bank final-teacher features in an InfoNCE objective; and a shortcut suppression loss ($\Lss$) that penalizes student projection onto the top eigenvectors of $\E[\Dh\Dh^{\top}]$, the uncentered second-moment matrix of early-to-final feature displacements. Across 13 teacher--student pairs on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-100, and TinyImageNet, ASD attains the highest clean top-1 accuracy on more than 10 pairs and outperforms standard KD on 12. On CIFAR-100-C corruption robustness, ASD obtains the lowest mean Corruption Error ($86.1$\,mCE) on the most challenging cross-architecture pair (WRN-40-2$\to$ShuffleNet-V2). Mechanistic diagnostics confirm the intended geometry: the ASD student is systematically anti-aligned with the shortcut direction, while its projection onto the robust subspace is substantially larger ($0.45$ vs.\ $0.12$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出反捷径蒸馏 (Anti-Shortcut Distillation, ASD)，一种利用教师优化轨迹进行知识蒸馏的推拉框架。作者将收敛教师视为正语义锚点、早期检查点教师视为时序负参考，通过时序对比损失和捷径抑制损失让学生主动远离教师已学会抑制的捷径特征。在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-100和TinyImageNet的13个师生对上，ASD在超过10对上达到最高clean top-1准确率，并在12对上优于标准KD。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏只引导学生靠近收敛教师，却未利用教师自身学习过程中抑制了哪些方向；早期教师强调而收敛教师衰减的特征恰好是应该让学生避开的捷径方向，而这一信号已经编码在教师的优化轨迹中。
Method: 提出ASD框架，包含两个损失：时序对比损失将早期教师特征作为同样本负样本，与批内和记忆库中的最终教师特征一起构造InfoNCE目标；捷径抑制损失则惩罚学生特征投影到早期到最终特征位移的非中心二阶矩矩阵主特征向量上。
Result: 在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-100和TinyImageNet的13个师生对中，ASD在超过10对上取得最高clean top-1准确率，并在12对上优于标准KD；在CIFAR-100-C鲁棒性上，跨架构WRN-40-2→ShuffleNet-V2获得最低平均 Corruption Error (86.1 mCE)。机制诊断表明ASD学生系统性反对齐于捷径方向，且在鲁棒子空间上的投影显著更大（0.45 vs 0.12）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调教师优化轨迹中的时序负知识可用于提升学生泛化与鲁棒性，并验证了ASD在特征几何上确实沿预期方向调整学生表征。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SKILLER: Language-Level Reinforcement Learning for Reusable Skill Extraction in Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills represent a standardized format for packaging procedural knowledge and domain expertise, serving within agent harness systems as an essential mechanism to continually constrain a language model's behavior space for repeatable, high-quality task execution. However, because strong closed-source models entail high inference costs, current popular agent harnesses, such as Codex and OpenClaw, remain prohibitively expensive when deploying these skills to accomplish real-world tasks. The rapid capability enhancement of open-source models deployable on consumer-grade GPUs presents a compelling opportunity to drastically reduce these costs by leveraging skill-based behavioral constraints. Nevertheless, automatically generating effective skills tailored specifically for such compact models remains a significant practical challenge. To address this, we propose SKILLER, a natural-language-driven reinforcement learning framework designed to automatically generate executor-specific skills for small models, which employs a strong model as the actor and critic, treats the small-model agent system as the environment, and propagates all reinforcement learning signals entirely via natural language. Extensive experimental evaluations across five relevant benchmarks using Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.5-4B demonstrate that SKILLER outperforms three open-source and one closed-source skill generation or evolution methods, achieving absolute gains ranging from 4.3 to 20.4 percentage points for the 9B model and 1.8 to 13.3 points for the 4B model, while remarkably matching the performance of strong closed-source models on single-skill tasks in SkillsBench. The project is available at https://github.com/DANG-ai/SKILLER.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, and 8 tables. Project and code: https://github.com/DANG-ai/SKILLER
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SKILLER，一个自然语言驱动的强化学习框架，用于为小语言模型自动生成执行器专属技能（executor-specific skills）。该框架以强模型作为 actor 和 critic，将小模型智能体系统视为环境，所有强化学习信号均通过自然语言传播。实验在五个基准上使用 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.5-4B 验证，显示相对三种开源和一种闭源技能生成/进化方法取得绝对增益，并在 SkillsBench 单技能任务上匹配强闭源模型表现。
Motivation: 闭源强模型在技能部署时推理成本高昂，而可在消费级 GPU 上运行的小模型具有成本优势，但自动为这类紧凑模型生成有效技能仍是实际挑战。
Method: SKILLER 采用自然语言驱动的强化学习框架，由强模型扮演 actor 和 critic，小模型智能体系统作为环境，全程通过自然语言传递强化学习信号，从而生成针对特定小模型的技能。
Result: 在五个相关基准上，SKILLER 相比三种开源和一种闭源技能生成或进化方法，为 9B 模型带来 4.3 到 20.4 个百分点的绝对提升，为 4B 模型带来 1.8 到 13.3 个百分点的提升，并在 SkillsBench 的单技能任务上与强闭源模型表现相当。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过自然语言强化学习可以为小型开源模型自动生成可复用的执行器专属技能，显著降低技能部署成本并达到接近闭源模型的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: INSIDE the Student's Mind: Jointly Modeling Latent Reasoning and Action in LLM Student Simulators
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based simulators often reproduce observable actions but fail to capture the underlying reasoning behind them. In education, where student simulation is increasingly used for various applications such as evaluating tutoring systems, this gap is especially pronounced. Two students may submit identical submissions for entirely different reasons. We present INTERNAL STUDENT DIALOGUE (INSIDE), a student modeling framework that fine-tunes LLMs not only to act like students but also to think like them. INSIDE generates internal dialogue grounded in Bloom's Taxonomy across cognitive, affective, and action dimensions, and fine-tunes models on paired think traces and actions. We baseline against different prompting frameworks and evaluate on two axes: fidelity of simulated actions and quality of generated internal dialogue. Our evaluations show that INSIDE improves simulation fidelity in both action fidelity, matching code generation of real students, and reasoning alignment, achieving the highest alignment across models up to 57.9%.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 INSIDE（INTERNAL STUDENT DIALOGUE）学生建模框架，通过微调 LLM 使其不仅模拟学生的可观察行为，还模拟其背后的内部推理。INSIDE 基于 Bloom 分类法在认知、情感和行动三个维度生成内部对话，并用配对的思考轨迹与行动进行微调。实验表明，相比多种提示框架基线，INSIDE 在模拟动作保真度与内部对话质量两个维度上均有提升。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的模拟器往往能重现可观察动作，却难以捕捉动作背后的推理过程；在教育场景中，两个学生可能因完全不同原因提交相同答案，这一差距尤为明显。
Method: 提出 INSIDE 框架，利用 Bloom 分类法在认知、情感和行动维度生成内部对话（internal dialogue），并在成对的思考轨迹（think traces）与行动数据上微调 LLM，使模型既像学生一样行动也像学生一样思考。
Result: 基于不同提示框架的基线进行对比，INSIDE 在动作保真度上更贴近真实学生的代码生成，并在推理对齐方面取得模型间最高对齐度，最高达 57.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同时建模潜在推理与可观察行动能够提升学生模拟的保真度，并从模拟动作保真度和内部对话质量两个维度进行了评估。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 INSIDE 框架，利用 Bloom 分类法在认知、情感和行动维度生成内部对话（internal dialogue），并在成对的思考轨迹（think traces）与行动数据上微调 LLM，使模型既像学生一样行动也像学生一样思考。
summary_sections.result: 基于不同提示框架的基线进行对比，INSIDE 在动作保真度上更贴近真实学生的代码生成，并在推理对齐方面取得模型间最高对齐度，最高达 57.9%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调同时建模潜在推理与可观察行动能够提升学生模拟的保真度，并从模拟动作保真度和内部对话质量两个维度进行了评估。

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling for CAD Generation via Verifier-Free Consensus Selection
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can write parametric CAD programs from a natural-language description (text-to-CAD generation), but a single sample is often wrong. Increasing test-time compute by sampling multiple candidates only helps if a good candidate can be identified, yet no ground-truth model is available at generation time. Existing systems often require a separate verifier, such as a vision-language judge, to select among candidates. We investigate whether the candidate pool itself provides enough signal for effective selection and a verifier-free alternative. We introduce 3D CAD consensus selection, hereafter consensus selection: sample $N$ parametric CAD programs, compile them to 3D models, and return the candidate that agrees most with the rest of the pool. The method is training-free and compatible with existing CAD agents. We investigate geometric and topological notions of agreement, each of which improves its corresponding evaluation metric. On the exact candidate pools of a state-of-the-art CAD generation method, geometric consensus improves all three geometric metrics over the method's verifier, while topological consensus matches it on topology. Across every tested LLM and prompt variant, geometric consensus also improves geometric accuracy over random selection from the same pool, reducing Chamfer distance by $1-10\%$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种免验证器的 3D CAD 生成测试时选择方法：对自然语言描述采样 N 个参数化 CAD 程序，编译为 3D 模型后，返回与候选池中其余候选一致性最高的结果。方法免训练且兼容现有 CAD agent，采用几何与拓扑两种一致性度量；在 SOTA CAD 生成方法的候选池上，几何共识提升全部三项几何指标，拓扑共识在拓扑指标上与该方法验证器持平，相对随机选择将 Chamfer distance 降低 1-10%。
Motivation: 文本到 CAD 生成中单次采样往往出错，增加测试时计算需要通过采样多个候选来提高成功率，但生成时没有 ground-truth 可用于挑选；现有系统常依赖独立的验证器（如视觉语言 judge）来选择候选，本文探索候选池本身是否提供足够的选择信号，从而实现免验证器选择。
Method: 提出 3D CAD 共识选择（consensus selection）：采样 N 个参数化 CAD 程序，编译为 3D 模型后，返回与池中其余候选一致性最高的候选；考察几何与拓扑两种一致性定义，方法无需训练，可直接适配现有 CAD agents。
Result: 在 SOTA CAD 生成方法的精确候选池上，几何共识在全部三项几何指标上超过该方法使用的验证器，拓扑共识在拓扑指标上与验证器持平；在所有测试的 LLM 与提示变体上，几何共识相对同一池的随机选择均提升几何精度，Chamfer distance 降低 1-10%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为候选池本身可以产生有效的选择信号，免验证器的共识选择可作为现有 CAD 生成方法中候选挑选策略的替代或补充。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: BAG: Budget-Aware Gating for Diffusion Caching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion caching is a lightweight strategy that accelerates Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) by reusing intermediate features across denoising steps, but existing paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: online heuristics lack global budget awareness, whereas static schedules lack instance adaptivity and fail to flexibly adapt to varying runtime budget constraints. To bridge this gap, we present BAG (Budget-Aware Gating), a novel caching policy that unifies global budget pacing with dynamic, instance-adaptive feature reuse. Rather than relying on hand-crafted rules, BAG employs a lightweight gating network that dynamically decides whether to execute a full computation or reuse cached features at each step by jointly conditioning on the budget state and local trajectory feedback. We train this policy via offline-to-online schedule distillation, transferring the decision-making of offline-searched schedules into a compact online gate. Extensive experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Wan2.1, and Qwen-Image-2512 demonstrate that BAG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art caching methods across various speedup tiers while remaining robust across different resolutions, seeds, and guidance scales. Code will be released.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 13 figures, and 14 tables. Code Link: see https://github.com/Westlake-AGI-Lab/BAG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BAG（Budget-Aware Gating），一种面向扩散 Transformer 缓存的预算感知门控策略，将全局预算调度与实例自适应的特征复用统一起来。BAG 使用轻量级门控网络在每个去噪步骤根据预算状态和局部轨迹反馈动态决定完整计算或复用缓存特征，并通过离线到在线的调度蒸馏训练该策略。在 FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1 和 Qwen-Image-2512 上的实验表明，BAG 在不同加速档位上一致优于现有缓存方法，并对分辨率、种子和引导尺度保持鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有扩散缓存方法在全局预算意识与实例自适应性之间存在根本权衡：在线启发式缺乏全局预算感知，而静态调度缺乏实例自适应，难以灵活应对变化的运行时预算约束。
Method: 作者提出 BAG 策略，采用轻量级门控网络，联合条件化于预算状态和局部轨迹反馈，在每个去噪步骤动态决策是执行完整计算还是复用缓存特征；训练采用离线到在线调度蒸馏（offline-to-online schedule distillation），将离线搜索出的调度策略迁移为紧凑的在线门控。
Result: 在 FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1 和 Qwen-Image-2512 上的大量实验显示，BAG 在各种加速档位上持续优于最先进的缓存方法，并且在不同分辨率、种子和引导尺度下保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: 作者强调 BAG 是一种不同于手工规则的新型扩散缓存策略，能够统一全局预算控制与实例自适应特征复用，并承诺发布代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MusicLayout: Explicit Structural Planning for Controllable Text-to-Music Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-music generation has advanced rapidly, but current systems still rely primarily on global text prompts, leaving the structural organization of generated music implicit and difficult to inspect, control, or revise before audio generation. To address this issue, we introduce MusicLayout, an explicit intermediate representation for controlling musical structure in text-to-music generation. MusicLayout describes a musical piece as a time-aligned layout of sections, textures, repetitions, variations, and instrument-level arrangements, serving as an interpretable planning layer between textual intent and the generated music. We integrate MusicLayout into a text-to-music framework built on a unified autoregressive formulation, where the model first generates a MusicLayout representation and subsequently predicts audio tokens conditioned on this representation within a single sequence. The resulting MusicLayout can be inspected and modified prior to audio generation, providing a mechanism for layout-level structural control. We evaluate MusicLayout through layout-conditioned generation, layout manipulation experiments, and matched-data ablations, providing evidence that explicit layout planning can improve long-range structural organization and support layout-level control. We have released the implementation as open source on GitHub at https://github.com/XaryLee/MusicLayout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MusicLayout，一种用于可控文本到音乐生成 (text-to-music generation) 的显式中间表示，将音乐作品描述为按时间对齐的乐段、织体、重复、变奏和乐器级编排布局，作为文本意图与生成音频之间的可解释规划层。作者将其整合进基于统一自回归 (autoregressive) 框架的系统中，模型先生成 MusicLayout，再在同一序列中基于该表示预测音频 token。评价实验包括布局条件生成、布局操控实验和匹配数据消融，表明显式布局规划有助于改善长程结构组织并支持布局级控制。
Motivation: 现有文本到音乐生成系统主要依赖全局文本提示，音乐的结构组织是隐式的，难以在音频生成前检查、控制或修改。
Method: 引入 MusicLayout 作为显式中间表示，描述时间对齐的乐段、织体、重复、变奏和乐器级编排；将其嵌入统一自回归框架，模型先生成布局表示，再基于该表示在单一序列中预测音频 token，从而允许在生成前检查和修改布局。
Result: 通过布局条件生成、布局操控实验和匹配数据消融进行评测，结果提供证据表明显式布局规划能改善长程结构组织并支持布局级控制。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 显式布局规划可作为文本到音乐生成中的可检查、可修改的结构控制机制，实现已开源在 GitHub 上；摘要未讨论明确局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Recovery to Drop-off: How Action Post-training Reduces a VLM's Late-Layer Depth Decodability
papers.abstract_en: How much of a vision-language model's (VLM) spatial understanding remains after the action post-training process of building a vision-language-action model (VLA)? We probe depth perception, a primitive of spatiogeometric understanding, from every decoder layer of a weight-matched open-source base VLM/VLA pair: Molmo2-ER and MolmoAct2-LIBERO. First, the VLA decodes depth worse at every layer, a persistent gap we call the floor. Second, the degradation is not uniform: while the base VLM's depth decodability improves through its final layers, the VLA's collapses, an additional late-layer drop we call the cliff. We causally localize the cliff to late-layer MLP interference: ablating the late-layer MLP writes recovers the majority of the terminal decodability cliff, while matched attention ablations and the same intervention in the weight-matched base VLM produce no comparable recovery. A module-level decomposition explains this dissociation: the base VLM carries depth most accessibly in accumulated MLP writes, whereas action post-training collapses depth decodability in the late accumulated writes.
papers.comment: Accepted to the archival proceedings track of the Embodied Multimodal Reasoning (EMR) Workshop at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以深度感知为探针，系统比较权重匹配的开源基础 VLM（Molmo2-ER）与 VLA（MolmoAct2-LIBERO）在每个解码器层的空间理解可解码性。作者发现 VLA 在所有层上的深度解码都更差（称为 floor），且其后期层出现额外的可解码性崩溃（称为 cliff）。通过消融实验，他们将 cliff 因果定位到后期层 MLP 写入的干扰，并给出模块级分解解释。
Motivation: 构建视觉语言动作模型（VLA）的动作后训练可能损害 VLM 已有的空间理解能力，但这类损伤具体发生在哪些层、来自哪种模块此前缺乏系统探查。
Method: 使用权重匹配的开源 VLM/VLA 对 Molmo2-ER 和 MolmoAct2-LIBERO，从每个解码器层探测深度感知；通过消融后期层 MLP 写入（MLP writes）和注意力写入来定位损伤来源，并做模块级分解比较累积写入中的深度信息。
Result: VLA 在每一层的深度解码都比基础 VLM 差（floor）；基础 VLM 的深度可解码性在最后几层持续改善，而 VLA 则崩溃（cliff）。消融后期层 MLP 写入可恢复终端可解码性 cliff 的大部分，而匹配的注意力消融及在基础 VLM 上的相同干预均无类似恢复。模块级分解表明，基础 VLM 的深度信息最易在累积 MLP 写入中被读取，而动作后训练破坏了后期累积 MLP 写入中的深度可解码性。
Conclusion: 动作后训练会系统性降低 VLA 的深度可解码性，并在后期层造成额外崩溃；该崩溃主要归因于晚期层 MLP 干扰。摘要未涉及其他任务或更广泛泛化能力的讨论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) makes Multimodal Large Language Models more accurate, but the gains are brittle: simply paraphrasing a question or changing the prompt template can degrade them, which challenges reliable deployment in high-stakes scenarios like medical VQA. We trace this to two issues of the standard RL objective. First, the binary verifier conflates format with content, so the reward signal cannot tell a wrong answer apart from a misformatted one. Second, the training distribution covers only a thin slice of the real-world prompts that the model might meet at deployment, so policies that perform well on the training distribution can behave differently under unseen prompts during test. Both failures call for a robust post-training method that helps the policy cover a broader distribution of semantically equivalent prompts, and we identify two measures that help achieve this objective: separating format from semantics in the reward, and applying policy invariance across perturbed prompts with equivalent semantics. We therefore propose Prompt-Invariant RLVR (PIRL), consisting of a dynamic trinary reward and a consistency regularizer based on an embedding-space adversary. Under stress testing, PIRL's average accuracy on benchmarks drops by only $\le 1\%$, where GRPO drops ~3%. On dynamic evaluation, PIRL also achieves the smallest performance drop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）虽然能提升多模态大语言模型的准确率，但这种提升在问题改写或提示模板变化时会显著退化，从而威胁医疗视觉问答等高危场景的可靠部署。作者将原因归结为二元验证器混淆格式与内容、以及训练分布只覆盖真实世界提示的极窄切片，并提出 Prompt-Invariant RLVR (PIRL)，包含动态三元奖励和基于嵌入空间对抗的一致性正则化。压力测试中 PIRL 在基准上的平均准确率下降不超过 1%，而 GRPO 下降约 3%。
Motivation: RLVR 使多模态大语言模型更准确，但泛化鲁棒性差：简单改写问题或改变提示模板就会导致性能下降，这阻碍了类似医疗 VQA 的高风险部署场景。
Method: 提出 PIRL，由两部分组成：将格式与语义分离的动态三元奖励（dynamic trinary reward），以及在语义等价但受扰动的提示上施加策略不变性的、基于嵌入空间对抗的一致性正则化（consistency regularizer）。
Result: 在压力测试（stress testing）下，PIRL 在基准上的平均准确率下降不超过 1%，而 GRPO 下降约 3%；在动态评估中 PIRL 也实现了最小的性能下降。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将奖励中的格式与语义分离，并对语义等价的扰动提示施加策略不变性，可以有效提升 RLVR 后训练对未见提示的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Enhancing Scientific Named Entity Recognition via Large Language Models: A Type-driven Multi-task Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Scientific named entity recognition (SciNER) plays a crucial role in information extraction and knowledge discovery from scientific texts. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the capacity to achieve competitive SciNER performance with minimal human effort. Existing research highlights the importance of incorporating candidate entity type information for accurate entity recognition and classification by LLMs. However, when too many candidate entity types are provided in the prompt, LLMs struggle to accurately recognize and label entities in scientific texts, where entity types are more complex than in general domains. To address this challenge, we propose TdSciNER, a type-driven approach that effectively leverages entity type information to enhance SciNER performance. In TdSciNER, we first design an entity type filter model to identify the most likely entity types present in a given sentence. Subsequently, we introduce an auxiliary multi-class entity typing task within a multi-task learning framework alongside SciNER to obtain richer contextual representations. Then, we develop a novel demonstration selection strategy based on sentence similarity and entity type diversity to activate the in-context learning capabilities of LLMs, thereby improving entity recognition accuracy across diverse scientific domains. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves performance comparable to fully supervised models. Further analysis validates that each entity type-driven component in TdSciNER contributes to the improvement of SciNER performance. This work provides valuable insights for future advancements in SciNER and broader information extraction tasks in scientific text mining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TdSciNER，一种类型驱动的科学命名实体识别方法，通过实体类型过滤模型、多任务学习中的辅助实体分类任务以及基于句子相似度和实体类型多样性的演示选择策略，提升 LLM 在科学文本上的实体识别与分类能力。在三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法能达到与全监督模型相当的性能，且各类型驱动的组件均有贡献。
Motivation: 科学文本中的实体类型比通用领域更复杂，当提示中提供过多候选实体类型时，LLM 难以准确识别和标注实体。现有研究虽强调候选实体类型信息的重要性，但缺乏有效利用该信息以增强 SciNER 的方法。
Method: TdSciNER 先设计实体类型过滤模型，识别给定句子中最可能出现的实体类型；随后在 SciNER 之外引入一个辅助多类实体分类任务，通过多任务学习框架获得更丰富的上下文表示；最后提出结合句子相似度和实体类型多样性的演示选择策略，以激活 LLM 的上下文学习能力。
Result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法取得了与全监督模型相当的性能；进一步分析验证了每个实体类型驱动的组件都提升了 SciNER 的效果。
Conclusion: 本文工作为未来 SciNER 以及科学文本挖掘中更广泛的信息抽取任务提供了有价值的见解。
