papers.title: DialectS2S: End-to-End Speech Dialogue Modeling for Low-Resource Chinese Dialects
papers.abstract_en: Current end-to-end speech dialogue models are primarily optimized for mainstream languages and remain limited in low-resource dialect scenarios due to the scarcity of dialect speech data. Moreover, during dialect adaptation, the semantic representation space of speech dialogue models continuously evolves, while conventional speech supervision remains unchanged, leading to semantic inconsistency between hidden representations and speech targets and degrading speech stability and naturalness. To address these issues, we propose DialectS2S, an end-to-end speech dialogue model for Chinese dialects. We first develop a scalable dialect speech dialogue synthesis pipeline for efficient data construction. We further introduce a two-stage post-training strategy with self-aligned speech supervision, which aligns the semantic content of speech supervision with the evolved semantic representations of the model to improve dialect speech generation quality. Experimental results show that DialectS2S consistently outperforms existing baselines across multiple Chinese dialects in speech dialogue, achieving substantial improvements in dialect consistency, response quality, and speech intelligibility. Our work provides an efficient and scalable solution for end-to-end speech dialogue modeling in low-resource dialect scenarios. To facilitate future research and practical applications, we fully open-source the DialectS2S framework, including model checkpoints, training datasets, and fine-tuning code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DialectS2S，一个面向低资源中文方言的端到端语音对话模型。为解决方言数据稀缺和方言适应中语义表示漂移导致的语音监督不一致问题，作者构建了可扩展的方言语音对话合成管道，并引入两阶段后训练策略与自对齐语音监督。实验表明该方法在多种中文方言上优于现有基线，并在方言一致性、响应质量和语音可懂度上取得显著改进。
Motivation: 现有端到端语音对话模型主要针对主流语言优化，低资源方言场景因方言语音数据稀缺而受限；此外，方言适应过程中模型的语义表示空间不断演化，而传统语音监督保持不变，导致隐藏表示与语音目标语义不一致，损害语音的稳定性和自然度。
Method: 提出可扩展的方言语音对话合成管道用于高效数据构建，并设计两阶段后训练策略，采用自对齐语音监督（self-aligned speech supervision），将语音监督的语义内容与演化后的模型语义表示对齐，从而提升方言语音生成质量。
Result: 实验结果显示，DialectS2S 在多种中文方言的语音对话任务上持续优于现有基线，在方言一致性、响应质量和语音可懂度方面均获得显著改进。
Conclusion: 该工作为低资源方言场景下的端到端语音对话建模提供了高效、可扩展的解决方案，并完整开源了框架，包括模型检查点、训练数据集和微调代码。

papers.title: TradeVerse: A Longitudinal Benchmark of Political Negotiation in International Trade
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly being applied to tasks involving institutional and political texts, but existing benchmarks evaluate them on isolated documents or single tasks. In realpolitik, negotiations are longitudinal data, where participating parties can align or argue over multiple iterations and each turn is an outcome of the previous turns, hence, understanding one turn requires tracking everything before it. We introduce TradeVerse, a benchmark built from the World Trade Organisation (WTO) specific trade concerns, where member states challenge one another and exchange arguments over multiple rounds, sometimes for years. We, in TradeVerse, reconstruct minutes of $1170$ meetings, spanning across 5 groups and $89$ product groups and define three tasks: first, the system has to analyze the longitudinal meeting records and predict the harmonized system codes (HS chapters) of the products under discussion in the particular meeting, second, we examine whether the system, upon analyzing the anonymized content of the meeting, can guess the name of the responding country and third, we ask the system to play the role of the responding country and provide the statement for the very last round. All labels are recovered directly from the proceedings, requiring no manual annotation. Our experiments highlight the challenges these tasks pose for current LLMs. To the best of our knowledge, TradeVerseis the first benchmark to investigate potential of LLMs in understanding longitudinal political trade negotiations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TradeVerse，一个基于 WTO 具体贸易关切（specific trade concerns）会议记录构建的国际政治贸易谈判纵向基准。摘要称其重建了 1170 场会议记录，涵盖 5 组和 89 个产品组，并定义了三个任务：预测会议中讨论产品的 HS 章节（HS chapters）、根据匿名会议内容猜测回应国、以及扮演回应国生成最后一轮声明；所有标签直接从会议记录中恢复，无需人工标注。实验表明这些任务对当前 LLM 具有挑战性，并称这是首个考察 LLM 理解纵向政治贸易谈判潜力的基准。
Motivation: 现有基准用孤立文档或单一任务评估 LLM 对制度性和政治性文本的理解，但现实谈判是纵向数据，每一轮都依赖之前所有轮次，理解某一轮需要追踪此前全部内容。作者希望填补这一评估缺口，检验 LLM 在多轮政治贸易谈判上的能力。
Method: 从 WTO 具体贸易关切记录中重建 1170 场会议纪要，按 5 组和 89 个产品组组织；设计三个任务，分别是预测 HS 章节、从匿名化会议内容猜测回应国、以及模拟回应国撰写最后一轮声明。所有标签直接从会议记录中获取，不需要人工标注。
Result: 摘要报告实验显示，当前 LLM 在 TradeVerse 的三个任务上表现困难，说明理解纵向谈判记录对现有人工智能模型仍具挑战。摘要未给出具体的量化性能数字。
Conclusion: 作者强调 TradeVerse 是第一个用于评估 LLM 理解纵向政治贸易谈判能力的基准，可用于推动模型在多轮谈判语境上的研究。摘要没有提及实验局限或后续方向。

papers.title: Learning visual representations for compositional analysis of artworks and photographs
papers.abstract_en: Composition, the deliberate arrangement of visual elements, is central to how meaning, emotion, and aesthetic quality are conveyed in artwork, yet it remains among the least formalized dimensions of visual understanding. Prior work highlights a persistent gap in learning meaningful compositional representations, attributing it to semantic bias and suggesting that human-inspired approaches may be key. We compare two parallel paradigms for composition analysis: a human-inspired method grounded in perceptual grouping, and fine-tuned foundation models enabled by recent large-scale compositional datasets. The human-inspired approach uses object-centric models for region-level decomposition and a graph attention network to capture spatial relationships between elements. Both paradigms are evaluated on composition score/category prediction, compositional image retrieval, and visual saliency detection. With frozen encoders, the human-inspired method achieves competitive performance while remaining interpretable. When sufficient data enables fine-tuning, large self-supervised models outperform significantly, but at the cost of interpretability and cross-domain generalization. Code and pre-trained models are available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了两种构图 (composition) 分析范式：基于知觉分组的人类启发式方法，以及基于大规模构图数据集微调的 foundation models。人类启发式方法用 object-centric 模型做区域分解，并用图注意力网络捕获元素间的空间关系；两种范式在构图分数/类别预测、构图图像检索和视觉显著性检测上评估。结果表明在冻结编码器时人类启发式方法性能有竞争力且可解释，而在数据充足时微调的大规模自监督模型显著更优，但牺牲可解释性和跨域泛化能力。
Motivation: 构图是艺术作品中传达意义、情感和美学质量的核心，但仍是视觉理解中形式化程度最低的维度之一。先前工作表明学习有意义的构图表征存在持续差距，并将其归因于语义偏置，认为人类启发式方法可能是关键。
Method: 提出并对比两条并行路径：一条是人类启发式方法，基于知觉分组原理，使用 object-centric 模型进行区域级分解，并用图注意力网络建模元素间的空间关系；另一条是借助近期大规模构图数据集微调的 foundation models。两者在冻结与微调两种设置下评估。
Result: 在冻结编码器设置下，人类启发式方法取得有竞争力的性能并保持可解释性；当数据充足可微调时，大规模自监督模型性能显著更优，但代价是可解释性和跨域泛化能力下降。
Conclusion: 作者强调构图分析中存在性能与可解释性/泛化之间的权衡，人类启发式方法在资源受限或需要可解释性的场景下仍有价值。代码与预训练模型已公开在 GitHub 上。

summary_sections.result: 在冻结编码器设置下，人类启发式方法取得有竞争力的性能并保持可解释性；当数据充足可微调时，大规模自监督模型性能显著更优，但代价是可解释性和跨域泛化能力下降。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调构图分析中存在性能与可解释性/泛化之间的权衡，人类启发式方法在资源受限或需要可解释性的场景下仍有价值。代码与预训练模型已公开在 GitHub 上。

papers.title: Distribution-Free Conformal Prediction for Steel Fatigue Strength: Marginal Validity Is Not Enough
papers.abstract_en: Predicting fatigue failure in steel components experimentally is costly, requiring testing across multiple compositions and processing conditions, spurring research on data-driven prediction models. Studies using the NIMS MatNavi steel fatigue dataset often report high point-prediction accuracy but rely on aggregate error metrics, leaving uncertainty about the reliability of individual predictions and whether accuracy is consistent across the fatigue-strength spectrum. This paper is the first to apply conformal prediction to steel fatigue strength, comparing seven interval-construction methods across 50 independent data splits and distinguishing marginal coverage from coverage within specific sub-regions of the predicted property. A gradient-boosting point model achieves an R^2 of 0.976 +/- 0.009 and a mean absolute error of 18.3 +/- 2.3 MPa. Split-conformal prediction provides valid marginal coverage (0.918) but drops to 0.758 in the highest-strength quartile, where design margins are most critical, a pattern also observed with a Gaussian process baseline. Two locally-adaptive methods correct this: a cross-fitted normalised conformal method holds 0.872-0.940 across quartiles at no cost in average width, and Mondrian group-conditional conformal prediction holds the tightest band of any method (0.917-0.939) at a 12% width premium, part of which traces to the more conservative finite-sample quantile level implied by per-group calibration at this sample size. Conformalized quantile regression, by contrast, restores marginal validity but inflates intervals in every quartile without closing the conditional gap. Marginal coverage claims for ML-based fatigue-strength predictions can conceal systematic unreliability precisely where engineering decisions are most risky; therefore, conditional coverage should be routinely assessed alongside marginal coverage.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. v2: adds Mondrian group-conditional conformal prediction and conformalized quantile regression (seven methods total); quartile cut points are now derived from training-set out-of-fold predictions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将保形预测 (conformal prediction) 应用于钢疲劳强度预测，在 NIMS MatNavi 数据集上比较七种区间构造方法，并基于 50 次独立数据划分区分边际覆盖与条件覆盖。摘要报告梯度提升点模型达到 R^2 0.976 ± 0.009、MAE 18.3 ± 2.3 MPa；分裂保形预测的边际覆盖有效 (0.918)，但在强度最高的四分位区间降至 0.758。作者指出，基于 ML 的疲劳强度预测中，边际覆盖声明可能掩盖工程设计最危险区域的系统性不可靠性。
Motivation: 钢构件疲劳失效的实验预测成本高，数据驱动模型虽常有高精度点预测，但依赖聚合误差指标，无法反映单个预测的可靠性以及误差在疲劳强度谱上是否一致；本文认为应同时评估条件覆盖与边际覆盖。
Method: 比较七种区间构造方法，包括分裂保形预测、交叉拟合归一化保形方法、Mondrian 组条件保形预测、保形分位回归，并以高斯过程为基线；四分位切点由训练集外预测 (out-of-fold predictions) 推导，在 50 次独立数据划分上区分边际覆盖与子区域覆盖。
Result: 梯度提升点模型 R^2 为 0.976 ± 0.009，MAE 为 18.3 ± 2.3 MPa。分裂保形预测边际覆盖为 0.918，但在最高强度四分位降至 0.758；交叉拟合归一化保形方法在各四分位保持 0.872-0.940 且不增加平均区间宽度；Mondrian 组条件保形预测宽度最紧 (0.917-0.939)，但增加 12% 宽度代价；保形分位回归恢复边际覆盖却使各四分位区间膨胀且未消除条件覆盖差距。
Conclusion: 边际覆盖声明可能掩盖工程决策最危险区域的系统性不可靠性，因此条件覆盖应作为边际覆盖的常规补充评估。

papers.title: LUNAR: Benchmarking Personalized Large Language Models on UNiversal User BehAvioR Logs
papers.abstract_en: Existing personalized LLM benchmarks primarily rely on textual personas or isolated behavioral signals, providing limited evaluation of cross-domain behavioral personalization, where responses must be grounded in heterogeneous daily-life activities. To address this gap, we introduce LUNAR, the first benchmark for evaluating how LLMs personalize responses from longitudinal app interaction histories across universal daily-life domains, including clothing, food, housing, and mobility. To support scalable benchmark construction while mitigating data sparsity and privacy concerns, LUNAR uses a multi-stage coarse-to-fine synthesis pipeline grounded in real-world behavioral patterns. Fidelity analyses show closer alignment with real behavioral distributions than other synthetic benchmarks. Experiments on 19 mainstream LLMs show that access to behavioral logs is necessary but not sufficient for deep personalization: neither more context nor larger models guarantees better performance; effective personalization depends on selecting and integrating relevant evidence across domains. Direct retrieval of fine-grained behavioral records consistently outperforms compressed memory, while stronger personalization can come at the cost of privacy protection. These findings identify evidence selection, cross-domain integration, and privacy control as key challenges for personalized LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LUNAR，据称是首个基于跨领域日常行为日志（clothing、food、housing、mobility）评估大语言模型个性化能力的基准。为缓解数据稀疏与隐私问题，LUNAR 采用多阶段粗到细的合成流程，并声称其保真度比现有合成基准更接近真实行为分布。在 19 个主流 LLM 上的实验表明，行为日志可访问是深度个性化的必要条件但非充分条件。
Motivation: 现有个性化 LLM 基准主要依赖文本化人设或孤立行为信号，难以评估需要基于异构日常活动进行跨领域行为个性化的场景，因此缺少一个覆盖通用生活领域的纵向行为日志基准。
Method: 构建 LUNAR 基准，使用多阶段 coarse-to-fine 的合成流程，基于真实行为模式合成跨领域的纵向 app 交互历史，以支持可扩展的基准构建并缓解数据稀疏和隐私问题。
Result: 在 19 个主流 LLM 上的实验显示，更多上下文或更大模型并不必然带来更好性能；直接检索细粒度行为记录一致优于压缩记忆，而更强的个性化可能以隐私保护为代价。
Conclusion: 作者指出证据选择（evidence selection）、跨领域整合（cross-domain integration）和隐私控制是当前个性化 LLM 面临的关键挑战。

papers.title: YOLOv14: Adaptive Real-Time Object Detection for Diverse Imaging Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Real-time object detectors achieve remarkable accuracy under controlled conditions, yet degrade sharply on non-ideal inputs-fisheye distortion, game-rendered content, aerial views, and 360°panoramas. We present YOLOv14, a unified adaptive detection framework that addresses these variations through four complementary mechanisms, formalized under a novel Adaptive Routing and Modulation (ARM) paradigm. Unlike conventional unsupervised domain adaptation, our approach employs Target-Prior Guided Source-Domain Augmentation(TP-SDA), using only 50 unlabeled target images offline to estimate style statistics, while adversarial alignment serves as a lightweight regularizer rather than the primary adaptation driver. Together, these components enable YOLOv14 to achieve 49.1 mAP on COCO val2017 at 2.91 ms (T4 GPU), with substantial gains of +4.1 (fisheye), +6.6 (panorama), +6.4 (drone), and +26.1 (gamestylized) mAP over YOLOv12s. Crucially, we validate generalization on real-world game screenshots (GTA-V, Unity), achieving +14.2 mAP, confirming practical transferability beyond synthetic benchmarks. Code and models are released at https://github.com/zhangcbb/yolov14.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 YOLOv14，一个统一的自适应实时目标检测框架，针对鱼眼畸变、游戏渲染内容、航拍视角和 360° 全景等非理想输入条件。方法基于 Adaptive Routing and Modulation (ARM) 范式，结合 Target-Prior Guided Source-Domain Augmentation (TP-SDA)，仅用 50 张无标注目标图像离线估计风格统计，并将对抗对齐作为轻量正则化器而非主要适应手段。在 COCO val2017 上达到 49.1 mAP、2.91 ms (T4 GPU)，并在鱼眼、全景、无人机、游戏风格化等场景上相对 YOLOv12s 有显著 mAP 提升。
Motivation: 现有实时目标检测器在受控条件下精度可观，但在非理想输入上性能急剧下降，例如鱼眼畸变、游戏渲染内容、航拍视角和全景图像，现有方法缺乏统一的适配框架。
Method: 提出 YOLOv14 检测框架，形式化为 Adaptive Routing and Modulation (ARM) 范式，由四种互补机制组成；其中 TP-SDA 使用 50 张未标注目标图像离线估计风格统计，对抗对齐仅作为轻量正则化器使用。
Result: YOLOv14 在 COCO val2017 上取得 49.1 mAP 和 2.91 ms 延迟 (T4 GPU)；相比 YOLOv12s 在鱼眼 (+4.1)、全景 (+6.6)、无人机 (+6.4) 和游戏风格化 (+26.1) mAP 上有显著提升；并通过对真实游戏截图 (GTA-V, Unity) 验证了泛化性，取得 +14.2 mAP。
Conclusion: 作者强调其方法在真实世界游戏截图上的有效性，证实了超出合成基准的实际可迁移性，并已发布代码和模型。

papers.title: From Non-Convex Self-Concordant Regularization to Scalable Quasi-Newton Training of PINNs
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often require high-accuracy quasi-Newton refinement to obtain reliable partial differential equation solutions, but their residual objectives can exhibit indefinite, nearly singular, and poorly scaled local curvature. Regularized quasi-Newton methods provide established mechanisms for stabilizing secant models, while self-concordant methods provide local-metric rules for curvature-dependent step selection. Building on these two lines of work, we propose SCORE, a self-concordance-inspired quasi-Newton method with decrement-coupled shifted secant geometry for PINN training. Its distinguishing mechanism is that a single quasi-Newton decrement computed from the learned inverse metric jointly determines a strong-Wolfe-tested candidate step and an adaptive shift used to define the next secant geometry. The shifted displacement represents the action of an averaged shifted metric along the accepted step, while requiring neither Hessian construction nor Hessian-vector products. Under a local spectral-equivalence condition, we show that the quasi-Newton decrement and candidate step remain comparable to their counterparts in a positive shifted metric, and recover the normalized self-concordant rule in the matched-metric case. Strong Wolfe acceptance, fallback line search, and standard curvature safeguards provide globalization without modifying the underlying PINN objective. Experiments on the viscous Burgers, Kuramoto--Sivashinsky, Korteweg--de Vries, and complex Ginzburg--Landau equations show that SCORE attains lower final errors than the tested BFGS and self-scaled Broyden baselines. The Burgers ablation further indicates that shifted curvature stabilization and decrement-based step selection make complementary contributions to high-accuracy refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 PINN（物理信息神经网络）训练中残差目标函数局部曲率不定、近奇异且尺度不良的问题，提出自协调启发（self-concordance-inspired）的拟牛顿方法 SCORE。其核心机制是用从学习到的逆度量计算的单一拟牛顿衰减量（decrement）同时决定满足强 Wolfe 条件的候选步长，以及用于构造下一步割线几何的自适应位移（shift）。在黏性 Burgers、Kuramoto–Sivashinsky、Korteweg–de Vries 和复 Ginzburg–Landau 方程上，SCORE 达到比测试的 BFGS 与自缩放 Broyden 基线更低的最终误差。
Motivation: PINN 的残差目标在局部可能呈现不定、近奇异且尺度不良的曲率，导致需要高精度拟牛顿精修才能获得可靠的偏微分方程解；现有正则化拟牛顿与自协调方法分别处理割线模型稳定性和基于曲率的步长选择，但缺乏两者联合的机制。
Method: 提出 SCORE：由学习到的逆度量计算一个拟牛顿衰减量，该衰减量同时确定强 Wolfe 检验的候选步长和定义下一步割线几何的自适应位移；位移表示沿接受步长的平均位移度量作用，既不需要构造 Hessian 也不需要 Hessian-向量乘积。强 Wolfe 接受准则、回退线搜索与标准曲率保护提供全局化，且不修改底层 PINN 目标函数。
Result: 在局部谱等价条件下，作者证明拟牛顿衰减量与候选步长与正位移度量中的对应量可比，并在匹配度量情形恢复归一化自协调规则。实验显示在黏性 Burgers、Kuramoto–Sivashinsky、Korteweg–de Vries 和复 Ginzburg–Landau 方程上，SCORE 最终误差低于 BFGS 和自缩放 Broyden 基线；Burgers 消融表明位移曲率稳定化与基于衰减量的步长选择对高精度精修有互补贡献。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将自协调启发思想与位移割线几何结合，可以在不改变 PINN 损失函数的前提下实现稳定且高精度的拟牛顿精修。该方法的结果限于摘要中测试的几类方程与拟牛顿基线，并未声称泛化到其他优化器或更大规模问题。
Relevance: 15

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调将自协调启发思想与位移割线几何结合，可以在不改变 PINN 损失函数的前提下实现稳定且高精度的拟牛顿精修。该方法的结果限于摘要中测试的几类方程与拟牛顿基线，并未声称泛化到其他优化器或更大规模问题。

papers.title: Latent Reward Registers for Diffusion Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Aligning diffusion models with human preferences usually relies on a sparse terminal reward evaluated on the final generated samples, which creates a severe temporal credit-assignment problem across the denoising process. We propose Latent Reward Registers, a mechanism that estimates terminal preference directly from intermediate noisy latents. Learnable, position-free register tokens are appended as an auxiliary read path to a frozen Diffusion Transformer (DiT), extracting preference signals without altering the generator's hidden states or velocity field. The resulting dense, differentiable reward field spans the full denoising trajectory and supports two alignment strategies. For training, Reward-Gradient On-Policy Distillation (RG-OPD) converts this dense reward field into per-step targets at states visited by the current generator, replacing rollout-intensive policy gradients with direct on-policy distillation. For inference, Reward-Guided Sampling (RGS) steers trajectories with magnitude-matched reward-gradient corrections and no parameter updates. Empirically, at high noise levels (t=0.8) the registers reach the highest pairwise accuracy among the evaluated latent reward models. RG-OPD outperforms online reinforcement learning baselines while reducing GPU hours by up to 33x. RGS achieves significant reward improvement with a favorable reward-quality balance against training-free baselines. Code and weights are to be available at https://github.com/Guanys-dar/latent-reward-register
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Reward Registers，用于扩散模型偏好对齐中的稠密奖励估计。在冻结的 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 上附加可学习、位置无关的寄存器 token，直接从中间含噪隐变量估计终端偏好，不改变生成器的隐状态或速度场。基于该机制提出两种对齐策略：用于训练的 Reward-Gradient On-Policy Distillation (RG-OPD) 和用于推理的 Reward-Guided Sampling (RGS)，并在高噪声水平下报告了优势。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型与人类偏好对齐通常依赖最终生成样本上的稀疏终端奖励，导致去噪过程中存在严重的时序信用分配 (temporal credit assignment) 问题。
Method: 提出 Latent Reward Registers：可学习、位置无关的寄存器 token 作为辅助读取路径附加到冻结的 DiT，直接从中间噪声隐变量估计偏好，从而得到覆盖完整去噪轨迹的稠密可微奖励场。训练策略 RG-OPD 将该奖励场转换为当前生成器访问状态上的逐步目标，取代依赖 rollout 的策略梯度；推理策略 RGS 使用幅度匹配的奖励梯度修正引导采样，无需参数更新。
Result: 摘要报告在高噪声水平 (t=0.8) 下，寄存器在所评估的潜在奖励模型中达到最高 pairwise accuracy；RG-OPD 优于在线强化学习基线，同时将 GPU 训练时间最多减少 33 倍；RGS 相对无训练基线实现显著奖励提升，并取得较好的奖励-质量平衡。
Conclusion: 摘要认为直接从中间含噪隐变量估计终端偏好可以缓解扩散过程中的稀疏奖励问题，且两种对齐策略分别在训练效率和推理引导上有效；代码和权重将公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PhyAI: Real-Time Physical AI at the Edge, Scalable Rollouts in the Cloud
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI policies require inference throughout their lifecycle, including model evaluation, cloud reinforcement learning rollout, edge GPU serving, and onboard deployment. Although these settings share the same checkpoint and action semantics, they often rely on separate inference programs. To unify them, we build PhyAI, a Physical AI inference engine with a single runtime that keeps architecture-specific conditioning, solver, cache, and output logic in model adapters while sharing graph execution, kernels, memory management, and parallel services. The same codebase runs vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs) on single or multiple GPUs across onboard, edge, and cloud deployments. We used the adapter interface to add MiniCPM-Robot on the day of its release. PhyAI achieves 1.40x-4.65x speedups over the official implementations of pi0, pi0.5, GR00T N1.7, and MiniCPM-Robot. On Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID it reduces latency from 2.46 to 1.18 s on eight H20 GPUs (CFG=2, TP=4), a 2.08x speedup. Specialized runtimes remain faster in several configurations, so our goal is one runtime with competitive latency rather than the fastest result in every case. Detailed profiles reveal why different models need different execution policies: on a Hopper-series GPU at batch size one, the pi0.5 action expert accounts for 8.8% of FLOPs but 57.2% of latency; at batch size 32 its share drops to 13.5% and throughput reaches about 100 samples/s. Cosmos3 remains generation-dominated and gains only 14.3% throughput as batch size increases from 1 to 16. We further introduce the control-time Roofline, which distinguishes inference-bound from environment-bound control; the measured pi0.5 points on four LIBERO suites are environment-bound while Cosmos3 stays inference-bound. Code and benchmarks: https://github.com/mingti-org/phyai.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhyAI 是一个面向物理 AI 的统一推理引擎，用单一运行时覆盖板载、边缘和云端的多阶段推理场景，通过模型适配器 (model adapter) 隔离架构相关的条件、求解器、缓存与输出逻辑，共享图执行、内核、内存管理和并行服务。摘要报告其在 pi0、pi0.5、GR00T N1.7、MiniCPM-Robot 上相较官方实现取得 1.40x-4.65x 加速，并在 Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID 八卡 H20 上将延迟从 2.46s 降至 1.18s；同时指出专用运行时在若干配置下仍更快，作者目标是一个延迟有竞争力的统一运行时而非每项配置都最快。文中还提出控制时间 Roofline 模型区分推理受限与环境受限控制，并给出模型在 LIBERO 与 Cosmos3 上的实测行为。
Motivation: 物理 AI 策略在生命周期中需要多种推理设置（模型评估、云强化学习 rollout、边缘 GPU 服务、板载部署），它们共享检查点与动作语义，却常依赖相互独立的推理程序，导致工程重复与部署割裂。
Method: 构建 PhyAI 推理引擎，采用单一运行时架构：共享图执行、内核、内存管理与并行服务，把架构相关的条件、求解器、缓存和输出逻辑放进模型适配器；同一代码库支持 VLA 模型与世界动作模型 (WAM) 在单/多 GPU 上的板载、边缘和云端部署。
Result: 在 pi0、pi0.5、GR00T N1.7、MiniCPM-Robot 上取得 1.40x-4.65x 加速；Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID 在八张 H20 上（CFG=2, TP=4）延迟从 2.46s 降到 1.18s，加速 2.08x。详细剖析显示不同模型需要不同执行策略：Hopper GPU 批大小 1 时 pi0.5 动作专家占 8.8% FLOPs 却占 57.2% 延迟，批大小 32 时降至 13.5%，吞吐约 100 samples/s；Cosmos3 以生成为主，批大小从 1 增至 16 仅提升 14.3% 吞吐。四个 LIBERO 套件上 pi0.5 实测为环境受限，Cosmos3 仍为推理受限。
Conclusion: 论文目标是提供一个延迟有竞争力的统一运行时而非在每种配置下都取得最快结果；其控制时间 Roofline 可用于区分推理受限与环境受限的物理 AI 控制场景，适配器接口便于快速接入新模型（如发布当天加入 MiniCPM-Robot）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hi-Token: Hierarchical Coordinate Tokenization for Generative Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Generative Vision-Language Models (VLMs) commonly treat bounding-box coordinates as independent output symbols, leaving numerical order and axis semantics implicit. We identify this representation as an important source of error in visual grounding. Hi-Token encodes each coordinate with axis-specific tokens for the hundreds, tens, and ones digits, which adds coarse-to-fine structure and increases token reuse while retaining the existing VLM architecture. Hi-GAR complements this representation with a geometry-based reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using box overlap and coordinate accuracy at multiple scales. Controlled comparisons under matched training conditions show that Hi-Token improves localization throughout the evaluated IoU range. Hi-GAR further reduces low-overlap predictions and is used only during training. Experiments on three VLM backbones and the RefCOCO family show consistent gains across models and benchmarks. Hi-R1 achieves higher values than strong specialist baselines on most reported metrics. Analyses of token frequency, digit boundaries, object scale, and IoU distributions explain the effects of coordinate representation and reward training. The results show that structured coordinate generation provides an effective approach to generative visual grounding. Project page: https://xyzzzh.github.io/Hi-Token/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hi-Token，一种面向生成式视觉定位 (generative visual grounding) 的层次化坐标分词方法。Hi-Token 将每个边界框坐标按百位、十位、个位使用轴专属 token 编码，在保留现有 VLM 架构的前提下引入由粗到细的结构并提升 token 复用；同时提出 Hi-GAR，一种基于几何的奖励函数，用于 GRPO 训练中结合多尺度框重叠与坐标准确度。在 RefCOCO 系列基准和三个 VLM 骨干上的受控对比实验中，该方法在 IoU 区间内持续提升定位精度，Hi-R1 在多数指标上超越强专用基线。
Motivation: 生成式视觉语言模型通常将边界框坐标视为独立的输出符号，未显式建模数值顺序和轴语义；作者指出这种表示是视觉定位中一类重要的错误来源。
Method: Hi-Token 为每个坐标的百位、十位、个位数字分配轴专属 token，引入粗到细结构并提高 token 复用；Hi-GAR 为 GRPO 提供基于几何的奖励，结合多尺度框重叠和坐标准确度，且仅在训练时使用。
Result: 在三个 VLM 骨干和 RefCOCO 系列上的受控实验显示，Hi-Token 在整个评估 IoU 范围内改善定位，Hi-GAR 进一步减少低重叠预测；Hi-R1 在多数报告指标上高于强专用基线。
Conclusion: 作者通过 token 频率、数字边界、物体尺度和 IoU 分布的分析，说明结构化坐标生成是生成式视觉定位的有效途径，且奖励训练的作用局限于训练阶段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Direct Route to Markov Chain Convergence via Asymptotic Equivalence with the Target
papers.abstract_en: For a Markov kernel $T$ with an invariant probability measure $π$, we give a self-contained proof of the Markov chain convergence theorem via a criterion called asymptotic equivalence with the target. It assumes two parts about the Lebesgue decompositions of $T^n_x$ and $π$ for every starting point $x$: 1.) asymptotic absolute continuity: the singular mass $\mathrm{sing}(T^n_x \mid π)$ tends to $0$; and, 2.) asymptotic domination of the target: the singular mass $\mathrm{sing}(π\mid T^n_x)$ tends to $0$, as $n \to \infty$. Assuming a jointly measurable density for the absolutely continuous part of each iterate $T^n$ w.r.t. $π$, this criterion is sufficient and necessary for convergence. A positive minorant density version of it is verified in three cases: i.) $T$ has a positive transition density w.r.t. $π$; ii.) $T$ consists of an absolutely continuous part with positive transition density together with an atom at the starting point, which covers the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm; iii.) the transition density is positive only after a finite number of steps that may depend on the starting point $x$. To demonstrate our general criterion, we investigate the Gibbs sampler with random scan and the parallel tempering algorithm. Furthermore, we show that in all mentioned settings Birkhoff's ergodic theorem applies, so as to obtain the strong law of large numbers. Throughout this paper, neither irreducibility, nor aperiodicity, nor recurrence, nor couplings, nor splitting constructions, nor small sets are used. In all results, the state space is a general measurable space with no structure beyond a $σ$-algebra. That joint measurability is assumed of the Markov kernel, not of the space; countable generation supplies it. None of the theorems proved here is new; what is offered is a short route to a single, widely applicable Markov chain convergence criterion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具有不变概率测度 π 的马尔可夫核 T，给出马尔可夫链收敛定理的一个自包含证明，核心判据称为“与目标渐近等价”(asymptotic equivalence with the target)。该判据基于每次迭代 T^n_x 与 π 的 Lebesgue 分解，要求奇异质量在两个方向上都趋于 0，并假设迭代密度关于 π 联合可测；作者证明该判据是收敛的充分必要条件。文中在正小量密度 (positive minorant density) 版本下验证了包括 Metropolis-Hastings 算法在内的若干情形，并说明 Birkhoff 遍历定理在这些设置下成立。
Motivation: 现有的马尔可夫链收敛证明通常依赖不可约性、非周期、回复性、耦合、分割构造或小集等结构条件，而本文希望在不要求状态空间额外结构的情况下，给出一个单一、广泛适用的收敛判据。
Method: 引入“与目标渐近等价”判据：要求对所有起始点 x，奇异常量 sing(T^n_x | π) 和 sing(π | T^n_x) 都随 n 趋于 0，并在迭代核 T^n 关于 π 的绝对连续部分具有联合可测密度时，证明该判据为收敛的充要条件。随后在三种情形下验证正小量密度版本：T 关于 π 有正转移密度；T 由正密度的绝对连续部分加起始点原子组成（覆盖 Metropolis-Hastings）；转移密度仅在有限步后为正（步数可依赖起始点）。并证明这些设置下 Birkhoff 遍历定理适用。
Result: 论文在一般可测空间上证明了所提判据是马尔可夫链收敛的充分必要条件，并验证了 Metropolis-Hastings 算法、随机扫描 Gibbs 采样器和并行回火算法等设置满足该判据。作者强调全文不依赖不可约性、非周期、回复性、耦合、分割构造或小集等传统条件，且状态空间只需 σ-代数，无需额外结构。

papers.title: EchoChange: A Diffusion Language Model with Dual Pass Remasking for Factual Remote Sensing Disaster Change Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Bi-temporal remote-sensing disaster change captioning often needs to identify sparse and spatially localized changes across large pre- and post-event scenes and then translate them into coherent, factual descriptions. However, existing change captioning methods always follow an autoregressive decoding paradigm to generate the change description and thus an early misinterpretation of the changed object, event, or spatial relation becomes an irreversible premise for subsequent text, amplifying visual ambiguity into cascading factual errors. To address this limitation, we propose EchoChange, a multimodal discrete diffusion language model that formulates change captioning as iterative masked-token denoising rather than left-to-right generation. By repeatedly revising the entire caption while conditioning on the image pair, EchoChange can reconsider uncertain content and correct imperfect intermediate predictions. We further introduce draft-aware dual-pass training, a progressive masking curriculum, and confidence-guided remasking to align training with iterative inference. Extensive experiments on the RSCC benchmark show that EchoChange substantially outperforms both general-purpose and remote-sensing-specific baselines across lexical and semantic metrics. The EchoChange Project is at https://sundongwei.github.io/EchoChange_Project/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EchoChange，一种多模态离散扩散语言模型，用于双时相遥感灾害变化描述生成。它将变化描述建模为迭代掩码 token 去噪（masked-token denoising），而非自回归从左到右生成，并引入 draft-aware dual-pass training、渐进掩码课程（progressive masking curriculum）和置信度引导重掩码（confidence-guided remasking）来对齐训练与推理。在 RSCC 基准上，EchoChange 在词汇和语义指标上均显著优于通用及遥感专用基线。
Motivation: 现有变化描述方法通常采用自回归解码，早期对变化目标、事件或空间关系的误判会作为后续文本的不可逆前提，把视觉歧义放大为级联的事实错误。
Method: 提出 EchoChange 扩散语言模型，将变化描述生成视为迭代掩码 token 去噪而非从左到右生成；通过 draft-aware dual-pass training、progressive masking curriculum 和 confidence-guided remasking 使训练过程与迭代推理一致。
Result: 在 RSCC 基准上的大量实验表明，EchoChange 在词汇和语义指标上均大幅优于通用和遥感专用基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过在图像对条件下反复修正整个描述，模型能够重新考虑不确定内容并纠正不完美的中间预测，为遥感灾害变化描述提供了一种非自回归生成范式；摘要未提及明确局限。

papers.title: WAM-Diff2: Hierarchical AR-to-Diffusion Distillation for Highly Efficient Autonomous Driving VLA
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving; however, their efficient deployment is severely constrained by high computational latency and exposure bias arising from sequential autoregressive decoding. Conversely, while specialized diffusion policies enable low-latency, parallel execution, training them from scratch typically yields narrow, single-task architectures that lack holistic visual-linguistic reasoning. Successfully transforming pre-trained autoregressive generalists into parallel diffusion models could combine multi-task cognitive intelligence with execution efficiency, yet this transition presents a formidable architectural challenge due to mismatched attention patterns (causal versus bidirectional) and divergent optimization objectives. To bridge this divide, we introduce WAM-Diff2, a multi-task discrete diffusion VLA framework powered by a three-stage hierarchical distillation strategy. By structuring the architectural shift through progressive block-wise adaptation, block-wise distillation, and model-wise cross-scale distillation, WAM-Diff2 preserves the underlying semantic foundations of the base model while accelerating inference. Extensive evaluations across driving understanding, perception, and planning benchmarks demonstrate that WAM-Diff2 effectively mitigates exposure bias and achieves performance parity with autoregressive baselines. Crucially, the autoregressive-to-diffusion transition yields a 2.8x decoding speedup, which scales to an ultimate 15.1x acceleration when combined with system-level optimizations including FlashInfer and CUDA Graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WAM-Diff2，一种用于自动驾驶的多任务离散扩散 VLA 框架，通过三阶段分层蒸馏将预训练的自回归 VLA 模型转换为并行扩散模型。摘要报告该方法在驾驶理解、感知与规划基准上达到与自回归基线相当的性能，同时将解码速度提升 2.8 倍，并结合 FlashInfer 与 CUDA Graphs 等系统优化后可达到 15.1 倍加速。
Motivation: VLA 模型采用顺序自回归解码，存在高计算延迟和暴露偏差 (exposure bias)，难以高效部署；而从头训练的扩散策略通常是窄领域单任务架构，缺乏整体视觉-语言推理能力。将预训练自回归通用模型转换为并行扩散模型可结合两者优势，但存在因果注意力与双向注意力的不匹配以及优化目标差异等架构挑战。
Method: 提出 WAM-Diff2，一种多任务离散扩散 VLA 框架，采用三阶段分层蒸馏策略：渐进块级适应 (progressive block-wise adaptation)、块级蒸馏 (block-wise distillation) 和模型级跨尺度蒸馏 (model-wise cross-scale distillation)，以保留基础模型的语义基础并加速推理。
Result: 在驾驶理解、感知和规划基准上的评估表明，WAM-Diff2 缓解了暴露偏差并达到与自回归基线相当的性能。自回归到扩散的转换带来 2.8 倍解码加速，结合 FlashInfer 和 CUDA Graphs 等系统级优化后可实现 15.1 倍加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作成功弥合了自回归通用模型与并行扩散策略之间的架构鸿沟，验证了将预训练自回归 VLA 蒸馏为扩散模型以获得高效自动驾驶推理的可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cloud-ScPO: Hidden-State Geometry for Semi-Supervised Preference Optimization in LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Preference optimization improves mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs), but reliable chosen-rejected pairs usually require verified answers, human annotations, or external reward models. We investigate whether preference supervision can instead be derived from the model's internal representation geometry in a semi-supervised setting. Our analysis shows that reasoning trajectories generated across different mathematical problems form structured global point clouds in which correct and incorrect trajectories exhibit different geometric organization. Based on this observation, we propose Cloud-ScPO, a topology-guided preference-mining framework that uses a small labeled set to construct multiple correct and incorrect reference Clouds. Each trajectory is represented by a mean-pooled hidden state and scored against connectivity-induced components using a component-level soft $k$-nearest-neighbor measure averaged across reference banks. We combine this cross-problem Cloud signal with prompt-level self-consistency: self-consistency determines the answer-level preference direction, while Cloud scoring selects concrete trajectories and filters pairs by their score margin. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH-Numeric across four model settings show that Cloud-ScPO consistently improves over ScPO, with gains of up to 4.49% on GSM8K and 4.19% on MATH-Numeric. Pair-level analyses further show that Cloud-ScPO maintains comparable correctness reliability while more effectively separating informative chosen trajectories from incomplete, repetitive, or otherwise low-quality rejected responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cloud-ScPO，一个基于隐藏状态几何的拓扑引导半监督偏好挖掘框架，用于大语言模型（LLM）的数学推理偏好优化。作者发现不同数学问题的推理轨迹构成结构化全局点云，正确与错误轨迹呈现不同的几何组织，因此利用小标注集构建参考 Cloud，并结合 prompt 级自一致性来生成偏好对。在 GSM8K 和 MATH-Numeric 上的四个模型设置中，Cloud-ScPO 一致优于 ScPO，说明内部表示几何可以作为半监督偏好信号的来源。
Motivation: 偏好优化能提升 LLM 的数学推理能力，但构造可靠的 chosen-rejected 对通常依赖验证答案、人工标注或外部奖励模型。本文研究能否在半监督场景下从模型内部表示的几何结构中直接推导偏好监督，从而减少对外部监督来源的依赖。
Method: Cloud-ScPO 使用小规模标注集构建多个正确与不正确的参考 Cloud，每条轨迹用均值池化隐藏状态（mean-pooled hidden state）表示，并通过跨参考库平均的组件级软 k 近邻度量（component-level soft k-nearest-neighbor）打分。prompt 级自一致性决定答案级偏好方向，Cloud 打分用于选择具体轨迹并按分数差距过滤配对。
Result: 在 GSM8K 和 MATH-Numeric 上的四个模型设置中，Cloud-ScPO 相比 ScPO 一致提升，GSM8K 最高提升 4.49%，MATH-Numeric 最高提升 4.19%。Pair 级分析显示其正确性可靠性相近，但能更有效地区分信息丰富的 chosen 轨迹与不完整、重复或低质量的 rejected 响应。
Conclusion: 摘要认为隐藏状态几何可以支撑半监督偏好挖掘，并表明 Cloud 信号与自一致性结合能持续改进偏好优化效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Subtype Robustness Is Not Just Accuracy: Calibration Under Unseen Subtype Shift
papers.abstract_en: Subtype robustness asks whether a model keeps the correct coarse prediction when test examples come from fine-grained subtypes absent from training but still inside a known coarse category. Prior work studies this almost entirely through accuracy. We ask whether the model also stays calibrated. We present the first systematic study of the question across ImageNet, BREEDS, iNaturalist and CIFAR-100 with five architectures. Calibration breaks down on unseen subtypes, where accuracy drops while confidence barely follows, leaving the model systematically overconfident exactly where it has become less accurate. At matched accuracy loss, generic image corruption causes a much larger drop in confidence, so the effect is not a general consequence of losing accuracy. The model reacts to visible degradation but not to in-taxonomy novelty. Recalibration tuned on seen subtypes narrows the gap but does not close it, and out-of-distribution scores flag the affected inputs only weakly. Subtype robustness should therefore be evaluated through calibration, not accuracy alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究模型在未见过的细粒度子类型（unseen subtype）下是否保持校准（calibration），而不仅是准确率。作者在 ImageNet、BREEDS、iNaturalist 和 CIFAR-100 上用五种架构评估，发现校准在未见子类型上显著失效：准确率下降而置信度几乎不跟随，模型在变差的区域系统性过度自信。该效应并非准确率下降的一般后果，因为同等准确率损失下通用图像损坏会使置信度大幅下降。
Motivation: 现有子类型鲁棒性（subtype robustness）研究几乎只关注准确率，忽视了模型在训练时未见过的细粒度子类型上是否仍能保持校准。校准失效会导致模型在粗分类正确率下降时仍给出过高置信度，这对高风险应用十分关键。
Method: 作者在 ImageNet、BREEDS、iNaturalist 和 CIFAR-100 上对五种架构进行系统性校准评估，比较未见子类型转移与通用图像损坏下的置信度变化，并检验基于已见子类型重校准（recalibration）以及 OOD 分数对受影响输入的检测能力。
Result: 未见子类型下准确率下降而置信度几乎不变，模型系统性过度自信；在匹配的准确率损失下，通用图像损坏导致置信度大幅下降，表明模型对可见退化有反应但不对分类学内的新颖性反应。基于已见子类型的重校准只能缩小差距而无法消除，OOD 分数对受影响输入的指示也很弱。
Conclusion: 子类型鲁棒性应通过校准而非仅准确率来评估。该结论局限在图像分类基准与所测试的架构和重校准方案上。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 现有子类型鲁棒性（subtype robustness）研究几乎只关注准确率，忽视了模型在训练时未见过的细粒度子类型上是否仍能保持校准。校准失效会导致模型在粗分类正确率下降时仍给出过高置信度，这对高风险应用十分关键。
summary_sections.method: 作者在 ImageNet、BREEDS、iNaturalist 和 CIFAR-100 上对五种架构进行系统性校准评估，比较未见子类型转移与通用图像损坏下的置信度变化，并检验基于已见子类型重校准（recalibration）以及 OOD 分数对受影响输入的检测能力。
summary_sections.result: 未见子类型下准确率下降而置信度几乎不变，模型系统性过度自信；在匹配的准确率损失下，通用图像损坏导致置信度大幅下降，表明模型对可见退化有反应但不对分类学内的新颖性反应。基于已见子类型的重校准只能缩小差距而无法消除，OOD 分数对受影响输入的指示也很弱。
summary_sections.conclusion: 子类型鲁棒性应通过校准而非仅准确率来评估。该结论局限在图像分类基准与所测试的架构和重校准方案上。

papers.title: From Code Review to Code Critique: Intent, Drift, and Spotlight for AI-Generated Diffs at Scale
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are generating code at volumes that exceed the capacity of traditional peer review. At the same time, existing AI code review tools over-index on low-value suggestions such as style and best practices while under-indexing on the concerns human reviewers prioritize most: correctness, security, and performance. We present ARCTIC, an AI-powered Code Critique system that reframes code review around three capabilities: intent prediction, which infers why a change was made from conversation logs and metadata; drift detection, which measures divergence between the developer's intent and the agent's output via backtranslation; and code spotlight, which ranks the regions of a diff most warranting human scrutiny. We ground these capabilities in a six-theme taxonomy derived from 18,000 code reviews. Offline evaluation shows that intent prediction achieves 0.86 F1, drift detection reaches near-perfect ordinal agreement with human annotators (QWK = 0.907), and spotlight outperforms the baseline AI reviewer by 2.4x on quality estimation at 5x fewer tokens. In the experimental rollout, the drift scores reduces code misalignment by an additional 5.76 points (p = 0.026), intent prediction receives 90.2% approval, and zero defects have been attributed to self-reviewed diffs since launch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARCTIC，一个将代码审查重构为三能力的 AI 代码批判系统：意图预测（intent prediction）、漂移检测（drift detection）和代码聚焦（code spotlight），并基于 18,000 条代码审查提炼出六主题分类法。摘要报告离线评估中意图预测 F1 为 0.86，漂移检测与人工标注者的序数一致性接近完美（QWK=0.907），代码聚焦在质量估计上比基线 AI 审查器提升 2.4 倍且使用 token 少 5 倍；实验部署中漂移分数使代码错位额外减少 5.76 点（p=0.026），意图预测获得 90.2% 的批准率，且自发布以来未发现自审查 diff 导致的缺陷。
Motivation: AI 编码智能体生成代码的规模已超过传统同行评审的承载能力，而现有 AI 代码审查工具过度关注风格和最佳实践等低价值建议，低估了人类审查者优先关心的正确性、安全性和性能。
Method: 提出 ARCTIC 系统，包含三个核心能力：意图预测（从对话日志和元数据推断变更原因）、漂移检测（通过 backtranslation 衡量开发者意图与智能体输出的偏差）和代码聚焦（对 diff 中最需要人工审查的区域进行排序），并以六主题分类法作为能力基础。
Result: 离线评估中，意图预测 F1 为 0.86，漂移检测与人工标注者的 QWK 达到 0.907，代码聚焦在质量估计上较基线 AI 审查器提升 2.4 倍且 token 消耗减少 5 倍。实验部署中，漂移分数额外降低代码错位 5.76 点（p=0.026），意图预测批准率为 90.2%，自启动以来零缺陷归因于自审查 diff。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将代码审查重构为针对 AI 生成 diff 的三能力范式可以在规模上缓解审查压力，但未详细说明系统的适用范围或潜在局限。

papers.title: Teffic-Audio: Tell Fact from Fiction
papers.abstract_en: Speech deepfake detection has expanded in scope with increasingly heterogeneous spoofing mechanisms, including speech synthesis, voice conversion, vocoder reconstruction, and neural-codec resynthesis. The resulting spoofing artifacts can be further shaped by variability in source speech, recording environments, and transmission channels. This variability makes robust generalization across heterogeneous conditions a central requirement for practical detection systems. This report presents Teffic-Audio, a general speech deepfake detection system designed for comprehensive evaluation environment. Teffic-Audio adopts a straightforward detector architecture consisting of a Conformer-based speech encoder, multi-head attentive statistics pooling, and a binary classifier. Rather than relying on additional architectural complexity, the system improves generalization through its training recipe, which integrates multi-source data, attack- and source-balanced sampling, and diverse audio augmentation. Trained only with open-source data, Teffic-Audio achieves a pooled EER of 1.454% on the 14 test sets of Speech-DF-Arena, outperforming all currently public systems on the leaderboard. It also obtains the lowest EER on five individual test sets and shows a favorable performance-complexity trade-off compared with larger leading systems. Overall, Teffic-Audio provides a strong and practical reference system for general speech deepfake detection.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Technical report. Project page: https://tefficlabs.com/teffic-audio
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Teffic-Audio，一个面向综合评测环境的通用语音深度伪造检测系统。系统采用 Conformer 语音编码器、多头注意力统计池化和二分类器的简单结构，通过多源数据、攻击与来源平衡采样、多样音频增强的训练方案提升泛化能力。仅用开源数据训练，在 Speech-DF-Arena 的 14 个测试集上 pooled EER 为 1.454%，超过现有公开系统。
Motivation: 语音深度伪造检测面临语音合成、语音转换、声码器重构、神经编解码重采样等异构欺骗机制，且源语音、录音环境和传输信道的差异会进一步改变伪影分布，使跨异构条件的鲁棒泛化成为实际检测系统的核心需求。
Method: 提出直接的检测器结构：Conformer 语音编码器、多头注意力统计池化和二分类器；不依赖额外架构复杂度，而是通过训练配方（多源数据、攻击与来源平衡采样、多样音频增强）来改善泛化能力。
Result: 仅用开源数据训练，Teffic-Audio 在 Speech-DF-Arena 的 14 个测试集上取得 pooled EER 1.454%，优于排行榜上所有现有公开系统；在 5 个单独测试集上取得最低 EER，并相对更大规模的领先系统展现出有利的性能-复杂度权衡。
Conclusion: 作者将 Teffic-Audio 定位为通用语音深度伪造检测的强且实用的参考系统，强调通过训练策略而非架构复杂度来获得泛化收益。

papers.title: Correcting What You Cannot See: Credit Assignment for Perception Distillation in Multimodal Reasoners
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multimodal reasoners, but its trajectory-level reward cannot determine whether a failed answer arose from perception or subsequent reasoning. Perception Success Rate (PSR), estimated from multiple reasonings sharing one perception, remains ambiguous because low success conflates perceptual insufficiency with reasoning difficulty. We introduce \textbf{Perception-Correction Distillation (PCD)}, a label-free method that identifies correctable perception failures using downstream failure and teacher--student disagreement as complementary witnesses. Their product, , forms a soft AND gate that strengthens distillation only when both witnesses are present. We motivate this rule through Bayesian evidence combination and show that multiplication is the unique normalized bilinear gate that vanishes when either witness is absent. PCD uses separated perception--reasoning rollouts and mean-preserving weights, leaving the reasoning objective unchanged. Across eight benchmarks, PCD improves the 8B 2B macro average from 44.50 with OPD to 47.28 and the 32B 8B result from 56.94 to 61.22. In matched 2B ablations, removing PCD and separated rollout reduces held-out average by 2.22 and 0.88 points, respectively. Effective multimodal distillation therefore depends not only on what the teacher predicts, but also on identifying when perception is the appropriate target of correction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Perception-Correction Distillation (PCD)，一种无标签方法，用于多模态推理器的感知蒸馏。核心思路是利用下游失败与师生分歧作为互补证据，构造软 AND 门控来识别可纠正的感知失败，并在 8B→2B 与 32B→8B 蒸馏中显著提升宏平均性能。
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏 (on-policy distillation) 提供密集监督，但轨迹级奖励无法判断回答失败源于感知错误还是后续推理错误；基于多次推理共享一次感知估计出的感知成功率 (PSR) 仍有歧义，因为低成功率可能由感知不足或推理困难造成。
Method: PCD 使用下游失败和师生分歧作为互补证据，其乘积构成软 AND 门控，仅当两个证据同时存在时才加强蒸馏。作者通过贝叶斯证据组合推导该规则，并证明乘法是唯一满足条件的归一化双线性门控。同时采用分离的感知-推理 rollout 和保均值权重，保持推理目标不变。
Result: 在八个基准上，PCD 将 8B→2B 蒸馏的宏平均从 OPD 的 44.50 提升到 47.28，32B→8B 从 56.94 提升到 61.22；在匹配的 2B 消融中，移除 PCD 和分离 rollout 分别使留出平均降低 2.22 和 0.88 分。
Conclusion: 有效的多模态蒸馏不仅取决于教师预测什么，还取决于识别感知何时是对应的纠正目标；作者强调感知失败定位本身对蒸馏收益起关键作用。

papers.title: Towards Practical Algorithm Selection for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Numerous unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) algorithms exist, but for clinical practice, selecting the best-suited one along with proper hyperparameters often remains unclear, as the unlabeled deployment (target) domain prevents direct evaluation. We propose a label-free criterion that jointly selects the algorithm and hyperparameters for UDA. Given a pool of candidate models from multiple algorithms trained with different hyperparameters, our approach scores each candidate against an agreement reference, and selects the one with the highest score. The agreement reference is constructed in two levels without using target labels. First, we leverage multiple label-free selection signals, using each to nominate a model within every algorithm. Second, the nominated models are aggregated across algorithms to form a reference prediction for each unlabeled target sample. The candidate whose predictions agree most with this reference is then selected for deployment. Experimental results on four brain MRI and four chest X-ray datasets across seven clinically relevant transfer scenarios show that our method achieves better selection performance than other methods and remains effective across different algorithm pools. Our approach takes a step towards practical, label-free algorithm selection for clinical deployment of UDA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学影像中无监督域适应 (UDA) 的算法与超参数选择问题，提出一种无需目标域标签的选择准则。方法从多个算法、多组超参数训练出的候选模型池中，通过与两级构造的共识参考 (agreement reference) 比较预测一致性来选出最优模型。在四个脑 MRI 和四个胸部 X 射线数据集上的七个临床相关迁移场景中，该方法的选择性能优于其他方法，且在不同算法池下保持有效。
Motivation: 临床实践中存在大量 UDA 算法，但由于部署时的目标域无标签，无法直接评估哪个算法及其超参数组合最合适，导致算法选择困难。
Method: 提出无标签的选择准则：先从每个算法内部利用多种无标签选择信号各提名一个模型，再跨算法聚合提名模型形成每个目标样本的参考预测，最后选择与参考预测最一致的候选模型进行部署。
Result: 在四个脑 MRI 和四个胸部 X 射线数据集、七个临床相关迁移场景上，该方法的选择性能优于其他方法，并且在不同的算法池上保持有效。
Conclusion: 该方法为医学影像中 UDA 的临床部署提供了一种实用、无需标签的算法选择途径；摘要未报告具体数值或局限性。

papers.title: RepBench: Compiling Benchmarks into Capability Representations for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Representation engineering reads and steers capability directions in large language models, yet methods are typically evaluated on paper-specific synthetic data. The resulting measurements are difficult to compare or reproduce and may reflect surface patterns rather than capabilities. We present RepBench, a benchmark-grounded data layer for capability-aligned representation probing. Crawling 13,427 benchmark papers yields a taxonomy of 182 capability clusters in 13 families; harvesting 353 public benchmark datasets yields 46,149 audited probe texts covering 94 capabilities, each supported by at least two independent benchmarks. This multi-benchmark design reduces dependence on any single source: raw per-text vectors exhibit no natural cluster granularity, whereas benchmark-pooled capability vectors show an interior clustering optimum at a small number of clusters on all 12 evaluated models, with low agreement to the human taxonomy. Under cross-benchmark transfer evaluation across twelve models completed by all four readouts, difference-in-means attains the highest model-level mean on ten models, while logistic regression wins the most capability-model cells. This disagreement shows that the readout method and aggregation criterion are meaningful evaluation dimensions. The pipeline, corpus, and evaluation code are released as a reusable closed-loop workflow.

TL;DR: 本文提出 RepBench，一个以基准为导向的数据层，用于面向能力的表示探测 (capability-aligned representation probing)。作者爬取 13,427 篇基准论文，得到 13 个家族、182 个能力簇的 taxonomy，并从 353 个公开基准数据集中整理出 46,149 条经过审计的探测文本，覆盖 94 种能力且每种能力至少由两个独立基准支持。在 12 个模型上的跨基准迁移评估中，差均值 (difference-in-means) 在 10 个模型上取得最高的模型级均值，逻辑回归则在最多能力-模型单元上获胜，说明读出方法与聚合标准是有意义的评估维度。
Motivation: 现有的表示工程 (representation engineering) 方法通常在论文自制的合成数据上评估，导致测量结果难以比较、复现，且可能反映表面模式而非真实能力。
Method: RepBench 通过大规模爬取基准论文并整合公开数据集，构建多基准支持的探测文本库；评估比较了多种读出方法 (readout) 与聚合标准在不同模型上的表现。
Result: 原始逐文本向量没有自然聚类粒度，而基准池化的能力向量在全部 12 个评估模型上呈现少聚类数的内部聚类最优，且与人工 taxonomy 一致性低；跨基准迁移评估中差均值在 10 个模型上取得最高模型级均值，逻辑回归在最多能力-模型单元上获胜。
Conclusion: 作者认为读出方法和聚合标准是表示能力评估中的关键维度，并发布了可复用的闭环工作流，包括 pipeline、语料和评估代码。

papers.title: Kalypso: Relational LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used as semantic operators for filtering, extracting, ranking, joining, and transforming unstructured data. Existing semantic query processing systems invoke request-centric LLM serving systems that are unaware of the query plan, leaving substantial performance opportunities unused. This paper introduces relational LLM serving, an abstraction that makes LLM serving aware of semantic query structure while preserving query semantics and output accuracy. The key opportunity is pipelined execution across semantic operators: when intermediate tuples flow directly from one operator to the next, their KV-cache state can be reused instead of recomputed. We present Kalypso, a relational LLM serving system that exposes an API for semantic query plans and executes them using an adaptive, memory-aware scheduling algorithm. Kalypso addresses a new online scheduling problem in which pipelined operator execution is coupled with GPU memory pressure management to reuse KV-cache state in the serving engine before eviction. Its scheduler continuously adjusts memory allocations to balance upstream parallelism, downstream progress, and GPU utilization. Our evaluation shows that Kalypso improves query completion time over baselines using request-centric LLM serving, with speedups up to 4.57x across diverse workloads, demonstrating that query-aware LLM serving can substantially improve the efficiency of semantic query execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出关系型 LLM 服务 (relational LLM serving) 抽象，让 LLM 服务端感知语义查询计划，并据此在语义算子间流水线执行，复用中间元组的 KV-cache 状态。作者实现系统 Kalypso，用自适应、内存感知的调度算法在 GPU 内存压力下平衡上游并行、下游进度与 GPU 利用率。评估显示相比请求中心式 (request-centric) LLM 服务基线，查询完成时间最高加速 4.57 倍。
Motivation: 现有语义查询处理系统依赖请求中心式 LLM 服务，服务端不了解查询计划，导致跨算子的中间结果需要重复计算 KV-cache，存在大量性能浪费。
Method: 提出关系型 LLM 服务抽象，暴露语义查询计划 API；Kalypso 将其建模为一个新的在线调度问题，调度器持续调整内存分配，在缓存被逐出前复用算子间流水线中的 KV-cache 状态。
Result: 在多样工作负载上，Kalypso 相比请求中心式 LLM 服务基线将查询完成时间最多加速 4.57 倍。
Conclusion: 查询感知的 LLM 服务能够显著提升语义查询执行效率，表明语义查询结构可作为 LLM 服务优化的重要维度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GTIN: A Unified Framework for Joint Event and Time Prediction in Temporal Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Temporal graphs are increasingly used to model dynamic systems in diverse domains such as social networks, financial networks, and traffic networks. Predicting both what the next event will be and when it will occur in these systems is crucial for understanding and anticipating complex behaviors, but has not been studied much. To address this gap, we propose a unified mathematical framework capable of capturing varying degrees of complexity across temporal graphs. Our framework is flexible and expressive enough to accommodate a wide range of network structures and temporal dynamics. Building upon this analysis, we introduce our novel approach for jointly predicting the next event and its occurrence time. Empirical evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing techniques, particularly in scenarios involving irregular event patterns and complex temporal dependencies. These findings highlight the potential of our framework as a robust foundation for future research in temporal event prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的数学框架 GTIN，用于在时序图（temporal graphs）中联合预测下一个事件及其发生时间，并刻画不同复杂度的网络结构与时间动态。基于该框架，作者给出联合预测模型，实证表明在多个数据集上优于现有方法，尤其在事件模式不规则和时序依赖复杂的场景下。
Motivation: 时序图广泛用于社交网络、金融网络和交通网络等动态系统，但联合预测"下一个事件是什么"及其发生时间的研究相对缺乏，现有方法也缺少能覆盖不同复杂度与动态模式的统一框架。
Method: 提出一个统一且灵活的数学框架，能适应多种网络结构和时序动态，并在此基础上构建联合预测下一事件类别与发生时刻的模型。
Result: 多个数据集上的实证评估显示，该方法一致优于现有技术，特别是在不规则事件模式和复杂时间依赖的场景中表现突出。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架可作为时序事件预测领域未来研究的稳健基础。摘要未披露具体数据集、指标或消融细节。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: SkillSight: Calibrating Generic Content Bias for Skill Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: As large language model agents gain access to increasingly large skill libraries, retrieving the right skill becomes critical to reliable capability selection and execution. Existing retrievers often treat skill contents as ordinary documents, overlooking their highly regular structure: shared descriptive patterns recur across many skills while providing little evidence for distinguishing the required capability. We show that this shared descriptive background is reflected in dense relevance scores, induces a pronounced energy gap between queries and skill documents, and obscures discriminative signals, especially for structurally similar hard negatives. Based on this observation, we propose SkillSight, a training-free retrieval framework that calibrates shared background in both semantic and lexical spaces. Semantic Background Calibration estimates a background subspace from generic tokens identified by IDF, reducing similarity induced by shared descriptive patterns, while Lexical Evidence Calibration downweights shared background tokens to recover discriminative token-level evidence. Experiments on SRA-Bench and SkillBench-Supp demonstrate consistent improvements across retrieval metrics, with SkillSight improving Recall@10 by up to 20.21 percentage points over the original dense retriever. It is up to 1,248 times faster than the Dense + Reranker baseline. In end-to-end evaluation, SkillSight achieves the best overall performance across three agent models and outperforms LLM Selection by up to 4.97 percentage points. These results identify shared descriptive background as a source of ranking interference in skill retrieval and demonstrate that calibrating it enables accurate and efficient skill selection without additional training. Our code can be found at https://github.com/xiaojinying/SkillSight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillSight，一个无需训练的检索框架，针对大型语言模型代理的技能库检索问题。核心观察是技能内容具有高度规则化的共享描述模式，这些模式在稠密相关性分数中引入能量间隙并掩盖判别性信号，尤其影响结构相似的难负样本。SkillSight 通过语义背景校准（Semantic Background Calibration）与词汇证据校准（Lexical Evidence Calibration）在语义和词汇空间中消除共享背景干扰。在 SRA-Bench 与 SkillBench-Supp 上，Recall@10 最高提升 20.21 个百分点，且比 Dense + Reranker 基线快最多 1248 倍。
Motivation: 现有检索器将技能内容当作普通文档处理，忽略了技能库中大量技能共享的规律性描述模式；这些共享背景缺乏区分能力，却干扰了稠密检索的相关性分数，导致难以从结构相似的技能中选出正确的一项。
Method: SkillSight 是一种无训练的检索框架：语义背景校准利用 IDF 识别通用词元并估计背景子空间，以降低共享描述模式带来的相似度；词汇证据校准则对共享背景词元降权，恢复判别性的词元级证据。
Result: 在 SRA-Bench 与 SkillBench-Supp 上，SkillSight 相比原始稠密检索器将 Recall@10 最高提升 20.21 个百分点，比 Dense + Reranker 基线快最多 1248 倍；端到端评估中，它在三个代理模型上取得最佳整体性能，并比 LLM Selection 最高提升 4.97 个百分点。
Conclusion: 共享描述背景是技能检索中排序干扰的来源，对它在语义与词汇层面进行校准可以在无需额外训练的情况下实现准确且高效的技能选择。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Debiasing Text-to-Image Evaluation via Implicit Cultural Alignment Reward Modeling
papers.abstract_en: As Text-to-Image (T2I) systems rapidly advance, evaluating the cultural authenticity of synthesized content has become increasingly important for fair and trustworthy generative AI. Existing T2I evaluation metrics and multimodal judges often rely on visual-semantic representations that underrepresent implicit cultural norms, leading to biased preference judgments and the omission of fine-grained cultural cues. In addition, visual question answering (VQA)-based evaluators typically depend on autoregressive text generation, which limits their scalability for real-time reward modeling. To address these limitations, we introduce an Implicit Cultural Alignment Reward Model built upon a lightweight 4.2-billion-parameter Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM). Our framework integrates an Implicit Cultural Probe with a Skip-connection Cross-Attention (SkipCA) mechanism, enabling late-stage semantic features to directly attend to early-stage visual representations and better preserve culturally salient details. Evaluations on 3,323 challenging and carefully curated image pairs from the CulturalFrames benchmark show that our approach achieves 82.12% pairwise accuracy, with Pearson and Kendall correlation coefficients of 0.585 and 0.412, respectively, outperforming representative vision-language metrics and MLLM-based evaluators. Moreover, by bypassing autoregressive text generation, our model processes each evaluation in 0.21 seconds under our local inference setup, achieving a $10\times$ speedup over standard VQA-based evaluators. These results suggest that the proposed reward model can provide an efficient and culturally aware scalar signal for preference optimization pipelines such as Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback and Direct Preference Optimization. Additional resources are available on our project page at https://bensonch1214.github.io/Implicit_Cultural_Alignment/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于42亿参数轻量级多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的隐式文化对齐奖励模型（Implicit Cultural Alignment Reward Model），用于评估文本到图像（T2I）生成内容的文化真实性。模型结合隐式文化探针（Implicit Cultural Probe）与跳跃连接交叉注意力（SkipCA），使后期语义特征直接关注早期视觉表示以保留文化细节。在CulturalFrames基准的3,323个图像对上达到82.12%的成对准确率，Pearson与Kendall相关系数分别为0.585和0.412，并实现每次评估0.21秒、较标准VQA评估器快10倍的推理速度。
Motivation: 现有T2I评估指标和多模态评判器依赖的视觉语义表示低估了隐式文化规范，导致偏好判断有偏并遗漏细粒度文化线索；基于VQA的评估器依赖自回归文本生成，限制了实时奖励建模的可扩展性。
Method: 提出基于4.2B参数MLLM的隐式文化对齐奖励模型，集成隐式文化探针与Skip-connection Cross-Attention (SkipCA)机制，使晚期语义特征直接关注早期视觉表示以保留文化显著细节，并通过绕过自回归文本生成实现高效推理。
Result: 在CulturalFrames基准的3,323个精心筛选图像对上达到82.12%的成对准确率，Pearson相关系数0.585、Kendall相关系数0.412，优于代表性视觉语言指标和MLLM评估器；每次评估用时0.21秒，相比标准VQA评估器获得10倍加速。
Conclusion: 该奖励模型可以为RLHF和DPO等偏好优化流程提供高效且具有文化感知能力的标量奖励信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IoU-PD: IoU-Aware Privileged Distillation for Visual Grounding with Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding with multimodal large language models is commonly formulated as autoregressive coordinate generation, where a model outputs bounding-box coordinates as text given an image and a referring-expression prompt. While this interface is simple and compatible with instruction following, it introduces a mismatch between training and evaluation: training optimizes token-level likelihood over coordinate strings, whereas grounding quality is measured by geometric overlap. We propose IoU-PD, an IoU-aware privileged distillation method for coordinate-generating multimodal large language models. IoU-PD uses ground-truth boxes not only as coordinate targets, but also as privileged training-time guidance. During training, the student receives the original image and prompt, while a frozen teacher receives a box-marked image and an augmented prompt that indicates the marked region. The student is trained with a supervised fine-tuning anchor and a privileged distillation loss whose token weights reflect both geometric importance and teacher reliability. At inference time, IoU-PD requires no box overlay, privileged hint, teacher branch, or additional prediction module. Experiments on standard referring-expression grounding benchmarks show consistent region-level improvements over strong coordinate-generating baselines, demonstrating that ground-truth boxes can provide useful privileged guidance beyond serving as coordinate labels. Project page: https://xyzzzh.github.io/IoU-PD/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型 (multimodal large language model) 视觉接地中通常采用的自回归坐标生成范式，指出其训练与评估存在不匹配：训练优化坐标字符串的 token 级似然，而评估用几何重叠度量。作者提出 IoU-PD，一种 IoU 感知的特权蒸馏方法，在训练时将 ground-truth 框既作为坐标目标，又作为特权指导信息；推理时无需额外模块。在标准指代表达接地基准上，该方法相对强坐标生成基线取得一致的区域级改进。
Motivation: 自回归坐标生成的视觉接地模型在训练时优化 token 级似然，而接地质量由几何重叠（即 IoU）评价，二者不匹配会限制最终定位精度。
Method: IoU-PD 采用教师-学生框架：学生接收原始图像和提示，冻结的教师接收带有框标记的图像和指示标记区域的增强提示；学生由监督微调锚点和特权蒸馏损失共同训练，损失中的 token 权重同时反映几何重要性与教师可靠性。推理时不依赖框覆盖、特权提示、教师分支或额外预测模块。
Result: 在标准指代表达接地基准上的实验显示，与强坐标生成基线相比，该方法在区域级定位性能上有一致提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，ground-truth 框不仅能作为坐标标签，还能提供超出坐标标签的额外特权指导，从而改进坐标生成式多模态大语言模型的视觉接地能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CFM-Bench: A Unified Multi-Domain, Multi-Task Benchmark for Channel Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Channel foundation models (CFMs) are commonly evaluated in model-specific pipelines that differ in data, radio configurations, partitions, adaptation procedures, task definitions, and metrics, preventing reproducible comparison across CFMs and against task-specific networks. We release CFM-Bench, a unified multi-domain, multi-task benchmark comprising 157,900 official single-frame examples from six domains spanning 3GPP statistical simulation, two ray-tracing pipelines, terrestrial and aerial measurements, and synchronized vehicular multimodal simulation. Source-specific interfaces preserve complex channel state information (CSI) and the physical metadata available in each domain while allowing documented model-specific preprocessing. To reduce spatio-temporal leakage, official partitions isolate complete trajectories, measurement sessions, flights, vehicle links, simulation realizations, or buffered spatial regions. CFM-Bench excludes all benchmark splits from foundation-model pretraining, reserves the official training split for downstream fine-tuning, and reports the data used during model development. Six task groups across PHY, RAN, and ISAC applications cover CSI feedback, frequency and temporal channel extrapolation, propagation-state classification, current- and future-beam prediction, and single-frame and temporal localization. Representative experiments on CSI feedback, channel extrapolation, current-beam prediction, and wireless positioning provide reproducible reference results for pretrained channel-prediction models and task-specific neural networks. These results show that relative model performance can vary across data domains, highlighting the importance of using common data partitions, task definitions, and evaluation metrics. CFM-Bench provides a common substrate for evaluating the transferability of channel representations across models, domains, and tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布 CFM-Bench，一个面向信道基础模型（channel foundation models, CFMs）的统一多域、多任务基准，包含来自六个域的 157,900 个官方单帧样本，覆盖 3GPP 统计仿真、两条射线追踪管线、地面与空中测量以及同步车载多模态仿真。基准设计了减少时空泄漏的官方数据划分，并定义横跨 PHY、RAN 与 ISAC 的六组任务，包括 CSI 反馈、信道外推、传播状态分类、波束预测与定位。代表性实验表明相对模型性能会随数据域变化，凸显统一数据划分、任务定义与评估指标的重要性。
Motivation: 现有 CFM 通常在各自模型专属的评估流程中进行，数据、无线电配置、数据划分、适应流程、任务定义和指标各不相同，导致无法在 CFM 之间以及与任务特定网络之间进行可复现的比较。
Method: 构建统一的多域多任务基准，提供源特定接口以保留每个域中的复杂 CSI 与物理元数据，同时允许记录在案的模型专属预处理；官方划分隔离完整轨迹、测量会话、飞行、车辆链路、仿真实现或缓冲空间区域以减少时空泄漏；将基准划分排除在预训练之外，保留官方训练划分用于下游微调，并报告模型开发期间使用的数据。
Result: 摘要报告在 CSI 反馈、信道外推、当前波束预测和无线定位上的代表性实验提供了可复现的参考结果，并显示相对模型性能在不同数据域间存在差异。
Conclusion: CFM-Bench 为跨模型、域和任务评估信道表示的可迁移性提供了公共基础，强调共同数据划分、任务定义和评估指标的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SportD: How do VLMs physically strategize?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can describe a scene, but can they act well within one? We study whether VLMs can make sound strategic decisions, using soccer as an objective testbed with quantifiably-valued actions. We introduce SportD, a dataset and evaluation consisting of 1415 decision scenarios across professional men's and women's soccer games, where a VLM observes the seconds before a decision and chooses the next action. Models only select the optimal action around 30% of the time, even less frequently than humans do. Furthermore, they exhibit a clear preference for safer actions, favoring lower-variance, lower-value choices that also make less physical progress toward goal. Frontier VLMs are better at estimating whether an action will succeed, placing the highest-success-probability action among their top choices in 83-92% of cases. Yet VLMs systematically conflate likelihood with value, assigning higher value to actions that are more likely to succeed ($ρ$=+0.30 to +0.52), despite no such relationship in the ground truth ($ρ$=-0.08). The conservatism therefore reflects a mis-calibration of value. Replacing a single deliberation sentence with one that steers toward risk lifts the frontier models towards the real players' skills. SportD opens a new direction for rigorously evaluating physical strategic decision-making in VLMs, showing that careful decomposition of their choices can reveal the mechanisms underlying systematic biases such as risk aversion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型 (VLM) 是否能在具身场景中做出合理的策略决策，以足球比赛为客观测试环境，提出数据集 SportD。SportD 包含 1415 个来自职业男女足球比赛中的决策场景，模型在观察到决策前几秒的画面后选择下一步动作。摘要报告模型仅约 30% 的情况下选出最优动作，低于人类表现，且明显偏好低方差、低价值的保守动作。作者进一步发现 VLM 将成功概率与动作价值混淆，而通过风险偏向的提示词可提升前沿模型的表现。
Motivation: VLM 能够描述场景，但能否在场景中良好地行动尚不清楚。现有评估缺乏客观、可量化价值的策略决策测试平台，作者用足球作为测试床，因为其动作具有可量化的价值。
Method: 构建 SportD 数据集和评测框架，从职业男女足球比赛中提取 1415 个决策场景，让 VLM 观察决策前数秒的画面并选择下一步动作；同时分析模型对动作成功概率与价值的估计，并通过替换单句推理提示词来引导风险偏好。
Result: 模型仅在约 30% 的案例中选出最优动作，低于人类；前沿 VLM 在 83-92% 的案例中能将最高成功概率的动作排在候选前列。VLM 将更高的价值赋予更可能成功的动作（相关性 ρ=+0.30 至 +0.52），而真实数据中二者并无此关系（ρ=-0.08）。风险偏向的提示词可使前沿模型表现接近真实球员水平。
Conclusion: SportD 为严格评估 VLM 的物理策略决策提供了新方向；对模型选择的细致分解可揭示系统偏差（如风险厌恶）背后的机制，即价值校准错误。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ShortOPD: Recovering Pruned LLMs with Short-to-Long On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Structured pruning is a hardware-friendly way to compress LLMs, but it is mostly validated on multiple-choice recognition tasks, while the same compressed checkpoints can collapse on the free-form generation that deployment actually requires. Two observations trace this gap. First, greedy \textsc{pass}@$1$ nearly vanishes after compression, yet \textsc{pass}@$k$ recovers substantially under repeated sampling: useful generations are demoted, not erased. Second, the recoverable regime fails mainly through suffix repetition. Recovery should therefore train on the compressed model's own on-policy states with dense token-level supervision, which On-Policy Distillation (OPD) provides by reusing the pre-compression model as a frozen teacher. However, long on-policy rollouts spend early recovery budget on low-information repetitive suffixes, delaying loss descent. To mitigate this waste, we propose \textbf{\shortopd}, a short-to-long OPD schedule that detects teacher-confirmed repetitive suffixes, treats the surviving prefix as each rollout's effective length, and allocates future rollout budgets to the effective lengths the policy can currently use. Across math, code, and open-ended generation, \shortopd\ raises the compressed model's score to about $9\times$ its unrecovered value and $1.6$--$4.4\times$ standard recovery recipes (SFT w/o KD, KD, and SeqKD), and it matches a fixed $8192$-token rollout horizon within two points using a quarter of the training time ($8.5$ vs.\ $35.9$ hours) and $71\%$ fewer rollout tokens. We hope this recipe helps move structured pruning beyond marginal gains on perplexity and multiple-choice benchmarks, a step closer to deployment-ready generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ShortOPD（short-to-long on-policy distillation），一种用于恢复结构化剪枝后大语言模型（LLM）生成能力的训练方案。作者观察到压缩后模型的 pass@1 几乎消失但 pass@k 仍能恢复，且失败主要源于后缀重复，因此主张在压缩模型自身的 on-policy 状态上用冻结的原始模型做稠密 token 级蒸馏。ShortOPD 通过检测教师确认的重复后缀，把有效序列长度用于分配 rollout 预算，从而减少低信息重复后缀带来的训练浪费。
Motivation: 结构化剪枝虽然在硬件上友好，但已有验证多集中在多项选择识别任务上，压缩后的模型在自由形式生成任务上可能崩溃；作者认为现有恢复方法忽略了 on-policy 状态与稠密 token 级监督的重要性，且长 rollout 会把早期训练预算浪费在低信息量的重复后缀上。
Method: 提出 ShortOPD，一种短到长的 on-policy 蒸馏调度：复用压缩前模型作为冻结教师，检测教师确认的重复后缀，将幸存前缀视为每次 rollout 的有效长度，并把后续 rollout 预算分配给当前策略能有效利用的长度。
Result: 摘要报告在数学、代码和开放生成任务上，ShortOPD 可将压缩模型得分提高到未恢复值的约 9 倍，是标准恢复方案（SFT w/o KD、KD、SeqKD）的 1.6–4.4 倍；与固定 8192 token rollout 视界相比，训练时间从 35.9 小时降至 8.5 小时，并减少 71% 的 rollout token，得分差距在两点以内。
Conclusion: 作者希望该方案帮助结构化剪枝超越困惑度和多项选择基准上的边际收益，向部署可用的生成质量迈进。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RUBRIC: Realism--Utility Balanced Ranking for Imbalanced Classification
papers.abstract_en: Class imbalance poses a fundamental challenge in risk-sensitive applications such as fraud detection and medical diagnosis, where minority-class samples are scarce yet critical for accurate classification. Existing oversampling methods generate synthetic samples to rebalance class distributions; however, they often produce large numbers of low-quality candidates that distort decision boundaries or introduce artifacts, leading to overfitting and degraded generalization. In this work, we introduce RUBRIC, a generator-agnostic filtering framework that formulates synthetic sample selection as a quality-over-quantity optimization problem. RUBRIC ranks candidates using a realism-utility trade-off: realism is quantified by a learned discriminator that distinguishes real samples from synthetic samples, while utility captures proximity to the decision boundary through a concave margin-based scoring function. We show that, under mild regularity conditions, the proposed filtering strategy monotonically tightens the generalization bound for margin-based classifiers by jointly reducing distribution shift and suppressing near-negative tail contributions. Through extensive experiments on credit-card fraud detection and other imbalanced benchmarks, we demonstrate that RUBRIC improves F1-macro and recall while maintaining comparable ROC-AUC across several generators. We also provide explicit lambda-sensitivity analysis to show how users can recover AUPRC when ranking quality is prioritized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RUBRIC，一个与生成器无关 (generator-agnostic) 的合成样本过滤框架，将不平衡分类中的过采样问题转化为质量优先于数量的筛选优化。RUBRIC 通过真实感-效用权衡对候选样本排序，并在温和正则条件下证明该策略能单调收紧基于间隔分类器的泛化上界。在信用卡欺诈检测等不平衡基准上，RUBRIC 在多个生成器下提升 F1-macro 与召回率，同时保持接近的 ROC-AUC。
Motivation: 现有过采样方法会生成大量低质量合成样本，扭曲决策边界或引入伪影，导致过拟合与泛化退化；在欺诈检测和医学诊断等风险敏感场景中，少数类样本稀缺但分类错误代价高。
Method: RUBRIC 将合成样本选择建模为 quality-over-quantity 的优化问题：用学习到的判别器 (discriminator) 区分真实样本与合成样本来量化 realism，用基于凹的间隔 (margin-based) 评分函数度量样本到决策边界的 proximity 作为 utility，二者共同构成排序分数。
Result: 在温和正则条件下，该过滤策略通过联合减小分布偏移并抑制近负尾部的贡献，单调收紧基于间隔分类器的泛化界；在信用卡欺诈检测等多个不平衡基准上，RUBRIC 在多个生成器下提升 F1-macro 和召回率，并保持相当的 ROC-AUC。此外给出显式的 lambda 敏感性分析，说明用户如何在优先排序质量时恢复 AUPRC。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将合成样本选择视为质量-数量权衡的过滤问题，可以在不依赖特定生成器的情况下改善不平衡分类的泛化表现，并提供理论上的泛化界保证。

papers.title: HumanForge: A Human-Centric Deepfake Video Benchmark with Multi-Agent Forgery Rationales
papers.abstract_en: Rapid advancements in video diffusion models and temporal editing tools have enabled the generation of highly realistic human-centric videos, presenting unprecedented challenges to digital content forensics. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on face-swapping or global text-to-video synthesis, overlooking the crucial dimensions of multimodal alignment and complex human-object or human-human interactions. To address these limitations, we introduce HumanForge, a unified, large-scale, and multi-paradigm human-centric video forgery benchmark containing over 18,000 synthesized videos across four distinct scenarios: audio-driven, pose-driven, semantic-driven, and interaction. To construct and annotate this dataset without labor-intensive manual labeling or blind monolithic prompting, we propose Gen2Anno (Generation-to-Annotation), a cooperative multi-agent pipeline. Gen2Anno orchestrates six specialized agents-ranging from driving asset profiling to MoE-based reference analysis and closed-loop verification-to dynamically execute video synthesis and produce structured annotations containing binary authenticity labels, generative model attribution, and natural-language contrastive forgery rationales. By systematically contrasting expected states derived from generation provenance with actual visual observations, the framework generates logically grounded forensic reasoning chains. Extensive benchmarks using state-of-the-art traditional detectors and Vision-Language Models demonstrate the significant challenges of cross-generator generalization, perturbation robustness, and explainable reasoning on HumanForge. The code and dataset will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HumanForge，一个大规模、多范式的人像中心深度伪造视频基准，包含超过 18,000 个合成视频，覆盖音频驱动、姿态驱动、语义驱动和交互四类场景。作者同时提出 Gen2Anno，一个由六个专门智能体组成的协作式多智能体标注流程，用于自动生成包含二元真实性标签、生成模型归因和自然语言对比式伪造理由的结构化标注。基准测试表明现有传统检测器与视觉语言模型在跨生成器泛化、扰动鲁棒性和可解释推理方面仍面临显著挑战。
Motivation: 现有深度伪造基准主要关注换脸或全局文生视频，忽略了多模态对齐以及复杂的人-物、人-人交互维度，难以支撑数字内容取证对细粒度、可解释证据的需求。
Method: 提出 Gen2Anno 多智能体流水线，从驱动素材画像到基于 MoE 的参考分析再到闭环验证，动态执行视频合成；通过将生成来源 (generation provenance) 推导出的期望状态与实际视觉观察进行系统对比，生成立足逻辑的取证推理链。
Result: 摘要报告使用最先进的传统检测器和视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models）在 HumanForge 上进行大量基准实验，显示跨生成器泛化、扰动鲁棒性和可解释推理均构成显著挑战，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调该基准暴露了现有取证方法在多范式人像深度伪造与可解释威胁分析上的不足，并承诺公开代码与数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Classical Versus Deep Mirror-Symmetry Scoring: A Benchmark of Thirteen Methods
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying how mirror-symmetric an image is about a given axis (symmetry scoring) underpins applications from visual aesthetics to medical imaging, yet proposed scoring methods have never been compared on a common, statistically grounded protocol. We benchmark 13 scoring methods (9 collected from the literature; 4 introduced here) spanning from classical features to frozen deep features, across four single-axis and five multi-axis datasets under a reflection-exact protocol with a chance-anchored, significance-tested discrimination skill. Deep backbones perform best on single-axis and harder multi-axis protocols. However, a classical histogram-of-oriented-gradients (HOG) descriptor trails the best frozen-network readout by a small (but significant) margin, is not statistically separable from the runner-up (a CNN-filter measure), and runs $\sim$300$\times$ faster on CPU. Our results show that discrimination concentrates in mid-scale oriented features, where deep backbones peak at a low or mid stage, and HOG peaks at a mid cell size. Among existing methods, frozen deep features thus offer little over a tuned classical descriptor for measuring symmetry; whether task-trained deep scorers can do better remains open. We release the scorers and harness, in imgsym, an open toolkit for image symmetry detection and measurement.
papers.comment: v2: matches the published journal version; 24 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/maxwoe/imgsym
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对13种镜像对称评分方法（9种来自文献、4种新提出）进行了统一基准测试，方法覆盖经典特征到冻结深度特征，并在四个单轴和五个多轴数据集上使用反射精确协议（reflection-exact protocol）与机会锚定、显著性检验的判别技能进行评估。结果显示深度骨干在单轴和更困难的多轴协议上表现最佳，但经典HOG描述符与最佳冻结网络读出的差距很小且显著，并在CPU上快约300倍；判别信息集中在中等尺度定向特征上。
Motivation: 镜像对称性量化支撑视觉美学、医学成像等应用，但已有对称评分方法从未在共同的、具有统计可靠性的协议下进行过比较，缺乏统一的基准来评估不同方法的实际判别能力。
Method: 搭建包含13种评分方法的基准，其中9种收集自文献、4种为本工作新提出，方法从经典特征（如HOG）到冻结深度特征（frozen deep features）均有覆盖；采用反射精确协议，并以机会锚定（chance-anchored）、显著性检验的判别技能作为评估指标，在四个单轴与五个多轴数据集上比较。
Result: 深度骨干在单轴及更难的多轴协议上成绩最佳；经典HOG描述符比最佳冻结网络读出仅差一个很小但显著的幅度，且与第二名的CNN滤波器度量在统计上不可分离，但在CPU上快约300倍。深度骨干在低或中阶段特征达到峰值，HOG在中等单元尺寸达到峰值。
Conclusion: 在现有方法中，冻结深度特征相比经过调优的经典描述符在对称性测量上优势很小；任务训练（task-trained）的深度评分器能否做得更好仍属开放问题。作者发布了imgsym开源工具包，包含所评测的评分器与测试框架。

papers.title: TypeProbe: Recovering Type Representations from Hidden States of Pre-trained Code Models
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art code models achieve impressive performance, yet the extent to which they internally encode type information remains poorly understood. We probe the residual streams of pretrained code models for internal type representations using a parallel dataset of Java and Python code examples. Our results show that cross-lingual type representations emerge even from untyped code. Moreover, we test whether hidden states linearly encode the result type implied by typed function application by training probes on one language to infer argument and result types in the other. Finally, we find that this structure is partly robust to lexical perturbations and cross-language syntactic variations. To the best of our knowledge, prior work on interpretability of code models has not directly targeted formal type semantics or cross-lingual type representations. We release our code and datasets.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 12 figures. Accepted at ESSLLI 2026 (StuS; double-blind)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对预训练代码模型内部是否编码类型信息这一问题，使用Java和Python的并行数据集对模型残差流（residual streams）进行探针分析（probing）。结果显示跨语言类型表示甚至能从无类型代码中涌现，且在一种语言上训练的探针可以推断另一种语言的参数类型和结果类型；该结构对词汇扰动和跨语言句法变化具有一定鲁棒性。论文同时发布了代码与数据集。
Motivation: 最先进的代码模型性能虽强，但内部编码了多少类型信息仍不清楚；先前代码模型可解释性工作未直接针对形式类型语义或跨语言类型表示。
Method: 使用并行Java与Python代码示例，通过探针（probes）分析预训练代码模型的隐藏状态，检验隐藏状态是否线性编码类型应用所隐含的结果类型，并训练跨语言探针来推断另一种语言中的参数类型和结果类型。
Result: 摘要报告跨语言类型表示从无类型代码中涌现；在一种语言上训练的探针可推断另一种语言中的参数和结果类型；该结构部分鲁棒于词汇扰动和跨语言句法变化。
Conclusion: 论文强调其直接针对形式类型语义和跨语言类型表示，属于此前解释性工作未覆盖的方向，并公开代码与数据集。

papers.title: InfiniVerse: Occupancy Guided Unbounded Scene Generation for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Generating realistic, controllable, and temporally coherent urban environments is a critical yet unresolved challenge in the autonomous driving community. In this paper, we introduce InfiniVerse, a unified pipeline for long-range, 2D-3D-aligned, and controllable synthesis of dynamic urban scenes from a single frame. In practice, our approach first reconstructs a 3D occupancy representation from the input multi-view frame. This representation serves as a foundation for autoregressive scene extension along arbitrary trajectories. Subsequently, a video diffusion model translates the coarse occupancy grid into realistic, spatiotemporally consistent video sequences. Moreover, we propose a hierarchical sketch-and-refine paradigm, in which the generated videos are re-projected as image-conditioned feedback to enhance the 3D occupancy representation, establishing cross-modal alignment and mutual enhancement between the visual and spatial domains. Extensive evaluations on the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes demonstrate that InfiniVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance, with a FID of 6.4 and FVD of 67.97, significantly outperforming existing benchmarks in both duration and stability.
papers.comment: Paper accepted as poster at ECCV workshop SPAD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InfiniVerse，一种面向自动驾驶的从单帧多视角输入生成动态城市场景的统一框架。方法先重建 3D occupancy 表示，再沿任意轨迹进行自回归场景扩展，并通过视频扩散模型将粗粒度 occupancy 网格转换为时空一致视频；同时提出层次化 sketch-and-refine 范式，将生成视频重投影为图像条件反馈以增强 occupancy 表示，实现视觉与空间域的跨模态对齐。在 Waymo Open Dataset 和 nuScenes 上的评估显示，该方法取得 SOTA 性能，FID 为 6.4，FVD 为 67.97。
Motivation: 自动驾驶社区仍缺乏生成真实、可控、时间连贯的城市场景的有效方法，尤其是长距离范围的动态场景合成，这是一个关键且尚未解决的挑战。
Method: 首先从输入的多视角帧重建 3D occupancy 表示，作为沿任意轨迹自回归场景扩展的基础；随后用视频扩散模型将 occupancy 网格转换成逼真且时空一致的视频序列。此外，提出层次化 sketch-and-refine 范式，将生成视频重投影为图像条件反馈来增强 3D occupancy 表示，从而建立视觉域与空间域的相互增强。
Result: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 和 nuScenes 上的广泛评估表明，InfiniVerse 取得了 SOTA 性能，FID 为 6.4，FVD 为 67.97，在生成时长和稳定性方面显著优于现有基准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作实现了从单帧输入进行长距离、2D-3D 对齐且可控的动态城市场景合成，并通过跨模态对齐与反馈机制统一了 occupancy 表示和视频生成。
