papers.title: Adaptive Stopping for Multi-Turn LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on multi-turn reasoning and interaction, such as adaptive retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and ReAct-style agents, to answer difficult questions. These methods improve accuracy by iteratively retrieving information, reasoning, or acting, but introduce a key challenge: \textbf{When should the model stop?} Existing approaches rely on heuristic stopping rules or fixed turn budgets and provide no formal guarantees that the final prediction still contains the correct answer. This limitation is particularly problematic in high-stakes domains such as finance and healthcare, where unnecessary turns increase cost and latency, while stopping too early risks incorrect decisions. Conformal prediction (CP) provides formal coverage guarantees, but existing LLM-CP methods only apply to a single model output and cannot handle multi-turn pipelines with adaptive stopping. To address this gap, we propose Multi-Turn Language Models with Conformal Prediction (MiCP), the first CP framework for multi-turn reasoning. MiCP allocates different error budgets across turns, enabling the model to stop early while maintaining an overall coverage guarantee. We demonstrate MiCP on adaptive RAG and ReAct, where it achieves the target coverage on both single-hop and multi-hop question answering benchmarks while reducing the number of turns, inference cost, and prediction set size. We further introduce a new metric that jointly evaluates coverage validity and answering efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多轮 LLM 推理（如 adaptive RAG 与 ReAct 智能体）中“何时停止”缺乏形式化保证的问题，提出 MiCP（Multi-Turn Language Models with Conformal Prediction），据称是首个面向多轮推理的共形预测（conformal prediction）框架。MiCP 在不同轮次间分配误差预算，使模型能在维持整体覆盖率保证的前提下提前停止，并在单跳与多跳问答基准上达到目标覆盖率，同时减少轮次数、推理成本与预测集大小。作者还引入了一个联合评估覆盖率有效性与回答效率的新指标。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖启发式停止规则或固定轮数预算，无法形式化保证最终预测仍包含正确答案；而现有多轮 LLM 与共形预测（LLM-CP）结合的方法只适用于单次模型输出，无法处理带自适应停止的多轮流水线。该问题在金融、医疗等高风险领域尤为突出：轮次过多增加成本与延迟，过早停止则可能导致错误决策。
Method: 提出 MiCP，首个用于多轮推理的共形预测框架，通过在不同轮次间分配不同的误差预算（error budget），使模型能够提前停止同时保持整体的覆盖率保证（coverage guarantee）。方法在 adaptive RAG 和 ReAct 两种多轮流水线上进行验证。
Result: 在单跳（single-hop）和多跳（multi-hop）问答基准上，MiCP 达到目标覆盖率，同时减少了轮次数（number of turns）、推理成本以及预测集大小（prediction set size）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MiCP 填补了多轮推理自适应停止缺乏形式化保证的研究空白，并引入一个新的联合评估指标，用于同时衡量覆盖率有效性和回答效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BUZZY: Contrastive Scoring to Mitigate Text-Induced Bias in Multimodal Multiple-Choice QA
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) provides a standardized and objectively measurable setting for evaluating vision-language models (VLMs). However, because the MCQA format incorporates the candidate choices into the input context, it introduces several unintended biases. Previous work has primarily focused on structural biases, such as preferences for certain choices. Instead, we argue that the choices act as textual priors, causing models to favor linguistically plausible options regardless of the visual content. We hypothesize and empirically verify that a model genuinely relies on visual evidence only when its multimodal distribution significantly diverges from its text-only distribution. Based on this observation we propose BUZZY,a training-free decoding method that corrects multimodal predictions by subtracting the text-only distribution. Experiments with five VLMs on five multimodal MCQA benchmarks demonstrate that BUZZY achieves the highest average accuracy among state-of-the-art methods while reducing inference latency by over 28% compared to prior contrastive decoding approaches. Overall, these results suggest that amplifying the visual signal by penalizing text-only preferences is key to efficient and robust multimodal MCQA reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BUZZY，一种无需训练的对比解码 (contrastive decoding) 方法，通过从多模态预测分布中减去纯文本分布来校正预测，从而缓解多选题候选选项作为文本先验 (textual prior) 引发的偏差。作者假设并验证，只有当多模态分布与纯文本分布显著分歧时，模型才真正依赖视觉证据。实验在五个 VLM 和五个多模态多选题问答 (MCQA) 基准上取得最高平均准确率，并将推理延迟降低超过 28%。
Motivation: 多模态多选题问答把候选选项并入输入上下文，会引入多种非预期偏差；已有工作主要关注结构偏好，而本文指出选项本身充当文本先验，使模型偏向语言上合理的选项而忽略视觉内容。作者由此提出假设：模型仅在多模态分布与纯文本分布显著不同时才真正使用视觉证据。
Method: 基于该假设提出 BUZZY，一种训练无关的推理时解码方法，核心是在预测时减去文本-only 分布，以惩罚语言先验并放大视觉信号。
Result: 在五个视觉语言模型和五个多模态 MCQA 基准上，BUZZY 的平均准确率超过现有 state-of-the-art 方法，且相较此前对比解码方法，推理延迟降低 28% 以上。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过惩罚文本-only 偏好来放大视觉信号，是实现高效且鲁棒的多模态 MCQA 推理的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CVT-Bench: Probing Spatial-State Integrity through Counterfactual Viewpoint Transformations
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) perform strongly on isolated spatial tasks, but whether their predictions remain persistent and mutually coherent across viewpoints and competing scenes is unclear. We formalize this behavioral property as spatial-state integrity and introduce CVT-Bench, a factorial diagnostic suite spanning two domains (CVT-Synthetic, CVT-Real), four context regimes (CVT-Isolated, irrelevant filler, attribute filler, CVT-Competing), three representations (Image, Text/BBox, Scene Graph), and ten viewpoint conditions (nine azimuths from $0^\circ$ to $360^\circ$ at $45^\circ$ increments, plus Top) with target views withheld. Across 200 scenes and 11,833 relational queries, we measure counterfactual accuracy, cycle consistency, the normalized survival coefficient, spatial realizability, and context-specific interference. Five state-of-the-art MLLMs exhibit rapid persistence loss and frequently produce jointly unrealizable states despite high local accuracy, with failures amplified by competing contexts and natural-scene complexity. Matched irrelevant and attribute filler controls show that prompt length, position, or loss of scene access alone are insufficient explanations. On average, Text/BBox improves accuracy, persistence, and realizability, while Scene Graph provides complementary gains; neither eliminates the instability. Thus, isolated spatial accuracy substantially overestimates robustness, establishing spatial-state integrity as a distinct evaluation target. The complete benchmark and codebase will be publicly released.
papers.comment: Reframed CVT-Bench around spatial-state integrity, added real-world benchmark derived from 3dSGG, context controls and other minor changes. 21 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Project page: https://shanmukha-here.github.io/CVT-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CVT-Bench，一个用于探测多模态大语言模型（MLLM）空间状态完整性（spatial-state integrity）的因子化诊断基准，通过反事实视角变换检验预测在不同视角与竞争场景下是否持续且相互一致。基准覆盖两个域（CVT-Synthetic、CVT-Real）、四种上下文条件、三种表征、十个视角条件，共 200 个场景、11,833 个关系查询。摘要报告五个 SOTA MLLM 均出现快速持久性丢失，并频繁产生整体不可实现（unrealizable）的状态；Text/BBox 表征能改善准确性、持久性与可实现性，Scene Graph 提供互补增益，但两者均未消除不稳定性。
Motivation: MLLM 在孤立空间任务上表现强，但其预测能否跨视角和竞争场景保持持久且相互一致尚不明确；现有评估可能高估了模型的鲁棒性。
Method: 构建因子化诊断套件 CVT-Bench，包含 CVT-Synthetic 与 CVT-Real 两个域，CVT-Isolated、无关填充、属性填充、CVT-Competing 四种上下文，Image、Text/BBox、Scene Graph 三种表征，以及九个方位角与俯视共十个视角条件并隐藏目标视角；测量反事实准确率、循环一致性、归一化存活系数、空间可实现性和上下文特定干扰。
Result: 五个 SOTA MLLM 在局部准确率较高的情况下表现出快速持久性丢失，并频繁产生联合不可实现的状态；竞争上下文和自然场景复杂度会放大失败。匹配的无关填充与属性填充对照表明，提示长度、位置或场景访问丢失不足以解释失效。Text/BBox 平均提升准确率、持久性与可实现性，Scene Graph 提供互补增益，但两者均无法消除不稳定性。
Conclusion: 孤立空间准确率显著高估了模型鲁棒性，空间状态完整性应作为独立的评估目标；完整基准与代码将公开发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bridging Network Fragmentation: A Semantic-Augmented DRL Framework for UAV-aided VANETs
papers.abstract_en: Urban Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks (VANETs) can become fragmented because buildings obstruct wireless links and vehicle mobility continuously changes the network topology. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) can serve as mobile relays, but Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-based deployment often suffers from inefficient exploration because it lacks road-topology guidance. To address this problem, we propose Semantic-Augmented DRL (SA-DRL), which models network fragmentation over the road topology and aligns a pretrained Large Language Model (LLM) to generate a topology-dependent action prior from dynamic traffic states. The resulting Semantic-Augmented PPO (SA-PPO) algorithm combines this prior with the PPO policy through Logit Fusion, guiding exploration toward promising intersections while retaining adaptation through environmental returns. Simulations driven by real-world urban trajectories show that SA-PPO reaches the final converged reward of Vanilla PPO using only 28.6% of its training episodes. It improves the average number of vehicles in connected components and the average connected-component size by 7.9% and 8.7%, respectively, while reducing UAV energy consumption by 21.3%.
papers.comment: Revised version. This update includes substantial improvements to the methodology, ablation studies, temporal robustness analysis, and cross-city generalization experiments. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Cognitive Communications and Networking. 15 pages, 14 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对城市车载自组织网络 (VANET) 因建筑物遮挡和车辆移动导致的网络碎片化问题，提出语义增强的深度强化学习框架 SA-DRL。该方法将网络碎片化建模到道路拓扑上，并利用预训练大语言模型 (LLM) 从动态交通状态生成拓扑相关的动作先验，再通过 Logit Fusion 将其与 PPO 策略结合，提出 SA-PPO 算法。基于真实城市轨迹的仿真表明，SA-PPO 仅用 Vanilla PPO 28.6% 的训练回合即达到其最终收敛奖励，同时提升了连接性能并降低 UAV 能耗。
Motivation: 城市 VANET 中建筑物会遮挡无线链路，车辆移动又持续改变拓扑，导致网络碎片化；UAV 可作为移动中继，但基于深度强化学习 (DRL) 的部署因缺乏道路拓扑引导而探索效率低下。
Method: 提出 Semantic-Augmented DRL (SA-DRL)，在道路拓扑上建模网络碎片化，并将预训练 LLM 对齐到动态交通状态以生成拓扑相关的动作先验；该先验通过 Logit Fusion 与 PPO 策略融合，将探索引导至有前景的交叉口，同时保留环境回报驱动的适应性。
Result: 在真实城市轨迹驱动的仿真中，SA-PPO 以 Vanilla PPO 28.6% 的训练回合达到其最终收敛奖励；平均连通组件内车辆数提升 7.9%，平均连通组件规模提升 8.7%，UAV 能耗降低 21.3%。
Conclusion: 本文表明利用道路拓扑和 LLM 语义先验可以显著加速 DRL 在 UAV 辅助 VANET 中的训练并改善网络连通性；修订版补充了消融实验、时间鲁棒性分析和跨城市泛化实验，并已投稿至 IEEE Transactions on Cognitive Communications and Networking。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Systematic Comparison of Training Objectives for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is critical in safety-sensitive applications. While this challenge has been addressed from various perspectives, the influence of training objectives on OOD behavior remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we present a systematic comparison of four widely used training objectives: Cross-Entropy Loss, Prototype Loss, Triplet Loss, and Average Precision (AP) Loss, spanning probabilistic, prototype-based, metric-learning, and ranking-based supervision, for OOD detection in image classification under standardized OpenOOD protocols. Within the evaluated ResNet-18/OpenOOD setting and objective-specific OOD scoring rules, Cross-Entropy Loss, Prototype Loss, and AP Loss achieve comparable in-distribution accuracy, while Cross-Entropy Loss provides the most consistent near- and far-OOD AUROC overall; the other objectives can be competitive in specific settings.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Uncertainty Quantification for Computer Vision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了四种常用训练目标——交叉熵损失 (Cross-Entropy Loss)、原型损失 (Prototype Loss)、三元组损失 (Triplet Loss) 和平均精度损失 (Average Precision Loss)——对图像分类中分布外 (OOD) 检测性能的影响，在标准化的 OpenOOD 协议和 ResNet-18 架构下进行评估。结果显示交叉熵损失、原型损失和 AP 损失在分布内准确率上相近，而交叉熵损失总体上提供最一致的近端/远端 OOD AUROC，其他目标在特定设置下也能具有竞争力。
Motivation: OOD 检测对安全敏感应用至关重要，但训练目标如何影响 OOD 行为的研究相对不足，现有工作多从其他角度切入，缺乏对目标函数的系统对照。
Method: 在统一 OpenOOD 协议下，以 ResNet-18 为骨干，对四类监督范式（概率式、原型式、度量学习式、排序式）的典型损失函数进行标准化比较，并为各目标配套相应的 OOD 评分规则。
Result: 在所评估的 ResNet-18/OpenOOD 设置中，交叉熵损失、原型损失和 AP 损失达到可比的分布内准确率；交叉熵损失在近端和远端 OOD 的 AUROC 上总体最一致，其余目标仅在特定设置下有竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调交叉熵损失在整体 OOD 检测表现上具有优势，但其他训练目标在特定场景中仍可与之竞争，结论受限于所评估的 ResNet-18/OpenOOD 设定及各目标配对的评分规则。

papers.title: Point-Supervised Skeleton-Based Human Action Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Skeleton-based temporal action segmentation is a fundamental yet challenging task, playing a crucial role in enabling intelligent systems to perceive and respond to human activities. While fully-supervised methods achieve satisfactory performance, they require costly frame-level annotations and are sensitive to ambiguous action boundaries. To address these issues, we introduce a point-supervised framework for skeleton-based action segmentation, where only a single frame per action segment is labeled. We leverage multimodal skeleton data, including joint, bone, and motion information, encoded via a pretrained unified model to extract rich feature representations. To generate reliable pseudo-labels, we propose a novel prototype similarity method and integrate it with two existing methods: energy function and constrained K-Medoids clustering. Multimodal pseudo-label integration is proposed to enhance the reliability of the pseudo-label and guide the model training. We establish new benchmarks on PKU-MMD (X-Sub and X-View), MCFS-22, and MCFS-130, and implement baselines for point-supervised skeleton-based human action segmentation. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves competitive performance, even surpassing some fully-supervised methods while significantly reducing annotation effort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种点级监督的基于骨架的时间动作分割框架，每个动作片段只需标注一帧。利用多模态骨架数据（关节、骨骼、运动信息）经预训练统一模型编码，提出原型相似度方法并结合能量函数和约束 K-Medoids 聚类生成伪标签，再通过多模态伪标签集成提升可靠性。在 PKU-MMD (X-Sub, X-View)、MCFS-22 和 MCFS-130 上建立新基准，实验表明其性能与部分全监督方法相当甚至更优，同时显著降低标注成本。
Motivation: 全监督的骨架动作分割需要昂贵的逐帧标注，且对模糊动作边界敏感。为降低标注成本，本文引入仅需每个动作片段一个标注帧的点级监督框架。
Method: 利用预训练的统一模型编码关节、骨骼和运动等多模态骨架信息；提出原型相似度方法生成伪标签，并与能量函数和约束 K-Medoids 聚类两种现有方法集成；通过多模态伪标签集成提高伪标签可靠性并指导模型训练。
Result: 在 PKU-MMD (X-Sub 和 X-View)、MCFS-22 和 MCFS-130 上建立新基准并实现基线。实验表明该方法达到有竞争力的性能，甚至超过部分全监督方法，同时显著减少标注工作量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调点级监督能在大幅降低标注成本的同时取得与全监督相当甚至更优的性能，为基于骨架的动作分割提供了一种高效的弱监督方案。

papers.title: The Expressive Limits of Diagonal SSMs for State-Tracking
papers.abstract_en: State-Space Models (SSMs) have recently been shown to achieve strong empirical performance on a variety of long-range sequence modeling tasks while remaining efficient and highly-parallelizable. However, the theoretical understanding of their expressive power remains limited. In this work, we study the expressivity of input-Dependent Complex-valued Diagonal (DCD) SSMs on sequential state-tracking tasks. We show that single-layer DCD SSMs cannot express state-tracking of any non-Abelian group at finite precision. More generally, we show that $k$-layer DCD SSMs can express state-tracking of a group if and only if that group has a subnormal series of length $k$, with Abelian factors. That is, we identify the precise expressivity range of $k$-layer DCD SSMs within the solvable groups. Empirically, we find that multi-layer models often fail to learn state-tracking for non-Abelian groups, highlighting a gap between expressivity and learnability.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论角度研究输入依赖的复值对角状态空间模型（input-dependent Complex-valued Diagonal SSMs, DCD SSMs）在序列状态跟踪任务上的表达能力。作者证明单层 DCD SSM 在有限精度下无法表达任何非阿贝尔群的状态跟踪；更一般地，k 层 DCD SSM 能表达某个群的状态跟踪当且仅当该群具有长度为 k、且各因子为阿贝尔群的次正规列（subnormal series）。实验发现多层模型在非阿贝尔群上往往无法学会状态跟踪，说明表达力与可学习性之间存在差距。
Motivation: 状态空间模型（SSM）在长程序列建模上表现优异且高效可并行化，但其表达能力缺乏理论刻画。本文旨在精确定位 DCD SSM 在状态跟踪类任务上的表达极限。
Method: 对 DCD SSM 进行形式化表达能力分析，利用群论中的次正规列和阿贝尔因子来刻画 k 层模型所能表达的状态跟踪群类别，并辅以针对非阿贝尔群的实验观察。
Result: 定理表明单层 DCD SSM 无法表达任何非阿贝尔群；k 层 DCD SSM 可表达某群当且仅当其具有长度 k、阿贝尔因子的次正规列。实验显示多层模型在非阿贝尔群上常训练失败，体现表达力与可学习性之间的差距。
Conclusion: 该工作将 k 层 DCD SSM 的表达范围精确限定在可解群（solvable groups）之内，并强调理论上可表达并不代表实际可学习。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 本文从理论角度研究输入依赖的复值对角状态空间模型（input-dependent Complex-valued Diagonal SSMs, DCD SSMs）在序列状态跟踪任务上的表达能力。作者证明单层 DCD SSM 在有限精度下无法表达任何非阿贝尔群的状态跟踪；更一般地，k 层 DCD SSM 能表达某个群的状态跟踪当且仅当该群具有长度为 k、且各因子为阿贝尔群的次正规列（subnormal series）。实验发现多层模型在非阿贝尔群上往往无法学会状态跟踪，说明表达力与可学习性之间存在差距。

papers.title: Global Interpretability via Automated Preprocessing: A Framework Inspired by Psychiatric Questionnaires
papers.abstract_en: Psychiatric questionnaires are highly context sensitive and often only weakly predict subsequent symptom severity, which makes the prognostic relationship difficult to learn. Although flexible nonlinear models can improve predictive accuracy, their limited interpretability can erode clinical trust. In fields such as imaging and omics, investigators commonly address visit- and instrument-specific artifacts by extracting stable signal through preprocessing and then fitting an interpretable linear model. We adopt the same strategy for questionnaire data by decoupling preprocessing from prediction: REFINE (Redundancy-Exploiting Follow-up-Informed Nonlinear Enhancement) uses follow-up information to learn a nonlinear, item-aligned preprocessing of baseline measurements, and then maps these stabilized baseline items to future severity through a linear coefficient matrix. This construction constrains where nonlinearity enters rather than restricting the end-to-end predictive function class, allowing the prognostic relationship to remain globally interpretable through a single coefficient matrix rather than through post hoc local attributions. In the population, the resulting predictor recovers the Bayes-optimal conditional mean, so global linear interpretability does not require sacrificing nonlinear predictive flexibility. In experiments, REFINE outperforms other interpretable approaches while preserving clear global attribution of prognostic factors across psychiatric and non-psychiatric longitudinal prediction tasks.
papers.comment: R code is available at https://github.com/ericstrobl/REFINE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REFINE（Redundancy-Exploiting Follow-up-Informed Nonlinear Enhancement）框架，面向精神病学问卷数据，把预处理与预测解耦：利用随访信息学习基线测量值的非线性、条目对齐预处理，再通过线性系数矩阵将稳定后的基线条目映射到未来严重程度。摘要称在总体水平上该方法能恢复贝叶斯最优条件均值，因此在保持全局线性可解释性的同时不牺牲非线性预测灵活性。实验表明，REFINE 在精神病学与非精神病学的纵向预测任务上优于其他可解释方法，并保留清晰的全局归因。
Motivation: 精神病学问卷高度依赖情境，往往只能较弱地预测后续症状严重程度，使得预后关系难以学习；灵活的非线性模型虽能提升预测精度，但其有限的可解释性会削弱临床信任。
Method: 借鉴影像和组学中通过预处理提取稳定信号再拟合可解释线性模型的策略，REFINE 使用随访信息学习基线的非线性、条目对齐预处理，然后通过线性系数矩阵完成对未来严重程度的预测；该构造将非线性限制在预处理阶段，而不是限制端到端的预测函数类。
Result: 摘要报告，在总体水平上该预测器可恢复贝叶斯最优条件均值；在精神病学和非精神病学纵向预测任务中，REFINE 优于其他可解释方法，同时保持对预后因素的清晰全局归因。
Conclusion: 通过将预处理与预测解耦，全局线性可解释性不必以牺牲非线性预测灵活性为代价。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Global-Local Dual Perception for MLLMs in High-Resolution Text-Rich Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: Text Image Machine Translation (TIMT) aims to translate text embedded in images in the source-language into target-language, requiring synergistic integration of visual perception and linguistic understanding. Existing TIMT methods, whether cascaded pipelines or end-to-end multimodal large language models (MLLMs),struggle with high-resolution text-rich images due to cluttered layouts, diverse fonts, and non-textual distractions, resulting in text omission, semantic drift, and contextual inconsistency. To address these challenges, we propose GLoTran, a global-local dual visual perception framework for MLLM-based TIMT. GLoTran integrates a low-resolution global image with multi-scale region-level text image slices under an instruction-guided alignment strategy, conditioning MLLMs to maintain scene-level contextual consistency while faithfully capturing fine-grained textual details. Moreover, to realize this dual-perception paradigm, we construct GLoD, a large-scale text-rich TIMT dataset comprising 510K high-resolution global-local image-text pairs covering diverse real-world scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GLoTran substantially improves translation completeness and accuracy over state-of-the-art MLLMs, offering a new paradigm for fine-grained TIMT under high-resolution and text-rich conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GLoTran，一种用于基于多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的高分辨率文本丰富图像翻译 (TIMT) 的全局-局部双视觉感知框架。它结合低分辨率全局图像与多尺度区域级文本图像切片，通过指令引导的对齐策略，使 MLLM 同时保持场景级上下文一致性和细粒度文本细节。作者还构建了包含 510K 高分辨率全局-局部图文对的 GLoD 数据集，实验表明相比现有 MLLM 显著提升翻译完整性和准确性。
Motivation: 现有 TIMT 方法（无论是级联流水线还是端到端 MLLM）在处理高分辨率、文本密集图像时，因布局杂乱、字体多样和非文本干扰，容易出现文本遗漏、语义漂移和上下文不一致问题。
Method: GLoTran 采用全局-局部双视觉感知：将低分辨率全局图像与多尺度区域级文本图像切片结合，在指令引导的对齐策略下训练 MLLM，兼顾场景级上下文与细粒度文本细节。同时构造 GLoD 数据集，包含 510K 高分辨率全局-局部图文对，覆盖多种真实场景，以支撑该双感知范式。
Result: 大量实验表明，GLoTran 在翻译完整性和准确性上显著超过最先进的 MLLM，为高分辨率、文本密集条件下的细粒度 TIMT 提供了新范式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调全局-局部双感知与大规模数据构建相结合，可缓解高分辨率文本密集图像翻译中的文本遗漏与上下文不一致问题；摘要未提及具体局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NAST: Improving Negation Handling in Medical Vision-Language Models through Negation-Aware Selective Training
papers.abstract_en: Negation is a fundamental linguistic operation in clinical reporting, yet vision-language models (VLMs) frequently fail to distinguish affirmative from negated medical statements. To systematically characterize this limitation, we introduce a radiology-specific diagnostic benchmark that evaluates polarity sensitivity under controlled clinical conditions, revealing that common medical VLMs consistently confuse negated and non-negated findings. To enable learning beyond simple condition absence, we further construct a contextual clinical negation dataset that encodes structured claims and supports attribute-level negations involving location and severity. Building on these resources, we propose Negation-Aware Selective Training (NAST), an interpretability-guided adaptation method that uses causal tracing effects (CTEs) to modulate layer-wise gradient updates during fine-tuning. Rather than applying uniform learning rates, NAST scales each layer's update according to its causal contribution to negation processing, transforming mechanistic interpretability signals into a principled optimization rule. Experiments demonstrate improved discrimination of affirmative and negated clinical statements without degrading general vision-language alignment, highlighting the value of causal interpretability for targeted model adaptation in safety-critical medical settings. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/healthylaife/NAST.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 在临床报告中对否定表述识别不佳的问题，引入放射学专用的极性敏感诊断基准和上下文临床否定数据集，并提出 Negation-Aware Selective Training (NAST)，一种基于因果追踪效应 (CTEs) 按层调节梯度更新的微调方法。实验显示该方法提升了对肯定与否定临床陈述的区分能力，同时不损害通用视觉-语言对齐。
Motivation: 否定是临床报告中的基本语言操作，但现有医学 VLM 经常无法区分肯定与否定的医学陈述，在受控临床条件下系统性混淆否定与非否定发现，这对安全关键的临床场景构成风险。
Method: 作者首先构建放射学诊断基准以刻画极性敏感性，并构造支持属性级否定（如位置和严重程度）的上下文临床否定数据集；然后提出 NAST，利用因果追踪效应 (causal tracing effects, CTEs) 调制微调中逐层的梯度更新，使各层更新幅度与其对否定处理的因果贡献成比例。
Result: 实验表明 NAST 改善了模型对肯定与否定临床陈述的判别能力，同时没有降低通用视觉-语言对齐性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调因果可解释性可用于安全关键医学场景下 VLM 的定向适配，并公开了代码和资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LatentAM: Real-Time, Large-Scale Latent Gaussian Attention Mapping via Online Dictionary Learning
papers.abstract_en: We present LatentAM, an online 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) mapping framework that builds scalable latent feature maps from streaming RGB-D observations for open-vocabulary robotic perception. Instead of distilling high-dimensional Vision-Language Model (VLM) embeddings using model-specific decoders, LatentAM proposes an online dictionary learning approach that is both model-agnostic and pretraining-free, enabling plug-and-play integration with different VLMs at test time. Specifically, our approach associates each Gaussian primitive with a compact query vector that can be converted into approximate VLM embeddings using an attention mechanism with a learnable dictionary. The dictionary is initialized efficiently from streaming observations and optimized online to adapt to evolving scene semantics under trust-region regularization. To scale to long trajectories and large environments, we further propose an efficient map management strategy based on voxel hashing, where optimization is restricted to an active local map on the GPU, while the global map is stored and indexed on the CPU to maintain bounded GPU memory usage. Experiments on public benchmarks and a large-scale custom dataset demonstrate that LatentAM attains significantly better feature reconstruction fidelity compared to state-of-the-art methods, while achieving near-real-time speed (12-35 FPS) on the evaluated datasets. Our project page, including the code, is available at: https://junwoonlee.github.io/projects/LatentAM
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for RA-L. Homepage: https://junwoonlee.github.io/projects/LatentAM/ Code: https://github.com/UMich-SSI-Lab/latentam
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LatentAM，一个基于在线 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 的地图构建框架，从流式 RGB-D 观测构建可扩展的潜在特征地图，用于开放词汇机器人感知。方法用在线字典学习替代模型特定的 VLM 嵌入蒸馏，使框架模型无关且无需预训练；结合基于体素哈希的地图管理，将优化限制在 GPU 上的活动局部地图，保持 GPU 内存有界。在公共基准和大型自定义数据集上，特征重建保真度优于现有方法，速度达到 12-35 FPS 的近实时水平。
Motivation: 现有将 VLM 嵌入蒸馏到 3D 地图的方法依赖模型特定解码器，难以在测试时即插即用地切换不同视觉语言模型，且长轨迹和大规模环境下的内存与优化开销高。
Method: 为每个高斯原语关联一个紧凑查询向量，通过带可学习字典的注意力机制近似 VLM 嵌入；字典从流式观测初始化并在线优化，使用信任域正则化适应场景语义演化；地图管理基于体素哈希，GPU 仅优化活动局部地图，全局地图存储并索引在 CPU 上。
Result: 在公共基准和大型自定义数据集上，相比最先进方法特征重建保真度显著更高，并达到 12-35 FPS 的近实时速度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调模型无关且免预训练的在线字典学习，结合活跃局部地图优化，可以支持大规模长轨迹下的实时开放词汇 3D 感知地图构建。

papers.title: Learning Perceptual Representations for Gaming NR-VQA with Multi-Task FR Signals
papers.abstract_en: No-reference video quality assessment (NR-VQA) for gaming videos is challenging due to limited human-rated datasets and unique content characteristics including fast motion, stylized graphics, and compression artifacts. We present MTL-VQA, a multi-task learning framework that uses full-reference (FR) quality metrics as supervisory signals to learn perceptually meaningful features without human labels during pretraining. By jointly optimizing multiple complementary proxy FR objectives with adaptive task weighting, our approach learns shared representations that transfer effectively to downstream NR-VQA. Experiments on gaming video datasets show that MTL-VQA achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art methods in both mean opinion score-supervised and label-efficient or self-supervised settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MTL-VQA，一个用于游戏视频无参考质量评估（NR-VQA）的多任务学习框架，利用全参考（FR）质量指标作为监督信号，在预训练阶段无需人工标注即可学习感知上有意义的特征。通过自适应任务加权联合优化多个互补的代理 FR 目标，框架学习到可迁移到下游 NR-VQA 的共享表示。在游戏视频数据集上的实验表明，MTL-VQA 在 MOS 监督以及标签高效或自监督设置下均取得与最先进方法竞争的性能。
Motivation: 游戏视频的 NR-VQA 因人工评分数据集有限，且内容具有快速运动、风格化图形和压缩伪影等独特特性而充满挑战。作者希望解决缺少人工标签时如何学习感知特征的问题。
Method: 提出 MTL-VQA 多任务学习框架，使用 FR 质量指标作为预训练监督信号；通过自适应任务加权联合优化多个互补的代理 FR 目标，学习共享表示并迁移到下游 NR-VQA 任务。
Result: 在游戏视频数据集上的实验显示，MTL-VQA 在 mean opinion score 监督设置以及标签高效或自监督设置下均达到与最先进方法竞争的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用 FR 信号进行多任务预训练可以学习感知上有意义的表示，从而缓解游戏视频 NR-VQA 中人工标签稀缺的问题。

papers.title: ArGEnT: Arbitrary Geometry-encoded Transformer for Operator Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning solution operators on arbitrary geometries remains a central challenge in scientific machine learning, especially for many-query simulation, physics-informed learning, and evolving geometries requiring accurate, geometry-aware predictions at arbitrary spatial locations. Existing operator-learning methods often rely on structured discretizations, explicit geometry parameterizations, or point-cloud formulations that couple geometric representation with solution-query sampling, limiting flexibility on irregular and non-parameterized domains. We propose the Arbitrary Geometry-encoded Transformer (ArGEnT), a geometry-conditioned attention framework that decouples geometry encoding from query-point evaluation. We develop three variants: self-attention, cross-attention, and hybrid-attention. ArGEnT can be used independently or integrated with neural operators to incorporate non-geometric physical inputs. In the cross-attention variant, geometry is represented by an independently sampled point cloud used to construct keys and values, while arbitrary solution-query points construct queries. This design enables mesh-independent field prediction, reduces sensitivity to query-point distribution, and allows compact geometric representations to condition large-scale solution evaluations. Across benchmarks in fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and electrochemical systems, ArGEnT consistently improves accuracy and generalization over standard DeepONet, point-cloud-based operator learning, and geometry-aware transformer baselines. In several cases, it reduces prediction errors by more than an order of magnitude while requiring substantially lower training cost than transformer-based baselines. These results demonstrate that decoupled geometry-query attention provides an accurate, scalable, and flexible framework for operator learning on arbitrary geometries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArGEnT（Arbitrary Geometry-encoded Transformer），一种将几何编码与查询点评估解耦的几何条件注意力框架，用于任意几何上的算子学习。论文开发了自注意力、交叉注意力和混合注意力三种变体，可独立使用或与神经算子集成以纳入非几何物理输入。在流体动力学、固体力学和电化学系统基准上，ArGEnT 相比 DeepONet、基于点云的算子学习和几何感知 Transformer 基线持续提升精度与泛化，多个案例中预测误差降低一个数量级以上且训练成本更低。
Motivation: 现有算子学习方法常依赖结构化离散化、显式几何参数化或点云公式，这些方法将几何表示与解查询采样耦合，限制了在不规则和非参数化域上的灵活性。
Method: 提出几何条件注意力框架 ArGEnT，将几何编码与查询点评估解耦；在交叉注意力变体中，用独立采样的点云表示几何并构造键和值，任意解查询点构造查询，从而支持网格无关的场预测并将紧凑几何表示用于大规模解评估。
Result: 摘要报告在流体动力学、固体力学和电化学系统基准上，ArGEnT 相对 DeepONet、基于点云的算子学习和几何感知 Transformer 基线持续提升精度与泛化，若干情况下误差降低一个数量级以上，同时训练成本显著低于基于 Transformer 的基线。
Conclusion: 摘要认为解耦几何-查询注意力为任意几何上的算子学习提供了准确、可扩展且灵活的方法，但未提及明确局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Resource-Efficient RGB-Only Action Recognition for Edge Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Resource-constrained assistive monitoring requires compact local video perception and an explicit understanding of how recognition reliability changes under common visual degradation. We present a compact RGB-only action-recognition network that combines an X3D-style hierarchy with temporal shift, a 3D Universal Inverted Bottleneck, Ghost pointwise convolutions, factorized depthwise operators, selective temporal adaptation, and parameter-free attention. The model attains 95.10/98.31% on NTU RGB+D 60 (X-Sub/X-View) and 90.88/92.66% on NTU RGB+D 120 (X-Sub/X-Set) with only 0.96-0.99M parameters. To connect compact deployment with assistive use, we evaluate frozen checkpoints without retraining on the datasets' official Medical Conditions groups while retaining the original 60-/120-way decision spaces. Medical macro recall reaches 93.19/97.93% on NTU60 and 91.47/91.48% on NTU120. Under controlled Level-2 visual stress on NTU60 X-Sub, medical recall drops by 1.77 points under low light, 2.23 under motion blur, 4.87 under crop perturbation, and 19.05 under occlusion; among the four selected Level-2 perturbations, occlusion causes the largest observed degradation. On Jetson Orin Nano, the TensorRT FP16 engine occupies 5.30 MiB, demonstrating strong static compactness but not throughput superiority. The results position the model as a compact perception component for lower-rate assistive monitoring, rather than as a complete clinical or robotic system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向资源受限的辅助监控场景，提出一个紧凑的纯 RGB 动作识别网络，组合了 X3D 风格层级、时间平移 (temporal shift)、3D Universal Inverted Bottleneck、Ghost pointwise 卷积、分解深度可分离算子、选择性时间适配和无参数注意力。作者报告该模型在 NTU RGB+D 60 上达到 95.10/98.31%（X-Sub/X-View），在 NTU RGB+D 120 上达到 90.88/92.66%（X-Sub/X-Set），参数量仅 0.96-0.99M；并在不重训练的情况下用冻结 checkpoint 评测官方 Medical Conditions 分组，同时研究了常见视觉退化下的识别可靠性。
Motivation: 资源受限的辅助监控需要紧凑的本地视频感知，同时需要明确理解识别可靠性在常见视觉退化（如低光、运动模糊、裁剪、遮挡）下如何变化，这是现有紧凑动作识别工作较少系统覆盖的问题。
Method: 提出一种结合 X3D 风格层级与多种轻量化算子（temporal shift、3D Universal Inverted Bottleneck、Ghost pointwise 卷积、分解 depthwise 算子、选择性时间适配、无参数注意力）的紧凑 RGB 动作识别网络；在此基础上，直接用冻结 checkpoint（保留原始 60/120 类决策空间）评测 Medical Conditions 分组，并在 NTU60 X-Sub 上施加四类 Level-2 视觉扰动来刻画可靠性变化。
Result: 摘要报告 NTU60 上 95.10/98.31%、NTU120 上 90.88/92.66% 的准确率，参数量 0.96-0.99M；Medical macro recall 在 NTU60 为 93.19/97.93%，NTU120 为 91.47/91.48%。在 NTU60 X-Sub 的 Level-2 扰动下，medical recall 分别下降 1.77（低光）、2.23（运动模糊）、4.87（裁剪扰动）和 19.05 个百分点（遮挡），其中遮挡退化最大。在 Jetson Orin Nano 上 TensorRT FP16 引擎仅占 5.30 MiB，体现出较好的静态紧凑性，但未宣称吞吐优势。
Conclusion: 作者将该模型定位为面向低速率辅助监控的紧凑感知组件，而非完整的临床或机器人系统；摘要未声称该方法在吞吐或全面可靠性上超越现有方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A Unified Assessment of the Poverty of the Stimulus Argument for Neural Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Several recent contributions have evaluated the Poverty of the Stimulus Hypothesis (PoSH) using Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). The results suggest that ANN-based language models can acquire certain structure-dependent generalizations from limited input without structural inductive biases of the type traditionally hypothesized by linguists. However, existing studies have largely focused on individual phenomena and adopted different evaluation protocols, leaving it unclear whether previous findings generalize across phenomena and learning conditions. We introduce \poshbench, a unified benchmark covering four canonical PoS phenomena. Training Transformer, LSTM, and n-gram models, we find that ANN-based models can achieve above-chance generalization from surprisingly limited input (10M words), but they show less efficient learning than children as input scale grows. Moreover, cognitively motivated inductive biases substantially improve broad syntactic competence but do not consistently translate to PoS-relevant generalization. Our findings provide systematic evidence challenging the claim that innate syntax is the only possible route to generalization, while suggesting that human-like learning efficiency requires inductive biases beyond those implemented here.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的基准 PoSHBench，覆盖四个经典的刺激贫乏 (Poverty of the Stimulus, PoS) 现象，用以评估神经网络语言模型能否从有限输入中习得结构依赖的概括。作者在统一协议下训练 Transformer、LSTM 和 n-gram 模型，发现这些模型能从约 10M 词这样有限的输入中实现高于偶然水平的泛化，但随着输入规模增大，其学习效率不如儿童。文章还报告了认知动机型归纳偏置的效果，并以此系统性地反驳“天赋句法”是概括唯一路径的主张。
Motivation: 已有的关于刺激贫乏假说 (PoSH) 的神经网络研究大多集中于单个语言现象并采用不同的评估协议，导致无法判断既有结论是否在不同现象和学习条件下具有普遍性。
Method: 引入统一的基准测试集 PoSHBench，涵盖四个经典的 PoS 现象，并在相同评测协议下训练 Transformer、LSTM 和 n-gram 模型进行比较，同时检验认知动机型归纳偏置的作用。
Result: 基于 ANN 的模型在仅 10M 词的有限输入下即可实现高于偶然水平的泛化，但当输入规模增大时，其学习效率低于儿童；认知动机型归纳偏置能显著提升总体句法能力，却并未一致地转化为 PoS 相关泛化上的改善。
Conclusion: 该研究提供了系统性证据，挑战了“先天句法知识是泛化唯一可行路径”的论断，同时说明要实现类似人类的学习效率，还需要超出当前所实现归纳偏置之外的其他机制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AtomBridge: Agentic VLA Inference Plugin for Long-Horizon Tasks in Scientific Experiments
papers.abstract_en: Robotic laboratories play a critical role in autonomous scientific discovery by enabling scalable, continuous experimental execution. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a promising foundation for robotic laboratories. However, scientific experiments typically involve long-horizon tasks composed of multiple atomic tasks. Existing VLA models may fail to perform composed tasks formed by reordering and composing these known atomic actions. This limitation can arise from a skill-chaining gap caused by robot-state mismatch: the terminal robot state of one skill can fall outside the valid initial-state distribution of the next. To address this challenge, we propose AtomBridge, an Agentic VLA Inference Plugin for Long-Horizon Tasks in Scientific Experiments. AtomBridge attaches at inference time to a VLA policy already fine-tuned on atomic tasks, while keeping its weights fixed. At each task boundary, it uses LLM-based transition reasoning and robotic-action code generation to insert transitional actions between consecutive tasks. This plug-and-play design mitigates the skill-chaining gap caused by robot-state mismatch without additional VLA fine-tuning or demonstrations of composed long-horizon sequences. Across scientific manipulation sequences in simulation and a real-world experimental environment, AtomBridge improves execution continuity and per-step atomic-task success. On 8-step composed tasks, AtomBridge improves full-sequence success by 10%~25%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AtomBridge，一个推理时附加的 Agentic VLA 推理插件，用于科学实验中长视界（long-horizon）任务的技能链式拼接。作者指出，现有 VLA 模型能执行原子任务，但由已知原子动作重排组合成的任务可能失败，原因可能是机器人状态失配造成的技能链式缺口（skill-chaining gap），即前一技能的终止状态落在下一技能有效初始状态分布之外。AtomBridge 在不改动已微调 VLA 权重、也不额外微调或提供组合长序列演示的情况下，在任务边界用 LLM 进行过渡推理并生成机器人动作代码，插入过渡动作。在仿真与真实实验环境中的科学操作序列上，该方法改善了执行连续性和逐步原子任务成功率，8 步组合任务的全序列成功率提升 10%~25%。
Motivation: 机器人实验室需要可扩展、连续地执行科学实验，但科学实验通常是由多个原子任务组成的长视界任务；现有 VLA 模型可能无法完成由已知原子动作重排组合而成的任务，这种失败可能源于机器人状态失配导致的技能链式缺口。
Method: AtomBridge 是一种推理时插件，附加在已经过原子任务微调的 VLA 策略上并保持其权重固定；在每个任务边界，它使用基于 LLM 的过渡推理和机器人动作代码生成，在连续任务之间插入过渡动作，采用即插即用设计来缓解技能链式缺口。
Result: 在仿真和真实实验环境的科学操作序列上，AtomBridge 提升了执行连续性和每步原子任务成功率；对于 8 步组合任务，全序列成功率相对提升 10%~25%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，该即插即用设计无需额外的 VLA 微调或组合长序列演示，即可缓解由机器人状态失配引起的技能链式缺口。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 AtomBridge，一个推理时附加的 Agentic VLA 推理插件，用于科学实验中长视界（long-horizon）任务的技能链式拼接。作者指出，现有 VLA 模型能执行原子任务，但由已知原子动作重排组合成的任务可能失败，原因可能是机器人状态失配造成的技能链式缺口（skill-chaining gap），即前一技能的终止状态落在下一技能有效初始状态分布之外。AtomBridge 在不改动已微调 VLA 权重、也不额外微调或提供组合长序列演示的情况下，在任务边界用 LLM 进行过渡推理并生成机器人动作代码，插入过渡动作。在仿真与真实实验环境中的科学操作序列上，该方法改善了执行连续性和逐步原子任务成功率，8 步组合任务的全序列成功率提升 10%~25%。
summary_sections.motivation: 机器人实验室需要可扩展、连续地执行科学实验，但科学实验通常是由多个原子任务组成的长视界任务；现有 VLA 模型可能无法完成由已知原子动作重排组合而成的任务，这种失败可能源于机器人状态失配导致的技能链式缺口。
summary_sections.method: AtomBridge 是一种推理时插件，附加在已经过原子任务微调的 VLA 策略上并保持其权重固定；在每个任务边界，它使用基于 LLM 的过渡推理和机器人动作代码生成，在连续任务之间插入过渡动作，采用即插即用设计来缓解技能链式缺口。
summary_sections.result: 在仿真和真实实验环境的科学操作序列上，AtomBridge 提升了执行连续性和每步原子任务成功率；对于 8 步组合任务，全序列成功率相对提升 10%~25%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，该即插即用设计无需额外的 VLA 微调或组合长序列演示，即可缓解由机器人状态失配引起的技能链式缺口。

papers.title: Semantically Labelled Automata for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with LTL Instructions
papers.abstract_en: We study multi-task reinforcement learning (RL), a setting in which an agent learns a single, universal policy capable of generalising to arbitrary, possibly unseen tasks. We consider tasks specified as linear temporal logic (LTL) formulae, which are commonly used in formal methods to specify properties of systems, and have recently been successfully adopted in RL. In this setting, we present a novel task embedding technique leveraging a new generation of semantic LTL-to-automata translations, originally developed for temporal synthesis. The resulting semantically labelled automata contain rich, structured information in each state that allow us to (i) compute the automaton efficiently on-the-fly, (ii) extract expressive task embeddings used to condition the policy, and (iii) naturally support full LTL. Experimental results in a variety of domains demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance and is able to scale to complex specifications where existing methods fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究以线性时序逻辑 (LTL) 公式指定任务的多任务强化学习 (multi-task RL)，提出一种利用新一代语义 LTL-to-automata 翻译的任务嵌入技术。所得语义标注自动机 (semantically labelled automata) 在每个状态携带丰富结构化信息，支持在线上高效计算自动机、抽取表达性任务嵌入以条件化策略，并完整支持 LTL。实验表明该方法在多种域上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并能扩展到现有方法失败的复杂规范。
Motivation: 多任务 RL 需要单一通用策略泛化到任意甚至未见过的任务，而 LTL 公式是描述系统性质的常用形式化方法，近年已被用于 RL。作者希望让策略更好地利用 LTL 任务的结构化语义，以提升泛化能力和可扩展性。
Method: 提出一种新的任务嵌入技术，基于为时序综合 (temporal synthesis) 开发的语义 LTL-to-automata 翻译构建语义标注自动机。该自动机支持在线上高效按需计算，并能从中提取丰富的任务嵌入来条件化策略，且天然支持完整的 LTL 规范。
Result: 在多个域的实验中，该方法达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并能扩展到复杂规范，而现有方法在这些规范上失败。
Conclusion: 作者强调语义标注自动机结合高效的自动机构建方式，使 LTL 指令下的多任务 RL 能够处理复杂规范；摘要未提及具体数值或消融细节。

papers.title: PEFT-MuTS: A Multivariate Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Framework for Remaining Useful Life Prediction based on Cross-domain Time Series Representation Model
papers.abstract_en: The application of data-driven remaining useful life (RUL) prediction has long been constrained by the availability of large amount of degradation data. Mainstream solutions such as domain adaptation and meta-learning still rely on large amounts of historical degradation data from equipment that is identical or similar to the target, which imposes significant limitations in practical applications. This study investigates PEFT-MuTS, a Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning framework for few-shot RUL prediction, built on cross-domain pre-trained time-series representation models. Contrary to the widely held view that knowledge transfer in RUL prediction can only occur within similar devices, we demonstrate that substantial benefits can be achieved through pre-training process with large-scale cross-domain time series datasets. A independent feature tuning network and a meta-variable-based low rank multivariate fusion mechanism are developed to enable the pre-trained univariate time-series representation backbone model to fully exploit the multivariate relationships in degradation data for downstream RUL prediction task. Additionally, we introduce a zero-initialized regressor that stabilizes the fine-tuning process under few-shot conditions. Experiments on aero-engine and industrial bearing datasets demonstrate that our method can achieve effective RUL prediction even when less than 1\% of samples of target equipment are used. Meanwhile, it substantially outperforms conventional supervised and few-shot approaches while markedly reducing the data required to achieve high predictive accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/fuen1590/PEFT-MuTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PEFT-MuTS，一个基于跨域预训练时间序列表示模型的参数高效微调（PEFT）框架，用于少样本剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测。作者认为RUL预测中的知识迁移不必局限于相似设备，通过在大型跨域时间序列数据集上预训练，可以在目标设备样本极少（<1%）的情况下实现有效预测。方法包括独立的特征微调网络、基于元变量的低秩多元融合机制以及零初始化回归器，并在航空发动机和工业轴承数据集上验证了效果。
Motivation: 数据驱动的RUL预测长期受限于大量退化数据的可获得性，主流方法如域适应和元学习仍依赖目标设备相同或相似设备的大量历史退化数据，限制了实际应用。
Method: 构建跨域预训练的单变量时间序列表示主干模型，并通过独立的特征微调网络和基于元变量的低秩多元融合机制，使预训练模型能利用退化数据中的多元关系；同时引入零初始化回归器以稳定少样本条件下的微调过程。
Result: 在航空发动机和工业轴承数据集上，使用不到1%的目标设备样本即可实现有效的RUL预测，并显著优于传统监督方法和少样本方法，同时大幅减少达到高预测精度所需的数据量。
Conclusion: 作者证明跨域大规模时间序列预训练能为RUL预测带来显著收益，挑战了知识迁移只能发生在相似设备之间的传统观点；代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Semantic Differentiation for Tackling Challenges in Watermarking Low-Entropy Constrained Generation Outputs
papers.abstract_en: We demonstrate that while the current approaches for language model watermarking are effective for open-ended generation, they are inadequate at watermarking LM outputs for constrained generation tasks with low-entropy output spaces. Therefore, we devise SeqMark, a sequence-level watermarking algorithm with semantic differentiation that balances output quality, watermark detectability, and imperceptibility. It improves on the shortcomings of token-level watermarking algorithms that cause under-utilization of the sequence-level entropy available for constrained generation tasks. Moreover, we identify and improve upon the problem of region collapse, a different failure mode associated with prior sequence-level watermarking algorithms. This occurs because the pseudorandom partitioning of semantic space for watermarking in these approaches causes all high-probability outputs to collapse into either invalid or valid regions, leading to a trade-off in output quality and watermarking effectiveness. Instead, SeqMark differentiates the high-probable output subspace and partitions it into valid and invalid regions, ensuring the even spread of high-quality outputs among all the regions. On various constrained generation tasks like machine translation, abstractive summarization, and code generation, SeqMark substantially improves watermark detection accuracy (up to 28% increase in F1) while maintaining high generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有语言模型水印方法在开放生成上有效，但在机器翻译、摘要、代码生成等低熵约束生成任务上检测不足。作者提出 SeqMark，一种序列级水印算法，利用语义区分（semantic differentiation）将高概率输出子空间划分为合法/非法区域，避免 token 级方法未充分利用序列级熵，并修复序列级方法中高概率输出坍缩到单一区域的问题。在多种约束生成任务上，SeqMark 显著提升水印检测 F1（最高提升 28%），同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: 现有水印方法主要面向开放生成，低熵约束生成任务中可用熵较少，token 级水印算法难以有效嵌入和检测；此前序列级水印算法则存在 region collapse 问题，导致高概率输出坍缩到合法或非法区域，不得不在输出质量与水印有效性之间取舍。
Method: 提出 SeqMark，一种序列级水印算法；它通过语义区分将高概率输出子空间与其余输出空间区分开，并把这个高概率子空间划分为合法与非法区域，使高质量输出在各区域均匀分布，从而更充分地利用约束生成任务中可用的序列级熵。
Result: 在机器翻译、抽象式摘要和代码生成等多种约束生成任务上，摘要报告 SeqMark 将水印检测 F1 最高提升 28%，同时维持较高的生成质量。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，序列级的语义区分能有效改善低熵约束生成场景下的水印检测，并解决先前序列级水印方法中 region collapse 所带来的输出质量与检测效果之间的权衡。

papers.title: Where Does Vision Meet Language? Understanding and Refining Visual Fusion in MLLMs via Contrastive Attention
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in vision-language understanding, yet how they internally integrate visual and textual information remains poorly understood. To bridge this gap, we perform a systematic layer-wise masking analysis across multiple architectures, revealing how visual-text fusion evolves within MLLMs. The results show that fusion emerges at several specific layers rather than being uniformly distributed across the network, and certain models exhibit a late-stage "review" phenomenon where visual signals are reactivated before output generation. Besides, we further analyze layer-wise attention evolution and observe persistent high-attention noise on irrelevant regions, along with gradually increasing attention on text-aligned areas. Guided by these insights, we introduce a training-free contrastive attention framework that models the transformation between early fusion and final layers to highlight meaningful attention shifts. Extensive experiments across various MLLMs and benchmarks validate our analysis and demonstrate that the proposed approach improves multimodal reasoning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 进行逐层掩码分析，考察视觉与文本信息在模型内部如何融合。研究发现融合发生在若干特定层而非全网均匀分布，且某些模型在输出生成前存在视觉信号被重新激活的后期"复习"现象。作者进一步分析逐层注意力演化，观察到无关区域持续存在高注意力噪声、文本对齐区域注意力逐渐增强，并据此提出无需训练的对比注意力框架 (contrastive attention framework)，在多种 MLLM 与基准上提升了多模态推理性能。
Motivation: MLLMs 在视觉-语言理解任务上进展显著，但其内部如何整合视觉与文本信息仍缺乏理解，该问题对解释和优化多模态模型具有重要意义。
Method: 提出跨多种架构的系统性逐层掩码分析，并分析逐层注意力演化；基于观测到的融合层分布与注意力噪声模式，设计一个训练免费的对比注意力框架，用于建模早期融合层与最终层之间的注意力变换以突出有意义的转移。
Result: 摘要报告在多种 MLLMs 和基准上的广泛实验验证了分析结论，并表明所提方法能提升多模态推理性能；摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 作者强调视觉-文本融合在 MLLMs 中集中于特定层并伴随后期"复习"现象，基于这些洞察的对比注意力框架无需训练即可改善推理性能。

papers.title: Edit2Restore:Few-Shot Image Restoration via Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Pre-trained Editing Models
papers.abstract_en: Image restoration has traditionally required training specialized models on thousands of paired examples per degradation type. Large pre-trained text-conditioned image editing models encode rich priors about image structure, quality, and degradation, yet we find that this knowledge does not, on its own, make them restorers: state-of-the-art editing models largely fail at restoration in the zero-shot regime. We show that what these priors lack is not capability but direction, and that a small amount of parameter-efficient adaptation supplies it. Fine-tuning LoRA adapters on FLUX.1 Kontext, a 12B-parameter flow matching model for image-to-image translation, with only 32--128 paired images per task and guided by simple text prompts, we turn a mediocre zero-shot editor into a competitive restorer. A single unified adapter, conditioned on task-specific prompts, handles five diverse degradations. Despite using three to four orders of magnitude less data, our few-shot model surpasses a recent restoration baseline trained on over a million curated pairs on the majority of perceptual and distribution-level metrics, on which we evaluate in keeping with our focus on perceptual rather than pixel-fidelity quality. Through comprehensive studies, we analyze the impact of training-set size, the trade-off between task-specific and unified multi-task adapters, the effect of text encoder adaptation, and zero-shot baseline performance, establishing pre-trained editing models as a compelling, data-efficient foundation for few-shot, prompt-guided image restoration.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Edit2Restore，利用预训练图像编辑模型 FLUX.1 Kontext（12B 参数的 flow matching 模型）通过参数高效适配 (LoRA) 实现少样本图像恢复。仅用每任务 32–128 张配对图像和简单文本提示，即可将零样本下表现不佳的编辑模型转化为有竞争力的恢复器，且一个统一适配器可处理五种退化。相比在超过百万对图像上训练的基线，该方法数据量少三到四个数量级，并在多数感知与分布级指标上超过该基线。
Motivation: 传统图像恢复需要为每种退化类型训练数千配对样本的专用模型。大型预训练文本条件编辑模型虽然编码了丰富的图像结构与质量先验，但在零样本恢复中基本失效；作者认为这些先验缺少的不是能力而是方向。
Method: 在 FLUX.1 Kontext 图像到图像模型上微调 LoRA 适配器，使用任务特定提示和每任务 32–128 张配对图像。通过任务特定提示条件约束，单个统一适配器处理五种不同的退化；作者还系统分析了训练集大小、任务特定与统一多任务适配器的权衡、文本编码器适配的影响以及零样本基线表现。
Result: 在大多数感知指标和分布级指标上，该少样本模型超越了基于超过一百万对高质量配对图像训练的近期恢复基线，且训练数据量减少三到四个数量级。评估重点在感知质量而非像素保真。
Conclusion: 研究将预训练编辑模型确立为少样本、提示引导图像恢复的数据高效基础。摘要强调评估侧重于感知质量而非像素保真，未明确讨论其他局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Implicit Bias and Invariance: How Hopfield Networks Efficiently Learn Graph Orbits
papers.abstract_en: Many learning problems are organized by group symmetries. While invariance is often imposed through architectures or group averaging, we ask when it can emerge from training on a finite random subset of an orbit. We study this question in classical Hopfield networks, where strict memorization can be expressed as a linear margin problem. Reparameterizing minimization of energy flow (MEF) as an exponential loss connects gradient descent to the corresponding minimum-norm hard-margin memorizer. Our main result shows that, for independent uniform samples from any finite permutation orbit, the exact sample hard-margin support vector machine (HSVM) concentrates exponentially around the invariant full-orbit HSVM. Consequently, an orbit-size-independent polynomial number of samples suffices both for approximate parameter invariance and for simultaneous memorization of every orbit element; directional convergence transfers this conclusion asymptotically to MEF gradient descent. For graph-isomorphism orbits, we characterize the invariant parameters as a three-dimensional subspace and show that every such orbit is memorizable. For cliques of fixed linear density, additional symmetry sharpens the uniform memorization bound to $O(v^4\log(1/δ))$, exponentially smaller than the orbit size. Together with experiments across several learning rules, these results give a finite-sample account of how optimization bias can recover symmetry from partial group-structured data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究经典 Hopfield 网络中，仅从有限随机轨道子集训练能否自发涌现群对称不变性。作者将能量流最小化 (MEF) 重参数化为指数损失，从而把梯度下降与最小范数硬间隔记忆器联系起来。主要结论是：对任意有限置换轨道的独立均匀采样，样本硬间隔支持向量机 (HSVM) 会以指数速度集中于不变的全轨道 HSVM，因此与轨道规模无关的多项式样本量足以同时实现近似参数不变性和对所有轨道元素的记忆。对于图同构轨道，不变参数构成三维子空间；对固定线性密度的团，均匀记忆界可收紧为 O(v^4 log(1/δ))，远小于轨道规模。
Motivation: 许多学习问题受群对称性组织，不变性通常通过架构或群平均强制引入；本文关注不变性能否仅从轨道的有限随机子集训练中自然产生，这是一个此前缺乏有限样本刻画的问题。
Method: 以经典 Hopfield 网络为对象，将严格记忆表达为线性间隔问题；通过把能量流最小化 (MEF) 重参数化为指数损失，将梯度下降对应到最小范数硬间隔记忆器。随后分析样本 HSVM 向全轨道不变 HSVM 的指数浓度，并对图同构轨道的参数空间结构进行刻画，同时用多种学习规则的实验进行验证。
Result: 摘要报告：对任意有限置换轨道，独立均匀采样的样本 HSVM 以指数方式集中于不变的全轨道 HSVM；与轨道规模无关的多项式样本量足够实现近似参数不变性与对所有轨道元素的记忆。方向性收敛将该结论渐近地推广到 MEF 梯度下降。对固定线性密度的团，均匀记忆界可强化为 O(v^4 log(1/δ))，比轨道规模指数级更小。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果给出了优化偏差如何从部分群结构化数据中恢复对称性的有限样本解释，并证明图同构意义下的每个轨道都是可记忆的。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: INFORM-CT: INtegrating LLMs and VLMs FOR Incidental Findings Management in Abdominal CT
papers.abstract_en: Incidental findings in CT scans, though often benign, can have significant clinical implications and should be reported following established guidelines. Traditional manual inspection by radiologists is time-consuming and variable. This paper proposes a novel framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) and foundational vision-language models (VLMs) in a plan-and-execute agentic approach to improve the efficiency and precision of incidental findings detection, classification, and reporting for abdominal CT scans. Given medical guidelines for abdominal organs, the process of managing incidental findings is automated through a planner-executor framework. The planner, based on LLM, generates Python scripts using predefined base functions, while the executor runs these scripts to perform the necessary checks and detections, via VLMs, segmentation models, and image processing subroutines. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through experiments on a CT abdominal benchmark for three organs, in a fully automatic end-to-end manner. Our results show that the proposed framework outperforms existing pure VLM-based approaches in terms of accuracy and efficiency.
papers.comment: Spotlight presentation at the 9th International Conference on Medical Imaging with Deep Learning (MIDL) 2026 Additional code and implementation details available at https://idan-tankel.github.io/InformCT_ProjectPage/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合大语言模型（LLM）与基础视觉语言模型（VLM）的规划-执行（plan-and-execute）代理框架，用于自动检测、分类和报告腹部CT扫描中的偶然发现（incidental findings）。规划器基于LLM生成使用预定义基础函数的Python脚本，执行器运行脚本并调用VLM、分割模型及图像处理子程序完成检查。在腹部CT基准上针对三个器官的全自动端到端实验中，该方法在准确性和效率上优于纯VLM方法。
Motivation: CT扫描中的偶然发现虽常为良性，但可能有重要临床意义，需按既定指南报告；放射科医生的人工检查耗时且存在观察者间差异，因此需要更高效、更精准的自动化管理流程。
Method: 提出自动化偶然发现管理的规划-执行框架：基于LLM的规划器依据腹部器官医学指南生成Python脚本，脚本调用预定义基础函数；执行器运行这些脚本，通过VLM、分割模型和图像处理子程序完成必要的检查与检测，从而实现从指南到报告的端到端自动化。
Result: 在CT腹部基准上对三个器官进行全自动端到端评估，结果显示该框架在准确性和效率两方面均优于现有纯VLM方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这种以LLM作规划、VLM及图像处理作执行的代理式框架能够提升腹部CT偶然发现检测、分类和报告流程的效率与精度。

papers.title: A Configuration-First Framework for Reproducible, Low-Code Localization
papers.abstract_en: As machine learning (ML) increasingly underpins critical applications, credible, comparable, and repeatable experimental results become more important. Everyday workflows should make rigorous experiment specification and controlled execution the default while allowing advanced experimentation when required. In practice, researchers still have to combine tools for configuration, execution, versioning, and evaluation, and repeat common implementation work within their application domain. In this paper, we present a configuration-first design for application-specific ML experimentation frameworks and implement it as LOCALIZE for radio-localization research. Experiments are declared in human-readable configuration files, a workflow orchestrator executes isolated stages with explicit inputs and outputs, and code, data, configurations, environment specifications, and generated artifacts are versioned. LOCALIZE provides preconfigured datasets, processing stages, model-development procedures, and experiment templates while retaining access to the underlying pipeline. Through a qualitative comparison and controlled quantitative studies comparing LOCALIZE with corresponding Jupyter notebook and Kedro implementations, we show that, within the studied localization workflows, LOCALIZE requires fewer codebase edits for changes supported by its localization-specific functionality, while total wall-clock time and peak memory usage remain comparable. In a controlled scaling experiment covering 1x, 5x, and 10x the base dataset volume, we observed sublinear growth in total CPU and wall time over the tested sizes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向特定应用领域 ML 实验的配置优先 (configuration-first) 设计，并实现为无线电定位研究框架 LOCALIZE。实验以人类可读配置文件声明，工作流编排器执行带显式输入输出的隔离阶段，并对代码、数据、配置、环境与产物进行版本管理。作者通过与 Jupyter notebook 和 Kedro 实现的对比研究，表明在定位工作流中 LOCALIZE 需要更少的代码库修改，而总墙钟时间与峰值内存相当；在数据集规模 1x、5x、10x 的扩展实验中，总 CPU 与墙钟时间呈次线性增长。
Motivation: ML 实验需要可信、可比且可重复的结果，但研究者在实践中仍需自行组合配置、执行、版本化和评估工具，并在应用领域内重复大量实现工作，缺乏面向领域工作流的默认规范化实验流程。
Method: 构建配置优先的 ML 实验框架 LOCALIZE：实验用人类可读配置文件声明，由工作流编排器执行输入输出显式的隔离阶段，并对代码、数据、配置、环境规格和生成产物统一版本化；同时提供预配置数据集、处理阶段、模型开发流程和实验模板，且保留对底层管道的访问。
Result: 在与 Jupyter notebook 和 Kedro 的定量对比中，LOCALIZE 对框架支持的变更需要更少的代码库编辑，总墙钟时间和峰值内存相当；在覆盖 1x、5x、10x 基础数据集规模的受控扩展实验中，总 CPU 和墙钟时间呈次线性增长。
Conclusion: 作者认为配置优先设计能在不牺牲执行效率的前提下减少领域内实验改动成本，但其结论限定在所研究的无线电定位工作流范围内。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Lost in Phonation: Voice Quality Variation as an Evaluation Dimension for Speech Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Speech Foundation Models (SFMs) enable direct processing of raw audio, allowing models to respond to subtle paralinguistic variation. However, how these models interpret non-lexical cues remains largely unstudied. We introduce VQ-Bench, a controlled evaluation suite featuring a parallel dataset of synthesized modal, breathy, creaky, and end-creak phonation types. We evaluate SFM sensitivity through open-ended generation across four ecologically valid domains, alongside speech emotion recognition. Our results reveal performance gaps: while a leading commercial API failed basic biometric sanity checks, other models exhibited systematic shifts in agency, empathy, and leadership based on phonation. Our findings also highlight gender asymmetries in salary and leadership endorsements, demonstrating that SFMs may mirror or amplify human social biases. This work establishes a reproducible framework for ensuring responsible paralinguistic interpretation in speech-based AI.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, accepted at Interspeech 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VQ-Bench，一个用于评估语音基础模型 (SFM) 对非词汇语音质量变化（如气声、嘎裂声、结尾嘎裂声）敏感性的受控基准，包含合成平行数据集并在四个生态有效领域进行开放式生成评估以及语音情感识别。结果显示不同模型对发声类型表现出系统性差异，例如代理性、共情和领导力判断随发声类型变化，并出现性别不对称的薪资和领导力认可偏差，揭示 SFM 可能镜像或放大人类社会偏见。
Motivation: 语音基础模型能够直接处理原始音频并对细微副语言变化做出反应，但这些模型如何解释非词汇线索（如发声类型）仍未被充分研究，本文旨在填补这一评估空白并建立可复现的责任化副语言理解框架。
Method: 构建 VQ-Bench 评估套件，使用合成的平行数据集包含 modal、breathy、creaky 和 end-creak 四种发声类型，通过开放式生成（覆盖四个生态有效领域）和语音情感识别任务评估 SFM 的敏感性。
Result: 摘要报告发现性能差距：一个领先的商业 API 未能通过基础生物特征合理性检查，而其他模型在代理性、共情和领导力上随发声类型出现系统性偏移；同时发现薪资和领导力认可中的性别不对称，表明 SFM 可能镜像或放大人类社会偏见。
Conclusion: 该工作确立了可复现的评估框架，用于确保基于语音的 AI 中副语言解释的负责任性。

papers.title: Redefining Generalization in Visual Domains: A Two-Axis Framework for Fake Image Detection with FusionDetect
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of generative models has made it increasingly crucial to develop detectors that can reliably detect synthetic images. Although most of the work has now focused on cross-generator generalization, we argue that this viewpoint is too limited. Detecting synthetic images involves another equally important challenge: generalization across visual domains. To bridge this gap,we present the OmniGen Benchmark. This comprehensive evaluation dataset incorporates 12 state-of-the-art generators, providing a more realistic way of evaluating detector performance under realistic conditions. In addition, we introduce a new method, FusionDetect, aimed at addressing both vectors of generalization. FusionDetect draws on the benefits of two frozen foundation models: CLIP & Dinov2. By deriving features from both complementary models,we develop a cohesive feature space that naturally adapts to changes in both thecontent and design of the generator. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that FusionDetect delivers not only a new state-of-the-art, which is 3.87% more accurate than its closest competitor and 6.13% more precise on average on established benchmarks, but also achieves a 4.48% increase in accuracy on OmniGen,along with exceptional robustness to common image perturbations. We introduce not only a top-performing detector, but also a new benchmark and framework for furthering universal AI image detection. The code and dataset are available at http://github.com/amir-aman/FusionDetect
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新定义虚假图像检测中的泛化问题，指出现有工作只关注跨生成器泛化，而忽略了跨视觉域泛化的同等重要性。作者提出 OmniGen 基准，包含 12 个最新生成器用于更真实的评测，并引入 FusionDetect 方法，利用两个冻结的基础模型 CLIP 与 Dinov2 的特征构建统一特征空间。实验表明 FusionDetect 在既有基准上比最接近的竞争者平均准确率高 3.87%、精确率高 6.13%，在 OmniGen 上准确率提升 4.48%，并对常见图像扰动具有较强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有合成图像检测研究主要聚焦跨生成器泛化，但检测还面临跨视觉域泛化的挑战，现有视角过于局限，缺乏同时覆盖这两个维度的评测和方法。
Method: 提出 FusionDetect，从两个互补的冻结基础模型 CLIP 与 Dinov2 中提取特征，构建能够自适应内容与生成器设计变化的统一特征空间；同时构建包含 12 个最新生成器的 OmniGen 基准用于更贴近现实的评测。
Result: 摘要报告 FusionDetect 在既有基准上比最接近的竞争者准确率高 3.87%、平均精确率高 6.13%，在 OmniGen 基准上准确率提升 4.48%，并对常见图像扰动表现出优异鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者不仅给出了性能领先的检测器，还提供了新基准与评测框架，用于推动通用 AI 图像检测方向的发展。

papers.title: The Metacognitive Bottleneck: Japanese Riddles Reveal Fundamental Limits of Machine Insight and Self-Evaluation in Reasoning AI
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark saturation and training-data contamination increasingly obscure whether reported gains in large language models (LLMs) reflect genuine advances in reasoning or familiarity with recurring patterns in benchmark problems. We introduce the NazoNazo Benchmark, a renewable and extensible evaluation dataset derived from Japanese children's riddles that isolates a specific class of reasoning processes: insight-like representational restructuring and metacognitive evaluation. Rather than modeling reasoning in general, these tasks provide a focused test of failure modes that are difficult to detect in standard benchmarks. We curate 201 riddles and establish a human reference on a 120-item subset (n = 126; mean accuracy 52.9%). The benchmark is fully open, low-cost to refresh, and designed for continual evaluation under reduced contamination risk. We evaluate 38 frontier LLMs (2023-2025) under a strict retrieval-free, zero-shot protocol. On the human-comparison subset, non-reasoning models achieve 7.6% accuracy and reasoning-oriented models reach 17.6%, compared with a human mean of 52.9%, although performance varies substantially across models. Beyond accuracy, qualitative analysis of model-generated thought-logs identifies a distinctive failure mode, which we call verification failure: models generate a correct intermediate candidate but fail to endorse it as their final answer. This dissociation between candidate generation and endorsement reveals a metacognitive bottleneck: across the models with usable thought-logs, verification failures account for between 5% and 39% of a model's incorrect answers. By isolating the gap between generation and verification, this work provides a practical framework for diagnosing reasoning reliability and suggests concrete directions for improvement, including better calibration, structured verification, and stopping mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 NazoNazo Benchmark，一个基于日本儿童谜语构造的可更新评估数据集，用于隔离测试 LLM 的洞察式表征重构与元认知评估能力。作者在 120 题子集上建立人类参照（n=126，平均准确率 52.9%），并对 38 个 2023-2025 年的前沿 LLM 采用无检索、零样本协议评估：非推理模型准确率 7.6%，推理导向模型 17.6%。对模型思维日志的定性分析还识别出一种称为 "验证失败"（verification failure）的失败模式，即模型生成正确中间候选但未将其采纳为最终答案。
Motivation: 基准饱和与训练数据污染日益使 LLM 报告的性能提升难以区分是真正的推理进步还是对基准模式的热悉，因此需要一种能隔离特定推理过程、且不易被标准基准检测的评估手段。
Method: 构建完全开放、成本低且可更新的 NazoNazo Benchmark（201 个谜题），其中 120 题子集配有 126 名人类受试者的参照数据；在严格的检索无关、零样本协议下评估 38 个前沿 LLM，并对模型生成思维日志进行定性分析以识别失败类型。
Result: 人类平均准确率为 52.9%；非推理模型为 7.6%，推理导向模型为 17.6%，且模型间差异显著。在可用思维日志的模型中，验证失败占错误答案的 5% 至 39%，表明候选生成与最终采纳之间存在系统性解离。
Conclusion: 通过隔离生成与验证之间的差距，该工作为诊断推理可靠性提供了实用框架，并给出改善方向，包括更好的校准、结构化验证与停止机制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PHASE: Passive Human Activity Simulation Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Cybersecurity simulation environments, such as cyber ranges, honeypots, and sandboxes, require realistic human behavior to be effective, yet no quantitative method exists to assess the behavioral fidelity of synthetic user personas. This paper presents PHASE (Passive Human Activity Simulation Evaluation), a machine learning framework that analyzes Zeek connection logs and distinguishes human from non-human activity with over 90\% accuracy. PHASE operates entirely passively, relying on standard network monitoring without any user-side instrumentation or visible signs of surveillance. All network activity used for machine learning is collected via a Zeek network appliance to avoid introducing unnecessary network traffic or artifacts that could disrupt the fidelity of the simulation environment. The paper also proposes a novel labeling approach that utilizes local DNS records to classify network traffic, thereby enabling machine learning analysis. Furthermore, we apply SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) analysis to uncover temporal and behavioral signatures indicative of genuine human users. In a case study, we evaluate a synthetic user persona and identify distinct non-human patterns that undermine behavioral realism. Based on these insights, we develop a revised behavioral configuration that significantly improves the human-likeness of synthetic activity yielding a more realistic and effective synthetic user persona.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PHASE（Passive Human Activity Simulation Evaluation），一个用于评估网络安全仿真环境中合成用户角色行为保真度的机器学习框架。该框架分析 Zeek 连接日志，以超过 90% 的准确率区分人类与非人类活动，完全被动运行且无需用户侧探针。案例研究中，作者用该方法发现合成角色的非人类行为模式，并据此改进行为配置以提升拟真度。
Motivation: 网络靶场、蜜罐和沙箱等仿真环境需要逼真的人类行为才能有效，但目前缺乏定量方法来评估合成用户角色的行为保真度。
Method: 利用 Zeek 网络设备被动收集网络流量，提出基于本地 DNS 记录对流量进行标注的新方法以支持机器学习分析；随后应用 SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）分析挖掘真实人类用户的时序与行为特征，并基于这些发现重新设计合成角色的行为配置。
Result: 在区分人类与非人类活动上取得超过 90% 的准确率；案例研究识别出削弱行为真实性的非人类模式，修订后的行为配置显著提升了合成活动的人类相似度。
Conclusion: PHASE 提供了一种完全被动的合成角色保真度评估手段，并且其基于可解释分析的行为配置修订能生成更真实有效的合成用户角色。

papers.title: Concept Unlearning by Modeling Key Steps of Diffusion Process
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models remain susceptible to generating undesirable or harmful content. Although concept unlearning mitigates this risk, existing methods struggle with a critical optimization dilemma: thorough semantic erasure frequently induces the catastrophic forgetting of unrelated generative capabilities. To overcome this challenge, we propose Key Step Concept Unlearning (KSCU). Serving as an integrated methodological refinement deeply motivated by information theory, KSCU explores the profound impact of step scheduling order and reveals that traditional randomized timestep sampling severely disrupts trajectory dependency. We demonstrate that indiscriminately targeting the entire diffusion process is inefficient, as the optimal step range for unlearning inherently varies across different concepts. Rather than globally fine-tuning all timesteps, KSCU explicitly integrates a sequential-scheduling-based Key Step Table, CFG-aware leakage compensation, and prompt augmentation to dynamically isolate optimization to a concept-specific active region. This localized strategy successfully eradicates the target concept while preventing the structural collapse caused by early-step over-optimization. Consequently, KSCU significantly reduces computational overhead and establishes a state-of-the-art trade-off between concept erasure and utility retention. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that KSCU consistently delivers superior performance across diverse unlearning tasks, including nudity, style, object classes, and mass instance concepts. For example, in nudity removal, KSCU yields a 96.5% unlearning accuracy alongside a state-of-the-art FID of 14.1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型中的概念遗忘 (concept unlearning) 提出 Key Step Concept Unlearning (KSCU) 方法。KSCU 认为传统的随机时间步采样会破坏扩散轨迹依赖，并且最优遗忘步长范围因概念而异，因此通过顺序调度的 Key Step Table、CFG-aware 泄漏补偿和提示增强，将优化动态隔离到概念特定的活跃区域，而非全局微调所有时间步。实验覆盖裸体、风格、物体类别和大量实例概念，例如裸体移除任务达到 96.5% 的遗忘准确率和 14.1 的 FID。
Motivation: 现有概念遗忘方法面临关键优化困境：彻底的语义擦除常常导致无关生成能力的灾难性遗忘；同时传统的随机时间步采样严重破坏轨迹依赖，且不同概念的最优遗忘步长范围天然不同。
Method: KSCU 作为一个受信息论启发的集成式方法改进，显式结合基于顺序调度的 Key Step Table、CFG-aware 泄漏补偿与提示增强，动态地将优化限制在概念特定的活跃区域，避免对所有时间步进行全局微调。
Result: 综合评估显示 KSCU 在裸体、风格、物体类别和大量实例等多种遗忘任务上表现一致优越；例如裸体移除任务实现 96.5% 遗忘准确率与最优 FID 14.1，并显著降低计算开销。
Conclusion: KSCU 通过局部化策略有效消除目标概念，同时防止早期步骤过优化导致的结构崩溃，在概念擦除与生成能力保留之间建立了最优权衡。

papers.title: READ: A Retrieval-Alignment Diffusion Framework for Structure-based Drug Design
papers.abstract_en: Structure-based drug design (SBDD) models are central to modern pharmaceutical research, enabling the rational exploration of protein-ligand interactions at atomic resolution. However, most existing approaches frame molecular generation as an isolated optimization or a one-to-one matching task, overlooking the shared binding patterns and intrinsic similarities among protein-ligand complexes. This fragmented perspective constrains their ability to capture the fundamental principles governing molecular recognition and binding specificity. Moreover, the limited availability of high-quality experimental data further hampers model generalization and real-world applicability. To address these challenges, we present READ, a retrieval-alignment molecular generation framework that conditions the generative process on small molecules targeting homologous proteins. Retrieved ligands are aligned with a diffusion model across multiple representational spaces and integrated as conditional guidance throughout successive stages of generation. Under a standardized docking-based evaluation protocol, READ achieves consistently strong performance against state-of-the-art SBDD methods. More importantly, it introduces a retrieval-alignment paradigm for structure-based molecular generation, offering a practical framework for early-stage computational hit generation while leaving prospective experimental validation as future work.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 8 figures. Supplementary material is included as an ancillary file. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Computational Biology and Bioinformatics
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Computational Biology and Bioinformatics, pp. 1-15, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 READ，一个检索-对齐（retrieval-alignment）的分子生成框架，用于基于结构的药物设计（SBDD）。方法以靶向同源蛋白的小分子为条件，将检索到的配体在多个表示空间上与扩散模型（diffusion model）对齐，并在生成的连续阶段中作为条件引导。在标准化对接评估协议下，READ 相对现有 SBDD 方法取得一致的强性能，并提出检索-对齐这一生成范式。
Motivation: 现有方法大多将分子生成视为孤立优化或一对一匹配任务，忽略了蛋白-配体复合物之间共享的结合模式和内在相似性，限制了模型对分子识别与结合特异性的刻画；同时高质量实验数据稀缺，削弱了模型泛化与实际适用性。
Method: READ 是一个检索-对齐分子生成框架：以靶向同源蛋白的小分子作为条件，将检索到的配体在多个表示空间上与扩散模型对齐，并将其作为条件引导集成到生成的各个连续阶段中。
Result: 在标准化基于对接（docking-based）的评估协议下，READ 相对现有最先进的 SBDD 方法取得了持续且稳定的强性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 作者将 READ 定位为一种面向基于结构的分子生成的检索-对齐范式，为早期计算命中物（hit generation）提供实用框架；同时指出前瞻性实验验证留待未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoCA: Step-level Reward for Free in RL-based T2I Diffusion Model Fine-tuning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) diffusion model fine-tuning leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to align generated images with learnable reward functions. The existing approaches reformulate denoising as a Markov decision process for RL-driven optimization. However, they suffer from reward sparsity, receiving only a single delayed reward per generated trajectory. This flaw hinders precise step-level attribution of denoising actions, undermines training efficiency. To address this, we propose a simple yet effective credit assignment framework that dynamically distributes dense rewards across denoising steps. Specifically, we track changes in cosine similarity between intermediate and final images to quantify each step's contribution on progressively reducing the distance to the final image. Our approach avoids additional auxiliary neural networks for step-level preference modeling and instead uses reward shaping to highlight denoising phases that have a greater impact on image quality. Our method achieves 1.25 to 2 times higher sample efficiency and better generalization across four human preference reward functions, without compromising the original optimal policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoCA，一个面向 RL 微调文本到图像 (T2I) 扩散模型的信用分配框架，通过动态地在去噪步骤间分发密集奖励来解决奖励稀疏问题。方法利用中间图像与最终图像之间余弦相似度的变化来量化每个去噪步骤的贡献，并通过 reward shaping 突出对图像质量影响更大的阶段，无需额外的辅助神经网络。摘要报告该方法在四种人类偏好奖励函数上取得 1.25 至 2 倍的样本效率提升和更好的泛化，同时不损害原始最优策略。
Motivation: 现有基于 RL 的 T2I 扩散模型微调将去噪过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程，但每个生成轨迹只获得单个延迟奖励，存在奖励稀疏问题，难以对去噪动作进行精确的步骤级归因，并损害训练效率。
Method: 提出一个简单的信用分配框架，动态地将密集奖励分配到各去噪步骤：通过追踪中间图像与最终图像之间余弦相似度的变化来估算每步对缩短与最终图像距离的贡献，并采用 reward shaping 突出影响图像质量的关键去噪阶段，避免引入额外的辅助网络进行步骤级偏好建模。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在四种人类偏好奖励函数上比基线实现 1.25 至 2 倍的样本效率提升，并展现出更好的泛化能力，同时不牺牲原有最优策略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于 reward shaping 的密集奖励分配可以显著提升 RL 驱动的 T2I 扩散模型微调效率，且方法简单、无需额外网络。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Tracking the Flight: Exploring a Computational Framework for Analyzing Escape Responses in Plains Zebra (Equus quagga)
papers.abstract_en: Ethological research increasingly benefits from the growing affordability and accessibility of drones, which enable the capture of high-resolution footage of animal movement at fine spatial and temporal scales. However, analyzing such footage presents the technical challenge of separating animal movement from drone motion. While non-trivial, computer vision techniques such as image registration and Structure-from-Motion (SfM) offer practical solutions. For conservationists, open-source tools that are user-friendly, require minimal setup, and deliver timely results are especially valuable for efficient data interpretation. This study evaluates three approaches: a bioimaging-based registration technique, an SfM pipeline, and a hybrid interpolation method. We apply these to a recorded escape event involving 44 plains zebras, captured in a single drone video. Using the best-performing method, we extract individual trajectories and identify key behavioral patterns: increased alignment (polarization) during escape, a brief widening of spacing just before stopping, and tighter coordination near the group's center. These insights highlight the method's effectiveness and its potential to scale to larger datasets, contributing to broader investigations of collective animal behavior.
papers.comment: Accepted to the CV4Animals workshop at CVPR 2025; v2: corrected Fig. 3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机拍摄动物行为视频中难以将动物自身运动与无人机运动分离的问题，评估了三种计算机视觉方法：基于生物成像的配准技术、Structure-from-Motion (SfM) 流水线以及混合插值方法。作者将这些方法应用于一段包含44头平原斑马逃逸事件的单一无人机视频，并用表现最佳的方法提取个体轨迹，识别出逃逸时极化（alignment/polarization）增强、停止前间距短暂扩大以及群体中心附近协调更紧密等行为模式。摘要强调该方法有效且可扩展至更大数据集。
Motivation: 无人机成本降低使高分辨率动物运动拍摄日益普及，但将动物运动与无人机自身运动分离是分析中的技术难点；保护工作者尤其需要易于使用、设置简单且能快速产出结果的开源工具。
Method: 研究评估了三种方法：基于生物成像的配准技术、Structure-from-Motion (SfM) 流水线以及一种混合插值方法，并将其应用于一段包含44头平原斑马逃逸事件的单一无人机视频，以提取个体运动轨迹。
Result: 使用表现最佳的方法成功提取个体轨迹，并识别出关键行为模式：逃逸期间群体对齐（极化）增强、停止前间距短暂扩大、群体中心附近协调更紧密。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该方法具有有效性并可扩展到更大数据集，有助于更广泛的集体动物行为研究。该工作被 CVPR 2025 的 CV4Animals workshop 接收，v2 修正了 Fig. 3。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Linear Geometry of Interpretable Tokens: Jailbreaking Attacks and Defenses for Unlearned Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models excel at generating high-quality images but can memorize and reproduce harmful concepts when prompted. Although fine-tuning methods have been proposed to unlearn a target concept, they struggle to fully erase it while maintaining generation quality on other concepts, leaving models vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing jailbreak methods demonstrate this vulnerability but offer limited insight into how unlearned models retain harmful concepts, limiting progress on effective defenses. In this work, we show that the erased concept persists as a coherent, interpretable linear subspace of the token embedding space, and that both an attack and a defense follow directly from this structure. We introduce SubAttack, a novel jailbreaking attack that reads out this subspace by learning an orthogonal set of attack token embeddings, each being a linear combination of human-interpretable textual elements, revealing that unlearned models still retain the target concept through related textual components. Furthermore, our attack is also more powerful and transferable across text prompts, initial noises, and unlearned models than prior attacks. Conversely, projecting out the same subspace yields SubDefense, a lightweight plug-and-play defense mechanism that suppresses the residual concept in unlearned models. SubDefense provides stronger robustness than existing defenses while better preserving safe generation quality. Extensive experiments across multiple unlearning methods, concepts, and attack types demonstrate that our approach advances both understanding and mitigation of vulnerabilities in diffusion unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散模型在概念消除（unlearning）后仍保留有害概念的问题，发现被擦除的概念在 token embedding 空间中形成一个可解释的线性子空间。据此提出越狱攻击 SubAttack，通过学习一组正交的、由可解释文本元素线性组合的攻击 token 嵌入来读出该子空间，并进一步提出轻量级防御 SubDefense，通过投影去除同一子空间来抑制残余概念。实验表明攻击在多种文本提示、初始噪声和未学习模型上具有更强迁移性，防御在鲁棒性和安全生成质量上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有微调式概念消除方法难以在保持其他概念生成质量的同时完全擦除目标概念，模型仍易受越狱攻击；已有攻击方法缺乏对未学习模型如何保留有害概念的机制性理解，限制了防御发展。
Method: 提出从 token 嵌入空间出发的几何视角：被擦除概念以可解释的线性子空间形式存留。攻击 SubAttack 通过学习一组正交攻击 token 嵌入（每个嵌入是文本语义元素的线性组合）来读出该子空间；防御 SubDefense 将该子空间投影掉，作为即插即用的轻量级机制。
Result: 实验覆盖多种未学习方法和概念，SubAttack 在文本提示、初始噪声与不同未学习模型之间更具迁移性且更强；SubDefense 的鲁棒性优于现有防御，同时更好地保持安全生成质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作通过揭示未学习模型保留目标概念的线性几何结构，同时推进了对扩散模型未学习漏洞的理解与缓解。

papers.title: HierDAMap: Towards Universal Domain Adaptive BEV Mapping via Hierarchical Perspective Priors
papers.abstract_en: The exploration of Bird's-Eye View (BEV) mapping technology has driven significant innovation in visual perception technology for autonomous driving. BEV mapping models need to be applied to the unlabeled real world, making the study of unsupervised domain adaptation models an essential path. However, research on unsupervised domain adaptation for BEV mapping remains limited and cannot perfectly accommodate all BEV mapping tasks. To address this gap, this paper proposes HierDAMap, a universal and holistic BEV domain adaptation framework with hierarchical perspective priors. Unlike existing research that solely focuses on image-level learning using prior knowledge, this paper explores the guiding role of perspective prior knowledge across three distinct levels: global, sparse, and instance levels. With these priors, HierDAMap consists of three essential components, including Semantic-Guided Pseudo Supervision (SGPS), Dynamic-Aware Coherence Learning (DACL), and Cross-Domain Frustum Mixing (CDFM). SGPS constrains the cross-domain consistency of perspective feature distribution through pseudo labels generated by vision foundation models in 2D space. To mitigate feature distribution discrepancies caused by spatial variations, DACL employs uncertainty-aware predicted depth as an intermediary to derive dynamic BEV labels from perspective pseudo-labels, thereby constraining the coarse BEV features derived from corresponding perspective features. CDFM, on the other hand, leverages perspective masks of the view frustum to mix multi-view perspective images from both domains, which guides cross-domain view transformation and encoding learning through mixed BEV labels. Furthermore, this paper introduces intra-domain feature exchange data augmentation to enhance the efficiency of domain adaptation learning. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/lynn-yu/HierDAMap.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems (T-ITS). The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/lynn-yu/HierDAMap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HierDAMap，一个面向鸟瞰图（BEV）映射的通用无监督域自适应框架，利用层次化的透视先验（global、sparse、instance 三个层级）。框架包含 Semantic-Guided Pseudo Supervision (SGPS)、Dynamic-Aware Coherence Learning (DACL) 和 Cross-Domain Frustum Mixing (CDFM) 三个组件，并引入域内特征交换数据增强。摘要称该方法旨在统一适配各类 BEV 映射任务，代码将公开。
Motivation: BEV 映射模型需要应用到未标注的真实世界，无监督域自适应研究对此至关重要，但现有研究有限且不能完美适配所有 BEV 映射任务，且多局限于利用先验知识的图像级学习。
Method: 在全局、稀疏、实例三个层次利用透视先验：SGPS 通过视觉基础模型在 2D 空间生成伪标签，约束透视特征分布的跨域一致性；DACL 以不确定性感知的预测深度为中介，从透视伪标签导出动态 BEV 标签，约束对应透视特征派生的粗 BEV 特征；CDFM 利用视锥的透视掩码混合两个域的多视角透视图像，通过混合 BEV 标签指导跨域视图变换与编码学习，并配合域内特征交换数据增强。
Result: 摘要未报告具体定量结果或基准数据集上的数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 HierDAMap 是一种通用且整体的 BEV 域自适应框架，通过层次化透视先验提升跨域适配能力，并计划公开源代码。
Relevance: 0
