summary_sections.method: 在全局、稀疏、实例三个层次利用透视先验：SGPS 通过视觉基础模型在 2D 空间生成伪标签，约束透视特征分布的跨域一致性；DACL 以不确定性感知的预测深度为中介，从透视伪标签导出动态 BEV 标签，约束对应透视特征派生的粗 BEV 特征；CDFM 利用视锥的透视掩码混合两个域的多视角透视图像，通过混合 BEV 标签指导跨域视图变换与编码学习，并配合域内特征交换数据增强。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体定量结果或基准数据集上的数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 HierDAMap 是一种通用且整体的 BEV 域自适应框架，通过层次化透视先验提升跨域适配能力，并计划公开源代码。

papers.title: LLM-Advisor: An LLM Advisor for Cost-efficient Path Planning across Multiple Terrains
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses fixed-graph terrain-aware path refinement, in which a global planner is restricted to a predefined route space and may remain optimal within that space while missing lower-cost terrain corridors available in the native-resolution map. We propose LLM-Advisor, an external verification-guided multimodal refinement framework that uses semantic terrain context to propose route alternatives with lower cost than the baseline route. The framework combines a multimodal prompt, map-disjoint Reference Example Augmentation (REA), and deterministic validation with fallback: a proposed route is deployed only when it is feasible and strictly lower in cost than the baseline. To evaluate the method, we introduce MultiTerraPath, a controlled 2,000-map benchmark with Easy and Hard subsets for fixed-graph terrain-cost refinement, and further conduct a semantic-cost transfer evaluation on RUGD. Using coarse-lattice A* with stride r=50 as the fixed baseline planner, we compare LLM-Advisor with direct LLM planning and LLM-A*. LLM-Advisor with GPT-5.5 achieves the highest FIR on MultiTerraPath, improving 52.00% of Easy maps and 45.00% of Hard maps. Deterministic verification and fallback yield 100.00% NDR and Final Validity across all evaluated RUGD scene groups. Across lattice strides from r=10 to r=100, offline oracle analysis shows that coarser graphs create larger coarse--oracle gaps, while LLM-Advisor recovers up to 49.16% and 29.98% of the available gap on Easy and Hard maps when r=100, respectively.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM-Advisor，一个外部验证引导的多模态路径细化框架，用于固定图 (fixed-graph) 地形感知路径规划。框架利用语义地形上下文提出比基线路径成本更低的备选路线，并仅在备选路线可行且成本严格更低时才部署。作者引入 MultiTerraPath 基准（2,000 张受控地图，含 Easy 与 Hard 子集），并以粗网格 A*（stride r=50）为固定基线进行对比。摘要报告 LLM-Advisor 搭配 GPT-5.5 在 MultiTerraPath 上取得最高 FIR，Easy 地图改善 52.00%、Hard 地图改善 45.00%。
Motivation: 固定图规划器被限制在预定路线空间内，即使在该空间内最优，也可能错过原生分辨率地图中成本更低的地形走廊。作者希望利用大语言模型的语义地形理解来弥补这一固定图带来的成本缺口。
Method: 框架结合多模态提示 (multimodal prompt)、与地图不重叠的参考示例增强 (map-disjoint Reference Example Augmentation, REA) 以及确定性验证与回退机制：只有当提议路线可行且成本严格低于基线时才采用该路线，否则回退到基线。
Result: 在 MultiTerraPath 上，LLM-Advisor 搭配 GPT-5.5 取得最高 FIR，Easy 地图改善 52.00%、Hard 地图改善 45.00%；在 RUGD 上确定性验证与回退机制在所有场景组中获得 100.00% 的 NDR 和最终有效性。离线 oracle 分析表明，在 lattice stride 从 r=10 到 r=100 时，越粗的图产生越大的 coarse-oracle 差距，而 LLM-Advisor 在 r=100 时分别恢复了 Easy 和 Hard 地图中 49.16% 与 29.98% 的可用差距。
Conclusion: 作者强调，经过验证与回退保护的 LLM 多模态路线细化可以有效恢复被粗固定图遗漏的低成本地形走廊，同时保证路线有效性。该工作聚焦固定图地形成本细化场景，已被 IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering 接收。

papers.title: From Field Data to Global Food Systems Intelligence: A Semantic Graph Framework for Sustainable Wheat Production
papers.abstract_en: In response to the growing need for structured, interoperable agricultural data, this paper presents the Sustainable Wheat Production Datahub, a modular, graph-based framework that brings diverse wheat production datasets together into a single, queryable store. Using the Knowledge Acquisition and Representation Methodology (KNARM), with domain experts in the loop, we developed ontologies for nutrient management and disease management, two of the areas that most affect wheat yield and its sustainability, covering practices such as nitrogen fertilization and fungicide-based disease control. The two ontologies are federated, meaning they are maintained as separate but connected modules, joined by a bridging layer of cross-domain links, and together they form the schema of a knowledge graph (KG). We construct this KG by populating the ontologies with data from diverse sources, including field trials, expert knowledge, and environmental descriptors. We validate the ontologies, showing the KG accurately answers practical agronomic questions expressed in SPARQL. We demonstrate that the KG derives facts entailed by the ontologies beyond those explicitly stored, and that a single query can draw across independently sourced datasets. The framework also has practical implications for wheat research and extension programs, since it makes data from different sources easier to find, combine, and reuse. Designed to expand toward the full wheat lifecycle, from farm to table, this work establishes the foundation for a scalable, semantically rich global food systems datahub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可持续小麦生产数据枢纽 (Sustainable Wheat Production Datahub)，一个基于知识图谱 (KG) 的模块化框架，将来自田间试验、专家知识和环境描述符的多种小麦生产数据集整合为单一可查询存储。作者采用知识获取与表示方法论 (KNARM)，在领域专家参与下为养分管理和病害管理构建了两个可联邦的农业本体，并通过跨域链接层组成知识图谱模式。验证表明该KG能准确回答用SPARQL表达的实际农学问题，并能推导出本体蕴含的额外事实。
Motivation: 农业数据往往异构且互操作性差，缺乏结构化、可互操作的统一存储方式，导致小麦生产数据难以被查找、组合和复用。
Method: 使用KNARM方法并让领域专家参与，开发养分管理与病害管理两个领域本体；两个本体以联邦方式作为独立但连接的模块维护，通过跨域链接桥梁层整合为知识图谱模式，再填充田间试验、专家知识和环境描述符等数据构建KG。
Result: 验证显示该KG能准确回答SPARQL表达的农学问题，能推导出本体蕴含的、超出显式存储的事实，并且单一查询可以跨独立来源的数据集进行检索。
Conclusion: 框架对小麦研究和推广项目具有实际意义，使不同来源数据更易发现、组合和复用；作者将其定位为向完整小麦生命周期（从农场到餐桌）扩展的可扩展全球粮食系统数据枢纽的基础。

papers.title: Generative Modeling with Bayesian Sample Inference
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel view of diffusion-like generative modeling from the perspective of iterative Gaussian posterior inference. By treating the generated sample as an unknown variable, we formulate the sampling process in the language of Bayesian probability: at each step, a model predicts the unknown sample from our current belief state and we compute a posterior belief from that prediction. Based on this formulation, we propose the generative model Bayesian Sample Inference (BSI). In addition to a rigorous theoretical analysis, we show that our perspective includes Bayesian Flow Networks (BFNs) and that BSI and BFNs represent the two opposite ends of a range of isotropic hyper-priors over the initial belief state. In our experiments, we demonstrate that BSI improves sample quality over both BFNs and the closely related Variational Diffusion Models on ImageNet32 and ImageNet64, while achieving equivalent log-likelihoods on both datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bayesian Sample Inference (BSI)，一种将扩散式生成建模视为迭代高斯后验推断的新视角。该视角将生成样本视为未知变量，每一步由模型基于当前信念状态预测未知样本，再据此计算后验信念。理论上本文证明该视角包含 Bayesian Flow Networks (BFNs)，且 BSI 与 BFNs 是初始信念状态各向同性超先验谱系中的两个极端；实验显示 BSI 在 ImageNet32 和 ImageNet64 上的样本质量优于 BFNs 和 Variational Diffusion Models，同时取得相当的对数似然。
Motivation: 现有扩散类生成模型缺乏统一的贝叶斯形式化，作者希望将采样过程表达为迭代高斯后验推断，从而提供更严格的理论基础并连接已有方法。
Method: 提出 BSI：在每一采样步中，模型从当前信念状态预测未知生成样本，再基于该预测计算后验信念以更新状态。作者还给出了严格的理论分析，刻画了 BSI 与 BFNs 在初始信念状态各向同性超先验选择上的对应关系。
Result: 摘要报告 BSI 在 ImageNet32 和 ImageNet64 上相比 BFNs 与 Variational Diffusion Models 改善了样本质量，并在两个数据集上取得等价的对数似然。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该贝叶斯推断视角统一并延伸了扩散式生成建模，理论分析覆盖 BFNs 的特殊情形；摘要未讨论具体应用场景或明确局限。

papers.title: Musical Agent Systems: MACAT and MACataRT
papers.abstract_en: Our research explores the development and application of musical agents, human-in-the-loop generative AI systems designed to support music performance and improvisation within co-creative spaces. We introduce MACAT and MACataRT, two distinct musical agent systems crafted to enhance interactive music-making between human musicians and AI. MACAT is optimized for agent-led performance, employing real-time synthesis and self-listening to shape its output autonomously, while MACataRT provides a flexible environment for collaborative improvisation through audio mosaicing and sequence-based learning. Both systems emphasize training on personalized, small datasets, fostering ethical and transparent AI engagement that respects artistic integrity. This research highlights how interactive, artist-centred generative AI can expand creative possibilities, empowering musicians to explore new forms of artistic expression in real-time, performance-driven and music improvisation contexts.
papers.comment: In Proceedings of the Creativity and Generative AI NIPS (Neural Information Processing Systems) Workshop 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍两个音乐智能体系统 MACAT 与 MACataRT，用于人机共同创作 (co-creative) 场景下的音乐表演与即兴演奏。MACAT 面向智能体主导的表演，利用实时合成与自我监听自主塑造输出；MACataRT 则通过音频马赛克 (audio mosaicing) 和序列学习支持灵活的人机协作即兴。两个系统都强调基于个性化小数据集训练，并注重伦理与透明的 AI 交互。
Motivation: 现有生成式 AI 在支持音乐表演和即兴演奏方面缺乏面向艺术家的人机协作设计，作者希望探索能嵌入实时表演与即兴语境的人类在环 (human-in-the-loop) 生成系统。
Method: 提出两套音乐智能体系统：MACAT 采用实时合成和自听机制实现智能体主导输出；MACataRT 结合音频马赛克与序列学习提供协作即兴环境。两者均以个性化小数据集训练。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，主要给出系统设计层面的定性描述，声称能够拓展实时表演与即兴音乐中艺术表达的创造性可能。
Conclusion: 作者强调以艺术家为中心、交互式的生成式 AI 可以赋能音乐家探索新的表达形式，并通过小数据训练与透明 AI 维护艺术完整性与伦理参与。

papers.title: Ordinal-Aware Calibration for Ordinal Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks frequently produce overconfident, miscalibrated predictions. In ordinal classification, predictions must also adhere to a unimodal and order-consistent structure, a requirement that has dominated prior work while overlooking calibration. We formalize this joint challenge as ordinal calibration for the first time and propose the Ordinal loss for Calibration and Unimodality (ORCU). Unlike incremental modular combinations, ORCU provides a concise, principled unification of distance-aware soft encoding and an ordinal-aware log-barrier extension on adjacent logit gaps. This coupling is theoretically synergetic: soft-encoded targets pre-condition the optimization landscape by providing a finite, full-support ordinal anchor for well-posed refinement, while the log-barrier extension preserves non-vanishing adjacent-gap gradients in the unimodality-feasible interior. This enables the log-barrier to refine confidence without disrupting the ordinal geometry. ORCU requires no architectural changes or post-hoc calibration. Across four ordinal benchmarks, it achieves state-of-the-art calibration without compromising accuracy. We establish a new reliability standard by providing a reproducible benchmark over 10 specialized and general-purpose loss functions. Our code is available at https://github.com/labhai/ORCU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将序数分类（ordinal classification）中的校准问题形式化为"序数校准"，并提出 ORCU 损失函数，统一了距离感知的软编码（distance-aware soft encoding）与相邻 logit 间隔的有序感知对数障碍扩展（ordinal-aware log-barrier extension）。该方法无需任何架构修改或事后校准，在四个序数基准上取得最佳校准性能且不损害准确率，并提供了涵盖 10 种损失函数的可复现基准。
Motivation: 深度神经网络常产生过度自信且校准不良的预测；序数分类还要求预测满足单峰且顺序一致的结构，此前研究主要关注这一结构而忽略了校准。作者首次将这一联合挑战形式化为序数校准问题。
Method: 提出 ORCU 损失，将距离感知的软编码与作用于相邻 logit 间隔的有序感知 log-barrier 扩展耦合：软编码目标通过提供有限且全支持的序数锚点来预处理优化地形，log-barrier 则在单峰可行内部保留非消失的相邻间隔梯度，从而在不破坏序数几何的前提下细化置信度。
Result: 摘要报告在四个序数基准上，ORCU 取得了最先进的校准性能（state-of-the-art calibration），同时不牺牲准确率；作者还提供了包含 10 种专门和通用损失函数的可复现基准，提出了新的可靠性标准。
Conclusion: 作者强调 ORCU 提供了一种简洁且有原则的联合校准方案，无需架构改动或事后校准，并通过可复现基准为序数分类校准建立了可靠性评估标准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Edge Case Detection in Automated Driving: Methods, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: Automated vehicles (AVs) promise to enhance transportation safety and efficiency. However, ensuring their reliability in real-world conditions remains challenging, particularly due to rare and unexpected situations known as edge cases. While numerous approaches exist for detecting edge cases, a comprehensive survey reviewing these techniques is lacking. This paper bridges this gap by presenting a hierarchical review and systematic classification of edge case detection and assessment methodologies. Our classification is structured on two levels: first, by AV modules, including perception and trajectory-related (encompassing prediction, planning, and control) subsystems; and second, by underlying methodologies and theories guiding these techniques. Furthermore, we introduce "knowledge-driven" approaches, which complement data-driven methods by leveraging expert insights and domain knowledge to identify cases absent in training datasets. We then examine techniques and metrics for evaluating edge case detection methods, including detection performance, practical deployment (e.g., computational overhead), and domain-specific measures (e.g., crash rates and severity analysis). We conclude by highlighting key challenges for edge case detection, including data availability and quality issues, validation and interpretability limitations, the simulation-to-real gap, and computational constraints. The hierarchical classification and review of methods and assessment techniques in this survey enable modular and targeted testing frameworks by guiding the selection of detection methods for specific AV subsystems while considering methodological principles. It also supports practical testing by facilitating scenario generation in simulation and focused subsystem validation in the real world.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于自动驾驶边缘情况（edge case）检测的综述，针对现有方法缺乏系统性梳理的问题，提出按 AV 模块（感知、轨迹相关子系统）和底层方法论两个层级进行的分层分类。论文还引入知识驱动（knowledge-driven）方法作为数据驱动方法的补充，并总结了检测性能、部署开销和领域特定指标等评估技术。最后指出数据质量、验证与可解释性、仿真到现实差距以及计算约束等关键挑战。
Motivation: 自动驾驶车辆在真实世界中可靠性保障的难点在于罕见且意外的情况，即边缘情况；虽然已有大量检测方法，但缺乏系统性综述来组织这些技术。
Method: 提出两层级的分层分类框架：第一层按 AV 模块（感知、预测、规划与控制等轨迹相关子系统）划分，第二层按底层方法论与理论划分；此外引入知识驱动方法，利用专家经验和领域知识识别训练数据集中不存在的情况，并梳理了检测方法评估技术与指标。
Result: 作为综述，本文的主要成果是给出边缘情况检测方法的系统性分类、知识驱动与数据驱动方法的互补性分析，以及包括检测性能、实际部署（如计算开销）和领域特定指标（如碰撞率与严重性分析）在内的评估技术梳理。
Conclusion: 作者总结边缘情况检测的主要挑战包括数据可用性与质量、验证与可解释性限制、仿真到现实差距以及计算约束，并认为该分层分类框架可支持模块化、有针对性的测试框架构建，以及仿真场景生成和现实世界子系统验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OTIS: Learning High-Quality Time Series Features With Tiny Encoders
papers.abstract_en: We introduce OTIS, an open time series encoder that yields high-quality time series features for downstream deployment on any system, including resource-constrained wearables and industrial sensors. Currently, the development of powerful general-purpose encoders relies on the scaling laws hypothesis, using large encoder sizes to memorise the heterogeneous distributions of multi-domain training data. However, this reliance on scale creates a barrier to real-world utility, rendering deployment on resource-constrained systems infeasible due to strict memory, energy, and latency constraints. Surprisingly, we find that tailoring standard masked modelling pre-training to time series properties yields a tiny $7.1\,$M encoder that matches the state-of-the-art performance of $54\times$ larger encoders across $162$ tasks, while requiring $10\times$ less memory, $43\times$ less energy, and $37\times$ lower latency. To achieve this without the capacity tax, we introduce three novel components: (1) a domain-aware tokeniser to resolve conflicting semantics within multi-domain training data; (2) a dual masking strategy to capture spatiotemporal structures and temporal causality; and (3) a structure-aware objective to decouple feature learning from modelling noise. Consequently, OTIS produces high-quality time series features that enable state-of-the art performance in discriminative tasks and even extend seamlessly to generative tasks at minimal additional cost. To democratise access to powerful time series features on any system, we release our code and pre-trained weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OTIS——一个开放的小型时间序列编码器，通过针对时间序列特性定制掩码建模预训练，在 162 个下游任务上以约 7.1M 参数匹配比其大 54 倍的编码器的性能，同时显著降低内存、能量和延迟。作者设计了领域感知 tokeniser、双掩码策略和结构感知目标三个组件，使小模型能在不依赖规模的前提下学到高质量时间序列特征，并可直接用于判别与生成任务。
Motivation: 现有通用时间序列编码器依赖缩放定律，通过大模型记忆多领域异构训练数据，导致内存、能量和延迟约束严格的可穿戴设备与工业传感器等部署场景不可行。
Method: 提出以时间序列特性定制掩码建模(masked modelling)预训练的三大组件：领域感知 tokeniser 解决多域数据中的冲突语义；双掩码策略捕获时空结构与时间因果性；结构感知目标将特征学习与噪声建模解耦，从而避免容量代价。
Result: 摘要报告该约 7.1M 参数的编码器在 162 个任务上匹配 54 倍更大编码器的性能，且内存减少 10 倍、能耗减少 43 倍、延迟降低 37 倍，在判别任务上达到 state-of-the-art 并能以极小额外成本扩展到生成任务。
Conclusion: 作者强调针对时间序列特性的预训练能使小巧编码器绕过缩放定律的容量门槛，在资源受限系统上也能获得高质量时间序列特征，并开源代码和预训练权重以推动更广泛使用。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: A Probabilistic Framework for Learnable Optimization Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: We propose a statistical-learning framework for optimization algorithms. The framework is based on probability distributions over optimization trajectories induced by a distribution of optimization problems and a learnable optimization algorithm. Within this setting, optimization performance is represented through measurable performance functionals, including stopping times, contraction factors, and trajectory-level properties. The resulting framework provides a statistical perspective on optimization algorithms, allows their performance to be studied at the population level, and naturally accommodates the learning of optimization algorithms from data. Moreover, it enables the application of statistical-learning techniques to optimization, including PAC-Bayesian generalization guarantees for bounded optimization-specific performance measures. Experiments on convex, non-smooth, non-convex, and stochastic optimization problems illustrate the framework and demonstrate the statistical nature of optimization performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于优化算法的统计学习框架，将优化轨迹视为由问题分布和可学习优化算法共同诱导的概率分布，并用可测性能泛函（如停时、收缩因子、轨迹级性质）刻画优化性能。该框架从群体层面研究优化算法性能，并支持从数据中学习优化算法，还引入了针对有界优化性能指标的 PAC-Bayes 泛化保证。作者在凸、非光滑、非凸和随机优化问题上进行了实验，用以说明框架并展示优化性能的统计本质。
Motivation: 传统优化算法分析多为确定性的或针对具体问题，缺乏从统计学习角度统一研究算法性能、处理问题分布以及从数据中学习算法的框架。
Method: 提出基于优化轨迹概率分布的统计学习框架，将优化性能表示为可测性能泛函，并结合 PAC-Bayes 技术为有界的优化性能指标提供泛化保证。
Result: 摘要报告在凸、非光滑、非凸和随机优化问题上的实验验证了框架，并展示了优化性能的统计性质。
Conclusion: 该框架为优化算法的统计视角和可学习性提供了统一基础，使统计学习技术能够应用于优化；实验主要用于说明框架而非声称某一算法在基准上的最优表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Separation capacity of linear reservoirs with random connectivity matrix
papers.abstract_en: A natural hypothesis for the success of reservoir computing in generic tasks is the ability of the untrained reservoir to map distinct input time series to separable reservoir states, a property we term separation capacity. In this work, we develop a rigorous mathematical framework for analysing the separation capacity of random linear reservoirs. We show that the expected separation induced by a random reservoir is completely characterised by the spectral properties of a positive semi-definite matrix naturally associated with the connectivity matrix, which we call the generalised matrix of moments. Taking Gaussian connectivity matrices as an example, we investigate how separation depends on the reservoir dimension $N$, the scaling of the connectivity matrix, and structural assumptions such as symmetry. In the symmetric case, we show that, although the classical scaling $N^{-1/2}$ yields the most balanced separation for large reservoirs, the quality of separation inevitably deteriorates as the length of the input time series increases. In contrast, for reservoirs with independent and identically distributed connectivity entries, we prove that the classical scaling $N^{-1/2}$ is asymptotically optimal from the perspective of separation and derive quantitative bounds describing the evolution of separation with the time horizon. Finally, numerical experiments suggest a strong practical connection between balanced separation profiles and downstream learning performance. Beyond providing a theoretical justification for several common reservoir design choices, our results introduce separation capacity as a tractable and informative framework for the analysis of random reservoirs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为随机线性储备池 (linear reservoir) 的分离能力 (separation capacity) 建立严格数学框架，证明随机储备池诱导的期望分离完全由连通矩阵关联的正半定矩阵（广义矩矩阵）的谱性质刻画。以高斯连通矩阵为例，作者考察分离能力随储备池维度 N、连通矩阵缩放及对称性等结构假设的变化，并在数值实验中观察到分离剖面与下游学习性能之间的强联系。
Motivation: 储备计算 (reservoir computing) 成功的一个自然假设是未训练的储备池能将不同输入时间序列映射到可分离的储备池状态，即分离能力；但该性质缺少严格的数学分析工具。
Method: 引入与连通矩阵自然关联的正半定矩阵（广义矩矩阵，generalised matrix of moments），用其谱性质完全刻画随机储备池的期望分离；并以高斯连通矩阵为例，分析分离能力对 N、矩阵缩放和对称性等结构假设的依赖。
Result: 在对称情形下，经典缩放 N^{-1/2} 对大型储备池给出最均衡的分离，但随输入时间序列长度增加分离质量必然下降；对 i.i.d. 连通项情形，证明 N^{-1/2} 在分离意义上渐近最优，并给出分离随时间视界演化的定量界。数值实验提示均衡的分离剖面与下游学习性能密切相关。
Conclusion: 该工作为若干常见储备池设计选择提供理论依据，并提出分离能力作为分析随机储备池的可行且信息丰富的框架；摘要未讨论具体应用领域或实际数据集上的表现。
Relevance: 8

summary_sections.result: 在对称情形下，经典缩放 N^{-1/2} 对大型储备池给出最均衡的分离，但随输入时间序列长度增加分离质量必然下降；对 i.i.d. 连通项情形，证明 N^{-1/2} 在分离意义上渐近最优，并给出分离随时间视界演化的定量界。数值实验提示均衡的分离剖面与下游学习性能密切相关。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为若干常见储备池设计选择提供理论依据，并提出分离能力作为分析随机储备池的可行且信息丰富的框架；摘要未讨论具体应用领域或实际数据集上的表现。

papers.title: Automated Inference of Graph Transformation Rules
papers.abstract_en: The explosion of data available in life sciences is fueling an increasing demand for expressive models and computational methods. Graph transformation is a model for dynamic systems with a large variety of applications. We introduce a novel method of the graph transformation model construction, combining generative and dynamical viewpoints to give a fully automated data-driven model inference method. The method takes the input dynamical properties, given as a "snapshot" of the dynamics encoded by explicit transitions, and constructs a compatible model. The obtained model is guaranteed to be minimal, thus framing the approach as model compression (from a set of transitions into a set of rules). The compression is permissive to a lossy case, where the constructed model is allowed to exhibit behavior outside of the input transitions, thus suggesting a completion of the input dynamics. The task of graph transformation model inference is naturally highly challenging due to the combinatorics involved. We tackle the exponential explosion by proposing a heuristically minimal translation of the task into a well-established problem, set cover, for which highly optimized solutions exist. We further showcase how our results relate to Kolmogorov complexity expressed in terms of graph transformation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种全自动的数据驱动图变换模型推断方法，将生成视角与动力学视角结合：输入由显式转移编码的动力学快照，输出与该动力学兼容的图变换规则集。该方法保证所得模型最小，因此被表述为从转移集合到规则集合的模型压缩，并允许有损情形以补全输入动力学。由于组合爆炸，作者将该任务启发式地约简为集合覆盖问题，并讨论其结果与图变换表达下的 Kolmogorov 复杂度之间的联系。
Motivation: 生命科学领域数据激增，需要更具表达力的动态系统模型；图变换 (graph transformation) 虽应用广泛，但缺少从输入动力学自动构造兼容且最小的模型的方法。
Method: 将动力学快照视为显式转移集合，通过把图变换模型推断问题转化为集合覆盖 (set cover) 实例来求解；利用高度优化的集合覆盖求解器，并允许损失性压缩以覆盖输入转移之外的行为。
Result: 摘要声称所得模型被保证是最小的，从而将推断问题框架化为模型压缩；同时展示了该结果与用图变换表示的 Kolmogorov 复杂度的联系。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了从转移数据自动推断最小图变换规则集的途径，并借由集合覆盖约简应对组合爆炸；有损情形可视为对输入动力学的补全。

papers.title: Leveraging Few-Shot Learning and Large Language Models for Analyzing Blood Pressure Variations Across Biological Sex from Scientific Literature
papers.abstract_en: Current blood pressure (BP) technologies and standards were established decades ago, and these standards are still used worldwide today, often without adjusting BP readings for individual demographic factors such as sex and age. While these standards provide useful guidelines and help identify at-risk patients, they are not fully reliable for diagnosis due to the lack of demographic considerations. This study aims to assess the feasibility of using large language models (LLMs) for the automated extraction of BP-related information from the scientific literature, with a focus on biological sex-based distinctions in BP distributions. We employed natural language processing (NLP) methods to extract the means and standard deviations of BP values from the literature, distinguishing by biological sex. We developed a Solr-based search engine to retrieve scientific articles containing BP-related keywords and biological sex indicators from PubMed. From the retrieved articles, we created a manually reviewed subset comprising 213 articles including 90 cases that reported BP values based on biological sex. We experimented with one few-shot learning method and two zero-shot LLM-based methods---LLaMA3 and GPT-3.5---to extract the mean and standard deviations of BP values, and the associated biological sex. Based on the automatically-extracted information, we generated heatmaps and contour plots to study the variations of BP values across biological sex.
papers.comment: Accepted by the journal of Computers in Biology and Medicine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估使用大语言模型（LLM）从科学文献中自动提取血压（BP）相关信息、并区分生物学性别差异的可行性。作者构建了基于 Solr 的检索系统从 PubMed 获取文献，人工审核了 213 篇子集，并用少样本学习以及 LLaMA3 和 GPT-3.5 两种零样本方法提取血压的均值、标准差及其对应的生物学性别。基于自动提取的信息，进一步生成热力图和等高线图来观察血压随性别的变化。
Motivation: 当前血压技术及其标准几十年前制定，至今仍被全球使用，且未根据性别、年龄等人口统计学因素调整血压读数，导致诊断可靠性不足。作者希望借助 LLM 自动化提取文献中的血压分布信息，以便研究基于生物学性别的血压差异。
Method: 采用自然语言处理（NLP）方法提取文献中的血压均值和标准差，并按生物学性别区分。开发了基于 Solr 的搜索引擎从 PubMed 检索含血压相关关键词和性别指示词的论文；在人工审核的 213 篇论文（其中 90 篇按性别报告血压）上，实验了一种少样本学习方法和两种零样本 LLM 方法（LLaMA3、GPT-3.5）来提取数值与性别，最后用热力图和等高线图分析血压随性别的变化。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的定量提取性能指标，仅说明基于自动提取的信息生成了用于研究血压随生物学性别变化的热力图和等高线图，表明该方法在可行性层面得到验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调本研究旨在评估 LLM 自动提取文献中按性别区分的血压信息的可行性，并未提供明确的定量结论或局限性讨论。

papers.title: Exposition on over-squashing problem on GNNs: Current Methods, Benchmarks and Challenges
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) have achieved remarkable success in both node and graph-level learning tasks. However, several identified problems, including over-smoothing (OSM), limited expressive power, and over-squashing (OSQ), still limit the performance of MPNNs. In particular, OSQ serves as the latest identified problem, where MPNNs gradually lose their learning accuracy when long-range dependencies between graph nodes are required. In this work, we provide an exposition on the OSQ problem by summarizing different formulations of OSQ from current literature, as well as the three different categories of approaches for addressing the OSQ problem. In addition, we also discuss the alignment between OSQ and expressive power and the trade-off between OSQ and OSM. Furthermore, we summarize the empirical methods leveraged from existing works to verify the efficiency of OSQ mitigation approaches, with illustrations of their computational complexities. Lastly, we list some open questions that are of interest for further exploration of the OSQ problem along with potential directions from the best of our knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是关于图消息传递神经网络 (MPNN) 中过压缩 (over-squashing, OSQ) 问题的综述性论述，系统梳理了文献中 OSQ 的不同形式化定义，以及当前解决该问题的三类方法。文章还讨论了 OSQ 与表达能力的对齐关系、OSQ 与过平滑 (over-smoothing, OSM) 之间的权衡，并总结了现有工作中用于验证 OSQ 缓解方法有效性的经验手段及其计算复杂度，最后列出了若干开放问题。
Motivation: OSQ 是 MPNN 最新被识别出的限制性问题：当图节点之间需要长程依赖时，MPNN 的学习精度会逐渐下降。该问题与过平滑、表达能力受限等已知问题共同影响 MPNN 性能，因此需要系统梳理已有定义、方法与评估手段，为后续研究提供清晰图景。
Method: 采用综述 (exposition) 形式，汇总当前文献中 OSQ 的不同公式化表述，将缓解方法归纳为三个类别，并分析 OSQ 与网络表达能力的关系以及 OSQ 与 OSM 的权衡。同时总结现有工作中验证 OSQ 缓解效果的实证方法和相关计算复杂度，并列举开放问题与潜在研究方向。
Result: 本文是综述而非新方法论文，未报告新的实验数据；其主要成果是结构化的分类、对不同方法关系与权衡的讨论，以及现有验证手段及其计算复杂度的汇总。
Conclusion: 作者认为 OSQ 问题仍有若干值得进一步探索的开放问题，并基于现有认识给出了潜在研究方向；同时强调 OSQ 与 OSM 之间存在权衡，需要整体看待。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Logarithmic Mathematical Morphology: Theory and applications
papers.abstract_en: In Mathematical Morphology for grey-level functions, an image is analysed by another image named the structuring function. This structuring function is translated over the image domain and summed to the image. However, in an image presenting lighting variations, when the structuring function is added to this image, the amplitude of this translated structuring function should vary according to the image intensity. Such a property is not verified in Mathematical Morphology for grey level functions, when the structuring function is summed to the image with the usual additive law. This issue has been addressed by defining a framework that uses an additive law, for which the amplitude of the structuring function added to the image varies according to the amplitude of the image itself. This additive law is chosen within the Logarithmic Image Processing framework and models the lighting variations with a physical cause such as a change of light intensity. The framework is named Logarithmic Mathematical Morphology (LMM) and allows the definition of operators which are robust to such lighting variations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对数数学形态学（Logarithmic Mathematical Morphology, LMM）框架，用于灰度图像分析。其核心是在 Logarithmic Image Processing 框架内选择一种加法律，使结构函数（structuring function）叠加到图像上的幅度随图像自身幅度变化，从而对光照变化（如光强度改变）具有鲁棒性。摘要主要阐述该框架的动机与定义，未给出定量实验结果。
Motivation: 在传统灰度数学形态学中，结构函数被平移到图像域并与图像相加；但当图像存在光照变化时，该结构函数的幅度本应随图像强度变化，而通常的加法律并不满足这一性质。
Method: 通过在对数图像处理（Logarithmic Image Processing）框架中选择一种加法律，构造结构函数幅度随图像幅度变化的新形态学框架，并据此定义对光照变化鲁棒的算子。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实验数值或基准结果，仅说明该框架支持定义对光照变化鲁棒的算子。
Conclusion: 该框架被命名为对数数学形态学（LMM），其目标是处理具有物理原因（如光强度变化）的光照变化，并定义相应鲁棒算子。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Why we need an AI-resilient society
papers.abstract_en: Three generations of software have transformed the role of artificial intelligence in society. In the first, programmers wrote explicit logic. In the second, neural networks learned programs from data. In the third, large language models turn natural language itself into a programming interface. These shifts reach far beyond computer science, reshaping how societies generate knowledge, make decisions, and govern themselves. While generative adversarial networks introduced the era of deepfakes and synthetic media, large language models have added a new class of systemic risks. This report applies a forensic-psychology profiling methodology to characterize AI based on nine documented features: hallucinations, bias and toxicity, sycophancy and echo chambers, fabrication and credulity, knowledge without understanding, discontinuity and the inability to learn from experience, jagged intelligence and scaling limits, shortcuts and fractured representations, and cognitive atrophy. The resulting profile reveals an "entity" that confabulates fluently, mirrors its users' biases, possesses encyclopedic recall without causal understanding, and erodes the competence of those who depend on it. The implications extend to institutional erosion across law, academia, journalism, and democratic governance. To address these challenges, this report proposes a three-pillar framework for AI resilience: (i) cognitive sovereignty, which preserves the capacity for independent judgment, (ii) measurable control, which translates ethical commitments into enforceable standards and red lines, and (iii) partial autonomy, which maintains human agency at critical decision points. This report is an updated and extended version of arXiv:1912.08786v1.
papers.comment: Version 3. 21 pages. For associated TEDx video, see https://youtu.be/f6c2ngp7rqY
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该报告用法证心理学画像（forensic-psychology profiling）方法，基于九项文档化特征为AI系统画像，包括幻觉、偏见与毒性、谄媚与回音室效应、虚构与轻信、无理解的知识、不连续性与无法从经验学习、锯齿形智能与扩展极限、捷径与碎片化表征、认知萎缩。报告据此提出AI韧性（AI resilience）的三支柱框架：认知主权（cognitive sovereignty）、可测量控制（measurable control）和部分自主（partial autonomy），并指出AI对法律、学术界、新闻业和民主治理的制度性侵蚀风险。该版本是arXiv:1912.08786v1的更新扩展版。
Motivation: 从程序员书写显式逻辑，到神经网络从数据学习程序，再到大型语言模型把自然语言本身变成编程接口，三代软件变革使AI对社会知识生产、决策与治理的影响远超计算机科学范畴，并带来一类新的系统性风险。
Method: 采用法证心理学画像方法，依据九项文档化特征系统刻画AI行为特征，并在此基础上构建三支柱的AI韧性框架：认知主权、可测量控制、部分自主。
Result: 画像显示AI是一种能流畅虚构（confabulate）、镜像用户偏见、拥有百科全书式记忆但缺乏因果理解、并侵蚀依赖者能力的“实体”；摘要指出其影响延伸至法律、学术界、新闻业和民主治理等机构层面。
Conclusion: 为了应对这些挑战，报告提出以认知主权、可测量控制和部分自主为三支柱的AI韧性框架，强调在关键决策点保持人类能动性。

papers.title: Active Regression via Linear-Sample Sparsification
papers.abstract_en: We present an approach that improves the sample complexity for a variety of curve fitting problems, including active learning for linear regression, polynomial regression, and continuous sparse Fourier transforms. In the active linear regression problem, one would like to estimate the least squares solution $β^*$ minimizing $\|Xβ- y\|_2$ given the entire unlabeled dataset $X \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times d}$ but only observing a small number of labels $y_i$. We show that $O(d)$ labels suffice to find a constant factor approximation $\tildeβ$: \[ \mathbb{E}[\|X\tildeβ - y\|_2^2] \leq 2 \mathbb{E}[\|X β^* - y\|_2^2]. \] This improves on the best previous result of $O(d \log d)$ from leverage score sampling. We also present results for the \emph{inductive} setting, showing when $\tildeβ$ will generalize to fresh samples; these apply to continuous settings such as polynomial regression. Finally, we show how the techniques yield improved results for the non-linear sparse Fourier transform setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于线性样本稀疏化 (linear-sample sparsification) 的方法，用以改进若干曲线拟合问题的样本复杂度，包括线性回归的主动学习、多项式回归和连续稀疏傅里叶变换。在主动线性回归问题中，作者证明只需 O(d) 个标签即可得到常数因子近似解，改进了此前基于 leverage score 采样的 O(d log d) 结果，并进一步给出归纳 (inductive) 设置下的泛化结论。
Motivation: 主动线性回归中，给定全部无标签数据 X，只观察少量标签 y 时，如何用最少标签数估计最小二乘解 β* 是核心问题；此前最优的 leverage score 采样需要 O(d log d) 个标签。
Method: 提出线性样本稀疏化技术，通过更有效地选取少量样本（标签）来近似整体最小二乘问题，并配套分析归纳设置下的泛化性质；该技术还用于连续稀疏傅里叶变换等非线性问题。
Result: 摘要报告在主动线性回归中 O(d) 个标签即可满足 E[||Xβ~ - y||_2^2] ≤ 2 E[||Xβ* - y||_2^2]，优于此前 O(d log d) 的结果；同时在归纳设置和连续稀疏傅里叶变换中也有改进。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法统一改进了主动线性回归、多项式回归与稀疏傅里叶变换等多个曲线拟合问题的样本复杂度。

papers.title: AdsWorldEngine: A Self-Evolving Conversational Advertising Agent through Orchestrator and Tool Coevolution
papers.abstract_en: Conversational advertising aims to deliver useful ads within multi-turn assistant interactions. Unlike conventional query-based advertising, where the user's intent is often expressed in a short standalone query, conversational ads must infer latent commercial intent from the current user query, the assistant response, and dialogue history while also deciding whether an ad would be helpful rather than intrusive. We propose AdsWorldEngine, an agentic framework for conversational advertising. AdsWorldEngine uses an Opportunity Gate to determine whether ads should be shown, an Orchestrator to generate commercial intents, call advertising tools, and construct a top-3 ad slate, and an Evaluator to score delivered ads for offline optimization. The central contribution is an iterative actor-tool training procedure: we first train the Orchestrator with supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, then use high- and low-reward rollouts to construct preference data to train tools. This creates a self-improving loop in which the system learns not only how to use advertising tools, but also how to improve them from rewarded behavior. To support subjective production decisions, we introduce label grounded judgment modeling, which trains judgment models from human labels collected under explicit guidelines. It enriches labels with thinking traces, filters inconsistent rationales through reflection, and further optimizes binary judgments with a cost sensitive GRPO variant that preserves asymmetric reward gaps. Offline, AdsWorldEngine improves diversity by 60% and relevance by 80% over the current production ad delivery system. In an online A/B test, it increases RPM by 22% and ads coverage by 74%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdsWorldEngine，一个用于对话式广告 (conversational advertising) 的智能体框架。系统由 Opportunity Gate 判断是否展示广告、Orchestrator 生成商业意图并调用广告工具构造 top-3 广告、Evaluator 对投放广告评分用于离线优化。核心是迭代式的 actor-tool 共同进化训练：先对 Orchestrator 做监督微调和智能体强化学习，再利用高/低奖励的 rollouts 构造偏好数据训练工具，形成自我改进闭环。离线测试中多样性提升 60%、相关性提升 80%，在线 A/B 测试中 RPM 提升 22%、广告覆盖率提升 74%。
Motivation: 与常规基于短查询的广告不同，对话式广告需要从当前用户查询、助手回复和对话历史中推断潜在商业意图，并判断何时展示广告是有帮助而非侵扰，现有方法难以处理这种主观且上下文相关的决策。
Method: 提出 AdsWorldEngine 框架，包含 Opportunity Gate、Orchestrator 和 Evaluator；训练上采用先 SFT 后 agentic reinforcement learning 的 Orchestrator 训练，再以高/低奖励 rollouts 构造偏好数据训练工具，实现工具与智能体的相互进化。另提出 label grounded judgment modeling：基于明确指南下的人工标签训练判断模型，用思考轨迹丰富标签、通过反思过滤不一致理由，并用保留不对称奖励差距的成本敏感 GRPO 变体优化二元判断。
Result: 离线评测中，AdsWorldEngine 相比当前生产广告投放系统将多样性提升 60%、相关性提升 80%；在线 A/B 测试中 RPM 提升 22%、广告覆盖率提升 74%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Orchestrator 与工具的协同进化使系统不仅能学会使用广告工具，还能从奖励行为中改进工具本身；同时 label grounded judgment modeling 用于支持主观的生产投放决策。

papers.title: HI-MeshGraphNets: Efficient and Accurate Mesh-based Physics Learning with Hierarchical Multi-scale Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learned physical surrogate models have become promising alternatives to mesh-based numerical solvers. Among them, graph neural networks (GNNs) are well suited for representing simulation meshes and learning nodal state evolution through message passing. However, conventional flat message passing becomes inefficient on large, high-fidelity meshes because information propagates only one hop per layer, requiring deep processors for long-range interactions and increasing computational cost, memory usage, and the risk of over-smoothing. To address this limitation, we propose Hierarchical Interpolating MeshGraphNets (HI-MGN), a multiscale extension of MeshGraphNets for efficient long-range communication on unstructured meshes. HI-MGN replaces the flat processor with a hierarchical multiscale processor that coarsens graphs using farthest-point sampling and Voronoi partitioning while preserving the original mesh topology. Message passing on coarse graphs enables information to travel over larger geometric distances with fewer layers, and a learned graph interpolation network reconstructs fine-resolution features. Across three structural and fluid benchmarks, HI-MGN achieves improved accuracy compared with MeshGraphNets and the Bi-Stride Multi-Scale GNN while reducing training time and peak memory usage. The results show that topology-aware hierarchical message passing and learned coarse-to-fine interpolation provide an effective and practical framework for scalable mesh-based physics surrogate modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HI-MGN，一种 MeshGraphNets 的多尺度层次扩展，用于非结构化网格上的高效物理学习。该方法通过最远点采样 (farthest-point sampling) 和 Voronoi 划分对图进行粗化，同时保留原始网格拓扑，使消息传递能在较少层数内覆盖更大的几何距离，并利用学习的图插值网络重建细分辨率特征。在三个结构和流体基准上，与 MeshGraphNets 和 Bi-Stride Multi-Scale GNN 相比，HI-MGN 提升了精度，同时降低了训练时间和峰值内存。
Motivation: 平坦的消息传递在大型高保真网格上效率低下，因为每层只传播一跳，长程相互作用需要很深的处理器，导致计算成本、内存占用增加以及过平滑风险。需要一种多尺度机制来实现更高效的长程通信。
Method: 提出 HI-MGN，将平坦处理器替换为层次多尺度处理器：先用最远点采样和 Voronoi 划分构建粗化图并保持原始网格拓扑，在粗图上进行消息传递，再通过学习的图插值网络 (learned graph interpolation network) 将粗尺度特征重建为细分辨率特征。
Result: 在三个结构和流体基准上，HI-MGN 相比 MeshGraphNets 和 Bi-Stride Multi-Scale GNN 取得了更高的精度，同时减少了训练时间和峰值内存使用。摘要未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 拓扑感知的层次消息传递与学习的粗到细插值构成了一种可扩展、实用的网格物理代理建模框架。

papers.title: SPEAR: Structure Property Explainability with Attention Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning is increasingly used to learn structure property relationships from spectroscopic and diffraction data, yet its adoption in materials discovery is often limited by poor interpretability of model predictions. Although attention mechanisms are frequently treated as inherently explainable, unregularized attention can yield unstable, fragmented, or intensity driven attribution patterns that obscure the physical origin of these relationships. Here we introduce SPEAR (Structure Property Explainability with Attention Regularization), a framework that constrains attention distributions during training to improve their stability, selectivity, and physical interpretability. SPEAR augments attention based regression with a learnable temperature that controls attention concentration and a smoothness penalty that enforces coherence across neighboring spectral positions, treating attention as a learnable explanatory object rather than a post hoc visualization. Using synthetic spectral benchmarks with known generative structure, we show that attention regularization produces smooth, contiguous attribution profiles aligned with causal features while preserving predictive accuracy. Applied to experimental X ray diffraction data from a combinatorial rare earth zirconate thin film library, the regularized model selectively emphasizes physically relevant diffraction features and decouples feature importance from raw peak intensity. The reflection it identified prompted a reassessment of our earlier structural analysis, revealing a correlation between the 220 peak position, the tetragonal distortion that accommodates cation size disorder, and the local thermal conductivity. Attention regularization therefore provides a principled training constraint for explainable structure property regression, yielding mechanistically meaningful explanations without sacrificing predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPEAR（Structure Property Explainability with Attention Regularization）框架，在训练过程中约束注意力分布，以提升其稳定性、选择性和物理可解释性，用于光谱/衍射数据驱动的结构-性质回归。作者将注意力视为可学习的解释对象，通过可学习温度控制注意力集中程度、光滑性惩罚保证相邻光谱位置的连续性。在合成光谱基准和组合稀土锆酸盐薄膜的 X 射线衍射数据上，正则化模型产生平滑连续的归因分布，并识别出与四角畸变及局部热导率相关的 220 峰位特征。
Motivation: 机器学习被越来越多地用于从光谱和衍射数据学习结构-性质关系，但模型预测可解释性差限制了其在材料发现中的应用；未正则化的注意力机制常产生不稳定、碎片化或强度驱动的归因模式，掩盖物理起源。
Method: 在基于注意力的回归上引入可学习温度参数控制注意力集中程度，并加入光滑性惩罚促使相邻谱位置的注意力连续一致，把注意力当作训练中可学习的解释对象，而非事后可视化。
Result: 在具有已知生成结构的合成光谱基准上，注意力正则化产生与因果特征对齐的光滑连续归因剖面，同时保持预测精度；在实验 X 射线衍射数据上，模型选择性强调物理相关的衍射特征，并将特征重要性从原始峰强度中解耦，识别出的反射促使重新评估先前结构分析，发现 220 峰位与容纳阳离子尺寸无序的四角畸变及局部热导率相关。
Conclusion: 注意力正则化提供了一种原则性的训练约束，可在不牺牲预测性能的前提下为结构-性质回归生成具有机理意义的可解释结果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SDO: Subspace Deconflicting Operator for Multi-Adapter Composition
papers.abstract_en: Composing independently trained adapters within a shared diffusion backbone provides a modular approach to multi-character generation, but naive joint deployment often causes identity mixing, cross-character attribute leakage, and unstable scene composition. We study this interference from a parameter-space perspective and hypothesize that it arises partly from conflicts between overlapping dominant subspaces in shared layers. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{SDO}, a \textbf{S}ubspace \textbf{D}econflicting \textbf{O}perator for multi-adapter composition. SDO reconstructs layer-wise low-rank updates from the selected adapters, extracts compact subspace signatures, measures pairwise conflict through output-subspace overlap, and applies a permutation-equivariant transformation that suppresses harmful shared directions while retaining identity-specific characteristics. The resulting representations are mapped back to standard adapter updates and can be directly incorporated into existing diffusion inference pipelines. Experiments demonstrate that SDO consistently improves identity fidelity and compositional stability, with particularly clear gains as the number of jointly composed adapters increases.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SDO（Subspace Deconflicting Operator），用于共享扩散主干中多个独立训练适配器的组合。作者从参数空间角度假设干扰部分源于共享层中重叠主导子空间的冲突，并通过重构逐层低秩更新、提取子空间签名、度量输出子空间重叠并施加置换等变变换来抑制有害共享方向。实验表明 SDO 能持续提升身份保真度和组合稳定性，且随着联合适配器数量增加收益更明显。
Motivation: 在共享扩散主干中朴素地联合部署独立训练的适配器会导致身份混合、跨角色属性泄漏和场景组合不稳定，现有方法缺少对这种干扰的参数空间层面的解释与解决方案。
Method: SDO 从所选适配器中重构逐层低秩更新，提取紧凑的子空间签名，通过输出子空间重叠度量成对冲突，并施加置换等变变换（permutation-equivariant transformation）以抑制有害共享方向、保留身份特定特征；所得表示被映射回标准适配器更新，可直接集成到现有扩散推理流程中。
Result: 实验表明 SDO 一致性地改善身份保真度和组合稳定性，且联合组合的适配器数量越多，增益越明显。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SDO 提供了一种参数空间视角来缓解多适配器组合干扰，且无需改动现有扩散推理管线即可使用；论文发表于 ACM MM 2026 Main Track，范围限定在扩散模型的多适配器组合场景。

papers.title: Trajectory Dynamics in Self-Supervised Learning Latent Space for Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Human speech production is constrained by physiology, giving rise to characteristic temporal structure on acoustic signals. We hypothesise that these constraints manifest as structured trajectory dynamics in the latent space of Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) models, and that synthetic speech violates them detectably. To test this hypothesis, we train a causal Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) next-frame predictor on bonafide speech only (Stage 1), using the deepfake-specialised SSL backbone Wav2Vec2-Large-AntiDeepfake, and compare against a static global-average-pooling baseline using identical features, thus isolating the contribution of temporal modelling. A supervised Stage 2, which trains a Multi-Layer Perceptron on the frozen LSTM internal states using labelled data, is included to characterise the role of spoof supervision. Our system achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across six benchmarks: ASVspoof 2019/2021, Codecfake, In-the-Wild, MLAAD-EN, and Deepfake-Eval-2024, including best published EER on ASVspoof 2021 (0.75\%) and, notably, Stage 1 trained on bonafide speech only surpasses the published supervised baseline from the same backbone on DE2024 (30.35\%). On near-domain benchmarks, static and dynamic approaches perform comparably. On harder cross-corpus benchmarks with diverse synthesis methods, trajectory dynamics provide substantial gains, confirming that temporal physiological constraints carry detection signal beyond utterance-level statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于轨迹动力学的音频深度伪造检测方法：假设人类语音的生理约束会表现为自监督学习（SSL）模型隐空间中的结构化时间轨迹，而合成语音会违反这一结构。作者用真实语音训练因果LSTM下一步预测器（Stage 1），并与静态全局平均池化基线对比，再通过有监督的Stage 2在冻结LSTM隐状态上训练MLP以考察欺骗监督的作用。系统在ASVspoof 2019/2021、Codecfake、In-the-Wild、MLAAD-EN和Deepfake-Eval-2024六个基准上取得有竞争力或最优结果。
Motivation: 现有音频深度伪造检测方法大多利用SSL模型的特征，但常忽略语音产生过程固有的生理时间约束；作者希望验证这些约束在SSL隐空间中表现为可检测的轨迹动态，并证明时间建模能带来超越语级统计量的检测信号。
Method: 使用deepfake专用的Wav2Vec2-Large-AntiDeepfake作为SSL骨干，仅用真实语音训练因果LSTM逐帧预测器（Stage 1），以全局平均池化静态基线作为对照来隔离时间建模的贡献；Stage 2用有标签数据在冻结的LSTM内部状态上训练MLP。
Result: 系统在六个基准上达到有竞争力或最优性能，其中ASVspoof 2021取得最佳已发表EER（0.75%）；仅用真实语音训练的Stage 1在Deepfake-Eval-2024上超过同一骨干的已发表有监督基线（30.35%）。在近域基准上静态与动态方法性能相当，而在跨语料、多样合成方式的更难基准上轨迹动态带来显著提升。
Conclusion: 摘要认为时间上的生理约束携带了超越句子级统计量的检测信息，轨迹动态建模在跨域和多样化合成场景下尤其有效；但近域场景中静态方法已足够，说明动态建模的价值主要体现在跨语料泛化上。

papers.title: What preferences can - and cannot - predict in multi-agent online learning
papers.abstract_en: We examine the interplay between ordinal, preference-based solution concepts in games and the long-run behavior of game dynamics, asking in particular to what extent the combinatorial data of a game -- its preference graph -- determine the outcomes of no-regret learning dynamics -- such as follow-the-regularized-leader (FTRL). In one direction, we show that the skeleton of every dynamically stable set (i.e. the set of pure profiles it contains) must also be preferentially stable, that is, it must be closed under profitable deviations. We then ask the converse question: when do preferences determine the long-run behavior of the players' learning dynamics? We begin by showing that preferences characterize asymptotic stability in the case of subgames -- i.e. subsets of pure profiles obtained by restricting players' action sets. Beyond this case however, the equivalence between dynamic and preferential stability collapses: concretely, we construct a three-player game with a preferentially stable set whose span is dynamically unstable, showing in this way that preferences do not suffice as a criterion of dynamic stability. We then bridge this gap via the notion of resilience under aggregate deviations, an easy-to-check payoff-based condition that guarantees asymptotic stability of arbitrary spans of pure strategies.
papers.comment: 56 pages, 15 figures; oral presentation at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究博弈中基于序数偏好的解概念与无遗憾学习动力学（如 follow-the-regularized-leader, FTRL）长期行为之间的关系，考察博弈的偏好图能在多大程度上决定学习动力学的收敛结果。作者证明每个动态稳定集合的骨架（所含纯轮廓集）必须偏好稳定，并构造三玩家博弈反例表明一般情形下偏好稳定性与动态稳定性不等价，最后引入聚合偏离下的韧性条件来弥合这一差距。
Motivation: 现有博弈论结果很少系统回答序数偏好数据（偏好图）是否足以预测玩家学习动力学的长期行为；该问题对理解无遗憾学习在博弈中的均衡选择具有重要意义。
Method: 形式化定义偏好稳定性（preferential stability）与动态稳定性，并证明动态稳定集合蕴含偏好稳定；随后构造反例说明逆命题不成立，并提出一个基于聚合偏离（aggregate deviations）韧性的、易于检验的收益支付条件，用以保证任意纯策略跨度的渐近稳定性。
Result: 在子博弈（通过限制玩家动作集得到的纯轮廓子集）情形下，偏好可以刻画渐近稳定性；但一般情形下二者不等价，文中给出一个三玩家博弈，其中存在偏好稳定集合其跨度在动力学下不稳定；新的韧性条件则可保证这类跨度的渐近稳定性。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为，仅凭偏好数据不足以作为一般博弈中动态稳定性的充分判据，需要借助聚合偏离韧性这一额外条件；该条件被强调为容易从收益支付中检验。

papers.title: Optimal Power Allocation and AI Receiver Design for Superimposed DMRS and Data Transmission
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider transmissions with superimposed (SI) demodulation-reference-symbol (DMRS) and data in orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) based multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. First, we derive an analytical framework to characterize the iterative behavior between the mean-square errors (MSEs) of channel estimation (CE) and MIMO detection (MD) within an iterative CE and detection (ICED) process. This framework is subsequently utilized to optimize power allocation and pilot patterns between the DMRS and data symbols for SI-DMRS transmission. Second, we design an artificial intelligence (AI) based receiver built upon Transformer encoders for SI-DMRS transmissions, which incorporates an iterative CE and detection (ICED) structure. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed AI-ICED receiver, combined with SI-DMRS, effectively increases spectral efficiency (SE) compared to conventional systems using non-overlapped DMRS and data symbols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 OFDM 多天线 (MIMO) 系统中叠加解调参考符号 (SI-DMRS) 与数据共同传输的问题。作者先建立解析框架刻画迭代信道估计 (CE) 与 MIMO 检测 (MD) 之间均方误差 (MSE) 的迭代行为，并据此优化 DMRS 与数据之间的功率分配和导频图案；随后设计基于 Transformer 编码器的 AI 接收机，内嵌迭代 CE 与检测 (ICED) 结构。仿真显示 AI-ICED 接收机结合 SI-DMRS 相比传统非重叠 DMRS/数据方案能提高频谱效率 (SE)。
Motivation: 现有非重叠 DMRS 与数据传输会占用额外时频资源，降低频谱效率；需要在叠加传输下优化功率分配和导频图案，并设计能应对迭代 CE 与检测耦合的接收机。
Method: 推导一个分析框架，用于刻画 ICED 过程中 CE 与 MD 的 MSE 迭代行为，并基于该框架优化 DMRS 与数据间的功率分配及导频图案；同时设计基于 Transformer 编码器、集成 ICED 结构的 AI 接收机。
Result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的 AI-ICED 接收机结合 SI-DMRS 能相比传统非重叠 DMRS/数据的系统有效提升频谱效率 (SE)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调叠加 DMRS 与 AI 接收机结合可在保持信道估计与检测性能的同时提升频谱效率；但具体增益数值、鲁棒性等细节未在摘要中给出。

papers.title: Label-Free Deep-Tissue Peripheral Nerve Detection with a Handheld Multimodal OCT Probe and NerveDetNet
papers.abstract_en: Peripheral nerves buried beneath intact tissue are difficult to visualize during surgery and remain inaccessible to white light wide-field imaging and other surface optical imaging methods. Existing OCT nerve studies have largely relied on exposed nerves or polarization contrast with limited depth penetration, restricting their value for subsurface intraoperative guidance. Here, we introduce, to our knowledge, the first label-free framework for detecting peripheral nerves beneath unopened tissue and resolving their depth using intensity-based OCT structural signatures alone. The framework combines a handheld multimodal probe, integrating swept-source OCT with co-registered white light and autofluorescence imaging, with a ``confirm-then-capture'' workflow designed for practical surgical use. To enable efficient analysis of sparsely sampled OCT volumes, we develop NerveDetNet, a lightweight 2.5D segmentation network that recovers weak and spatially displaced nerve signals by incorporating spatial context, frame-order information, and shift-tolerant correlations across frames through a dedicated nerve feature correlation module. In ex vivo tissue experiments, NerveDetNet consistently outperformed six representative 2D baselines across all frame spacings, achieving a Dice score of 0.725 under the sparsest sampling condition while using approximately half the model parameters. End-to-end validation demonstrated localization of nerves invisible at the surface and depth-resolved detection up to 1.3--1.4~mm below the tissue surface, with OCT derived depth maps overlaid directly onto the surgical view. Together, these results establish a practical label-free approach for subsurface nerve visualization that supports intraoperative compatibility, enables efficient sparse-volume analysis, and provides depth-resolved guidance without tissue opening, contrast agents, or nerve exposure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个 label-free 框架，用于在未切开组织下检测外周神经并解析其深度，结合手持多模态 OCT 探头（扫频源 OCT 与白光、自发荧光共配准）和 NerveDetNet 轻量 2.5D 分割网络。NerveDetNet 通过空间上下文、帧序信息和跨帧平移容忍相关模块恢复弱且空间偏移的神经信号。离体实验中，NerveDetNet 在所有帧间距下优于六个 2D 基线，最稀疏采样下 Dice 0.725 且参数约减半；端到端验证实现皮下 1.3–1.4 mm 的深度分辨检测。
Motivation: 外周神经埋在完整组织下，手术中难以可视化，白光宽场成像等表面光学方法无法观察；现有 OCT 神经研究多依赖暴露神经或偏振对比，深度穿透有限，难以用于皮下术中导航。
Method: 提出结合手持多模态探头与 confirm-then-capture 工作流的框架，仅依靠基于强度的 OCT 结构特征检测未切开组织下的神经；开发 NerveDetNet 轻量 2.5D 分割网络，通过专用神经特征相关模块整合空间上下文、帧序信息和跨帧相关以恢复弱神经信号。
Result: 离体组织实验中，NerveDetNet 在所有帧间距下均优于六个代表性 2D 基线，最稀疏采样条件下 Dice 达 0.725，且模型参数约为一半；端到端验证可定位表面不可见的神经，深度分辨检测达皮下 1.3–1.4 mm，并将 OCT 深度图直接叠加到手术视野。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需切开组织、造影剂或暴露神经，即可提供深度分辨的皮下神经可视化，支持术中兼容性并实现高效的稀疏体积分析。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出首个 label-free 框架，用于在未切开组织下检测外周神经并解析其深度，结合手持多模态 OCT 探头（扫频源 OCT 与白光、自发荧光共配准）和 NerveDetNet 轻量 2.5D 分割网络。NerveDetNet 通过空间上下文、帧序信息和跨帧平移容忍相关模块恢复弱且空间偏移的神经信号。离体实验中，NerveDetNet 在所有帧间距下优于六个 2D 基线，最稀疏采样下 Dice 0.725 且参数约减半；端到端验证实现皮下 1.3–1.4 mm 的深度分辨检测。
summary_sections.motivation: 外周神经埋在完整组织下，手术中难以可视化，白光宽场成像等表面光学方法无法观察；现有 OCT 神经研究多依赖暴露神经或偏振对比，深度穿透有限，难以用于皮下术中导航。
summary_sections.method: 提出结合手持多模态探头与 confirm-then-capture 工作流的框架，仅依靠基于强度的 OCT 结构特征检测未切开组织下的神经；开发 NerveDetNet 轻量 2.5D 分割网络，通过专用神经特征相关模块整合空间上下文、帧序信息和跨帧相关以恢复弱神经信号。

papers.title: Stochastic Control Policies for Robust Molecular Transition Path Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Transition path sampling (TPS) aims to efficiently generate rare molecular transition trajectories between metastable states and is essential for understanding biomolecular mechanisms. Beyond traditional molecular dynamics (MD)-based sampling, machine learning has become central to state-of-the-art TPS. One major class of methods learns control forces during explicit MD rollouts. By preserving the underlying molecular dynamics, these methods tend to produce more physically plausible trajectories than endpoint-conditioned generators that construct paths directly. However, rollout-based control methods have been reported to exhibit unstable and strongly seed-dependent performance. We recast rollout-based control as learning a path-space proposal distribution and investigate stochasticity placement as a design choice for improving exploration and optimization robustness. We develop two stochastic policies: FS-TPS, which directly parameterizes a state-dependent Gaussian distribution over the control policy output, and LaS-TPS, which samples a compact latent control variable and decodes it into structured, cross-atom-correlated force variation. We conduct extensive multi-seed experiments on three biomolecular systems of increasing size: alanine dipeptide, chignolin, and BBL, a fast-folding protein. Stochastic policies consistently improve transition success and path quality over deterministic-policy baselines while substantially reducing sensitivity to random initialization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分子过渡路径采样 (transition path sampling, TPS) 中 rollout-based control 类方法，将其重新表述为学习路径空间上的提议分布 (proposal distribution)，并提出两种随机策略 FS-TPS 和 LaS-TPS 来改善探索与优化鲁棒性。摘要报告在丙氨酸二肽、chignolin 和 BBL 三个生物分子系统上的多随机种子实验中，随机策略一致提高过渡成功率和路径质量，并显著降低对随机初始化的敏感性。
Motivation: rollout-based control 方法通过保留底层分子动力学来生成物理上更合理的轨迹，但已有报道称其训练不稳定且性能强烈依赖随机种子。作者希望把随机性放置 (stochasticity placement) 作为设计选择，以提升路径空间上的探索效率和优化稳定性。
Method: 将 rollout-based control 重新解释为学习路径空间上的提议分布；提出 FS-TPS，直接对控制策略输出的状态相关高斯分布进行参数化；以及 LaS-TPS，采样一个紧凑的隐控制变量并解码为跨原子相关的结构化力扰动。
Result: 在尺寸递增的 alanine dipeptide、chignolin 和 BBL 三个生物分子系统上开展多随机种子实验，随机策略相比确定性策略基线一致提升过渡成功率与路径质量，并显著降低对随机初始化的敏感性。
Conclusion: 作者认为在控制策略中引入随机性是提升 rollout-based TPS 鲁棒性与探索能力的有效设计选择；摘要未额外声明明显局限。

papers.title: Dynamic Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing with Online Requests: Event-Driven Transformer--DRL and Rolling-Horizon Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an event-driven learning and benchmarking framework for the Dynamic Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing Problem with progressively revealed requests and evolving vehicle states. Masked MLP and Transformer policies are trained through behavior cloning and proximal policy optimization. Deterministic feasibility masking prevents invalid vehicle--request assignments, while fixed-prefix/flexible-suffix route commitments protect completed, active, and near-term decisions and separately measure vehicle reassignment and resequencing. The learned policies are compared with dynamic insertion heuristics and time-limited rolling-horizon optimization. In a 20-scenario policy benchmark, all methods completed every request without invalid actions, but nearest feasible achieved the lowest mean objective and outperformed the learned policies in routing quality, waiting time, stability, makespan, and runtime. Across five independent training runs, PPO had little average effect on the MLP and improved the Transformer on average, although with greater seed variability. Under the common protocol, nearest feasible achieved the lowest combined objective and route disruption, whereas rolling horizon achieved the lowest waiting times and makespan at substantially higher computational cost. The learned policies retained millisecond-level decisions and transferred to instances with up to 80 requests without retraining, but did not outperform the strongest heuristic. No single method was best across routing efficiency, service responsiveness, stability, and online computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向动态多车场车辆路径问题（Dynamic Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing Problem）的事件驱动学习与基准测试框架，其中请求逐步揭晓、车辆状态持续演变。作者用行为克隆（behavior cloning）和近端策略优化（PPO）训练带掩码的 MLP 与 Transformer 策略，并与动态插入启发式和限时滚动时域优化（rolling-horizon optimization）比较。在 20 个场景的策略基准中，nearest feasible 启发式取得最低平均目标值，且在学习策略之上表现更优；滚动时域在等待时间和 makespan 上最好但计算成本高得多，没有任何单一方法在所有指标上全面最佳。
Motivation: 动态多车场车辆路径问题中在线请求和车辆状态不断变化，现有方法在实时决策质量、稳定性与计算开销之间难以兼顾，缺乏统一的事件驱动学习与基准评估框架来公平比较学习策略、启发式和优化方法。
Method: 构建事件驱动学习框架，采用掩码 MLP 和 Transformer 策略，通过行为克隆与 PPO 联合训练；确定性可行性掩码阻止无效的车辆-请求指派，固定前缀/灵活后缀的路线承诺机制保护已完成、进行中和近期决策，并分别度量车辆重指派和重新排序。作为对照，比较动态插入启发式和限时滚动时域优化。
Result: 在 20 场景策略基准中所有方法都完成请求且无无效动作，但 nearest feasible 启发式的平均目标值最低，并在路由质量、等待时间、稳定性、makespan 和运行时间上优于学习策略；五次独立训练中 PPO 对 MLP 平均影响很小，对 Transformer 平均有改进但种子间方差更大。滚动时域在共同协议下达到最低等待时间和 makespan，但计算成本显著更高；学习策略保持毫秒级决策，可零重训练迁移到最多 80 个请求的实例，却未超越最强启发式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调没有单一方法能在路由效率、服务响应性、稳定性和在线计算开销上同时最优，说明该问题需要针对具体指标进行方法权衡。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Recent Advances in Deep Learning-Based Drug-Target Binding Affinity Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Computational approaches to drug discovery involve multiple sub-problems, and among them, drug-target binding affinity prediction plays an important role. Despite recent advances, accurately predicting binding affinity remains an open research area. The major objective of our paper is to perform a comprehensive review and comparative analysis of recent machine learning methods for drug-target binding affinity prediction, with a focus on identifying strengths, limitations, and research gaps. We review representative recent deep learning approaches that use common benchmark datasets and evaluation metrics, covering a range of neural network architectures and representation strategies. In addition, we analyze seven widely used benchmark datasets and commonly adopted evaluation metrics for drug-target binding affinity prediction. Our analysis indicates that although many methods report strong performance on standard benchmarks, their effectiveness is often influenced by dataset bias and limited evaluation settings. Furthermore, most methods exhibit reduced performance in cold-start scenarios, highlighting challenges in generalization. We identify several limitations of current approaches, including dataset imbalance, the lack of standardized evaluation, limited real-world applicability, and challenges in cold-start scenarios. We also discuss future research directions, including better dataset design, more robust evaluation methods, improved handling of cold-start problems, and the integration of multimodal representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于基于深度学习的药物-靶点结合亲和力（drug-target binding affinity）预测方法的综述与比较分析。作者回顾了使用常见基准数据集和评估指标的多种深度学习方法，覆盖不同的神经网络架构与表示策略，并系统分析了七个常用基准数据集及评估指标。分析指出，尽管许多方法在标准基准上报告了较强性能，其有效性常受数据集偏差和有限评估设置影响，且在冷启动（cold-start）场景下表现明显下降。
Motivation: 准确预测药物-靶点结合亲和力仍是开放研究问题，且现有方法在标准基准上的表现并不能充分反映真实泛化能力，因此需要系统梳理当前方法的优缺点、数据集与评估中的问题，以明确研究空白。
Method: 作为综述性论文，作者回顾了近期使用常见基准数据集和评估指标的深度学习药物-靶点结合亲和力预测方法，涵盖多种神经网络架构和表示策略，并分析了七个广泛使用的基准数据集及常用评估指标（evaluation metrics）。
Result: 分析表明，许多方法在标准基准上报告了强性能，但其有效性往往受数据集偏差和有限的评估设置影响；同时，大多数方法在冷启动场景下性能下降，暴露出泛化困难。
Conclusion: 论文总结当前方法的主要局限包括数据集不平衡、缺乏标准化评估、真实世界适用性有限以及冷启动问题，并提出未来研究方向：更好的数据集设计、更稳健的评估方法、改进冷启动处理以及整合多模态表示（multimodal representations）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Brittleness of Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Gaussian Process Hyperparameter Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) has become an indispensable part of modern engineering design workflows. A crucial step in training an ML model is the selection of the loss function which can be systematically formulated via various techniques such as maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) and cross-validation . While MLE is one of the most popular, effective, and intuitive mechanisms for training ML models, it is brittle: if the assumptions underpinning it are not met, the trained ML model may generalize poorly. This brittleness affects even Gaussian processes (GPs) which are widely used in engineering design and are often (incorrectly) presumed to be very robust to overfitting. In this paper, we fundamentally evaluate the brittleness of MLE in the context of training GPs for probabilistic regression or classification tasks. We compare theoretically grounded metrics against MLE and propose practical solutions. Our extensive studies demonstrate the effectiveness of our solutions in downstream design tasks such as Bayesian optimization and provide a blueprint for practitioners to build accurate and robust GPs that can even outperform tabular foundation models in terms of prediction accuracy, uncertainty quantification, and inference cost. Our contributions are publicly available via GitHub at https://github.com/Bostanabad-Research-Group/GP-vs-TabPFN-vs-GPyTorch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了最大似然估计 (MLE) 在高斯过程 (GP) 超参数优化中的脆弱性，指出当 MLE 假设不满足时 GP 模型可能泛化不佳。作者对比理论驱动的度量与 MLE，并提出实用解决方案，在贝叶斯优化等下游设计任务中验证了有效性，称其方法构建的 GP 在预测精度、不确定性量化和推理成本上甚至可超越表格基础模型。代码已公开。
Motivation: MLE 是训练 ML 模型最常用且直观的机制，但在假设不满足时可能产生泛化差的模型；即便通常被认为对过拟合稳健的 GP 也受此影响，这给工程设计中 GP 的可靠使用带来隐患。
Method: 从概率回归或分类任务出发，从基础层面评估 MLE 训练 GP 的脆弱性，对比基于理论的度量与 MLE，并提出可操作的实用解决方案来提升 GP 的鲁棒性。
Result: 大量研究表明所提方案在贝叶斯优化等下游设计任务中有效，所训练的 GP 在预测精度、不确定性量化和推理成本方面能够甚至超过表格基础模型。
Conclusion: 作者为实践者提供构建准确且稳健 GP 的蓝图，并公开了 GitHub 代码仓库以复现和扩展。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: VLM- and LLM-Driven Multi-Agent System for PET Image Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Positron emission tomography (PET) imaging suffers from limited spatial resolution and low signal-to-noise ratio, which can compromise quantitative accuracy and lesion detectability. Deep learning-based denoising methods have demonstrated strong potential for improving PET image quality. However, their practical deployment in real-world settings remains challenging, often requiring multiple specialized models and expert interventions, such as identifying motion-induced misregistration artifacts, estimating noise levels to select an appropriate denoiser, and performing lesion-focused quantitative assessment after denoising. Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) for image quality understanding and large language models (LLMs) for contextual reasoning provide new opportunities for automated, decision-driven workflows. Inspired by expert workflows for PET image quality enhancement, we propose an VLM- and LLM-driven multi-agent PET denoising framework that dynamically assesses image quality and lesion status, autonomously selects optimal denoising models and parameters, and enables closed-loop feedback with rollback mechanisms. Experiments were conducted on Siemens Biograph Vision Quadra PET/CT data with 1/20 and 1/50 low-dose settings. Individual module evaluations demonstrated the reliability of the agentic components, while the complete framework achieved higher PSNR and SSIM than UNet, GAN, and DDPM baselines at both dose levels. These preliminary results demonstrate the feasibility of using a closed-loop multi-agent framework to adapt PET denoising strategies to different image conditions.

papers.title: PPAPlace: Differentiable Cross-Stage Objectives for Chip Placement Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Macro placement significantly affects a chip's post-route performance, power, and area (PPA). Most placement methods optimize half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL) as the primary objective. However, recent benchmarking shows a near-zero correlation between HPWL and post-route timing metrics such as the worst negative slack (WNS) and total negative slack (TNS). As a result, all six evaluated artificial intelligence (AI) placers degraded PPA relative to the hierarchical baseline. Recent efforts have tried to train cross-stage predictors to close this gap. However, existing methods focus on macro-only representations and use pre-route metrics as training labels. A label fidelity study of ten circuits at four design flow stages reveals that HPWL and pre-route timing poorly reflect final post-route timing rankings. In contrast, post-global-routing achieves the best balance between final timing fidelity and label generation cost-effectiveness. Based on this finding, PPAPlace is a timing-driven differentiable surrogate predicting post-route PPA from macro and standard-cell placements. The surrogate is a dual-stream predictor that combines graph attention over the chip netlist with spatial convolution over the placement grid. It is trained on post-global-routing labels. The predicted WNS and TNS gradients flow end-to-end back to cell coordinates. PPAPlace exploits these gradients in two ways: as a co-objective injected into an analytical placer's optimization loop (PPAPlace-CoOpt), and as a post-placement refinement step that adjusts macro positions via projected gradient descent (PPAPlace-Refine). On five ChiPBench test circuits excluded from training, PPAPlace improves average WNS and TNS by 22\% and 51\% over the hierarchical baseline while preserving power and routability, using the same predictor without test-circuit retraining. Code is available at https://github.com/ValleyC/PPAPlace.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables, accepted at ICCAD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PPAPlace，一种面向芯片宏布局优化的可微时序驱动替代模型。摘要指出 HPWL 与后布线时序指标（如 WNS、TNS）相关性接近零，现有六个 AI 布局器在 PPA 上均劣于分层基线。PPAPlace 使用结合图注意力与空间卷积的双流预测器，从宏单元和标准单元位置预测后布线 PPA，并用后全局布线标签训练；预测出的 WNS 和 TNS 梯度端到端传回单元坐标。在排除于训练之外的五个 ChiPBench 测试电路上，该方法相比分层基线平均改善 WNS 22%、TNS 51%，同时保持功耗和可布线性，无需测试电路重训练。
Motivation: 现有布局方法以 HPWL 为主要目标，但 HPWL 与后布线时序指标几乎零相关，导致 AI 布局器实际 PPA 退化。已有的跨阶段预测器只使用宏级表示和布线前指标作为标签，无法准确反映最终布线后的时序排名。
Method: PPAPlace 是一个时序驱动的可微替代模型，采用双流预测器，结合芯片网表上的图注意力（graph attention）与布局网格上的空间卷积（spatial convolution）。训练标签来自后全局布线（post-global-routing）阶段，因为该阶段在最终时序保真度和标签生成成本之间达到最佳平衡。预测的 WNS 和 TNS 梯度端到端流向单元坐标，并用于两种模式：作为共目标注入解析布局器优化循环（PPAPlace-CoOpt），以及作为布局后精化步骤，用投影梯度下降调整宏单元位置（PPAPlace-Refine）。
Result: 在五个排除于训练之外的 ChiPBench 测试电路上，PPAPlace 相比分层基线平均改善 WNS 22%、TNS 51%，同时保持功耗和可布线性；且使用同一预测器，无需对测试电路重新训练。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，使用后全局布线标签训练可微的跨阶段预测器，并在布局优化和精化中利用其时序梯度，可以有效弥合布局与最终 PPA 之间的差距，在保持功耗和可布线性的前提下显著改善时序，且对未见测试电路具有良好的泛化性。

papers.title: From Passive Delegates to Strategic Negotiators: Reinforcing Social Reasoning in Small Language Models with SocialRL
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly act on their users' behalf, handling tasks such as scheduling meetings, comparing offers, and haggling over prices. These principal-driven tasks routinely place the agent across from a counterpart (another user's agent, a seller, a recruiter) whose goals may conflict with its principal's. Yet the dispositions that make an assistant pleasant can make it a poor delegate: a friendly, helpful frontier model may disclose its principal's private information unprompted and concede at the first sign of resistance. We present SocialRL, a general recipe that trains social reasoning directly, and apply it to a 4B model across six domains: Deal-or-No-Deal, CaSiNo, Craigslist, Job Interview, Calendar, and Marketplace. Every domain is trained in-domain under the same recipe, and every policy is evaluated on all six. We find that (1) in-domain training reaches the frontier: on held-out scenarios the 4B matches or exceeds the GPT-5 family per domain, closing 73-122% of the baseline-to-frontier gap on the negotiation games, with 78% of buyer openings anchoring below target versus 3% untrained; (2) cross-domain transfer follows game structure: structurally paired games lift each other, a broad multi-issue donor lifts nearly all domains, and structurally isolated games transfer nothing; (3) guided by this transfer structure, two strategies, cascade RL and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD), consolidate the per-domain specialists into a single unified 4B that reaches 0.627 average utility across all six environments, matching or exceeding GPT-4.1 (0.625), GPT-5.1 (0.619), and GPT-5.2 (0.613); (4) an explicit theory-of-mind scaffold helps only through training: distilling the ToM trace, rather than actions alone, lifts utility on every environment and generalizes better across them, and of the two ToM skills, only next-action prediction predicts negotiation outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SocialRL，一种直接训练社交推理能力的通用方法，并将其应用于 4B 小模型，覆盖 Deal-or-No-Deal、CaSiNo、Craigslist、Job Interview、Calendar、Marketplace 六个领域。摘要报告称，域内训练可使 4B 模型在各自领域达到或超越 GPT-5 家族水平，并利用显式心智理论 (theory-of-mind) 轨迹蒸馏和级联 RL、多教师 on-policy distillation (OPD) 等策略将领域专家整合为单一 4B 模型。
Motivation: AI 代理越来越多地代表用户执行定价谈判、比较报价等主理驱动任务，但友好顺从的助手倾向（如主动泄露主理人私有信息、遇到抵抗就妥协）使它成为糟糕的谈判代表。现有模型缺乏直接训练的社交推理能力，作者希望针对这一问题给出可复现的通用训练方案。
Method: 提出 SocialRL 通用方案：在六个领域分别做域内 (in-domain) 训练，并用同一配方评估所有策略在所有六个环境上的表现。进一步结合显式心智理论 (theory-of-mind) 脚手架（蒸馏 ToM 轨迹而非仅动作），以及级联 RL (cascade RL) 和多教师 on-policy distillation (OPD) 来把各领域专家合并成一个统一的 4B 模型。
Result: 域内训练达到前沿水平：4B 在各自领域的保留场景上匹配或超越 GPT-5 家族，在谈判游戏中缩小了基线到前沿差距的 73-122%，78% 的买家开场报价锚定在目标以下（未训练时为 3%）。跨域迁移遵循博弈结构：结构配对的游戏互相提升，多议题的宽泛供体域能提升几乎所有领域，结构隔离的领域则无迁移。统一后的 4B 在六个环境上达到 0.627 平均效用，匹配或超过 GPT-4.1 (0.625)、GPT-5.1 (0.619) 和 GPT-5.2 (0.613)；ToM 轨迹蒸馏在所有环境上提升效用并改善跨域泛化，且两种 ToM 技能中只有 next-action prediction 能预测谈判结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过 SocialRL 直接训练社交推理并利用 ToM 轨迹蒸馏，小模型也能从被动顺从的委托者转变为战略性谈判者；跨域迁移的结构性规律为设计统一多域训练策略提供了依据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Do AI chatbots find what experts would? Effects of model, user role, and sample size on study retrieval for medical questions
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) chatbots are increasingly used to answer clinical questions with citations to relevant clinical studies. Prior research has largely focused on citation fabrication, leaving a gap in evaluating the quality of retrieved studies and the factors driving their selection. In this study, we evaluated three general-purpose LLM chatbots: Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and ChatGPT GPT-5.5. We prompted the models with clinical questions adapted from 20 review questions in Issues 6 and 7 of the 2026 Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, simulating patient, clinician, and evidence-synthesis researcher roles. Each chatbot was queried under each user role with four independent repetitions, yielding 720 responses. Each chatbot was asked to support its answers with primary clinical citations, which we benchmarked against the included and excluded study sets of the Cochrane reviews. On average, a chatbot response retrieved 39.2% $\pm$ 29.8% of Cochrane included studies, while citing 5.0% $\pm$ 9.4% of excluded studies. Recall of Cochrane included studies varied significantly by model and user role. ChatGPT achieved higher recall than Claude or Gemini (63.1% $\pm$ 29.5% vs. 37.0% $\pm$ 23.8% vs. 17.3% $\pm$ 13.1%; $p=2.0\times10^{-5}$). The researcher role yielded higher recall than the clinician or patient roles (42.8% $\pm$ 30.8% vs. 38.6% $\pm$ 28.9% vs. 36.1% $\pm$ 29.3%; $p=2.0\times10^{-5}$). Controlling for publication year, citations per year, and open-access status, sample size was the only independently significant predictor of retrieval (odds ratio 1.80 per 1-unit increase in log sample size, 95% CI 1.37-2.36, $p=2.34\times10^{-5}$). These findings suggest that while LLM chatbots can retrieve some studies identified by expert reviewers, their performance varies by model and user role, and they exhibit a bias toward clinical trials with larger sample sizes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估三个通用大语言模型聊天机器人（Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、ChatGPT GPT-5.5）在回答临床问题时检索相关临床研究的能力。作者根据 2026 年 Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews 第 6、7 期中 20 个综述问题构造提示，模拟患者、临床医生和证据综合研究者三种用户角色，每个模型每种角色重复查询 4 次，共获 720 条回复，并以 Cochrane 综述纳入/排除的研究集合为基准。结果显示，聊天机器人平均召回 39.2% 的纳入研究，仅引用 5.0% 的排除研究；模型和用户角色显著影响召回率，且对样本量更大的临床试验存在检索偏好。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注大语言模型聊天机器人在临床问答中的引用编造问题，而缺少对检索到的研究质量以及哪些因素驱动研究选择的系统评估。
Method: 使用三个通用 LLM 聊天机器人，对来自 20 个 Cochrane 综述的临床问题进行提问，模拟患者、临床医生和证据合成研究者三种角色，每角色独立重复 4 次；将回复中的引文与 Cochrane 综述的纳入和排除研究集合对比，并控制发表年份、年均引用量和开放获取状态后分析检索的预测因素。
Result: 平均每条回复召回 39.2%±29.8% 的 Cochrane 纳入研究，引用 5.0%±9.4% 的排除研究；ChatGPT 的召回率显著高于 Claude 和 Gemini（63.1%±29.5% vs 37.0%±23.8% vs 17.3%±13.1%，p=2.0×10⁻⁵），研究者角色显著高于临床医生和患者角色（42.8% vs 38.6% vs 36.1%）。样本量是唯一独立的显著预测因子（每增加 1 个 log 样本量单位，比值比 1.80，95% CI 1.37–2.36）。
Conclusion: LLM 聊天机器人能够检索到部分专家评审者认定的临床研究，但表现因模型和用户角色而异，并表现出偏向较大样本量临床试验的偏差。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文评估三个通用大语言模型聊天机器人（Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、ChatGPT GPT-5.5）在回答临床问题时检索相关临床研究的能力。作者根据 2026 年 Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews 第 6、7 期中 20 个综述问题构造提示，模拟患者、临床医生和证据综合研究者三种用户角色，每个模型每种角色重复查询 4 次，共获 720 条回复，并以 Cochrane 综述纳入/排除的研究集合为基准。结果显示，聊天机器人平均召回 39.2% 的纳入研究，仅引用 5.0% 的排除研究；模型和用户角色显著影响召回率，且对样本量更大的临床试验存在检索偏好。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有研究主要关注大语言模型聊天机器人在临床问答中的引用编造问题，而缺少对检索到的研究质量以及哪些因素驱动研究选择的系统评估。

papers.title: Doomed to Re-Annotate, Forever: The ImageNet Story
papers.abstract_en: Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1k remains the most commonly reported metric in visual recognition. Quality issues with the dataset have been repeatedly reported, yet the original 2012 noisy labels are still predominantly used. The paper presents a comprehensive effort, which goes well beyond prior correction attempts, towards obtaining accurate and complete ImageNet-1k validation set annotations. The result, ReImageNet, includes multilabel correction, object localization, revised class definitions, and semantic attributes (text-recognition, rendition, reflection, crowd, dominant). The reannotation reveals that approximately 12% of the original ImageNet-1k labels are incorrect, 33.3% of images are multilabel and 3.8% contain no object from an ImageNet-1k class. With the new labels, top-1 accuracy increases by up to 1.2% for supervised models and by 5-6% for MLLMs. We argue that annotation at ImageNet scale cannot realistically be completed in one pass, as errors and definitional issues are discovered only through annotating, and we build our pipeline around repeated refinement and error checking. We observed that human and LLM collaboration with appropriate tooling represents the current quality ceiling for annotation at this scale. ImageNet-1k issues propagate into its derivative test sets, indicating that the problem is structural rather than specific to any single benchmark. All annotations, class definitions, guidelines, and analysis code have been publicly released. Project page: https://vrg.fel.cvut.cz/reimagenet Annotations: https://huggingface.co/datasets/vrg-prague/ReImageNet Code: https://github.com/klarajanouskova/ImageNet
papers.comment: 25 pages, 16 figures, 8 tables. Project page: https://vrg.fel.cvut.cz/reimagenet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReImageNet，对 ImageNet-1k 验证集进行了远超以往纠正尝试的全面重新标注，包含多标签纠正、目标定位、修订后的类别定义以及语义属性（text-recognition、rendition、reflection、crowd、dominant）。重新标注发现约 12% 的原始标签不正确，33.3% 的图像为多标签，3.8% 的图像不包含任何 ImageNet-1k 类别目标。使用新标签后，监督模型 top-1 准确率最多提升 1.2%，MLLM 提升 5-6%。作者主张 ImageNet 规模的标注无法一次完成，并围绕反复精化与错误检查构建流程。
Motivation: ImageNet-1k top-1 准确率仍是视觉识别中最常报告的指标，且原始 2012 年噪声标签仍被广泛使用，尽管数据质量问题已被多次报道。目标是获得准确且完整的 ImageNet-1k 验证集标注。
Method: 构建了一个包含反复精化与错误检查的重标注流程，标注内容包括多标签纠正、目标定位、修订类别定义和语义属性。作者观察到，在适当工具支持下的人类与 LLM 协作代表了当前该规模标注的质量上限。
Result: 重新标注显示约 12% 的原始 ImageNet-1k 标签不正确，33.3% 的图像含有多标签，3.8% 的图像不含任何 ImageNet-1k 类别目标；新标签使监督模型 top-1 准确率最多提升 1.2%，MLLM 提升 5-6%。
Conclusion: ImageNet 规模的标注实际上不可能一次性完成，因为错误和定义性问题只有在标注过程中才会被发现；ImageNet-1k 的问题会传播到衍生测试集，说明问题具有结构性。所有标注、类别定义、指南和分析代码均已公开。

papers.title: FLARE MCMC: Fidelity-based Layer-Adaptive REcursive proposals for MCMC
papers.abstract_en: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) requires only the ability to evaluate the likelihood, making it a common technique for inference in complex models. However, it can have a slow mixing rate, requiring the generation of many samples to obtain good estimates and an overall high computational cost. FLARE MCMC is a multi-fidelity layered MCMC method that exploits lower-fidelity approximations of the true likelihood calculation to improve mixing and leads to overall faster performance. Such lower-fidelity likelihoods are commonly available in scientific and engineering applications where the model involves a simulation whose resolution or accuracy can be tuned. Our technique uses recursive, layered chains with simple layer tuning; it does not require the likelihood to take any form or have any particular internal mathematical structure. We demonstrate experimentally that FLARE MCMC achieves larger effective sample sizes for the same computational time across different scientific domains including hydrology and cosmology.
papers.comment: This is the author's accepted manuscript of an article published in SIAM Journal on Uncertainty Quantification. The final version is available at \url{https://doi.org/10.1137/25M1795194
papers.journal_ref: SIAM/ASA Journal on Uncertainty Quantification Volume 14, Issue 2, June 2026 Pages: 661 - 690
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FLARE MCMC，一种多保真度分层 MCMC (multi-fidelity layered MCMC) 方法，利用真实似然计算的低保真近似来改善链的混合效率并降低总计算成本。方法采用递归式分层链和简单的层参数调整，不要求似然具有特定形式或内部数学结构。实验表明，在诸如水文学和宇宙学等不同科学领域中，FLARE MCMC 在相同计算时间内可获得更大的有效样本量 (effective sample size)。
Motivation: 标准 MCMC 只需能评估似然即可用于复杂模型推断，但混合速率可能很慢，需要生成大量样本才能获得良好估计，导致计算成本高。许多科学与工程模型中存在可通过调整模拟分辨率或精度得到的低保真似然，本文利用这一资源来加速 MCMC。
Method: 提出递归式分层链 (recursive, layered chains) 的 FLARE MCMC 框架，通过简单的层参数调整在不同保真度层次之间切换，以低保真似然近似辅助高保真推断；方法不依赖似然的函数形式或内部数学结构。
Result: 摘要报告，在包括水文学和宇宙学在内的多个科学领域实验中，FLARE MCMC 在相同计算时间下取得了更大的有效样本量，即改善了混合效率并加快整体性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用可调的保真度层次并以简单方式调参，可以在不限定似然结构的条件下提升 MCMC 的计算效率。

papers.title: CutClean: Neural Network Pruning for Privacy-Preserving Inference
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks are increasingly deployed in high-stakes applications with growing privacy leakage concerns. We show that this privacy leakage can occur even in the absence of representation imbalances that lead to traditional dataset biases. This poses significant privacy risks when deploying models that process sensitive attributes. In this context, we propose CutClean, a privacy-aware pruning method that allows to reduce privacy information flow through the network, while increasing its sparsity. Our approach employs auxiliary linear privacy heads placed at each network's block to quantify information leakage, and further applies increasing levels of sparsity to remove the private attribute leakage, measured in terms of the accuracy of the privacy head attached to the last block. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach effectively minimizes private information flow while achieving high sparsity rates and preserving classification target accuracy.
papers.journal_ref: In: De Marsico, M., et al. Pattern Recognition. ICPR 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 16822. Springer, Cham
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CutClean，一种隐私感知的神经网络剪枝方法，通过在网络的每个模块（block）放置辅助线性隐私头来量化信息泄漏，并施加递增的稀疏化以移除私有属性泄漏。实验在合成和真实数据集上显示该方法能最小化隐私信息流，同时达到高稀疏率并保持目标分类准确率。
Motivation: 神经网络在高风险应用中部署时存在隐私泄漏问题，且这种泄漏即使在没有导致传统数据集偏差的表示不平衡（representation imbalances）情况下也可能发生，对处理敏感属性的模型构成显著隐私风险。
Method: CutClean 在每个网络模块附加辅助线性隐私头以量化信息泄漏，并逐步增加稀疏化程度，以最后一个模块所接隐私头的准确率作为私有属性泄漏的度量来引导剪枝。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法能有效最小化私有信息流，同时实现高稀疏率并保持目标分类任务的准确率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调隐私泄漏可在缺乏传统数据集偏差的情况下出现，并提出通过剪枝在提升稀疏性的同时降低隐私信息流；未说明具体局限。
