papers.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Spatially Independent Multispectral Land Classification
papers.abstract_en: Land classification from satellite imagery is important for land management, environmental monitoring, and urban planning. Machine learning methods such as random forests and multilayer perceptrons have shown strong performance on multispectral data, while the Kolmogorov-Arnold network has emerged as an alternative architecture with compact model structures. This study evaluates the Kolmogorov-Arnold network for land classification using Landsat 8 imagery and compares it with random forest and multilayer perceptron models. The models were trained and tested on data from Edmonton, Alberta and evaluated on an independent dataset from Calgary, Alberta across five land classes: agriculture, urban, water, forest, and bare ground. For the Calgary dataset, the Kolmogorov-Arnold network matched the accuracy of the random forest and outperformed the multilayer perceptron, while requiring substantially fewer trainable parameters and providing greater interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）在基于 Landsat 8 多光谱影像的土地分类任务上的表现，并与随机森林和多层感知机对比。模型在 Edmonton 数据上训练，在 Calgary 独立数据集上测试，覆盖农业、城市、水体、森林和裸地五类。结果表明 KAN 在 Calgary 数据集上达到与随机森林相当的准确率，优于多层感知机，且可训练参数显著更少、可解释性更强。
Motivation: 土地分类对土地管理、环境监测和城市规划很重要，传统机器学习方法（如随机森林、多层感知机）在多光谱数据上表现良好，而 KAN 作为紧凑模型结构的新兴架构尚未在此类任务中被充分评估。
Method: 使用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络对 Landsat 8 多光谱影像进行分类，并与随机森林和多层感知机进行对比；模型在 Edmonton 数据上训练，在 Calgary 独立数据集上评估。
Result: 在 Calgary 测试集上，KAN 的准确率与随机森林相当，并超过多层感知机，同时所需可训练参数大幅减少，且具有更高的可解释性。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 KAN 在多光谱土地分类中能以更紧凑的模型达到有竞争力的精度，并兼具可解释性优势；研究基于特定地理区域和五类土地覆盖，泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Simulation-Aware In-Context Policy Improvement for LLM-Aided Analog Layout Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Analog IC layout design remains a labor-intensive iterative process dominated by simulation-driven refinement. Although end-to-end layout generators accelerate initial placement and routing, they still require experts to manually tune layout optimization parameters with repeated post-layout simulations for stringent design specifications. While Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely adopted for parameter tuning in analog IC design, at the layout level it typically requires hundreds to thousands of evaluations, each involving costly parasitic extraction and post-layout simulation, which makes it impractical. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in improving the sample efficiency of such simulation-driven tuning. However, their restricted access to geometric layout context and design-specific heuristics limits their ability to manipulate the layout optimization process. In this paper, we propose a simulation-aware LLM multi-agent framework that performs in-context policy improvement (ICPI) by iteratively updating layout optimization parameters exposed by an analog layout generator through an act-observe-reflect loop on compact structured layout representations. Experiments on real-world analog circuits show that, with only tens of post-layout simulations, our approach improves post-layout performance over the generator's built-in heuristics and BO-based tuning method.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. To appear in the Proceedings of the 2026 International Conference on LLM-Aided Design (ICLAD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对模拟集成电路版图设计中参数调优样本效率低的问题，提出一个仿真感知的 LLM 多智能体框架，通过 act-observe-reflect 循环在紧凑的结构化版图表示上迭代更新版图生成器暴露的优化参数，实现上下文内策略改进 (in-context policy improvement, ICPI)。实验表明，在真实模拟电路上仅需数十次后仿真 (post-layout simulation) 即可超越生成器内置启发式和基于贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian Optimization, BO) 的调优方法。
Motivation: 模拟 IC 版图设计依赖反复的仿真驱动调参；端到端版图生成器虽可加速初始布局布线，但后续参数优化仍需人工与大量后仿真。BO 在版图层面通常需要数百到上千次含寄生提取与后仿真的评估，成本过高，而 LLM 因缺乏几何版图上下文和设计特定启发式，难以直接操控版图优化过程。
Method: 提出一个仿真感知的 LLM 多智能体框架，基于生成器暴露的版图优化参数，通过 act-observe-reflect 迭代循环在紧凑的结构化版图表示上执行上下文内策略改进，逐步更新参数配置。
Result: 在真实模拟电路上的实验显示，仅需数十次后仿真，该方法就能在版图后仿真性能上超过生成器内置启发式和基于 BO 的调优方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为仿真感知的 LLM 多智能体框架能够以少量仿真评估有效改进版图优化过程，为版图级参数调优提供一种比 BO 更实用的路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ChartProbe: A Diagnostic Study on Visual Reasoning through Perception, Grounding, and Simple Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable on chart questions that require reasoning over visual quantities, and this weakness is usually attributed to a reasoning deficit and addressed with more reasoning supervision. We ask whether the difficulty lies in reasoning itself, or in the simpler skills that reasoning operates on: reading the plotted elements (\emph{perception}), locating them and binding them to their labels (\emph{grounding}), and performing single-step computations such as ranking, totals, and differences (\emph{simple reasoning}). We introduce \textbf{ChartProbe}, a diagnostic framework whose probes are generated directly from the code that renders each chart, so every gold answer is exact by construction, needs no human annotation, and attributes each failure to a single skill. ChartProbe enables an intervention prior work does not attempt: instead of synthesizing complex-reasoning data, we withhold complex questions and reasoning traces entirely, fine-tune on one simple skill at a time, and measure transfer to held-out complex-reasoning questions. Across three open-weight VLMs, supervising the simpler skills alone produces large gains on complex-reasoning questions the model never trained on: where these skills are weak and the model can be taught to read the image, training them recovers much of complex reasoning at no reasoning-data cost. The gains hold across three out-of-distribution settings: an unseen chart type (pie charts), a human-written benchmark disjoint from our images and templates (ChartQA), and a non-chart visual domain (CLEVR). Complex visual reasoning can therefore improve without complex-reasoning supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChartProbe 是一个面向视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的图表视觉推理诊断框架，将图表问题失败归因于三个基础技能：感知 (perception)、定位与标签绑定 (grounding)、以及单步计算 (simple reasoning)。探针由渲染图表的代码直接生成，因此金标答案精确且无需人工标注。作者进一步做干预实验：不训练复杂推理，只逐项微调简单技能，并测量向保留的复杂推理问题的迁移。
Motivation: VLM 在需要视觉数量推理的图表问题上表现不可靠，以往通常归因于推理缺陷并用更多推理监督解决。作者质疑难点是否在于推理本身，而在于推理所依赖的更简单的技能：读取图形元素、绑定标签、单步计算。
Method: 提出 ChartProbe 诊断框架，探针由每张图表的渲染代码直接生成，保证金标答案精确。干预方式为完全保留复杂问题和推理轨迹，仅一次微调一个简单技能，再评估对未见过的复杂推理问题的迁移效果。
Result: 在三个开放权重 VLM 上，仅监督简单技能就在模型从未训练过的复杂推理问题上产生大幅提升。提升在三个分布外设置中保持：未见过的图表类型 (饼图)、与图像和模板不相交的人工基准 (ChartQA)、以及非图表视觉域 (CLEVR)。
Conclusion: 摘要认为复杂视觉推理可以不需要复杂推理监督而得到改善，即训练更基础的技能能恢复大部分复杂推理能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Amplified Does Not Mean Predictive: Reasoning Behaviors in Thinking Models
papers.abstract_en: Which reasoning behaviors are associated with correct answers in reasoning models, and does reasoning-oriented training amplify those behaviors? This distinction is important because reasoning-oriented training can make traces look more deliberative without amplifying the behaviors most tied to model correctness. We quantify this mismatch with Behavioral Lift, a metric that measures how much correctness changes when a behavior is present versus absent in a model's reasoning trace. Across 15 models and 6 benchmarks spanning text-only and vision-language reasoning, we annotate 15,282 traces with a taxonomy whose core behaviors are defined for both LLM and VLM traces. We find evidence for an Amplification-Lift Gap, in which thinking models strongly amplify self-correction, hypothesis testing, and uncertainty acknowledgment, while the highest-lift behaviors are confidence calibration, knowledge alignment, and self-awareness. Confidence calibration is among the strongest positive signals of correctness in both modalities, yet is barely amplified; uncertainty acknowledgment is amplified by 3--7$\times$, yet is weakly or negatively associated with correctness. We find that reasoning-oriented training does not preferentially amplify the highest-Lift behaviors, motivating process-level objectives that reward calibrated and grounded reasoning rather than surface form alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究思维模型 (thinking models) 中哪些推理行为与正确答案相关，以及推理导向训练是否放大这些行为。作者提出 Behavior Lift 指标，量化行为存在与否时正确性的变化，并在 15 个模型、6 个基准（含文本与视觉-语言推理）上标注了 15,282 条轨迹。研究发现存在“放大-提升差距”(Amplification-Lift Gap)：思维模型强烈放大自我修正、假设检验和不确定性承认，而最高提升的行为是置信校准、知识对齐和自我意识；置信校正在两种模态中都是最强的正确性正信号却很少被放大，不确定性承认被放大 3–7 倍却与正确性弱相关或负相关。
Motivation: 推理导向训练可能让推理轨迹看起来更深思熟虑，却没有放大与模型正确性最相关的行为，这种不匹配需要被量化，以便理解当前训练目标是否对准真正重要的推理过程。
Method: 提出 Behavior Lift 指标，通过对比某行为在推理轨迹中存在与缺失时正确性的变化来度量行为的重要性；使用同时覆盖 LLM 与 VLM 轨迹的统一行为分类法，对 15,282 条轨迹进行人工标注。
Result: 在 15 个模型和 6 个基准上发现 Amplification-Lift Gap：思维模型放大自我修正、假设检验和不确定性承认，而最高提升的行为是置信校准、知识对齐和自我意识；置信校准在两个模态中都是最强的正确性正信号却几乎不被放大，不确定性承认被放大 3–7 倍却与正确性弱相关或负相关。
Conclusion: 推理导向训练并未优先放大最高 Lift 的行为，这提示需要设计过程级目标 (process-level objectives) 来奖励校准且接地 (grounded) 的推理，而非只奖励表面形式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Integer Alibi: Localizing Cross-Kernel Divergence in INT8-Quantized LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Two GPU kernels implementing the same scaled INT8 GEMM interface are usually treated as interchangeable. We test that assumption: holding the checkpoint, prompts, hardware, inference engine, decoding, and quantization configuration fixed, we swap only the INT8 linear kernel (CUTLASS versus Triton) inside vLLM. At 1.7B each arm reproduces itself bit-for-bit across cold restarts, yet the arms agree on no sequence in any end-to-end comparison we ran (0/8, 0/16, and 0/64). What makes this more than a benchmark discrepancy is an integer alibi: for shared INT8 operands under a verified no-overflow bound, the INT32 dot product is exact and order-independent, so the accumulator cannot be the source of any difference. Feeding both kernels identical operands from every linear layer of Qwen3-1.7B and 8B (196 and 252 layers), we find bit-identical outputs under power-of-two scales, confirming a pinned prediction list 196/196 and 252/252 (pre-registered at 1.7B, pinned but not blind at 8B), and observed differences of at most one bfloat16 spacing under the checkpoints' real scales. This localizes the divergence to scale application and output rounding after the exact accumulator. Applied as a probe checkpoint, the same intervention restores end-to-end bitwise agreement (8/8 and 16/16 sequences). Cross-implementation FP8 GEMM shows a different signature: both the prevalence and the magnitude of differences grow with reduction depth, while the INT8 fraction stays at parts per million and within one spacing over a 64x range of K. Teacher-forced replay ties layers to tokens: flips concentrate at small logit margins, which predict flip risk with ROC-AUC 0.94 on 16,384 positions. We will release the pre-registration, per-layer predictions, manifests with kernel-selection evidence, and a conformance procedure that turns these controls into a concrete check for kernel interchangeability.
papers.comment: 10 pages (IEEEtran two-column), 4 figures, 4 tables. Pre-registered protocol with append-only amendments; measurement artifacts and per-run manifests with kernel-selection evidence are described in the artifact statement. Companion to arXiv:2608.11693
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验一个常见假设：实现相同 scaled INT8 GEMM 接口的两个 GPU kernel 是否可互换。作者在 vLLM 中固定 checkpoint、prompts、硬件、推理引擎、解码与量化配置，仅将 INT8 linear kernel 从 CUTLASS 换成 Triton，发现两臂在冷重启后各自逐位复现，但在端到端比较中没有任何序列结果一致（0/8、0/16、0/64）。通过逐层喂入相同操作数，作者将分歧定位到 exact INT32 accumulator 之后的 scale 应用与输出舍入，并证明用该干预作为探针 checkpoint 可恢复端到端逐位一致（8/8、16/16）。
Motivation: 同一 scaled INT8 GEMM 接口的不同 GPU 实现通常被视为可互换，但跨 kernel 实现（CUTLASS 与 Triton）可能导致 LLM 推理结果出现端到端分歧；由于 INT8 点积在无溢出下精确且与顺序无关，accumulator 不可能是差异来源，因此需要定位真正的分歧层。
Method: 在 vLLM 中仅替换 INT8 linear kernel（CUTLASS 对 Triton），对 Qwen3-1.7B 和 8B 的所有线性层（196 与 252 层）喂给两 kernel 相同操作数，比较 power-of-two scale 与真实 scale 下的逐位输出；同时用探针 checkpoint 干预 scale 与舍入，并做 FP8 GEMM 跨实现对比与 teacher-forced replay 分析。
Result: 摘要报告两 kernel 在共享 INT8 操作数下逐位一致（196/196 与 252/252，1.7B 预注册、8B pinned 但非盲），真实 scale 下差异最多一个 bfloat16 spacing；端到端原样对比无序列一致，但探针干预恢复 8/8 与 16/16 逐位一致。FP8 GEMM 差异随 reduction depth 增长，而 INT8 分歧率在 64 倍 K 范围内保持在 ppm 量级且在一个 spacing 内；logit margin 小的 token 更易翻转，ROC-AUC 0.94（16,384 位置）。
Conclusion: 作者将跨 kernel 分歧定位到 exact accumulator 之后的 scale 应用与输出舍入，而非 INT8 点积本身，并提出一套 conformance procedure 将控制条件转化为检查 kernel 可互换性的具体手段；将发布预注册、逐层预测、manifest 与相关证据。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Explanation Multiplicity: Circuit-Level Interpretability Evidence Does Not Survive Defensible Analytic Variation
papers.abstract_en: The EU AI Act requires providers of high-risk systems to file technical documentation describing how the system reaches its decisions. Mechanistic interpretability is the obvious source of such evidence, and circuit discovery is its most developed instrument. We ask whether that evidence survives the condition under which it would be relied upon: two competent analysts, the same system, the same tool, different defensible settings. We pre-registered a crossed grid of seven analytic axes, every level taken from a published implementation, and mapped each discovered circuit through a deterministic claim map to a structured Annex IV statement. Across 15,840 pre-registered specifications on GPT-2 small and the indirect object identification task, of which 7,561 produced a claim, the derived statement flips across 73.2% of specification pairs (95% CI 0.725 to 0.738) and the modal claim commands 41.1% of the space. The evidence fails a filability criterion at every tolerance a conformity assessment body would plausibly accept. Standardising the single most influential choice, the evaluation metric, leaves the flip rate at 59.4%. Removing circuit size from the claim entirely and holding it fixed leaves 27.1% (95% CI 0.255 to 0.286), still above the pre-registered threshold. The circuits underlying these claims are structurally near-disjoint, median pairwise Jaccard overlap 4%, and functionally uncorrelated at Cohen's kappa 0.015, so the instability is not one mechanism described in different words. We give the filability criterion as a standalone protocol, and we report that one of the seven documented discovery objectives does not execute at all on the library's own canonical task. The study covers one model and one task, and whether the conclusion holds at scale is untested.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Pre-registered analysis plan; code and results available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对欧盟 AI 法案对高风险系统技术文档的要求，检验机制可解释性中的电路发现 (circuit discovery) 证据是否经得起分析者的合理选择差异。作者预注册了一个七维分析轴交叉网格，每级设置均来自已发表实现，在 GPT-2 small 和间接宾语识别任务上运行 15,840 个规范，其中 7,561 个产生了声明。结果显示推导出的声明在 73.2% 的规范对之间翻转，模态声明只占 41.1% 的空间，且发现的电路结构上近不相交（Jaccard 中位数 4%）、功能上不相关（Cohen's kappa 0.015）。摘要称这些证据在合理容差下均无法通过可归档性 (filability) 标准。
Motivation: 欧盟 AI 法案要求高风险系统提供关于决策过程的技术文档，机制可解释性是此类证据的明显来源，电路发现是其最成熟的工具。问题在于该证据能否在真实依赖条件下存活：两位胜任的分析者、同一系统、同一工具、不同的合理设置。
Method: 预注册一个七条分析轴的交叉网格，每个水平取自已发表实现，并通过确定性声明映射将每个发现的电路转换为结构化的 Annex IV 声明。作者将可归档性标准作为独立协议给出，并报告七个已记录发现目标之一在该库自身的规范任务上完全无法执行。
Result: 在 15,840 个预注册规范中，声明在 73.2% 的规范对间翻转（95% CI 0.725 至 0.738），模态声明占 41.1% 的空间；标准化最具影响力的单一选择（评估指标）后翻转率仍为 59.4%，将电路大小从声明中完全移除并固定后为 27.1%（95% CI 0.255 至 0.286）。基础电路的中位成对 Jaccard 重叠仅 4%，Cohen's kappa 为 0.015，说明不稳定性并非同一机制的不同表述。
Conclusion: 该研究覆盖一个模型和一个任务，结论能否推广到更大规模尚未测试；摘要强调证据在合规范畴评估机构可能接受的每一种容差下都未能通过可归档性标准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: An Interactive, Automated 4D-STEM data acquisition and analysis routine for Scanning Electron Nanobeam Diffraction and Ptychography experiments
papers.abstract_en: Modern transmission electron microscopes are versatile instruments which have become indispensable tools for understanding structure and chemical composition at the nano- and atomic scale. In the physical sciences these instruments are still largely manually controlled, requiring significant operator expertise, limiting throughput, and precluding statistical analysis of large datasets. Recent technical advances in both hardware and in control software now allow for the interaction with almost every functionality of the microscope through a programming interface. This enables better experimental design and data collection automation while also reducing operator collection bias and required expertise. In this study, we present an automated data collection routine with machine-driven decision-making to enable the collection of hundreds of 4D-STEM nanobeam diffraction and ptychography data from a large distribution of size-selectively deposited Pt nanoparticles. We present a semi-automated data analysis workflow to extract pertinent information from the large volumes of collected data. For the nanobeam diffraction data, reducing each dataset to its azimuthal variance profile and combining automated crystal orientation mapping with per-particle morphology descriptors reveals the orientation, shape and phase distributions across the ensemble, including a weak {110} texture. For the ptychographic data, an automated screening pipeline identifies on-zone-axis particles and enables atomic-resolution phase imaging and lattice-strain mapping of individual grains. Together these demonstrate how automation turns instrument throughput into statistically meaningful, atomic-scale microstructural information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套交互式、自动化的 4D-STEM 数据采集与分析流程，面向扫描电子纳米束衍射 (nanobeam diffraction) 与叠层衍射成像 (ptychography) 实验。作者在尺寸选择沉积的 Pt 纳米颗粒上自动采集数百组数据，并通过半自动分析工作流提取取向、形状、相分布以及原子级晶格应变等微观结构信息。摘要表明该方法将仪器吞吐量转化为具有统计意义的原子尺度微结构信息。
Motivation: 现代透射电镜仍主要依赖人工控制，需要大量操作者经验，限制吞吐量并阻碍大数据集的统计分析。硬件与控制软件的进步使几乎所有显微镜功能都可通过编程接口调用，从而支持自动化实验设计、数据采集，并减少操作者采集偏差。
Method: 提出机器驱动的自动数据采集例程，以及配套的半自动数据分析工作流。对纳米束衍射数据，将每个数据集约化为方位角方差剖面 (azimuthal variance profile)，并结合自动晶体取向映射与颗粒形貌描述符；对叠层衍射数据，建立自动筛选管线以识别在轴 (on-zone-axis) 颗粒，进而实现原子分辨相位成像与晶格应变映射。
Result: 在 Pt 纳米颗粒集合上成功采集并分析数百组数据，揭示了取向、形状和相分布，包括一个弱的 {110} 织构；同时实现了对单个晶粒的原子分辨相位成像和晶格应变映射。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自动化能够将仪器吞吐量转化为统计上有意义的原子尺度微结构信息，展示了机器驱动决策在电镜实验设计与数据分析中的价值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CAST: Closed-form Analytic Semantic Transfer for Zero-Shot Classifier Extension
papers.abstract_en: Large pre-trained models have become foundational components of modern machine learning systems. Yet adapting these models to novel categories typically requires examples from the target distribution. In many domains, however, such data are unavailable. Zero-shot learning (ZSL) permits recognition under these limitations through relying on auxiliary semantic information such as textual descriptions. We introduce CAST (Closed-form Analytic Semantic Transfer), a training-free, image-free framework for extending a pre-trained classifier to previously unseen classes through weight injection. We provide a theoretical foundation for CAST and derive a finite-sample error decomposition that identifies the \emph{semantic extrapolation residual} $ρ_u$. The residual is a computable, model-agnostic measure and provides a principled criterion for dataset curation and benchmark design. Experiments on standard zero-shot learning benchmarks demonstrate that CAST matches or exceeds existing image-free approaches and approaches the performance of few-shot adaptation methods, while requiring neither iterative optimization nor examples from the target distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAST（Closed-form Analytic Semantic Transfer），一种无需训练、无需图像样本的零样本分类器扩展框架，通过权重注入（weight injection）将预训练分类器扩展到未见类别。作者给出理论支撑，推导出有限样本误差分解，并识别出可计算的、与模型无关的度量——语义外推残差（semantic extrapolation residual）ρ_u。在标准零样本学习基准上，CAST 匹配或超过现有 image-free 方法，并接近少样本自适应方法的性能。
Motivation: 大规模预训练模型难以适应新类别，通常需要目标分布的样本，而在许多领域中这类数据不可用。零样本学习（ZSL）依赖文本描述等辅助语义信息来弥补这一缺口，但现有方法往往需要迭代优化或目标样本。
Method: 提出 CAST，一个训练无关、图像无关的框架，通过闭式解析语义转移进行权重注入来扩展分类器。同时提供理论分析，推导有限样本误差分解，定义语义外推残差 ρ_u 作为可计算的模型无关度量，用于指导数据集构建和基准设计。
Result: 在标准零样本学习基准上，CAST 匹配或超过现有 image-free 方法，并接近少样本自适应方法的性能，且不需要迭代优化，也不需要目标分布的样本。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，CAST 提供了一种无需训练样本即可扩展分类器的原则性方案，其提出的 ρ_u 可作为数据集整理和基准设计的判据；方法为 image-free 且无需迭代优化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Data-driven techniques for translational neuroscience and personalized neuro-health
papers.abstract_en: Neurodegenexrative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease are diagnosed most reliably only after substantial, often irreversible, neuronal loss has already occurred, creating an urgent need for quantitative tools that can detect subtle, early, and individual-specific brain changes from neuroimaging data. This review surveys a broad and rapidly evolving toolkit of data-driven techniques for translational neuroscience and personalized neuro-health, organized around four complementary methodological pillars. Throughout, we emphasize how these methodologically diverse approaches converge on a common translational goal: personalized, mechanistically grounded, and clinically actionable models of individual brain health, and we close by discussing the principal open statistical, computational, and clinical challenges that remain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，系统梳理用于转化神经科学（translational neuroscience）与个性化神经健康的数据驱动技术，按四个互补的方法论支柱组织。文章强调这些方法共同服务于一个目标：构建个性化、机制可解释且临床可用的个体脑健康模型，并在结尾讨论统计学、计算与临床方面的开放性挑战。
Motivation: 阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等神经退行性疾病通常要等到大量且往往不可逆的神经元丢失后才能被可靠诊断，因此亟需能够从神经影像数据中检测细微、早期且个体特异性脑变化的定量工具。
Method: 以综述形式组织，围绕四个互补的方法论支柱介绍广泛的数据驱动技术工具包，并阐述这些方法如何汇聚到共同的转化目标上。
Result: 作为综述论文，未报告具体实验结果或基准数据，而是归纳方法学进展与挑战。
Conclusion: 文章总结指出，个性化、机制可解释且临床可操作的脑健康模型是共同方向，并强调当前仍然存在的统计、计算和临床开放性挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does ISO-Grounded NFR Specification Improve LLM Code Generation? A Comparison of Rich and Structured Interventions against a Natural-Language Baseline
papers.abstract_en: In LLM-based code generation, Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) are often specified as terse one-line phrases. We ask whether grounding those specifications in ISO/IEC 25010 Quality Model, either as rich natural-language prose (NL-rich) or as structured JSON (Structured), improves code generated on HumanEval/HumanEval-ET compared to a RobuNFR-style one-line baseline (NL-simple). We evaluate four NFRs (performance, error handling, code smell, readability) with ten prompt variations per condition under a fixed model snapshot and paired non-parametric analysis. Primary finding: ISO-grounded enrichment improves static quality proxies (unreadability density falls across all four NFRs (e.g., Performance 0.88 -> 0.69 for NL-rich)) and reduces sensitivity to prompt wording, but does not reliably improve functional correctness; for error handling, extended-test pass rate decreases, suggesting tension between defensive coding patterns and exact-output benchmarks. Secondary finding: when ISO content is held constant, NL-rich and Structured differ negligibly in correctness (|delta| <= 0.023), indicating that semantic content matters more than JSON-vs-prose format. Practitioners should invest in standard-grounded NFR content rather than serialization form. A fully traceable replication package is provided.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, Accepted for publication at the 20th Brazilian Symposium on Software Components, Architectures, and Reuse (SBCARS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在基于 LLM 的代码生成中，将非功能需求 (NFR) 的规格说明基于 ISO/IEC 25010 质量模型进行增强（rich 自然语言 prose 或结构化 JSON）是否能比 RobuNFR 风格的单行基线 (NL-simple) 更好地改善 HumanEval/HumanEval-ET 上的生成代码。作者在固定模型快照下，对 performance、error handling、code smell、readability 四类 NFR 各用十种 prompt 变体进行了配对非参数分析。主要发现是 ISO 基底的增强能改善静态质量代理指标（如 unreadability density 在全部四个 NFR 上下降，Performance 从 0.88 降到 0.69）并降低对 prompt 措辞的敏感性，但不能稳定提升功能正确性；对 error handling，扩展测试通过率反而下降，说明防御性编码模式与精确输出基准之间存在张力。
Motivation: LLM 代码生成中非功能需求通常被写成简短的单行短语，作者质疑这种规格方式是否充分，并试图检验基于 ISO/IEC 25010 质量模型对 NFR 进行语义增强能否带来更好的生成代码。
Method: 实验设计了三种条件：自然语言单行基线 (NL-simple)、ISO 基底的丰富自然语言描述 (NL-rich)、以及 ISO 基底的结构化 JSON (Structured)。对四个 NFR 各采用十种 prompt 变体，在固定模型快照下使用配对非参数统计检验比较生成结果。
Result: ISO 基底增强显著改善静态质量代理（unreadability density 在所有四类 NFR 上均下降，例如 Performance 从 0.88 降到 0.69）并降低对 prompt 措辞变化的敏感性，但并未可靠提升功能正确性；error handling 的扩展测试通过率下降。当 ISO 内容相同时，NL-rich 与 Structured 在正确性上差异极小（|delta| ≤ 0.023）。
Conclusion: 作者认为对实践者而言，投入精力于基于标准 (standard-grounded) 的 NFR 内容比选择 JSON 或 prose 的序列化形式更重要；语义内容比格式更关键，并提供了完整可追溯的复现包。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: LLM 代码生成中非功能需求通常被写成简短的单行短语，作者质疑这种规格方式是否充分，并试图检验基于 ISO/IEC 25010 质量模型对 NFR 进行语义增强能否带来更好的生成代码。
summary_sections.method: 实验设计了三种条件：自然语言单行基线 (NL-simple)、ISO 基底的丰富自然语言描述 (NL-rich)、以及 ISO 基底的结构化 JSON (Structured)。对四个 NFR 各采用十种 prompt 变体，在固定模型快照下使用配对非参数统计检验比较生成结果。
summary_sections.result: ISO 基底增强显著改善静态质量代理（unreadability density 在所有四类 NFR 上均下降，例如 Performance 从 0.88 降到 0.69）并降低对 prompt 措辞变化的敏感性，但并未可靠提升功能正确性；error handling 的扩展测试通过率下降。当 ISO 内容相同时，NL-rich 与 Structured 在正确性上差异极小（|delta| ≤ 0.023）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为对实践者而言，投入精力于基于标准 (standard-grounded) 的 NFR 内容比选择 JSON 或 prose 的序列化形式更重要；语义内容比格式更关键，并提供了完整可追溯的复现包。

papers.title: GALA: Generation-Aware Cross-Modal Alignment for Text-to-Time-Series Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing time series from natural language is emerging as the most expressive form of controllable time series generation. However, existing text-conditioned generators either take caption embeddings frozen from off-the-shelf text encoders, or adapt the encoder end-to-end, letting the denoising loss shape the embeddings only as a by-product. In either case, the conditioning representation is never deliberately matched to the signal modality, leaving it ill-suited to guide generation. We address this by introducing GALA: Generation-Aware cross-modaL Alignment for text conditional time series generation. GALA is a two-stage approach that first contrastively couples a pretrained text encoder with a time-series foundation model into a shared embedding space with both encoders adapted to generation by an auxiliary generative loss, and then freezes the resulting caption embedding to drive a flow-matching generator. On TSFragment-600K, spanning four domains and three fragment lengths, GALA sets a new state of the art, ranking first in 30 of 36 metric columns and reaching an average rank of 1.08/1.08/1.42 at lengths 24/48/96 against 1.92/2.00/1.75 for the strongest baseline. We further find that generator-internal text encoders force a trade-off between fidelity and caption adherence, whereas conditioning on the aligned embedding breaks it: FID, CTTP, and JFTSD all improve at once. Ablating the auxiliary loss degrades FID, CTTP and JFTSD together, it indicates the generative term is a necessary component of the alignment rather than an add-on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GALA (Generation-Aware cross-modaL Alignment)，一种用于文本条件时间序列生成的两阶段对齐方法。GALA 先将预训练文本编码器与时间序列基础模型通过对比学习耦合到共享嵌入空间，并辅以生成损失来对齐，随后冻结所得文本嵌入以驱动 flow-matching 生成器。在 TSFragment-600K 上，GALA 在 36 个指标列中 30 个排名第一，长度 24/48/96 的平均排名为 1.08/1.08/1.42，优于最强基线。
Motivation: 现有文本条件时间序列生成器要么使用冻结的 off-the-shelf 文本编码器嵌入，要么端到端适配编码器使去噪损失间接影响嵌入，两种情况下的条件表示都没有刻意与信号模态对齐，导致其不擅长引导生成。
Method: 提出两阶段方法 GALA：第一阶段用对比学习将预训练文本编码器与时间序列基础模型耦合到共享嵌入空间，并通过辅助生成损失适配两个编码器；第二阶段冻结所得文本嵌入，将其作为条件输入驱动 flow-matching 生成器。
Result: 在 TSFragment-600K（覆盖四个领域和三种片段时间长度）上，GALA 在 30/36 个指标列中排名第一，长度 24/48/96 的平均排名为 1.08/1.08/1.42，而最强基线为 1.92/2.00/1.75。摘要还报告生成器内部的文本编码器会导致保真度与文本一致性之间的权衡，而基于对齐嵌入的条件化可同时改进 FID、CTTP 和 JFTSD。
Conclusion: 消融实验表明，去除辅助生成损失会同时使 FID、CTTP 和 JFTSD 变差，说明生成项是对齐的必要组成部分而非附加模块。

papers.title: Building AI-Intensive Software with AI: Early Results and a Cautionary Tale on Measuring Development Cost
papers.abstract_en: Empirical reports on the true cost of AI-intensive software development remain scarce, and the few that exist are easy to get wrong in ways that never surface in the final number. We report early results from an ongoing case study: a six-person student team built a full conversational onboarding assistant -- RAG-based code chat, guided tours, dependency graphs, technical-debt analysis -- over one academic term using pervasive AI assistance. We instrumented development with a three-layer cost model (real AI spend, self-reported human effort, human counterfactual) and initially reported a 19.4x cost ratio. A follow-up pass revealed two independent errors -- inferring per-token cost under a flat-rate subscription, and pricing the counterfactual with the wrong regional labor rates -- that together had inflated the ratio by roughly 2x; the corrected figure is ~9.9x. We present this correction as an early, generalizable finding in its own right: both errors are easy to make, invisible in the final number, and plausibly common in similar reports. We outline next steps toward a more robust, replicable costing methodology for AI-intensive development.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, Accepted for publication at the International Workshop on Intelligent Software Engineering (ISE 2026) @ CBSoft 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一项进行中案例研究的早期结果：六人学生团队在一个学期内借助广泛 AI 辅助，构建了完整的对话式入职助手（含基于 RAG 的代码聊天、导览、依赖图、技术债分析）。作者用三层成本模型（实际 AI 花费、自报人力投入、人力反事实）测量开发成本，最初得到 19.4 倍成本比，后续修正发现两个独立错误，修正后约为 9.9 倍。
Motivation: 关于 AI 密集型软件开发的真实成本的实证报告很少，且现有报告容易以最终数字中不可见的方式出错，因此需要更可靠的度量方法。
Method: 作者对开发过程进行插桩，采用三层成本模型：实际 AI 花费、自报人力投入、以及人力反事实（counterfactual）估算；随后通过复查修正了成本计算中的误差。
Result: 初始报告的 19.4 倍成本比因两个独立错误被高估约 2 倍：一是在包月订阅下错误推断每 token 成本，二是用错误的区域劳动力价格给反事实定价；修正后成本比约为 9.9 倍。
Conclusion: 作者将这次修正本身视为早期且可推广的发现，指出这两类错误容易犯、在最终数字中不可见，并可能普遍存在于类似报告中；下一步将建立更稳健、可复现的成本度量方法。

papers.title: Limitations of Synthetic Data Generation in Specialized Data-Scarce Domains
papers.abstract_en: Advances in diffusion-based generative models have motivated the use of synthetic image generation to alleviate data scarcity in vision tasks. While this strategy has shown promise in natural image benchmarks such as ImageNet, its effectiveness in sparse, high-variance real-world domains remains unclear. In this work, we focus on domains where images differ substantially from common image datasets and additional data are expensive to obtain. Against non-generative data augmentation baselines, we evaluate the downstream classifier performance improvements yielded by two schools of generative sparse data extension: distribution modeling and sample perturbation. Across five trauma classification tasks using subject-wise train--validation splits, no generative approach consistently outperforms a strong non-generative baseline. Feature-space analysis reveals recurring failure modes: memorization or collapse, distributional drift, and generation of visually plausible but simplified canonical instances that are easier to classify than real data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散生成模型在数据稀缺的专业视觉领域中的效果。在五个创伤分类任务上，作者对比了两类生成式数据扩展方法（分布建模和样本扰动）与非生成式数据增强基线，发现没有任何生成方法能稳定超过强非生成基线。特征空间分析揭示了记忆/坍缩、分布漂移以及生成视觉上合理但过于简化的典型实例等失败模式。
Motivation: 尽管合成图像在 ImageNet 等自然图像基准上显示出潜力，但在图像分布差异大且获取额外数据昂贵的专业领域是否有效仍不明确。
Method: 采用两种生成式稀疏数据扩展范式：分布建模（distribution modeling）和样本扰动（sample perturbation），并用基于受试者的训练-验证划分（subject-wise train-validation splits）在五个创伤分类任务上评估下游分类器性能，与非生成式数据增强基线对比。
Result: 没有任何生成式方法能一致胜过强非生成式基线。特征空间分析显示反复出现的失败模式：记忆化或坍缩（memorization or collapse）、分布漂移（distributional drift），以及生成视觉上看似合理但被简化、比真实数据更容易分类的典型实例。
Conclusion: 合成数据在数据稀缺专业领域的收益有限，可能不优于传统增强；生成样本的易分类性会造成性能假象。

papers.title: Architecture and Affordances of PLAUD: Performative Latents and Unsupervised DDSP
papers.abstract_en: PLAUD (Performative Latents and Unsupervised DDSP) is a neural synthesizer and Max for Live instrument for live electronic music, built on NoiseBandNet and trained on small personal sound corpora. We present its architecture, combining a variational DDSP synthesis model, latent smoothing, multi-scale spectral and adversarial losses, and an optional transformer prior, alongside a set of bending operations that intervene directly in the synthesis chain: component limiting, waveshaping, and prior feedback. The Max for Live interface exposes control generation, trajectory sampling, and modulation as primary modes of interaction. Throughout, we thread an affordance analysis arguing that the system's performative character follows from architectural decisions rather than being designed on top of them. The paper contributes both a technical account of the system and a situated affordance analysis of its role in live electronic music performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 PLAUD（Performative Latents and Unsupervised DDSP），一个面向现场电子音乐的神经合成器与 Max for Live 音色插件，基于 NoiseBandNet 并在小型个人声音语料上训练。系统结合变分 DDSP 合成模型、潜在平滑、多尺度频谱与对抗损失以及可选的 transformer prior，并提供直接干预合成链的 bending 操作（component limiting、waveshaping、prior feedback）。Max for Live 界面以控制生成、轨迹采样和调制为主要交互模式。论文同时给出系统的技术描述与情境化 affordance 分析，主张其表演性来自架构决策而非事后附加设计。
Motivation: 现场电子音乐中神经合成器常受限于个人小型声音语料，且系统的可表演性（performative character）往往被当作附加功能，而非由底层架构支撑。
Method: 提出 PLAUD 架构，包含变分 DDSP 合成模型、潜在平滑、多尺度频谱与对抗损失以及可选 transformer prior；引入一组直接作用于合成链的 bending 操作，并通过 Max for Live 接口暴露控制生成、轨迹采样和调制等交互模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PLAUD 的表演性源于架构决策而非事后设计，并以技术账目与情境化 affordance 分析的方式服务于 AI 音乐创作社区。

papers.title: Capacity-Dependent Effects of Data Selection for Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: In reasoning supervised fine-tuning, candidate responses for the same instruction can differ substantially in how well they match the student's current distribution. Recent likelihood-based response selection methods suggest that responses closer to the student distribution provide more effective supervision, motivating the hypothesis that high-likelihood responses may generally be preferable for fine-tuning. In this paper, we revisit this intuition and show that the value of likelihood-based data selection depends critically on model capacity and training duration. Through controlled experiments on mathematical reasoning, using students ranging from 1.5B to 8B parameters and supervision generated by stronger teacher models, we observe a clear \emph{capacity-dependent} ``{\color{SMALLCOLOR}\textbf{Fast-Fit}} / {\color{LARGECOLOR}\textbf{Slow-Gain}}'' pattern. High-likelihood data provides faster and more stable early improvements, especially for smaller models, but low-likelihood data becomes increasingly beneficial for larger models when training is allowed to continue longer. To explain this phenomenon, we analyze learning dynamics, showing that small models often fail to absorb low-likelihood supervision and instead fall into shallow or repetitive behaviors, while larger models are better able to move toward the teacher distribution under such data. We further provide a capacity-constrained theoretical view of distillation that clarifies how data difficulty, data span, and student capacity jointly govern transfer. Overall, our findings show that effective data selection for reasoning should be aware of model capacity and computing budget rather than based on a single universal preference for high-likelihood supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视推理任务监督微调 (supervised fine-tuning) 中基于似然度的响应选择策略，指出该策略的有效性强烈依赖学生模型容量与训练时长。通过在数学推理任务上使用 1.5B 到 8B 参数的学生模型和更强教师模型生成的监督数据，作者观察到清晰的容量依赖型 Fast-Fit / Slow-Gain 模式：高似然数据在训练早期带来更快更稳定的提升（尤其对小模型），而低似然数据在训练时间延长后对大模型越来越有利。论文还从学习动力学和蒸馏的理论视角解释了这一现象。
Motivation: 近期基于似然度的响应选择方法暗示，更接近学生当前分布的响应能提供更有效的监督，从而普遍偏好高似然数据；本文旨在检验这一直觉，揭示模型容量与计算预算对数据选择结论的关键影响，而非存在单一的普适偏好。
Method: 在数学推理场景下做受控实验，使用 1.5B 至 8B 参数的学生模型与更强的教师模型生成的监督数据，比较高似然与低似然数据选择的效果；通过分析学习动力学说明小模型难以吸收低似然监督而陷入浅层或重复行为，大模型则更能向教师分布移动；并给出容量受限的蒸馏理论视角，阐明数据难度、数据跨度 (data span) 与学生容量如何共同决定知识迁移。
Result: 摘要报告了容量依赖的 Fast-Fit / Slow-Gain 模式：高似然数据带来更快、更稳定的早期提升，尤其对较小模型；低似然数据在训练允许持续更久时对大模型越来越有益。理论分析还表明数据难度、数据跨度与学生容量共同主导蒸馏迁移的效果。

papers.title: Coverage Aware Active Evaluation for Failure Discovery with Paired Systems
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous systems can fail in rare and heterogeneous ways, making real-world failure discovery difficult under limited testing budgets. Although cheaper proxies such as simulators, lower-fidelity systems, or related policies can be sampled extensively to find failures, proxy failures often do not transfer to the real world due to sim-to-real and system-to-system gaps. The key challenge is therefore to effectively leverage proxy system information for accurate prediction of severe target system failures. We propose an adaptive failure discovery method that combines proxy evaluations with limited target system results to guide scenario selection for target system testing. Our method learns a local predictor of target risk by correcting proxy failure signals using control-variate-inspired residual modeling. To find failures that are both likely and diverse, we combine this predictor with a support-aware mutual-information objective that favors realistic, well-supported regions while expanding coverage across failure modes. Across autonomous driving, manipulation, and quadruped velocity-tracking tasks, our method discovers up to 2$\times$ as many failures as random sampling and active-learning baselines, including severe and diverse failures missed by competing methods.
papers.comment: 9 main pages followed by Appendix, total 21 pages, 12 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对自主系统的自适应失效发现方法，在有限目标系统测试预算下，利用代理系统（如仿真器、低保真系统或相关策略）的大量评估结果来引导目标系统测试场景选择。方法通过控制变量启发式残差建模（control-variate-inspired residual modeling）修正代理失效信号，学习目标风险的局部预测器，并结合支持感知的互信息目标（support-aware mutual-information objective）在真实且充分支撑的区域中扩展失效模式覆盖。摘要报告在自动驾驶、机械操作和四足速度跟踪任务上，该方法发现的失效数量最高为随机采样和主动学习基线的2倍。
Motivation: 自主系统会以罕见且异质的方式失效，而在有限测试预算下、现实世界中难以发现失效；虽然模拟器等代理系统可以被大量采样以寻找失效，但代理失效常因sim-to-real和系统间差距（system-to-system gaps）而无法转移到真实世界。因此需要有效利用代理信息来准确预测严重的目标系统失效。
Method: 提出一种自适应失效发现方法，将代理评估与有限的目标系统结果相结合来指导目标系统测试的场景选择。具体地，学习目标风险的局部预测器，用控制变量启发的残差建模来修正代理失效信号；再将此预测器与支持感知的互信息目标结合，偏好真实且受支撑良好的区域，同时扩展跨失效模式的覆盖。
Result: 在自动驾驶、机械操作和四足速度跟踪任务上，该方法比随机采样和主动学习基线最多多发现2倍数量的失效，包括被对比方法遗漏的严重且多样化的失效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过对代理失效信号进行残差修正并结合覆盖感知的探索，可以在有限真实测试预算下高效发现目标系统的严重和多样化失效；其有效性在三个自主系统任务上得到展示。

papers.title: Reading Between The Lines: Modeling and Evaluating Behavioral Realism in Legal Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Deposition training requires attorneys to manage dynamic witness behavior, yet legal-AI evaluations largely focus on factual accuracy, reasoning, or response-level plausibility. We introduce WitnessSim, a deposition simulator driven by controllable legal personas. We use an evaluation framework separating behavioral realism from pedagogical usefulness. We assess realism through adversarial testing, blinded attorney comparison, and analysis of longitudinal behavioral trajectories. WitnessSim generally maintained plausible behavioral boundaries, and attorneys did not systematically prefer either original testimony or WitnessSim generated testimony. Pedagogical tests showed that witness behavior changed meaningfully in response to question form and attorney intervention without uniformly collapsing the assigned persona. Together, these results showcase a model of behavioral fidelity in legal simulations, and provide a framework for evaluating its performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 AI4Law. 47 pages, 26 tables, 14 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WitnessSim，一个由可调控法律人格（legal personas）驱动的取证模拟器，并引入一个将行为真实性（behavioral realism）与教学效用（pedagogical usefulness）分离的评估框架。研究发现 WitnessSim 通常能维持合理的行为边界，且律师并未系统性地偏好原始证词或 WitnessSim 生成的证词；教学测试显示证词行为会随提问形式和律师干预而显著变化，但不会彻底瓦解预设人格。作者认为这些结果展示了法律模拟中行为保真度的建模方式，并提供了评估其表现的框架。
Motivation: 取证培训要求律师应对动态的证人行为，但现有法律 AI 评估大多聚焦于事实准确性、推理能力或回答层面的合理性，缺乏对行为真实性的建模与评估。
Method: 引入 WitnessSim，一个由可控法律人格驱动的取证模拟器；评估框架将行为真实性与教学效用分开考量，通过对抗性测试、盲评律师对比以及纵向行为轨迹分析来评估真实性。
Result: WitnessSim 总体维持了合理的行为边界，律师没有系统性偏好原始证词或 WitnessSim 生成证词；教学测试表明证词行为会随提问形式和律师干预发生有意义的改变，同时不会完全丢失预设人格。
Conclusion: 该工作为法律模拟中的行为保真度提供了建模思路，并给出了一套评估其表现的框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TRUE-Colon: Exposing a Consistent Transfer Asymmetry in Real-Time Polyp Detection
papers.abstract_en: Computer-aided detection (CADe) systems for colonoscopy promise to reduce clinical miss rates, yet reliable real-world deployment remains elusive. This translational gap stems in part from a structural flaw in model development: the reliance on curated datasets that under-represent the long negative stretches and procedure-related artifacts characteristic of routine examinations. Training and evaluating architectures strictly on these lesion-centric benchmarks creates an illusion of success, since such benchmarks cannot capture clinically crucial metrics. To expose this gap, we establish TRUE-Colon, a standardized benchmarking protocol that measures key deployment characteristics alongside localization accuracy, and evaluate four real-time architectures (Faster R-CNN, YOLOv8, YOLOv11, RT-DETR) across curated benchmarks (SUN, PICCOLO) and 60 unedited, full-length procedures (REAL-Colon). We observe a consistent transfer asymmetry: models trained strictly on curated clips suffer a severe performance collapse when evaluated on full procedures, whereas procedure-trained models substantially improve rejection of non-polyp content on REAL-Colon, and largely retain their accuracy on curated benchmarks. Beyond transferability, we find that the Transformer detector attains the strongest sensitivity and the earliest, most persistent detections, while the convolutional detectors stay competitive at a higher throughput. Together, these results indicate that both training and benchmarking for deployable CADe should shift from curated, lesion-centric clips toward full-procedure data and deployment-relevant operating points. Source code is available at https://github.com/sdoerrich97/true-colon.
papers.comment: Accepted to EndoLINA @ MICCAI 2026 (The International Workshop on Endoluminal Intervention Navigation and Autonomy)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRUE-Colon，一个评估结肠镜实时息肉检测 CADe 系统部署性能的标准化基准协议，并分别在策展基准（SUN、PICCOLO）和 60 段未剪辑全流程结肠镜视频（REAL-Colon）上评估 Faster R-CNN、YOLOv8、YOLOv11、RT-DETR 四种实时架构。作者观察到一致的迁移不对称性：仅用策展片段训练的模型在完整流程上性能严重崩溃，而用完整流程训练的模型在 REAL-Colon 上显著改善非息肉内容拒绝，并基本保留策展基准上的精度。RT-DETR 这类 Transformer 检测器表现出最强的灵敏度与最早、最持久的检测，卷积检测器则在更高吞吐下保持竞争力。
Motivation: CADe 系统虽有望降低临床漏检率，但实际部署仍不可靠。作者指出这种转化鸿沟部分源于模型开发依赖策展数据集，这些数据集低估了常规检查中占主体的长阴性片段和手术相关伪影，导致基于病变中心基准的训练与评估造成成功假象。
Method: 建立 TRUE-Colon 标准化基准协议，在定位精度之外同时测量关键部署特征；在 SUN、PICCOLO 两个策展基准以及 60 段未编辑的全长度 REAL-Colon 流程上，对四种实时检测架构进行一致的训练与评估。
Result: 摘要报告存在一致的迁移不对称性：严格在策展片段上训练的模型在完整流程评估时性能严重下降，而流程训练的模型在 REAL-Colon 上大幅提升对非息肉内容的拒绝能力，并在策展基准上基本保持精度。Transformer 检测器达到最强灵敏度和最早最持续的检测，卷积检测器在更高吞吐下仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为可部署 CADe 的训练与基准评估都应由策展、病变中心的片段转向完整流程数据和部署相关的操作点。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TeachMateGPT: A Multi-Agent Knowledge-Grounded Framework for Pedagogical Assessment Generation from Science Curriculum Materials
papers.abstract_en: Automatically generating textbook-grounded assessment items can reduce science teachers' workload, but existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems rely on flat retrieval, support only single-question generation, lack safeguards against weak evidence, and are ill-suited to low-resource, board-exam-structured curricula. We address these limitations with TeachMateGPT, a multi-agent system contributing four advances to curriculum-grounded science-assessment authoring. (i) COPE, a hierarchical knowledge base replacing token-window chunking with a multi-resolution index that segments documents along syllabus structure and links them at three granularities via a traversable graph-based lineage, matching evidence to each topic's instructional level. (ii) A staged, fail-closed agent pipeline replacing one-shot retrieve-then-generate: routing gates search, retrieval fuses dense and lexical evidence under a coverage gate that withholds generation on insufficient evidence, and specialist agents draft objective and constructed-response items. (iii) SAVER, a source-attributed verification protocol scoring faithfulness, relevance, and hallucination risk against retrieved evidence, applying stricter grounding checks across each creative question's four sub-parts, paired with teacher-in-the-loop evaluation rather than automatic filtering. (iv) NCTB-SciGen8, a curriculum-grounded dataset of 198 items (143 multiple-choice, 55 creative questions) spanning all 14 chapters of the NCTB Class 8 science textbook, produced by the pipeline and rated by three practicing teachers. TeachMateGPT raises faithfulness (0.68 $\rightarrow$ 0.96) and answer relevancy (0.60 $\rightarrow$ 0.89) over a vanilla RAG baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TeachMateGPT，一个基于多智能体 (multi-agent) 的课程知识问答生成框架，用于从科学教材自动生成评估题目。系统包含 COPE 层次化知识库、分阶段的 fail-closed 检索生成流水线、SAVER 溯源验证协议以及 NCTB-SciGen8 数据集。相比 vanilla RAG 基线，faithfulness 从 0.68 提升到 0.96，answer relevancy 从 0.60 提升到 0.89。
Motivation: 现有基于检索增强生成 (RAG) 的教材评估题生成系统存在平面检索、仅支持单题生成、缺乏弱证据防护等问题，不适合低资源、以考试大纲为导向的课程体系，增加了教师工作负担。
Method: 提出多智能体框架 TeachMateGPT，包含四个贡献：COPE 层次化知识索引（多分辨率索引 + 图结构谱系）、分阶段 fail-closed 智能体流水线（路由门控、稠密与词法证据融合、覆盖门控、专业智能体起草）、SAVER 源归属验证协议（对四个子部分做严格 grounding 检查并配教师参与评估），以及 NCTB-SciGen8 数据集。
Result: 在 NCTB 八年级科学教材全部 14 章上构建 198 道题的数据集（143 道多项选择、55 道创意题），由三位在职教师评分；faithfulness 从 0.68 提升到 0.96，answer relevancy 从 0.60 提升到 0.89。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架能缓解现有 RAG 在课程嵌入式评估题生成中的不足，并通过 fail-closed 设计与教师参与评估提高可信度；其他领域适用性或长期教学效果未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: CLAIR-Fin: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Framework for Claim-Level Verification and Adaptive Debate in Cross-Modal Financial QA
papers.abstract_en: Existing defenses against hallucination in retrieval-augmented and multi-agent pipelines remain partial: evidence is trusted despite modality disagreement, debate verifies an aggregate report rather than individual claims, and such verification occurs only after drafting, leaving inter-agent errors undetected until the final text. To close this gap, we present CLAIR-Fin, a nine-agent framework that decomposes each question into atomic claims maintained in a typed Financial Claim Ledger. Each claim is resolved through Asymmetric Evidence Authority, which conditions evidence trust on claim type rather than treating all modalities as equally reliable; Chain-of-Custody Verification, which checks grounding at the hand-off between drafting and adversarial review rather than only at the pipeline's exit; an Adaptive Rebuttal Cycle, which routes contested claims through adversarial debate whose depth scales with what that debate finds; and a terminal entailment audit paired with a continuous Hallucination Risk Index that distinguishes claims that passed scrutiny from claims never contested. We evaluate CLAIR-Fin on BB-FinQA-X, a 500-question cross-modal financial evaluation set built from Bangladesh Bank Annual Report material, stratified by query type, format, and difficulty. Relative to a single-pass retrieval-augmented generation baseline, it raises faithfulness ($0.780 \rightarrow 0.889$) while abstaining on 5.4% of questions when evidence is insufficient rather than forcing an unsupported response, and it exceeds stronger retrieval-strategy baselines such as HyDE and Graph-RAG on faithfulness ($\leq 0.874$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLAIR-Fin 是一个九智能体 (nine-agent) 框架，面向跨模态金融问答中的声明级验证与自适应辩论。它把每个问题分解为原子声明并维护在类型化的 Financial Claim Ledger 中，通过 Asymmetric Evidence Authority 按声明类型决定证据可信度、以 Chain-of-Custody Verification 在起草与对抗审查交接处检查接地、用 Adaptive Rebuttal Cycle 按辩论发现动态调整辩论深度，并以终期蕴含审计和连续 Hallucination Risk Index 区分通过审查与从未被质疑的声明。在基于孟加拉国银行年报构建的 BB-FinQA-X 500 题跨模态评测集上，它比单次检索增强生成 (RAG) 基线将忠实度从 0.780 提升到 0.889，并在证据不足时对 5.4% 的问题选择弃答而非强行生成。
Motivation: 现有针对幻觉的防御在检索增强和多智能体管线中仍然是不完整的：证据在模态不一致时仍被信任，辩论只验证汇总报告而非逐条声明，且验证发生在起草完成后，导致智能体间错误直到最终文本才暴露。
Method: 提出九智能体框架，将问题分解为原子声明并记录在类型化 Financial Claim Ledger 中；Asymmetric Evidence Authority 依据声明类型而非把各模态视为同等可靠来决定证据信任；Chain-of-Custody Verification 在起草与对抗审查交接处检查接地；Adaptive Rebuttal Cycle 使争议声明进入辩论，且辩论深度随发现结果扩展；最后以终期蕴含审计与连续 Hallucination Risk Index 区分通过审查与从未被质疑的声明。
Result: 在 BB-FinQA-X（500 题跨模态金融评测集，按查询类型、格式和难度分层）上，相对单次 RAG 基线，忠实度从 0.780 提升至 0.889，并在证据不足时对 5.4% 的问题弃答；同时优于 HyDE、Graph-RAG 等更强检索策略基线（其忠实度 ≤ 0.874）。
Conclusion: 论文强调把证据信任条件化于声明类型、在交接环节而非仅出口处检查接地，并以声明级辩论和弃答机制提升忠实度。其评测限于孟加拉国银行年报构建的金融领域数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAGE: Surrogate-gradient Adaptation via Attention-Guided Entropy for Spiking Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient alternative to conventional deep neural networks by exploiting sparse event-driven computation, but their training remains challenging because the non-differentiable spike function requires surrogate gradients whose fixed shape may be suboptimal across layers and training stages. In this work, we introduce SAGE, an uncertainty-modulated surrogate-gradient mechanism for Transformer-based SNNs. SAGE estimates block-level uncertainty from normalized self-attention entropy and uses this signal to adapt the surrogate-gradient slope during training while leaving the inference model unchanged. By modulating only the training-time surrogate parameter, the proposed method preserves the original architecture and deployment cost while improving optimization flexibility. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 demonstrate that SAGE achieves improved accuracy over fixed-surrogate baselines, with results up to 1-2\% consistent gains across multiple simulation time steps. These results highlight the potential of attention-derived uncertainty as a lightweight training signal for adaptive surrogate-gradient learning in transformer-based SNNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE，一种针对 Transformer 结构脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 的不确定性调制替代梯度机制。SAGE 从归一化自注意力熵中估计块级不确定性，并据此在训练时调整替代梯度斜率，推理模型保持不变。实验表明，在 CIFAR-10/100 上相比固定替代梯度基线，SAGE 在多个模拟时间步下取得了 1-2% 的稳定精度提升。
Motivation: SNN 训练因脉冲函数不可微而依赖替代梯度，但固定形状的替代梯度在不同层和不同训练阶段可能不是最优，限制了优化灵活性。
Method: SAGE 利用归一化自注意力熵估计每个 block 的不确定性，并以此信号在训练过程中自适应调节替代梯度斜率；仅修改训练时的替代参数，不改变原始架构与推理部署成本。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10/100 上，SAGE 相对固定替代梯度基线取得改进，多个模拟时间步下精度一致提升约 1-2%。
Conclusion: 作者认为注意力导出的不确定性可作为轻量级训练信号，用于 Transformer 结构 SNN 的自适应替代梯度学习，同时保持推理模型不变。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GRPO Beyond English: A Large-Scale Study of GRPO in Non-English and Multilingual Settings
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), often optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has become a central recipe for improving the reasoning capabilities of pretrained language models but current studies remain heavily English-centric. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of multilingual and non-English GRPO across a wide range of base models, training languages, and different reasoning language rewards. We find that training to reason in the native language often leaves only a small gap to training for English reasoning. We further observe strong crosslingual transfer: training in one language often improves performance in many others. However, specific trends are highly model- and language-dependent. In some cases, training in a particular language induces severe regressions on out-of-domain capabilities in other languages. Our analysis shows that RLVR beyond English can provide broad crosslingual gains, but also requires broad evaluation to detect language-specific regressions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多语言与非英语场景下的 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 做了大规模实证研究，覆盖多种基础模型、训练语言和推理语言奖励设置。摘要发现用母语训练推理与用英语训练推理的差距较小，且跨语言迁移明显，但具体趋势高度依赖模型和语言，某些语言训练会在其他语言上造成严重的领域外能力回退。
Motivation: 现有 RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) 与 GRPO 研究高度以英语为中心，缺乏对非英语和多语言环境下训练效果的系统认识。
Method: 开展大规模多语言、非英语 GRPO 实证研究，变化基础模型、训练语言以及不同的推理语言奖励设置，系统比较各条件下的推理能力表现。
Result: 摘要报告母语推理训练与英语推理训练之间的性能差距通常较小，并观察到强跨语言迁移；但特定趋势因模型和语言而异，部分语言训练会在其他语言上导致严重回归。
Conclusion: 摘要认为超出英语范围的 RLVR 可以带来广泛的跨语言收益，但需要用广泛评测来发现语言特定的性能回退。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Language-Specific Gaps in AI Safety Training Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Large language model providers routinely cite multilingual safety benchmarks spanning a dozen or more languages as evidence that their models are safe for non-English-speaking users. We show that these collection-level coverage claims frequently do not survive inspection at the level of an individual language. Auditing 21 resources across 25 language slices, of which 20 count as datasets under our counting rules, spanning three languages chosen to represent low- (Hausa), mid- (Swahili), and high-resource (French) tiers, we find that gaps in provenance, annotation reliability, access, harm-taxonomy coverage, and data reuse recur in patterns that partially, but not fully, track resource level. Using a controlled within-pipeline comparison, we show a Hausa-language slice falling below its own paper's translation-quality acceptance threshold while the same pipeline's Swahili output clears the same bar comfortably; this is evidence that these gaps are measurable and addressable, not inherent. We further show that self-harm and sexual-content categories have no native-language coverage in either African-language tier we studied, a total rather than gradated gap that a purely resource-level account does not predict. We connect these findings to a documented, persistent asymmetry in multilingual jailbreak robustness (single-turn attacks largely mitigated, multi-turn attacks still effective), arguing that this asymmetry is structurally consistent with where our audit finds training and evaluation data thinnest. We contribute a reusable slice-level audit methodology, a cross-tier empirical comparison, and concrete recommendations for dataset creators, model providers, and venues aiming to make ``multilingual coverage'' claims verifiable rather than merely stated. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ChialukaOnuoha/safety-slice-audit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了21个资源、25个语言切片（其中20个按作者计数规则算作数据集），覆盖低资源豪萨语（Hausa）、中资源斯瓦希里语（Swahili）和高资源法语（French）三个层级，发现多语言安全基准的集合级覆盖声明在单个语言层面经常不成立。通过受控的流水线内比较，豪萨语切片低于其论文自身的翻译质量接受阈值，而斯瓦希里语切片轻松通过；自残（self-harm）和性内容（sexual-content）类别在两种非洲语言层均无本地语言覆盖。文章将该现象与多语言越狱鲁棒性（jailbreak robustness）的单轮缓解、多轮仍有效的结构性不对称联系起来，并提出可复用的切片级审计方法。
Motivation: 大型语言模型提供商常用覆盖十多种语言的多语言安全基准来宣称模型对非英语用户安全，但这些集合级覆盖声明缺乏单语言层面的严格检验，低资源语言的安全数据缺口因此被掩盖。
Method: 提出可复用的切片级（slice-level）审计方法，跨低/中/高三个资源层级审计21个资源、25个语言切片，系统评估来源（provenance）、标注可靠性、访问性、危害分类学（harm taxonomy）覆盖与数据复用，并进行了受控的流水线内比较。
Result: 摘要报告豪萨语切片未能达到其论文自身设定的翻译质量接受阈值，而同一流水线的斯瓦希里语输出轻松超过该阈值；此外，两种非洲语言层的自残与性内容类别均无本地语言覆盖，属于完全缺失而非渐进式的缺口。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些缺口可以测量且可以解决，并非语言本身固有；其分布与多语言越狱鲁棒性的单轮攻击大体缓解、多轮攻击仍有效的已知不对称在结构上一致，并对数据集创建者、模型提供方和学术会议提出了使“多语言覆盖”声明可验证而非仅陈述的建议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MedPlex: Deep Vision-Language Co-Adaptation for Clinically Grounded Medical Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation is still largely treated as a vision-only problem, although clinical interpretation often relies on textual knowledge of anatomy, location, appearance, and surrounding context. Existing text-guided segmentation methods within the Vision-Language Model (VLM) paradigm often use language only as a late conditioning signal, limiting its influence on visual representation learning. We introduce MedPlex (Medical Plexus of Vision and Language), an end-to-end VLM framework that makes text guidance a continuous, clinically grounded component of segmentation learning. Through Bi-Fusion (Bidirectional Fusion), visual and textual representations evolve jointly across the encoding hierarchy. MedPlex further introduces class-level and region-level concept alignment to organize the shared representation at complementary granularities. Class-level alignment anchors each anatomical target to an aggregated clinical concept profile, while region-level alignment preserves individual concepts, such as shape, location, appearance, and texture, through class-specific visual evidence. In this way, language provides structured supervision throughout the encoder rather than serving only as a late-stage cue. MedPlex achieves state-of-the-art performance across CT and MR benchmarks for multi-organ, cardiac substructure, and tumor segmentation, including settings with real free-text clinical supervision. Code: https://github.com/rafiibnsultan/MedPlex.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedPlex（Medical Plexus of Vision and Language），一种端到端视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 框架，用于医学图像分割。MedPlex 通过双向融合 (Bi-Fusion) 使文本指导贯穿编码层级，并引入类别级与区域级概念对齐，将临床文本知识作为持续的结构化监督信号。摘要报告该方法在 CT 和 MR 的多器官、心脏亚结构和肿瘤分割基准上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 医学图像分割通常被当作纯视觉任务，而临床解读常依赖解剖、位置、外观和周围环境的文本知识。现有 VLM 分割方法往往仅将语言作为后期条件信号，限制了语言对视觉表示学习的影响。
Method: MedPlex 提出 Bi-Fusion（双向融合）机制，使视觉和文本表示在编码器层级间联合演化；同时引入类别级对齐（将每个解剖目标锚定到聚合的临床概念画像）和区域级对齐（通过类别特定的视觉证据保留形状、位置、外观、纹理等个体概念）。
Result: 摘要称 MedPlex 在 CT 和 MR 基准上针对多器官、心脏亚结构及肿瘤分割达到最先进性能，包括使用真实自由文本临床监督的设置。
Conclusion: 作者认为语言可以作为贯穿编码器的结构化监督而非仅作为后期提示，从而提升医学分割的临床 grounding。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning to Assemble Novel Structures with Unfamiliar Parts under Semantic Constraints
papers.abstract_en: This paper describes a neurosymbolic architecture for learning to assemble novel structures using evidence from embodied conversations and task demonstrations. We focus on scenarios where an agent encounters, after deployment, semantic constraints on structures--in other words, constraints as to which part types and features make valid structures--that were not available during training, and where it is initially unaware of the relevant structure and component part concepts. The agent must acquire and exploit such knowledge through user interactions while attempting assembly. We study this setting in a simulated toy truck assembly domain, learning from symbolic evidence encoded in natural language and from dense visual observations. Our experiments show that communicating semantic constraints through natural language (e.g., "dump trucks have a dumper") yields more data-efficient online adaptation than relying only on task demonstrations and/or only naming the parts through natural language.
papers.comment: Accepted to, and to appear in the 20th Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning (NeSy 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号 (neuro-symbolic) 架构，让智能体在部署后通过与用户的具身对话和任务演示，学习组装包含陌生部件的新结构。研究场景是模拟玩具卡车装配域，智能体最初不知道相关结构与部件概念，也面对训练时未出现的语义约束。实验表明，用自然语言传达语义约束（例如“dump trucks have a dumper”）比仅依赖任务演示或仅用自然语言命名部件能实现更高数据效率的在线适应。
Motivation: 现有方法假定训练时已获得所有结构约束，而实际部署中智能体会遇到训练时未出现的语义约束，且对相关结构和部件概念一无所知；智能体需要在尝试装配的过程中通过与用户交互获取并利用这些知识。
Method: 采用神经符号架构，从自然语言编码的符号证据和密集视觉观测中学习；具体场景中通过具身对话和任务演示获取语义约束，并在线更新对结构及部件概念的认知。
Result: 在模拟玩具卡车装配域中，通过自然语言传达语义约束（如“dump trucks have a dumper”）比仅依赖任务演示、或仅通过自然语言命名部件，带来更数据高效的在线适应。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自然语言交互传递语义约束是数据高效的在线适应关键，但其结论局限于模拟玩具卡车装配域这一设定。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning Qwen3-27B for C-to-Rust Code Translation: A Three-Stage Curriculum of Pretraining, Debugging-Aware SFT, and Task-Specific SFT
papers.abstract_en: Translating C code into safe, idiomatic Rust is a longstanding software-engineering goal because it can eliminate entire classes of memory-safety vulnerabilities while preserving the functional behavior of legacy systems. Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for this task but typically underperform when applied off-the-shelf, since general-purpose pretraining rarely emphasizes idiomatic Rust generation, cross-language semantic equivalence, or the ability to reason about and repair compiler/runtime feedback. In this report we describe a three-stage fine-tuning curriculum applied to Qwen3-27B that is designed to progressively specialize the model for the C-to-Rust (C2Rust) translation task: (1) continued pretraining on Rust-centric corpora to strengthen the model's prior over idiomatic Rust syntax and standard-library usage; (2) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the microsoft/Verus_Training_Data dataset to instill debugging and self-repair behavior over Rust code; and (3) task-specific SFT on paired C/Rust solutions derived from LeetCode problems to teach direct semantic translation. We evaluate the resulting model using the agentic, static-analysis-guided verification framework of SACTOR, which performs structure-aware, two-phase (unidiomatic to idiomatic) translation with foreign-function-interface (FFI)-based end-to-end (E2E) testing. We report success rate, idiomaticity (Clippy lint counts, unsafe-code fraction), and failure-mode analyses, and compare our fine-tuned model against baseline Qwen3-27B and other LLMs evaluated under the same framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对通用大语言模型在 C 到 Rust 翻译任务上表现不佳的问题，提出一种针对 Qwen3-27B 的三阶段微调课程：先在 Rust 中心语料上继续预训练，再在 microsoft/Verus_Training_Data 上进行调试感知的监督微调，最后在 LeetCode 配对的 C/Rust 解决方案上进行任务特定微调。评估使用 SACTOR 静态分析引导的验证框架，报告成功率、惯用性（Clippy lint 计数、unsafe 代码比例）和失败模式分析，并与基线 Qwen3-27B 及其他 LLM 比较。
Motivation: 将 C 代码翻译为安全、惯用的 Rust 是长期目标，可消除内存安全漏洞并保留功能行为，但现成的 LLM 通常表现不佳，因为通用预训练不重视惯用 Rust 生成、跨语言语义等价性以及根据编译器/运行时反馈进行推理和修复的能力。
Method: 提出三阶段微调课程：(1) 在 Rust 中心语料上继续预训练以强化惯用 Rust 语法和标准库使用先验；(2) 在 microsoft/Verus_Training_Data 上做监督微调以灌输 Rust 代码的调试和自我修复行为；(3) 在 LeetCode 派生的配对 C/Rust 解决方案上做任务特定 SFT 以教授直接语义翻译。评估采用 SACTOR 框架的结构感知两阶段（非惯用到惯用）翻译，并进行基于 FFI 的端到端测试。
Result: 摘要报告了包含成功率、惯用性（Clippy lint 计数、unsafe 代码比例）和失败模式分析的评估，并与 Qwen3-27B 基线及同框架下的其他 LLM 比较；未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该三阶段课程能逐步将模型专门化到 C 到 Rust 翻译任务，并通过静态分析引导的验证框架得到评估；文中未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: hint$^2$: Hierarchical World Models for Inference-Time Temporal Logic Guidance
papers.abstract_en: A central goal of robot learning is to enable robots to execute rich instructions specified at runtime. Large-scale language-conditioned policies have made substantial progress toward this goal, yet still struggle with temporal structure and safety constraints. Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) provides a powerful language to express complex, non-Markovian instructions. However, guiding learned manipulation policies toward LTL satisfaction remains challenging because modern policies generate short-horizon action chunks and replan in closed loop, while almost all LTL specifications are evaluated over long-horizon trajectories. In this paper, we introduce hint$^2$, a method for guiding short-horizon policies toward satisfying complex LTL specifications at inference time using hierarchical world models. Our key idea is to derive two separate guidance objectives using each world model's abstraction level. A high-level model predicts future action-induced transitions in task-relevant atomic propositions to guide progress through the LTL automaton, while a low-level dynamics model predicts immediate state evolution for accurate local safety guidance. Our results show that hint$^2$ overcomes the limitations of current LTL-guided diffusion methods, outperforms existing inference-time steering methods in CALVIN, and successfully completes instructions with complex liveness and safety constraints more elegantly than language-conditioned alternatives. Finally, we demonstrate that hint$^2$ can handle complex instructions on a real UR5e manipulator.
papers.comment: Videos available on our project page: https://anonymous-hint2.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向机器人操作中在运行时执行带时间逻辑指令的问题，提出 hint$^2$：利用分层世界模型 (hierarchical world models) 在推理时为短视界策略提供线性时序逻辑 (LTL) 引导。高层模型预测原子命题转移以推进 LTL 自动机，低层动力学模型提供局部安全引导。摘要报告该方法在 CALVIN 上优于现有推理时引导方法，并在真实 UR5e 机械臂上完成复杂指令。
Motivation: 现有语言条件策略难以处理长视界、非马尔可夫的指令；LTL 能表达这类时序与安全约束，但现代策略以短视界动作块闭环重规划，而 LTL 规格在长视界轨迹上评估，造成引导困难。
Method: 提出 hint$^2$，用两种不同抽象层次的世界模型分别派生引导目标：高层模型预测动作引起的任务相关原子命题转移，用于推进 LTL 自动机；低层动力学模型预测即时状态演化，用于局部安全引导。
Result: 摘要报告 hint$^2$ 克服了现有 LTL 引导扩散方法的局限，在 CALVIN 基准上超过现有推理时转向 (inference-time steering) 方法，并能比语言条件替代方法更优雅地完成含活性 (liveness) 与安全约束的指令；在真实 UR5e 机械臂上验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为分层世界模型的双层引导可在推理时协调短视界策略与长视界 LTL 规格；摘要仅展示仿真与实物实验范围，未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EEG-PRISM: Physiologically-Grounded Interpretability of Predictions by EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Objective: Foundation models represent the next advancement in AI for EEG analysis; however current explainable AI techniques provide attribution scores in the time-channel input space, which is mismatched to clinical intuition about EEG. Thus, there is a critical need for a universal method that can extend the interpretability of any foundation model to alternative and physiologically relevant domains without modifying or retraining the underlying model. Methods: EEG-PRISM leverages linear transformations and established backpropagation rules to map time-channel attribution scores into alternative domains. We derive mappings to the frequency domain via an invertible DFT and to the source domain via an approximately invertible EEG generative model. We evaluate EEG-PRISM in simulated and real data, assessing recovery of ground-truth phenomena across domains with five foundation models and four AI explainers. Results: In simulation, EEG-PRISM achieves near-perfect spectral recovery and 69.2% spatial accuracy. In epilepsy, EEG-PRISM correctly determines that delta-theta activity is most salient and correctly localizes the seizure onset region with 50% accuracy. In autism, EEG-PRISM localizes the predictive delta-alpha biomarkers to frontal and temporal regions, consistent with prior work. Conclusion: EEG-PRISM is a theoretically-grounded post-hoc attribution method with accurate mapping into the spectral and spatial domains. It supports window-level analysis of transient events (e.g., seizures) and group-level identification of clinically relevant biomarkers (e.g., autism), thus advancing interpretable EEG foundation models. Significance: This work enables physiologically-grounded interpretation of EEG foundation models and supports clinically relevant insights such as event localization and biomarker identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EEG-PRISM，一种面向 EEG 基础模型的生理学可解释性后验归因方法。它利用线性变换和反向传播规则，将时间-通道归因分数映射到频域（通过可逆 DFT）和源域/空间域（通过近似可逆的 EEG 生成模型），无需修改或重训底层模型。作者在模拟与真实 EEG 数据上，用五个基础模型和四种可解释器评估，报告了频域近完美恢复、癫痫发作区定位与自闭症生物标志物定位等结果。
Motivation: 现有可解释 AI 对 EEG 基础模型只提供时间-通道输入空间的归因分数，与临床对 EEG 的直觉（频段、空间源）不匹配；需要一个不修改或重训模型即可把任意基础模型的解释映射到生理相关领域的通用方法。
Method: EEG-PRISM 通过可逆 DFT 将时间-通道归因映射到频域，并通过近似可逆的 EEG 生成模型映射到源域（空间域）；采用线性变换和既定反向传播规则实现，支持窗口级分析。评估覆盖五个基础模型和四种 AI 解释器，并在模拟及真实数据（癫痫、自闭症）上验证。
Result: 模拟中，EEG-PRISM 达到近完美的频谱恢复和 69.2% 的空间精度；在癫痫数据中正确判断 delta-theta 活动最显著，并以 50% 精度定位癫痫发作起始区；在自闭症数据中将 delta-alpha 预测性生物标志物定位到额叶和颞叶区域，与既往研究一致。
Conclusion: EEG-PRISM 是一种有理论依据的后验归因方法，能准确映射到频谱和空间域，支持对瞬时事件（如癫痫发作）的窗口级分析和对临床相关生物标志物（如自闭症）的组级识别，推进可解释的 EEG 基础模型。摘要未提及跨域局限或与天气/降水任务的关系。

papers.title: From BERT to Frontier Agents: Eight Years of Language-Model Progress, the Collapse of the Capability-Cost Curve, and the Rise of Task-Targeted Models
papers.abstract_en: Between October 2018 and July 2026 AI models progressed from simple systems like BERT to massive agents that solve complex math and write software. The ability to resolve real coding issues improved by nearly six times per year since late 2024. During this time costs dropped sharply with OpenAIs budget model GPT 5 point 6 Luna matching flagship capabilities for just one to six dollars per million tokens beating older versions at a fraction of the price. Top performance is now split across specialized models as Claude Opus 5 leads in frontend coding Claude Fable 5 excels at repository level coding and GPT 5 point 6 Sol dominates terminal tasks. In a grade school math test using the Qwen 2 point 5 model basic methods solved 58 of 100 problems while advanced sampling solved up to 79. A confidence ranking tool correctly identified 47 right answers in its top 50 choices proving highly useful for sorting tasks with all research materials made fully public.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回顾了 2018 年 10 月至 2026 年 7 月间语言模型从 BERT 演进到可解复杂数学和写软件的前沿 agent 的过程，并报告了多项量化趋势：真实编码问题解决能力自 2024 年底起每年提升近六倍，推理成本大幅下降，且顶级能力分散在不同专用模型上。作者还给出一个基于 Qwen 2.5 的小学数学测试评估以及一个置信度排序工具的实验结果，并承诺公开全部研究材料。
Motivation: 作者旨在系统梳理八年间的模型能力与成本变化，指出推理成本崩溃和性能分布向任务特定模型（task-targeted models）转移这一趋势，帮助研究者理解当前模型生态的格局。
Method: 论文采用分析加评估的方式：对历史模型进展做综述性分析，并设计测试来量化成本与能力；具体实验包括使用 Qwen 2.5 在小学数学题上对比基础方法与高级采样，以及利用一个置信度排序工具对答案进行排序筛选。
Result: 摘要报告：自 2024 年底起真实编码问题解决能力每年提升约六倍；OpenAI 的预算模型 GPT-5.6 Luna 以每百万 token 1 至 6 美元的价格匹敌旗舰能力；Claude Opus 5、Claude Fable 5、GPT-5.6 Sol 分别在前后端编码、仓库级编码和终端任务上领先；在 Qwen 2.5 的数学测试中，基础方法解出 58/100 题，高级采样最高解出 79/100 题，置信度排序工具在 top 50 中识别出 47 个正确答案。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前顶级模型的能力高度专业化，不同模型在不同任务域各居领先，且成本坍塌使旗舰级能力变得廉价；同时强调置信度排序工具对任务筛选有用，并声明所有研究材料完全公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PROVE: Training-Free Prompt Recovery using Verifiable Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Modern text-to-image models can generate highly realistic images from natural-language prompts, while recent advances in prompt inversion have made it increasingly feasible to recover those prompts from generated outputs, raising new concerns for copyright protection and content ownership. As prompt marketplaces emerge, recovered prompts can enable both the unauthorized reproduction and redistribution of copyrighted creative works, and the exposure of the prompts that encode an artist's creative recipe in AI-generated content. Existing prompt inversion methods rely on gradient-based optimization, autoregressive captioning, or reinforcement learning. However, optimization-based methods often produce unreadable prompts, captioning methods hallucinate unverified details, and RL-based approaches frequently overfit to specific generators while introducing evaluation circularity. We introduce PROVE (Prompt Recovery with Verified Evidence), a training-free, black-box prompt inversion attack that reconstructs prompts by composing verifiable scene descriptions rather than optimizing token sequences, targeting both original copyrighted works and AI-generated content. The resulting prompts are fully auditable, with every recovered claim grounded in explicit image evidence, and are formalized through a precision-constrained recall maximization objective. Across MS-COCO, Flickr30K, and Lexica, using state-of-the-art text-to-image generators, PROVE consistently outperforms optimization, captioning, and RL-based baselines on image similarity (DINO, LPIPS) and text-image alignment (CLIP), without any training, generator access, or fine-tuning, demonstrating a stronger and more practical prompt inversion attack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PROVE（Prompt Recovery with Verified Evidence），一种无训练、黑盒的提示词反演攻击方法，通过组合可验证的场景描述而非优化 token 序列来重建文本到图像模型的提示词，目标覆盖原始版权作品和 AI 生成内容。恢复出的提示词完全可审计，每个声称都有显式图像证据支撑，并形式化为精度约束下的召回最大化目标。在 MS-COCO、Flickr30K 和 Lexica 上使用最新文本到图像生成器，PROVE 在图像相似度（DINO、LPIPS）和文本-图像对齐（CLIP）上一致优于优化、captioning 和 RL 基线。
Motivation: 提示词反演技术的进步使从生成图像恢复原始提示词变得可行，而提示词市场的出现引发了版权侵权和艺术家创作配方泄露的担忧。现有方法各有缺陷：优化式方法产生不可读提示词，captioning 方法会幻觉出未验证细节，RL 方法常过拟合特定生成器并带来评价循环问题。
Method: 提出一种无需训练、无需生成器访问的纯黑盒攻击，将提示词恢复构建为组合可验证场景描述的过程，而不是直接的 token 序列优化；每个恢复声称都锚定在显式图像证据上，并用 precision-constrained recall maximization 目标进行形式化。
Result: 在 MS-COCO、Flickr30K 和 Lexica 三个数据集上，结合最新文本到图像生成器，PROVE 在 DINO、LPIPS 图像相似度以及 CLIP 文本-图像对齐指标上一致超越优化、captioning 和 RL 基线，且无需任何训练、生成器访问或微调。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PROVE 是一种更强且更实用的提示词反演攻击，输出完全可审计，所有恢复内容都有图像证据支撑，并可在黑盒、零训练的设定下工作。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Multiphase-Diff: Diffusion-Based Generative Modeling for High-Contrast Multiphase Physical Systems with Sharp Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Physics-constrained diffusion for high-contrast, sharp-interface multiphase fields faces three coupled difficulties. At coefficient jumps, expanded pointwise strong-form PDE residuals contain singular gradient terms that can penalize physical interfaces. Under extreme contrast, low-magnitude phases may fall below the diffusion noise floor and be erased, misscaled, or generated with negative coefficients, while a global likelihood scale allows high-magnitude phases to dominate supervision. We therefore propose Multiphase-Diff, which makes three corresponding contributions: (i) a conservative flux residual that avoids differentiating discontinuous coefficients and enforces discrete conservation; (ii) an analytic bijective representation that maps low-amplitude signals to order-one latent scales and guarantees coefficient positivity through exponential decoding; and (iii) a Jacobi-preconditioned likelihood that normalizes local residual scales for balanced supervision. Experiments on three complementary multiphase benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of Multiphase-Diff over seven baselines in both physical and distributional fidelity and its robustness across phase contrasts and compositions, establishing its effectiveness for scientific sample generation in this challenging regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multiphase-Diff，一种面向高对比度、尖锐界面多相物理系统的物理约束扩散生成模型。摘要指出，现有物理约束扩散在高对比系数跳变处因奇异梯度项惩罚界面、低幅相被噪声底限抹除或产生负系数、全局似然尺度导致高幅相主导监督等问题。作者提出保守通量残差、解析双射表示与 Jacobi 预条件似然三项改进，并在三个多相基准上相较七种基线同时提升物理保真度与分布保真度。
Motivation: 物理约束扩散用于高对比度、尖锐界面多相场时面临三个耦合困难：系数跳变处的强形式 PDE 残差含有奇异梯度项，会惩罚真实物理界面；极端对比下低幅相低于扩散噪声底限而被抹除、错标度或生成负系数；全局似然尺度使高幅相主导监督。
Method: 提出三项对应设计：(i) 保守通量残差，避免对不连续系数求导并强制离散守恒；(ii) 解析双射表示，将低幅信号映射到量级约为一的隐空间并经由指数解码保证系数为正；(iii) Jacobi 预条件似然，归一化局部残差尺度以实现均衡监督。
Result: 在三个互补的多相基准上，Multiphase-Diff 在物理保真度与分布保真度上均优于七种基线，并在不同相位对比度与组成下表现稳健。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为高对比、尖锐界面多相体系中的科学样本生成提供了有效方法，但其适用范围限于该类物理系统，未涉及气象或降水等具体应用场景。

papers.title: The Query Knows What to Forget: A Second Erase Direction for Linear Attention
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention keeps a state of fixed size. At long context, many stored items share this state, and interference between them degrades retrieval. Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2), like every delta-rule model before it, derives its erase vector from the key of the current token. However, the interference in its reads is measured through the query, and the erase step cannot reach it. We introduce the Query-derived Erase Direction (QED). QED adds a second erase direction derived from the query and orthogonal to the key. In the fast-weight view, a key-directed delta edit cannot change the key-orthogonal part of a read. It uses the editable part to cancel old-state content measured along the query. It also improves retrieval at every length past the training window, and it about doubles the usable context length on S-NIAH-1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对线性注意力（linear attention）固定大小状态中长上下文物项相互干扰导致检索退化的问题，提出 Query-derived Erase Direction (QED)。QED 为 Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) 等 delta-rule 模型增加一个由 query 导出且与 key 正交的第二擦除方向，用于抵消沿 query 方向测得的旧状态内容。摘要报告该方法在超过训练窗口的任意长度下都改善检索，并将 S-NIAH-1 上的可用上下文长度大约翻倍。
Motivation: 线性注意力维护固定大小的状态，长上下文下大量存储项共享该状态，之间的干扰会损害检索；现有 delta-rule 模型（如 GDN-2）的擦除向量都由当前 token 的 key 导出，但读取时干扰是通过 query 衡量的，擦除步骤无法触及该部分。
Method: 引入 QED，增加一个由 query 派生、与 key 正交的第二擦除方向。在 fast-weight 视角下，由 key 定向的 delta 编辑无法改变读取中与 key 正交的部分，QED 利用可编辑部分来抵消沿 query 测量的旧状态内容。
Result: 摘要显示 QED 可改善训练窗口之外所有长度上的检索表现，并在 S-NIAH-1 上使可用上下文长度大约翻倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为 delta-rule 线性注意力模型需要 query 导向的擦除方向才能处理读取侧的干扰，QED 提供了一种与 key 正交的补充擦除机制。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 引入 QED，增加一个由 query 派生、与 key 正交的第二擦除方向。在 fast-weight 视角下，由 key 定向的 delta 编辑无法改变读取中与 key 正交的部分，QED 利用可编辑部分来抵消沿 query 测量的旧状态内容。
summary_sections.result: 摘要显示 QED 可改善训练窗口之外所有长度上的检索表现，并在 S-NIAH-1 上使可用上下文长度大约翻倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 delta-rule 线性注意力模型需要 query 导向的擦除方向才能处理读取侧的干扰，QED 提供了一种与 key 正交的补充擦除机制。

papers.title: Second Thought: Reasoning in Parallel as LLM Agents Act and Observe
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents in the ReAct paradigm alternate between reasoning, acting, and observing, but deliberate reasoning is confined to the Thought phase: while the agent serializes an action and waits for the environment, its reasoning is frozen. We identify this recurring interval for Action and Observation as a reasoning idle window and ask whether it can host additional reasoning in parallel that serves future turns. Therefore, we propose Second Thought, a training-free inference framework that forks four auxiliary branches the instant each Thought phase concludes, decodes them concurrently with the main loop, and merges the generated thoughts back when the environment observation arrives. In this way, Second Thought relocates the added reasoning off the main thread's sequential decoding path. Across three agentic benchmarks and three reasoning LLMs, Second Thought lowers the average turn count in all nine (model,benchmark) pairs and reduces main thread decoding in six of them by up to 43% (roughly 20% on average among those settings), while leaving it essentially unchanged in a seventh; Pass@1 shows no significant change in seven of nine pairs and the two significant differences are +12.4 and +10.2 points. Against a compute-matched control that forces an equivalent budget onto the main thread's own reasoning, it attains strictly higher Pass@1 with 1.3 to 3.2 less sequential decoding in all four settings where the control applies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 ReAct 范式中 LLM agent 的推理被限制在 Thought 阶段的问题，提出 Second Thought，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的推理框架：在每个 Thought 阶段结束时并行fork四个辅助分支，在主循环解码的同时并发生成额外思考，并在环境观测返回时合并回主线程。摘要报告在三个 agentic 基准和三个推理 LLM 上，九个 (model, benchmark) 组合的平均回合数全部下降，其中六个组合的主线程解码减少最高 43%（平均约 20%），Pass@1 在九个组合中的七个无显著变化，两个显著提升分别为 +12.4 和 +10.2 分。
Motivation: ReAct 范式中 agent 在 Thought 阶段之外，序列化执行 Action 并等待环境观测时推理处于停滞状态；作者将这段 Action 与 Observation 之间的重复间隔识别为推理空闲窗口 (reasoning idle window)，并探讨能否在其中并行开展服务于未来回合的额外推理。
Method: 提出 Second Thought 框架：在每个 Thought 阶段结束的瞬间fork四个辅助分支，使它们在主循环之外并发解码，待环境观测到达时把生成的思考合并回主线程，从而将额外推理移出主线程的串行解码路径；该方法不依赖训练。
Result: 在三个 agentic 基准与三个推理 LLM 上，平均回合数在全部九个组合中下降；主线程解码在六个组合中减少最高 43%（这些设置中平均约 20%），第七个组合几乎不变；Pass@1 在七个组合中无显著变化，两个显著差异为 +12.4 和 +10.2 分。与将等量计算预算强制放到主线程推理的 compute-matched 对照相比，在适用该对照的全部四个设置中，Second Thought 以少 1.3 至 3.2 的串行解码量取得严格更高的 Pass@1。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是，将额外推理放到 Action/Observation 空闲窗口并行执行，可以在减少串行解码和回合数的同时保持甚至提升 Pass@1，且该收益无需训练即可获得；其适用范围是 agentic 推理场景下的训练无关推理框架。

papers.title: Ontology-Grounded Project Memory for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents have become the primary means of generating new code in many software projects, and the resulting velocity of changes makes keeping track of the reasons behind those changes challenging. This paper introduces MOOSEDev, a system designed to give coding agents structured, ontology-grounded project memory. The system captures architectural decisions, lessons, constraints, and rationales in a knowledge graph exposed to agents via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface. Records carry lifecycle status, provenance, and supersession links, queryable via MOOSE, a proprietary neurosymbolic engine that treats the symbolic layer as the primary reasoning substrate. We compared MOOSEDev against a production vector-memory tool on a neutral public corpus of 835 typed records. MOOSEDev returned the expected answer set essentially in full (0.98-1.00) on supersession, set-completeness, and negation questions, whereas the baseline's top-k retrieval surfaced between 6% and 27%. Conversely, relevance recall and token cost were largely equivalent between the two systems. We also describe a temporal commit-history bootstrap of our own codebase, a pre-registered live trial, and lessons learned.
papers.comment: 5 pages. Accepted at NeSy 2026 (Industry Track); to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research vol. 284. Benchmark artifact: https://github.com/Trivyn/moosedev
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 MOOSEDev，一个为编码智能体 (coding agents) 提供基于本体 (ontology) 的结构化项目记忆系统。系统将架构决策、经验教训、约束与理由存入知识图谱，并通过 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 接口暴露给智能体；记录带有生命周期状态、来源 (provenance) 和取代链接 (supersession links)，可经符号层推理引擎 MOOSE 查询。在 835 条类型化记录的中性公开语料上，MOOSEDev 在取代、集合完备性和否定类问题上的召回率接近完整 (0.98-1.00)，而向量记忆基线 top-k 检索仅覆盖 6%-27%；相关性召回与 token 开销两者基本相当。
Motivation: 编码智能体已成为许多软件项目中生成新代码的主要手段，变更速度使得追踪变更背后的原因变得困难；现有方法缺少对架构决策、约束和理由的结构化记忆。
Method: 提出 MOOSEDev，将项目记忆构建为知识图谱，并通过 MCP 接口向智能体暴露记录；记录携带生命周期、来源与取代关系，由符号层作为主要推理基底的神经符号引擎 (neurosymbolic engine) MOOSE 查询。
Result: 在 835 条类型化记录的中性公开语料上，MOOSEDev 在取代、集合完备性和否定类问题的预期答案集召回为 0.98-1.00，而基线向量记忆工具 top-k 检索仅为 6%-27%；两者在相关性召回和 token 成本上基本相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为以符号层为主的记忆推理能够显著提升对复杂关系问题的完整回答，并报告了时间性提交历史引导 (temporal commit-history bootstrap) 的自身代码库实验、预注册现场试验 (pre-registered live trial) 和经验教训。
Relevance: 0
