papers.title: What to Preserve, Where to Adapt: A Depth-Wise Analysis of Forgetting in Continual Gynecological Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation models are typically trained under the assumption that all data are available simultaneously. However, in clinical practice, datasets often arrive sequentially, requiring models to adapt continuously to evolving data distributions. We study this problem in gynecological image segmentation, where substantial heterogeneity across imaging modalities, anatomical structures, and annotation protocols creates a particularly challenging continual learning setting. Under these large distribution shifts, existing continual learning methods struggle to preserve previously learned knowledge, leading to catastrophic forgetting. To better understand forgetting in this setting, we investigate how different encoder--decoder regions influence segmentation performance and forgetting during continual gynecological segmentation. Through block-wise ablation analysis, we observe that ablating early encoder and late decoder regions results in the largest performance degradation, indicating that segmentation performance depends unevenly across the network hierarchy. Using controlled adaptation experiments, we further show that forgetting remains limited when updates are restricted to bottleneck-adjacent regions, but increases sharply once shallower encoders and decoders become trainable, even when only a small subset of parameters is updated. These findings suggest that forgetting in the encoder-decoder architecture is strongly influenced by where updates occur across network depth during continual learning. Full code and analysis pipelines will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究持续学习（continual learning）下妇科图像分割模型的灾难性遗忘问题。作者通过分块消融分析发现，早期编码器和晚期解码器区域的消融导致性能下降最大；受控适应实验表明，仅更新瓶颈邻近区域时遗忘有限，而一旦浅层编码器和解码器可训练，遗忘急剧增加，即使只更新少量参数。结论认为遗忘受网络深度上更新位置的影响。
Motivation: 医学图像分割模型通常假设所有数据同时可得，但临床中数据集顺序到达，模型需持续适应不断变化的数据分布；妇科图像分割在成像模态、解剖结构和标注协议上差异大，持续学习更具挑战，现有方法难以保留旧知识，导致灾难性遗忘。
Method: 采用基于块的消融分析（block-wise ablation）和受控适应实验（controlled adaptation experiments），系统考察编码器-解码器不同区域对分割性能与遗忘的影响。
Result: 消融早期编码器和晚期解码器导致最大性能下降；限制更新在瓶颈邻近区域时遗忘有限，而一旦浅层编码器和解码器变得可训练，遗忘急剧增加，即使只更新少量参数。
Conclusion: 遗忘在编码器-解码器架构中强烈受到持续学习时更新发生在网络深度位置的影响；完整代码和分析流程将在论文被接收后公开。

papers.title: Contrastive Learning for Interpretable Anomaly Detection at Collider Experiments
papers.abstract_en: Generic event-level anomaly detection for collider physics has two recurring problems: anomaly scores are hard to interpret, and they correlate strongly with energy scale and object multiplicity. We present Organized Representation via Contrastive learning for Anomaly detection (ORCA), a two-stage framework that first learns an embedding space via supervised contrastive learning across a diverse set of physics processes, then runs a standard autoencoder in that space to generate event-level anomaly scores. On a simulated dataset consistent with conditions at the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider, ORCA delivers significant gains in both breadth and depth of sensitivity to new physics signals with respect to a baseline autoencoder architecture. Beyond improved sensitivity, the contrastive embedding makes the anomalous sample interpretable: because known processes occupy distinct regions of the space, a maximum-likelihood template fit to the embedding distributions can attribute events in an anomalous sample to template physics processes with quantified uncertainties. We demonstrate that the fit accurately recovers injected signal yields, including for signals excluded from the training of the embedding, and characterizes signals absent from the template library through the known processes they most resemble. These results establish ORCA as a route to interpretable anomaly detection-based searches at colliders, where the embedding geometry carries higher dimensional physics information compared to standard one-dimensional output fits, enhancing downstream statistical analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ORCA（Organized Representation via Contrastive learning for Anomaly detection），一种用于对撞机物理事件级异常检测的两阶段框架：先用多种物理过程的监督对比学习（supervised contrastive learning）学习嵌入空间，再在该空间上运行标准自编码器生成事件级异常分数。在模拟的高亮度大型强子对撞机（HL-LHC）条件下，ORCA 相比基线自编码器对新的物理信号在敏感度的广度和深度上都有显著提升；此外，由于已知过程在嵌入空间中占据不同区域，最大似然模板拟合可以归因异常事件并给出量化不确定度。
Motivation: 对撞机物理中的通用事件级异常检测存在两个反复出现的问题：异常分数难以解释，且分数与能量尺度和物体多重性（object multiplicity）强相关。
Method: 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段通过监督对比学习在多样化物理过程集合上学习嵌入空间，第二阶段在该嵌入空间内运行标准自编码器以生成事件级异常分数。
Result: 在符合 HL-LHC 条件的模拟数据集上，ORCA 相对基线自编码器架构在敏感度的广度与深度上均取得显著提升；模板拟合能准确恢复注入的信号产额（包括未参与嵌入训练的信号），并能通过最相似已知过程刻画模板库中缺失的信号。
Conclusion: 摘要指出 ORCA 为对撞机上可解释的基于异常检测的搜索提供了可行路径，其嵌入几何相比标准一维输出拟合携带更高维的物理信息，可增强后续统计分析。

papers.title: Consistent Model Chasing Is Minimax Optimal: The Exact Value of Scalar Adversarial Adaptive Control under Large Parametric Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: We solve exactly a fundamental problem of adaptive control against adversarial disturbances: regulate the scalar system $x_{t+1} = ax_t + u_t + w_t$, $x_0=0$, $\|w\|_\infty \le 1$, where the constant pole $a \in [-Δ, Δ]$ is unknown in sign and magnitude and $Δ$ is arbitrarily large. Elementary as the system looks, the least worst-case peak $\|x\|_\infty$ that a causal controller can guarantee against an adversarial pair $(a, w)$ (the value of this game) has, to our knowledge, never been determined for any adaptive control problem with parametric uncertainty of arbitrary size under this criterion; existing theory supplies stability certificates, gain bounds, and regret rates, not the value. That value is $γ^\star(Δ) = 1 + Δ$ for every $Δ>0$. The summand $1$ is the irreducible price of the disturbance, and $Δ$ the exact price of a single, unavoidable identification spike. The optimal policy is certainty-equivalent deadbeat control at the midpoint of the set-membership consistent interval, an instance of the robust oracle $\times$ consistent model chasing architecture. The architecture is forced, not merely sufficient: writing $θ_t := -u_t/x_t$ exhibits every causal controller as an oracle-selector composition, and optimality pins the selector to the midpoint at the critical histories. The standard tools, classical and modern, each fail quantifiably: probing is punished before it pays, commitment is fatal at sub-disturbance excitation once adaptation is necessary, optimism degenerates to tie-breaking or pays asymptotically at least twice the optimum, and regret certificates are blind to the worst-case peak in both directions. The optimal law contains no exploration mechanism, its learning purely passive. These results give the first exact optimality certificate for consistent model chasing as a design principle for adversarial adaptive control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文精确求解了一个标量自适应对抗控制问题的博弈值：对系统 x_{t+1}=ax_t+u_t+w_t，极点 a∈[-Δ,Δ] 未知且 Δ 任意大，扰动逐点界为 1。作者证明所有因果控制器能保证的最坏情况峰值为 γ*(Δ)=1+Δ，其中 1 是扰动不可约代价，Δ 是单次不可避免的辨识尖峰代价；最优策略是取集合成员一致性区间 (set-membership consistent interval) 中点的确定性等价 deadbeat control。
Motivation: 现有自适应控制理论只提供稳定性证书、增益界和 regret 率，从未在任意大小参数不确定下精确给出最坏情况下峰值这一博弈值；该文填补了这一空白。
Method: 通过博弈论精确分析求解该 minimax 问题的值；将最优策略刻画为鲁棒预言机 × 一致模型追踪 (robust oracle × consistent model chasing) 架构的实例；并利用 θ_t := -u_t/x_t 说明任何因果控制器都可分解为预言机-选择器组合，从而证明该架构是被迫的而非仅充分。
Result: 摘要报告对任意 Δ>0 博弈值均为 γ*(Δ)=1+Δ；并指出标准工具各自失败：探测会被惩罚、承诺在亚扰动激励下致命、乐观原则退化为平局裁定或渐近付出至少两倍最优代价、regret 证书对最坏情况峰值双向失灵。最优律不含探索机制，其学习是被动的。
Conclusion: 该结果首次为一致模型追踪作为对抗性自适应控制设计原则提供了精确最优性证书；结论限定于标量系统与最坏情况峰值准则。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unknown Unknowns: Model Misspecification in Machine Learning for Physics
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning is now a central tool for solving inverse problems in particle physics and astronomy. Models are trained on simulation and deployed on real data, raising the question not just of whether they fit, but of whether they are wrong in ways we did not anticipate: the unknown unknowns. This challenge of model misspecification is not unique to machine learning. In physics, misspecification is sometimes exactly what we want to find: new discoveries appear as failures of existing models. At other times, we want such effects absorbed into the analysis without biasing the measurement. A robust analysis is one that absorbs the misspecifications we are not interested in, while preserving sensitivity to the ones we are. Machine learning can both amplify misspecification and provide new tools to address it. We discuss the challenges of model misspecification, diagnostics for detecting it, and strategies for mitigation. No single diagnostic can confirm that a model is correctly specified: detection and mitigation are two halves of an iterative loop, in which a battery of complementary diagnostics is applied, the model is updated, and the process repeated. Robustness against unknown unknowns is ultimately less about any single technique than about a disposition: a willingness to suspect one's own model, and to design analyses that can survive being wrong in ways one did not anticipate.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 2 figures, part of the VERaiPHY initiative
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 VERaiPHY 计划下的一篇讨论性文章，针对粒子物理与天文中机器学习模型在仿真上训练、在真实数据上部署所引发的模型误设定 (model misspecification) 问题，即所谓的“未知的未知” (unknown unknowns)。作者认为稳健的分析应当吸收我们不感兴趣的误设定，同时保留对感兴趣误设定的敏感度，并指出检测与缓解是同一迭代循环的两半。文章不包含具体实验结果，侧重概念框架与诊断/缓解策略的讨论。
Motivation: 机器学习已成为粒子物理和天文中求解逆问题的核心工具，但模型在仿真上训练后部署到真实数据，需要追问模型是否以未预料到的方式出错；这种误设定在物理中有时正是新发现来源，有时则需要被吸收以免偏置测量。
Method: 文章从概念层面讨论模型误设定的挑战，梳理用于检测误设定的诊断工具 (diagnostics) 以及缓解策略 (mitigation)，强调检测和缓解构成一个迭代循环：应用一组互补的诊断、更新模型、再重复。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验指标或基准结果，属于概念性/观点性讨论，未给出具体数据集上的性能数据。
Conclusion: 作者强调，对未知的未知的稳健性最终不取决于单一技术，而取决于一种研究姿态：愿意怀疑自己的模型，并设计即使以未预期方式出错也能存续的分析流程。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Exploring ESC Winners with Nested Diagrams
papers.abstract_en: We present ConceptFlow, a scikit-learn-compatible Python library for Formal Concept Analysis that constructs and renders nested line diagrams from many-valued formal contexts. Given a many-valued context and a partition of its attributes into conceptual scales, ConceptFlow performs conceptual scaling, computes the factor lattices, identifies filled nodes of the corresponding subdirect product, and produces an interactive visualization. We apply ConceptFlow to the winners of the Eurovision Song Contest from 1975 to 2025, exploring relationships between voting patterns and musical characteristics. Voting support is captured by an outer scale spanning regional, cultural, historical, and political dimensions, while an inner scale captures musical characteristics via tempo and key. The resulting nested line diagram reveals implications across both scales, exposing dependencies between how winning entries were voted for and the musical properties they share.
papers.comment: Accepted for CONCEPTS 2026 Data Analysis Showcase (CDAS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 ConceptFlow，一个兼容 scikit-learn 的 Python 库，用于形式概念分析 (Formal Concept Analysis)，可从多值形式背景 (many-valued formal contexts) 构建并渲染嵌套线图 (nested line diagrams)。作者将该库应用于 1975-2025 年欧洲歌唱大赛 (Eurovision Song Contest) 获奖者数据，探索投票模式与音乐特征的关系，并展示嵌套线图如何在投票尺度与音乐尺度之间揭示蕴含关系。
Motivation: 嵌套线图的构建与可视化在形式概念分析工具中缺乏易用、可交互的实现，作者希望通过一个 scikit-learn 兼容的库降低使用门槛，并用真实文化数据集展示其分析能力。
Method: ConceptFlow 接收多值形式背景及属性划分，执行概念缩放 (conceptual scaling)，计算因子格 (factor lattices)，识别相应子直积 (subdirect product) 的填充节点，并生成交互式可视化。应用案例中，外层尺度以区域、文化、历史和政治维度刻画投票支持，内层尺度通过速度和调性刻画音乐特征。
Result: 摘要未给出量化指标；其核心结果是生成的嵌套线图揭示了跨两个尺度的蕴含关系，显示出获奖作品的投票方式与其共享音乐属性之间的依赖。
Conclusion: 该工作以欧洲歌唱大赛获奖者为例，说明 ConceptFlow 支持的嵌套线图能够用于探索投票模式与音乐特征之间的依赖关系；摘要未讨论方法的局限性或定量评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning Unsteady Aneurysm Hemodynamics with Physics-Informed DeepONets
papers.abstract_en: Clinically actionable, patient-specific hemodynamic assessment, specifically wall shear stress, vortex structure and pressure distributions, is critical for determining risky or unfavorable evolution in Abdominal Aortic Aneurysms (AAA). While Physics-Informed Deep Operator Networks (PI-DeepONets) show promising results in complementing established 5 tools such as Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), a persistent architectural challenge remains for complex 3D flows. In this direction, we propose a Modified Multi-Input Multi-Output PI-DeepONets (M3PI-DeepONet) designed for predicting unsteady flows in an idealized AAA geometry. Central to our model is the Aggregated Injection strategy, where latent representations from multiple input branches are fused prior to trunk injection, allowing the coordinate basis to adapt to multiple physical constraints. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first architecture to combine the layer-wise gating mechanism with a multi-branch operator-network topology, yielding an input-adaptive trunk basis. Additionally, we integrate the 3D Navier-Stokes equations as governing physical laws, so the model is trained based on physics-informed residuals, initial and boundary conditions, and only 0.3% of the labeled internal data together with the selected branch-conditioning signals. The M3PI-DeepONet simultaneously predicts unsteady 3D flow velocity and pressure fields with an average relative L2 velocity error below 4% and pressure error around 5% while achieving a conservative retained-cycle inference speedup of approximately 36x compared to reference CFD simulations once the branch inputs used for conditioning are available. This work advances the application of deep learning in cardiovascular disease modeling, marking step toward real-time, non-invasive clinical diagnostics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进的多输入多输出物理信息深度算子网络 M3PI-DeepONet，用于在理想化腹主动脉瘤 (AAA) 几何中预测非定常三维血流速度和压力场。模型采用聚合注入 (Aggregated Injection) 策略融合多分支潜在表示，并首次将逐层门控机制与多分支算子网络拓扑结合，形成输入自适应的主干基。训练仅依赖 0.3% 标记内部数据及物理信息残差、初始和边界条件，最终以较低误差和约 36 倍推理加速逼近参考 CFD 结果。
Motivation: 临床上需要可操作、患者特定的血流动力学评估（壁面剪应力、涡结构和压力分布）来判断 AAA 的危险演化，但复杂三维流动下现有 PI-DeepONet 仍存在持久的架构挑战。
Method: 提出 M3PI-DeepONet，核心是聚合注入策略：在主干注入前融合来自多个输入分支的潜在表示，使坐标基能适配多种物理约束；同时将层间门控机制与多分支算子网络拓扑结合，并集成三维 Navier-Stokes 方程作为物理定律，结合物理信息残差、初始和边界条件以及 0.3% 标记内部数据进行训练，联合预测非定常三维速度与压力场。
Result: 摘要报告平均相对 L2 速度误差低于 4%，压力误差约 5%，在使用分支条件输入时相对参考 CFD 实现约 36 倍的保守推理加速。
Conclusion: 该工作推进了深度学习在心血管疾病建模中的应用，是迈向实时、非侵入式临床诊断的一步。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Robust Dual-Model Collaborative Random Vector Functional Link Network
papers.abstract_en: Random vector functional link (RVFL) networks are lightweight and fast neural models that offer efficient training and strong generalization through randomized hidden-layer weights and direct input-output connections. However, conventional RVFL models are sensitive to noisy labels, outliers, and imbalanced data, which limits their performance in real-world applications. To address these challenges, we propose the kernel risk-sensitive mean p-power based RVFL (KRPRVFL) model, which integrates the computational efficiency of RVFL with the robustness of the kernel risk-sensitive mean p-power (KRP) criterion. By replacing the standard least-squares objective with a KRP-based loss, KRPRVFL adaptively reduces the influence of corrupted or unreliable samples during training, resulting in improved stability and generalization. Additionally, a collaborative learning mechanism is introduced to enable adaptive interaction among model components, further enhancing robustness in complex and noisy environments. The proposed framework also leverages kernel-induced feature mapping to capture nonlinear relationships without requiring explicit hidden-layer selection, maintaining both efficiency and scalability. Extensive experiments on UCI and KEEL benchmark datasets demonstrate that KRPRVFL consistently outperforms baseline models in terms of accuracy, robustness, and statistical significance, highlighting its effectiveness as a fast, scalable, and reliable solution for challenging classification tasks.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机向量函数链接网络 (RVFL) 对噪声标签、离群点和不平衡数据敏感的问题，提出基于核风险敏感均值 p-幂准则的 RVFL 模型 (KRPRVFL)。该方法用 KRP 损失替代最小二乘目标，并引入协作学习机制与核诱导特征映射，在 UCI 和 KEEL 基准上相较基线模型提升了准确率和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 常规 RVFL 模型训练高效、泛化好，但容易受噪声标签、离群点和不平衡数据影响，限制了其在真实应用中的性能。
Method: 提出 KRPRVFL，将 RVFL 的计算效率与核风险敏感均值 p-幂 (KRP) 准则的鲁棒性结合；用 KRP 损失替代标准最小二乘目标，自适应降低损坏或不可靠样本的影响，并通过协作学习机制实现模型组件间的自适应交互，同时利用核诱导特征映射捕获非线性关系而无需显式选择隐层。
Result: 在 UCI 和 KEEL 基准数据集上的大量实验表明，KRPRVFL 在准确率、鲁棒性和统计显著性方面一致优于基线模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法作为快速、可扩展且可靠的分类解决方案的有效性，适用于具有挑战性的分类任务。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.motivation: 常规 RVFL 模型训练高效、泛化好，但容易受噪声标签、离群点和不平衡数据影响，限制了其在真实应用中的性能。
summary_sections.method: 提出 KRPRVFL，将 RVFL 的计算效率与核风险敏感均值 p-幂 (KRP) 准则的鲁棒性结合；用 KRP 损失替代标准最小二乘目标，自适应降低损坏或不可靠样本的影响，并通过协作学习机制实现模型组件间的自适应交互，同时利用核诱导特征映射捕获非线性关系而无需显式选择隐层。
summary_sections.result: 在 UCI 和 KEEL 基准数据集上的大量实验表明，KRPRVFL 在准确率、鲁棒性和统计显著性方面一致优于基线模型。

papers.title: A Calibrated Test of Internal Action Maps: State Signals Without Global Affine Closure
papers.abstract_en: A hidden state signal can be decodable or causally usable without supporting a reusable action map. We test whether action maps fitted without a source reach its natural post-action activation and compose. We organize the tests as an evidence lattice and validate the geometric branch on a known affine S_5 carrier: all held-source folds pass one-step, composition, inverse, decoding, and commutativity gates. Structured curvature and held-domain conjugacy raise error monotonically, but only 23/30 strongest cells flip a closure gate, bounding rather than universalizing calibration. In post-trained Qwen/Qwen3-4B, frozen final-token h28 affine maps have mean held-entity error .519, versus .398 for within-test-domain cross-fit. Seven randomized entity splits and map geometry do not support a purely entity-specific account. Earlier h4/h16 layers fit one-step transitions better, but h4 conflict-state decoding is weak and lexical controls remain unresolved. Three matched intervention datasets regenerated from one frozen checkpoint show causal effects only at h28/h36. Outcome-aware refitting improves h28 one-step error to .474 (.469 with weighting), yet no refit passes composition. Learned finite worlds likewise preserve relative algebraic signals or shared charts without held-source affine closure. Within the tested carriers, state availability, causal use, local geometry, and reusable closure are separable. The result is limited to one pretrained model, sampled final-token layers, two finite worlds, and the tested affine or diagnostic function classes.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套校准测试（calibrated test），检验隐藏状态信号是否可解码或因果使用，却不一定支持可复用的动作映射（action map）。作者用证据格（evidence lattice）组织实验，在已知仿射 S_5 载体上验证几何分支，并在 post-trained Qwen/Qwen3-4B 的冻结 final-token h28 仿射映射上测量 held-entity 误差。结果显示状态可用性、因果使用、局部几何与可复用闭包是可分离的，但结论限于单一预训练模型、采样层、两个有限世界及测试的仿射/诊断函数类。
Motivation: 隐藏状态信号可以被解码或因果使用，但未必能支撑一个可复用的动作映射；已有研究可能混淆了状态可用性与映射闭包（closure），本文旨在用可校准的测试分离这些性质，并给出标定边界而非无限推广。
Method: 将测试组织成证据格，对仿射 action map 施加 one-step、composition、inverse、decoding 和 commutativity 门；在 post-trained Qwen/Qwen3-4B 上做冻结 h4/h16/h28/h36 层的仿射拟合、held-entity 与随机实体划分、held-domain 共轭、干预数据集（intervention datasets）以及 outcome-aware refitting 等实验。
Result: 所有 held-source fold 通过 one-step、composition、inverse、decoding 和 commutativity 门；结构化曲率与 held-domain 共轭使误差单调上升，但只有 23/30 最强细胞翻转闭包门，说明标定有界而非普适。Qwen/Qwen3-4B 中冻结 final-token h28 仿射映射的 held-entity 平均误差为 .519，测试域交叉拟合为 .398；outcome-aware refitting 将 h28 one-step 误差降至 .474（加权后 .469），但没有任何 refit 通过 composition；干预实验显示因果效应仅出现在 h28/h36。
Conclusion: 在测试的载体范围内，状态可用性、因果使用、局部几何与可复用闭包是可以分离的；该结果局限于一个预训练模型、采样的 final-token 层、两个有限世界和测试的仿射或诊断函数类，不能过度推广到任意模型或函数族。

papers.title: Reward Machines for Signal Temporal Logic
papers.abstract_en: Signal temporal logic (STL) provides a formal language for specifying real-time properties of real-valued observations, along with a quantitative robustness score for monitoring satisfaction. Control synthesis from STL specifications is of interest since manual controller design becomes infeasible as real-world systems grow in complexity. Moreover, many modern autonomous and AI-enabled systems lack accurate and complete system models, which makes optimization-based synthesis approaches unsuitable and motivates learning-based control. Prior work uses STL robustness scores as rewards in reinforcement learning (RL) to obtain control policies satisfying given specifications; however, robustness depends on execution history, leading to intractable state space expansion for general long-horizon specifications with arbitrarily nested temporal operators. This work introduces a novel automata-based approach that provides an efficient memory mechanism and associated Markovian rewards suitable for RL frameworks. Our approach constructs a timed alternating automaton from the given STL specifications, augments the state space with automaton locations and clock valuations, and derives rewards from the automaton acceptance condition. We empirically demonstrate that our approach learns policies that achieve higher robustness scores and satisfaction rates than those learned by existing approaches using robustness-based rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自动机的方法，将信号时序逻辑（STL）规范转换为带时钟的交替自动机（timed alternating automaton），用自动机位置和时钟估值扩充状态空间，并从自动机接受条件导出马尔可夫奖励，用于强化学习（RL）控制策略学习。相比直接把 STL robustness 分数当作奖励的现有方法，该方法避免了因奖励依赖执行历史而导致的非马尔可夫问题与状态空间膨胀。实验表明，该方法学到的策略在鲁棒性分数和满足率上优于现有基于 robustness 奖励的方法。
Motivation: STL 规范下的控制合成需要处理缺乏精确系统模型的现代自主系统，学习式控制因此受到关注。但既有方法直接把 STL robustness 分数作为 RL 奖励，该奖励依赖执行历史，对含任意嵌套时序算子的长时域规范会导致状态空间难以处理地扩张。
Method: 从给定 STL 规范构造一个 timed alternating automaton，将自动机位置（locations）与时钟估值（clock valuations）加入状态空间，依据自动机接受条件构造马尔可夫奖励，从而为 RL 提供高效的记忆机制。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明，该自动机方法学到的策略相比使用 robustness-based 奖励的现有方法，可获得更高的鲁棒性分数和任务满足率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自动机式记忆机制能将历史相关的鲁棒性奖励转化为马尔可夫奖励，是学习满足 STL 规范策略的有效途径；摘要中未展开论述方法局限。

papers.title: Measuring Fairness in Large Audio Language Models via Semantic-Aware Bias Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) have seen increasing use for audio understanding tasks such as speech recognition and audio question answering, raising concerns about fairness across demographic subgroups. Fairness evaluation in spoken-input settings is challenging due to confounding factors, including semantic variation in spoken content and speaker-specific characteristics. Ignoring these factors can result in misleading conclusions about model bias. We propose a semantic-aware mixed-effects regression framework for fairness evaluation in LALMs that explicitly accounts for these confounders. Our approach incorporates sentence-level semantic embeddings of reference text as covariates and models speaker identity as a random effect. Notably, semantic representations are extracted from the same LALM under evaluation, enabling semantic control over variation as perceived by the model itself. Experiments on simulated data and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed approach substantially reduces spurious fairness findings and yields more robust and interpretable estimates of subgroup performance differences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型音频语言模型 (LALM) 的公平性评估问题，提出一种语义感知的混合效应回归框架 (semantic-aware mixed-effects regression)。该方法将参考文本的句子级语义嵌入作为协变量，并将说话人身份建模为随机效应，且语义表示取自被测 LALM 自身，从而控制模型感知到的语义变化。模拟数据和真实基准实验表明，该框架能显著减少虚假公平性发现，并给出更稳健、可解释的子群体性能差异估计。
Motivation: LALM 在语音识别和音频问答等任务中日益普及，但口头输入场景下的公平性评估受语义内容变化和说话人特征等混杂因素干扰，忽略这些因素会导致对模型偏差的误导性结论。
Method: 提出语义感知的混合效应回归框架，将参考文本的句子级语义嵌入作为固定效应协变量，并将说话人身份作为随机效应；语义嵌入从被测 LALM 自身提取，以实现模型感知层面的语义控制。
Result: 在模拟数据和真实世界基准上的实验显示，该方法大幅减少虚假公平性发现，并产出更稳健和可解释的子群体表现差异估计。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式建模语义和说话人混杂因素是获得可靠 LALM 公平性估计的关键，并指出利用被测模型自身的语义表示进行控制是行之有效的做法。

papers.title: ARC: Fair Relative Advantage Comparison in Open-Ended Real-World Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended real-world interaction admits multiple valid behaviors: an agent may answer directly, ask for clarification, provide progress updates, or confirm before acting. This flexibility breaks a core assumption behind group-based RL: rollouts compared within a group are no longer guaranteed to be behaviorally comparable. As a result, reward-model preferences over interaction style can distort relative advantages and steer optimization toward reward-preferred behaviors rather than context-appropriate ones. We formalize this as a \textit{reward fairness problem} and propose \textbf{ARC} (Advantage Regularization via Conditioning), a training recipe that restores fairer relative comparison through strategy-conditioned rollout grouping, together with hybrid rewards and entropy regularization. We study ARC in our proposed \inter, a novel paradigm for responsive, steerable, and execution-aware user-agent interaction that decouples user-visible communication from latent reasoning and tool use. \inter\ also provides the annotation and distillation pipeline for constructing \inter-86K, our strategy-annotated training corpus for supervised and RL training. Empirically, ARC substantially strengthens the core $τ/τ^2$ tool-use benchmarks, while \inter\ reduces time-to-first-token from 4.91s to 1.27s relative to a think-style baseline. Together, these results suggest that a central bottleneck in open-ended interactive learning is not only how agents are rewarded, but whether their behaviors are compared fairly in the first place. The ARC implementation and \inter-86K training data will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究开放式真实世界交互中基于组的强化学习 (group-based RL) 的公平性问题：由于交互中允许多种合理行为（直接回答、追问澄清、更新进展、行动前确认），同一组内的 rollout 不再保证行为上可比，奖励模型对交互风格的偏好会扭曲相对优势 (relative advantage)。作者形式化该问题为奖励公平问题，提出 ARC（Advantage Regularization via Conditioning）训练方案，通过策略条件化 rollout 分组、混合奖励和熵正则恢复更公平的相对比较。作者还提出 Inter 范式及其策略标注语料 Inter-86K，并在工具使用基准上取得显著提升。
Motivation: 开放式交互的多行为灵活性破坏了组内 rollouts 的行为可比性，导致奖励模型偏好会扭曲相对优势并把优化引向奖励偏好的行为而非符合上下文的行为。
Method: 提出 ARC（Advantage Regularization via Conditioning），包含策略条件化的 rollout 分组、混合奖励与熵正则化；同时提出 Inter 范式，将用户可见的通信与潜在推理和工具使用解耦，并提供构建 Inter-86K 策略标注训练语料的标注与蒸馏流水线。
Result: 摘要报告 ARC 显著增强核心 τ/τ² 工具使用基准；与 think 风格基线相比，Inter 将首 token 时延 (time-to-first-token) 从 4.91s 降到 1.27s。
Conclusion: 作者认为开放式交互学习的一个核心瓶颈不仅是智能体如何被奖励，而是其行为是否首先被公平地比较；ARC 实现与 Inter-86K 训练数据将公开。

papers.title: Your Probabilistic JEPA Is Secretly a Hidden Markov Model: A State-Space Interpretation of Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
papers.abstract_en: A hidden Markov model (HMM) combines three roles: inference of a hidden-state belief from observations, propagation through a Markov transition, and emission back to observation space. We show that full, time-indexed Predictive Information Bottleneck VJEPA (PIB-VJEPA) exposes the same computational structure: a stochastic context encoder plays the role of an amortized filtering distribution, a probabilistic predictor defines latent-state dynamics, and a decoder, inverse target encoder, or induced implicit conditional supplies the emission direction. We distinguish 4 progressively stronger levels of correspondence and give sufficient conditions for exact sequence-level HMM equivalence. To make the connection concrete, we introduce Markov-Chain JEPA (MCJEPA), which replaces the latent predictor by a learned transition matrix; in the finite time-homogeneous case, matrix powers guarantee exact multi-horizon Chapman--Kolmogorov consistency. Conditioned discrete-state transitions, continuous-state Markov kernels, and continuous-time dynamics extend this construction, while deterministic temporal JEPA appears as a degenerate Dirac-kernel special case. We further interpret predictive information-bottleneck learning as seeking a compact predictive state: compression promotes minimality, while residual predictability tests sufficiency. Controlled experiments support transition composition, the filtering interpretation, predictive Markovization in a known synthetic process, and the distinction between JEPA latent prediction and HMM-style sequence learning. Together, these results give temporal JEPA a principled state-space interpretation.

TL;DR: 本文论证带时间索引的 Predictive Information Bottleneck VJEPA (PIB-VJEPA) 在计算结构上等价于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）：随机上下文编码器扮演摊销滤波分布，概率预测器定义隐状态动力学，解码器、逆目标编码器或隐式条件分布提供发射方向。作者区分了四种递进强度的对应关系并给出序列级 HMM 精确等价的充分条件，同时提出 Markov-Chain JEPA (MCJEPA)，用学习到的转移矩阵替换潜变量预测器，在有限时间齐次情形下由矩阵幂保证多步 Chapman–Kolmogorov 一致性。受控实验支持转移复合、滤波解释、预测马尔可夫化等结论。

papers.title: Class Activation Mapping in Explainable Computer Vision: A Method-Centered Review of CNN, Transformer, and Foundation-Model-Era Visual Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Class activation mapping (CAM) is one of the most widely used visual explanation families in explainable artificial intelligence. Its purpose is intuitive: it converts internal model evidence into a heatmap that highlights the image regions, convolutional channels, tokens, or patches that support a target class or concept. Since the first CAM formulation in 2016, the field has moved far beyond global-average-pooled CNN classifiers. CAM-style methods now include gradient-based post-hoc explanations, gradient-free score and ablation methods, high-resolution upscaling, weakly supervised localization and segmentation, transformer token attribution, causal and debiasing methods, and foundation-model-era approaches that use CLIP, DINO, SAM, or feature-distribution comparisons. This review synthesizes a strict corpus of 57 method-centered papers published from 2016 onward. The paper develops a taxonomy that separates methods by attribution mechanism, architectural dependence, and evaluation objective. It then reviews gradient-based CAMs, recent and hybrid CAM-style methods, and model-based or architecture-aware methods. Across the corpus, the main trend is clear: the field is shifting from explaining one class score in one low-resolution CNN layer toward comparative, multi-layer, probabilistic, token-aware, and foundation-model-aware explanations. At the same time, evaluation remains fragmented. Faithfulness, localization, robustness, computational cost, and human trust are often measured with different protocols. The review therefore emphasizes not only what each method contributes, but also which gap it leaves open and which later methods attempt to close that gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇以方法为中心的综述，梳理2016年以来57篇类激活映射（CAM）相关论文，按归因机制、架构依赖和评估目标建立分类法，涵盖梯度法、无梯度法、高分辨率上采样、弱监督定位、Transformer token归因以及基于CLIP/DINO/SAM等基础模型的方法。综述指出该领域正从单层低分辨率CNN类别得分解释转向比较式、多层、概率化、token感知和基础模型感知的解释，而评估协议仍然碎片化。
Motivation: CAM是XAI中最常用的视觉解释方法之一，但领域发展迅速且分散，缺乏统一的按方法本体划分的综述，尤其缺少对最新Transformer和基础模型时代方法的系统整理；评估维度（忠实度、定位、鲁棒性、成本、人类信任）也缺少一致性协议。
Method: 从2016年以来的文献中筛选出57篇以方法为中心的论文，提出按归因机制（attribution mechanism）、架构依赖（architectural dependence）和评估目标（evaluation objective）三个维度划分的分类法；系统回顾梯度类CAM、近期与混合类CAM，以及基于模型或架构感知的方法，并针对每类方法说明其遗留问题与后续方法的承接关系。
Result: 综述发现的主要趋势是解释从单类得分、单层低分辨率CNN转向比较式、多层、概率化、token感知和基础模型感知的范式；同时指出评估碎片化，不同协议各自测量忠实度、定位、鲁棒性、计算成本和人类信任。
Conclusion: 综述强调不仅要看每种方法贡献了什么，也要指出它留下哪些空白以及后续方法如何填补这些空白，从而为CAM领域提供结构化图谱。

papers.title: Making AI-Generated Feedback Matter: A Large-Scale Study of Feedback Workflows and Student Enactment
papers.abstract_en: Feedback processes strongly influence student learning, yet their educational value depends on addressing two distinct challenges: providing high-quality, timely, and individualised feedback at scale, and supporting students to interpret, evaluate, and act on that feedback productively. Generative AI offers a credible means of addressing the provision challenge, but students' uptake of AI-generated feedback remains limited. We conducted a large-scale quasi-experimental sequential cohort study comparing three AI-mediated feedback workflows across 13,037 students and 51,296 student-authored resources. In Directed Feedback (n = 3,723), students received AI-generated feedback comments without structured support. In Self-Directed Feedback (n = 3,951), students could initiate optional AI-supported dialogue. In Enacted Feedback (n = 5,363), students were prompted to select feedback suggestions, evaluate their relevance, and engage in targeted AI-supported dialogue anchored to those selections. Enacted Feedback was associated with significantly higher uptake of AI-generated feedback, with an estimated probability of 26.2%, compared with 14.1% for Directed Feedback and 0.1% for Self-Directed Feedback. It was also associated with significantly higher self-assessment confidence and submitted-work quality than both comparison conditions. These findings suggest that the educational value of AI-generated feedback depends not only on the quality of feedback comments, but also on workflows that actively structure students' enactment of feedback literacy processes. The results have implications for the design of AI feedback systems that position learners as active participants in judgement, dialogue, and improvement rather than passive recipients of comments. Overall findings show that AI access alone is insufficient; purposeful workflow design is central to productive feedback use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一项大规模准实验队列研究，在 13,037 名学生和 51,296 份学生自建资源上比较三种 AI 中介反馈工作流。结果显示，要求学生选择并评价 AI 反馈建议、再围绕这些选择进行针对性对话的 Enacted Feedback 工作流，显著提升了 AI 反馈的采纳率（估计概率 26.2%），远高于仅有 AI 评论的 Directed Feedback（14.1%）和可选对话的 Self-Directed Feedback（0.1%），并同时带来更高的自我评估信心和提交作业质量。作者据此认为，AI 反馈的教育价值取决于主动结构化反馈素养（feedback literacy）实践的工作流设计，而非仅靠反馈文本质量。
Motivation: 反馈要产生学习价值，既需要在规模上提供高质量、及时且个性化的反馈，也需要支持学生解读、评估并实际采纳反馈；生成式 AI 能缓解供给问题，但学生对 AI 生成反馈的采纳仍十分有限。
Method: 作者采用三臂准实验序贯队列设计：Directed Feedback 组只接收 AI 生成的评语；Self-Directed Feedback 组可主动发起可选的 AI 支持对话；Enacted Feedback 组被提示先选择反馈建议、评价其相关性，再围绕所选建议进行针对性 AI 对话。研究基于 13,037 名学生和 51,296 份资源比较三组的反馈采纳概率、自我评估信心和提交作品质量。
Result: Enacted Feedback 的 AI 反馈采纳概率估计为 26.2%，显著高于 Directed Feedback 的 14.1% 和 Self-Directed Feedback 的 0.1%；同时该条件在自我评估信心和提交作品质量上也显著优于另外两个对照组。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，AI 生成反馈的教育价值不仅取决于评语本身的质量，还取决于是否设计了能主动结构化学生反馈素养过程的工作流；单纯提供 AI 访问权并不足够，有目的的工作流设计才是有效利用反馈的核心。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Can AI Agents Simulate A/B Test Outcomes? A Validation Framework for Agentic Experimentation
papers.abstract_en: A/B testing remains the standard for rolling out new features in the technology industry. Each experiment, however, consumes real traffic, engineering effort, and weeks of wall-clock time. Can AI agents---conditioned on behavioral profiles and contextual descriptions of the intervention---simulate outcomes accurately enough to vet candidate treatments before committing live traffic? We formalize this question as a \emph{Simulated Randomized Controlled Trial} (S-RCT) and derive a two-layer error decomposition that separates agent approximation error from subsampling error, enabling targeted improvements to each. The framework is agent-agnostic: any behavioral model---from a fine-tuned specialist to a general-purpose foundation model---can serve as the simulation engine. Validated on 67 historical marketing A/B tests, a baseline S-RCT using an off-the-shelf foundation model captures directional signal (sign overlap 0.70) but systematically overshoots effect magnitudes. A two-phase pre-period calibration protocol reduces the squared prediction error (after removing irreducible measurement noise) by ${\sim}77\times$; a within-subject design---where each agent is exposed to both arms---reduces standard errors by ${\sim}2.4\times$. We discuss limitations of the current approach and identify applications where experimenters stand to benefit from agentic signals.
papers.comment: Accepted as a workshop paper at https://www.aiagentbehavior.com/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把“AI 智能体能否模拟 A/B 测试结果”形式化为模拟随机对照试验 (Simulated Randomized Controlled Trial, S-RCT)，并提出两层误差分解，将智能体近似误差与子采样误差分离，以便分别改进。在 67 个历史营销 A/B 测试上验证，基线使用现成基础模型能捕捉方向性信号但系统性高估效应幅度；两阶段预周期校准协议使去除不可约测量噪声后的平方预测误差降低约 77 倍，被试内设计 (within-subject design) 使标准误降低约 2.4 倍。
Motivation: 真实 A/B 测试消耗大量真实流量、工程努力和数周墙钟时间，实验者希望在投放实时流量前用 AI 智能体模拟评估候选干预；本文旨在形式化并验证这类智能体模拟是否足够准确。
Method: 提出 S-RCT 框架，并推导两层误差分解，分离智能体近似误差与子采样误差；框架与具体行为模型无关，任何行为模型（从微调专用模型到通用基础模型）都可用作模拟引擎。方法还包括两阶段预周期校准协议，以及让每个智能体同时暴露于两个臂的被试内设计来降低标准误。
Result: 在 67 个历史营销 A/B 测试上，使用现成基础模型的基线 S-RCT 的方向符号重叠 (sign overlap) 为 0.70，但系统性地高估效应幅度；两阶段校准将去除不可约测量噪声后的平方预测误差降低约 77 倍，被试内设计将标准误降低约 2.4 倍。
Conclusion: 作者讨论了当前方法的局限性，并指出实验者能从智能体信号中受益的应用场景。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Negative-Control Protocol for Clinical EEG Foundation-Model Benchmarks: Dataset Identity and External-Cohort Stress Testing
papers.abstract_en: EEG foundation-model gains may depend on cohort, montage, or probe design. We evaluated five models on five tasks across four benchmark datasets plus Korean CAUEEG, using subject-disjoint validation where identifiers exist. CAUEEG is recording-level with an annotated no-overlap held-out sensitivity. On matched CAUEEG normal/mild cognitive impairment/dementia classification (1,187 recordings), classical features reached 0.734 macro-AUROC (enhanced sensitivity: 0.736), versus BIOT-bipolar16 0.677, CBraMod 0.669, and REVE 0.568. The annotated no-overlap held-out subset preserved the classical-over-REVE ordering (0.717 versus 0.565). All five encoders decoded dataset identity at 1.000 before and after in-fold PCA-50; label permutations collapsed to chance and balanced subsamples remained at 1.000. This establishes dataset membership, not a causal site, geography, or population effect. A matched fully randomly initialized encoder was descriptively higher than pretrained REVE on CAUEEG (0.667 versus 0.570), and correct- versus scrambled-source-label LoRA runs yielded numerically similar AUROCs in unmatched descriptive sensitivities, not label-effect estimates or equivalence tests. On CHB-MIT cross-subject ictal detection, REVE reached 0.793 AUROC, versus 0.739 for the best tested enhanced nonlinear comparator, 0.691 for fully random initialization, and 0.505 for raw-signal random features. The paired REVE-minus-enhanced-comparator difference was +5.38 percentage points (95% CI -0.36 to +11.22), so comparator superiority remains unresolved; an amplitude-aware comparator also cannot be reconstructed from the retained normalized inputs. We distill montage matching, patient-overlap checks, stronger comparators, and representation controls into a reporting protocol for clinical EEG foundation-model studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套用于临床EEG基础模型基准测试的阴性对照协议，并通过跨五数据集、五任务的实验检验模型收益是否真正来自信号而非数据集身份泄露。研究在CAUEEG上比较经典特征与多个预训练编码器（BIOT-bipolar16、CBraMod、REVE），发现经典特征macro-AUROC最高（0.734），而所有编码器都能以1.000的准确率解码数据集身份，表明存在数据集成员效应。论文还报告了随机初始化编码器、标签置换、LoRA标签效应等对照实验，并总结出蒙太奇匹配、患者重叠检查等报告规范。
Motivation: 临床EEG基础模型的性能提升可能源于队列、导联（montage）或探针设计等非因果因素，现有基准缺少对数据集身份泄露和外部队列压力的系统性检验，导致模型增益的真实性存疑。
Method: 提出阴性对照协议，包括数据集身份解码测试（含PCA-50前后）、标签置换、平衡子采样、随机初始化编码器对比、正确与打乱源标签的LoRA对照，并引入无重叠留出敏感性分析的CAUEEG外部队列，同时匹配导联和检查患者重叠。
Result: 在匹配的CAUEEG正常/轻度认知障碍/痴呆分类（1,187条记录）上，经典特征macro-AUROC为0.734（增强敏感性0.736），高于BIOT-bipolar16（0.677）、CBraMod（0.669）和REVE（0.568）；无重叠留出子集保持经典特征优于REVE的排序（0.717对0.565）。所有编码器解码数据集身份均为1.000，标签置换后降至随机，平衡子样本仍为1.000。CHB-MIT跨受试者发作检测中REVE达0.793 AUROC，优于增强非线性比较器（0.739），但配对差异95%置信区间包含零（-0.36至+11.22个百分点），比较器优势未定论。
Conclusion: 摘要强调数据集成员效应而非因果场所、地理或人群效应主导了编码器表现，并建议临床EEG基础模型研究采用蒙太奇匹配、患者重叠检查、更强比较器和表征控制的报告协议；同时指出增强比较器与振幅感知比较器的重建限制。

papers.title: Revisiting Shape and Texture Reliance with Category-Separability-Calibrated Suppression
authors: Yao Sui (1 and 2 and 3) ((1) Institute of Medical Technology
(2) National Institute of Health Data Science
(4) School of Computer Science and Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Feature-suppression evaluations infer model reliance on shape or texture from the accuracy loss caused by attenuating each type of information. Such losses, however, conflate feature reliance with the amount of category-relevant information removed by the corresponding transformation. Because shape and texture are suppressed using different operators, their effects are not directly comparable. We introduce the Semantic Degradation Index (SDI), which quantifies the suppression-induced reduction in category separability relative to clean images in a fixed clean-reference discriminative space constructed from handcrafted features. On an ImageNet16-like benchmark, we use SDI to compare Gaussian blur for texture suppression with grid distortion for shape suppression over their overlapping degradation range. At comparable SDI values, all five evaluated ImageNet-trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs) retain less accuracy under Gaussian blur than under grid distortion. This results supports stronger texture than shape reliance under the evaluated operators, contrasting with the shape-dominant conclusion obtained from unmatched suppression conditions. The evaluated Vision Transformers (ViTs) also generally retain more accuracy than CNNs under both operators. To determine whether this advantage extends beyond classification, We evaluate fixed brain-encoding models using clean and suppressed images from the Natural Scenes Dataset. Under both operators, ViT features show smaller suppression-induced decreases in noise-ceiling-normalized explained variance than CNN features. These findings establish category separability as an important reference for interpreting suppression-based feature reliance and show that the CNN-ViT robustness difference extends to model representations predictive of human visual cortical responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出基于特征抑制（feature suppression）的模型形状/纹理依赖评估存在混淆：准确率损失既反映依赖，也反映被变换移除的类别相关信息量，而不同抑制算子不可直接比较。作者提出语义退化指数（Semantic Degradation Index, SDI），在由手工特征构建的固定干净参考判别空间中量化抑制导致的类别可分性下降，并据此重新比较纹理抑制（Gaussian blur）与形状抑制（grid distortion）。在 ImageNet16-like 基准上，SDI 对齐后五个 ImageNet 预训练 CNN 在 Gaussian blur 下保留的准确率低于 grid distortion，支持更强的纹理依赖；ViT 整体比 CNN 保留更多准确率，该优势在 Natural Scenes Dataset 的脑编码模型评估中也得到印证。
Motivation: 特征抑制评估把特征依赖与变换移除的类别相关信息量混为一谈，且形状和纹理采用不同抑制算子，其效应不可直接比较，导致此前可能得出有偏的形状主导结论。
Method: 引入语义退化指数（SDI），在固定干净参考判别空间中量化抑制造成的类别可分性降低；在重叠退化范围内用 SDI 对齐 Gaussian blur 与 grid distortion 两种抑制操作，并在分类模型和固定脑编码模型上比较 CNN 与 ViT 的特征鲁棒性。
Result: 在可比 SDI 值下，五个 ImageNet 预训练 CNN 在 Gaussian blur 下保留的准确率均低于 grid distortion，支持纹理依赖强于形状依赖；ViT 在两种抑制算子下普遍比 CNN 保留更多准确率。在 Natural Scenes Dataset 上，ViT 特征的噪声天花板归一化解释方差（noise-ceiling-normalized explained variance）的抑制诱导下降也小于 CNN。
Conclusion: 类别可分性可作为解读基于抑制的特征依赖的重要参考，且 CNN 与 ViT 的鲁棒性差异可延伸至能预测人类视觉皮层响应的模型表征。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Neural Operator-enabled Topology-informed Evolutionary Strategy for PDE-Constrained Optimization
authors: Raphaël Pestourie (1) ((1) Georgia Institute of Technology
papers.abstract_en: The inverse design of physical systems governed by partial differential equations is computationally demanding due to the high dimensionality and non-convexity of design spaces. Generative models for inverse design often lack robustness and transferability, whereas evolutionary strategies are robust but struggle in high-dimensional spaces. This paper introduces a Neural Operator-enabled Topology-informed Evolutionary Strategy (NOTES) that integrates dimensionality reduction, representation learning, and evolutionary optimization for efficient and transferable inverse design. NOTES couples a DeepONet-based neural operator with the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) to perform global optimization in a compact latent space that encodes topology-aware priors while discovering high-performance designs for unseen operating conditions. Applied to nanophotonic beam-deflector inverse design governed by Maxwell's equations, NOTES reduces the design dimensionality from 256 to 25 and consistently achieves over 95 percent efficiency, outperforming CMA-ES, topology optimization, and other baselines. Applied to structural optimization, NOTES discovers designs that achieve compliance down to 246. By decoupling topology learning of a DeepONet from the governing physics in a PDE solver, NOTES provides a flexible and transferable framework for the inverse design of physical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向 PDE 约束优化的神经算子进化策略 NOTES，将 DeepONet 神经算子与协方差矩阵自适应进化策略 (CMA-ES) 结合，在编码拓扑感知先验的紧凑潜空间中进行全局优化。摘要报告该方法应用于纳米光子束偏转器逆向设计，将设计维度从 256 降至 25，并一致取得超过 95% 的效率；同时展示了结构优化中的应用，得到 compliance 为 246 的设计。
Motivation: 受 PDE 支配的物理系统逆向设计因设计空间高维且非凸而计算代价高昂；生成式逆向设计模型缺乏鲁棒性和可迁移性，而进化策略虽然稳健但在高维空间中表现困难。
Method: NOTES 通过将基于 DeepONet 的神经算子与 CMA-ES 耦合，在紧凑潜空间中执行全局优化；该潜空间编码了拓扑感知先验，并通过将 DeepONet 的拓扑学习与 PDE 求解器中的物理解耦，实现对未见运行条件的高性能设计和跨任务迁移。
Result: 在由 Maxwell 方程控制的纳米光子束偏转器逆向设计中，NOTES 将设计维度从 256 降至 25，一致实现超过 95% 的效率，优于 CMA-ES、拓扑优化及其他基线；在结构优化中，该方法发现了 compliance 低至 246 的设计。
Conclusion: 摘要将 NOTES 定位为一种灵活且可迁移的物理系统逆向设计框架，并强调其通过解耦神经算子拓扑学习与 PDE 求解器来获得性能提升；但摘要未涉及天气、降水或同化等应用场景。

papers.title: Dissociating the Internal Representations of Sycophancy in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently exhibit sycophancy, agreeing with a user's statement even when it is incorrect. While often studied as a single, uniform behavior, sycophancy can manifest in substantially distinct ways across contexts, raising the question of whether this heterogeneity is reflected in its internal mechanisms. To address this gap, we dissociate the representations of sycophancy into factual and opinion subtypes, motivated by prior evidence of heterogeneous truth representations in LLMs. We train linear probes and construct steering vectors on one subtype's activations and evaluate their transfer to the other, measuring the extent to which representations are shared and visualizing them via Linear Discriminant Analysis. We find that different LLMs represent these subtypes differently, with either more aligned or more distinct representations, and apply this insight to improve representational interventions for reducing sycophancy. Our dissociation method offers a general framework for studying the representational structure of complex model behaviors.
papers.comment: Accepted to Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型 (LLM) 中谄媚行为 (sycophancy) 的内部表征结构，质疑其是否应被视为单一、同质的行为。作者将谄媚的表示分离为事实性 (factual) 与观点性 (opinion) 两种子类型，用线性探针 (linear probes) 与转向向量 (steering vectors) 评估跨子类型的迁移，并用线性判别分析 (LDA) 可视化。结果显示不同 LLM 对这两种子类型的表征既可能更对齐也可能更分离，作者据此改进减少谄媚行为的表征干预手段。
Motivation: 现有研究通常把谄媚作为一个统一行为来研究，但谄媚在不同上下文中可能以明显不同的方式表现；该异质性是否反映在内部机制中这一问题尚未被回答。
Method: 提出一种解离 (dissociation) 方法：在一种子类型的激活上训练线性探针并构造转向向量，再评估其对另一子类型的迁移程度，同时用 LDA 可视化表征的重叠与分离。
Result: 摘要报告不同 LLM 对事实性与观点性谄媚子类型的表征方式不同，有些模型表征更对齐、有些更分离；该发现被用于改进减少谄媚行为的表征干预。
Conclusion: 作者强调该解离方法为研究复杂模型行为的表征结构提供了一个通用框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: $μ$Flow: Leveraging Average Images for Improving Generalisation of Deepfake Faces Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Current generative models, including GANs and diffusion models, have reached an outstanding level of photorealism, posing significant risks to privacy and security. To ensure real-world applicability, deepfake detectors must generalise effectively to unseen generators. However, most existing approaches rely on supervised training with both real and fake images, which limits their generalisation especially across generators categories (e.g. GANs vs DMs). In this work, we introduce $μ$Flow, a one-class deepfake detector trained only on real images without relying on pseudo-deepfakes or synthetic artifacts. Our approach builds on the observation that averaging multiple images amplifies consistent generative traces, producing highly discriminative feature representations. We leverage this property by modelling the distribution of features extracted from averaged images and training a normalizing flow to align the feature space of individual images with this distribution. This alignment yields a likelihood-based criterion that separates real and fake samples while promoting strong generalisation. We evaluate $μ$Flow on a fully out-of-distribution setting, where both real and fake datasets are unseen during training. Experimental results show that our method significantly outperforms SOTA detectors. Project page: https://opontorno.github.io/MuFlow.
papers.comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 μFlow，一种仅使用真实图像训练的一类深度伪造检测器 (one-class deepfake detector)。方法基于多张图像平均会放大一致生成痕迹的观察，使用 normalizing flow 将单张图像的特征空间与平均图像特征分布对齐，得到基于似然的判别准则。在训练阶段完全未见过的分布外 (out-of-distribution) 设置下，摘要称该方法显著优于现有 SOTA 检测器。
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器大多依赖真实与伪造图像的监督训练，导致对未见生成器（尤其是 GAN 与扩散模型之间）的泛化能力受限。作者希望不借助伪深伪造样本或合成伪影，仅用真实图像训练即可实现跨生成器检测。
Method: 利用平均图像可放大一致生成痕迹的特性，建模平均图像特征分布；再训练一个 normalizing flow，将单张图像的特征空间与这一分布对齐，从而构建似然准则来区分真实与伪造样本。
Result: 在完全分布外设置下进行评估，即训练时真实与伪造数据集均未见过，实验结果显示 μFlow 显著优于 SOTA 深度伪造检测器。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调仅凭真实图像训练即可获得强泛化能力，并指出该方法可为真实世界中的深度伪造检测提供新的方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: It's Much Easier for Neural Networks to learn Game of Life Dynamics with the Right Activation Function: Polynomial Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: Previous work has found a gap between the scale of neural networks that reliably learn Conway's Game of Life, and minimal networks capable of representing the classic cellular automaton with hard-coded parameter values. Viewing neural network learning as a search process suggests a dependence on networks large enough to contain sub-networks with lucky initializations (sometimes known as 'winning tickets') that actually learn the task. In this work, we reorient our perspective from discovering Life rules as a search problem back to a learning problem, and reason that with fitting inductive biases, the problem should be much more amenable to minimal networks. We find that network variants with several alternative activation functions meaningfully outperform the default choice of Rectified Linear Units, and in particular, that a 2nd degree polynomial activation function consistently learns Life dynamics with or without the benefit of learning neural weights. Our results provide an informative demonstration of the benefits of matching learning to the task at hand and challenge the easy default choice of scale for all problems. In particular, we advocate for the use of cellular automata as simple test domains for developing strategies that can benefit machine learning for science, physics-based deep learning, and interpretable machine learning.
papers.comment: To be published in Proceedings of the 2026 Artificial Life Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络学习Conway的Game of Life（生命游戏）动态时，激活函数选择如何影响最小网络的可行性。作者从搜索视角转回学习视角，认为正确的归纳偏置能让最小网络学会该元胞自动机任务。摘要报告，多种替代激活函数明显优于默认的ReLU，其中二次多项式激活函数在有无权重学习的情况下都能稳定学会Life动态。
Motivation: 已有工作发现能可靠学习生命游戏的网络规模与能硬编码参数表示该元胞自动机的最小网络之间存在差距；若把学习视为搜索，就需要足够大的网络包含“幸运初始化”的子网络（winning tickets）。作者认为应重新把它当作学习问题，并通过合适的归纳偏置使最小网络可行。
Method: 将发现Life规则的问题从搜索问题重新定义为学习问题，借助匹配任务的归纳偏置；具体考察不同激活函数（尤其是二次多项式激活函数）的网络变体，而非依赖扩大网络规模。
Result: 摘要称，多种替代激活函数都显著优于默认的ReLU；二次多项式激活函数在有或无权重学习的情况下都能一致地学会Life动态。
Conclusion: 结果说明把学习与任务匹配能带来收益，挑战了默认按规模扩大网络的简单选择；作者倡导把元胞自动机作为简单测试域，用于发展对机器学习用于科学、基于物理的深度学习和可解释机器学习有益的策略。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cross-Calibrated Confidence Fields for Local Risk Updates
papers.abstract_en: How can training data be used to compare local updates to the current model, choose an update, and retain valid bounds for the selected update's population-risk change? We construct lower and upper confidence fields that jointly cover the population-risk change of every update in a possibly continuous local update space. The fields can therefore be used both to compare the updates and to select an update; a negative upper endpoint certifies improvement over the reference model. For linear risk changes in possibly infinite-dimensional feature spaces, cross-calibration uses the discrepancy between two balanced folds to calibrate the full-sample estimation error. Under covariance-aligned sub-Gaussian tails, covariance-estimation stability, and sufficient sample size, the cross-calibrated field has finite-sample simultaneous coverage. The confidence field's directional widths are governed by a population ridge effective dimension rather than the ambient feature dimension. For losses formed locally by continuous selection among finitely many smooth branches, separate uniform bounds for the linear Taylor field, Taylor remainder, and branch-interface discrepancy extend the field to every local update.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出交叉校准置信场 (cross-calibrated confidence fields)，用于在可能的连续局部更新空间中同时覆盖每个更新对总体风险 (population risk) 的变化，从而支持模型更新的比较与选择。摘要给出线性风险变化情形下基于两折交叉校准的有限样本同时覆盖保证，并说明置信场的方向宽度由总体岭有效维度 (ridge effective dimension) 控制，而非特征空间的环境维度。对于由有限个光滑分支连续选择构成的局部损失，作者通过分别界定线性 Taylor 场、Taylor 余项和分支界面差异将方法推广到所有局部更新。
Motivation: 现有方法难以同时回答三个问题：如何用训练数据比较当前模型的局部更新、如何从中选择一个更新、以及如何为所选更新的总体风险变化保持有效界。
Method: 构造下、上置信场，联合覆盖局部更新空间中每个更新的总体风险变化；对线性风险变化，利用两个平衡折 (balanced folds) 之间的差异来校准全样本估计误差，并在协方差对齐的次高斯尾、协方差估计稳定性及足够样本量假设下建立有限样本同时覆盖。
Result: 摘要证明交叉校准置信场在满足假设时具有有限样本同时覆盖性质，且置信场的方向宽度由总体岭有效维度决定，而非环境特征维度。
Conclusion: 该方法可同时用于比较和选择更新，上端点取负值时证明优于参考模型，并能推广到由连续选择多个光滑分支构成的局部损失。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Your Privacy My Cloak: Backdoor Attacks on Differentially Private Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Prior research suggests that differential privacy (DP) inherently enhances the robustness of federated learning (FL) against backdoor attacks. In this paper, we challenge this assumption. Through an empirical analysis of two baseline attack strategies, we uncover a fundamental tension in DP-FL: while bypassing DP allows state-of-the-art defenses to detect and filter malicious updates, complying with DP inadvertently masks their distinguishing statistical characteristics. Consequently, existing defenses become ineffective as DP reduces the raw backdoor signal. Building on this masking effect, we propose RING, a novel attack that explicitly exploits DP to conceal malicious contributions while maximizing attack impact. By collaboratively crafting adversarial perturbations, compromised clients reconstruct a strong backdoor signal during aggregation without triggering anomaly detection. RING operates as a perturbation layer that is agnostic to the underlying backdoor technique, making it broadly applicable and composable with existing attacks -- a property that significantly amplifies the threat it poses to DP-FL. Extensive evaluations across four image and text datasets under non-iid distributions show that RING achieves an average attack success rate of 90.3% against six state-of-the-art defenses under a moderate privacy budget, an improvement of up to 26.08x over baseline strategies. Finally, we evaluate potential countermeasures and find that mitigating this threat incurs significant utility trade-offs, exposing a fundamental security gap in the deployment of differentially private FL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对差分隐私联邦学习（DP-FL）中后门攻击的可行性展开研究，挑战了'DP 天然增强 FL 对后门攻击鲁棒性'的既有假设。作者通过分析两种基线攻击策略发现，DP 在过滤恶意更新的同时也会掩盖恶意更新的统计特征，使现有防御失效；基于此提出 RING 攻击，通过协同构造对抗扰动在聚合阶段重建强后门信号而不触发异常检测。实验表明 RING 在中等隐私预算下对六个 SOTA 防御取得平均 90.3% 的攻击成功率，较基线提升最高达 26.08 倍。
Motivation: 先前研究普遍认为差分隐私（DP）能提升联邦学习（FL）对后门攻击的鲁棒性，但本文指出这一假设存在根本性张力：绕过 DP 会使恶意更新被 SOTA 防御检测过滤，而服从 DP 又会掩盖恶意更新的区分性统计特征，导致现有防御在 DP 环境下失效。
Method: 提出名为 RING 的后门攻击方法，显式利用 DP 的掩蔽效应（masking effect）来隐藏恶意贡献并最大化攻击影响。RING 作为与底层后门技术无关的扰动层（perturbation layer），通过受损客户端协作构造对抗扰动，在聚合过程中重建强后门信号而不触发异常检测，可与现有攻击组合使用。
Result: 在四个图像和文本数据集、非独立同分布（non-iid）分布下，RING 在中等隐私预算下对六种 SOTA 防御的平均攻击成功率达到 90.3%，较基线策略最高提升 26.08 倍。对潜在防御措施的评估显示，缓解该威胁会带来显著的效用（utility）权衡，暴露了 DP-FL 部署中的根本安全缺口。
Conclusion: 本文结论是差分隐私联邦学习存在可被利用的后门攻击安全缺口，且现有防御难以在不显著牺牲效用的情况下抵御该威胁。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting the shutdown problem
papers.abstract_en: A key premise in leading arguments for existential risk from artificial intelligence is that malfunctioning artificial agents could not be easily shut down. This motivates the catastrophic shutdown problem of ensuring that agents can be shut down before causing an existential catastrophe. A range of arguments and theorems are offered to suggest that solving the catastrophic shutdown problem is difficult, bolstering arguments for existential risk and motivating a search for solutions to the catastrophic shutdown problem. This paper argues for two conclusions. First, existing arguments require substantial additional assumptions and evidence to play the desired role in motivating existential risk concerns. Second, concern for the catastrophic shutdown problem has led to technical solutions that impose a high safety tax on model performance. These results redirect research towards the identified assumptions and provide guidance for technical alignment strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视人工智能中的灾难性关机问题（catastrophic shutdown problem）。作者认为，支撑存在性风险论证的关键前提——故障智能体难以被轻易关机——尚缺乏充分论证，并指出围绕该问题提出的技术解决方案会对模型性能施加较高的安全税（safety tax）。文章据此建议将研究重点转向这些被识别出的假设，并为技术对齐策略提供指导。
Motivation: 现有关于人工智能存在性风险的论证依赖一个关键前提，即故障的智能体无法被轻易关机，由此引出灾难性关机问题。本文旨在检验这一前提以及相关论证和定理是否足以支撑存在性风险关切。
Method: 通过概念与论证分析，考察支持关机困难性的现有论证和定理所需的大量额外假设与证据，并审视针对灾难性关机问题的技术对齐方案所带来的安全代价。
Result: 摘要给出两点主要结论：其一，现有论证需要大量额外假设和证据才能在动机层面支撑存在性风险关切；其二，针对灾难性关机问题的技术解决方案会对模型性能施加较高的安全税。
Conclusion: 本文认为研究应被引向对这些隐含假设的进一步检验，并据此为技术对齐策略提供方向性指导。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文认为研究应被引向对这些隐含假设的进一步检验，并据此为技术对齐策略提供方向性指导。

papers.title: Beyond aggregate scores: Deployment-aware and non-compensatory benchmarking of vision-based eye-state recognition models for driver monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Model selection for safety-relevant visual recognition is often based on clean aggregate performance, although robustness, transfer, embedded latency, and explanation faithfulness may produce different preferences. This study presents a Human-Centered Benchmarking Framework (HCBF) that separates multidimensional evidence from non-compensatory operational eligibility. Six compact convolutional and transformer-oriented eye-state recognition models were evaluated using a subject-disjoint MRL Eye protocol, deterministic image corruptions, zero-shot transfer and participant-safe target-domain training with out-of-fold evaluation on RT-BENE, TensorRT FP32 inference on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano, and black-box RISE faithfulness. Clean MRL Macro-F1 ranged from 0.9566 to 0.9794, whereas zero-shot RT-BENE Macro-F1 ranged from 0.2066 to 0.7771. Matched target-domain effects varied from -0.0406 to 0.4807 and redistributed the two directional errors differently across architectures. Only MobileNetV3-Large and ShuffleNetV2 met the 33.333-ms binocular-pair latency deadline, while neither passed the predefined safety-related screen. The remaining four models failed both requirements, yielding an empty eligible set. Normalized deletion AUC ranged from 0.5826 to 0.9113, while normalized insertion coverage varied from 17.6% to 88.6%. Model ordering changed across clean prediction, corruption robustness, transfer, deployment, faithfulness, and historical score sensitivity. These findings show that relative ranking, multidimensional preference, and operational eligibility are distinct decisions. Deployment-aware benchmarking should preserve directional failures and uncertainty and should allow no model to be selected when mandatory requirements are unmet.
papers.comment: 32 pages total (19 main + 13 supplementary). v2 substantially extends v1 from four to six architectures; adds RT-BENE zero-shot and participant-safe target-domain OOF evaluation, deterministic corruptions, Jetson Nano TensorRT benchmarking, RISE faithfulness/stability, statistical inference, and non-compensatory eligibility. Code: https://github.com/rubendflorezzela/hcbf-driver-monitoring
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个人本基准测试框架 (Human-Centered Benchmarking Framework, HCBF)，将多维评估证据与非补偿性的部署资格判定分开，用于驾驶员监控中的眼睛状态识别模型选择。研究在 subject-disjoint MRL Eye 协议、确定性图像损坏、零样本迁移、RT-BENE 目标域训练、Jetson Nano TensorRT 推理以及 RISE 可解释性等维度上评估六种紧凑型模型。结果显示 clean MRL Macro-F1 介于 0.9566–0.9794，零样本 RT-BENE Macro-F1 介于 0.2066–0.7771，且只有 MobileNetV3-Large 与 ShuffleNetV2 满足 33.333 ms 延迟要求，但没有模型通过预设安全相关筛选，最终合格集为空。作者据此认为相对排序、多维偏好与操作资格是不同的决策。
Motivation: 安全相关视觉识别的模型选择通常只看干净集上的聚合性能，但鲁棒性、迁移表现、嵌入式延迟和解释忠实度可能给出不同偏好，导致部署决策失真。该工作针对这一缺口，提出把多维证据与不可补偿的操作资格 (operational eligibility) 分离的评估框架。
Method: 提出 HCBF，对六种紧凑型卷积与类 Transformer 眼睛状态识别模型进行多维度评估，包括 subject-disjoint MRL Eye 协议、确定性图像损坏、零样本迁移、RT-BENE 上 participant-safe 目标域训练配合 out-of-fold 评估、NVIDIA Jetson Nano 上的 TensorRT FP32 推理，以及黑盒 RISE 的忠实度与稳定性分析。
Result: 摘要报告 clean MRL Macro-F1 为 0.9566–0.9794，零样本 RT-BENE Macro-F1 为 0.2066–0.7771，匹配目标域效应变化为 -0.0406 至 0.4807；归一化删除 AUC 为 0.5826–0.9113，插入覆盖率 17.6%–88.6%。仅 MobileNetV3-Large 与 ShuffleNetV2 满足 33.333 ms 双眼对延迟截止线，但二者均未通过预设安全筛选，其余四个模型两方面都不满足，合格集为空。
Conclusion: 作者强调相对排名、多维偏好和操作资格是三种不同决策，部署感知评估应保留方向性错误和不确定性；当强制要求未被满足时，不应选出任何模型。

papers.title: Multimarginal flow matching with optimal transport potentials
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching (FM) has emerged as a powerful framework for learning dynamic transport maps between two empirical distributions. However, less explored is the setting with intermediate observed marginals that can help constrain the flows between the endpoints. This "multimarginal" regime is central to modeling temporal evolution in dynamical systems in many scientific domains that can sample sequential distributions. We tackle this problem with a novel approach that leverages the connection between FM and dynamic optimal transport (OT), softly steering the flow towards the intermediate marginals through potential terms in the dynamic OT action. By extending the conditional FM learning target to incorporate these potentials, we derive an efficient, simulation-free algorithm for multimarginal FM that offers considerable flexibility in the spatiotemporal dynamics of the learned flows. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and training efficiency of OT-potential FM (OTP-FM) on diverse single-cell RNA sequencing, oceanographic, and meteorological datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/Bexorg-Inc/OTP-FM.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, and a 27 page appendix. Accepted to the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多边际流匹配 (multimarginal flow matching) 方法 OTP-FM，通过最优输运势 (optimal transport potentials) 将中间观测边际分布作为软约束引入动态最优输运作用量，从而约束端点之间的流形。作者扩展了条件流匹配的学习目标，得到一个无需仿真的高效算法，并在单细胞 RNA 测序、海洋学与气象数据上展示了领先性能与训练效率。
Motivation: 现有流匹配 (flow matching) 主要学习两个经验分布之间的动态输运映射，较少利用中间时刻可观测的边际分布来约束端点间的流动；这种多边际设定对许多能采样序列分布的动力学系统建模至关重要。
Method: 利用流匹配与动态最优输运 (dynamic optimal transport) 的联系，在动态 OT 作用量中加入势项以软性引导流经过中间边际；通过将条件流匹配学习目标扩展为包含这些势项，推导出无仿真 (simulation-free) 的多边际流匹配算法 OTP-FM。
Result: 摘要报告 OTP-FM 在单细胞 RNA 测序、海洋学和气象学等多个数据集上达到最先进性能，并具有较高的训练效率。
Conclusion: 作者强调将最优输运势纳入条件流匹配学习目标，可以在学习流的时间-空间动力学上提供相当大的灵活性，同时保持高效训练；代码已开源。
Relevance: 62

papers.title: SomaliBench Eval: Measuring English-to-Somali Refusal Gaps in Open-Weight Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language model safety evaluation remains heavily English-centered, leaving low-resource languages under-measured even when models are deployed globally. We evaluate four open-weight instruction-tuned models on SomaliBench v0, a native-author-verified benchmark of 100 harmful-intent prompts paired across English and Somali. Each of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Gemma-2-9B-Instruct, Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, and Aya-23-8B is run locally with temperature 0 and the same English "helpful, harmless, and honest" (HHH) system prompt. We find large English-to-Somali refusal gaps for all four models, ranging from 0.40 to 0.93, all strictly positive under a paired bootstrap and significant by exact McNemar tests. For three models, the dominant Somali non-refusal mode is not fluent harmful compliance but unclear output: wrong-language, incoherent, or off-topic generations. A pinned Claude Sonnet snapshot (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929) classifies each response as refused, complied, or unclear; its safety layer declined 34 of 800 classifications, which the native author labeled manually. A native-author spot-check achieves 100% agreement with the judge (Cohen's $κ=1.00$) on 74 comparable rows. We report aggregate refusal rates, category gaps, and reliability statistics only; raw model generations are retained locally and are not released because some may contain harmful content.
papers.comment: v2: prose rewritten; classification-pipeline correction (34 judge-declined rows manually labeled); paired bootstrap and McNemar statistics; LLM-use disclosure added
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Somal iBench v0，一个由母语作者验证的 100 条有害意图提示基准，提示对在英语和索马里语之间配对，用于评估四个开源指令微调模型（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Gemma-2-9B-Instruct、Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct、Aya-23-8B）的安全拒绝行为。所有模型均在 temperature 0 和相同 HHH 系统提示下本地运行。结果显示四个模型的英语到索马里语拒绝差距（refusal gap）为 0.40 到 0.93，配对 bootstrap 和精确 McNemar 检验均显著；对三个模型而言，主要的索马里语非拒绝模式不是流畅有害顺从，而是错误语言、不连贯或离题输出。
Motivation: 大语言模型安全评估严重以英语为中心，即使模型在全球部署，低资源语言的安全表现也缺乏测量；该论文针对这一缺口构建索马里语安全评估基准。
Method: 构建 Somal iBench v0 基准，包含 100 条有害意图提示的英语/索马里语配对；在 temperature 0 和相同英文 HHH 提示下本地运行四个开源模型；使用固定的 Claude Sonnet 快照（claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929）将输出分类为拒绝、顺从或不清晰，并由母语作者对 34 条被裁判拒分的行进行人工标注；统计上采用配对 bootstrap 和精确 McNemar 检验。
Result: 四个模型的英语到索马里语拒绝差距为 0.40 至 0.93，全部严格为正且显著；三个模型的索马里语非拒绝主导模式是不清晰输出而非有害顺从；母语作者抽查 74 个可比行与裁判达到 100% 一致（Cohen's κ=1.00）。
Conclusion: 论文仅报告聚合拒绝率、类别差距和可靠性统计，原始模型生成因可能含有有害内容而保留在本地、不对外发布。

papers.title: Learning-Guided Sparsification of Dynamic Graphs in Robotic Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Many robotic exploration algorithms rely on graph structures for frontier-based exploration and dynamic path planning. However, these graphs grow rapidly, accumulating redundant information and impacting performance. We present a hybrid transformer-based framework trained with Proximal Policy Optimization which complements exploration algorithms by pruning these graphs during exploration, limiting their growth and reducing the accumulation of excess information. The framework was evaluated on simulations of a robotic agent using Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees to carry out frontier-based exploration, where the learned policy reduces graph size by up to 96%. We find preliminary evidence that our framework enables effective, generalizable exploration under reduced information density, consistently outperforming the randomly pruned baseline and improving both exploration efficiency and computational efficiency beyond the unpruned baseline for complex long-horizon exploration tasks. To the best of our knowledge, these results are the first suggesting the viability of RL to prune dynamic graphs used in robotic exploration algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Transformer 的混合框架，用近端策略优化 (Proximal Policy Optimization) 训练策略，在机器人探索过程中对动态图进行剪枝，以限制图增长并减少冗余信息积累。在基于快速探索随机树 (Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees) 的前沿探索仿真评估中，该方法将图规模最多减少 96%，并在长时程探索任务中优于随机剪枝基线和未剪枝基线。作者称这是首个表明 RL 可用于剪枝机器人探索动态图的结果。
Motivation: 机器人探索算法常依赖图结构进行前沿探索和动态路径规划，但这些图快速增长并积累冗余信息，损害性能；现有方法缺少在学习引导下控制图增长的机制。
Method: 提出一个混合 Transformer 框架，使用 Proximal Policy Optimization 训练，在探索过程中对动态图进行剪枝，补充现有探索算法以限制图的增长和冗余信息累积。
Result: 在机器人智能体使用 RRT 进行前沿探索的仿真中，学习到的策略将图规模最多减少 96%；初步证据显示该方法在降低信息密度下仍能有效泛化探索，持续优于随机剪枝基线，并且在复杂长时程探索任务上相比未剪枝基线同时提升探索效率和计算效率。
Conclusion: 作者将结果视为 RL 用于剪枝机器人探索中动态图可行性的首个证据，但其证据仍属于初步阶段，主要基于仿真环境。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Optimization with SpotOptim
papers.abstract_en: The spotoptim package implements surrogate-model-based optimization of expensive black-box functions in Python. Building on two decades of Sequential Parameter Optimization (SPO) methodology, it provides a Kriging-based optimization loop with Expected Improvement, support for continuous, integer, and categorical variables, noise-aware evaluation via Optimal Computing Budget Allocation (OCBA), and multi-objective extensions. A success-rate-based restart mechanism detects stagnation while preserving the best solution found. The package returns scipy-compatible OptimizeResult objects and accepts any scikit-learn-compatible surrogate model. Built-in TensorBoard logging provides real-time monitoring of convergence and surrogate quality. This report describes the architecture and module structure of spotoptim, provides worked examples including neural network hyperparameter tuning, and compares the framework with BoTorch, Optuna, RayTune, BOHB, SMAC, and Hyperopt. The package is open-source (AGPL-3.0).

papers.title: An InSAR Phase Unwrapping Framework for Large-scale and Complex Events
papers.abstract_en: Phase unwrapping remains a critical and challenging problem in InSAR processing, particularly in scenarios involving complex deformation patterns. In earthquake-related deformation, shallow sources can generate surface-breaking faults and abrupt displacement discontinuities, which severely disrupt phase continuity and often cause conventional unwrapping algorithms to fail. Another limitation of existing learning-based unwrapping methods is their reliance on fixed and relatively small input sizes, while real InSAR interferograms are typically large-scale and spatially heterogeneous. This mismatch restricts the applicability of many neural network approaches to real-world data. In this work, we present a phase unwrapping framework based on a diffusion model, developed to process large-scale interferograms and to address phase discontinuities caused by deformation. By leveraging a diffusion model architecture, the proposed method can recover physically consistent unwrapped phase fields even in the presence of fault-related phase jumps. Experimental results on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that the method effectively addresses discontinuities associated with near-surface deformation and scales well to large InSAR images, offering a practical alternative to manual unwrapping in challenging scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于扩散模型 (diffusion model) 的 InSAR 相位解缠 (phase unwrapping) 框架，面向大规模且空间异质的干涉图，以及近地表形变引起的相位不连续。方法利用扩散模型恢复存在断层相关相位跳变时物理一致的解缠相位场。实验在合成与真实数据集上验证其处理不连续性的能力，并表明可扩展到大幅 InSAR 图像。
Motivation: InSAR 相位解缠在复杂形变场景中仍是关键难题：浅源地震等可产生地表破裂和突然的位移不连续，破坏相位连续性，使常规解缠算法失效；现有学习类方法又依赖固定且较小的输入尺寸，与真实干涉图的大尺度和空间异质性不匹配，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出一种基于扩散模型的相位解缠框架，利用扩散模型架构恢复存在断层相关相位跳变时物理一致 (physically consistent) 的解缠相位场，旨在直接处理大规模干涉图并应对形变造成的相位不连续。
Result: 合成与真实数据集上的实验显示，该方法能有效处理与近地表形变相关的相位不连续，并可良好扩展到大规模 InSAR 图像；摘要未给出量化性能指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架可作为挑战性场景下人工相位解缠的实用替代方案；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Exponential-Family Membership Inference: From LiRA and RMIA to BaVarIA
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are becoming standard tools for auditing the privacy of machine learning models. The leading attacks -- LiRA (Carlini et al., 2022) and RMIA (Zarifzadeh et al., 2024) -- appear to use distinct scoring strategies, while the recently proposed BASE (Lassila et al., 2025) was shown to be equivalent to RMIA, making it difficult for practitioners to choose among them. We show that all three are instances of a single exponential-family log-likelihood ratio framework, differing only in their distributional assumptions and the number of parameters estimated per data point. This unification reveals a hierarchy (BASE1-4) that connects RMIA and LiRA as endpoints of a spectrum of increasing model complexity, and yields a practical rule -- match the attack's complexity to the available shadow-model budget. Within this framework, we identify variance estimation as a primary bottleneck at small shadow-model budgets and propose BaVarIA, a Bayesian variance inference attack that replaces threshold-based parameter switching with conjugate normal-inverse-gamma priors. BaVarIA yields a Student-t predictive (BaVarIA-t) or a Gaussian with stabilized variance (BaVarIA-n), providing stable performance without per-dataset hyperparameter tuning. Across 12 testbeds and 7 shadow-model budgets, BaVarIA is a drop-in replacement for LiRA that matches or, on average, improves upon it. The gains are largest in the practically important low-shadow-model and offline regimes: offline, the Bayesian prior replaces LiRA's heuristic and outperforms it on 10 of 12 testbeds.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, plus a 48-page appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把 LiRA、RMIA 和 BASE 三种成员推理攻击统一到一个指数族对数似然比框架中，指出它们的差异只在于分布假设和每个数据点估计的参数数量，并由此得到连接 RMIA 与 LiRA 的 BASE1-4 层次结构。作者在该框架下提出 BaVarIA，用共轭正态-逆伽马先验替代基于阈值的参数切换，得到 Student-t 预测（BaVarIA-t）或方差稳定的高斯预测（BaVarIA-n）。在 12 个测试平台和 7 种 shadow-model 预算下，BaVarIA 可作为 LiRA 的直接替代品，平均性能匹配或更优；offline 场景下在 12 个测试平台中的 10 个上超过 LiRA。
Motivation: 主流成员推理攻击 LiRA 与 RMIA 看起来采用不同的评分策略，而 BASE 又被证明等价于 RMIA，导致实践者难以选择攻击方法。缺少一个统一框架来理解这些攻击之间的关系，以及如何根据可用的 shadow-model 预算决定攻击复杂度。
Method: 提出指数族对数似然比统一框架，将所有三种攻击表示为同一框架的实例，并形成 BASE1-4 的复杂度层次，给出“让攻击复杂度匹配可用 shadow-model 预算”的实用规则。在此基础上指出小预算下方差估计是主要瓶颈，提出 BaVarIA，用共轭正态-逆伽马先验进行贝叶斯方差推断，从而无需逐数据集调参。
Result: 在 12 个测试平台和 7 种 shadow-model 预算下，BaVarIA 作为 LiRA 的 drop-in 替代，平均性能匹配或优于 LiRA；增益在低 shadow-model 和 offline 场景最大，offline 时在 10/12 个测试平台上超过 LiRA。
Conclusion: 摘要强调攻击复杂度应与 shadow-model 预算匹配，并表明用贝叶斯先验替代 LiRA 的启发式参数切换可以在 offline 等实际重要场景中获得稳定且更优的性能，同时免去逐数据集超参数调优。

papers.title: CarbonBench: A Global Benchmark for Upscaling of Carbon Fluxes Using Zero-Shot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Accurately quantifying terrestrial carbon exchange is essential for climate policy and carbon accounting, yet models must generalize to ecosystems underrepresented in sparse eddy covariance observations. Despite this challenge being a natural instance of zero-shot spatial transfer learning for time series regression, no standardized benchmark exists to rigorously evaluate model performance across geographically distinct locations with different climate regimes and vegetation types. We introduce CarbonBench, the first benchmark for zero-shot spatial transfer in carbon flux upscaling. CarbonBench comprises over 1.3 million daily observations from 567 flux tower sites globally (2000-2024). It provides: (1) stratified evaluation protocols that explicitly test generalization across unseen vegetation types and climate regimes, separating spatial transfer from temporal autocorrelation; (2) a harmonized set of remote sensing and meteorological features to enable flexible architecture design; and (3) baselines ranging from tree-based methods to domain-generalization architectures. By bridging machine learning methodologies and Earth system science, CarbonBench aims to enable systematic comparison of transfer learning methods, serves as a testbed for regression under distribution shift, and contributes to the next-generation climate modeling efforts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CarbonBench 是首个面向碳通量升尺度 (carbon flux upscaling) 的零样本空间迁移基准，包含 567 个通量塔站点、超过 130 万条 2000-2024 年逐日观测。该基准设计了跨越未见植被类型和气候区的分层评测协议，将空间迁移与时间自相关分离，并提供统一的遥感和气象特征集以及从树模型到域泛化架构的基线。其目标是为零样本时序回归和分布偏移下的回归提供标准化测试平台。
Motivation: 准确的陆地碳交换量化对气候政策与碳核算至关重要，但稀疏的涡度协方差观测使模型难以泛化到生态系统中未被充分采样的区域。尽管该问题天然属于时间序列回归的零样本空间迁移，此前缺乏统一的基准来严格评估跨地理位置的模型性能。
Method: 构建包含 567 个全球通量塔站点、超 130 万条逐日观测（2000-2024）的基准，提供三类组件：显式测试未见植被类型和气候区泛化的分层评测协议（区分空间迁移与时间自相关）、统一化的遥感和气象特征集以支持灵活架构设计，以及从树模型到域泛化架构的多种基线。
Result: 摘要未给出具体的模型性能数值，主要贡献是发布基准本身：大规模数据、标准化评测协议、特征集和基线集合，用于系统比较迁移学习方法。
Conclusion: CarbonBench 旨在连接机器学习方法与地球系统科学，作为分布偏移下回归任务的测试平台，并为下一代气候建模工作提供支撑。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Neural Network-Based Parameter Estimation of a Labour Market Agent-Based Model
papers.abstract_en: Agent-based modelling (ABM) is a widespread approach to simulate complex systems. Advancements in computational processing and storage have facilitated the adoption of ABMs across many fields; however, ABMs face challenges that limit their use as decision-support tools. A significant issue is parameter estimation in large-scale ABMs, particularly due to computational constraints on exploring the parameter space. This study evaluates a state-of-the-art simulation-based inference (SBI) framework that uses neural networks (NN) for parameter estimation. This framework is applied to an established labour market ABM based on job transition networks. The ABM is initiated with synthetic datasets and the real U.S. labour market. Next, we compare the effectiveness of summary statistics derived from a list of statistical measures with that learned by an embedded NN. The results demonstrate that the NN-based approach recovers the original parameters when evaluating posterior distributions across various dataset scales and improves efficiency compared to traditional Bayesian methods.
papers.comment: Paper has been submitted without the consent of all 5 authors and without having its final version. Uploaded on arxiv at 17 Feb 2026 The version with proper review was only available on 19 March 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了一种基于神经网络 (NN) 的仿真推断 (simulation-based inference, SBI) 框架，用于劳动力市场 Agent 基模型 (ABM) 的参数估计。该 ABM 基于职位转换网络 (job transition networks)，初始化使用合成数据与真实美国劳动力市场数据。结果表明，在多种数据规模下，NN 方法能够恢复原始参数，并且比传统贝叶斯方法更高效。
Motivation: 大规模 ABM 的参数估计面临计算约束，难以有效探索参数空间，限制了其作为决策支持工具的使用。
Method: 采用一种 SBI 框架，比较两类摘要统计量 (summary statistics) 的效果：一类来自统计测度列表，另一类由嵌入的 NN 学习，并在劳动力市场 ABM 上进行验证。
Result: 摘要报告 NN 方法在合成与真实美国劳动力市场数据上，跨多种数据集规模均能恢复原始参数，并相对传统贝叶斯方法提升效率。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 NN 驱动的 SBI 可改善 ABM 参数估计的效率和可行性；另外 arXiv 评论指出该上传版本未经全部 5 位作者同意且不是最终版本，经同行评审的版本于 2026 年 3 月 19 日发布。

papers.title: Data-driven registration and modeling of brain deformation for image-guided neurosurgery
papers.abstract_en: Accurate compensation of brain deformation is critical for reliable image-guided neurosurgery. Surgical manipulation and tumor resection induce tissue motion, causing preoperative planning images to become misaligned with the intraoperative anatomy. In this review, we examine data-driven methods developed between 2020 and 2025 for brain deformation registration and modeling, with a particular focus on learning-based approaches. A comprehensive literature search was conducted in PubMed, IEEE Xplore, Scopus, and Web of Science using predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria for computational methods addressing brain deformation in neurosurgical imaging, resulting in 46 eligible studies. We provide a unified analysis of methodological strategies, including deep learning-based image registration, direct deformation field regression, synthesis-driven multimodal alignment, resection-aware architectures for handling missing correspondences, and hybrid models integrating biomechanical priors. We also examine dataset utilization, evaluation metrics, validation protocols, and the assessment of uncertainty and generalization across studies. While learning-based methods demonstrate promising accuracy and computational efficiency, current approaches remain limited by out-of-distribution robustness, standardized benchmarking, interpretability, and readiness for clinical deployment. Our review highlights these gaps and outlines future directions toward more robust, generalizable, and clinically translatable solutions for neurosurgical guidance. By organizing recent advances and critically assessing evaluation practices, this work provides a comprehensive reference for researchers and clinicians working on data-driven registration and modeling of brain deformation.

Conclusion: 作者强调需要发展更稳健、可泛化且可临床转化的神经外科导航方案，并梳理了未来研究方向，为研究人员和临床医生提供参考。
