papers.title: XtraLight-MedMamba for Classification of Neoplastic Tubular Adenomas
papers.abstract_en: Accurate risk stratification of precancerous polyps during routine colonoscopy screening is a key strategy to reduce the incidence of colorectal cancer (CRC). However, assessment of low-grade dysplasia remains limited by subjective histopathologic interpretation. Advances in computational pathology and deep learning offer new opportunities to identify subtle, fine morphologic patterns associated with malignant progression that may be imperceptible to the human eye. In this work, we propose XtraLight-MedMamba, an ultra-lightweight state-space-based deep learning framework to classify neoplastic tubular adenomas from whole-slide images (WSIs). The architecture is a blend of a ConvNeXt-based shallow feature extractor with parallel vision mamba blocks to efficiently model local texture cues within global contextual structure. An integration of the Spatial and Channel Attention Bridge (SCAB) module enhances multiscale feature extraction, while the Fixed Non-Negative Orthogonal Classifier (FNOClassifier) enables substantial parameter reduction and improved generalization. The model was evaluated on a curated dataset acquired from patients with low-grade tubular adenomas, stratified into case and control cohorts based on subsequent CRC development. XtraLight-MedMamba achieved an accuracy of 97.18\% and an F1-score of 0.9767 using approximately 32,000 parameters, outperforming transformer-based and conventional Mamba architectures, which have significantly higher model complexity and computational burden, making it suitable for resource-constrained areas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XtraLight-MedMamba，一种超轻量级基于状态空间模型 (state-space model) 的深度学习框架，用于从全切片图像 (WSIs) 中对肿瘤性管状腺瘤进行分类。该架构结合 ConvNeXt 浅层特征提取器、并行 Vision Mamba 模块、Spatial and Channel Attention Bridge (SCAB) 以及 Fixed Non-Negative Orthogonal Classifier (FNOClassifier)，在约 32,000 个参数下达到 97.18% 准确率和 0.9767 的 F1 分数，优于 Transformer 和常规 Mamba 架构。模型面向资源受限环境设计。
Motivation: 结肠镜筛查中癌前息肉的风险分层对降低结直肠癌 (CRC) 发病率至关重要，但低度不典型增生的评估受主观病理判读限制。作者希望利用计算病理学和深度学习识别人眼难以察觉的、与恶性进展相关的细微形态模式。
Method: 提出一个超轻量级状态空间深度学习框架，混合 ConvNeXt 浅层特征提取器与并行 Vision Mamba 块，以在全局上下文中建模局部纹理线索；SCAB 模块增强多尺度特征提取，FNOClassifier 实现参数大幅减少并改善泛化。
Result: 在来自低度管状腺瘤患者、按后续是否发生 CRC 分为病例组和对照组的 curated 数据集上，XtraLight-MedMamba 达到 97.18% 准确率和 0.9767 F1 分数，仅用约 32,000 个参数，优于复杂度更高的 Transformer 和常规 Mamba 架构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该超轻量级模型在资源受限环境下对病理图像分类的适用性，但未提及外部验证、数据集规模或临床可推广性的局限性。

papers.title: The Nonstationarity-Complexity Tradeoff in Return Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Does more data improve return prediction? In non-stationary financial markets, longer training windows improve prediction of complex models but incorporate outdated economic regimes, whereas simpler models require less data and are less vulnerable to changes in economic conditions. We formally characterize this nonstationarity-complexity tradeoff, showing that model complexity and training window length must be jointly optimized. We propose an adaptive selection procedure with formal performance guarantees. Over three decades of U.S. equity markets, our method improves out-of-sample $R^2$ on industry portfolios by 14% relative to fixed-window and regime-switching benchmarks, with large gains during recessions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非平稳金融市场中数据量与收益预测的关系，正式刻画了非平稳性与模型复杂度之间的权衡。作者提出一种自适应选择程序，联合优化模型复杂度和训练窗口长度，并在美国股票市场上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 在非平稳金融市场中，更长的训练窗口能改善复杂模型的预测，但会引入过时的经济体制；而简单模型需要更少数据、对经济条件变化更不敏感。该文献缺少对这种非平稳性-复杂度权衡的正式刻画，导致模型复杂度和窗口长度难以联合优化。
Method: 作者正式刻画非平稳性-复杂度权衡，证明模型复杂度和训练窗口长度必须联合优化，并提出一种具有形式化性能保证的自适应选择程序。
Result: 在三十年美国股票市场中，该方法将行业组合的样本外 R² 相对固定窗口和体制切换基准提高 14%，且在衰退期间收益尤其大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调模型复杂度与训练窗口长度需要联合选择，自适应选择程序可显著提升收益预测的样本外表现。

papers.title: J-RAS: Mutual Adaptation for Medical Image Segmentation via Contrastive Retrieval-Augmented Joint Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Manual medical image segmentation by clinicians, though accurate, is time-consuming and variable across experts, while AI-based models automate this process but often falter under limited data and domain shifts. Inspired by how humans learn new tasks through guidance such as how children draw more accurately when shown reference images, we propose Joint Retrieval-Augmented Segmentation (J-RAS), a framework that enables segmentation networks to learn with guidance. J-RAS jointly optimizes a segmentation model and a retrieval model through alternating contrastive and supervised learning, allowing the retrieval network to discover contextually relevant image-mask pairs that refine the segmentation model's anatomical reasoning. Unlike conventional retrieval-based augmentation that passively provides similar samples, J-RAS establishes a mutual adaptation and optimization loop where the retrieval model learns to emphasize segmentation-relevant cues, while the segmentation model leverages retrieved examples to improve boundary delineation, robustness to rare cases and and cross-dataset generalization. Evaluations on two public benchmarks, ACDC and M&Ms, across multiple backbones (U-Net, TransUNet, SAM, and SegFormer) demonstrate the generality and effectiveness of J-RAS. For instance, on ACDC, SegFormer improves from a mean Dice of 0.8708$\pm$0.042 and HD of 1.8130$\pm$2.49 to 0.9115$\pm$0.031 and 1.1489$\pm$0.30. These results highlight how retrieval-guided contrastive optimization bridges human-like guidance and machine-learned precision in medical image segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出联合检索增强分割框架 J-RAS（Joint Retrieval-Augmented Segmentation），通过交替的对比学习和监督学习联合优化分割模型与检索模型，使检索网络发现与分割任务相关的图像-掩码对，从而改进分割模型的解剖推理。在 ACDC 和 M&M 两个公开医学影像基准上，针对 U-Net、TransUNet、SAM、SegFormer 等多种骨干网络验证了有效性与泛化性。
Motivation: 临床医生手工分割医学图像准确但耗时且存在专家间差异，AI 分割模型自动化了该过程，但在数据有限和域偏移下表现不佳；现有基于检索的增强方法只是被动提供相似样本，缺乏分割模型与检索模型的相互适应。
Method: J-RAS 构建分割模型与检索模型之间的相互适应与联合优化循环：检索模型通过对比学习学习强调与分割相关的线索，分割模型利用检索到的图像-掩码对改善边界描绘与稀有病例鲁棒性；两者通过交替的对比学习和监督学习共同优化。
Result: 在 ACDC 上，SegFormer 的平均 Dice 从 0.8708±0.042、HD 从 1.8130±2.49 提升到 0.9115±0.031 和 1.1489±0.30；在 ACDC 和 M&M 两个基准上的多个骨干网络结果验证了方法的通用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调检索引导的对比优化将类似人类学习的引导方式与机器学习的精度结合，可用于改善医学图像分割的边界刻画、稀有病例鲁棒性和跨数据集泛化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SALSA-V: Shortcut-Augmented Long-form Synchronized Audio from Videos
papers.abstract_en: We propose SALSA-V, a multimodal video-to-audio generation model capable of synthesizing highly synchronized, high-fidelity long-form audio from silent video content. Our approach introduces a masked diffusion objective, enabling audio-conditioned generation and the seamless synthesis of unconstrained length audio sequences. Additionally, by integrating a shortcut loss into our training process, we achieve rapid generation of high-quality audio samples in as few as eight sampling steps, paving the way for near-real-time applications without requiring dedicated fine-tuning or retraining. We demonstrate that SALSA-V significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in both audiovisual alignment and synchronization with video content in quantitative evaluation and a human listening study. Furthermore, our use of random masking during training enables our model to match spectral characteristics of reference audio samples, broadening its applicability to professional audio synthesis tasks such as Foley generation and sound design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SALSA-V，一个从静音视频合成同步、高保真长时音频的多模态视频到音频生成模型。方法引入掩码扩散目标（masked diffusion objective），支持音频条件生成与任意长度音频序列的合成；训练中加入 shortcut loss，使模型仅需 8 步采样即可生成高质量音频，无需专门微调。摘要报告该模型在定量评估和人工听感测试中显著优于现有最先进方法，在视听对齐与同步方面表现更好。
Motivation: 现有视频到音频生成方法难以兼顾长音频的同步性、高保真度与生成速度，缺乏面向近乎实时应用的高效生成方案。
Method: 采用掩码扩散目标实现音频条件生成与任意长度音频的平滑合成；在训练中引入 shortcut loss，使模型能够以少至 8 步采样快速生成高质量音频，并且不需要额外的微调或重训练。
Result: 摘要称 SALSA-V 在定量评估和人工听感研究中显著优于现有最先进方法，特别是在视听对齐（audiovisual alignment）和与视频内容的同步性方面。
Conclusion: 训练时的随机掩码使模型能够匹配参考音频的频谱特征，从而扩展到 Foley 生成和声音设计等专业音频合成任务。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 摘要称 SALSA-V 在定量评估和人工听感研究中显著优于现有最先进方法，特别是在视听对齐（audiovisual alignment）和与视频内容的同步性方面。
summary_sections.conclusion: 训练时的随机掩码使模型能够匹配参考音频的频谱特征，从而扩展到 Foley 生成和声音设计等专业音频合成任务。

papers.title: TENET: One Step Toward Test-Driven Development for Repository-Level Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Test-Driven Development (TDD) is a widely adopted practice that requires developers to create and execute tests alongside implementation. With recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), developers can shift from manually writing the code to defining tests as executable specifications and delegating code synthesis to AI agents. However, enabling repository-level TDD under developer-written tests is challenging, requiring: (1) specification enhancement: identifying a concise yet representative test subset from large suites with rich task semantics; (2) retrieval augmentation: using tests to guide reasoning and context retrieval; and (3) test-driven refinement: interpreting test feedback for iterative improvement. We propose TENET, an agentic framework for repository-level code generation under the TDD paradigm. TENET includes: (1) a test harness mechanism that selects a concise test suite to maximize diversity of the target usage scenarios; (2) a tailored agent toolset for efficient retrieval and debugging; and (3) a reflection-based refinement workflow that iteratively analyzes failures and updates implementations. TENET consistently outperforms the strongest baselines across backbones, achieving 69.08% and 81.77% Pass@1 on RepoCod and RepoEval with Claude Sonnet 4, improving by 9.49 and 2.17 percentage points, respectively. Additionally, we present the first systematic study of how test suite characteristics influence LLM agent performance in TDD settings.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 37th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TENET，一个面向仓库级代码生成的智能体框架，遵循测试驱动开发 (TDD) 范式。TENET 包含测试套件筛选、针对检索与调试的定制工具集，以及基于反思的迭代改进流程，在 RepoCod 和 RepoEval 上搭配 Claude Sonnet 4 达到 69.08% 和 81.77% 的 Pass@1，分别提升 9.49 和 2.17 个百分点。作者还首次系统研究了测试套件特征如何影响 TDD 设置下 LLM 智能体的性能。
Motivation: 在开发者编写测试作为可执行规范、由 AI 代理承担代码合成的仓库级 TDD 场景中，存在三个挑战：从大型测试套件中挑选简洁且具有代表性的子集以丰富任务语义、利用测试来引导推理和上下文检索、以及解释测试反馈以进行迭代改进。
Method: TENET 包括三部分：一个测试装置机制 (test harness mechanism)，选择能最大化目标使用场景多样性的简洁测试套件；一套定制化的智能体工具，用于高效检索与调试；以及一个基于反思的改进流程，通过迭代分析失败并更新实现。
Result: 在多种骨干模型上，TENET 一致优于最强基线；使用 Claude Sonnet 4 时在 RepoCod 和 RepoEval 上分别取得 69.08% 和 81.77% 的 Pass@1，比基线提升 9.49 和 2.17 个百分点。论文还提供了关于测试套件特征影响 LLM 智能体性能的首个系统研究。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过系统的测试筛选、检索调试工具和反思式精化，TENET 能够在仓库级代码生成中稳定超越基线，并强调测试套件特征对 TDD 智能体性能的可解释影响。

papers.title: The Fools are Certain; the Wise are Doubtful: Exploring LLM Confidence in Code Completion
papers.abstract_en: Code completion entails the task of providing missing tokens given a surrounding context. It can boost developer productivity and serve as a code discovery tool. Code completion has recently been approached with Large Language Models (LLMs) fine-tuned on code (code LLMs). The performance of code LLMs can be assessed with downstream and intrinsic metrics. Downstream metrics are usually employed to evaluate the practical utility of a model, but can be unreliable and require complex calculations and domain-specific knowledge. In contrast, intrinsic metrics such as perplexity, entropy, and mutual information, which measure model confidence or uncertainty, are simple, versatile, and universal across LLMs and tasks, and have been proposed as proxies for functional correctness and hallucination risk in LLM-generated code. Motivated by this, we evaluate the confidence of LLMs when generating code by measuring code perplexity across programming languages, models, and datasets using various LLMs, and a sample of 2254 files from 881 GitHub projects. We find that strongly-typed languages exhibit lower perplexity than dynamically typed languages. Scripting languages also demonstrate higher perplexity. Shell appears universally high in perplexity, whereas Java appears low. Code perplexity depends on the employed LLM; under a fixed model, relative language-level rankings are largely stable across evaluation corpora. Although code comments modestly increase perplexity, the language ranking based on perplexity is barely affected by their presence. LLM researchers, developers, and users can use our findings to assess the suitability of LLM-based code completion in specific software projects based on how language, model choice, and code characteristics impact model confidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究代码补全场景下 LLM 的置信度评估，使用代码困惑度 (perplexity) 作为内在度量，跨编程语言、模型和数据集测量模型信心。基于 881 个 GitHub 项目的 2254 个文件样本，发现强类型语言困惑度低于动态类型语言，Shell 普遍高而 Java 低；语言层面的相对排序在固定模型下跨语料库基本稳定。
Motivation: 下游指标评估代码 LLM 的实用性可能不可靠且需要复杂计算，而困惑度、熵、互信息等内在指标简单通用，可作为功能正确性和幻觉风险的代理；作者希望系统评估 LLM 生成代码时的置信度。
Method: 使用多种代码 LLM，在编程语言、模型和数据集多个维度上测量代码困惑度，样本来自 881 个 GitHub 项目的 2254 个文件，并分析注释对困惑度及语言排序的影响。
Result: 强类型语言困惑度低于动态类型语言，脚本语言困惑度更高；Shell 普遍高，Java 低；困惑度依赖模型，但在固定模型下语言级相对排序跨语料库稳定，注释对排序影响甚微。
Conclusion: 语言、模型选择和代码特征会影响模型置信度，研究结果可帮助研究人员、开发者和用户评估 LLM 代码补全在具体项目中的适用性。

papers.title: Responsiveness Verification: Will Predictions Change? How Much? How Often?
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models are often used in applications where their inputs change due to routine interactions, strategic manipulation, or noise. In such settings, models can undermine safety as these changes lead them to predict over regions of input space they have not seen. We propose to address these challenges by measuring responsiveness---the probability that a model output changes when its inputs change under an interaction model. We develop algorithms to estimate responsiveness for any machine learning model, and a framework to specify broad classes of interaction models. We pair these algorithms with statistical guarantees that support practical validation. We demonstrate how our tools can promote safety and reliability across domains by detecting preclusion in recidivism prediction, estimating the cost of gaming in content moderation, and testing the robustness of benchmarks for LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“响应性验证”(responsiveness verification) 这一框架，用来度量机器学习模型在输入发生变化时输出变化的概率。作者给出适用于任意模型的响应性估计算法、用于描述交互模型 (interaction model) 的规范框架，以及配套的统计保证，并在累犯预测、内容审核和 LLM 基准测试等场景中展示其作用。
Motivation: ML 模型常被用于输入会因日常交互、策略性操纵或噪声而改变的场景，此时模型可能对未见过的输入空间区域进行预测，从而损害安全性。
Method: 将响应性定义为在给定交互模型下模型输出随输入变化而变化的概率，并开发可估计该量的算法，同时提供支持实际验证的统计保证，以及用于表达多种交互模型的框架。
Result: 摘要报告该方法可用于检测累犯预测中的 preclusion、估计内容审核中的 gaming 成本，以及检验 LLM 基准测试的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些工具能在多个领域提升模型的安全性与可靠性，强调响应性验证为模型行为变异提供了可验证的量化手段。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Duality and Policy Evaluation in Distributionally Robust Bayesian Diffusion Control
papers.abstract_en: We study diffusion control problems under parameter uncertainty. Controllers based on plug-in estimation can be brittle due to potential distribution shifts. Bayesian control with a prior on the parameters offers a formulation with beliefs about such shifts. However, as with any Bayesian model, the prior may be misspecified. To mitigate misspecification and reduce over-pessimism compared to classical robust control approaches (e.g. \citet{hansen2008robustness}), we propose a distributionally robust Bayesian control (DRBC) formulation in which an adversary perturbs the prior within a divergence neighborhood of a baseline prior. We develop a strong duality result that reduces the distributionally robust prior evaluation to a low-dimensional optimization and yields a practical simulation-based policy evaluation and learning procedure with structured policy parameterizations. We validate the efficiency of the algorithm on a synthetic linear-quadratic control example and real-data portfolio selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究参数不确定性下的扩散控制问题，提出分布鲁棒贝叶斯控制（Distributionally Robust Bayesian Control, DRBC）公式：允许对手在基线先验的散度邻域内扰动先验，以缓解先验错设并避免经典鲁棒控制的过度悲观。作者建立了强对偶结果，将分布鲁棒先验评估化为低维优化，并据此给出基于模拟的策略评估与学习算法；在合成线性二次控制实例和真实数据投资组合选择上验证了效率。
Motivation: 基于插件估计的控制器在分布变化下可能脆弱，而贝叶斯控制依赖的先验可能被错误设定；经典鲁棒控制（如 Hansen-Sargent）又往往过于悲观。需要一种兼顾先验不确定性又能控制悲观程度的控制公式。
Method: 提出 DRBC 公式，其中对抗者在基线先验的散度邻域内扰动先验；通过强对偶定理把分布鲁棒的先验评估简化为低维优化，并利用结构化策略参数化实现基于模拟的策略评估和学习过程。
Result: 摘要报告在合成线性二次控制示例和真实数据投资组合选择实验上验证了算法效率，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DRBC 能以计算可行的方式缓解先验错设并降低相对经典鲁棒控制的过度悲观，为参数不确定下的扩散控制提供实用评估框架。

papers.title: MLCC: A Congestion Control Technique to Accelerate ML Training
papers.abstract_en: We present MLCC, a novel technique to augment today's congestion control algorithms to accelerate DNN training jobs in shared GPU clusters in a fully distributed manner. At the heart of MLCC lies a straightforward principle: DNN training flows should scale their sending rate to shift other flows' communication into their compute periods, achieving interleaving. We show that integrating this principle into today's congestion control protocols is simple (requiring less than 60 lines of code for a given protocol) and enables DNN jobs to interleave within a few training iterations, thereby reducing network contention and improving job completion times. Our testbed demonstrates that MLCC accelerates the average and 99th percentile training iteration times by up to 1.9x and 2.7x respectively. Through extensive packet-level simulations, we observe a 1.35x improvement in training throughput on a 36-node, 288 GPU fat-tree topology.
papers.comment: Anton A. Zabreyko, Sanjoli Narang: Equal Contribution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MLCC，一种用于加速共享 GPU 集群中 DNN 训练任务的分布式拥塞控制增强技术。其核心原则是让训练流调整发送速率，把其他流的通信时间移到自身的计算阶段，从而实现流间交错 (interleaving)。测试床显示平均和 99 分位训练迭代时间分别最高加速 1.9x 和 2.7x，包级仿真在 36 节点、288 GPU 胖树拓扑上观察到 1.35x 的训练吞吐提升。
Motivation: 分布式 DNN 训练在共享 GPU 集群中面临网络争用，导致训练迭代时间变长、作业完成时间恶化；现有拥塞控制算法未专门针对 DNN 训练流的计算-通信交叠特性进行优化。
Method: 提出一种轻量级、全分布式的技术 MLCC，将“训练流将其他流的通信转移到自身计算周期”这一原则集成到现有拥塞控制协议中，对给定协议只需不到 60 行代码改动，并能在几个训练迭代内实现流间交错。
Result: 测试床实验中，平均与 99 分位训练迭代时间分别最高加速 1.9x 和 2.7x；大规模包级仿真在 36 节点、288 GPU 胖树拓扑上训练吞吐提升 1.35x。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MLCC 以很小的代码改动即可集成到现有拥塞控制协议，并显著降低网络争用、改善 DNN 作业完成时间；其适用范围是共享 GPU 集群中的分布式训练场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BAT: Learning to Reason about Spatial Sounds with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Spatial sound reasoning is a fundamental human skill, enabling us to navigate and interpret our surroundings based on sound. In this paper we present BAT, which combines the spatial sound perception ability of a binaural acoustic scene analysis model with the natural language reasoning capabilities of a large language model (LLM) to replicate this innate ability. To address the lack of existing datasets of in-the-wild spatial sounds, we synthesized a binaural audio dataset using AudioSet and SoundSpaces 2.0. Next, we developed SpatialSoundQA, a spatial sound-based question-answering dataset, offering a range of QA tasks that train BAT in various aspects of spatial sound perception and reasoning. The acoustic front end encoder of BAT is a novel spatial audio encoder named Spatial Audio Spectrogram Transformer, or Spatial-AST, which by itself achieves strong performance across sound event detection, spatial localization, and distance estimation. By integrating Spatial-AST with LLaMA-2 7B model, BAT transcends standard Sound Event Localization and Detection (SELD) tasks, enabling the model to reason about the relationships between the sounds in its environment. Our experiments demonstrate BAT's superior performance on both spatial sound perception and reasoning, showcasing the immense potential of LLMs in navigating and interpreting complex spatial audio environments.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2024. Our demo, dataset, code and model weights are available at: https://zhishengzheng.com/bat
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BAT，将双耳声学场景分析模型与大型语言模型（LLaMA-2 7B）结合，用于空间声音推理。作者利用 AudioSet 和 SoundSpaces 2.0 合成双耳音频数据集，并构建 SpatialSoundQA 问答数据集，设计了新的空间音频编码器 Spatial-AST。实验表明 BAT 在空间声音感知与推理任务上表现优越，超越了标准的声学事件定位与检测（SELD）任务。
Motivation: 空间声音推理是人类感知环境的基本能力，但现有数据集缺乏野外空间声音数据，且标准 SELD 任务无法支持对环境中声音之间关系的自然语言推理。
Method: 提出 BAT 架构，由空间音频编码器 Spatial-AST 与 LLaMA-2 7B 语言模型组成；通过 AudioSet 和 SoundSpaces 2.0 合成双耳音频数据集，并构建 SpatialSoundQA 问答数据集来训练多种空间声音感知与推理任务。
Result: 摘要报告 Spatial-AST 在声音事件检测、空间定位和距离估计上表现强；BAT 在空间声音感知与推理任务上均优于基线，展示了 LLM 在复杂空间音频环境中的潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将空间音频编码器与 LLM 结合可超越传统 SELD 任务，实现环境声音关系的自然语言推理。

papers.title: Algorithm Design and Physician Liability
papers.abstract_en: A single clinical algorithm can deliver unequal accuracy across patient groups, and concern about such disparity has grown as artificial intelligence (AI) spreads through clinical decision-making. In response, a liability rule introduced in the United States holds healthcare providers responsible when their reliance on disparate algorithms contributes to erroneous clinical decisions. We examine how such liability considerations reshape (i) an AI firm's algorithm design decisions that drive group-specific accuracy and (ii) a physician's decisions to use AI in healthcare delivery. The AI firm designs an algorithm for two patient groups, and improving accuracy for the disadvantaged group is more costly. The physician (who remains the accountable decision-maker) then decides whether to consult AI, weighing the reduction in clinical uncertainty against expected liability exposure when AI errors disproportionately affect the disadvantaged group. We find the liability rule can induce disparate use of AI: the physician may reduce AI use overall and, over an intermediate range of liability, rely on AI less for disadvantaged patients. The effect is non-monotone. As liability increases, the physician's use of AI for disadvantaged patients first declines, then rises as the firm reallocates investment toward reducing disparity or switches to an equal-accuracy design. Mandating equal algorithmic accuracy across patient groups can then inadvertently harm both groups, because a uniform accuracy requirement distorts the firm's investment incentives and the physician's equilibrium AI-use decisions.
papers.comment: 65 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables; includes online appendix (pp. 51-65)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究美国医疗责任规则如何影响 AI 公司的算法设计（针对两个患者群体的分组准确率）与医生使用 AI 的决策。通过理论建模，作者发现责任规则可能诱导 AI 使用的差异：医生可能整体减少 AI 使用，且在中等责任水平下对弱势群体患者更少依赖 AI，效果非单调。文章还指出强制各组算法准确率相同可能反而伤害两个群体。
Motivation: 临床算法可能在不同患者群体间准确率不均，随着 AI 进入临床决策，这种差异引发担忧；美国引入的责任规则将医疗提供者纳入责任范围。作者想要理解该责任规则如何影响算法设计者和使用者的均衡决策。
Method: 构建理论模型：AI 公司为两个患者群体设计算法，改善弱势群体准确率的成本更高；医生作为最终责任决策者，权衡临床不确定性降低与责任暴露，决定是否使用 AI。分析责任规则下企业投资与医生 AI 使用的均衡。
Result: 摘要指出责任规则可诱导 AI 使用的差异，医生可能整体减少 AI 使用，在中等责任区间对弱势患者依赖更少；随责任增加，对弱势患者的使用先降后升，因为企业重新分配投资减少差异或转向等准确率设计。强制等准确率会无意中伤害两个群体。
Conclusion: 作者认为强制跨患者群体的算法准确率相等会扭曲企业投资激励和医生均衡 AI 使用决策，反而可能对两个群体均有害。该结论基于理论建模，摘要未报告实证数据。

papers.title: How Compliant is Sepsis Treatment? An Expert-Guided Neuro-symbolic Pipeline for Generating Clinical Compliance Insights
papers.abstract_en: Verifying whether clinical care follows evidence-based protocols is a natural neuro-symbolic problem, yet the safety-critical setting defeats either paradigm alone. We present an expert-guided pipeline that constrains a large language model strictly to semantic normalization, mapping messy drug and microbiology strings onto a fixed clinical vocabulary, while a Sugeno fuzzy inference system reasons over the normalized events. The fuzzy layer encodes eight Surviving Sepsis Campaign bundle rules and replaces binary judgments with graded scores in [0,1]. Applied to 2,438 MIMIC-IV v3.1 sepsis episodes, it surfaces antibiotic timing as the most critical breakdown (mean 0.24, 13% within one hour), Hour-1 underperformance (mean 36.7%), a 51% elevated-lactate drop-off, and descriptive differences in ICU stay across compliance groups (3.8 versus 5.1 days).
papers.comment: This has been submitted and accepted in NeSy 2026 (https://2026.nesyconf.org/)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对临床护理是否符合循证方案这一安全问题，提出一个专家引导的神经符号 (neuro-symbolic) 流水线：先用严格约束的大语言模型 (LLM) 完成语义归一化，将杂乱药物和微生物学字符串映射到固定临床词汇表，再用 Sugeno 模糊推理系统对归一化事件进行推理。模糊层编码八条 Surviving Sepsis Campaign bundle 规则，以 [0,1] 分级评分替代二元判断。将该流水线应用于 2,438 个 MIMIC-IV v3.1 脓毒症 episodes，发现抗生素时机是最关键薄弱环节，并量化了 Hour-1 表现不足、乳酸升高处理脱落率以及不同依从性组间 ICU 住院时长差异。
Motivation: 验证临床护理是否遵循循证协议本质上是神经符号问题，但安全关键场景使单一范式无法胜任，需要将神经网络的灵活性与符号规则的可靠性结合起来。
Method: 流水线包含两步：LLM 被严格限制为仅做语义归一化，把混乱的药品和微生物字符串转换为固定临床词汇；随后 Sugeno 模糊推理系统在归一化事件上推理，编码八条 Surviving Sepsis Campaign bundle 规则，并用分级评分替代二元判断。
Result: 在 2,438 个 MIMIC-IV v3.1 脓毒症 episodes 上，摘要报告抗生素时机的平均得分为 0.24、仅 13% 在 1 小时内给抗生素；Hour-1 表现平均 36.7%；51% 出现乳酸升高处理脱落；依从性分组间 ICU 住院时长分别为 3.8 天与 5.1 天。
Conclusion: 作者强调这种专家引导的神经符号流水线能够在安全关键场景下生成临床依从性洞察，其中的模糊推理层以分级评分揭示关键薄弱环节而不只是二元判定。

papers.title: Adjacency-Based Spectral Proxy Control of Mobile Communication Agents
papers.abstract_en: We consider a heterogeneous mobile-agent network composed of uncontrolled task agents and controllable communication agents. The objective is to reposition communication agents online as task agents move. Since throughput-based objectives are generally unsuitable for real-time control, spectral graph metrics such as algebraic connectivity are commonly adopted as surrogate objectives. However, controlling algebraic connectivity relies on the eigenvector corresponding to the second-smallest eigenvalue of a graph's Laplacian matrix (i.e., the Fiedler vector), whose distributed estimation requires an unbounded number of communication rounds to converge. In this work, we identify a structural decomposition of this Fiedler-gradient controller into a local interaction rule and a graph embedding component, suggesting the use of alternative embeddings that are easier to estimate distributively than the Fiedler vector. As a particular instance, we propose A-Fiedler, which replaces the Fiedler embedding with the dominant eigenvector of the adjacency matrix, commonly used as a graph embedding of nodes into a latent geometry. This representation is more naturally suited for distributed implementation under local communication constraints. We evaluate A-Fiedler against the classical Fiedler-gradient controller. Results show comparable network performance in the absence of communication constraints and improved robustness under distributed estimation. For instance, under the same number of communication rounds, the Fielder-gradient may even converge to disconnected configurations whereas our proposition maintains performance. We believe our contribution provides a simpler path toward distributed network control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究由不可控任务智能体与可控通信智能体构成的异构移动智能体网络，目标是随任务智能体运动而在线重定位通信智能体。作者将经典的 Fiedler 梯度控制器分解为局部交互规则与图嵌入（graph embedding）两部分，并提出 A-Fiedler，用邻接矩阵的主特征向量替代 Fiedler 向量作为图嵌入，从而更便于在局部通信约束下进行分布式估计。实验显示 A-Fiedler 在无通信约束时性能与经典 Fiedler 梯度控制器相当，在分布式估计下鲁棒性更好。
Motivation: 基于吞吐量的目标通常不适合实时控制，因此常用代数连通度（algebraic connectivity）等谱图指标作为替代目标；但控制代数连通度依赖 Fiedler 向量，其分布式估计需要无界数量的通信轮次才能收敛。
Method: 识别出 Fiedler 梯度控制器可分解为局部交互规则与图嵌入成分，并提出 A-Fiedler：用邻接矩阵的主导特征向量（即节点到潜在几何空间的常见图嵌入）替换 Fiedler 嵌入，使其更适合本地通信约束下的分布式实现。
Result: 在无通信约束下 A-Fiedler 与经典 Fiedler 梯度控制器性能相当；在分布式估计下鲁棒性更好。例如在相同通信轮次下，Fiedler 梯度可能收敛到不连通配置，而 A-Fiedler 保持性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为该贡献为分布式网络控制提供了一条更简单的路径；论文聚焦移动通信智能体网络的谱图控制，不涉及气象或降水相关内容。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VoiceDesigner: Text-to-Voice Generation and Editing via Unified Diffusion Modeling and Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Recent breakthroughs in generative models have made text-to-voice generation (TTV) possible, enabling the synthesis of speech directly from textual voice descriptions. However, existing systems face two key challenges. First, they struggle to generate a diverse range of voices, spanning real-world human speakers and fictional characters. Second, they lack robust and flexible voice editing capabilities, such as voice cloning and the ability to modify attributes like emotion and tone. In this paper, we propose VoiceDesigner, a unified framework for text-to-voice generation and editing that supports diverse and controllable voice design. To tackle the above challenges, we propose solutions from two perspectives. First, we develop a hybrid data pipeline that leverages digital signal processing techniques and speech generation models to construct a diverse voice dataset covering both real-world and fictional voices. Second, we introduce a diffusion transformer with architectural improvements to better handle complex conditioning and enhance multi-task performance, enabling unified voice generation and editing. Through subjective and objective evaluations, VoiceDesigner achieves superior prompt alignment with both voice descriptions and editing instructions, while maintaining competitive perceptual quality and voice usability compared to state-of-the-art TTV models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VoiceDesigner，一个统一的文本到语音（TTV）生成与编辑框架，支持多样化和可控的语音设计。摘要报告通过混合数据流水线构建涵盖真实和虚构语音的多样化数据集，并引入带架构改进的扩散 transformer（diffusion transformer）来统一语音生成与编辑。主观和客观评估显示，VoiceDesigner 在语音描述和编辑指令的提示对齐上优于现有 SOTA TTV 模型，同时保持有竞争力的感知质量和语音可用性。
Motivation: 现有 TTV 系统难以生成覆盖真实说话人和虚构角色的多样化语音，也缺乏稳健灵活的语音编辑能力（如语音克隆、情感和语气属性修改），这两点限制了文本到语音生成与编辑的实际应用。
Method: 提出两条解决路径：一是混合数据流水线，利用数字信号处理技术和语音生成模型构建涵盖真实与虚构语音的多样数据集；二是引入扩散 transformer 并做架构改进，以更好处理复杂条件并提升多任务性能，实现统一的语音生成与编辑。
Result: 通过主观和客观评估，VoiceDesigner 在语音描述和编辑指令的提示对齐上优于现有 SOTA TTV 模型，同时保持有竞争力的感知质量和语音可用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一的扩散建模与数据增强可以实现多样化、可控的语音设计与编辑，说明联合处理生成与编辑任务能够改善提示对齐并维持语音质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SemPlan: Benchmarking Structured Semantic Planning for LLM-Based Queries over Enterprise Data
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language interfaces to enterprise data must translate underspecified requests into governed, executable behavior while controlling invalid queries, policy failures, cost, and nondeterminism. SemPlan Benchmark evaluates this architectural design space with a deterministic synthetic bilingual benchmark containing 1,800 cases in English and Brazilian Portuguese; 1,200 cases form the frozen scientific evaluation subset. Four architectures are compared under the same model configuration: direct SQL generation (A1), a bounded tool-agent baseline (A2), structured semantic-request generation followed by deterministic planning and execution (A3), and a clarification/stateful semantic-plan variant (A4). Across 4,800 primary records, answer correctness was low in absolute terms: 22.25% for A1, 22.58% for A2, 25.67% for A3, and 24.25% for A4. A3 had the highest observed correctness and significantly exceeded A1, A2, and A4 in the pre-specified paired correctness analysis, while A1 retained the highest policy-correct rate and the lowest unsafe-or-invalid rate. A4 had the lowest mean API cost and lowest false-refusal rate. On a preselected 150-case stability subset, answer-correct repeatability ranged from 92.00% to 98.67%. The results support a trade-off interpretation rather than a universal ranking: additional structural constraints changed failure modes and efficiency, but did not monotonically improve correctness or solve ambiguity and multi-turn state consistency.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SemPlan 是一个用于评估企业数据自然语言查询系统架构的确定性合成双语基准，包含英语和巴西葡萄牙语的 1,800 个用例，其中 1,200 个构成冻结的科学评估子集。论文在相同模型配置下比较了四种架构：直接 SQL 生成 (A1)、有界工具代理基线 (A2)、结构化语义请求生成后接确定性规划与执行 (A3)，以及带澄清/有状态语义规划的变体 (A4)。在 4,800 条主记录上，各架构的答案正确率绝对水平均较低：A1 为 22.25%、A2 为 22.58%、A3 为 25.67%、A4 为 24.25%；A3 在预设配对正确性分析中显著优于其余三者。
Motivation: 自然语言界面需要将欠指定的请求转换为受管控且可执行的行为，同时控制无效查询、策略失败、成本和非确定性；该问题缺乏系统性的架构评估基准，SemPlan 旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 构建确定性的合成双语基准，并设计四种架构在同一模型配置下进行比较，包括直接 SQL 生成、有界工具代理、结构化语义请求加确定性规划执行，以及带澄清机制的语义规划变体。
Result: A3 取得最高的观测正确率并在预指定配对分析中显著优于 A1、A2 和 A4；A1 保持最高的策略正确率和最低的不安全或无效率；A4 的平均 API 成本最低且错误拒绝率最低。在预选的 150 例稳定性子集上，答案正确的可重复性介于 92.00% 到 98.67% 之间。
Conclusion: 结果支持权衡解释而非单一排序：增加结构约束会改变失败模式和效率，但不会单调提升正确率，也无法解决歧义和多轮状态一致性问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating Agentic Learning Harness Capabilities Without Labels via the Scaling Hypothesis
papers.abstract_en: Agentic "Continual Learning Harnesses", systems that pair an LLM with retrieval or memory to improve from feedback without retraining, have shown growing value in cybersecurity. But their value is conventionally measured by gains against labeled benchmarks, an approach that often fails in operational security settings. Benchmark labels are scarce, stale, and unrepresentative, so a practitioner often cannot tell whether a given harness helps at all or which of two is better for their task. Traditional LLM-as-a-judge offers little signal because it is no stronger than the agent it evaluates, and distillation is unreliable on scarce, sporadic, and biased labels. We propose a framework for evaluating learning harnesses end-to-end without a labeled benchmark, grounded in the scaling hypothesis. A stronger teacher model provides sparsely sampled corrections to a smaller student with a continual learning harness. We score a harness by how much its student converges toward the teacher over time. Across security tasks, model families, and harness designs, we show that improvement relative to the teacher correlates with improvement relative to a held-out gold standard, validating teacher-relative lift as a proxy for true harness uplift when labels are absent. We further show that LLM-as-a-judge between similarly powered models yields no usable signal. These results suggest that a teacher-sized model can be improved through the same harness when humans provide the same kind of sparse, high-precision corrections.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at CAMLIS 2025 (Conference on Applied Machine Learning for Information Security)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需标注基准即可端到端评估“持续学习式智能体框架”(continual learning harness，即 LLM 配检索或记忆、从反馈中改进且不重训的系统) 的评测方案。其核心是利用缩放假说 (scaling hypothesis)：更强的教师模型向带 harness 的小学生模型提供稀疏采样修正，并以学生模型随时间向教师收敛的程度给 harness 打分。作者在安全任务、模型族和 harness 设计上验证，学生相对教师的提升与相对留出金标准的提升相关，从而在无标签时用 teacher-relative lift 代理真实收益；同时发现平行能力模型间的 LLM-as-a-judge 不产生可用信号。
Motivation: 操作安全场景中标注基准稀缺、过期且不具代表性，传统上用标注基准的增益来衡量 harness 价值常常失效，从业者难以判断某 harness 是否有用或哪个更优。LLM-as-a-judge 不比被评智能体更强，蒸馏在稀疏、零散且有偏的标签上也不可靠。
Method: 提出基于缩放假说的无标签评测框架：由更强的教师模型对带持续学习 harness 的较小学生模型提供稀疏采样的修正，并以学生逐渐逼近教师的表现来评分 harness，即 teacher-relative lift 作为代理指标。
Result: 在多种安全任务、模型族和 harness 设计上，相对教师的提升与相对留出金标准的提升存在相关性，验证了无标签时 teacher-relative lift 可作为真实 harness 增益的代理；而 LLM-as-a-judge 在能力相近模型之间无法提供可用信号。
Conclusion: 结果表明，当人类以同样稀疏且高精度的修正方式介入时，教师规模的模型也可通过同一 harness 得到改进，从而支持无标注环境下 harness 的可评测性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: No Universal Signal Predicts Sample-Level LLM Regression under Version Updates
papers.abstract_en: Frontier LLMs are updated frequently and typically outperform their predecessors in aggregate. But aggregate gains say little about individual samples: an update can still cause sample-level regression, where a response correct under the old model becomes incorrect under the new one. This paper studies how to predict such regressions from signals available at inference time. We compare single-model signals (confidence, logit margin, attention entropy) against cross-version signals (output KL divergence, likelihood drift, token-level KL, representation drift) under a unified added-value test that isolates each signal's gain over a confidence baseline. Across six benchmarks in three task families (multiple-choice question answering, or MCQ; math reasoning; code generation) and six model update pairs, we find that (1) signal effectiveness is task-dependent: confidence is strongest on MCQ and simpler math, while likelihood/KL signals give the most frequent gains on harder math and code; (2) no signal is universally best across model updates either; and (3) some cross-version signals stay informative even when confidence fails, including without labels, which supports a proof-of-concept selective fallback that routes high-risk samples back to the old model. Practitioners can use these task-level patterns to choose which regression signal to trust for a given update. Code is available at https://github.com/jiashengsally/llm-regression-signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究前沿 LLM 版本更新时,单个样本层面出现的推理性能回归(regression)能否用推理时可得的信号预测。作者在六个基准、三个任务族(多选题问答 MCQ、数学推理、代码生成)和六组模型更新对上,统一比较了单模型信号(置信度、logit margin、注意力熵)与跨版本信号(输出 KL 散度、似然漂移、token 级 KL、表示漂移),发现没有一种信号在所有任务和更新对中普遍最优,且信号有效性高度依赖任务类型。
Motivation: LLM 频繁更新后整体指标通常提升,但聚合表现掩盖了单个样本上的退化:旧模型回答正确的新模型可能答错。若能从推理时信号预测这类回归,就能在部署时进行高风险的兜底处理,这对可靠地应用持续更新的模型很重要。
Method: 提出一个统一的增值测试(added-value test),在置信度基线之上检验每个信号带来的独立预测增益;对比单模型信号与跨版本信号,并在无标签条件下考察跨版本信号是否仍具信息性;同时用这些任务级规律构建一个将高风险样本回退到旧模型的选择性兜底(selective fallback)原型。
Result: 摘要报告三点结果:信号有效性依赖任务——置信度在 MCQ 和较简单数学上最强,而似然/KL 信号在较难数学和代码生成上更常带来增益;没有信号在所有模型更新对上普遍最优;部分跨版本信号在置信度失效时仍能提供信息,甚至在无标签情况下也成立。
Conclusion: 实践者应根据具体更新场景按任务类型选择要信任的回归信号,而非依赖某个通用信号;论文也指出这些信号可用于将高风险样本路由回旧模型的不完善的兜底方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MobileMem: Learning from a Year of Mobile Experiences
papers.abstract_en: The next generation of AI agents is increasingly moving beyond systems that answer isolated questions toward persistent personal assistants that can understand, remember, and continuously learn from users' experiences. Such assistants require long-term memory to accumulate and leverage user-specific experiences over time, yet existing benchmarks remain inadequate for realistic mobile settings, where experiences are heterogeneous, multimodal, evolving, and deeply personal. We introduce MobileMem, a benchmark and framework for studying on-device long-term memory, grounded in a year-scale collection of mobile experiences. MobileMem employs a knowledge-grounded synthesis pipeline to construct coherent and temporally consistent long-horizon trajectories from user-app sessions. It provides complementary text and multimodal settings covering multi-hop and temporal reasoning, knowledge updating, and implicit preference inference. Specifically, MobileMem enables agents to remember the past, understand the present, and adapt to the future. By modeling experiences rather than isolated facts, MobileMem moves memory beyond information retrieval toward experiential intelligence for continuous personal learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MobileMem 是一个面向设备端长期记忆的基准与框架，基于一年尺度的移动体验数据，通过知识引导的合成流程构建时间一致的长时程轨迹，并提供文本与多模态两种设置，覆盖多跳与时序推理、知识更新和隐式偏好推断。论文主张把记忆从信息检索推进到体验智能，以支持持续的个人学习。
Motivation: 现有基准不足以刻画真实移动场景中的长期记忆，因为用户的体验是异构、多模态、演化且高度个人化的，而下一代个人助理需要跨时间积累并利用这些经验。
Method: 提出 MobileMem 基准与框架，采用知识引导的合成流程从用户-应用会话中构造连贯且时间一致的长期轨迹，并设计互补的文本与多模态任务来覆盖多跳推理、时序推理、知识更新和隐式偏好推断。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数字或基准结果，论文的主要贡献在于基准本身及其任务设计。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过建模体验而非孤立事实，可以将记忆从信息检索转向体验智能，从而支持持续的个人学习。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有基准不足以刻画真实移动场景中的长期记忆，因为用户的体验是异构、多模态、演化且高度个人化的，而下一代个人助理需要跨时间积累并利用这些经验。
summary_sections.method: 提出 MobileMem 基准与框架，采用知识引导的合成流程从用户-应用会话中构造连贯且时间一致的长期轨迹，并设计互补的文本与多模态任务来覆盖多跳推理、时序推理、知识更新和隐式偏好推断。

papers.title: Active Perception for Embodied Disambiguation
papers.abstract_en: Natural language provides robots with a flexible task interface, but target ambiguity in embodied environments arises not only from user intent; it can also result from missing taskrelevant physical evidence in the current observation. Existing interactive disambiguation methods primarily obtain additional information by asking the user, whereas occlusion, restricted viewpoints, unreadable text, and unobserved targets require the robot to actively change its observation. We propose an active-perception framework for embodied target disambiguation that uses active observation as the backbone for information acquisition and uses a vision-language model to decide, on the basis of accumulated visual evidence and interaction information, whether to continue observing, request clarification, or complete target selection. Active observation can both directly recover missing discriminative evidence and reveal object names, labels, and semantic attributes, thereby improving user clarification when it remains necessary. Real-robot experiments show that the framework combines physical information acquisition and userintent clarification within a unified embodied disambiguation process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具身环境中目标歧义不仅来自用户意图、也来自当前观测缺失任务相关物理证据的问题，提出以主动观察为主干的主动感知消歧框架。框架利用视觉语言模型根据累积的视觉证据和交互信息，决策继续观察、请求澄清或完成目标选择。真实机器人实验表明该方法将物理信息获取与用户意图澄清统一到同一个具身消歧流程中。
Motivation: 现有交互式消歧方法主要依赖询问用户来获取额外信息，但遮挡、受限视角、不可读文字和未观察到的目标要求机器人主动改变观测，这一需求未被现有方法覆盖。
Method: 提出一个主动感知框架，以主动观察作为信息获取的主干，并使用视觉语言模型基于累积视觉证据和交互信息在继续观察、请求澄清和完成目标选择之间做决策。
Result: 真实机器人实验显示，该框架能够将物理信息获取与用户意图澄清统一在同一个具身消歧过程中。
Conclusion: 摘要指出主动观察既能直接恢复缺失的判别性证据，也能揭示对象名称、标签和语义属性，从而在必要时改进用户澄清的效果。

papers.title: Cross-Disciplinary Taxonomy and Modeling of Misunderstanding Generation, Amplification, and Detection, from Pragmatics to AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Detection of misunderstanding is an urgent problem to solve because communication has moved away from real-time, in-person interaction and is increasingly handled by AI-mediated channels. This shift cuts communicators off from the resources repair depends on faster than new means of detection are being built. In this paper we analyse misunderstanding as a layered process in which a divergence is generated, may then be amplified, and is either detected and repaired or left to persist unnoticed. Consolidating accounts from nine fields of research that do not ordinarily cite one another, we identify eleven exact failure modes and show that each operates at a specific point in a communicative process rather than anywhere within it. Those points give eight analytical layers, derived from the literature rather than adopted from an existing model. Eight of the mechanisms primarily generate a divergence, two primarily amplify one already present, and one governs whether a divergence is detected and repaired. We model the eight layers formally, extending information and communication theory from the transmission of signals to the reconstruction of meaning, and we supply a source-by-source evidence matrix that makes every rating auditable, a coding manual, and nine analysed dialogue cases. No prior classification of misunderstanding both locates mechanisms at points in the process and types them by function.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables, 94 references. Cross-disciplinary conceptual synthesis across multiple fields. Includes a source-by-source evidence matrix in Appendix A and a coding manual in Appendix B for independent application of the taxonomy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个跨学科的误解生成、放大与检测分类法，将误解视为分歧产生、可能被放大、最终被检测修复或持续存在的分层过程。作者整合九个通常互不引用的研究领域，识别出11种失效模式并将其定位于通信过程的特定节点，归纳出8个分析层次，并用形式化模型将信息与通信理论从信号传输扩展到意义重建。论文还提供逐来源证据矩阵、编码手册和9个对话案例分析。作者称此前没有分类既定位机制又按功能分类误解。
Motivation: 通信从实时面对面转向由AI中介的渠道，交流者失去修复误解所依赖的资源的速度快于新检测手段的建设，因此误解检测成为紧迫问题。
Method: 综合九个领域文献，识别11种失效模式，按功能划分：8种主要产生分歧、2种放大既有分歧、1种决定分歧是否被检测修复；将这些机制映射到由文献推导的8个分析层次，并对其进行形式化建模，从而把信息与通信理论延伸到意义重建。附带可审计的逐来源证据矩阵和供独立应用的编码手册。
Result: 识别出11种失效模式和8个分析层次，并通过9个对话案例加以说明；同时给出使每项评级可审计的逐来源证据矩阵。摘要未报告量化实验结果。
Conclusion: 作者声称这是首个既将误解机制定位于通信过程节点、又按功能对其分类的分类体系；作为跨学科概念综合，其贡献在于理论分类与分析工具，而非实证检验。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Omni-LiveAvatar: Minute-Level Real-Time Streaming Joint Audio-Visual Avatar Generation
papers.abstract_en: Joint audio-video generative models serve as foundation for immersive and interactive digital-human generation. Nevertheless, most existing models rely on bidirectional attention and multi-step denoising and can generate only short clips, making them unsuitable for real-time interaction over extended durations. We present Omni-LiveAvatar, the first framework for minute-level, real-time streaming joint audio-video avatar generation. Specifically, we propose (1) a progressive autoregressive distillation pipeline that transfers a large bidirectional joint audio-video diffusion model into a few-step autoregressive generator without auxiliary stabilization mechanisms; (2) a synchronized audio-video long-short-term memory that preserves global consistency under a bounded memory budget; and (3) a hierarchical rolling prompt planning strategy that enables coherent semantic evolution and seamless prompt transitions. Extensive experiments show that Omni-LiveAvatar generates high-quality, synchronized minute-level avatars in real time. In terms of speed, it achieves a 33$\times$ generation speedup over its teacher, LTX-2, on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU; in terms of generation quality, it outperforms accelerated baselines across visual quality, audio quality, cross-modal synchronization, and human fidelity. Our code is available at https://github.com/Aoko955/Omni-LiveAvatar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Omni-LiveAvatar，号称首个支持分钟级、实时流式联合音频-视频数字人（avatar）生成的框架。作者将大型双向联合音频-视频扩散模型蒸馏为少步自回归生成器，配合同步音视频长短时记忆与分层滚动提示规划，实现长时间高一致性生成。摘要报告在单张 NVIDIA H200 上相比教师模型 LTX-2 获得 33 倍生成加速，并在视觉质量、音频质量、跨模态同步和人物保真度上优于加速基线。
Motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型依赖双向注意力和多步去噪，只能生成短视频片段，无法支撑长时间实时交互的数字人应用。
Method: 提出三条技术路线：渐进式自回归蒸馏（progressive autoregressive distillation），将大型双向联合音视频扩散模型转为少步自回归生成器且无需辅助稳定机制；同步音视频长短时记忆（synchronized audio-video long-short-term memory），在有界内存预算下保持全局一致性；分层滚动提示规划（hierarchical rolling prompt planning），实现连贯语义演化和平滑提示切换。
Result: 实验表明该方法能实时生成高质量、音视频同步的分钟级数字人。生成速度在单张 NVIDIA H200 上比教师模型 LTX-2 快 33 倍；生成质量在视觉质量、音频质量、跨模态同步和人物保真度上均优于加速基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法首次使分钟级实时流式音视频联合数字人生成成为可能，并开源代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hard Cases, Bad Labels: Testing Error Exposure and Error Location in Uncertainty Sampling Under Bounded Label Noise
papers.abstract_en: Active learning can reduce labeling cost by selecting informative examples, but the most uncertain examples may also be the hardest to label correctly. This study tests whether uncertainty sampling fails because it acquires more corrupted labels or because errors concentrated in difficult regions are especially harmful. Margin-based uncertainty sampling is compared with random sampling under clean labels, random classification noise (RCN), and bounded difficulty-dependent noise on three public binary tabular datasets. The design uses 100 paired seeds, nine expected noise rates from 0 to 0.30, annotation budgets from 20 to 120, and logistic regression with regularization re-selected by cross-validation at every budget. An exposure-matched RCN control aligns mean final acquired corruption, while a clean-label extension reaches budget 400. Under clean labels, uncertainty sampling improved normalized balanced-accuracy area under the learning curve by 1.09 to 1.77 percentage points on all datasets. Difficulty-dependent noise reduced this advantage more than RCN at six of eight rates on Breast Cancer Wisconsin, but at no tested rate on Banknote Authentication or MAGIC Gamma Telescope. Exposure-matched analyses found no corrected evidence for a universal additional penalty from structured error location. On clean MAGIC data, uncertainty sampling improved balanced accuracy while reducing average precision and true-positive rate at fixed false-positive rates. Thus, uncertainty sampling was label-efficient, but its apparent robustness depended on dataset, budget, noise structure, and evaluation metric.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/dev-juy/hard-cases-bad-labels
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在有限标签噪声条件下检验不确定性采样 (uncertainty sampling) 是否因获取更多错误标签而失效，或因为困难区域的错误格外有害而失效。作者在三个公开二分类表格数据集上，用成对种子设计了干净标签、随机分类噪声 (RCN) 和有界难度依赖噪声的对照实验，比较基于边际的不确定性采样与随机采样。结果表明不确定性采样在干净标签下始终更高效，但其鲁棒性随数据集、预算、噪声结构和评估指标而变。
Motivation: 主动学习通过选择信息量大的样本降低标注成本，但最不确定的样本往往也最难被正确标注。论文希望厘清不确定性采样性能下降的机制：是因为采集到更多被污染标签，还是因为困难区域的错误本身更具破坏性。
Method: 采用基于边际的不确定性采样与随机采样对比，在干净标签、随机分类噪声 (RCN) 和有界难度依赖噪声三种条件下进行实验；使用 100 对配对种子、9 个 0 到 0.30 的期望噪声率、20 到 120 的标注预算，并在每个预算下用交叉验证重新选择逻辑回归的正则化参数；另设暴露匹配 (exposure-matched) 的 RCN 对照，并将干净标签实验扩展至预算 400。
Result: 在干净标签下，不确定性采样在所有三个数据集上将归一化平衡准确率的曲线下面积提升了 1.09 到 1.77 个百分点。难度依赖噪声在 Breast Cancer Wisconsin 数据的八个测试噪声率中六个上比 RCN 更削弱该优势，但在 Banknote Authentication 和 MAGIC Gamma Telescope 上均未削弱；暴露匹配分析未发现结构化错误位置带来普遍额外惩罚的校正证据。在干净 MAGIC 数据上，不确定性采样提升平衡准确率的同时，降低了平均精度和固定假阳性率下的真正例率。
Conclusion: 不确定性采样是标签高效的，但其表现出的鲁棒性取决于数据集、预算、噪声结构和评估指标，不存在普遍的错误位置额外惩罚。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Continual Evolution Strategies in Control Tasks
papers.abstract_en: We study Evolution Strategies (ES) for continual control, where agents must adapt to changing tasks without forgetting previous ones. On sequential MuJoCo locomotion tasks, naive ES suffers from severe catastrophic forgetting. Replay substantially improves retention and can induce positive transfer, while larger replay budgets reduce plasticity. Overall, these results show that ES can support continual adaptation in control and that replay is an effective mechanism for mitigating forgetting.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the GECCO 2026 Companion Proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究进化策略 (Evolution Strategies, ES) 在持续控制任务中的表现，以顺序 MuJoCo 运动任务为基准。摘要显示朴素 ES 存在严重灾难性遗忘，重放 (replay) 能显著改善保留并可能带来正迁移，但更大的重放预算会降低可塑性。作者认为 ES 可以支持持续适应，重放是缓解遗忘的有效机制。
Motivation: 持续学习与控制结合时，代理需要在变化的任务间适应而不遗忘旧任务；现有 ES 在该场景下的遗忘程度与缓解机制尚未被充分研究。
Method: 采用 ES 作为优化器，在顺序 MuJoCo 运动任务上训练持续控制代理，并对比朴素 ES 与带重放缓冲的 ES 设置；通过改变重放预算考察保留、迁移与可塑性之间的权衡。
Result: 摘要报告朴素 ES 出现严重灾难性遗忘；重放显著改善任务保留，甚至能诱发正迁移，但更大的重放预算会降低可塑性。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是 ES 能够支撑控制任务中的持续适应，重放是缓解遗忘的有效机制；同时指出重放预算需要在保留与可塑性之间权衡。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Measuring Cross-Task Behavioral Consistency in Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent evaluation relies almost entirely on outcome metrics such as success rate, which capture whether an agent succeeds but not how consistently it behaves. We argue that behavioral consistency across tasks is a distinct and measurable property, and we introduce the Behavioral Consistency Metric (BCM) to quantify it. BCM trains a model to predict task success from behavioral features of agent execution traces, derives a per-trajectory feature-attribution vector, and measures the mean pairwise similarity of these vectors within an agent system. Across roughly 9,000 trajectories from six language model agents on software engineering tasks, our central finding is that cross-task and within-task consistency are distinct axes that can diverge: some systems are locally reproducible, behaving similarly on repeated attempts at one task, yet globally fragmented, with no stable strategy across different tasks, while others are consistent at both scales. Prior work measures only same-task reproducibility and so cannot observe this separation. We further find that consistency is not reducible to success rate, since systems with comparable success can differ sharply in consistency, and that the frontier-versus-open-source consistency gap persists under a within-task control that holds task difficulty constant. We position BCM as a process-level reliability signal that complements outcome metrics, and we are explicit about the conditions under which it is meaningful.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出行为一致性度量 (Behavioral Consistency Metric, BCM)，用于量化语言模型智能体在不同任务间的行为一致性，而不仅关注成功率等结果指标。BCM 先训练模型从执行轨迹的行为特征预测任务成功，得到每条轨迹的特征归因向量，再计算同一智能体系统内这些向量的平均成对相似度。基于软件工程任务上约 9000 条来自六个语言模型智能体的轨迹，作者发现跨任务一致性与任务内一致性是两个可能背离的维度，且一致性不能由成功率解释。
Motivation: 现有智能体评估几乎完全依赖成功率等结果指标，只能判断是否成功，无法刻画行为是否一致。作者认为跨任务行为一致性是独立且可测量的性质，而以往工作只测量同一任务内的可复现性，无法观察到这种分离。
Method: 提出 BCM 指标：训练一个模型根据智能体执行轨迹的行为特征预测任务成功，据此为每条轨迹生成特征归因向量，然后计算同一智能体系统内这些向量的平均成对相似度，以相似度高低表征行为一致性。
Result: 在约 9000 条轨迹、六个语言模型智能体上的实验表明：跨任务一致性与任务内一致性是可以背离的独立轴，有些系统局部可复现但全局策略不稳定；一致性无法化约为成功率，成功率相近的系统一致性可能差异很大；在控制任务难度的任务内对照下，前沿模型与开源模型之间的一致性差距仍然存在。
Conclusion: 作者将 BCM 定位为补充结果指标的流程级可靠性信号，并明确指出该指标有意义的具体条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Secret-Stego Dissimilarity as a Design Axis: Invertible Coverless Image Steganography with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Coverless image steganography (CIS) synthesizes a stego image rather than modifying an existing cover image, enabling authorized recipients to reconstruct the original secret image from the stego. Existing diffusion-based CIS methods can generate natural-looking stego images but preserve substantial visual similarity to the secret image. This resemblance risks exposing structural and semantic cues, giving rise to security vulnerabilities that cannot be evaluated solely via recovery fidelity. Achieving substantial visual dissimilarity between the secret and stego images without compromising stego quality and recovery fidelity remains challenging. To address this issue, we propose InvCISD, an invertible diffusion framework that couples the latent representations of the secret and an irrelevant reference image with an invertible network called LIMNet. We first train LIMNet in diffusion latent space, followed by end-to-end fine-tuning of the entire network, i.e., LIMNet integrated diffusion inversion and generation modules. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method substantially reduces secret-stego visual similarity, improves stego quality, and retains satisfactory secret reconstruction quality. Our further investigation shows that all evaluated methods are highly detectable by the CIS-oriented steganalysis model, indicating that resistance against targeted steganalysis constitutes a critical direction for future CIS research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InvCISD，一种面向无载体图像隐写的可逆扩散框架，目标是让生成的载密图像 (stego image) 与秘密图像在视觉上明显不同，同时保持载密图像质量和秘密图像重建质量。方法将秘密图像与无关参考图像的潜变量通过可逆网络 LIMNet 耦合，先在扩散潜空间训练 LIMNet，再端到端微调整个扩散反演与生成模块。实验显示该方法显著降低秘密图像与载密图像的视觉相似度，并改善载密图像质量。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的 CIS 方法能生成自然的载密图像，但载密图像与秘密图像仍保留大量视觉相似性，可能暴露结构和语义线索，带来仅靠重建保真度无法评估的安全隐患。在兼顾载密质量与重建保真度的前提下实现明显的视觉不相似性仍是挑战。
Method: 提出可逆扩散框架 InvCISD，用可逆网络 LIMNet 将秘密图像与无关参考图像的潜表示耦合，并在扩散潜空间训练 LIMNet，随后对包含 LIMNet、扩散反演和生成模块的整个网络进行端到端微调。
Result: 实验表明该方法显著降低秘密图像与载密图像之间的视觉相似度，提升载密图像质量，并保持令人满意的秘密重建质量。进一步研究发现所有被评估方法都能被面向 CIS 的隐写分析模型高度检测出来。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，针对定向隐写分析 (steganalysis) 的抵抗能力是未来 CIS 研究的关键方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Training-Free Knowledge Transfer Across Model Scales through Activation-Guided Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous model fusion seeks to combine models that differ in tasks, initializations, architectures, or scales. We study an underexplored cross-scale setting: improving a small recipient language model with a stronger donor despite substantial architectural mismatch. We ask whether useful capabilities can be transferred without explicit neuron-wise semantic alignment. Building on the observation that truncating a large model to a smaller architecture and injecting it with a tiny mixing weight can already improve the recipient, we propose Activation-Prune-Merge (APM), an activation-guided framework for cross-scale fusion. APM constructs task-conditioned activation maps on the donor, selects salient layers, hidden dimensions, attention heads, and MLP neurons to prune it to the recipient architecture, and injects the resulting donor slice into the original recipient using a micro interpolation coefficient. This formulation treats the donor as a source of concentrated functional components rather than requiring precise structural transplantation. Across 16 benchmarks spanning reasoning, mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and classification, APM improves the overall average accuracy from 55.5% to 60.6% over the original 3B recipient. RTE accuracy increases from 64.3% to 82.3%, QNLI from 52.3% to 65.7%, and BoolQ from 70.8% to 79.2%. Analyses of injection ratios and sequential multi-stage fusion further suggest that activation-guided extraction improves the quality of the transferable donor slice while preserving the small-ratio fusion regime. These results provide evidence that cross-scale heterogeneous fusion can succeed without explicit semantic alignment when the donor contribution is sufficiently concentrated and carefully selected.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究异构模型融合中的跨尺度场景：在存在显著架构差异时，用更强的 donor 模型改进较小的 recipient 语言模型。作者提出 Activation-Prune-Merge (APM) 框架，通过任务条件激活图选择 donor 的显著层、隐藏维度、注意力头和 MLP 神经元，将其剪枝到 recipient 架构后以微插值系数注入。在 16 个基准上，该无训练方法将 3B recipient 的平均准确率从 55.5% 提升到 60.6%。
Motivation: 现有异构模型融合通常需要显式的神经元级语义对齐，而跨尺度、架构不匹配场景下的能力迁移研究不足；作者试图回答能否在不做显式语义对齐的情况下实现有效迁移。
Method: 提出 APM 框架：在 donor 上构造任务条件激活图，据此选择显著的层、隐藏维度、注意力头和 MLP 神经元进行剪枝，使其匹配 recipient 结构；然后将得到的 donor 切片以微小的插值系数注入原始 recipient，形成无训练 (training-free) 的融合过程。
Result: 在涵盖推理、数学、代码生成、指令跟随和分类的 16 个基准上，APM 将原始 3B recipient 的平均准确率从 55.5% 提高到 60.6%；其中 RTE 从 64.3% 提到 82.3%，QNLI 从 52.3% 提到 65.7%，BoolQ 从 70.8% 提到 79.2%。注入比例分析与顺序多阶段融合实验表明，激活引导提取能提高可迁移 donor 切片的质量。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，当 donor 提供的功能成分足够集中并被仔细选择时，跨尺度异构融合可以在没有显式语义对齐的情况下成功；此方法将 donor 视为集中功能组件的来源，而非需要精确结构移植的对象。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Stable Miscalibration in Large Language Models: A Practical View of High-Confidence Errors
papers.abstract_en: High-confidence errors in large language models are often treated as evidence of fragile internal inference. We study a different possibility: stable miscalibration, where a confident wrong answer remains locally stable under small perturbations. We combine two diagnostics: a label-aware output-level audit score that ranks domains by confidence variation and overconfident mistakes under a forced-answer baseline, and an internal sensitivity probe that measures hidden-state movement. On a multi-domain binary factual audit set, this audit score tracks where abstention-aware self-critique reduces decision loss, although direct labeled baselines rank the same gain more strongly. Internally, self-critical prompting consistently reduces hidden-state sensitivity across layers in three open-weight models. This supports prompt-induced local stabilization rather than a purely output-level abstention pattern, but it does not imply calibration: audit-defined overconfident errors are not clearly more locally sensitive than confidently correct answers, so some high-confidence errors may be stable and miscalibrated rather than simply fragile.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML)@ICML 2026. 7 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨大语言模型中高置信错误的一种可能解释：稳定误校准（stable miscalibration），即错误的自信答案在小扰动下保持局部稳定。作者结合标签感知的输出级审计分数与内部敏感性探针，在多领域二元事实审计集和三个开放权重模型上检验这一假设。结果显示，自批判提示（self-critical prompting）能跨层降低隐藏状态敏感性，支持提示诱导的局部稳定化，但审计定义的高置信错误并不比正确高置信答案更局部敏感，因此部分高置信错误可能是稳定且误校准的，而非单纯脆弱。
Motivation: 高置信错误通常被视为模型内部推理脆弱的证据；本文提出另一种可能性：错误可能源于稳定的误校准，即错误答案在局部扰动下保持稳定，这挑战了将高置信错误直接等同于脆弱性的常见看法。
Method: 提出两种诊断手段：一是标签感知的输出级审计分数，在强制回答基线下按置信度变化和过度自信错误对领域排序；二是内部敏感性探针，测量隐藏状态在扰动下的移动，用于检测提示对局部稳定性的影响。
Result: 在多领域二元事实审计集上，审计分数能追踪放弃感知的自批判（abstention-aware self-critique）降低决策损失的位置，但直接标签基线对同一增益的排序更强。在三个开放权重模型中，自批判提示一致地降低各层的隐藏状态敏感性。
Conclusion: 实验结果支持提示诱导的局部稳定化（prompt-induced local stabilization），而非纯输出级放弃模式；但作者明确指出这不意味着校准良好——审计定义的高置信错误与自信正确的答案在局部敏感性上没有明显差异，因此某些高置信错误可能既是稳定的又是误校准的。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出两种诊断手段：一是标签感知的输出级审计分数，在强制回答基线下按置信度变化和过度自信错误对领域排序；二是内部敏感性探针，测量隐藏状态在扰动下的移动，用于检测提示对局部稳定性的影响。
summary_sections.result: 在多领域二元事实审计集上，审计分数能追踪放弃感知的自批判（abstention-aware self-critique）降低决策损失的位置，但直接标签基线对同一增益的排序更强。在三个开放权重模型中，自批判提示一致地降低各层的隐藏状态敏感性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 实验结果支持提示诱导的局部稳定化（prompt-induced local stabilization），而非纯输出级放弃模式；但作者明确指出这不意味着校准良好——审计定义的高置信错误与自信正确的答案在局部敏感性上没有明显差异，因此某些高置信错误可能既是稳定的又是误校准的。

papers.title: Robust XGBoosting for Regression
papers.abstract_en: XGBoost is a very popular and powerful method for prediction. It iteratively fits simple decision trees to the residuals of the previous step. An efficient and scalable implementation is available. The standard loss function for XGBoost is the quadratic loss, but a Huber loss can also be used. In this paper, we study the robustness of XGBoost and show that its performance can be affected by vertical outliers and leverage points. To address this, we explore alternative loss functions, based on M-, S-, and τ -estimators from robust regression. Our results indicate that a two-step procedure, referred to as MM-XGBoost, provides the best trade-off between robustness and prediction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 XGBoost 回归的稳健性，指出其性能会受到垂直离群点 (vertical outliers) 和杠杆点 (leverage points) 的影响。作者基于稳健回归中的 M、S 和 τ 估计量探索替代损失函数，并提出一个两步过程 MM-XGBoost。摘要报告 MM-XGBoost 在稳健性与预测精度之间提供了最佳权衡。
Motivation: 标准 XGBoost 使用二次损失或 Huber 损失，但在存在垂直离群点和杠杆点时预测性能可能下降，缺乏针对这类污染的稳健性研究。
Method: 在 XGBoost 的迭代提升框架中引入基于 M、S 和 τ 估计量的稳健损失函数，并设计一个两步估计过程 MM-XGBoost 来兼顾稳健性和预测精度。
Result: 实验结果表明，与标准 XGBoost 及其他稳健损失变体相比，MM-XGBoost 在稳健性和预测精度的权衡上表现最佳。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MM-XGBoost 是处理回归任务中离群点和杠杆点的有效选择，但摘要未给出具体数值或适用范围的限制说明。

papers.title: Context Aware AI Assistant and AR Interface for Lunar Extravehicular Activity (EVA) Procedural Guidance
papers.abstract_en: As human space exploration returns to the Moon, astronauts need rapid access to procedural information during extravehicular activities (EVAs), where attention is divided across navigation, repair tasks, tool handling, and environmental risk. The challenge is not the absence of information, but surfacing the right information at the right moment. We present GAIN-AI (Guided Assistant for Intelligent Navigation), a context-aware AI assistant and minimal heads-up interface for procedural guidance in simulated lunar EVA. The system operates in two layers. The first grounds a large language model with structured context: EVA procedure documents, live telemetry data, and error-handling protocols encoded as JSON. The second restructures that output into three compact units for AR display: Goal, Task, and Verification. Evaluated on 111 synthetic EVA scenarios, the system scores 10.0/10 on nominal conditions and 8.15/10 on single-fault scenarios, with performance degrading on multi-fault and boundary-threshold cases.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted to ACM SIGGRAPH 2026 Conference Posters, July 19-23, 2026, Los Angeles, California, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GAIN-AI，一个面向月球舱外活动 (EVA) 的上下文感知 AI 助手与 AR 界面，通过将大语言模型与结构化上下文（程序文档、遥测数据、错误处理协议）结合，并把输出重构为 Goal、Task、Verification 三个紧凑单元进行 AR 显示。系统在 111 个合成 EVA 场景中评估，标称场景得分 10.0/10，单故障场景 8.15/10，多故障与边界阈值场景性能下降。
Motivation: 宇航员在月球 EVA 中需要在导航、维修、工具操作和环境风险之间分配注意力，快速获取正确的程序性信息是关键挑战；问题不在于信息缺失，而在于如何在正确时刻呈现正确信息。
Method: 系统采用两层架构：第一层将 EVA 程序文档、实时遥测数据和错误处理协议编码为 JSON，为大型语言模型提供结构化上下文；第二层将模型输出重构为面向 AR 显示的 Goal、Task、Verification 三个紧凑单元。
Result: 在 111 个合成 EVA 场景中，系统在标称条件下得分 10.0/10，单故障场景得分 8.15/10，多故障和边界阈值场景下性能恶化。
Conclusion: GAIN-AI 展示了将大语言模型与结构化程序上下文结合、并通过 AR 界面提供简洁程序指导的可行性，但在多故障和边界阈值场景下仍有待改进。

papers.title: IterCOMP: Reasoning-aware Adaptive Prompt Compression for Multi-hop Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop question answering requires complex reasoning across multiple evidence segments, which often overwhelms retrieval-augmented generation systems with lengthy and noisy contexts, thereby undermining both efficiency and accuracy. While existing prompt compression methods attempt to address this issue, they are typically designed for single-turn queries and fail to capture interdependent reasoning steps. We propose IterCOMP, a unified, training-free prompt compression framework that incorporates multi-hop reasoning within an iterative compression loop. IterCOMP decomposes documents into evidence segments, evaluates question answerability, and generates targeted follow-up questions to iteratively integrate essential evidence, producing a compact, reasoning-oriented prompt. Experiments on MusiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA demonstrate that IterCOMP achieves substantial improvements in Exact Match and F1 scores while reducing the token budget, outperforming existing baselines and exhibiting robustness as reasoning complexity increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IterCOMP，一个无需训练的统一提示压缩框架，针对多跳问答 (multi-hop question answering) 中检索增强生成系统因上下文冗长嘈杂而效率与准确率下降的问题。IterCOMP 在迭代压缩循环中融入多跳推理：将文档分解为证据片段、评估问题可回答性并生成后续追问，以迭代整合关键证据，最终输出紧凑且面向推理的提示。在 MusiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA 和 HotpotQA 上的实验表明，该方法在降低 token 预算的同时显著提升 Exact Match 与 F1 分数，且随推理复杂度增加表现出鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有多跳问答依赖多个证据片段进行复杂推理，检索增强生成系统常被冗长嘈杂的上下文拖累，影响效率与准确率；已有提示压缩方法主要为单轮查询设计，无法捕捉相互依赖的推理步骤。
Method: 提出 IterCOMP，一个统一的、免训练的提示压缩框架，在迭代压缩循环内显式建模多跳推理。具体做法包括将文档分解为证据片段、评估问题可回答性、生成针对性的后续问题，从而迭代整合必要证据，产生紧凑且面向推理的提示。
Result: 在 MusiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA 和 HotpotQA 上的实验显示，IterCOMP 在降低 token 预算的同时取得 Exact Match 和 F1 分数的显著提升，优于现有基线，并在推理复杂度上升时保持鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将多跳推理纳入迭代压缩循环能够在压缩提示的同时提升多跳问答的性能与鲁棒性，且该方法无需训练即可部署。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: UltraArUco: A Lightweight Multilingual Library And Framework With Low-Latency Real-Time Marker-Based Tracking System For Mobile AR Interaction
papers.abstract_en: UltraArUco - a lightweight multilingual library and framework for low-latency, real-time marker-based tracking in mobile augmented reality. Unlike standard OpenCV-based implementations, UltraArUco introduces an optimized multilingual wrapper that reduces per-frame latency by five times, while maintaining high accuracy. Distributed Wi-Fi architecture provides portability, connects a mobile device (camera input) with a PC-based visual application, enabling responsive interactions. The framework is validated through an interactive piano simulation, where static ArUco markers on keys enable occlusion-based note triggering, and hand-mounted markers provide spatial gesture recognition. UltraArUco's system requirements make it perfect for resource-constrained mobile AR applications, demonstrating a viable AR music application without specialized equipment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UltraArUco 是一个面向移动增强现实的轻量级多语言库与框架，用于低延迟、实时的基于标记的跟踪。与标准 OpenCV 实现相比，该框架通过优化的多语言封装将每帧延迟降低五倍，同时保持高精度；分布式 Wi-Fi 架构将移动设备（摄像头输入）与 PC 端视觉应用连接，并通过交互式钢琴模拟验证了遮挡触发的音符与手部标记手势识别。
Motivation: 移动 AR 中的传统标记跟踪方案（如基于 OpenCV 的实现）在资源受限设备上延迟较高，难以支持实时交互，需要更轻量且低延迟的替代方案。
Method: 提出 UltraArUco，一个多语言封装框架，通过优化实现降低每帧处理延迟，并采用分布式 Wi-Fi 架构将移动端摄像头输入与 PC 端应用解耦，以提升便携性和响应性。
Result: 摘要报告该框架将每帧延迟比标准 OpenCV 实现降低五倍，同时保持高精度，并通过交互式钢琴模拟验证了其用于 AR 音乐应用的可行性，无需专用设备。
Conclusion: UltraArUco 的系统需求使其适合资源受限的移动 AR 应用，作者认为其展示了无需专用设备即可实现 AR 音乐应用的前景。

papers.title: From Prediction to Intervention: Personalized Meal-Level Glucose Regulation via an LLM Agent
papers.abstract_en: Personalized glucose regulation remains a central yet unresolved challenge in precision nutrition, as postprandial glucose response varies substantially across individuals. Existing approaches based on glycemic indices fail to adequately account for such heterogeneity and lack the mechanism to dynamically adjust meals based on personal physiological feedback. In this context, recent advances in LLM-based agents offer a promising direction, as they enable context-aware reasoning and iterative refinement. Inspired by this, we propose a physio-feedback agentic loop, a unified system that integrates individualized absorption modeling with dietary intervention to regulate glucose response. Specifically, we develop a Physiology-Aware Glucose Predictor to model individualized absorption dynamics through a learnable Temporal Physiological Absorption Decay Module. We then construct a Prediction-Driven Two-Stage Meal Optimization Agent that iteratively refines real-world meals using predicted outcomes as explicit feedback. Through extensive experiments on multiple public datasets, we demonstrate that our method not only improves prediction accuracy but also effectively reduces glucose excursions. To the best of our knowledge, this paper marks the first step in integrating physiological learning with an LLM-based agent for personalized glucose regulation.
papers.comment: Accepted in ACL 2026 Findings, 17 pages, 4 figures
papers.journal_ref: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics ACL 2026, pages 21629 to 21645
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种生理反馈智能体循环（physio-feedback agentic loop），将个体化吸收建模与膳食干预统一起来，用于餐后血糖调节。方法包含一个用于建模个体吸收动力学的 Physiology-Aware Glucose Predictor，以及一个以预测结果为显式反馈、迭代优化真实膳食的两阶段膳食优化智能体。在多个公开数据集上，该方法同时改善了血糖预测精度并减少血糖波动，作者称这是首个将生理学习与基于 LLM 的智能体结合用于个性化血糖调控的工作。
Motivation: 餐后血糖反应存在显著的个体差异，而基于血糖生成指数（glycemic index）的现有方法难以刻画这种异质性，也缺少依据个人生理反馈动态调整膳食的机制。
Method: 构建 Physiology-Aware Glucose Predictor，通过可学习的 Temporal Physiological Absorption Decay Module 建模个体化吸收动力学；并设计 Prediction-Driven Two-Stage Meal Optimization Agent，将预测结果作为显式反馈，对真实膳食进行迭代优化。
Result: 在多个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法不仅提高了血糖预测准确率，还有效减少了血糖波动（glucose excursions）。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是首次将生理学习与基于 LLM 的智能体集成用于个性化血糖调控，展示出预测与干预可在同一智能体循环中联合设计的方向。

summary_sections.result: 在多个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法不仅提高了血糖预测准确率，还有效减少了血糖波动（glucose excursions）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调这是首次将生理学习与基于 LLM 的智能体集成用于个性化血糖调控，展示出预测与干预可在同一智能体循环中联合设计的方向。

papers.title: Jais 2: A Family of Arabic-Centric Open Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Jais 2 is a family of Arabic-centric large language models developed jointly by MBZUAI, Cerebras, and Inception, designed to advance Arabic-centric language modeling, with strong performance across the Arabic and culturally grounded benchmarks evaluated in this report. The family includes, to our knowledge, the largest open Arabic-centric LLM trained from scratch at 70B parameters, and a competitive 8B-parameter variant among the evaluated open models. A custom Arabic-centric vocabulary enables efficient training and inference. In addition, an optimized architecture and training recipe yield highly compute-efficient training. With a substantially smaller token budget than comparable models, Jais 2 achieves strong Arabic performance on the benchmarks considered in this report and competitive English results. The models obtain leading results among the evaluated open models on OALL2 and AraGen. They also perform strongly on several culturally grounded Arabic benchmarks, including poetry, religion, cuisine, and dream interpretation, as well as in general tasks such as translation and summarization. We release the models in HuggingFace under a commercially permissive license. Jais 2 70B is also released as a chat app on the Web, iOS, and Android; it runs on Cerebras hardware, delivering up to 2,000 tokens per second, and enabling high-throughput Arabic-centric chat serving in our deployment setting. By uniting scale, linguistic diversity, cultural fidelity, openness, and speed, Jais 2 provides an open-weight foundation intended to support further research and development in Arabic-centric LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了由 MBZUAI、Cerebras 与 Inception 联合开发的阿拉伯语中心大语言模型家族 Jais 2，号称包含目前从零训练的最大开源阿拉伯语中心 LLM（70B 参数）以及一个有竞争力的 8B 变体。模型采用定制阿拉伯语词表并优化了架构与训练配方，在远小于同类模型的 token 预算下，于 OALL2 和 AraGen 等评测中取得领先结果，并在诗歌、宗教、烹饪、解梦等文化基准以及翻译、摘要等通用任务上表现良好。模型以商业许可发布在 HuggingFace，70B 版本还以聊天应用形式在 Web、iOS 和 Android 上提供，基于 Cerebras 硬件可达到每秒最多 2,000 tokens 的吞吐。
Motivation: 阿拉伯语中心语言模型领域缺少大规模、开放且兼顾语言多样性与文化保真度的基础模型，本文旨在通过联合规模、语言多样性、文化保真度、开放性和速度来推动该方向的研究与开发。
Method: 构建一个从零训练的模型家族，包含 70B 与 8B 两种规模的模型；采用定制的阿拉伯语中心词表以提升训练和推理效率，并通过优化架构与训练配方实现高计算效率的训练，同时使用比同类模型更小的 token 预算。
Result: 在评测的开放模型中，Jais 2 于 OALL2 和 AraGen 上取得领先结果，并在诗歌、宗教、烹饪、解梦等阿拉伯文化基准以及翻译和摘要等通用任务上表现强劲；70B 模型在 Cerebras 硬件上运行时支持最高每秒 2,000 tokens 的高吞吐阿拉伯语聊天服务。
Conclusion: 作者强调 Jais 2 作为开放权重基础模型，旨在支持后续阿拉伯语中心 LLM 的研究与开发；模型已在 HuggingFace 上以商业许可发布，70B 版本也提供了多平台聊天应用。

papers.title: BCMT: Blockwise Causal Memory Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Transformer architectures rely on dense self-attention to model long-range dependencies, but this mechanism exhibits quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length. We introduce BCMT (Blockwise Causal Memory Transformer), an architecture for long-context language modeling that decouples local token interactions from global context propagation. Dense causal self-attention is applied independently within local blocks, while each block produces an adaptive summary aggregated through an exponential causal memory. This memory is subsequently injected back into the token representations, enabling efficient propagation of long-range contextual information without relying on explicit global attention. Unlike standard Transformers and recurrent memory architectures, BCMT maintains neither dense interactions between distant tokens nor learned memory states. Its memory mechanism is fully parallelizable and remains compatible with standard implementations of dense self-attention. Experiments on language modeling with context lengths of up to 1024 tokens show that BCMT achieves validation performance comparable to that of Dense Transformers while significantly improving training throughput and reducing memory consumption. An ablation study further confirms that these improvements arise from the proposed memory mechanism. These results demonstrate that an exponential causal memory constructed from block summaries provides an effective alternative to dense global attention mechanisms for long-context language modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BCMT（Blockwise Causal Memory Transformer），一种用于长上下文语言建模的架构，将局部 token 交互与全局上下文传播解耦。局部块内使用密集因果自注意力，每个块生成自适应摘要，并通过指数因果记忆（exponential causal memory）聚合后注入回 token 表示，从而避免显式全局注意力。实验表明，在上下文长度至 1024 token 的语言建模上，BCMT 的验证性能与 Dense Transformer 相当，同时显著提升训练吞吐并降低内存消耗。
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 的密集自注意力随序列长度呈二次复杂度，难以高效建模长距离依赖；而现有循环记忆架构又依赖可学习的记忆状态。作者希望设计一种既无需全局密集交互、也不引入可学习记忆状态的并行化记忆机制。
Method: BCMT 在不相交的局部块内应用标准密集因果自注意力，每个块计算一个自适应摘要，这些摘要经过指数因果记忆聚合，再注入回各 token 表示以传播长程上下文。该记忆机制完全可并行化，且与标准密集自注意力实现兼容。
Result: 在上下文长度最高 1024 token 的语言建模实验中，BCMT 取得与 Dense Transformer 相当的验证性能，同时显著提高训练吞吐、降低内存消耗；消融研究确认这些收益来自提出的记忆机制。
Conclusion: 作者认为，由块摘要构造的指数因果记忆可以作为密集全局注意力的有效替代方案，用于长上下文语言建模。

papers.title: AI Evaluation Should Work With Humans
papers.abstract_en: This position paper argues that the dominant paradigm of AI evaluation (which focuses on superhuman autonomous performance and so implicitly targets the goal of replacing humans) is guiding AI development in the wrong direction. Instead, the AI community should pivot to evaluating the performance of human--AI teams. We argue that this collaborative shift will foster AI systems that act as true complements to human capabilities and therefore lead to far better societal outcomes than will the current process.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Position Paper Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 ICML 2026 Position Paper Track 的立场论文，认为当前 AI 评估的主导范式聚焦于超人类自主性能，隐含地以取代人类为目标，正在把 AI 发展引向错误方向。作者主张应转向评估人类与 AI 组成的团队 (human-AI teams) 的表现，认为这一协作式转变能促使 AI 系统真正补充人类能力，从而比现有过程带来更好的社会结果。
Motivation: 当前 AI 评估范式隐含追求用 AI 取代人类，作者认为这会误导 AI 发展方向；他们主张评估目标应转向人机协作性能，以引导 AI 成为人类能力的补充而非替代。
Method: 本文为立场论述，提出将 AI 评估的重心从超人类自主表现转向人类-AI 团队表现，并论证这一评估范式的转变会带来更有利于社会的 AI 发展方向。
Result: 未报告实验数据；核心论点是转向人机团队评估将引导 AI 系统成为人类能力的真正补充，并产生比现有评估过程更好的社会结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调 AI 评估应当与人类协作目标对齐，以人机团队绩效作为评估对象，从而实现更优的社会结果。

papers.title: BCIJelly: An integrated ecosystem for brain-computer interface research
papers.abstract_en: Brain-computer interface (BCI) research relies on multistage computational pipelines, yet progress remains constrained by fragmented data formats, heterogeneous decoder implementations and hardware-specific deployment toolchains, and researchers lack an integrated workflow. Here, we fill this gap with BCIJelly, a unified computational ecosystem that integrates 18 curated BCI datasets, 15 benchmark decoders and an algorithmic library of 80 reusable modules, an automated architecture search (AAS) procedure, and hardware-aware deployment through the toChip pipeline within a single Python framework. AAS constructs task-specific decoders without manual architecture design. It is further extended into a closed-loop mode guided by a large language model (LLM), which uses task specifications, module descriptions and search history to support multitask and cross-species decoding. The toChip pipeline compiles trained decoders for execution on neuromorphic chips, enabling energy-efficient deployment for BCI systems. An accompanying visualization software provides a graphical interface to the full workflow, making BCIJelly accessible without programming. We validate BCIJelly across five BCI paradigms (motor, visual, speech, emotion and auditory) with recordings from humans, macaques and mice, and single-task, multitask and cross-species decoding settings. BCIJelly establishes a unified and extensible infrastructure that bridges decoder development and hardware-aware deployment for BCI research.
papers.comment: 67 pages, 6 figures, 7 extended data figures, 20 supplementary tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BCIJelly，一个面向脑机接口 (BCI) 研究的统一计算生态系统，在单个 Python 框架内集成 18 个精选 BCI 数据集、15 个基准解码器、80 个可复用模块组成的算法库、自动架构搜索 (AAS) 流程以及通过 toChip 流水线实现硬件感知部署。AAS 可扩展为由大语言模型 (LLM) 引导的闭环模式，支持多任务和跨物种解码；toChip 将训练好的解码器编译到神经形态芯片上。作者在运动、视觉、语音、情绪和听觉五种 BCI 范式上，使用人类、猕猴和小鼠的记录，对单任务、多任务和跨物种解码设置进行了验证。
Motivation: BCI 研究依赖多阶段计算流程，但数据格式碎片化、解码器实现异构、部署工具链依赖特定硬件，研究者缺乏集成化工作流。
Method: 提出统一计算生态 BCIJelly，包含数据集与解码器整理、模块化算法库、可自动构建任务特定解码器的 AAS，以及引入 LLM 引导的闭环架构搜索和多硬件部署的 toChip 流水线，并配套可视化软件以支持无编程使用。
Result: 在运动、视觉、语音、情绪和听觉五种 BCI 范式上，使用人类、猕猴和小鼠数据，验证了 BCIJelly 在单任务、多任务和跨物种解码设置中的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 BCIJelly 建立了统一且可扩展的基础设施，桥接了解码器开发与硬件感知部署，为 BCI 研究提供一体化流程。

papers.title: Interactive Analysis of Global Explanations using Aggregated Class Activation Maps for Network Data
papers.abstract_en: Recent machine learning (ML) advances have demonstrated that deep learning (DL) achieves impressive results in different application domains, including the classification of computer network traffic to corresponding applications. However, the data frequently contains diverging patterns within a single predicted class. This presents a significant challenge to the ability to provide a clear and comprehensive explanation and emphasizes the necessity for tools capable of detecting and analyzing these patterns. Furthermore, the capacity to extract descriptive rules for classes is a crucial requirement in network traffic analysis and intrusion detection, particularly when leveraging advanced tools like next-generation firewalls. We provide a visual-interactive system that explains predictions of classes for network traffic. Global explanations derived from multiple samples of a given class contribute to understanding model predictions. Visualization of global explanations enables recognition of different patterns that offer experts a more comprehensive overview of its characteristics. We introduce a prototype that facilitates visual exploration and refinement of global explanations, enabling network experts to detect and refine new patterns for specific applications. These explanations support the identification of misleading features and the formulation of new rules for the management of networks. Our approach also aims at enabling ML experts to acquire new insights, including the possibility of separating or merging classes and the development of more accurate and reliable DL models. Our proposed prototype was evaluated by experts in machine learning and network analysis.
papers.comment: This paper is a preprint of a manuscript submitted to EuroVis 2025 that was not accepted for publication (it will be resubmitted soon)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向网络流量分类深度学习模型的视觉交互原型，利用聚合类激活图 (aggregated class activation maps) 提供全局解释，帮助检测同一预测类别内的不同数据模式。原型支持网络专家交互式探索和改进全局解释，以识别误导性特征并制定网络管理规则。作者通过机器学习和网络分析专家进行了评估。
Motivation: 深度学习在网络流量分类中表现良好，但单一预测类别内常存在不同模式，导致难以提供清晰全面的解释；同时网络流量分析和入侵检测需要能够为类别提取描述性规则。
Method: 提出可视化交互系统，从给定类别的多个样本中生成全局解释，并将类激活图聚合后进行可视化，使专家能够识别不同模式、细化全局解释，并据此发现误导特征或提出规则。
Result: 原型由机器学习和网络分析领域专家进行评估；摘要未报告具体定量指标，重点在于可用性和模式识别能力。
Conclusion: 该方法旨在帮助网络专家识别误导特征和制定网络管理规则，同时支持 ML 专家获得新见解，例如分离或合并类别、开发更准确可靠的深度学习模型。
Relevance: 5
