summary_sections.method: 提出可视化交互系统，从给定类别的多个样本中生成全局解释，并将类激活图聚合后进行可视化，使专家能够识别不同模式、细化全局解释，并据此发现误导特征或提出规则。
summary_sections.result: 原型由机器学习和网络分析领域专家进行评估；摘要未报告具体定量指标，重点在于可用性和模式识别能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法旨在帮助网络专家识别误导特征和制定网络管理规则，同时支持 ML 专家获得新见解，例如分离或合并类别、开发更准确可靠的深度学习模型。

papers.title: Agentao: A Governed Local-First Runtime for Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly operate as execution systems that invoke tools, modify local state, use persistent memory, and interact with external protocols. These capabilities make agents useful, but they also introduce risks related to over-privileged actions, weak auditability, prompt injection, tool poisoning, and uncontrolled side effects. This paper presents Agentao, a governed local-first runtime for tool-using LLM agents. Agentao separates model-generated action proposals from host-authorized execution through a layered architecture consisting of host-facing surfaces, a host contract, a runtime core, a permission-mediated tool system, and supporting subsystems for memory, replay, plugins, skills, sub-agents, and protocol integration. We describe the motivation, threat model, design goals, governance model, execution pipeline, and structured event interface of the system. Agentao does not provide formal safety guarantees; rather, it demonstrates how permissions, state, protocol boundaries, and execution traces can be made explicit runtime abstractions for building agents that are more governable, inspectable, and suitable for host-controlled local environments. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/jin-bo/agentao.
papers.comment: The code is publicly available at Github. We are conducting testing and analysis of this framework, and will provide experimental results and examples in future versions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentao，一个面向工具调用型 LLM 智能体的受治理本地优先运行时。其核心设计是将模型生成的动作提议与宿主授权的执行分离，并通过分层架构（宿主接口、宿主契约、运行时核心、权限介导工具系统以及内存、回放、插件、技能、子智能体和协议集成等子系统）实现。摘要强调该系统不提供形式化安全保证，而是把权限、状态、协议边界和执行轨迹显式建模为运行时抽象，使智能体更可治理、可检查并适合宿主控制的本地环境。代码已公开在 GitHub。
Motivation: LLM 智能体日益作为执行系统运行，会调用工具、修改本地状态、使用持久化记忆并与外部协议交互；这些能力带来过度授权动作、弱可审计性、提示注入、工具投毒和不可控副作用等风险，现有运行时的治理能力不足。
Method: 提出分层运行时架构，把模型动作提议与宿主授权执行分离；系统包含宿主面对的接口、宿主契约、运行时核心、经过权限介导的工具系统，以及内存、重放、插件、技能、子智能体和协议集成等支撑子系统，并设计了治理模型、执行流水线和结构化事件接口。
Result: 摘要未报告实验评测结果；论文目前以系统架构和设计描述为主，arXiv 说明指出作者正在进行测试和分析，将在未来版本中提供实验结果与示例。
Conclusion: Agentao 的价值在于证明权限、状态、协议边界和执行轨迹可以成为显式的运行时抽象，从而构建更可治理、可检查且适合宿主控制本地环境的智能体；作者明确说明该系统不提供形式化安全保证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A Year in LLM Serving: Workload Evolution, Caching and Load-Balancing
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) serving has become a critical cloud workload, and realistic traces are essential for motivating and benchmarking serving systems. However, existing LLM serving workload studies remain limited in scale and scope. They often observe short time periods and provide limited visibility into how users interact with models in production. As a result, they do not fully capture how LLM serving workloads evolve over time or how user-model interactions shape production traffic. In this work, we further the understanding of real-world LLM serving workloads through both a global characterization and a longitudinal study of a one-year production trace from Chutes. Unlike prior studies, our trace captures full production behavior across many models and users, including both popular and long-tail models. We analyze the workload from aggregate, temporal, model-level, and user-level perspectives, revealing workload evolution and user-model structure that are typically hidden behind aggregate views. To support future research, we will release the full one-year trace with the paper, enabling downstream studies of production behavior without relying on sampled or synthetically generated workloads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 Chutes 平台一年的生产流量 trace，对 LLM serving 工作负载进行全局刻画和纵向研究。与先前研究不同，该 trace 覆盖许多模型与用户的完整生产行为，包括热门模型和长尾模型。作者从聚合、时间、模型级和用户级四个视角分析工作负载，揭示聚合视图下隐藏的工作负载演变与用户-模型结构，并计划随论文发布完整一年 trace 供后续研究使用。
Motivation: 现有 LLM serving 工作负载研究在规模和范围上有限，通常只观察短时间窗口，对用户如何与生产环境中的模型交互可见性不足，因此无法完整捕捉工作负载随时间的演变以及用户-模型交互对生产流量的塑造作用。
Method: 对 Chutes 一年的生产 trace 做全局刻画与纵向研究，从聚合 (aggregate)、时间 (temporal)、模型级 (model-level) 和用户级 (user-level) 四个视角分析负载，并将发布完整的一年 trace，避免依赖采样或合成工作负载。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，主要发现是揭示出聚合视图下通常被隐藏的工作负载演变过程以及用户-模型结构。
Conclusion: 作者强调完整一年生产 trace 的发布可以支持后续对生产行为的下游研究，使研究者无需依赖采样或合成数据；本文定位偏向数据集刻画与分析，而非提出新系统方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Architect: Interactive Visualization of Deep Learning Mathematics Directly in Microsoft Excel
papers.abstract_en: We present The Architect, a system that turns Microsoft Excel into an interactive view of deep learning mathematics. A user describes a neural network in a compact table. The system then generates a workbook that shows the full forward pass and, when requested, the backward pass and parameter updates. Computed values appear as live spreadsheet formulas, while user-controlled values such as inputs, weights, labels, and hyperparameters remain editable. Excel reactively updates the dependent computations through its recalculation engine. Most deep learning tools hide the numerical details behind library calls. Many visualization tools show architecture diagrams or training summaries, but they do not expose the full arithmetic of the model. The Architect focuses on that missing middle layer. It makes matrices, activations, losses, gradients, and updates visible as inspectable spreadsheet regions, with editable controls for values users naturally manipulate. The system also produces aligned PyTorch snippets, which helps users connect formulas to implementation. This report describes the motivation, design, implementation, and use cases of The Architect. We show how the system supports introductory arithmetic tracing, learning-rate exploration, diagnosis of dying ReLU, and inspection of vanishing gradients. The main idea is simple: spreadsheets already support formulas, direct editing, reactive recomputation, and tabular layout. These properties make them a useful medium for understanding how small educational and diagnostic neural networks compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 The Architect，一个将 Microsoft Excel 变成深度学习数学交互视图的系统。用户以紧凑表格描述神经网络，系统生成包含前向传播、按需反向传播和参数更新的工作簿，计算值以实时电子表格公式呈现，输入、权重、标签和超参数保持可编辑，并依赖 Excel 重算引擎响应式更新。系统还生成对齐的 PyTorch 代码片段，用于连接公式与实现。
Motivation: 大多数深度学习工具将数值细节隐藏在库调用之后，许多可视化工具只展示架构图或训练摘要，没有暴露模型的完整算术过程。作者希望填补这一缺失的中间层，让矩阵、激活、损失、梯度和更新以可检查的电子表格区域呈现。
Method: 系统基于电子表格已有的公式、直接编辑、响应式重算和表格布局等特性，将用户描述的神经网络自动生成 Excel 工作簿，展示完整前向/反向传播并支持可编辑控制。同时生成对齐的 PyTorch 片段，帮助用户将公式与实现对应。
Result: 摘要展示了系统在若干用例中的支持能力：入门级算术追踪、学习率探索、dying ReLU 诊断和梯度消失检查。
Conclusion: 作者认为核心思想是电子表格天然适合理解小型教学和诊断神经网络的运算过程，该报告覆盖动机、设计、实现和使用场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Not All Tokens Are Equal: Inflation-Aware Routing for Agentic LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: When a language model fails to answer a query on the first attempt, an agentic system retries, consuming additional tokens each time. This retry overhead creates a gap between what a model's per-token price implies and what a full workflow actually costs. We call this gap \emph{token inflation} and define it as the ratio of true workflow cost to single-call cost. Systems like FrugalGPT route based on the latter, which can underestimate real cost by more than $2\times$ on difficult tasks. We address this with InflationAgent, a four-stage router that (1) measures token inflation systematically across model tiers and task types, finding inflation as high as $4.25\times$ for a 7B model on multi-hop question answering; (2) introduces CoT Branching Entropy (CBE), a pre-execution difficulty signal computed entirely from local inference, which predicts high inflation with AUROC 0.887; and (3) selects models by maximizing a Semantic Exchange Rate (SER) that divides expected accuracy by predicted true cost, with a fresh-escalation policy that discards failed chains before routing to a stronger model. On GSM8K under a fixed budget, InflationAgent achieves 94.7\% accuracy versus 91.0\% for FrugalGPT while using 31\% fewer tokens, and we show that forwarding a failed reasoning chain to GPT-4o reduces its accuracy by up to 34.8 percentage points, validating the fresh-escalation design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 token 膨胀 (token inflation) 概念，即智能体系统因重试而导致的真实工作流成本与单次调用成本之比，并据此构建四阶段路由器 InflationAgent。该路由器用 CoT Branching Entropy (CBE) 在预执行阶段估计难度，以 Semantic Exchange Rate (SER) 按预测真实成本选模型，并采用 fresh-escalation 策略丢弃失败推理链后再升级模型。在 GSM8K 固定预算下，InflationAgent 以 94.7% 准确率超过 FrugalGPT 的 91.0%，同时少用 31% token。
Motivation: 智能体系统在首次回答失败后会重试并消耗额外 token，使得按单次调用价格估算成本与真实工作流成本之间存在显著差距；现有路由系统如 FrugalGPT 基于后者做决策，在困难任务上可能低估真实成本超过 2 倍。
Method: 提出 InflationAgent 四阶段路由：先在模型层级与任务类型上系统测量 token 膨胀；引入 CoT Branching Entropy (CBE) 作为完全由局部推理得到的预执行难度信号；通过 Semantic Exchange Rate (SER)（预期准确率除以预测真实成本）选择模型；并采用 fresh-escalation 策略，在路由到更强模型前丢弃失败的推理链。
Result: 7B 模型在多跳问答上的 token 膨胀高达 4.25 倍；CBE 预测高膨胀的 AUROC 为 0.887；在 GSM8K 固定预算下准确率达 94.7%，优于 FrugalGPT 的 91.0%，并节省 31% token；将失败推理链直接转发给 GPT-4o 会使其准确率最多下降 34.8 个百分点，验证了 fresh-escalation 设计的必要性。
Conclusion: 路由决策应基于完整工作流的真实成本而非单次调用价格，且丢弃失败链后再升级模型能够显著减少推理损失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Think in Latent, Explain in Language: Self-Explainable Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning has emerged as a powerful alternative to text-based Chain-of-Thought (CoT), offering significant gains in computational efficiency by compressing verbose reasoning into compact embeddings. However, compressing reasoning into the latent space renders the thinking opaque, hindering its interpretability. Current methods present a stark trade-off: they either function as unexplainable ''black boxes'' (e.g., Coconut), where the latent reasoning is not human-readable, or rely on separate post-hoc decoders for explainability (e.g., Heima), introducing architectural overhead and decoupling the explanation from the actual reasoning process. In this work, we present a unified framework for Self-Explainable Latent Reasoning (SELR) that trains a single model to perform efficient and inherently explainable latent reasoning. Our core contribution is a novel multi-task training objective that optimizes for two goals simultaneously: (1) an Answer Loss that optimizes the latent reasoning trajectory to produce accurate final answers, and (2) a CoT Loss that explicitly trains the same model to decode its own latent representations back into human-understandable reasoning steps. This design ensures that generated latent representations are both task-effective and semantically interpretable, eliminating the need for external decoders. We validate the effectiveness of SELR on both Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs), demonstrating that SELR achieves superior token efficiency and accuracy compared to baselines, while uniquely providing self-contained explainability without auxiliary models. Project page is available at https://jasondayuan.github.io/SELR/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自解释潜在推理框架 SELR，让单一模型在潜在空间进行高效推理的同时，能将其潜变量解码为人类可读的推理步骤。方法在 LLM 和 VLM 上验证，相比基线在 token 效率和准确率上更优，且无需外部解码器，兼具可解释性与效率。
Motivation: 潜在推理虽然比文本 Chain-of-Thought 更高效，但压缩到潜在空间后不透明；现有方法要么成为不可解释的黑盒，要么需要额外的后处理解码器，引入架构开销并造成解释与实际推理过程脱节。
Method: 提出统一的多任务训练目标，同时优化 Answer Loss（保证潜在推理轨迹产生准确答案）和 CoT Loss（训练同一模型将自身潜表示解码为人类可理解的推理步骤），从而无需外部解码器即可获得自包含可解释性。
Result: 在大型语言模型和视觉语言模型上的实验表明，SELR 相比基线在 token 效率和准确率上取得更优结果，并独有地提供无需辅助模型的自包含可解释性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该设计使生成的潜表示既任务有效又语义可解释，证明了潜在推理与可解释性可以统一在单一模型框架中。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Does a Language Server Save Tokens for Coding Agents? A Measurement Methodology and Preliminary Study
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents spend most of their context budget on retrieval. Lexical retrieval (grep) is universal, instant, and zero-setup, but noisy: it cannot tell a definition from a call from a comment. Semantic retrieval via the Language Server Protocol (LSP) is precise and typed, but needs a running, indexed server and pays a per-symbol round-trip. The claim that semantic retrieval is more token-efficient is, we find, asserted almost everywhere and measured almost nowhere: no public source isolates the LSP-vs-lexical token delta for an agent at equal task-success. This paper formalizes the question with one metric (tokens-to-success), specifies a five-arm ablation isolating semantic retrieval from confounds, maps three pre-stated failure modes onto measurable variables, and reports a preliminary study (Python and TypeScript repos; Claude Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5). The answer is conditional and usually negative. On symbol-named localization the LSP costs tokens (+6% to +118%) and the agent ignores it when free. On reference-completeness it buys precision but not token savings and cannot raise the recall ceiling set by agent thoroughness; it saves tokens only for the weakest model. Tool choice is task-dependent: models default to grep on localization (0-6% semantic use) but reach for the LSP about half the time on reference tasks, unprompted. On edits scored by real test execution the gap is starkest: grep solves multi-file renames perfectly, a location-only LSP fails three-quarters of them by missing a call site, and even a complete, index-warmed, text-enriched LSP (each reference's line inline, as production LSP-MCP servers do) recovers most of the gap but cannot close it, since a rename must touch comments and strings that semantic references exclude. The implication is not LSP-always but an adaptive router keyed on task class, model capability, and lexical noise.

papers.title: Modular Cognitive Architecture Emerges in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The human brain exhibits a striking degree of functional specialization, with distinct networks supporting language, formal reasoning, reasoning about other minds, and reasoning about the physical world. Is this modular organization a fundamental principle of how intelligent systems must be built, or an evolutionary accident specific to biological brains? Here, we test whether a similar organization emerges in Large Language Models--another class of intelligent systems created through a very different optimization process. Using circuit analyses across N=46 tasks spanning four cognitive domains (language, formal reasoning, social reasoning, physical reasoning), we find that LLMs develop a modular architecture that mirrors the human brain: tasks drawing on the same network in humans recruit overlapping neurons in LLMs, whereas tasks drawing on different networks recruit distinct neurons. The convergent emergence of modularity in brains and neural networks suggests that it may be a fundamental property of intelligent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过电路分析 (circuit analyses) 检验大语言模型 (LLM) 是否自发涌现类似人脑的功能模块化组织。作者在覆盖四个认知领域（语言、形式推理、社会推理、物理推理）的 46 个任务上发现，LLM 的神经元招募模式与人脑功能网络对应：在人脑中共享同一网络的任务在 LLM 中招募重叠神经元，而调用不同网络的任务则招募不同神经元。作者认为这种趋同涌现表明模块化可能是智能系统的基本属性。
Motivation: 人脑表现出高度功能特化，不同网络分别支持语言、形式推理、他人心理推理和物理世界推理。论文要回答的问题是：这种模块化组织是智能系统构建的基本原则，还是生物脑进化中的偶然事件。
Method: 对 N=46 个跨四个认知域的任务进行电路分析，比较 LLM 中不同任务之间神经元招募的重叠程度，并与人脑功能网络的对应关系进行对照。
Result: 摘要报告 LLM 涌现出镜像人脑的模块化架构：在人脑中调用同一网络的任务在 LLM 中招募重叠神经元，而调用不同网络的任务招募不同神经元。
Conclusion: 模块化在生物脑和人工神经网络中的趋同涌现表明，模块化可能是智能系统的一个基本属性，而非生物脑的偶然特征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Don't Claim Benchmark-Oriented Optimization Improves General Coding Capability -- Diverse Evaluation Is Required
papers.abstract_en: Post-training papers, model cards, and blog posts often treat scores on a small set of coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench and LiveCodeBench) as evidence of broad coding capability, both for research artifacts and user-facing systems. We argue that optimization for these benchmarks leads to measuring task-specific performance, creating a meaning gap between measured scores and claims of general coding ability. We examine this gap with a Django-based case study benchmark suite we create. Evaluating foundation models and checkpoints post-trained on SWE-bench trajectories, we find that benchmark rankings frequently fail to generalize. Post-trained checkpoints show little cross-task transfer, and SWE-bench optimization yields limited or no gains on our tasks or on LiveCodeBench. Similarly, fine-tuning on individual Django modalities fails to transfer. We conclude that a small number of benchmarks is insufficient for evaluating diverse models under benchmark optimization pressure. We encourage the community to use differentiated evaluation - holistic assessment for frontier models, multi-task suites for research, and human-in-the-loop studies for narrow task applications. Finally, we argue for creating a capability taxonomy and sustained benchmark maintenance, rather than one-off benchmark releases. Without reliable evaluation standards, engineers and researchers using LLMs and agents have to rely on insufficient evidence to make research, development, and deployment decisions.
papers.comment: Accepted to the DL4Code workshop @ ICLR2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批评当前将少量编码基准（如 SWE-bench 和 LiveCodeBench）上的分数当作通用编码能力的做法，并用自建的 Django 案例研究套件验证了这一差距。作者发现基准排名常无法泛化，SWE-bench 后训练（post-training）在自建任务和 LiveCodeBench 上几乎没有提升，任务间迁移有限。文章呼吁采用差异化评估而非依赖单一基准。
Motivation: 论文针对的问题是：后训练论文、模型卡和博客常以少量编码基准分数推断模型的通用编码能力，导致测量分数与泛化能力声明之间存在语义鸿沟，影响研究、开发和部署决策。
Method: 作者构建了一个基于 Django 的案例研究基准套件，对在 SWE-bench 轨迹上后训练的基础模型和检查点进行评测，检验其跨任务迁移能力，并对比在单个 Django 模态上微调的效果。
Result: 摘要报告基准排名经常无法泛化；后训练检查点几乎没有跨任务迁移；SWE-bench 优化在自建任务或 LiveCodeBench 上增益有限甚至没有；针对单个 Django 模态的微调也无法迁移。
Conclusion: 少量基准不足以在基准优化压力下评估多样化模型，作者建议采用差异化评估：前沿模型用整体评估、研究用多任务套件、窄任务应用用人在回路研究，并呼吁建立能力分类法和持续维护基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Depth-Aware Sensitivity Analysis of Mixture-of-Experts Models via Magnitude-Based Expert Masking
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale large language models (LLMs) while preserving computational efficiency through sparse activation. Despite their widespread adoption, the relative importance of individual MoE layers remains insufficiently characterized, particularly for model compression. This paper presents a systematic layer-wise sensitivity analysis of the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model (40 MoE layers, 256 experts per layer, top-8 routing) using magnitude-based expert masking on the XLCoST cross-lingual code translation benchmark. We conduct a multi-phase study spanning 100, 300, and 500 prompt evaluation scales across three H100 GPU servers. Our central finding is that layer sensitivity is strongly depth-dependent: early layers (0-9) and middle layers (10-29) are highly fragile to expert masking, while late layers (30-39), and especially very-late layers (35-39), tolerate aggressive masking of low-magnitude experts. Flat all-layer masking at 30% retains only 150/300 Good+Similar outputs at 300-prompt scale, whereas late-focused policies retain 249-255/300 while masking 640-1,145 experts. On a later 500-prompt held-out validation slice, the narrow very-late policy (layers 35-39 @ 50%) achieves the strongest quality/masked-expert tradeoff among tested candidates, retaining 419/500 Good+Similar outputs while masking only 640 of 10,240 total experts. We additionally characterize top-k routing width reduction from 8 to 6 active experts per token, which shows a large observed wall-clock reduction on a 100-prompt probe with no Good+Similar loss, though it does not yet compose cleanly with aggressive expert masking. These findings provide an empirical foundation for depth-aware MoE expert masking and establish a practical path toward physical weight surgery, activation-based expert scoring, and training-based recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（40 个 MoE 层、每层 256 个专家、top-8 路由）在 XLCoST 跨语言代码翻译基准上做了基于幅度的专家掩蔽（magnitude-based expert masking）逐层敏感性分析。核心发现是层敏感性具有明显深度依赖性：早期层（0-9）和中间层（10-29）对专家掩蔽高度脆弱，而晚期层（30-39），尤其是极晚期层（35-39），能容忍对低幅度专家的大规模掩蔽。该工作为深度感知的 MoE 专家掩蔽提供了实证基础。
Motivation: MoE 架构通过稀疏激活扩展大语言模型并保持计算效率，但单个 MoE 层的相对重要性仍缺乏系统刻画，尤其是面向模型压缩的场景。
Method: 使用幅度基专家掩蔽对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 开展逐层敏感性分析，在三个 H100 GPU 服务器上进行 100、300、500 提示词规模的多个阶段实验；同时测试将 top-k 路由宽度从每个 token 8 个活跃专家减少到 6 个。
Result: 300-prompt 规模下，30% 的全层统一掩蔽仅保留 150/300 个 Good+Similar 输出；而侧重晚期层的策略在掩蔽 640-1,145 个专家的同时保留 249-255/300 个。500-prompt 独立验证切片上，极晚期策略（35-39 层 @ 50%）取得最佳质量/掩蔽专家数权衡：保留 419/500 个 Good+Similar，只掩蔽 10,240 个专家中的 640 个。top-k 从 8 降到 6 在 100-prompt 探针上显著降低墙钟时间且无 Good+Similar 损失，但与激进专家掩蔽结合时还不能干净地组合。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现为深度感知的 MoE 专家掩蔽提供了实证基础，并指出通向物理权重手术（physical weight surgery）、基于激活的专家评分和基于训练恢复的实用路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inducing Reward-Free Judging Rubrics that Reduce Over-Crediting in Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating language-model agents at scale increasingly relies on a second language model as an automatic judge, because the gold signal, an executable environment reward, is expensive, slow, or unavailable at deployment time. Such a judge is a reward-free proxy whose value depends on whether it can be trusted, yet existing judges either hand-write the scoring rubric, as in G-Eval, or fine-tune the judge's weights, and both tend to credit fluent but unsuccessful trajectories as successes. We instead induce the text of an agent-judging rubric from a small set of ground-truth-labeled trajectories, grounding it in true outcomes. We present RubricForge, which evolves a judge rubric by reflective evolution against labeled trajectories to maximize agreement with the environment reward, freezes it, and applies it to held-out trajectories in one model call with no environment access. The optimized artifact is human-readable text, so every verdict is attributable to named criteria. Using one frozen 7B model as both agent and judge, on tau-bench (173 labeled trajectories drawn from 220 rollouts) and WebShop (160), the principal gain is faithfulness rather than raw agreement. The edge over a generic G-Eval judge is not statistically significant (McNemar p = 0.248), and absolute-score calibration marginally favors the generic judge (|err| difference -0.048, p = 2x10^-4). Yet RubricForge over-credits failed trajectories roughly half as often (0.115 vs. 0.173 false-pass rate on tau-bench, with three over-credit catches and zero reversals) and ranks graded WebShop outcomes more faithfully (Spearman 0.410 vs. 0.370). For a reward-free evaluator the false-pass rate, not aggregate agreement, is the deployment-relevant quantity, since a false pass ships a broken agent whereas a false fail merely costs a retry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RubricForge，一种通过从少量带环境奖励标签的轨迹中演化出人类可读评判标准（rubric）的 LLM-as-a-judge 方法，用于评估语言模型智能体。使用同一个冻结 7B 模型作为 agent 和 judge，在 tau-bench 与 WebShop 上，相比通用 G-Eval 其原始一致性无统计显著提升，但显著降低了对失败轨迹的过度信任（false-pass rate），并提升排名忠实性。作者强调无奖励评估器部署时真正重要的是假阳性率而非总体一致性。
Motivation: 大规模评估语言模型智能体时，环境奖励作为金标准往往昂贵、缓慢或部署时不可用，因此依赖第二语言模型作为自动裁判。现有方法要么手写评分标准（如 G-Eval），要么微调裁判权重，两者都倾向于将流畅但未成功的轨迹判为成功，导致过度信任（over-crediting）。
Method: RubricForge 从一小批带 ground-truth 标签的轨迹出发，通过反思式演化（reflective evolution）迭代优化裁判文本，使其与环境奖励的判定一致性最大化；随后冻结该标准，在无需环境访问的单次模型调用中应用于未见轨迹。最终产物是人类可读文本，每次判定都可归因到具名标准。
Result: 在 tau-bench（220 次 rollout 中取 173 条带标签轨迹）和 WebShop（160 条）上，RubricForge 相对通用 G-Eval 的原始一致性优势不具备统计显著性（McNemar p = 0.248），绝对分数校准甚至稍差（|err| 差 -0.048，p = 2×10⁻⁴）。但其在 tau-bench 上的 false-pass rate 约减半（0.115 对 0.173），并有三例过度信任被纠正、零例反转；在 WebShop 上排序更忠实（Spearman 0.410 对 0.370）。
Conclusion: 作者主张对于无奖励评估器，false-pass rate（把失败轨迹判为成功）是部署相关指标：假通过会放出有缺陷的 agent，而假失败仅浪费一次重试。摘要将本文贡献定位为提升评估的忠实性（faithfulness）而非原始一致性，并承认一致性增益不显著、校准略逊于通用裁判。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Proxy-Validated LLM UX Micro-Simulations: An Artifact-First Protocol for Early-Stage Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Early-stage teams often lack users, time, and budget to run repeated UX studies, yet still need decision-oriented signals to iterate safely. We study an LLM-driven UX micro-simulation pipeline that generates structured customer-experience feedback (walkthrough steps, friction points, micro-survey signals) from versioned prompts, personas, tasks, and UI snapshots. Because public usability datasets with task outcomes are scarce, we validate simulated friction themes using multiple public proxy corpora (app reviews, support tweets, and open-source software issues). We propose a lightweight proxy-validation protocol with two alignment metrics: top-k Jaccard and distributional weighted-Jaccard (W), and compare lexical, TF-IDF, and multilingual embedding baselines across six proxy datasets. Embedding-based alignment yields higher W than lexical baselines on primary app-review and support-tweet proxies (e.g., W=0.128 vs 0.000 on Gojek), while top-k Jaccard is shown to overstate alignment at large k. We ablate four agent strategies (single-pass, best-of-N, hybrid, and a proposed score-then-select judge) across Azure OpenAI deployments and report bootstrap confidence intervals over 8 method-dataset pairs; these intervals reveal that the embedding W point estimate is systematically unstable under resampling at our subsample size. We also provide a failure-mode analysis of grounding and fabrication proxies, with documented calibration caveats and worked examples of outputs flagged as fabricated by an adversarial judge. Our artifact-first pipeline produces reproducible tables and figures from versioned run artifacts, supporting iterative prompt and taxonomy refinement before final paid-model calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一种由 LLM 驱动的 UX 微仿真 (micro-simulation) 流水线，用版本化的 prompts、personas、任务和 UI 快照生成结构化的客户体验反馈（walkthrough 步骤、摩擦点、微调查信号）。由于公开可用性数据集中任务级结果稀缺，作者提出轻量级代理验证协议，用多个公开代理语料（应用评论、支持推文、开源软件 issue）验证仿真摩擦主题，并比较词法、TF-IDF 和多语言 embedding 基线。结果显示 embedding 对齐在主代理集上优于词法基线，但 bootstrap 置信区间表明其在当前子样本量下不稳定。
Motivation: 早期团队往往缺少用户、时间和预算来开展重复的 UX 研究，但仍需要面向决策的信号来安全迭代。
Method: 提出 artifact-first 的 LLM UX 微仿真流水线，并设计代理验证协议，采用 top-k Jaccard 与分布加权 Jaccard (W) 两种对齐指标；比较词法、TF-IDF、多语言 embedding 基线在六个代理数据集上的表现，并对四种 agent 策略（single-pass、best-of-N、hybrid、score-then-select judge）进行消融。
Result: Embedding 对齐在主代理集（应用评论与支持推文）上比词法基线产生更高的 W（例如 Gojek 上 W=0.128 vs 0.000），而 top-k Jaccard 在大 k 时会高估对齐；对 8 个方法-数据集对的 bootstrap 置信区间显示 embedding W 在重采样下系统性不稳定，并给出 grounding 和 fabrication 失败模式分析。
Conclusion: 本文强调轻量代理验证只适用于早期决策支持，并记录了校准注意事项；artifact-first 流水线可从版本化运行产物生成可复现的表格和图表，支持在最终付费模型校准前进行迭代式 prompt 与分类法改进。

papers.title: L-FNO: Lorentzian Fourier Neural Operator for Stochastic Event Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Modern operational systems face uncertainty even in routine conditions, where rare, bursty, and self-exciting events emerge from both exogenous covariates and endogenous event dynamics. Standard neural operators are typically trained as regression-style function-to-function models rather than conditional-intensity estimators, limiting their suitability for sparse event regimes. We introduce the Lorentzian Fourier Neural Operator (L-FNO), a stochastic neural operator that combines an FNO-style covariate path, Lorentzian spectral kernels for history-dependent excitation, and a likelihood-based training objective. We evaluate L-FNO on eight synthetic point-process benchmarks and three real-world datasets covering disease outbreak prediction and semiconductor fault or defect detection. L-FNO improves event likelihood, calibration diagnostics, and rare-event detection over regression- and likelihood-based neural operator baselines. These results show that structured spectral memory and likelihood-based learning provide effective inductive biases for neural operator models of stochastic event dynamics.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 5 figures (9 pages for the main text)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lorentzian Fourier Neural Operator (L-FNO)，一种用于随机事件动力学的随机神经算子。它将 FNO 风格的协变量路径、用于历史依赖激发的 Lorentzian 谱核以及基于似然的训练目标结合，在八个合成点过程基准和三个真实数据集上提升事件似然、校准诊断和稀有事件检测。
Motivation: 标准神经算子通常被训练为回归式的函数到函数模型，而非条件强度估计器，这在稀疏事件场景下适用性受限；现代运行系统在常规条件下也会出现由外生协变量和内生事件动力学共同驱动的稀有、突发和自激事件。
Method: L-FNO 将 FNO 风格的协变量路径与 Lorentzian 谱核相结合以建模历史依赖的激发，并采用基于似然（likelihood-based）的训练目标进行学习。
Result: 在八个合成点过程基准和三个真实数据集（涵盖疾病暴发预测和半导体故障或缺陷检测）上，L-FNO 在事件似然、校准诊断和稀有事件检测上优于基于回归和基于似然的神经算子基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为结构化谱记忆和基于似然的学习为神经算子建模随机事件动力学提供了有效的归纳偏置。
